text.title: 血之沙
text.objectives: 在暮光高地的暮光海滩上干掉12名滩头堡陆战队员。
text.description: 我们在暮光高地的战略目标是横扫暮光堡垒，但是联盟却横插一脚，决定与我们为敌。$B$B既然如此，就给他们战争！$B$B杀死联盟的陆战队员，直到他们知道我们的厉害。
text.completion: Good, good. Let them reap what they sow!
text.completed: Return to Rok'tar on the Twilight Shores in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Blood on the Sand
english.objectives: Slay 12 Highbank Marines on the Twilight Shores in Twilight Highlands.
english.description: Our objective in the Twilight Highlands is to storm the Bastion of Twilight, but the Alliance have decided to make war.$B$BSo we will give them war!$B$BSlay their marines until the lesson is learned.
english.completion: Good, good. Let them reap what they sow!
english.completed: Return to Rok'tar on the Twilight Shores in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 内部攻破
text.objectives: 打开提尔之手修道院藏书房和武器大厅的银色传送门。
text.description: 在试图打开这座修道院里的传送门时，我们损失了几个人。你证明了自己不仅身手敏捷，而且身经百战……现在我要你再接再厉。$b$b修道院有两部分：藏书房和武器大厅。在这两部分里，你都可以找到一扇传送门。$b$b在传送门上用这颗钥石。如此一来就能强行打开它们，让我们余下的突击部队拿下这座修道院。
text.completion: The abbey will fall shortly.  We can soon move on, deeper into Tyr's Hand.
text.completed: Return to Crusade Commander Eligor Dawnbringer at Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Victory From Within
english.objectives: Open the Argent Portals in the Library Wing and the Hall of Arms within the abbey in Tyr's Hand.
english.description: A few of our men didn't make it through portals which were supposed to open inside this very abbey.  You've already proven your elusiveness and battlehardiness... now I need you to do so again.$b$bThe abbey has two wings: a library, and a hall of arms.  In each wing, you should find a portal.$b$bUse this keystone on these portals.  Doing so should force them open, allowing our remaining shock troopers to take this abbey.
english.completion: The abbey will fall shortly.  We can soon move on, deeper into Tyr's Hand.
english.completed: Return to Crusade Commander Eligor Dawnbringer at Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands.

starters.name: 十字军指挥官埃里戈尔·黎明使者

enders.name: 十字军指挥官埃里戈尔·黎明使者

objectiveDetails.description: 打开武器大厅的传送门

text.title: 杀手
text.objectives: 干掉提尔之手修道院钟楼里的杀手洛汗。
text.description: 血色十字军的命运是悲剧的，也是讽刺的。他们曾经冲在人类对抗亡灵的最前线。而现在，他们就像往日自己猎杀的那些行尸走肉一般。是什么让他们堕落成活死人一般，这点还无人得知，但他们依然危险这点是不变的。$b$b他们中最致命的是一个叫做洛汗的杀手。我们有情报称他就在这座修道院的钟楼顶上。找到他把他杀掉，$n。尽量别死在路上了。
text.completion: The death of Rohan eases my spirits a bit. I once fought beside him, you know.  He was an emissary of the Scarlet Crusade; one of the few that deigned to join us in our battle against Kel'thuzad, so many years ago.  How quickly things change.
text.completed: Return to Crusade Commander Eligor Dawnbringer at Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands.
text.giverWindow: 盗贼大师，荣誉尽失。

english.title: The Assassin
english.objectives: Kill Rohan the Assassin within the abbey bell tower in Tyr's Hand.
english.description: The fate of the Scarlet Crusade is tragic, if somewhat ironic.  At one point, they led the charge of humanity against the undead.  Now, they resemble those corpses that they once hunted.  What caused their descent into undeath isn't certain, but it doesn't make them any less dangerous.$b$bOne of their deadliest was an assassin who went by the name of Rohan.  We have intel that places him atop the bell tower in this very abbey.  Find him and kill him, $n.  And try not to die on the way.
english.completion: The death of Rohan eases my spirits a bit. I once fought beside him, you know.  He was an emissary of the Scarlet Crusade; one of the few that deigned to join us in our battle against Kel'thuzad, so many years ago.  How quickly things change.
english.completed: Return to Crusade Commander Eligor Dawnbringer at Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.giverWindow: A master rogue, bereft of honor.

starters.name: 十字军指挥官埃里戈尔·黎明使者

enders.name: 十字军指挥官埃里戈尔·黎明使者

text.title: 抢救血色财产
text.objectives: 获得赤红野猪、莉安娜的宝石串、乌瑟尔的罩布以及格文拉德的图章。
text.description: 战斗还没开始就已经结束了。现在，我们只是在玩点花式。$b$b兵营里面哭哭啼啼的血色十字军揪着他们无价的神器不肯放开，哪怕有些已经过于神圣，不适合他们如今的亡灵爪子去碰了。于是他们就把东西锁在箱子里，不让别人看见。$b$b你要找到这些神器，把它们带给我。它们的归属应该是银色北伐军战士。它们应该属于正义的人。
text.progress: I hope you gave them a fight.
text.completion: Well done, $n.  I will deliver these to Tyrosus when we return.
text.completed: Return to Crusade Commander Korfax at Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: Scarlet Salvage
english.objectives: Obtain the Crimson Boar, Lihanna's Strand, the Shroud of Uther, and Gavinrad's Sigil.
english.description: This battle was won before it started.  Right now, we're just shooting for style points.$b$bWithin these barracks, the sniveling Scarlet Crusaders cling to their priceless artifacts, even though some of the objects are too holy for their now-undead hand to touch.  So they keep them in chests, hidden from the world.$b$bYou will find these artifacts, and bring them back to me.  They belong to be among the Argent Crusade.  They belong in the hands of the righteous.
english.progress: I hope you gave them a fight.
english.completion: Well done, $n.  I will deliver these to Tyrosus when we return.
english.completed: Return to Crusade Commander Korfax at Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands.

starters.name: 十字军指挥官科尔法克斯

enders.name: 十字军指挥官科尔法克斯

text.title: 愤怒者
text.objectives: 杀死愤怒者玛塔乌斯。
text.description: 血色十字军一个更为邪恶的成员，愤怒者玛塔乌斯，就潜藏在兵营的地牢里。地下非常适合他那黑暗的心态。$b$b如果我再年轻些，还在前线的话，我就亲自把他干掉。而实情是，我被留在后方指挥我们的军队。所以我只要把荣幸交给你了。
text.completion: You are well on your way to becoming a true champion of the Light, $n.  Well done.
text.completed: Return to Crusade Commander Korfax at Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands.
text.giverWindow: 扭曲而病态的灵魂。

english.title: The Wrathcaster
english.objectives: Slay Mataus the Wrathcaster.
english.description: One of the more vile members of the Scarlet Crusade, Mataus the Wrathcaster, lurks within the barracks' dungeon.  Undeath suits his dark manner.$b$bWere I younger and on the front lines, I'd run him through myself.  As things are, I'm left behind to lead our forces from the rear.  So I leave the pleasure to you.
english.completion: You are well on your way to becoming a true champion of the Light, $n.  Well done.
english.completed: Return to Crusade Commander Korfax at Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.giverWindow: A sick and twisted soul.

starters.name: 十字军指挥官科尔法克斯

enders.name: 十字军指挥官科尔法克斯

text.title: 猎手
text.objectives: 杀死猎手雷奥普德。
text.description: 我们的人在要塞的枪林弹雨中损失了大半。我还没见着开火的敌人长什么样呢，不过也用不着。我知道上面那人的名字。$b$b雷奥普德。$b$b没错，上面只有一个人，挨个儿地把我的人都干掉了。而在我看来，你也只有一个。$b$b听上去像是一次公平的战斗。
text.completion: One less thing to worry about.  Nice work up there.
text.completed: Return to Crusade Commander Korfax at Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands.
text.giverWindow: 致命的远程猎手。

english.title: The Huntsman
english.objectives: Slay Huntsman Leopold.
english.description: We've already lost half a dozen men to a hail of bullets and arrows coming from atop this fortress.  I haven't seen the face of the enemy that's firing, but I don't need to.  I know the name of the man up there.$b$bLeopold.$b$bThat's right, there's only one man up there, picking off my men one-by-one.  And from what I can see, there's only one of you.$b$bSounds like a fair fight to me.
english.completion: One less thing to worry about.  Nice work up there.
english.completed: Return to Crusade Commander Korfax at Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.giverWindow: Deadly with any weapon at range.

starters.name: 十字军指挥官科尔法克斯

enders.name: 十字军指挥官科尔法克斯

text.title: 不再污秽
text.objectives: 去找东瘟疫之地提尔之手的大法师安吉拉·杜萨图斯。
text.description: 你能感觉到么？污染已经从这幢建筑上消失了。$b$b神圣的建筑就是神圣的，像洛汗和其他血色混账这样的坏人只能将其压住一时。$b$b拿下修道院后，我们距离占领提尔之手又近了一步。把战果报告给安吉拉。她应该在镇中央某处带人朝大教堂冲锋。
text.completion: Good, the abbey is ours.  I never doubted Eligor's ability for a moment.

english.title: Befouled No More
english.objectives: Report to Archmage Angela Dosantos at Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: Can you sense it?  The taint is already lifting from this building.$b$bA holy building wants to be holy, and villains like Rohan and the rest of his Scarlet scum only hold it back.$b$bWith the abbey secure, we are a step closer to taking Tyr's Hand.  Report the results of our strike to Angela.  She should be leading the charge on the cathedral from somewhere in the center of town.
english.completion: Good, the abbey is ours.  I never doubted Eligor's ability for a moment.

starters.name: 十字军指挥官埃里戈尔·黎明使者

enders.name: 大法师安吉拉·杜萨图斯

text.title: 银色动荡
text.objectives: 去找东瘟疫之地提尔之手的大法师安吉拉·杜萨图斯。
text.description: 我得说，咱们把这些兵营打成这样，也算是胜利了。一个指挥官、一个猎手，还有一个术士，全给杀了……更不用说我们解放出来的圣物。或者我该说……是你解放出来的。$b$b大教堂还在，不过撑不了多久了。去跟安吉拉·杜萨图斯谈谈。提尔之手大教堂的命运就掌握在她无所不能的手里。
text.completion: It sounds like Korfax really cleaned house over at the barracks.  It's very much like him to show off like that.

english.title: Argent Upheaval
english.objectives: Report to Archmage Angela Dosantos at Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: I'll say we've done enough damage to these barracks to call this a win.  A commander, a huntsman, and a warlock, all slain... not to mention the relics that we've liberated.  Or shall I say... YOU liberated.$b$bThe cathedral still remains, but not for long.  Talk with Archmage Angela Dosantos, in the central courtyard.  The fate of Tyr's Hand's cathedral falls in her able hands.
english.completion: It sounds like Korfax really cleaned house over at the barracks.  It's very much like him to show off like that.

starters.name: 十字军指挥官科尔法克斯

enders.name: 大法师安吉拉·杜萨图斯

text.title: 指挥官
text.objectives: 杀死血色指挥官玛尔兰。
text.description: 血色指挥官玛尔兰狡猾、精明、为了赢得战斗不择手段。但首要的是，她十分忠诚。$b$b毫无疑问，你可以在兵营中央大厅里找到她，在血红的旗帜下战斗，直到她胜利或是死亡。$b$b一定要让结果是后者。
text.completion: Good, good.  These barracks are as good as fallen.
text.completed: Return to Crusade Commander Korfax at Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands.
text.giverWindow: 她已经没有任何东西可以失去了。

english.title: The Commander
english.objectives: Slay Scarlet Commander Marjhan.
english.description: Scarlet Commander Marjhan is cunning, shrewd, and willing to do anything to win a battle.  Before all these things, however, she is loyal.$b$bI have no doubt you'll find her in the barracks' central chamber, fighting under a crimson banner, until she either wins or dies.$b$bMake sure it's the latter.
english.completion: Good, good.  These barracks are as good as fallen.
english.completed: Return to Crusade Commander Korfax at Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.giverWindow: She has nothing left to lose.

starters.name: 十字军指挥官科尔法克斯

enders.name: 十字军指挥官科尔法克斯

text.title: 如同鼠辈
text.objectives: 杀死十字军领主瓦德玛尔。
text.description: 好吧，很高兴埃里戈尔和科尔法克斯还是留了点乐子给我。他们身陷其中的鏖战正好让他们无法莽撞地冲进这座大教堂的中央。$b$b毕竟，这是你的职责。$b$b大教堂就在前面，血色势力最后的一处堡垒。在那里，十字军领主瓦德玛尔坐镇在那个摇摇欲坠、由谎言搭成的布道坛上。$b$b他将无处可逃，我们也不会心慈手软。血色十字军伪善的残余将在这里终结。杀掉他。
text.completion: While I can't agree with their methods, I can't argue with their results.  In many ways, the Scarlet were well-intentioned, but their zeal grew too strong, and their hate blinded them to reason. I only hope that the same doesn't happen to our Brotherhood of Light.
text.completed: Return to Leonid Barthalomew the Revered at Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.
text.giverWindow: 强者之陨。

english.title: Like Rats
english.objectives: Slay Crusader Lord Valdelmar.
english.description: Well, I'm glad that Eligor and Korfax left some fun for me.  It was a battle unto itself to keep them from rushing headlong into the middle of this cathedral.$b$bThat's YOUR job, after all.$b$bThe cathedral lies ahead of us, the last real bastion of Scarlet power remaining.  Within it, Crusader Lord Valdelmar sits atop Tyr's Hand's crumbling pulpit of lies.$b$bThere will be no escape; there will be no mercy.  The last simpering vestiges of the Scarlet Crusade end here.  Slay him.
english.completion: While I can't agree with their methods, I can't argue with their results.  In many ways, the Scarlet were well-intentioned, but their zeal grew too strong, and their hate blinded them to reason. I only hope that the same doesn't happen to our Brotherhood of Light.
english.completed: Return to Leonid Barthalomew the Revered at Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.giverWindow: How the mighty have fallen.

starters.name: 大法师安吉拉·杜萨图斯

text.title: 焰须巡逻营
text.objectives: 前往暮光高地的焰须巡逻营，找到科甘·焰须。
text.description: 我原本打算去焰须巡逻营报到的，就在赶往那里的途中，我的坐骑被敌人击落了。$B$B暮光之锤对整个暮光高地发动了突袭。他们的建筑物竟然直接从村子中央的地下冒了出来。那真是一场噩梦！$B$B混乱过后，焰须成为少数几名幸存者之一。他正试图招募幸存者组织狮鹫之翼。$B$B如果你希望蛮锤矮人也加入联盟的阵营，就去西边帮助焰须吧。
text.completion: Come to join the patrol, lad? Glad to have ya. I need some bodies helpin' to get our defenses under control here. Help me out and I'll see if I can't find some more prestigious work for ya.
text.completed: 去暮光高地的焰须巡逻营找到科甘·焰须。

english.title: Firebeard's Patrol
english.objectives: Seek out Keegan Firebeard at Firebeard's Patrol in Twilight Highlands.
english.description: I was on my way to join Firebeard's Patrol when my bird was shot down.$B$BTwilight's Hammer launched surprise attacks all over the Highlands. Sometimes their buildings crawled right out of the earth in the middle of our villages. It was a nightmare!$B$BIn the chaos, Firebeard is one of the few who's kept his head on straight. He's trying to piece together a full gryphon wing from the survivors.$B$BIf you want to bring the Wildhammer into the Alliance, start by helping out Firebeard, to the west.
english.completion: Come to join the patrol, lad? Glad to have ya. I need some bodies helpin' to get our defenses under control here. Help me out and I'll see if I can't find some more prestigious work for ya.
english.completed: Seek out Keegan Firebeard at Firebeard's Patrol in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 更先进的伐木机
text.objectives: 在暮光海滩上找到一台可回收的伐木机，使用它召唤出一名锈水抢修专家。在伐木机恢复正常运转之前，保护它免受攻击。
text.description: $n，我改进了伐木机的设计图。但是我不能让工程师只身犯险，进入战争区域。$B$B前往暮光海滩寻找可回收的伐木机，使用它召唤出一名抢修专家。在“升级”维修期间，确保伐木机免受攻击。$B$B联盟肯定猜不到是被什么东西给打了！当然，得等到我的营销战役全面展开后！
text.completion: That's right baby! That's right! Cold steel and hot death! What should we name our new creation? The Gnugatron? No - better - the $n-o-matic. That's got a ring to it.
text.completed: Return to Juice Gnugat at the Twilight Shores in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Mo' Better Shredder
english.objectives: Locate a Salvageable Shredder on the Twilight Shores, and use it to summon a Bilgewater Salvage Expert. Defend the shredder until it is operational again.
english.description: $n, I've got plans for a better shredder. But my engineers can't wade into a combat zone alone.$B$BGo locate a salvageable shredder in the Twilight Shores, and use it to signal one of my salvage experts to join you. Defend the shredder while we make some "upgrades."$B$BThe Alliance won't know what hit them! At least, not until my marketing campaign kicks in!
english.completion: That's right baby! That's right! Cold steel and hot death! What should we name our new creation? The Gnugatron? No - better - the $n-o-matic. That's got a ring to it.
english.completed: Return to Juice Gnugat at the Twilight Shores in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 巨人守护者
text.objectives: 从巨人守护者身上获得寒月之石和烈日之石。
text.description: 装着节杖的箱子似乎是被魔法封住，纹丝不动。$B$B牌匾上描绘着两个巨人雕像，身体中央分别是太阳和月亮形状石头的嵌槽。$B$B画上两个雕像所守护的金字塔看起来正是外面那座。$B$B也许这些都值得你调查一番。
text.progress: You wipe away the sand from the hieroglyphs only for them to become covered in a new layer.  You'd best hurry.
text.completion: You place the two gems inside the sockets in the wall.
text.completed: Return to the Sand-Covered Hieroglyphs at Orsis in Uldum.

english.title: Colossal Guardians
english.objectives: Obtain the Stone of the Moon and the Stone of the Sun from the Colossal Guardians.
english.description: The chest containing the scepter appears to be magically sealed and will not budge.$B$BThe plaque above it depicts two giant statues holding star and moon-shaped stones sockets at their center.$B$BThe two statues are pictured guarding pyramids that look like the ones outside.$B$BPerhaps it's worth your while to investigate these.
english.progress: You wipe away the sand from the hieroglyphs only for them to become covered in a new layer.  You'd best hurry.
english.completion: You place the two gems inside the sockets in the wall.
english.completed: Return to the Sand-Covered Hieroglyphs at Orsis in Uldum.

text.title: 坍塌之后
text.objectives: 拿到晨星宝珠、晚星宝珠、北极星宝珠和落星宝珠。
text.description: 啊啊，那没什么，真的。$b$b那些雕像本来就摇摇欲坠——就差推一把了。$b$b你去那些碎石堆里清理清理怎样？$b$b我有预感，一切就要水落石出了。
text.progress: Find anything interesting, $n?
text.completion: Fine work, $n. It looks as though our work here is nearly complete.
text.completed: 与群星之厅的哈里森·琼斯谈谈。

english.title: After the Fall
english.objectives: Collect the Orb of the Morning Star, the Orb of the Evening Star, Orb of the North Star and the Orb of the Shooting Star.
english.description: Aww, that was nothin', really.$b$bThose statues were teetering as it was - just needed a little push is all.$b$bHow about you go and sort through that rubble?$b$bI've got a feeling we're close to getting this all sorted out.
english.progress: Find anything interesting, $n?
english.completion: Fine work, $n. It looks as though our work here is nearly complete.
english.completed: Speak to Harrison Jones in the Chamber of the Stars.

text.title: 保卫奎尔丹尼
text.objectives: 在奎尔丹尼小屋杀死16名死亡猎手入侵者。
text.description: 亡灵来了！被遗忘者！他们越来越近，打算对我们发动全面进攻……那些可怕的憎恶！$B$B我麾下年轻的德莱尼人同高原精灵一起接受过战斗训练。他们并非毫无还手之力，但他们需要帮助！$B$B拜托你，$n，援助他们！把被遗忘者赶回去！
text.completion: Such aberrations in the face of the light... You are brave to face them, $n.
text.completed: Return to Anchorite Traska at Quel'Danil Lodge in The Hinterlands.

english.title: In Defense of Quel'Danil
english.objectives: Slay 16 Deathstalker Invaders at Quel'Danil Lodge.
english.description: The undead are here! The Forsaken! They've been moving closer and closer, but to launch an all-out attack on us... those horrid abominations!$B$BThe young draenei I was charged with have trained with the Highvale elves in combat. They are not defenseless, but they need help!$B$BPlease, $n, assist them! Drive back the Forsaken!
english.completion: Such aberrations in the face of the light... You are brave to face them, $n.
english.completed: Return to Anchorite Traska at Quel'Danil Lodge in The Hinterlands.

text.title: 高原精灵文档
text.objectives: 收集高原精灵报告、高原精灵记录，以及高原精灵笔记。
text.description: 高原精灵在这里保存了多年的详细记录。死亡、出生、季节……但也有重要的侦察情报，以及同联盟其他部分的联络方法。$B$B这些文档在混乱中散落了。如果它们落在被遗忘者的手里，就会有更多的人有生命危险！拜托你，你必须赶在部落前面把这些文档拿回来……
text.progress: Are they safe?
text.completion: Thank the Light. We will not let the Forsaken have anything that can be turned against us, no matter how small.
text.completed: Return to Anchorite Traska at the Quel'Danil Lodge in The Hinterlands.

english.title: The Highvale Documents
english.objectives: Collect the Highvale Report, the Highvale Records, and the Highvale Notes.
english.description: The Highvale have kept detailed records here for years. Deaths, births, seasons... but also vital scouting information and methods of contact with the rest of the Alliance.$B$BThe documents will be scattered in the chaos. If they fall into the hands of the Forsaken, more lives could be at risk! Please, you must retrieve the documents before they are taken by the Horde...
english.progress: Are they safe?
english.completion: Thank the Light. We will not let the Forsaken have anything that can be turned against us, no matter how small.
english.completed: Return to Anchorite Traska at the Quel'Danil Lodge in The Hinterlands.

text.title: 不过是漂亮点的蟑螂
text.objectives: 消灭5只紫水晶圣甲虫、5只蓝宝石圣甲虫、5只绿宝石圣甲虫和5只翡翠圣甲虫。
text.description: 显然，远古雕像是各种圣甲虫的家。$b$b为了要尽可能安然无恙地离开这个地方，你决定除掉大厅里的这些虫子。

english.title: Just a Fancy Cockroach
english.objectives: Kill 5 Amethyst Scarabs, 5 Sapphire Scarabs, 5 Turquoise Scarabs, and 5 Emerald Scarabs.
english.description: Evidently, the ancient statues were home to various species of scarab.$b$bDetermined to leave this site in the best condition possible, you resolve to ridding the chamber of these pests.

text.title: 向法奥瑞斯传达信息
text.objectives: 跟奥丹姆拉穆卡恒的法奥瑞斯国王谈一谈。
text.description: 赶快，$n。我们必须同我的兄弟——也就是国王——谈一谈。$B$B他正逐渐倾向于避免同奥拉基尔和尼斐塞特开战。他愚蠢地以为这个问题还存在用外交手段解决的可能。$B$B也许等他听说这里所发生的事情之后，就会理智起来的。
text.completion: This is just the beginning, $n.  If Deathwing's minions can bury entire cities, we have little chance of defeating them through conventional means.

english.title: Send Word to Phaoris
english.objectives: Speak to King Phaoris at Ramkahen in Uldum.
english.description: Hurry, $n.  We must speak to my brother, the king.$B$BHe is bent on averting war with Al'Akir and the Neferset.  He has foolish hopes that there is a diplomatic solution to this problem.$B$BMaybe once he hears what occurred here he will see reason.
english.completion: This is just the beginning, $n.  If Deathwing's minions can bury entire cities, we have little chance of defeating them through conventional means.

text.title: 宰相的一票
text.objectives: 跟奥丹姆埃卡赫莱平原的宰相塔诺忒普谈一谈。
text.description: 让宰相塔诺忒普违背我兄弟的意志将会十分困难。他的立场恰恰就取决于法奥瑞斯的意愿。$B$B要想推动对尼斐塞特的战争，我得靠点运气才行。$B$B无论如何你都得和他谈谈。也许他会听取一个外来人的见解。$B$B宰相就在埃卡赫莱平原处理公务。
text.completion: What manner of creature are you?  You will leave the king's lands before... Wait!  You are that $n I've heard so much about. You must pardon my lack of hospitality.  We have seen all manner of hostile intruders since the barrier around Uldum failed.

english.title: The Vizier's Vote
english.objectives: Speak to Vizier Tanotep at the Akhenet Fields in Uldum.
english.description: Getting Vizier Tanotep to go against my brother's wishes is going to be extremely difficult.  His very position is based on enforcing the will of Phaoris.$B$BI've had little luck making the case for open war against Neferset.$B$BNevertheless you must speak to him.  Perhaps he will listen to an outsider's perspective.$B$BYou will find the Vizier at the Akhenet Fields on official business.
english.completion: What manner of creature are you?  You will leave the king's lands before... Wait!  You are that $n I've heard so much about. You must pardon my lack of hospitality.  We have seen all manner of hostile intruders since the barrier around Uldum failed.

text.title: 高阶祭司的一票
text.objectives: 跟奥丹姆维尔纳尔水坝内的高阶祭司阿门特谈一谈。
text.description: 只有高阶祭司阿门特的一票不在我们的控制之下。$B$B他会依照神谕的指示选择，不管我们做什么都无法动摇他。$B$B我认为那反而让我们的机会均等。$B$B我们面对的唯一问题是，自从奥丹姆周围的屏障坍塌以来，他的预见就不是那么准确了。$B$B在重获神谕之力前，他是不会进行投票的。$B$B从维尔纳尔水坝任意一侧的梯子上去，找他谈谈，看你能不能帮什么忙。
text.completion: War, you say. Divinations for war are always difficult.  Some wars must never be fought, even if victory was assured.  Some wars have to be waged even if defeat is certain.

english.title: The High Priest's Vote
english.objectives: Speak to High Priest Amet inside the Vir'naal Dam in Uldum.
english.description: High Priest Amet's vote is the only one that is completely outside of our control.$B$BHe will vote as his divinations tell him and nothing we do will dissuade him.$B$BI figure that gives us even odds either way.$B$BThe only problem we face is that his clairvoyance has failed him ever since the barriers around Uldum fell.$B$BHe will not cast a vote unless he regains power over his divinations.$B$BTake the stairs at either side of the Vir'naal Dam and Speak to him to see what you can do to help.
english.completion: War, you say. Divinations for war are always difficult.  Some wars must never be fought, even if victory was assured.  Some wars have to be waged even if defeat is certain.

text.title: 高阶指挥官的一票
text.objectives: 跟奥丹姆拉穆卡恒军团前哨的高阶指挥官卡姆塞斯谈一谈。
text.description: 如果我们要通过战争表决，就必须让高阶议会全体一致投赞成票。$B$B我肯定高阶指挥官卡姆塞斯得知奥西斯所发生的一切后，会把他的一票给我们。$B$B请去拉穆卡恒和他谈谈，促成这件事。我必须做好计划失败的准备。
text.completion: No need to fill me in on the events in Orsis, $n. I've heard about them already.  And about you.  Any enemy of Al'Akir is a friend of mine.

english.title: The High Commander's Vote
english.objectives: Speak to High Commander Kamses at the Ramkahen Legion Outpost in Uldum.
english.description: If we're to pass a resolution for war, the high council's vote needs to be unanimous.$B$BI'm certain High Commander Kamses will give us his vote once he hears about what happened at Orsis.$B$BPlease speak to him in Ramkahen and make sure that's the case.  I must make preparations in case our plan fails.
english.completion: No need to fill me in on the events in Orsis, $n. I've heard about them already.  And about you.  Any enemy of Al'Akir is a friend of mine.

text.title: 塔诺忒普的儿子
text.objectives: 从尼斐塞特守卫身上获得维尔纳尔三角洲地图。
text.description: 我毕生服侍于国王，万事不为所动……只有一个例外：我的儿子。$B$B塔赫特被尼斐塞特哨兵抓走了。$B$B他们声称是因为我的儿子擅闯了他们的领地。法奥瑞斯正试图和他们谈判，放他出来……但我担心会出现最坏的情况。$B$B如果你能找到塔赫特，我就保证我的一票属于你。$B$B我不知道他们把囚犯都关在哪儿了，但我曾看见那些守卫是靠地图来确认他们穿越茂密植被的路线的。
text.progress: This might be the map you're after.
text.completion: You've obtained a map of the Vir'Naal river delta.
text.giverWindow: 尼斐塞特守卫也许携带着标有塔赫特位置的地图。

english.title: Tanotep's Son
english.objectives: Obtain the Vir'Naal Delta Map from a Neferset Guard.
english.description: I have devoted my life to serving the King.  That service is unrivaled in importance by anything... with one exception: my son.$B$BTahet was captured by Neferset sentries.$B$BThey claim my son was trespassing upon their territory.  Phaoris is attempting to negotiate his release... but I fear for the worst.$B$BIf you were to find Tahet, I would pledge my vote to you.$B$BI do not know where they take the prisoners, but I've seen the guards consult maps to guide them through the thick vegetation.
english.progress: This might be the map you're after.
english.completion: You've obtained a map of the Vir'Naal river delta.
english.giverWindow: Neferset guards may carry maps pointing to Tahet's location.

text.title: 血神哈卡
text.objectives: 杀死哈卡的化身。
text.description: 哈卡……仅仅是提起这个夺灵者的名字，许多人就会四散奔逃。在堕神圣地，阿塔莱获得了他的大部分骸骨，准备让他死而复生。他的子嗣已经开始在该地区纷纷出现。$B$B将这枚蛋放在圣地里。它会强行提前召唤哈卡。不要犹豫，$n，他的化身一旦出现就立即发起攻击！
text.completion: You have successfully stopped Hakkar here, but I fear we are far from done. The Atal'ai transported most of the blood they produced to Zul'Gurub, where the Hakkari work to summon The Blood God there. $n, I do not think that this was ever meant to be the place of Hakkar's arrival - it was merely a test to see if the blood was potent enough! Hakkar can only be summoned in Zul'Gurub...and I fear we may be too late to stop the Hakkari with the blood they now have in their possession.
text.completed: Return to Lord Itharius.

english.title: The Blood God Hakkar
english.objectives: Kill the Avatar of Hakkar.
english.description: Hakkar... The mere mention of The Soulflayer's name will send many running. In the Sanctum of the Fallen God the Atal'ai have recovered a significant portion of his skeleton and seek to restore him to life. Already his children have begun to show up in the area.$B$BPlace this egg in that sanctum, and it will force his summoning prematurely. $n, do not hesitate. Strike once his avatar appears!
english.completion: You have successfully stopped Hakkar here, but I fear we are far from done. The Atal'ai transported most of the blood they produced to Zul'Gurub, where the Hakkari work to summon The Blood God there. $n, I do not think that this was ever meant to be the place of Hakkar's arrival - it was merely a test to see if the blood was potent enough! Hakkar can only be summoned in Zul'Gurub...and I fear we may be too late to stop the Hakkari with the blood they now have in their possession.
english.completed: Return to Lord Itharius.

text.title: 神灵哈卡
text.objectives: 将装满的哈卡之卵交给塔纳利斯的叶基亚。
text.description: 现在是获取哈卡化身的精华的时候了。$B$B把哈卡之卵拿到悲伤沼泽的那座沉没的神庙中，在堕神圣地中使用卵的力量激怒死去的神灵。$B$B他将派出那些被称作“嗜血者”的奴仆对付你，杀掉它们，取出它们的哈卡莱血液，然后用这些血液熄灭包含哈卡灵魂能量的不灭火焰。当你熄灭所有的火焰时，哈卡的化身就可以进入我们的世界了。$B$B打败他，将他的精华封印在哈卡之卵中。
text.completed: Return to Yeh'kinya at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris.

english.title: The God Hakkar
english.objectives: Bring the Filled Egg of Hakkar to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.
english.description: Now it is time to capture the essence of the avatar of Hakkar.$B$BTake the Egg of Hakkar to the Sanctum of the Fallen God in the Sunken Temple in Azeroth.  Invoke the egg's power to stir the dead god.$B$BHe will send his minions against you.  Defeat his bloodrinkers and take their Hakkari blood, then use the blood to dowse the eternal flames that hold Hakkar's spirit.  When all the flames go out, the avatar of Hakkar will enter our world.$B$BDefeat him, and place his essence within the egg of Hakkar.
english.completed: Return to Yeh'kinya at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris.

text.title: 净化处理
text.objectives: 登上净化者500型开始净化处理。
text.description: 你已经在诺莫瑞根待了不少时间了，$n，这么久以来，你还活着，也没有丧失理智，真是叫人惊讶！我们得把你弄出去。$B$B在你前往地面和其他侏儒团聚之前，你必须得完成净化处理。到下一个房间去，登上净化者500型。剩下来的就交给它吧！应该不会……很痛。$B$B你都完成之后，到技师布朗格那里去登记，他会给你弄套合适的装备。
text.completion: There, now you're fit to head off to the surface and start your new life. The High Tinker will be delighted to hear of your arrival.
text.completed: Speak to Technician Braggle.

english.title: Decontamination
english.objectives: Board the Sanitron 500 to begin the decontamination process.
english.description: You've been down here in Gnomeregan for a long time, $n, and it's amazing that you've survived and kept your wits so long! We need to get you out.$B$BBefore we can send you to the surface to join the rest of the gnomes, you have to go through the decontamination process. Just head into the next room and board the Sanitron 500. It will do the rest! It shouldn't even hurt... much.$B$BWhen you're all done, check in with Technician Braggle and he'll make sure you get some suitable gear.
english.completion: There, now you're fit to head off to the surface and start your new life. The High Tinker will be delighted to hear of your arrival.
english.completed: Speak to Technician Braggle.

text.title: 只有你和马迪亚斯
text.objectives: 在暮光高地的暮光堡垒中找到马迪亚斯·肖尔。
text.description: 军情七处的人都死了。你得赶快去找到马迪亚斯·肖尔。$B$B好消息是，小队指挥官告诉过你他大概会在哪里。
text.completion: Where are the rest of my people?

english.title: Just You and Mathias
english.objectives: Find Master Mathias Shaw at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.
english.description: The SI:7 are all dead. Time to find Master Mathias Shaw.$B$BGood thing the squad commander told you where he would be.
english.completion: Where are the rest of my people?

text.title: 只有你和马迪亚斯
text.objectives: 在暮光高地的暮光堡垒中找到马迪亚斯·肖尔。
text.description: 那真是對我們的一大打擊。該死的丘加利!$B$B幸好小隊指揮官和你說了馬迪亞斯‧肖爾的確切所在。

english.title: Just You and Mathias
english.objectives: Find Master Mathias Shaw at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.
english.description: That's a blow to our efforts. Damn Cho'gall!$B$BIt's a good thing that the squad commander told you where to find Master Shaw.

text.title: 只有你和迦罗娜
text.objectives: 在暮光高地的暮光堡垒中找到半兽人迦罗娜。
text.description: 库卡隆的人都死了。你得赶快去找到半兽人迦罗娜。$B$B好消息是，小队指挥官告诉过你她大概会在哪里。
text.completion: Where are the Kor'kron?

english.title: Just You and Garona
english.objectives: Find Garona Halforcen at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.
english.description: The Kor'kron are all dead. Time to find Garona Halforcen.$B$BGood thing the squad commander told you where she would be.
english.completion: Where are the Kor'kron?

text.title: Just You and Garona
text.objectives: Find Garona Halforcen at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.
text.description: That's a heavy blow to our efforts. Damn that Cho'gall!$B$BIt's a good thing that the squad commander told you where to find Garona.

english.title: Just You and Garona
english.objectives: Find Garona Halforcen at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.
english.description: That's a heavy blow to our efforts. Damn that Cho'gall!$B$BIt's a good thing that the squad commander told you where to find Garona.

text.title: 顿沃德幸存者
text.objectives: 在顿沃德废墟寻找顿沃德家族的幸存者。
text.description: 如我所知，你的使命是说服蛮锤部族与联盟并肩作战。我不知道你是否清楚该怎么做。$B$B总之，说到打仗的话，你最好能赢得某个蛮锤家族的支持。往西南走，杀戮熔炉竞技场对面就是顿沃德家族的废址。他们的家园遭遇重创，但是这样的攻击并不足以击溃整个家族。问题是，你能不能找到他们。
text.completion: If it's Dunwalds you be lookin' for, it's Dunwalds you've found. A couple of'm anyway. I can't find me other brothers for the life of me.

english.title: Dunwalds Don't Die
english.objectives: Look for Dunwald family survivors in the Dunwald Ruins.
english.description: As I understand it, you're to be looking to bring the Wildhammer clans together with the Alliance for war. Not sure you know what you're gettin' into.$B$BAnyway, if it's battle you're preparin' for, there's definitely one family you want by your side. Head southwest, to the opposite side of the Crucible of Carnage, and there you'll find Clan Dunwald's ruins. They're rightly ravaged, but that's not likely to be stoppin' the Dunwalds. It's just a matter of findin' them.
english.completion: If it's Dunwalds you be lookin' for, it's Dunwalds you've found. A couple of'm anyway. I can't find me other brothers for the life of me.

text.title: 顺手之劳
text.objectives: 在顿沃德家族的领地内杀死20名暮光之锤的成员。
text.description: 嗨，$g小伙子:姑娘;。别听凯莉瞎说，你不用为我们的兄弟担心啦，他们能照顾自己的。我相信，他们很快就会设法回到这里。$B$B既然你打算寻找家族的幸存者，不如顺便帮我个忙……暮光之锤的教徒和他们的仆从依然在顿沃德家族的地盘上肆虐。如果你能警告一下这帮不受欢迎的客人，我会很感谢你的。
text.completion: Now that's what I'm talkin' about lad. My kinda $r.
text.completed: Return to Flynn Dunwald at the Dunwald Holdout in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: While Meeting The Family
english.objectives: Kill 20 Twilight's Hammer in Dunwald territory.
english.description: Hey there, $glad:lass;. I'm sure Keely's got you worrying about our brothers, but they can take care of themselves. They'll find their way back here one way or another.$B$BMaybe you can do me a favor while you're out meeting the family... Dunwald territory is still infested with Twilight's Hammer and their servants. I'd appreciate it if you could remind them that they're not welcome.
english.completion: Now that's what I'm talkin' about lad. My kinda $r.
english.completed: Return to Flynn Dunwald at the Dunwald Holdout in Twilight Highlands.

objectiveDetails.description: 欢迎暮光教徒造访顿沃德

text.title: 搜寻废墟
text.objectives: 找到12具顿沃德受害者的尸体。
text.description: 暮光之锤洗劫了我们的镇子，真是可恨至极。我和我的兄弟很可能是最后的防御力量。但是我得确认这一点。$B$B在你搜寻废墟的过程中，看看能不能找到族人的尸体。我想知道是否还有幸存者……以及是否有族人顺利逃生的迹象。
text.completion: That many dead, eh? Not seemin' likely that anyone outside of me brothers fought through it then. I guess I already expected as much. Thanks for takin' the time to look for me.
text.completed: Return to Flynn Dunwald at the Dunwald Holdout in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Sifting Through The Wreckage
english.objectives: Search for the bodies of 12 Dunwald Victims.
english.description: The Twilight's Hammer were damn thorough when they sacked our town.  Me and me brothers may well be the only ones that held'm back. I gotta be sure though.$B$BAs you're siftin' through the ruins, keep an eye out for the bodies of me kinsmen. I wanna know if dere were any survivors... or if it seems like some might have gotten away.
english.completion: That many dead, eh? Not seemin' likely that anyone outside of me brothers fought through it then. I guess I already expected as much. Thanks for takin' the time to look for me.
english.completed: Return to Flynn Dunwald at the Dunwald Holdout in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 东尼利·顿沃德
text.objectives: 找到东尼利·顿沃德。
text.description: 你是来找我们的，我也希望能找到我的兄弟。听上去我们有着同样的目的。$B$B东尼利是几兄弟中最年长的，他的体格健壮，头脑却不怎么灵活。他应该在顿沃德小屋的北部废墟。你能不能帮我找到他？如果他一切安好的话，我就放心了。
text.completion: Hi friend! I don't think I know you... I'm Donnelly Dunwald. What's your name? I don't think I know you... Do I know you?

english.title: Donnelly Dunwald
english.objectives: Find Donnelly Dunwald.
english.description: So you be lookin' to find us, and I be lookin' to find me brothers. It sounds to me like we got some common ground in there abouts.$B$BDonnelly's our eldest, and while his size shows it, his wits might not. He's usually up in the northern ruins - in the hovel. Do ya think you might go lookin' for him for me? It'd be a right comfort if I knew he were safe.
english.completion: Hi friend! I don't think I know you... I'm Donnelly Dunwald. What's your name? I don't think I know you... Do I know you?

text.title: 伊欧因·顿沃德
text.objectives: 找到伊欧因·顿沃德。
text.description: 伊欧因是双胞胎之一。他非常喜欢喝酒。你应该去古井周围找他——那附近曾经建有麦酒的储存室。$B$B让伊欧因去拜访一下他的姐姐吧，她快担心死了。如果你能找到麦酒桶，那他肯定就在附近了。
text.completion: Of all the buildings in all the towns to collapse, why'd it have to be this one?!

english.title: Eoin Dunwald
english.objectives: Find Eoin Dunwald.
english.description: Eoin's one of the twins. He's got a penchant for the drink. You'll likely be findin' him over by the old well - the ale stores were in a building there.$B$BMind making him to pay his worrying sister a visit? Shouldn't take much convincin' if you can get to the ale first.
english.completion: Of all the buildings in all the towns to collapse, why'd it have to be this one?!

text.title: 凯登·顿沃德
text.objectives: 找到凯登·顿沃德。
text.description: 凯登是另一名双胞胎。他也有一项嗜好，不过不是喝酒。我敢说，暮光之锤入侵以来，他过得不知道有多开心呢。但愿酣战能舒缓他好斗的天性吧。$B$B我觉得你可以去铁匠铺旁边的市场找他。他以前常在那里晃悠，如今市场到处都是暮光之锤的成员，说不定对他来说，那里更有家的感觉。$B$B找到凯登，最好能活着把他带回来。
text.completion: Well look at ya, all geared and fancy. Keely send you to keep an eye on old Cayden, eh? Won't be needin' it. I got these louts handled. Hahah! They chose the wrong dwarf to be ambushin' today! Ahahahahah!

english.title: Cayden Dunwald
english.objectives: Find Cayden Dunwald.
english.description: Cayden's the other twin. He's got a thirst too, but not for ale. I'm sure he's been havin' a grand time of it since the Twilight came to our doorstep. Gettin' some of that aggression out of his system mayhaps.$B$BI'm thinkin' the best place to go lookin for him is at market row, by the old smithy. He used ta hang out there anyway, but since that place is swarmin' with the most Twilight, he's probably got all the more reason to be callin' it home now.$B$BBring'm back for me. In one piece would be nice.
english.completion: Well look at ya, all geared and fancy. Keely send you to keep an eye on old Cayden, eh? Won't be needin' it. I got these louts handled. Hahah! They chose the wrong dwarf to be ambushin' today! Ahahahahah!

text.title: 寻找尖喙
text.objectives: 搜寻顿沃德小屋，帮助东尼利找到尖喙。
text.description: 我的狮鹫不见了。尖喙！你在哪儿？！$B$B愿意帮我找他吗？他就在顿沃德小屋。我肯定。$B$B尖喙？！你在哪儿呀？$B$B希望他没事才好。
text.completion: You found'm! You found Beak! I like you, new friend! I'm gonna go show Keely. Keely like Beak too.
text.completed: Return to Donnelly Dunwald at Dunwald Hovel in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Finding Beak
english.objectives: Help Donnelly find Beak in Dunwald Hovel.
english.description: I lost me gryphon. Beak! Where are you Beak?!$B$BWanna help me find him? I know he's in da hovel. He hasta be.$B$BBeak?! Wheres are ya?$B$BI hope he's okay.
english.completion: You found'm! You found Beak! I like you, new friend! I'm gonna go show Keely. Keely like Beak too.
english.completed: Return to Donnelly Dunwald at Dunwald Hovel in Twilight Highlands.

objectiveDetails.description: 搜寻顿沃德小屋南部的酒窖
搜寻顿沃德小屋西北部的酒窖
搜寻顿沃德小屋东部的酒窖

text.title: 我只要喝的
text.objectives: 搜寻伊欧因·顿沃德提到的酒窖，找到酒桶。
text.description: 嗨，伙计。要么你帮我找点喝的来，要么你就走吧。$B$B进入那座旧仓库的地下室。我怀疑那个一本正经的老图书管理员其实私下在书本后偷喝美酒呢。他肯定在地下室里藏有酒桶！$B$B如果你有所发现的话，就赶紧回来找我！别拖拖拉拉的……这事儿非常紧急！
text.progress: You stink of sober! Find me some drink!
text.completion: Donnelly's belly! That's more like it. Good to not be dyin' of the thirst again. Here, have some. Good ol' Eoin's never so impolite as ta not share!
text.completed: Speak to Eoin Dunwald at the Dunwald Ruins in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Anything But Water
english.objectives: Check the cellar Eoin Dunwald mentioned for a keg.
english.description: Look, buddy. Either you're here to help me find some drink, or you're in the way.$B$BWhy don't ya go down to the old storehouse and look downstairs. I had a mighty suspicion that ol' bookkeeper up in there was sneaking sips between pages. I bet he has a keg in his basement!$B$BIf ya find anything, come straight back to me! No dallyin'... this is urgent!
english.progress: You stink of sober! Find me some drink!
english.completion: Donnelly's belly! That's more like it. Good to not be dyin' of the thirst again. Here, have some. Good ol' Eoin's never so impolite as ta not share!
english.completed: Speak to Eoin Dunwald at the Dunwald Ruins in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 再次开战
text.objectives: 跟凯登·顿沃德一起参与所谓的伏击行动。
text.description: 好吧，好吧。你也想参与行动？没问题。$B$B准备好了就告诉我一声。
text.progress: They keep comin an' I'll keep swinging!
text.completion: A thing of beauty, isn't it? An' they keep comin' back for more. Love it! I'll go find Keely and settle her nerves in a bit. Just one more go through the row.
text.completed: Return to Cayden Dunwald at the Dunwald Ruins in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Once More Into The Fire
english.objectives: Accompany Cayden Dunwald through the somewhat obvious ambush.
english.description: Fine, fine. You want a piece of the action? You can join in.$B$BLet me know when you're ready ta go.
english.progress: They keep comin an' I'll keep swinging!
english.completion: A thing of beauty, isn't it? An' they keep comin' back for more. Love it! I'll go find Keely and settle her nerves in a bit. Just one more go through the row.
english.completed: Return to Cayden Dunwald at the Dunwald Ruins in Twilight Highlands.

objectiveDetails.description: 陪同凯登穿越顿沃德市场

text.title: 稳定的供给
text.objectives: 收集6桶蛮锤麦酒。
text.description: 嗨，伙计。你真是个友善体贴的好朋友呢，你愿不愿意帮我个忙啊？$B$B在顿沃德废墟……这些建筑物里一定有各种供给品。如果你找到麦酒，就带回来给我好吗？矮人总是嫌酒不够！$B$B我得回去找凯莉，所以你可能要费些功夫才能找到我，不过我不会亏待你的。
text.progress: Where's me booze?
text.completion: Woooooh! That's exactly what my belly needs! You get me all the nice things.
text.completed: Return to Eoin Dunwald at the Dunwald Ruins in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: A Steady Supply
english.objectives: Collect 6 Barrels of Wildhammer Ale.
english.description: Hey bud. Seeing as how you're so friendly and great and all, think you might do a dwarf a favor?$B$BThese are Dunwald ruins... there's SURE to be more stock in some of these buildings. If you come upon more ale, bring it my way, will ya? A good dwarf can never have enough!$B$BI'm thinkin' I'll find my way back to Keely, so ya might have to hunt me down, but I'll try'n make it worth it to ya.
english.progress: Where's me booze?
english.completion: Woooooh! That's exactly what my belly needs! You get me all the nice things.
english.completed: Return to Eoin Dunwald at the Dunwald Ruins in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 再次回家
text.objectives: 跟顿沃德据点的凯莉·顿沃德谈一谈。
text.description: 你应该去找凯莉。她迫切地想要知道新的消息。
text.completion: Thank you for bandin' my brothers back together. I know they're tough, but they're even tougher when they're side by side, and there's a lot of Twilight out there. You're good to put a gal's heart at ease.

english.title: Home Again
english.objectives: Speak to Keely Dunwald at the Dunwald Holdout.
english.description: Ya should find Keely. She'll be eager for word.
english.completion: Thank you for bandin' my brothers back together. I know they're tough, but they're even tougher when they're side by side, and there's a lot of Twilight out there. You're good to put a gal's heart at ease.

text.title: 像顿沃德那样战斗
text.objectives: 跟弗莱恩·顿沃德谈一谈，帮助顿沃德兄弟杀死达隆卡。
text.description: 他们已经出发了，准备找那只指挥顿沃德攻击战的双头怪报仇。我本来想叫他们等你一起的，但这帮家伙都是天生的急性子。$B$B他们朝废墟中央的城镇广场去了。赶紧去找他们吧，不然你就享受不到战斗的乐子了。
text.completion: Thanks for your help. You've got a warrior's spirit in ya - you coulda fooled me for a Wildhammer if it weren't for your... well.. you know. I know Firebeard sent you to unite us. My love for that dwarf runs shallow, but you know now we've got plenty of reasons to make enemies of Twilight. If you see him, tell him that when the battle starts, the Dunwald family will be there.
text.completed: Speak to Flynn Dunwald or Keely Dunwald at the Dunwald Ruins in Twilight Highlands.
text.giverWindow: 只要顿沃德家族重新联合起来，暮光高地上就没什么好怕的。

english.title: Doing It Like a Dunwald
english.objectives: Speak to Flynn Dunwald and aid the Dunwald brothers in killing Darunga.
english.description: They already left to hunt down the ettin that lead the attack on Dunwald. I asked them to at least give ya a chance to catch up, but I'm not sure waitin's in their blood.$B$BThey made off towards the town square, in the center of the ruins. You should go join'm before ya miss out on all the fun.
english.completion: Thanks for your help. You've got a warrior's spirit in ya - you coulda fooled me for a Wildhammer if it weren't for your... well.. you know. I know Firebeard sent you to unite us. My love for that dwarf runs shallow, but you know now we've got plenty of reasons to make enemies of Twilight. If you see him, tell him that when the battle starts, the Dunwald family will be there.
english.completed: Speak to Flynn Dunwald or Keely Dunwald at the Dunwald Ruins in Twilight Highlands.
english.giverWindow: There are few things in the highlands as terrifying as the Dunwalds reunited.

text.title: 黑暗刺客
text.objectives: 收集5枚黑暗刺客的坠饰。
text.description: 即便沦为猎物，那也是我藏身羊群理应承担的风险。$B$B<马蒂亚斯打量着你。>$B$B暮光之锤倒是有所长进，派出了黑暗刺客追杀我。他们还不错，可惜只是几具灌注了最优秀的杀手之魂的行尸走肉。$B$B你可以帮我个忙吗？除掉黑暗刺客，并带回他们的灵魂坠饰。
text.progress: How many pendants do you have?
text.completion: I'm not sure what I'm going to do with all of these. I'll probably fence them and donate the proceeds to the Stormwind orphanage. Now to find someone sick enough to buy such a thing. It'll probably be a goblin. Or, a gnome warlock.
text.completed: Return to Master Mathias Shaw at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Dark Assassins
english.objectives: Collect 5 Dark Assassin Pendants.
english.description: Even I get hunted. I suppose that's what I get for hiding amongst the sheep.$B$B<Mathias studies you for a moment.>$B$BThe Twilight's Hammer has taken it up a notch and sent their dark assassins after me. Nice bunch of guys. Dead now. They're made from the souls of the most skilled killers.$B$BWant to do me a favor? Hunt them down. Bring back their soul pendants.
english.progress: How many pendants do you have?
english.completion: I'm not sure what I'm going to do with all of these. I'll probably fence them and donate the proceeds to the Stormwind orphanage. Now to find someone sick enough to buy such a thing. It'll probably be a goblin. Or, a gnome warlock.
english.completed: Return to Master Mathias Shaw at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 黑暗刺客
text.objectives: 收集5枚黑暗刺客的坠饰。
text.description: $c，即便我沦为猎物，那也是藏身羊群的乐趣之一。$B$B<迦罗娜打量着你。>$B$B暮光之锤倒是有所长进，派出了黑暗刺客追杀我。他们还不错，可惜只是几具灌注了最优秀的杀手之魂的行尸走肉。$B$B你可以帮我个忙吗？除掉他们。$B$B黑暗刺客的脖子上挂着灵魂坠饰。将坠饰带回来给我。对他们而言，灵魂是可有可无的。
text.progress: How many pendants do you have?
text.completion: What do you think I should do with all of these? Maybe I'll melt them down and have the metal imbued into a new dagger that I can thrust into Cho'gall's chest. Think there's time for that?
text.completed: Return to Garona Halforcen at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Dark Assassins
english.objectives: Collect 5 Dark Assassin Pendants.
english.description: Even I get hunted, $c. But that's part of the fun of hiding amongst the sheep.$B$B<Garona studies you for a moment.>$B$BThe Twilight's Hammer has taken it up a notch and sent their dark assassins after me. Nice for a group of dead guys. They're made from the souls of only the most skilled killers.$B$BDo me a favor? Hunt them down.$B$BThey wear their souls in pendants about their necks. Bring them back to me. Souls optional.
english.progress: How many pendants do you have?
english.completion: What do you think I should do with all of these? Maybe I'll melt them down and have the metal imbued into a new dagger that I can thrust into Cho'gall's chest. Think there's time for that?
english.completed: Return to Garona Halforcen at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 重挫暮光之锤
text.objectives: 杀死10名要塞老兵、堕落的元素师和（或）暮光守备官。
text.description: 缺乏行之有效的传统的消灭坏人的计划，任何突袭行动都不可能成功。$B$B你的目标有很多，像是要塞老兵、堕落的元素师还有暮光守备官。$B$B你想怎么除掉他们，随你便。
text.completion: None of us are too good to get our hands a little dirty. Or bloody, in this case.
text.completed: Return to Master Mathias Shaw at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Bring the Hammer Down
english.objectives: Slay 10 Citadel Veterans, Corrupted Elementalists, and/or Twilight Vindicators.
english.description: No foray into the field would be complete without a good old-fashioned take-the-bad-guys-out kind of mission.$B$BBetween the citadel veterans, the corrupted elementalists, and the twilight vindicators, I'm sure you'll have plenty of targets.$B$BHow you choose to kill them is up to you.
english.completion: None of us are too good to get our hands a little dirty. Or bloody, in this case.
english.completed: Return to Master Mathias Shaw at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 重挫暮光之锤
text.objectives: 杀死10名要塞老兵、堕落的元素师和（或）暮光守备官。
text.description: 没有人比暮光之锤教徒更恶劣，他们连自己都憎恨！没有人能超越他们！这些白痴想要摧毁整个世界。$B$B就凭这一点，他们就该被彻底灭绝。$B$B你的目标有很多，像是要塞老兵、堕落的元素师还有暮光守备官。$B$B你想怎么除掉他们，随你便。
text.completion: Feels good to get a little blood on your hands, doesn't it? Especially when that blood belongs to such self-deluded fools.
text.completed: Return to Garona Halforcen at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Bring the Hammer Down
english.objectives: Slay 10 Citadel Veterans, Corrupted Elementalists, and/or Twilight Vindicators.
english.description: There's nothing worse than a self-hating Twilight's Hammer cultist. Nothing! These idiots actually want to bring about the end of the world.$B$BThat marks them for extinction in my book.$B$BBetween the citadel veterans, the corrupted elementalists, and the twilight vindicators, you should have no shortage of targets.$B$BI could care less how you choose to kill them.
english.completion: Feels good to get a little blood on your hands, doesn't it? Especially when that blood belongs to such self-deluded fools.
english.completed: Return to Garona Halforcen at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 铲除鳄患
text.objectives: 消灭8只盐齿鳄鱼。
text.description: 镇子东边的雄鹿沼泽里全是鳄鱼。全是，你听明白了吗？鳄鱼的每个部位我都能卖，只要你能想得到。$B$B鳄鱼皮、牙齿、尾巴、舌头、眼睛，随你说。我的意思是，它们不好卖了。因为鳄鱼太多了！我们显然是供大于求。$B$B那么，既然它们对我没用了，偶尔还会把我的客人吃掉，我就要你去杀掉那些混账。帮个忙吧，好不好？我要在这儿跟你们的人商量点事情。
text.completion: All taken care of? Good to hear. Takes a load off my mind. Now I can focus on proper business for the fine folk of Marshtide and Stonard, weary from the war... and all that junk.
text.completed: Return to Trade Baron Silversnap at Bogpaddle in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: Croc-Out
english.objectives: Slay 8 Sawtooth Crocolisks.
english.description: The Stagalbog east of town is swarming with crocolisks. Swarming, you hear me? I've sold every bit of crocolisk you could imagine.$B$BCrocolisk hides, teeth, tails, tongues, eyes, you name it. My point is, they ain't sellin' anymore. There's too many crocs! We're over-supplied and under-demanded.$B$BSo since they're of no use to me, and they occasionally eat my guests, I need you to just kill the suckers. Do me the favor, eh? I'll be here negotiatin' things with your people.
english.completion: All taken care of? Good to hear. Takes a load off my mind. Now I can focus on proper business for the fine folk of Marshtide and Stonard, weary from the war... and all that junk.
english.completed: Return to Trade Baron Silversnap at Bogpaddle in Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 来自唤地者的帮助
text.objectives: 跟暮光高地源质深渊的唤地者耶法谈一谈。
text.description: 古加尔的古器的调查行动进入了死胡同。暮光之锤强迫一批被俘的蛮锤铁匠为他们劳作，并在任务完成后将他们淹死在湖中。$B$B<马迪亚斯啐了一口。>$B$B我们需要帮助。你可以在源质矿洞的西南方找到大地之环的成员唤地者耶法。$B$B她和她的地精助手需要帮助，才能关闭附近的元素传送门。作为交换，我觉得她会帮我们解决问题的。
text.completion: $n! I'm glad you're here. Of course, I'm more than happy to lend you whatever assistance that I can.

english.title: Help from the Earthcaller
english.objectives: Speak with Earthcaller Yevaa at the Elementium Depths in the Twilight Highlands.
english.description: My investigation into Cho'gall's artifact has hit a dead end. The Twilight's Hammer enslaved a group of Wildhammer smiths and then drowned them in the lake when they were done with their services.$B$B<Mathias spits.>$B$BWe need help. There's an Earthen Ring woman, Earthcaller Yevaa, southwest at the Elementium mine.$B$BShe and her goblin initiate need help with the shutting down the elemental portals hereabouts. I'm thinking that in exchange, she can help us with our problem.
english.completion: $n! I'm glad you're here. Of course, I'm more than happy to lend you whatever assistance that I can.

text.title: 来自唤地者的帮助
text.objectives: 跟暮光高地源质深渊的唤地者耶法谈一谈。
text.description: 古加尔的古器的调查行动进入了死胡同。暮光之锤强迫一批被俘的蛮锤铁匠为他们劳作，并在任务完成后将他们淹死在湖中。$B$B<迦罗娜啐了一口。>$B$B虽然我很不情愿，但是我们需要帮助。你可以在西南方的源质矿洞找到大地之环的成员唤地者耶法和她的宠物地精。她是一名隶属于大地之环的女德莱尼。$B$B她和她的地精需要帮助，才能关闭附近的元素传送门。作为交换，她会帮我们解决问题的。
text.completion: $n! I'm glad you're here. Of course, I'm more than willing to help you in any way that I can.

english.title: Help from the Earthcaller
english.objectives: Speak with Earthcaller Yevaa at the Elementium Depths in the Twilight Highlands.
english.description: My investigation into Cho'gall's artifact has hit a dead end. The Twilight's Hammer enslaved a group of Wildhammer smiths and then drowned them in the lake when they were done with their services.$B$B<Garona spits.>$B$BI hate to say it, but we need help. There's an Earthen Ring woman, a draenei named Earthcaller Yevaa.  She and her pet goblin are southwest at the Elementium mine.$B$BThey need help with shutting down the elemental portals around here. In exchange, she can help us with our problem.
english.completion: $n! I'm glad you're here. Of course, I'm more than willing to help you in any way that I can.

text.title: 过载的传送门
text.objectives: 杀死衰弱的艾帕克萨尔、衰弱的阿瑟隆和衰弱的埃德曼图斯。
text.description: 我曾经是大地之环传送门的看守者。在我们赶去援助深岩之洲的时候，暮光之锤趁机侵入并腐蚀了这片区域。$B$B他们派出强大的升腾者看守我们的传送门。暮光之锤犯了一个严重的错误。$B$B我要你前往传送门，使用控制器令它们过载。这项操作将释放传送门的全部能量，令升腾者进入虚弱状态。接下来你就可以动手了。
text.completion: The last portal is deep within the mine here, but we'll deal with that in a bit.
text.completed: Return to Earthcaller Yevaa at the Elementium Depths in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Portal Overload
english.objectives: Slay Debilitated Apexar, Debilitated Aetheron, and Debilitated Edemantus.
english.description: I used to be the caretaker of the Earthen Ring's portals here. But while we were away helping to save Deepholm, the Twilight's Hammer moved in and corrupted the area.$B$BThey're using powerful ascendants to guard our portals. That's where they've made a critical error.$B$BI want you to go to the portals and use the controllers to overload them. This will unleash all of the portal's energy, debilitating the ascendant. Slay it.
english.completion: The last portal is deep within the mine here, but we'll deal with that in a bit.
english.completed: Return to Earthcaller Yevaa at the Elementium Depths in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 洛克之灵
text.objectives: 跟暮光高地瓦拉尔湖的瓦拉尔女伯爵谈一谈。
text.description: 我完全不了解古加尔在制造何种器物，但是我知道有谁可以帮上忙。$B$B瓦拉尔女伯爵是北面瓦拉尔湖的上古之魂。她不喜欢暮光之锤，因为他们污染了水源。$B$B向她请教你所寻找的智慧吧。
text.completion: I know why you are here, $n. Your reasons sing within your fluids. I know about the dead dwarf forgesmith polluting my lake. If you want to find out what his corpse remembers, you must earn it.

english.title: Spirit of the Loch
english.objectives: Speak with Countess Verrall at Loch Verrall in the Twilight Highlands.
english.description: I have no knowledge of any artifact that Cho'gall is crafting, but I think I know one that can help.$B$BCountess Verrall is the ancient spirit of Loch Verrall to the north. She has no love for the Twilight's Hammer, who have polluted her waters.$B$BSeek her for the wisdom that you seek.
english.completion: I know why you are here, $n. Your reasons sing within your fluids. I know about the dead dwarf forgesmith polluting my lake. If you want to find out what his corpse remembers, you must earn it.

text.title: 加农领主的末日
text.objectives: 杀死加农领主。
text.description: 加农领主是我的死对头，他竟然蠢到与暮光之锤结盟并决定为其效忠。$B$B在过去的岁月里，我们勉强维持着互不侵犯的休战协议。如今他已然倒戈，这令我别无选择，只能干掉他。或者我应该说，如果你希望揭开矮人铁匠遇害事件的真相，你就该为我除掉加农领主。$B$B去东南边的加农的火海找到他。
text.completion: I am pleased. Lord Cannon was always an unworthy adversary. Very well, $r, I will help you gain the information which you seek.
text.completed: Return to Countess Verrall at Loch Verrall in the Twilight Highlands.
text.giverWindow: 杀掉他来满足瓦拉尔女伯爵。

english.title: Fire the Cannon
english.objectives: Slay Lord Cannon.
english.description: My arch-nemesis, Lord Cannon, has foolishly decided to throw his allegiance to the Twilight's Hammer.$B$BIn the past, we've coexisted with a shaky truce, but his change of heart leaves me little choice but to put an end to him. Or, I should say, if you want the information that you seek from the dead dwarf, you're going to kill Lord Cannon for me.$B$BSeek him at Cannon's Inferno to the southeast.
english.completion: I am pleased. Lord Cannon was always an unworthy adversary. Very well, $r, I will help you gain the information which you seek.
english.completed: Return to Countess Verrall at Loch Verrall in the Twilight Highlands.
english.giverWindow: Slay him to appease Countess Verrall.

text.title: 摆脱束缚
text.objectives: 在暮光堡垒杀死10个被奴役的元素生物，让它们获得自由。
text.description: 元素生物是我唯一了解的领域。我能准确地感受到它们的情绪。我要说，它们一点也不喜欢被奴役的感觉！$B$B我的意思是，如果你想要释放那些被奴役的元素生物，我相信它们不仅会对你感激不已，还会转而对抗它们的主子。$B$B$n，这简直就是双赢啊。
text.completion: What'd I tell you? Elementals aren't so bad after all, eh?
text.completed: Return to Initiate Goldmine at the Elementium Depths in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Unbinding
english.objectives: Free 10 Enslaved elementals by slaying them at the Twilight Citadel.
english.description: Look, if there's one thing I know, it's elementals. I've been able to really gain an appreciation for how they feel. Let me tell you, they don't appreciate being enslaved one bit!$B$BSo, what I'm saying here is that if you were to free the enslaved elementals, I'm sure that not only would they show their gratitude, they'd also likely turn on their masters.$B$BSounds like a win-win to me, $n.
english.completion: What'd I tell you? Elementals aren't so bad after all, eh?
english.completed: Return to Initiate Goldmine at the Elementium Depths in the Twilight Highlands.

objectiveDetails.description: 释放被奴役的元素生物

text.title: 尝起来像是陆行鸟
text.objectives: 从沼泽陆行鸟身上获得9条巨大的沼泽陆行鸟之腿。
text.description: 你！没错，就是你！你想让我在贸易巨头面前替你美言几句吗？那就帮我个忙！$B$B我听说你就是那个把龙虾尾巴弄来的人。它们很棒，但作为沼泽食物还不大上台面。我需要在浓汤里放鸟腿！$B$B镇子外的忧伤湿地里有的是沼泽陆行鸟。把你能找到的最大的鸟腿给我弄来！
text.progress: Have you got those drumsticks?
text.completion: Ah, good, good! Just what I needed.
text.completed: Return to Pierre Fishflay at Bogpaddle in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: Tastes Like Strider
english.objectives: Collect 9 Jumbo Swampstrider Drumsticks from Swampstriders.
english.description: You there! Yes, you! You want a good word put in with the Trade Baron? Give me a hand!$B$BI heard you're the one that got all those makrura tails. They're wonderful, but not enough for proper swamp food. I need drumsticks for my gumbo!$B$BThere's plenty of swampstriders just outside town in the Sorrowmurk. I want the biggest drumsticks you can find!
english.progress: Have you got those drumsticks?
english.completion: Ah, good, good! Just what I needed.
english.completed: Return to Pierre Fishflay at Bogpaddle in Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 暗月火山套牌
text.objectives: 当暗月马戏团来到镇上的时候，把火山套牌交给他们。
text.description: 你现在已经收集到了余烬套牌的所有卡片，与前8张的背面图案完全一样的第9张卡片神秘地出现在你手中。在这张卡片上写着，“将这些卡片拿到暗月马戏团去，你就将获得奖励。”你听说每个月暗月马戏团的入口都会出现在莫高雷和闪金镇。
text.progress: I see that you have managed to complete a Volcanic deck!   Congratulations!
text.completion: So you have put together a deck of Embers.   Your gesture of returning it to us will create a tie between you and the Darkmoon that will not soon be forgotten.   Allow me to present you with one of the greater Darkmoon cards as a small token of our appreciation.
text.completed: Return to Professor Thaddeus Paleo.

english.title: Darkmoon Volcanic Deck
english.objectives: Return the Volcanic Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.
english.description: Now that you have gathered all of the Ember cards together into a deck, a ninth card mysteriously appears with the same backing as the first eight.   On this card is inscribed, "Return these cards to the Darkmoon Faire and be rewarded."   You have heard that this faire alternately stops at Mulgore and Goldshire every few months, so you will have to wait until they are here next.
english.progress: I see that you have managed to complete a Volcanic deck!   Congratulations!
english.completion: So you have put together a deck of Embers.   Your gesture of returning it to us will create a tie between you and the Darkmoon that will not soon be forgotten.   Allow me to present you with one of the greater Darkmoon cards as a small token of our appreciation.
english.completed: Return to Professor Thaddeus Paleo.
