text.title: 集中注意！
text.objectives: 纳兹戈林要你去永不沉没号北端，查看破碎的联盟箱子。
text.description: 听着，$r。不是我不重视营救工作，而是眼下的局势岌岌可危。$b$b你最好能保持警惕！$b$b就在刚才，我看见你从一只破碎的联盟箱子旁走过。$b$b那里面一定有我用得着的东西。$b$b你再过去瞧瞧，好吗？
text.completion: Sure enough... This looks to be something that Nazgrim will take quite an interest in.

english.title: Pay Attention!
english.objectives: Nazgrim wants you to see what lies in the broken Alliance crate north of The Immortal Coil.
english.description: Listen, $r. It's not that I don't appreciate the rescue and all, but this is a dire situation.$b$bYou have to pay better attention out there!$b$bI was watching, and you passed right over a busted alliance crate.$b$bThere's bound to be something in there that could help me and my boys.$b$bHow about you get out there and take a look-see, hrm?
english.completion: Sure enough... This looks to be something that Nazgrim will take quite an interest in.

text.title: 有幸
text.objectives: 在群星之厅的装置旁使用繁星宝珠。
text.description: 看来剩下来的事情就是把宝珠放在这个装置每一个角落的基座上。$b$b<哈里森看了你一会儿，然后把宝珠递给你。>$b$b那么，去吧，$n。$b$b没有你，我们是无法有如此发现的。
text.completion: Well, now. Would ya look at that! As amazing as this is, I am confident that there's more to our discovery than meets the eye... Much more.
text.completed: Speak with Harrison Jones at the Obelisk of the Stars.

english.title: Do the Honors
english.objectives: Use the Orbs of the Stars near the mechanism in the Chamber of the Stars.
english.description: It looks like all that's left to do is to place the orbs on the pedestals at each corner of this mechanism.$b$bWe appear to have stumbled upon what may be the most important find in modern history.$b$b<Harrison looks at you for a moment, then hands you the orbs.>$b$bWell, go ahead, $n.$b$bWe'd have never made this discovery without you.
english.completion: Well, now. Would ya look at that! As amazing as this is, I am confident that there's more to our discovery than meets the eye... Much more.
english.completed: Speak with Harrison Jones at the Obelisk of the Stars.

text.title: 被压制
text.objectives: 杀死6名癫狂的麻疯侏儒。
text.description: 我的名字叫内温·扭钳，是生还者高效救助小队，又称S.A.F.E.的指挥官。$B$B我不知道你是怎么从下面的辐射中幸存下来的，$n，不过其他大多数人都没那么走运。我的队伍正在搜索幸存者，但被辐射的混乱麻疯侏儒人数太多，我们支撑不了多久。他们都疯了！$B$B如果你还有力气挥动武器，或是施放法术，能不能帮我清理掉一些麻疯侏儒？
text.completion: Well done, $n. My men can take it from here. Let's focus on getting the other survivors out now.
text.completed: Speak to Nevin Twistwrench inside Gnomeregan.

english.title: Pinned Down
english.objectives: Kill 6 Crazed Leper Gnomes.
english.description: My name is Nevin Twistwrench and I'm the commander of the Survivor Assistance Facilitation Expedition, or S.A.F.E.$B$BI don't know how you managed to survive the radiation down here, $n, but most of the others haven't fared so well. My team is rounding up the survivors, but the radiation-addled leper gnomes are too numerous for us to hold back much longer. They've lost their minds!$B$BIf you're still strong enough to wield a weapon or cast a spell, would you help us clear out some of these leper gnomes?
english.completion: Well done, $n. My men can take it from here. Let's focus on getting the other survivors out now.
english.completed: Speak to Nevin Twistwrench inside Gnomeregan.

text.title: 照料幸存者
text.objectives: 使用传送信标将6名幸存者传送至安全地区。
text.description: 如果我们不做些什么的话，内温和幸存者们都没法活着出去。我要把小队紧急传送信标给你。我们还有力气和弹药，能自己杀出去，但那些幸存者无法这样逃脱。$B$B对幸存者们使用信标，安排他们传送到我的人在外面设好的安全地带。你完成以后，回来向我报告，我们会做好安排，把你也弄出去。
text.completion: I know Nevin will be pleased with all the survivors you managed to help. I still can't believe you managed to stay so strong down here in the radiation. You've seen the shape the other survivors are in. Let's get you to the loading room for decontamination.
text.completed: Speak with Carvo Blastbolt in Gnomeregan.

english.title: See to the Survivors
english.objectives: Use the Teleport Beacon to teleport 6 Survivors to safety.
english.description: If we don't do something quick, neither Nevin nor the survivors will make it out of here alive. I'm going to give you my squad's emergency teleport beacon. We still have enough strength and ammunition to fight our way out of here, but those survivors are in no condition to make a run for it.$B$BUse the beacon on survivors to arrange for them to be teleported out of here to the safe area my men have set up. Once you've done that, report back to me and we'll make arrangements to get you out of here.
english.completion: I know Nevin will be pleased with all the survivors you managed to help. I still can't believe you managed to stay so strong down here in the radiation. You've seen the shape the other survivors are in. Let's get you to the loading room for decontamination.
english.completed: Speak with Carvo Blastbolt in Gnomeregan.

text.title: 卡兹穆尔大厅
text.objectives: 击败艾隆纳亚。
text.description: 在地图大厅中，有一道门通往传说中的卡兹穆尔大厅。没有人知道里面隐藏着怎样的秘密！$B$B我们只知道泰坦的守护者艾隆纳亚负责看守大厅，她的体型和力量都不可小觑。如果你想要揭开奥达曼的秘密，就必须击败她！
text.completion: Don't worry about the chamber, my boys will check it out! You have more important things to do!
text.completed: Return to Lead Prospector Durdin.

english.title: The Chamber of Khaz'mul
english.objectives: Defeat Ironaya.
english.description: In the Map Chamber there is a door which leads to the legendary Chamber of Khaz'mul. Who knows what secrets could be hidden inside!$B$BWhat we do know is that it is guarded by Ironaya, a Titanic Watcher of immense size and power. You'll need to defeat her if you intend to unlock the secrets of Uldaman!
english.completion: Don't worry about the chamber, my boys will check it out! You have more important things to do!
english.completed: Return to Lead Prospector Durdin.

text.title: 珍贵的能量核心
text.objectives: 取回黑曜石能量核心和泰坦能量核心。
text.description: 造物者创造了两名远古巨石卫士，命令他们在艾隆纳亚和阿扎达斯沉睡期间确保奥达曼不受入侵者的骚扰以及协助处理日常运作事务。其中一位卫士驻守在神殿大厅，而艾卡默克洞穴中另一名的卫士已经被某种生物腐化了。$B$B我担心是某个上古之神干的，你帮我查明事情的真相吧！击败两名巨石卫士，取回他们的能量核心。其中就有我们想知道的一切信息。
text.progress: Where are the cores, lad? By Muradin's Beard, where are the bloody cores? Sorry about that. Have you been able to obtain the cores?
text.completion: This is incredible, $n. The power coursing through each core...the contrasting powers so close together! I'll take this to the proper dwarves right away. These cores are extremely important!
text.completed: Return to Kand Sandseeker.

english.title: It's What's Inside That Counts
english.objectives: Obtain the Obsidian Power Core and the Titan Power Core.
english.description: The Makers built two Ancient Stone Keepers to help protect Uldaman from would-be invaders and to oversee daily operations while Ironaya and Archaedas slumber. One is still fully operational in Temple Hall, but the one in Echomok Cavern has been corrupted by something.$B$BI fear that one of the Old Gods is responsible for this, and you're going to help me see if that's the case! Topple both of the guardians and bring me their power cores. They'll tell us all we need to know.
english.progress: Where are the cores, lad? By Muradin's Beard, where are the bloody cores? Sorry about that. Have you been able to obtain the cores?
english.completion: This is incredible, $n. The power coursing through each core...the contrasting powers so close together! I'll take this to the proper dwarves right away. These cores are extremely important!
english.completed: Return to Kand Sandseeker.

text.title: 到地面去
text.objectives: 跟托尔本·光爆谈一谈，传送到地面，然后去找内温·扭钳。
text.description: 内温刚送消息过来说，他和他的人正要到地面上去。他会在S.A.F.E.建立的总部里等你。$B$B看见那儿的托尔本·光爆了吗？做好前往地面的准备后，就跟他谈谈，他会安排把你送上去。认识你很高兴，$n，能作为小小的一份子帮助你逃离诺莫瑞根，在地面开始新生活，我很荣幸。
text.completion: It's good to see you again, $n. Without your help, we wouldn't have been able to get so many survivors out of Gnomeregan this time. Everyone is going to be thrilled to meet you and hear your story.
text.completed: 跟托尔本·光爆谈一谈，传送到地面，然后去找内温·扭钳。

english.title: To the Surface
english.objectives: Speak to Torben Zapblast to get teleported to the surface and report to Nevin Twistwrench.
english.description: Nevin has just sent word that he and his men are making their way to the surface. He'll be waiting for you in the building that S.A.F.E. has established as its headquarters.$B$BSee Torben Zapblast over there? Talk to him when you're ready to head to the surface and he'll arrange to have you transported up there. It's been a pleasure meeting you, $n, and I'm honored to have played a small role in helping you escape from Gnomeregan to start your life on the surface.
english.completion: It's good to see you again, $n. Without your help, we wouldn't have been able to get so many survivors out of Gnomeregan this time. Everyone is going to be thrilled to meet you and hear your story.
english.completed: Speak to Torben Zapblast to get teleported to the surface and report to Nevin Twistwrench.

text.title: 伪造的文件
text.objectives: 在暴风城的一幢住宅里领取你的伪造的文件。
text.description: 在暴风城的一幢住宅里领取你的伪造的文件。
text.progress: 你有什麽要给我的吗?
text.completion: <You hand over the forged documents, exchanging only a few words; your masterful skill speaks for itself.>

english.title: Forged Documents
english.objectives: Find a resident of Stormwind City to accept your Forged Documents.
english.description: Find a resident in Stormwind City to accept your forged documents.
english.progress: Do you have something for me?
english.completion: <You hand over the forged documents, exchanging only a few words; your masterful skill speaks for itself.>

text.title: 石门背后的秘密
text.objectives: 击败加加恩·火锤。
text.description: 加加恩·火锤和他的黑铁矮人部下驻守在三号挖掘场中一个石门前，而我们对那扇门背后的秘密却一无所知！这帮家伙老是干扰我们的作业，我受够了！探险者协会是唯一有权处置奥达曼遗物的组织！$B$B我要你进入挖掘场，干掉加加恩，好让我们安静地开展工作。我要知道那扇门背后到底有什么！
text.completion: Fantastic! Great work! We'll know all that Dig Three has to tell us in no time at all!
text.completed: Return to Olga Runesworn.

english.title: Behind Closed Doors
english.objectives: Kill Galgann Firehammer.
english.description: Galgann Firehammer and his band of Dark Irons are in Dig Three guarding a door that we know nothing about!  I've had it with their men getting in the way of our work here! The Explorers' League is the only group authorized to handle the artifacts throughout Uldaman!$B$BGo to the dig and dispose of him so that our work can continue undisturbed. I want to know what's behind that door!
english.completion: Fantastic! Great work! We'll know all that Dig Three has to tell us in no time at all!
english.completed: Return to Olga Runesworn.

text.title: 阿扎达斯，远古巨石卫士
text.objectives: 击败阿扎达斯。
text.description: 奥达曼之旅的真正目的是拿到诺甘农圆盘。其中记载的秘密可以改变我们对整个世界的认知。圆盘上记录了无数造物者的秘密……其价值远远超越你所能想象到的任何物质财富。$B$B唯一的问题是，造物者创造了一个古老而强大的造物，阿扎达斯来守护圆盘。不仅如此，他还统领着一支令人生畏的军队。我要你去击败他，为探险者协会拿到圆盘！
text.completion: Well done, lad! Now go to the discs and learn all you can!
text.completed: Return to Lead Prospector Durdin.
text.giverWindow: 这一切都是为了圆盘！

english.title: Archaedas, The Ancient Stone Watcher
english.objectives: Defeat Archaedas.
english.description: The true goal in Uldaman is to obtain the Discs of Norgannon. The secrets on these discs could change everything about how we view our world. Countless secrets of the Makers are inscribed on them...their value is beyond any material wealth you could possibly imagine.$B$BThe problem is that Archaedas, an ancient and powerful creation of the Makers, guards the discs with a venerable army at his disposal. I need you to defeat him and secure the discs for the Explorers' League!
english.completion: Well done, lad! Now go to the discs and learn all you can!
english.completed: Return to Lead Prospector Durdin.
english.giverWindow: It's all about the discs!

text.title: 白金圆盘
text.objectives: 同石头守卫交谈，了解他守护着怎样的古代知识。然后将你的发现告诉首席勘探员杜尔林！
text.description: 财宝室的中间是四块巨大的白金圆盘，每块圆盘上都刻满了各种各样的未知文字和图案。你的手触摸这些圆盘的时候，你感到了一丝震动。就在你接触圆盘的一瞬间，一个巨大的石头守卫者的形象出现在了你的面前。$B$B“你好。我是知识的守卫者。土灵的创造者所留下的一切有关这个种族的知识都已经存储在了这张诺甘农圆盘上了。”$B$B你发掘到了迄今为止这个世界上最宝贵的知识财富！
text.end: 学习石头守护者所看守的知识

english.title: The Platinum Discs
english.objectives: Speak with stone watcher and learn what ancient lore it keeps. Then, tell Lead Prospector Durdin what you found out!
english.description: The centerpieces of this treasure chamber are four huge platinum discs, each adorned with numerous sigils of an unknown origin.  Touching them makes your hand tingle.  Just after touching the discs, the visage of a large stone watcher springs forth.$B$B"Salutations.  I am a keeper of knowledge.  The Creators' synthesis of the Earthen has been chronicled and stored here for this world in the Discs of Norgannon."$B$BYou have uncovered a wealth of previously undiscovered worldly lore!
english.end: Learn what lore that the stone watcher has to offer

text.title: 卡兹穆尔大厅
text.objectives: 击败艾隆纳亚。
text.description: 我认为，在地图大厅中，有一道紧锁的大门通往传说中的卡兹穆尔大厅。我们还不知道里面藏着什么遗物。$B$B我们只知道泰坦的守护者艾隆纳亚负责看守大厅，她的体型和力量都不可小觑。如果你想要进一步探索这个地方，就必须击败她。
text.completion: Reliquary agents are en route to investigate the chamber. You have more important matters to attend to.
text.completed: Return to High Examiner Tae'thelan Bloodwatcher.
text.turninTarget: 高阶考察者泰瑟兰·血望者

english.title: The Chamber of Khaz'mul
english.objectives: Defeat Ironaya.
english.description: In the Map Chamber there is a locked door which I believe leads to the legendary Chamber of Khaz'mul. We do not yet know what artifacts wait inside it.$B$B$B$BWhat we do know is that it is guarded by Ironaya, a Titanic Watcher of immense size and power. You'll need to defeat her if you intend to progress any further into this place.
english.completion: Reliquary agents are en route to investigate the chamber. You have more important matters to attend to.
english.completed: Return to High Examiner Tae'thelan Bloodwatcher.

starters.name: 高阶考察者泰瑟兰·血望者

enders.name: 高阶考察者泰瑟兰·血望者

text.title: 阿扎达斯，远古巨石卫士
text.objectives: 击败阿扎达斯。
text.description: 奥达曼之旅的真正目的是拿到诺甘农圆盘。其中的秘密可以改变我们观察世界的方法。圆盘上装载了造物者数不尽的秘密……其价值远远超越你所能想象的任何物质财富。$B$B唯一的问题是，阿扎达斯率领一支古老的军队守护着圆盘，他是造物者在远古时期创造的石卫士。我要你击败他，确保神圣遗物学会拿到圆盘！
text.completion: You are a most reliable agent, $n. Proceed to the discs and learn all you can. Report back to me immediately after.
text.completed: Return to Lead Prospector Durdin.
text.giverWindow: 圆盘就是钥匙。
text.turninTarget: 高阶考察者泰瑟兰·血望者

english.title: Archaedas, The Ancient Stone Watcher
english.objectives: Defeat Archaedas.
english.description: The true goal in Uldaman is to obtain the Discs of Norgannon. These platinum discs could grant our order unbelievable power. Countless secrets of the Makers are inscribed on them...their value is beyond any material wealth you could possibly imagine.$B$BThe only problem in obtaining them is that Archaedas, an ancient and powerful creation of the Makers, guards the discs with a venerable army at his disposal. I need you to defeat him and secure the discs for The Reliquary.
english.completion: You are a most reliable agent, $n. Proceed to the discs and learn all you can. Report back to me immediately after.
english.completed: Return to Lead Prospector Durdin.
english.giverWindow: The discs are the key.

starters.name: 高阶考察者泰瑟兰·血望者

enders.name: 高阶考察者泰瑟兰·血望者

text.title: 石门背后的秘密
text.objectives: 杀死加加恩·火锤。
text.description: 加加恩·火锤和他的黑铁矮人部下驻守在三号挖掘场中的石门处，而我们对那扇门背后的秘密一无所知！这帮家伙老是干扰我们的作业，我受够了！神圣遗物学会是唯一有权处置奥达曼古器的组织！$B$B进入挖掘场，杀死加加恩，帮助我们恢复正常作业。我想知道门后面有什么东西！
text.completion: Well done. Dig Three and any secrets beyond that door will soon be ours and ours alone.
text.completed: Return to Lidia Sunglow.

english.title: Behind Closed Doors
english.objectives: Kill Galgann Firehammer.
english.description: Galgann Firehammer and his band of Dark Irons are in Dig Three guarding a door that we know nothing about!  I've had it with their men getting in the way of our work here! The Reliquary is the only group authorized to handle the artifacts throughout Uldaman!$B$BGo to the dig and dispose of him so that our work can continue undisturbed. I want to know what's behind that door!
english.completion: Well done. Dig Three and any secrets beyond that door will soon be ours and ours alone.
english.completed: Return to Lidia Sunglow.

text.title: 我们需要更多的矿石
text.objectives: 取回黑曜石能量核心和泰坦能量核心。
text.description: 造物者创造了两名远古巨石卫士，命令他们在艾隆纳亚和阿扎达斯沉睡期间确保奥达曼不受入侵者的骚扰以及协助处理日常运作事务。其中一位卫士驻守在神殿大厅，而艾卡默克洞穴中另一名的卫士已经被某种生物腐化了。$B$B我担心是某个上古之神干的，你帮我查明事情的真相吧！击败两名巨石卫士，取回他们的能量核心。其中就有我们想知道的一切信息。
text.progress: Do you have the cores with you, or are you just here to chat? Perhaps we should stop this whole charade and enjoy some snacks and fine wine instead?
text.completion: Both of these cores are still far more potent than most of the cores we use  to power our own protectors, and these are ancient devices! Thank you, these will prove extremely valuable to our society.
text.completed: Return to Aoren Sunglow.

english.title: We Require More Minerals
english.objectives: Obtain the Obsidian Power Core and the Titan Power Core.
english.description: The Titans built two Ancient Stone Keepers to help protect Uldaman from would-be invaders and to oversee daily operations while Ironaya and Archaedas slumber. One is still fully operational in Temple Hall, but the one in Echomok Cavern has been corrupted by something.$B$BI suspect that one of the Old Gods is responsible for this, and you're going to help me see if that is indeed true. Topple both of the guardians and bring me their power cores. They'll tell us all we need to know.
english.progress: Do you have the cores with you, or are you just here to chat? Perhaps we should stop this whole charade and enjoy some snacks and fine wine instead?
english.completion: Both of these cores are still far more potent than most of the cores we use  to power our own protectors, and these are ancient devices! Thank you, these will prove extremely valuable to our society.
english.completed: Return to Aoren Sunglow.

text.title: 到林子里去
text.objectives: 去找东瘟疫之地索多里尔河的一个女狼人。
text.description: 那天我看到一个最奇怪的队伍穿过镇子。一驾马拉的大车，装满了箱子，赶驾的是个女狼人，一个血精灵坐在她旁边，后面还跟着个矮人圣骑士，嘴里骂着我所听过的最有想象力的脏话。$b$b看起来他们是要朝东瘟疫之地去，不过我想他们现在应该刚过了索多里尔河不远。真不知道他们要去干嘛？
text.completion: 有事吗?

english.title: Into the Woods
english.objectives: Find a worgen woman at the Thondroril River in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: I saw the strangest commotion coming through town the other day.  A horse-drawn cart, loaded with crates and chests, a worgen woman at the reins, a blood elf by her side, and a dwarven paladin running behind, yelling some of the most creative obscenities I've heard in quite some time.$b$bThey looked like they were headed to Eastern Plaguelands, though I'd imagine they can't be far past the Thondroril River by now.  I wonder what they were up to?
english.completion: Yes?

starters.name: 银色黎明军官普尔哈特

text.title: 访客
text.objectives: 去找东瘟疫之地索多里尔河的一个女狼人。
text.description: 我听治愈者营地的消息来源说，不久就会有客人来拜访。他们是一群圣骑士——由一个狼人女商贩带领，真没想到——很快就将抵达这里。我期待着与他们见面，尤其是其中的某一个。$b$b你能不能路过的时候去瞧瞧他们？我说不好，不过等你到的时候，他们应该正好要跋涉过西边的索多里尔河。
text.completion: 有事吗?

english.title: Visitors
english.objectives: Find a worgen woman at the Thondroril River in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: My sources at the Menders' Stead have informed me that we will be having some visitors soon.  A group of paladins - led by a worgen tradeswoman, of all things - will be arriving here shortly.  I look forward to meeting them.  Particularly one of them.$b$bWould you mind stopping in and checking in on them?  I can't say for sure, but by the time you get there, they should just be crossing the Thondroril River, far to the west.
english.completion: Yes?

starters.name: 玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵

text.title: 未做完的好事
text.objectives: 跟柯尔普萨之森的埃达尔拉谈一谈。
text.description: 你好，$g小伙子:姑娘;。$b$b我是伦德尔。$b$b看来我和莫安纳来得正是时候。$b$b埃鲁纳克说这里的形势生死攸关，他还真不是开玩笑！$b$b嗯……于是我们放下手边的事务，急冲冲地从东边赶来支援。$b$b在别无选择的情况下，我们不得不放弃了那位濒临死亡的小姑娘，把她留在一个小小的通气孔边。$b$b你能不能赶去那里帮帮她？晚了就来不及了。
text.completion: Oh, finally... I don't know how much longer I can last!
text.giverWindow: 救命！

english.title: Good Deed Left Undone
english.objectives: Speak to Adarrah in the Kelp'thar Forest.
english.description: G'day, $gladdie:lassie;.$b$bThe name's Rendel.$b$bSeems ol' Moanah and I got here in the nick of time, eh?$b$bErunak wasn't kiddin' when he said it was life or death!$b$bSo... in our rush ta git over here, we left a little unfinished business off to the east a ways.$b$bA little lady was near death herself. We had no choice but ta leave her by a little air vent when we came here to yer rescue.$b$bHow bout yeh git over and help her while there's still time?
english.completion: Oh, finally... I don't know how much longer I can last!
english.giverWindow: Help!

text.title: 伪造的文件
text.objectives: 在奥格瑞玛的一幢住宅里领取你的伪造的文件。
text.description: 在奥格瑞玛的一幢住宅里领取你的伪造的文件。
text.progress: 你有什麽要给我的吗?
text.completion: <You hand over the forged documents, exchanging only a few words; your masterful skill speaks for itself.>

english.title: Forged Documents
english.objectives: Find a resident of Orgimmar to accept your Forged Documents.
english.description: Find a resident in Orgimmar to accept your forged documents.
english.progress: Do you have something for me?
english.completion: <You hand over the forged documents, exchanging only a few words; your masterful skill speaks for itself.>

text.title: 铲除格纳什
text.objectives: 将格纳什的徽记交给走私者洞穴的萨米尔。
text.description: 你击败了可怕的海巨人，真了不起啊！$b$b这头怪兽再也不会在走私者洞穴附近游荡了，那里的新住民应该大可放宽心了吧。
text.progress: You took down that Sea Giant, $c?
text.completion: It's not much, but it's all I've got down here. You're more than welcome to it, $c.

english.title: An Opened Can of Whoop Gnash
english.objectives: Bring Gnash's Head to Samir in Smuggler's Hole.
english.description: What an accomplishment, felling a  mighty sea giant!$b$bThe new residents of Smuggler's Hole will feel considerably safer knowing this monster is no longer loitering outside their haven.
english.progress: You took down that Sea Giant, $c?
english.completion: It's not much, but it's all I've got down here. You're more than welcome to it, $c.

text.title: 分散敌人的注意
text.objectives: 杀死阿丽斯·芬森女爵士、克雷穆大师和刺玫米娅
text.description: 我们必须铲除三名暮光升腾者的候选人：阿丽斯·芬森女爵士、克雷穆大师和刺玫米娅。$B$B我希望你能分散他们的注意。时机成熟时，我会从背后发动突袭并解决他们。$B$B$n，无论如何，你都不能低估这些家伙。他们是冷酷无情的一流杀手，才会挤上候选者的位子。
text.completion: That takes care of most of their leaders outside of the Bastion of Twilight. We work well together, $n.
text.completed: Return to Master Mathias Shaw at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Distract Them for Me
english.objectives: Slay Dame Alys Finnsson, Master Klem, and Mia the Rose.
english.description: There are three candidates for Ascendancy that we need to eliminate: Dame Alys Finnsson, Master Klem, and Mia the Rose.$B$BI'd like for you to serve as my distraction. When the time is right, I'll step in and finish them off from behind.$B$BWhatever you do, $n, do not underestimate them. Each got to where they are by being ruthless and very good at what they do.
english.completion: That takes care of most of their leaders outside of the Bastion of Twilight. We work well together, $n.
english.completed: Return to Master Mathias Shaw at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 分散敌人的注意
text.objectives: 杀死阿丽斯·芬森女爵士、克雷穆大师和刺玫米娅
text.description: 我们必须铲除三名暮光升腾者的候选人：阿丽斯·芬森女爵士、克雷穆大师和刺玫米娅。$B$B我希望你能分散他们的注意。时机成熟时，我会从背后发动偷袭并解决他们。$B$B记住，$n，无论如何都不要低估这些家伙。他们是冷酷无情的一流杀手，才会挤上候选者的位子。
text.completion: That takes care of most of their leaders outside of the Bastion. Not bad work, $n. Not bad at all.
text.completed: Return to Garona Halforcen at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Distract Them for Me
english.objectives: Slay Dame Alys Finnsson, Master Klem, and Mia the Rose.
english.description: There are three candidates for Ascendancy that need killing: Dame Alys Finnsson, Master Klem, and Mia the Rose.$B$BI want you to serve as a distraction. When the time is right, I'll step in to finish them off from behind.$B$BJust make sure that whatever you do, you don't underestimate them, $n. Each of those lunatics got to where they are by being ruthless and very good at what they do.
english.completion: That takes care of most of their leaders outside of the Bastion. Not bad work, $n. Not bad at all.
english.completed: Return to Garona Halforcen at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 驯龙者纳克拉尔
text.objectives: 向暮光高地溅血谷地的纳克拉尔·掠爪报到。
text.description: $n，溅血谷地的要塞是龙喉氏族在暮光高地的指挥中心，就在河流上游。纳克拉尔·掠爪利用他强大的能量，在溅血谷地中训练并组织龙骑士。$B$B龙喉兽人要取得最终的胜利，就看溅血谷地的成果了。去找纳克拉尔，确保一切进展顺利。
text.completion: Another mewling Horde whelp? Zaela saps our strength by diluting our forces with the weak. Very well, $c. Prove yourself to me, and show me what your Horde is made of.
text.completed: 向暮光高地溅血谷地的纳克拉尔·掠爪报到。

english.title: Narkrall, the Drake-Tamer
english.objectives: Report to Narkrall Rakeclaw at Bloodgulch in the Twilight Highlands.
english.description: $n, the stronghold at Bloodgulch is the heart of the Dragonmaw empire in the Highlands. It is just up the river. Narkrall Rakeclaw is using his considerable power to amass a wing of drake-riders there.$B$BFor the Dragonmaw to succeed, Bloodgulch must succeed. Go to Narkrall and make sure it is so.
english.completion: Another mewling Horde whelp? Zaela saps our strength by diluting our forces with the weak. Very well, $c. Prove yourself to me, and show me what your Horde is made of.
english.completed: Report to Narkrall Rakeclaw at Bloodgulch in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 疯狂的沼鳍
text.objectives: 消灭12只沼鳍鱼人。
text.description: 恐怕热砂港的其他人都完蛋了。鱼人来的时候，东边营地里的年轻人都牺牲了。$B$B是的，这片海滩上总是有鱼人……但没有见过这么多的。他们从海里成群而来，嘶号着吐着沫，蜂拥而至展开攻击！$B$B我们不能让他们还在周围到处晃荡，是不是？你能不能帮老地精一个忙，把他们给揍回海里去呢？
text.completion: You have to wonder just what's out there. This is the coast of the Forbidding Sea, with nothing beyond its reaches... but all these fishy folk just stomped right out of it. What's more, I saw where they've been going...
text.completed: Return to Baba Bogbrew at Stagalbog in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: Marshfin Madness
english.objectives: Slay 12 Marshfin Murlocs.
english.description: I'm afraid the rest of the Steamwheedle here are gone. All the young ones at the camp to the east were lost when the murlocs came.$B$BYes, there's always been murlocs on these shores... but not in these numbers. They came in droves from the sea at night, howling and frothing, swarming up onto the land to attack!$B$BWe can't have them still running around, now can we? Would you put an old goblin at ease and go beat some of them back into the water?
english.completion: You have to wonder just what's out there. This is the coast of the Forbidding Sea, with nothing beyond its reaches... but all these fishy folk just stomped right out of it. What's more, I saw where they've been going...
english.completed: Return to Baba Bogbrew at Stagalbog in Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 瑟莱德丝公主
text.objectives: 杀死瑟莱德丝公主。
text.description: 别紧张，年轻的$r。我叫扎尔塔，塞纳留斯之子，我来是寻求你的援助。$B$B很久以前，我犯下了一个错误，同瑟莱德丝公主，一名强大的、具有上古之神血统的土元素公主结合。我们的子嗣，半人马可汗，出生后忤逆于我，将我无情地杀害了。现在，瑟莱德丝的污染加深，威胁到的不止是玛拉顿。$B$B来杀掉她，把我的灵魂解放出来，让我们把凄凉之地重新恢复成一个生命繁荣的允诺之地，一如塞纳留斯所愿。
text.completion: Thank you, $n. As you can see, my mere presence here has resulted in a bloom of glorious life despite my mate's presence. Names aside, perhaps one day you will again venture into Desolace and find it a verdant oasis free of any traces of the Old Gods.
text.giverWindow: 你必须阻止她！

english.title: Princess Theradras
english.objectives: Kill Princess Theradras.
english.description: Do not be alarmed, young $r. I am Zaetar, son of Cenarius, and I come to you for your assistance.$B$BLong ago, I made the mistake of mating with Princess Theradras, a powerful earth elemental aligned with the Old Gods. Our children, the centuar Kahns, turned on me upon birth and slew me mercilessly. Now, Theradras' taint runs deep and threatens far more than just Maraudon.$B$BCome slay her and free my spirit so that we may restore Desolace to a place of verdant life and promise, as Cenarius would want.
english.completion: Thank you, $n. As you can see, my mere presence here has resulted in a bloom of glorious life despite my mate's presence. Names aside, perhaps one day you will again venture into Desolace and find it a verdant oasis free of any traces of the Old Gods.
english.giverWindow: You must stop her!

text.title: 戒卫的游戏
text.objectives: 将戒卫的棋卒传送到面向里边的位置，以完成戒卫的游戏。
text.description: 你看到这尊雕像分裂成了两座，然后是四座，然后是八座一模一样的雕像，以方阵排列。$b$b你听到了一个声音，不是从你的耳朵传进来的，而是直接传入你的心灵：$b$b   “真正的戒卫不会面向外界，寻求危机的迹象。$b  真正的戒卫总是检视自己，专注于保护他的内心。”$b$b也许这是一道谜题？
text.completion: The jade statue becomes one again, and you place it in your pocket.  You hear a shifting noise in the tomb's central chamber.

english.title: The Warden's Game
english.objectives: Complete the Warden's Game by teleporting the Warden's Pawns into inward-facing positions.
english.description: You see the statue split into two, then four, then eight identical statues in a square formation.$b$bYou hear a voice, not through your ears, but in the back of your mind:$b$b   "A true warden does not face OUTWARD, searching for signs of danger.$b  A true warden keeps his gaze INWARD, always focused on protecting his quarry."$b$bPerhaps this is a riddle of some sort?
english.completion: The jade statue becomes one again, and you place it in your pocket.  You hear a shifting noise in the tomb's central chamber.

text.title: 泪水之池
text.objectives: 从阿塔哈卡神庙周围的泪水之池里收集5件阿塔莱神器。
text.description: 潜伏在神庙里的巨魔对我族造成了莫大的伤害，$n。我们被派来是保护这个地方的，却遭到利用，把里面可怕的力量释放了出来。$B$B我请求你的帮助，因为只有凡人才可以帮助我。你将成为我的左右手，因为一旦我冒险亲自进入，就有可能和我的兄弟们反目。$B$B我们要订立一个契约，首先收集神庙周围水池里的阿塔莱神器，然后回来找我。
text.progress: Your gathering of these artifacts will be a sign of faith. Once rendered, I will perform the ritual.
text.completion: The essence of the green dragonflight wafts from these artifacts; the vestiges of my corrupted kin. In purifying them, I form a bond between us. Step forward, $n, and receive the Oathstone of Ysera's Dragonflight.
text.completed: Return to Lord Itharius atop the Temple of Atal'Hakkar in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: Pool of Tears
english.objectives: Collect 5 Atal'ai Artifacts from the Pool of Tears surrounding the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.
english.description: The trolls that lurk within this temple have done grievious harm to my kind, $n. We were sent here to guard this place, and were instead used to unleash the terrible powers within.$B$BI must beg you for the help only a mortal can give. You can be my hand within the temple; should I enter by myself, I risk being turned against my brothers as well.$B$BWe shall make a pact. If you wish to help, first gather Atal'ai artifacts from the waters around the temple, and return them to me.
english.progress: Your gathering of these artifacts will be a sign of faith. Once rendered, I will perform the ritual.
english.completion: The essence of the green dragonflight wafts from these artifacts; the vestiges of my corrupted kin. In purifying them, I form a bond between us. Step forward, $n, and receive the Oathstone of Ysera's Dragonflight.
english.completed: Return to Lord Itharius atop the Temple of Atal'Hakkar in Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 源质之斧
text.objectives: 取回源质之斧。
text.description: 暮光之锤俘虏并屠杀了很多红龙，但是尚有一只幸存。你还记得莉拉斯塔萨吗？她被囚禁在附近，我们要帮她重获自由。$B$B首先，我们需要一件锋利的器物砍断她的镣铐。$B$B双头怪守护者盲眼负责看守南面的升腾祭坛。$B$B他有一柄精心打造的源质之斧。说不定这就是古加尔的“终极”武器？
text.progress: Do you have the axe? They're going to kill Lirastrasza soon.
text.completion: That thing looks sharp. Sharp enough to the do deed, at least. But if I'm a judge of weaponry, that's not what Cho'gall's after.
text.completed: Return to Master Mathias Shaw at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.
text.giverWindow: 他有源质之斧！

english.title: The Elementium Axe
english.objectives: Obtain the Elementium Axe.
english.description: The Twilight cowards have captured and killed too many red dragons, but one yet lives. Do you remember Lirastrasza? She's shackled nearby and we're going to free her.$B$BBut first, we need something sharp enough to cut through her chains.$B$BThere's an old ettin named Blindeye the Guardian. He stands watch at the Altar of Ascension to the south.$B$BHe has a purely-wrought Elementium axe. I wonder if that's Cho'gall's "ultimate" weapon?
english.progress: Do you have the axe? They're going to kill Lirastrasza soon.
english.completion: That thing looks sharp. Sharp enough to the do deed, at least. But if I'm a judge of weaponry, that's not what Cho'gall's after.
english.completed: Return to Master Mathias Shaw at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.
english.giverWindow: He has the Elementium Axe!

text.title: 源质之斧
text.objectives: 取回源质之斧。
text.description: 暮光之锤俘虏并屠杀了很多红龙，但是尚有一只幸存。你还记得莉拉斯塔萨吗？她被囚禁在附近，我们要帮她重获自由。$B$B首先，我们需要一件锋利的器物砍断她的镣铐。$B$B双头怪守护者盲眼负责看守南面的升腾祭坛。$B$B他有一柄精心打造的源质之斧。说不定这就是古加尔的“终极”武器？
text.progress: Do you have the axe?
text.completion: That's a very sharp axe. It'll do the job, but if I'm any judge of weaponry, that's not what Cho'gall's after.
text.completed: Return to Garona Halforcen at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.
text.giverWindow: 他有源质之斧！

english.title: The Elementium Axe
english.objectives: Obtain the Elementium Axe.
english.description: The Twilight cowards have captured and killed many red dragons, but one's still breathing. Do you remember Lirastrasza? She's chained nearby and we're going to free her.$B$BBut first, we need something sharp enough to cut her free.$B$BThere's an old ettin named Blindeye the Guardian. He stands watch at the Altar of Ascension to the south.$B$BHe has a purely-wrought Elementium axe. I wonder if that's Cho'gall's "ultimate" weapon?
english.progress: Do you have the axe?
english.completion: That's a very sharp axe. It'll do the job, but if I'm any judge of weaponry, that's not what Cho'gall's after.
english.completed: Return to Garona Halforcen at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.
english.giverWindow: He has the Elementium Axe!

text.title: 玛拉顿的污染
text.objectives: 杀掉维利塔恩。
text.description: $n，我现在就需要你的援助！我乃扎尔塔，塞纳留斯之子，我历经磨难，被困在了这里！你必须先帮助我清除在玛拉顿横行肆虐的污染，才能将我救出来。$B$B维利塔恩是紫水晶洞窟的萨特统治者。他是一名阴险的燃烧军团使者，他的存在只会导致混沌和死亡。不能让他继续活着！
text.completion: Excellent work, $n! Eliminating Vyletongue's presence is a key step to freeing me and, ultimately, saving these lands from corruption. Take this as a token of my thanks and an incentive to continue your work here.
text.giverWindow: 他的大逆不道就在今天结束，英雄！
text.turninWindow: 你在这里要做的事情还远没有完成，英雄。

english.title: Corruption in Maraudon
english.objectives: Kill Lord Vyletongue.
english.description: $n, I require your assistance immediately! I am Zaetar, son of Cenarius, and I am trapped here after an unfortunate series of events! Before saving me is an option, you must help me clean out the corruption that runs so rampant through Maraudon.$B$BLord Vyletongue is the satyr ruler of the purple crystal caverns. He is an insidious agent of the Burning Legion and his continued presence can only lead to chaos and death. He can live no longer!
english.completion: Excellent work, $n! Eliminating Vyletongue's presence is a key step to freeing me and, ultimately, saving these lands from corruption. Take this as a token of my thanks and an incentive to continue your work here.
english.giverWindow: His treachery ends today, hero!
english.turninWindow: Your work here is far from over, hero.

text.title: 瑟莱德丝的奴仆
text.objectives: 杀死诺克赛恩和锐刺鞭笞者。
text.description: 我的前任配偶瑟莱德丝公主，用她强大力量污染着玛拉顿的自然。现在她的造物在这里横行无忌，我担心不久它们就会逃逸到外面的世界去，撒播死亡和毁灭的种子。$B$B$n，前去杀掉诺克赛恩和锐刺鞭笞者。这两个是她最强大的手下，他们的死会对麻木不仁的公主造成她应得的悲伤与痛楚。然后，或许，你就能把我的灵魂从她的掌握中解救出来。
text.completion: Without her powerful servants, Princess Theradras is significantly more vulnerable. Find her lair, $n...it is time to strike.
text.giverWindow: 他们对自然是种冒犯！

english.title: Servants of Theradras
english.objectives: Kill Noxxion and Razorlash.
english.description: Princess Theradras, my former mate, has used her enormous power to corrupt the very nature of Maraudon. Even now her creations run rampant here, and I fear that they may soon escape into the open world to sow the seeds of death and destruction.$B$B$n, venture forth and kill Noxxion and Razorlash. They are two of her most powerful minions and their deaths would cause the callous Princess much deserved grief and suffering of her own. Then, perhaps, you can help free my spirit from her grasp.
english.completion: Without her powerful servants, Princess Theradras is significantly more vulnerable. Find her lair, $n...it is time to strike.
english.giverWindow: They are affronts to nature itself!
english.turninWindow: I thank you for your efforts.

text.title: 软弱的鲨鱼
text.objectives: 在骸骨珊瑚礁收集5枚利颚的牙齿。
text.description: 那头鲨鱼太猛了！$b$b你决定尽量转移巴德对利颚以及骸骨珊瑚礁的注意力，这对大家都有好处。$b$b或许鲨鱼的牙齿可以成为最具说服力的物证……
text.progress: Whatcha got there, pal?
text.completion: What?! Gnaws ain't dead?! This kinda takes the quick outta my get rich quick scheme... Them giant shark teeth are nice and all, but we can't stop 'til that shiney is ours!
text.completed: Bring Gnaws' teeth to Budd at Budd's Dig in the Kelp'thar Forest.

english.title: Shark Weak
english.objectives: Collect 5 of Gnaws' teeth from the Skeletal Reef.
english.description: That's one tough shark!$b$bYou determine that it's in everyone's best interest to try and distract Budd and hope his attention never returns to Gnaws and this Skeletal Reef.$b$bPerhaps the teeth of the beast will prove captivating enough...
english.progress: Whatcha got there, pal?
english.completion: What?! Gnaws ain't dead?! This kinda takes the quick outta my get rich quick scheme... Them giant shark teeth are nice and all, but we can't stop 'til that shiney is ours!
english.completed: Bring Gnaws' teeth to Budd at Budd's Dig in the Kelp'thar Forest.

text.title: 释放红龙
text.objectives: 使用源质之斧砍断禁锢莉拉斯塔萨的镣铐。
text.description: 莉拉斯塔萨是被暮光之锤俘虏的红龙中最后的一条，也是最强大的一条。他们很快就会杀死她了。$B$B我要你使用源质之斧帮助她重获自由。
text.completion: Isn't she a beauty? Let's see what she does now that she's free.
text.completed: Return to Master Mathias Shaw at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.
text.giverWindow: 使用源质之斧帮她摆脱束缚！

english.title: Dragon, Unchained
english.objectives: Use the Elementium Axe to break the chains enslaving Lirastrasza.
english.description: Lirastrasza is the last and greatest of the red dragons that the Twilight's Hammer captured. They're about to kill her.$B$BI need you to take the Elementium Axe and free her from her bonds.
english.completion: Isn't she a beauty? Let's see what she does now that she's free.
english.completed: Return to Master Mathias Shaw at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.
english.giverWindow: Use the Elementium Axe to unchain her!

text.title: 释放红龙
text.objectives: 使用源质之斧砍断禁锢莉拉斯塔萨的镣铐。
text.description: 莉拉斯塔萨是被暮光之锤俘虏的红龙中最后的一条，也是最强大的一条。他们很快就会杀死她了。$B$B我要你使用源质之斧帮助她重获自由。
text.completion: Isn't she beautiful? So graceful. I hope she gets her fill of revenge and then some.
text.completed: Return to Garona Halforcen at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.
text.giverWindow: 使用源质之斧帮她摆脱束缚！

english.title: Dragon, Unchained
english.objectives: Use the Elementium Axe to break the chains enslaving Lirastrasza.
english.description: Lirastrasza is the last and greatest of the red dragons that the Twilight's Hammer captured. They're about to kill her, $c.$B$BYou need to take the Elementium Axe and free her from her bonds before they do.
english.completion: Isn't she beautiful? So graceful. I hope she gets her fill of revenge and then some.
english.completed: Return to Garona Halforcen at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.
english.giverWindow: Use the Elementium Axe to unchain her!

text.title: 致命一击
text.objectives: 给予5名暮光恐惧飞龙致命一击。
text.description: 瞧。莉拉斯塔萨正在激战！$B$B杀死那些被她击落的幼龙，$n。否则暮光之锤的治疗师会帮助他们重返空中。$B$B致命一击的时候到了。
text.completion: Our efforts to improve relations with the red dragons has really paid off, $n.
text.completed: Return to Master Mathias Shaw at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Coup de Grace
english.objectives: Deliver a Coup de Grace on 5 Twilight Skyterrors.
english.description: Look at that. Lirastrasza's destroying them!$B$BThere are drakes that she's downing that need finishing off, $n. Wouldn't want the Twilight's healers to get them back up into the air.$B$BTime for a little Coup de Grace.
english.completion: Our efforts to improve relations with the red dragons has really paid off, $n.
english.completed: Return to Master Mathias Shaw at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 致命一击
text.objectives: 给予5名暮光恐惧飞龙致命一击。
text.description: 瞧。莉拉斯塔萨正在激战！$B$B杀死那些被她击落的幼龙，$n。否则肮脏的暮光之锤治疗师会帮助他们重返空中。$B$B致命一击的时候到了。
text.completion: Good thing that you and Warlord Krogg made friends with the red dragons.
text.completed: Return to Garona Halforcen at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Coup de Grace
english.objectives: Deliver a Coup de Grace on 5 Twilight Skyterrors.
english.description: Look at that. Lirastrasza's destroying them!$B$BThere are still drakes that she's downing that need finishing off, $n. We don't want the stinking Twilight healers to get them back up into the air.$B$BTime for a little Coup de Grace.
english.completion: Good thing that you and Warlord Krogg made friends with the red dragons.
english.completed: Return to Garona Halforcen at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 沉没神庙的传说
text.objectives: 从神庙的前厅前往面具大厅。
text.description: 首先，我要你进入神庙，$n。一旦道路安全，我就会与你同行，但我不敢冒进。与同族对立之后，我就成了众矢之的。$B$B你可以先从我身后的阶梯下去，游过浸水的破碎大厅，沿着右边的通路找到面具大厅。$B$B要当心神庙的守卫。在你找到面具大厅之后，我会通过誓言石跟你联络。
text.completion: This is it! These are the bones of my kin...

english.title: Legends of the Sunken Temple
english.objectives: Journey through the antechambers of the temple to the Hall of Masks.
english.description: I will need you to enter the temple first, $n. I can join you once a path is secure, but I dare not enter blindly. Turned against my kind, I would be a vicious enemy.$B$BYou can start by descending the stairs behind me. Then, swim through the flooded depths of the Broken Hall. Once there, follow the passageway to the right to find the Hall of Masks.$B$BBeware of any temple guards. Once you have found the Hall of Masks, I will contact you through the Oathstone.
english.completion: This is it! These are the bones of my kin...

text.title: 第一步：女祭司
text.objectives: 杀死鲜血之厅的女祭司乌达布拉。
text.description: 我的兄弟们在这里遭到了屠戮。正如我所想的那样。$B$B在我进来之前，$n，我需要你的进一步帮助。在这座房间外面，有左右两道通路。右边的通往鲜血之厅，阿塔莱巨魔在这里举行黑暗仪式。$B$B他们为了对付我族已经枕戈待旦多年了，但他们并没有料到你会来。进入鲜血之厅，杀掉女祭司乌达布拉。她是这里三个阻挡我进入的邪恶存在之一。
text.completion: Good riddance. Another source of corruption in this world put to rest. I thank you for your bravery, $n.
text.giverWindow: 鲜血之厅的代言人

english.title: Step One: The Priestess
english.objectives: Slay Priestess Udum'bra in the Chamber of Blood.
english.description: My bretheren are being butchered here. It's as I thought.$B$BI must ask your help further before I enter, $n. In the passageway outside this room, the hallway proceeds left and right. To the right, it goes down to the Chamber of Blood. Here the Atal'ai perform their dark rituals.$B$BThey have expected and prepared for my kind for years, but not for you. Enter the Chamber of Blood and slay the Priestess Udum'bra. She is one of three foul presences here that must be vanquished before I may enter.
english.completion: Good riddance. Another source of corruption in this world put to rest. I thank you for your bravery, $n.
english.giverWindow: The speaker of the Chamber of Blood

text.title: 奥西斯节杖
text.objectives: 从圣器中获得奥西斯节杖。
text.description: 你把两块石头放到箱盘里，箱子发出咔嗒一声巨响，打了开来。$B$B拿到节杖，把它带给安曼特普将军。
text.progress: 你回来了，$N!
text.completion: So... this is what Al'Akir wanted all along.
text.completed: Bring the Scepter of Orsis to General Ammantep outside of Orsis.

english.title: The Scepter of Orsis
english.objectives: Obtain the Scepter of Orsis from the Sacred Receptacle.
english.description: The chest below unlocks with a loud click as you insert the two stones into the plaque.$B$BObtain the scepter and bring it back to General Ammantep.
english.progress: You're back, $n!
english.completion: So... this is what Al'Akir wanted all along.
english.completed: Bring the Scepter of Orsis to General Ammantep outside of Orsis.

text.title: 尼斐塞特监狱
text.objectives: 到尼斐塞特监狱去找到塔赫特的所在。
text.description: 象形文字在地图的东南角标着一个带有锁链的托维尔记号。$B$B也许塔赫特就是被带到那里去监禁起来的。

english.title: Neferset Prison
english.objectives: Go to the Neferset Prison Camp and find the whereabouts of Tahet.
english.description: Hieroglyphs depicting a chained Tol'vir mark the southeastern corner of the map.$B$BPerhaps Tahet was brought there when he was imprisoned.

text.title: 典狱官的末日
text.objectives: 石语者埃鲁纳克要你杀死关押所的典狱官埃兹加金。
text.description: <你的脑海中浮现出埃鲁纳克的影像。>$b$b你做得很好，$n。请再接再厉吧。$b$b离开这里之前，我们最好搞点破坏。$b$b找到这群纳迦的头儿，让他为自己的错误付出代价。
text.completion: It is good that this operation has been undone. Soon, I must move on...
text.completed: Speak with Erunak Stonespeaker in Deepmist Grotto in Kelp'thar Forest.
text.giverWindow: 你的脑海中浮现出埃鲁纳克的影像。

english.title: The Warden's Time
english.objectives: Erunak Stonespeaker wants you to slay Warden Azjakir at The Clutch.
english.description: <Erunak's image penetrates your mind.>$b$bYou have done well, $n, but more remains to be done.$b$bBefore moving on from this place, let us be sure that we leave it in disarray.$b$bFind the one who leads these naga and repay him for his misdeeds.
english.completion: It is good that this operation has been undone. Soon, I must move on...
english.completed: Speak with Erunak Stonespeaker in Deepmist Grotto in Kelp'thar Forest.
english.giverWindow: Erunak's image penetrates your mind.

text.title: 哨兵的游戏
text.objectives: 连接两座红色雕像，以完成哨兵的游戏。
text.description: 当你把这尊雕像放回原位之后，屋里出现了一些新的石像。其中又有一座红宝石色的雕像，在屋中的一处遥远角落的围栏中。你听到了一个声音：$B$B  “哨兵在注视。$b  哨兵在保卫。$b   哨兵预见的，永不会落空。”$b$b屋中另一边的那座红色雕像看样子很重要。也许你应该把这两座红色雕像连起来试试看？
text.completion: <The red statue falls over, and you place it back in your bags.  You hear a rumbling noise in the tomb's central chamber.>

english.title: The Sentinel's Game
english.objectives: Complete the Sentinel's Game by connecting the two red statues.
english.description: As you place the statue in its place, several other stone statues appear in the room.  One more ruby-colored statue also appears, in a small enclosure on the far end of the room.  You hear a voice:$b$b  "The Sentinel watches.$b  The Sentinel protects.$b   The Sentinel's vision never falters."$b$bThat red statue on the other side of the room looks important.  Perhaps you should try to connect the two red statues?
english.completion: <The red statue falls over, and you place it back in your bags.  You hear a rumbling noise in the tomb's central chamber.>

text.title: 返回源质深渊
text.objectives: 跟暮光高地源质深渊的见习萨满“金矿”谈一谈。
text.description: 唤地者的助手，见习萨满“金矿”想见你。$B$B他们大概觉得是时候让你帮忙处理矿洞的事务了。
text.completion: $n, glad you're back! Have I got something fun for us to do!

english.title: Back to the Elementium Depths
english.objectives: Speak with Initiate Goldmine at the Elementium Depths in the Twilight Highlands.
english.description: The Earthcaller's initiate, Goldmine, has need of you.$B$BI think that they're ready for you to help them with whatever's down in that mine.
english.completion: $n, glad you're back! Have I got something fun for us to do!

text.title: 返回源质深渊
text.objectives: 跟暮光高地源质深渊的见习萨满“金矿”谈一谈。
text.description: 唤地者有个地精见习萨满？他叫“金矿”？他想见你。$B$B他们大概觉得是时候让你帮忙处理矿洞的事务了。
text.completion: $n, glad you're back! Have I got something fun for us to do!

english.title: Back to the Elementium Depths
english.objectives: Speak with Initiate Goldmine at the Elementium Depths in the Twilight Highlands.
english.description: The Earthcaller has a goblin initiate? Goldmine is his name? He has need of you.$B$BI think that they're ready for you to do their dirty work with whatever's down in that mine.
english.completion: $n, glad you're back! Have I got something fun for us to do!

text.title: 死亡之翼降临之日
text.objectives: 听听塞尔杜林的故事。
text.description: 死亡之翼所到之处，天地变色，山崩地裂。如果不是我，他可能还在荒芜之地这里滥杀无辜呢。$B$B什么，你不相信我？好吧，听我细细道来。
text.progress: Are you going to listen or not?
text.completion: Some story, huh?  Now you know why Deathwing hasn't come back here since.
text.completed: Return to Theldurin the Lost at Aggramar's Hammer in the Badlands.

english.title: The Day that Deathwing Came
english.objectives: Listen to Theldurin's tale.
english.description: Deathwing made quite a mess when he passed through these parts.  If it weren't for me, he'd probably still be here, layin' waste to all the good people of the Badlands.$b$bWhat, you don't believe me?  Fine, let me tell you the whole story.
english.progress: Are you going to listen or not?
english.completion: Some story, huh?  Now you know why Deathwing hasn't come back here since.
english.completed: Return to Theldurin the Lost at Aggramar's Hammer in the Badlands.

text.title: 死亡之翼降临之日：真实的故事
text.objectives: 听听卢希恩·枪穗所讲述的另一个版本的故事。
text.description: 塞尔杜林的故事不仅内容不对，而且还非常无聊、缺乏想象力、冗长乏味。$B$B我来告诉你那天究竟发生了什么事。
text.completion: The end!  No moral.
text.completed: Speak with Lucien Tosselwrench at the Scar of the Worldbreaker in the Badlands.

english.title: The Day that Deathwing Came: The Real Story
english.objectives: Listen to Lucien Tosselwrench's version of the story.
english.description: Not only was Theldurin's story wrong, it was boring, unimaginitive, and slow.$b$bI'll tell you how things really happened on that day.
english.completion: The end!  No moral.
english.completed: Speak with Lucien Tosselwrench at the Scar of the Worldbreaker in the Badlands.

text.title: 死亡之翼降临之日：真正发生的事
text.objectives: 听听流放者马特克所讲述的另一个版本的故事。
text.description: 那两个家伙根本不知道怎么讲故事。塞尔杜林的故事太短，而卢希恩的故事又太长，你知道我什么意思。$b$b另外，他们的故事里都没有动作戏以及粉丝对我的仰慕。$b$b坐下，$n。我来告诉你那天究竟发生了什么。
text.completion: I can't believe those guys would interrupt me like that.  My story was going so well, too... Anyhow, thanks for sticking around so long.  It's nice to have someone new to share tall tales with.  I'm sure Lucien and Theldurin feel the same way. You have any you'd like to share with us?
text.completed: Speak with Martek the Exiled at the Scar of the Worldbreaker in the Badlands.

english.title: The Day that Deathwing Came: What Really Happened
english.objectives: Listen to Martek the Exiled's version of the story.
english.description: These two have no idea how to tell a story.  Theldurin's story was too short, and Lucien's tale was a little too tall, if you catch my drift.$b$bAlso, neither of their stories had hot babes in them.$b$bSit back, $n.  I'll tell you what really happened that day.
english.completion: I can't believe those guys would interrupt me like that.  My story was going so well, too... Anyhow, thanks for sticking around so long.  It's nice to have someone new to share tall tales with.  I'm sure Lucien and Theldurin feel the same way. You have any you'd like to share with us?
english.completed: Speak with Martek the Exiled at the Scar of the Worldbreaker in the Badlands.

objectiveDetails.description: 在贴身肉搏中击败死亡之翼

text.title: 古老的碎片
text.objectives: 将上古精灵符文交给莱维亚·梦行者。她跟联盟的奈瑟匹拉幸存者待在一起。
text.description: <古老的石板略显残破，上面密密麻麻地刻满了符文。你不懂这种文字，但是如此大量的符文加上花纹华美的石板，这一切都显示这件器物具有极高的价值。>$B$B<这正是莱维亚·梦行者一直在寻找的东西，她跟奈瑟匹拉幸存者待在一起。>
text.progress: Hah! Did you see the admiral giving me dirty looks and decide to throw some sympathy my way? I've pretty much lost hope of making him understand that these ruins offer us some opportunity to salvage some usefulness out of this whole mess. I'd actually hoped that you might turn up again - you seem like the only one I can rely on. Wait... what's that you have there?
text.completion: Brilliant! It will take me a while to translate, but this is precisely the kind of find I was hoping for. There's no knowing if we will make it out of this place, but if it comes down to it, I will find a way to float this to the surface in hopes that it will one day be found. Thank you again, $n. Here... perhaps I have something that may be of use to you.

You're unable to decipher the language, but the sheer amount of text and the semi-ornate nature of the stone suggest that this might carry significant value.>$B$B<Levia Dreamwaker, back with the Nespirah survivors, was looking for something exactly like this.>

text.title: 大酋长的命令：瓦丝琪尔！
text.objectives: 跟杜隆塔尔刃拳海湾的指挥官索拉卡谈一谈。
text.description: 部落所有身强体壮的公民听令，即刻向杜隆塔尔刃拳海湾的指挥官索拉卡报到。$B$B在与我们的宿敌联盟激战的关头，部落迫切地需要你的帮助！$B$B出奥格瑞玛进入杜隆塔尔后往南，沿着东边通往海岸的道路走便可抵达刃拳海湾。索拉卡就在码头附近值班。$B$B出发吧，$g兄弟:姐妹;！命运在召唤你！
text.completion: Lok'tar, brother! You have arrived just in time.

english.title: Warchief's Command: Vashj'ir!
english.objectives: Report to Commander Thorak at Bladefist Bay in Durotar.
english.description: All able-bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Commander Thorak at Bladefist Bay in Durotar.$B$BNow, more than ever, your help is needed in battling our most hated enemy, the Alliance!$B$BTo reach Bladefist Bay you must travel south through the main gates of Orgrimmar and enter Durotar. From there, follow the path east to the coast. Thorak will be standing at his post near the docks.$B$BOnward, $g brother:sister;! Destiny calls!
english.completion: Lok'tar, brother! You have arrived just in time.

text.title: 生命之水
text.objectives: 使用生命之水从铸炉之主芬雷的尸体上提取信息。
text.description: 带上生命之水，将它倒在淹死的矮人尸体上。$B$B生前他与金属为伍，如今湖水浸透他的肉身。你想知道的一切，生命之水都会让他告诉你。$B$B你知晓答案后，请立即离开我的领地。
text.completion: The Hammer of Twilight? And you say you got this information out of a drowned Wildhammer dwarf? You're kidding, right?
text.completed: 跟暮光高地暮光堡垒的马迪亚斯·肖尔大师谈一谈。

english.title: Water of Life
english.objectives: Use the Water of Life to extract information from the Corpse of Forgemaster Finlay.
english.description: Take my Water of Life and pass it into the corpse of the drowned dwarf.$B$BHe was a worker of metals in life, and though his body now feeds my loch, the Water will allow him to tell you what you want to know.$B$BThen, take your information and be gone from my demesne.
english.completion: The Hammer of Twilight? And you say you got this information out of a drowned Wildhammer dwarf? You're kidding, right?
english.completed: Speak with Master Mathias Shaw at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: “金矿”先生的交通工具
text.objectives: 跟见习萨满“金矿”一起乘坐矿车抵达终点。
text.description: $n，我们要前往洞穴尽头的大地传送门。$B$B我设法“弄到”了交通工具。如果可以乘坐交通工具的话，干嘛要走着去呢？希望你不会介意搭乘矿车。$B$B准备好了的话告诉我一声。
text.completion: Oh no! My weapons and totems! They're destroyed!!!
text.completed: Speak with Initiate Goldmine inside the Elementium Depths in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Mr. Goldmine's Wild Ride
english.objectives: Ride the mine cart with Initiate Goldmine to the end of the line.
english.description: Okay, $n, we need to get to the earth portal at the back of the cave.$B$BI've "procured" a ride for us. Why walk when we can ride in style? I hope you don't mind mine carts.$B$BLet me know when you're ready.
english.completion: Oh no! My weapons and totems! They're destroyed!!!
english.completed: Speak with Initiate Goldmine inside the Elementium Depths in the Twilight Highlands.

objectiveDetails.description: 跟“金矿”交谈以乘坐矿车

text.title: 大酋长的命令：海加尔山！
text.objectives: 跟塞纳里奥使者托尔·黑蹄谈一谈，进入月光林地。
text.description: 所有身强力壮的部落成员此刻起听候月光林地永夜港风歌使者的差遣。$B$B我们在塞纳里奥议会的弟兄们报告说，死亡之翼的爪牙已经对世界之树展开了一次毁灭性的进攻，并威胁要将它烧成焦炭！$B$B跟塞纳里奥使者托尔·黑蹄谈一谈，进入月光林地。黑蹄就在奥格瑞玛智慧谷的牛头人区。$B$B前进$g兄弟:姐妹;！命运在召唤！
text.completion: We knew the Horde would send help and not a moment too soon!
text.end: 获得前往月光林地的许可
text.completed: 跟月光林地永夜港的风歌使者谈一谈。

english.title: Warchief's Command: Mount Hyjal!
english.objectives: Speak to Cenarion Emissary Blackhoof to secure transportation to Moonglade.
english.description: All able-bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Emissary Windsong at Nighthaven in Moonglade.$B$BOur brothers in the Cenarion Circle report that Deathwing's minions have launched a destructive offensive against the world tree and threaten to burn it to the ground!$B$BSpeak with Cenarion Emissary Blackhoof to gain entry into Moonglade. Blackhoof is located at the tauren district in the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar.$B$BOnward, $g brother:sister;! Destiny calls!
english.completion: We knew the Horde would send help and not a moment too soon!
english.completed: Speak with Emissary Windsong at Nighthaven in Moonglade.

text.title: 大酋长的命令：深岩之洲！
text.objectives: 跟奥格瑞玛西部大地神殿的先知克洛伽谈一谈。
text.description: 此刻起，所有健全的部落成员都要听候奥格瑞玛西部大地神殿先知克洛伽的差遣。$B$B由我们前任酋长萨尔所领导的大地之环，需要我们的援助！他们报告说深岩之洲的元素位面威胁到了我们的世界，即将摧毁艾泽拉斯的所有生灵！$B$B西部大地神殿就在智慧谷的北方。$B$B前进吧，$g兄弟:姐妹;！命运在召唤！
text.completion: Our world is in danger, $n! We need the help of great heroes, like you, to save it!

english.title: Warchief's Command: Deepholm!
english.objectives: Speak with Farseer Krogar at the Western Earthshrine in Orgrimmar.
english.description: All able-bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Farseer Krogar at the Western Earthshrine in Orgrimmar.$B$BThe Earthen Ring, lead by our former Warchief, Thrall, requires our aid! They report that the elemental plane of Deepholm threatens to overtake our world!$B$BThe Western Earthshrine can be found just north of the Valley of Wisdom.$B$BOnward, $g brother:sister;! Destiny calls!
english.completion: Our world is in danger, $n! We need the help of great heroes, like you, to save it!

text.title: 英雄的召唤：瓦丝琪尔！
text.objectives: 跟暴风城港口的征募官伯恩斯谈一谈。
text.description: 尊敬的安度因·乌瑞恩国王殿下下令，联盟所有身强体壮的公民即刻向暴风城港口的征募官伯恩斯报到。$B$B最近部落接二连三地偷袭我们的商船，我们必须迅速组织兵力与之抗衡！$B$B暴风城港口位于暴风城西北区域。$B$B为了联盟的荣耀！战斗吧，$g兄弟:姐妹;！
text.completion: All of our war ships are off fighting the Horde. You'll have to take the mercenary ship.

english.title: Hero's Call: Vashj'ir!
english.objectives: Speak with Recruiter Burns at Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Recruiter Burns in Stormwind Harbor.$B$BRecent attacks by the Horde on our trade ships must be met with swift and just force!$B$BStormwind Harbor can be found in the northwest region of Stormwind City.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance! Fight on, $g brother:sister;!
english.completion: All of our war ships are off fighting the Horde. You'll have to take the mercenary ship.

text.title: 奎尔丹尼小屋
text.objectives: 跟奎尔丹尼小屋的学者特莱丝卡谈一谈。
text.description: 你大概会奇怪我为何要远离家园来到这里，$c。我们在鲁雷斯大使的带领来到这儿，在西北边和高等精灵一起住在奎尔丹尼小屋里，接受圣光之道的训练，享受这片土地的平和之美。$B$B但这样的和平可能无法持久了。我们已经看见部落正向西推进。你能不能到奎尔丹尼去警告学者特莱丝卡？她的小屋就在主屋的北边。
text.completion:
Yoro sends warning of the Horde? The Highvale have been cautious of an attack for some time now. In fact, we have been--

<Screams and the clash of metal break out to the south.>

english.title: Quel'Danil Lodge
english.objectives: Speak with Anchorite Traska at the Quel'Danil Lodge.
english.description: I may appear far from home to you, $c, but quite a few of my people were led here by Ambassador Rualeth. We have settled with the high elves of the Quel'Danil Lodge, to the northwest, to train in the ways of the Light and enjoy the peaceful beauty of this land.$B$BSuch peace may be short lived. We have seen the Horde moving further west from here. Could you travel to Quel'Danil and give warning to Anchorite Traska? Her cabin is just north of the main lodge.
english.completion:
Yoro sends warning of the Horde? The Highvale have been cautious of an attack for some time now. In fact, we have been--

<Screams and the clash of metal break out to the south.>

text.objectives: 跟塞纳里奥使者安亚·碧月谈一谈，进入月光林地。
text.description: 奉国王陛下安度因·乌瑞恩的命令，联盟所有身强力壮的公民都要向月光林地永夜港的风歌使者报到。$B$B我们在塞纳里奥议会的弟兄们报告说，死亡之翼的爪牙已经对世界之树展开了毁灭性的进攻，并威胁要将它烧成焦炭！$B$B跟暴风城堡的塞纳里奥使者安亚·碧月谈一谈，进入月光林地。$B$B为了联盟的荣耀和尊严！战斗吧，$g兄弟:姐妹;！
text.completion: We knew the Alliance would send help and not a moment too soon!
text.end: 获得前往月光林地的许可
text.completed: 跟月光林地永夜港的风歌使者谈一谈。

text.objectives: 跟暴风城东部大地神殿的地语者纳拉特谈一谈。
text.description: 奉安度因·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，联盟所有健全的市民都要向暴风城东部大地神殿的地语者纳拉特报到。$B$B大地之环需要我们的援助！他们报告说深岩之洲的元素位面威胁到了我们的世界，即将摧毁艾泽拉斯的所有生灵！$B$B东部大地神殿就在暴风城堡的西北面。$B$B为了联盟的荣耀和尊严！战斗吧，$g兄弟:姐妹;！
