english.objectives: Speak with Naraat the Earthspeaker at the Eastern Earthshrine in Stormwind City.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Naraat the Earthspeaker at the Eastern Earthshrine in Stormwind City.$B$BThe Earthen Ring requires our aid! They report that the elemental plane of Deepholm threatens to overtake our world and destroy all life on Azeroth!$B$BThe Eastern Earthshrine can be found directly northwest of Stormwind Keep.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance! Fight on, $g brother:sister;!
english.completion: Our world is in danger, $n! We need the help of great heroes, like you, to save it!

text.title: 再次对付海鳗
text.objectives: 在巨藻森林中杀死任意种类的8条海鳗。
text.description: 鳗鱼是艾泽拉斯最恐怖的生物之一。$b$b当然，有些人装作并不在乎这种生物——另一些人则宣称非常喜欢它们。$b$b他们在说谎。$b$b实际上，没有人喜欢鳗鱼。鳗鱼也不喜欢彼此。$b$b如果我们不用担心在阴暗的水域中突然被游弋的鳗鱼咬上一口，艾泽拉斯将成为更加美好的居住地。$b$b鳗鱼最喜欢咬脸了。
text.completion: You can add this to list of things you can tell your grandchildren that you've done for them.

english.title: Once More, With Eeling
english.objectives: Kill 8 of any Eel in the Kelp Forest.
english.description: Eels are among the creepiest of Azeroth's creatures.$b$bSure, there are those who pretend that they don't mind them - and others who actually claim to favor them.$b$bThey are lying.$b$bTruth be told, no one likes eels. Eels don't even like eels.$b$bAzeroth would be a better place if no one ever had to envision an eel slithering out from the murky depths and biting them.$b$bIn the face.
english.completion: You can add this to list of things you can tell your grandchildren that you've done for them.

objectiveDetails.description: 杀死足够多的令人作呕的海鳗

text.title: 偷梁换柱
text.objectives: 杀死兰多菲·摩洛克。
text.description: 你瞧，我十分乐意现在就下令，让我的人把这些叛乱分子轰成渣，但我不能，因为整个监狱在典狱官塞尔沃特的辖下，而他现在只想把他们控制住。$B$B我们要用一种稍稍不同的办法来解决这个问题，而不是抗命！我们成功地和莫提姆·摩洛克交上了朋友，他碰巧又是无情的反抗军领袖兰多菲·摩洛克的孪生兄弟。杀掉兰多菲，然后我们来个偷天换日，让莫提姆兵不血刃地制止叛乱！
text.completion: Yes, Mortimer just faked his own death. He'll probably take on his brother's name and continue on his 'epic schemes'. We'll just have to deal with that when the time comes.
text.completed: Return to Rifle Commander Coe.

english.title: The Good Ol' Switcheroo
english.objectives: Kill Randolph Moloch.
english.description: Look, I'd love to give the order and have my men blast these rebels to bits right now, but I can't because the entire Stockade is under Warden Thelwater's jurisdiction, and he only wants to contain them right now.$B$BRather than disobey orders, we're going to take care of this in a slightly different manner! We've managed to befriend Mortimer Moloch, who just so happens to be the ruthless rebel leader Randolph Moloch's twin. Kill Randolph, and we'll switch 'em so Mortimer can stop the rebellion peacefully!
english.completion: Yes, Mortimer just faked his own death. He'll probably take on his brother's name and continue on his 'epic schemes'. We'll just have to deal with that when the time comes.
english.completed: Return to Rifle Commander Coe.

text.title: 有了火我们就得救了！
text.objectives: 获得灼热勋爵的炽炎之核。
text.description: 我通晓急救和各种治疗手法，有光明之泉的帮助，我能护理我们的人，让他们大多数完全康复。我们仍然要面对的问题是，这里实在是又冷又潮，就算是治好了伤口，不少人还是没法挺过来！$B$B地震让监狱土地之下栖息的元素愤怒异常……它们破土而出时杀掉了半数的囚犯。如果你能把它们的头领灼热勋爵杀掉，把他的核心带来，我就能给我们的人取暖了！
text.progress: Do you have the core? Our men are dying in here!
text.completion: Thank goodness! With this fire, our men will live through this ordeal! Thank you so much, hero.
text.completed: Return to Nurse Lillian.

english.title: By Fire Be Saved!
english.objectives: Obtain Lord Overheat's Fiery Core.
english.description: I'm well-versed in first aid and other forms of healing, and with the help of my Lightwell I've been able to nurse many of our men back to full health. The problem we still have is that it's so cold and damp down here that I'm losing them anyways, despite healing their wounds!$B$BThe quakes angered the elements that reside in the prison...when they erupted out of the earth they slaughtered half of the prisoners. If you slay their leader, Lord Overheat, and bring me his core I can use it to warm our men!
english.progress: Do you have the core? Our men are dying in here!
english.completion: Thank goodness! With this fire, our men will live through this ordeal! Thank you so much, hero.
english.completed: Return to Nurse Lillian.

text.title: 邪鳞地穴
text.objectives: 把奥丹姆邪鳞地穴的塔赫特救出来。
text.description: 地图最南边的一个点上标着鳄鱼相互搏斗的象形符号。$B$B凯玛斯一定把塔赫特带到那儿去了。$B$B前往邪鳞地穴，想办法把宰相的儿子救出来。
text.completion: I thank you for what you've done, $n.  You can count on my vote when High Council convenes.

english.title: The Pit of Scales
english.objectives: Rescue Tahet at the Pit of Scales in Uldum.
english.description: A spot on the southern end of the map was marked with hieroglyphs of crocodiles fighting each other.$B$BThat must be where Caimas took Tahet.$B$BGo to the Pit of Scales and find a way to rescue the Vizier's son.
english.completion: I thank you for what you've done, $n.  You can count on my vote when High Council convenes.

text.title: 豺狼人国王
text.objectives: 击败霍格。
text.description: $n，我恐怕要交给你一项不可能的任务。$B$B我戴的这副眼罩就是拜他所赐。成千上万的人在他的愤怒下送命。我们将他限制在这个地区，只能说是单纯的奇迹。$B$B但这么做是一个严重的错误。我们尽可能地坚持着，他们却在这个时候出现了——那些效忠于霍格的豺狼人从阴影和黑暗中走来，将我最优秀的人马杀得片甲不留。$B$B你必须打败豺狼人国王，阻止他进行另一次进攻，不然他将无情而嗜血地把我们都杀死。
text.progress: Have you defeated Hogger?
text.completion: You have performed a deed this day unlike any I have seen in my long career. Hogger's death will plague the Riverpaw for years to come, and hopefully put an end to their attacks on our people. Greatest of heroes, please take this as a sign of my eternal gratitude.
text.completed: Return to Warden Thelwater.
text.giverWindow: 没人能够击败他。

english.title: The Gnoll King
english.objectives: Defeat Hogger.
english.description: $n, I'm afraid I must ask of you the impossible.$B$BI received my eyepatch because he willed it so. Countless thousands have perished to his wrath. It was only by sheer miracle that we were able to imprison him here.$B$BDoing so was a grave mistake. We held out as long as we could, but then they came. From the shadows and darkness, gnolls in service of Hogger ripped my best men to pieces.$B$BYou must defeat the Gnoll King, lest he mounts another attack and slaughters us all in cold, bloodthirsty rage.
english.progress: Have you defeated Hogger?
english.completion: You have performed a deed this day unlike any I have seen in my long career. Hogger's death will plague the Riverpaw for years to come, and hopefully put an end to their attacks on our people. Greatest of heroes, please take this as a sign of my eternal gratitude.
english.completed: Return to Warden Thelwater.
english.giverWindow: No one can defeat him.

text.title: 芭芭·沼酒
text.objectives: 跟小狂人黛西谈谈，坐大炮去找芭芭·沼酒。
text.description: 嘿，你不在的时候，贸易巨头来过了！他不停地踢我，直到我身上的钱掉出来了才罢手！$B$B话说回来，他总是那么干。不过这次他让我跟你说件事！他要你去南边帮助我们的药草师芭芭·沼酒。$B$B过了这片水域就是！不过你只需要去跟外面的好姑娘黛西谈谈，她可以用疯狂的拉里的方法把你送过去。
text.completion: Ah, it's so nice to have help dropped in. Modern convenience... I can't get enough of it.

english.title: Baba Bogbrew
english.objectives: Talk to Lil' Crazy Daisy to take a cannon ride to Baba Bogbrew.
english.description: Hey, while you were out, the Baron stopped by! He kicked me until money came out!$B$BHe always does that though. But this time he asked me to tell you something! He wants you to go south and help out our herbalist, Baba Bogbrew.$B$BShe's all the way across the water! But just talk to my girl Daisy outside and she'll send you there the Crazy Larry way!
english.completion: Ah, it's so nice to have help dropped in. Modern convenience... I can't get enough of it.

text.title: Show Me Your Papers
text.objectives: Go to the front gates of Stormwind, read King Wrynn's Proclamation and search 5 Stormwind Citizens. Keep anything suspicious that you find.
text.description: After your work in dealing with the Twilight's Hammer cult, Captain Anton recommended you for a delicate assignment.$B$BMy men recently discovered a group of cultists attempting to sneak into the city. The flow of traffic into the Stormwind has come to a halt. The king has decreed that all visitors must be searched before they can enter the gates. Take this copy of his proclamation and read it to the people assembled at the front gates, then assist the guards there in searching those who wish to enter.
text.completion: So there were more cultists waiting to be admitted to the city? It's a good thing that you caught them, $n. Reading over the note that you found, it seems they're planning something big.
text.completed: Return to Justine Demalier in Stormwind's Trade Quarter.

english.title: Show Me Your Papers
english.objectives: Go to the front gates of Stormwind, read King Wrynn's Proclamation and search 5 Stormwind Citizens. Keep anything suspicious that you find.
english.description: After your work in dealing with the Twilight's Hammer cult, Captain Anton recommended you for a delicate assignment.$B$BMy men recently discovered a group of cultists attempting to sneak into the city. The flow of traffic into the Stormwind has come to a halt. The king has decreed that all visitors must be searched before they can enter the gates. Take this copy of his proclamation and read it to the people assembled at the front gates, then assist the guards there in searching those who wish to enter.
english.completion: So there were more cultists waiting to be admitted to the city? It's a good thing that you caught them, $n. Reading over the note that you found, it seems they're planning something big.
english.completed: Return to Justine Demalier in Stormwind's Trade Quarter.

text.title: 分一杯羹
text.objectives: 收集6块源质碎片。
text.description: 你要知道，从页岩蜘蛛那里抢回源质矿是我们的义务。这些恶心的生物以源质矿为食！$B$B真浪费啊！$B$B怎么样？我们九一分账，我九你一如何？
text.progress: How much do you think you can carry?
text.completion: Hmm, I don't think that stuff's going to sell for much. I better give you your cut right now so you don't feel ripped off.
text.completed: Speak with Initiate Goldmine within the Elementium Depths in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: A Little on the Side
english.objectives: Collect 6 Elementium Shards.
english.description: You know, it's our moral obligation to save all of this Elementium from the shale spiders. Those creepy things eat the stuff!$B$BWhat a waste!$B$BSo, what do you say? 90/10 my way?
english.progress: How much do you think you can carry?
english.completion: Hmm, I don't think that stuff's going to sell for much. I better give you your cut right now so you don't feel ripped off.
english.completed: Speak with Initiate Goldmine within the Elementium Depths in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 既然来了
text.objectives: 在源质深渊杀死12名暮光之锤教徒，深渊监工和暮光矿工皆可。
text.description: 既然来了，就顺手除掉暮光之锤入侵者吧。这里毕竟曾经是我们的地盘！$B$B我本来可以帮忙的，但是图腾和武器都坏掉了，我也没有办法呀。
text.completion: They had it coming to them.
text.completed: Speak with Intiate Goldmine within the Elementium Depths in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: While We're Here
english.objectives: Slay 12 Twilight's Hammer cultists, either Depths Overseer or Twilight Miners, within the Elementium Depths.
english.description: You know, while we're here, we might as well take care of the Twilight's Hammer intruders. This place used to be ours, after all!$B$BI'd help, but with my totems and weapons broken, I'm pretty helpless.
english.completion: They had it coming to them.
english.completed: Speak with Intiate Goldmine within the Elementium Depths in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 摧毁符文
text.objectives: 摧毁暮光大地符文、暮光水之符文、暮光空气符文和暮光火焰符文。
text.description: 你注视着暮光大地符文，几乎能感觉到它的能量不断地向源质深渊扩散。$B$B它很可能与其它符文有所关联。见习萨满“金矿”认为你应该摧毁所有的符文。
text.completion: That'll teach 'em to move in on our territory! What's that over across the way?
text.completed: Speak with Initiate Goldmine within the Elementium Depths in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Rune Ruination
english.objectives: Destroy the Twilight Rune of Earth, Rune of Water, Rune of Air, and Rune of Fire.
english.description: Examining the Twilight Rune of Earth, you can almost feel its power extending further into the Elementium Depths.$B$BIt's probably connected to other runes. Initiate Goldmine thinks that you should destroy all of them.
english.completion: That'll teach 'em to move in on our territory! What's that over across the way?
english.completed: Speak with Initiate Goldmine within the Elementium Depths in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 火焰的重逢
text.objectives: 夺得火焰传送门控制器，并在火焰传送门中使用它。
text.description: 那是熔岩之牙，这只火元素与我不和。$n，你必须杀死他，不然我会没命的！$B$B其实只是个天大的误会。在深岩之洲的时候，我不过是“借”了他的心脏一用，我没有料到他会气得发疯啊。他又不会死……暂时而已，反正不会真的死掉！$B$B他身上肯定有传送门的控制器。你必须夺得控制器，然后在火焰传送门中使用它，这样我们就能返回入口处了。
text.completion: We survived and all of the portals are now shutdown! You don't think Magmatooth is going to hold a grudge, do you?
text.completed: Give the controller to Initiate Goldmine at the entrance of the Elementium Depths in the Twilight Highlands.
text.giverWindow: 曾属于见习萨满金矿的火元素。他们之间的关系很糟。

english.title: A Fiery Reunion
english.objectives: Obtain the Fire Portal Controller and use it at the Fire Portal.
english.description: That's Magmatooth, my estranged fire elemental. $n, you gotta kill him or he's gonna kill me!$B$BIt was all just a big misunderstanding. How was I to know he'd be mad about me "borrowing" his heart down in Deepholm? He can't die... not permanently anyway!$B$BHe's got the controller to the portal on him for sure. You gotta get the controller and then use it in the Fire portal to take us back to the entrance.
english.completion: We survived and all of the portals are now shutdown! You don't think Magmatooth is going to hold a grudge, do you?
english.completed: Give the controller to Initiate Goldmine at the entrance of the Elementium Depths in the Twilight Highlands.
english.giverWindow: Former fire elemental of Initiate Goldmine. There's bad blood between them.

objectiveDetails.description: 使用火焰传送门控制器

text.title: 被摧残的帝国
text.objectives: 向希尔斯布莱德丘陵南点大门的高级执行官达萨利亚报到。
text.description: 战争对我们造成了严重的创伤。跟洛丹伦的统治者一样，为了坚守领地，我们损失了大量的兵力。虽然目前我们暂时取得了胜利，但是东部王国的战火仍然在燃烧。$B$B我必须返回幽暗城养精蓄锐。我要你代表我奔赴希尔斯布莱德丘陵，$n。你是我最信任的士兵，我希望你能带领军队击败敌人，取得对希尔斯布莱德丘陵的绝对控制权。$B$B去东边，向南点大门的高级执行官达萨利亚报到吧。
text.completion: News of your conquest in Silverpine emboldens us, $n. We are prepared to fight at your command and beat back the last remaining vestiges of humanity in Hillsbrad.

english.title: Empire of Dirt
english.objectives: Report to High Executor Darthalia at Southpoint Blockade in Hillsbrad Foothills.
english.description: This war has taken its toll on us as a people. We have lost much to secure our place as the rightful rulers of Lordaeron. And though the moment is won, the battle continues to rage in other parts of the Eastern Kingdoms.$B$BI must return to the Undercity to recuperate. I want you to go to Hillsbrad Foothills in my stead, $n. As my most trusted soldier, you will lead our forces to absolute domination against our enemies in Hillsbrad.$B$BReport to High Executor Darthalia at Southpoint Blockade, to the east.
english.completion: News of your conquest in Silverpine emboldens us, $n. We are prepared to fight at your command and beat back the last remaining vestiges of humanity in Hillsbrad.

text.title: 全面战争
text.objectives: 在桑德玛尔废墟打破10桶桑德玛尔麦酒。
text.description: 许多蛮锤矮人逃离了家园。是时候将他们彻底地从地图上抹去了。$B$B你可以在桑德玛尔废墟北部的山脊处找到被遗弃的房屋。矮人将桑德玛尔麦酒桶留在了那里。$B$B那是220度的烈酒，我不知道他们是怎么酿造出来的。$B$B打破酒桶，烧掉矮人的美酒。统统烧掉！让他们的家园成为真正的废墟！
text.completion: Yes, yes. Burn them out, as you would flush groundhogs from their holes... Well done, $n.
text.completed: Return to Harkkan at Bloodgulch in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Total War
english.objectives: Smash 10 Thundermar Ale Kegs within the Thundermar Ruins.
english.description: Many of the Wildhammer have already fled their homes. It is time to wipe them from the map.$B$BUp on the ridge to the north you will find abandoned houses in the Thundermar Ruins. Kegs of potent Thundermar ale have been left behind.$B$BThundermar ale is 220 proof; I don't know how that's possible.$B$BSmash open the kegs and set their content aflame. Burn them out! Leave the dwarves nothing to return to!
english.completion: Yes, yes. Burn them out, as you would flush groundhogs from their holes... Well done, $n.
english.completed: Return to Harkkan at Bloodgulch in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 财富与荣耀
text.objectives: 摧毁黑曜石巨像。
text.description: 我们必须继续前进，$n。那些部队恢复秩序只是时间问题而已。$b$b箱子应该就在这些废墟后面。$b$b保持警惕。我感觉这事还没完……
text.completion: Good to see you're still in one piece, $n.
text.completed: Speak to Harrison Jones at Maker's Ascent.

english.title: Fortune and Glory
english.objectives: Kill the Obsidian Colossus.
english.description: We have to keep moving, $n. It's just a matter of time before those troops get their act together.$b$bThe coffer should be just beyond these ruins.$b$bStay on your toes. Something tells me this isn't over yet...
english.completion: Good to see you're still in one piece, $n.
english.completed: Speak to Harrison Jones at Maker's Ascent.

text.title: Arrest the Infiltrators
text.objectives: Use the Heavy Manacles to arrest 5 Cultist Infiltrators and bring them to Warden Thelwater at the Stockade. After you've returned with your prisoners, question one of the Detained Cultists in the Stockade.
text.description: You were right to bring this note to me, $n. The king's proclamation came too late; they already have infiltrators at work in the city.$B$BThis note contains instructions and locations for cultists to meet, but it doesn't say what they're doing. Our enemies have grown smarter. It's going to be tough to track down all the infiltrators, but we have to get as many as we can. Use these cuffs to restrain any agents you find, bring them to the entrance of the Stockade, and report to me when you're finished.
text.completion: Excellent work, $n. The note you captured makes sense in light of this ritual the infiltrators mentioned. This city is infested with cultists and their sympathizers. We must act before their plans can come to fruition.
text.completed: Return to Justine Demalier in Stormwind's Trade District.

english.title: Arrest the Infiltrators
english.objectives: Use the Heavy Manacles to arrest 5 Cultist Infiltrators and bring them to Warden Thelwater at the Stockade. After you've returned with your prisoners, question one of the Detained Cultists in the Stockade.
english.description: You were right to bring this note to me, $n. The king's proclamation came too late; they already have infiltrators at work in the city.$B$BThis note contains instructions and locations for cultists to meet, but it doesn't say what they're doing. Our enemies have grown smarter. It's going to be tough to track down all the infiltrators, but we have to get as many as we can. Use these cuffs to restrain any agents you find, bring them to the entrance of the Stockade, and report to me when you're finished.
english.completion: Excellent work, $n. The note you captured makes sense in light of this ritual the infiltrators mentioned. This city is infested with cultists and their sympathizers. We must act before their plans can come to fruition.
english.completed: Return to Justine Demalier in Stormwind's Trade District.

objectiveDetails.description: Arrested Cultists brought to the Stockade

text.title: 军粮供给
text.objectives: 在桑德玛尔废墟收集10件蛮锤存粮。
text.description: <格里夫的肚子咕咕叫。>$B$B龙喉氏族一旦开战，所有人都会停止狩猎。$B$B最美味的食物来自敌人的供给。河流以北的山脊处有一排蛮锤房屋的废墟。我敢打赌那里堆满了食物。$B$B给我找一些来。
text.progress: Hungry.
text.completion: Great! Did you get any for yourself?
text.completed: Bring the food back to Griff at Bloodgulch in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: War Forage
english.objectives: Gather 10 Wildhammer Food Stores from the Thundermar Ruins.
english.description: <Griff's stomach growls.>$B$BWhenever we Dragonmaw go on the warpath, everyone stops hunting.$B$BThe best tasting food is stolen from the mouths of the enemy. Up on the ridge north of the river there's a bunch of wrecked Wildhammer houses. I bet they're loaded with food.$B$BBring some to my mouth.
english.progress: Hungry.
english.completion: Great! Did you get any for yourself?
english.completed: Bring the food back to Griff at Bloodgulch in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 重创蛮锤矮人
text.objectives: 杀死蛮锤烙印战士，收集8枚蛮锤徽章。桑德玛尔废墟中带名字的生物也会掉落徽章。
text.description: 自从龙喉兽人抢先占领暮光高地起，蛮锤矮人就一直跟我们作对。我们曾经在格瑞姆巴托和湿地与他们交手，如今战火已经燃到了河流以北的区域，就在桑德玛尔废墟之中。$B$B证明你是个勇敢的人物吧。杀死蛮锤烙印战士。他们中最优秀的战士佩戴着徽章——我手下的士兵已经收集到好几打了。$B$B你行吗？
text.progress: Show me the insignias you've collected, $c.
text.completion: So, $c. There's more to you than meets the eye. Maybe your Horde can stand with the best of my warriors. Let's try you out...
text.completed: Bring the Wildhammer Insignias to Narkrall Rakeclaw at Bloodgulch in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Crushing the Wildhammer
english.objectives: Kill Wildhammer Warbrands to collect 8 Wildhammer Insignias. Named characters within the Thundermar Ruins will also carry insignias.
english.description: Since my people first claimed the Highlands, the Wildhammer dwarves have been our persistent foe. We fought them in Grim Batol, we fought them in the Wetlands, and even now open warfare rages to our north, across the river, amidst the Thundermar Ruins.$B$BProve your valor to me. Seek out and crush Wildhammer Warbrands. The best among them carry insignias - my warriors collect them by the dozen.$B$BCan you?
english.progress: Show me the insignias you've collected, $c.
english.completion: So, $c. There's more to you than meets the eye. Maybe your Horde can stand with the best of my warriors. Let's try you out...
english.completed: Bring the Wildhammer Insignias to Narkrall Rakeclaw at Bloodgulch in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 像蛮锤一样战斗
text.objectives: 在桑德玛尔废墟收集10桶桑德玛尔麦酒。小心，这酒很烈！
text.description: 我们酿造的美酒是东部王国最好喝的麦酒，这绝不是吹牛。它是220度的烈酒。对，你没听错！$B$B许多人从南部撤离到城镇中心时，被迫将麦酒留在了原址。$B$B<布朗迪停了下来，气氛变得更加凝重了。>$B$B把酒找回来！即便是最瘦弱的战士，只要喝下它，也会变成疯狂的杀戮机器。找回酒桶！这是我们唯一的希望！
text.progress: Get me that ale, $n. Hey, you haven't been skimmin' off the top, have you?
text.completion: Oh aye ... we get a few of these kegs out to the boys on the front and we're gonna see some fireworks. Thank you, $n!
text.completed: Bring the Ale back to Low Shaman Blundy at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Fight Like a Wildhammer
english.objectives: Collect 10 Kegs of Thundermar Ale from the Thundermar Ruins. Careful - it's got some kick!
english.description: S'not a boast to say that we Thundermars brew the finest ale in the Eastern Kingdoms. It's 220 proof. Yeah, you heard me!$B$BAs folks fled from the south to the town center, they were forced to leave behind their ale.$B$B<Blundy pauses, allowing the gravity of the situation to soak in.>$B$BGET IT BACK! That stuff'll turn even the stringiest of warriors into a whirlin' dervish of mouth-foaming destruction. Get them kegs! S'our only hope!
english.progress: Get me that ale, $n. Hey, you haven't been skimmin' off the top, have you?
english.completion: Oh aye ... we get a few of these kegs out to the boys on the front and we're gonna see some fireworks. Thank you, $n!
english.completed: Bring the Ale back to Low Shaman Blundy at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 绝不浪费粮食
text.objectives: 在桑德玛尔废墟收集10件蛮锤存粮。
text.description: 我们的物资愈发短缺了，$n。不断有来自山脊各处的难民涌来桑德玛尔——填饱这么多张嘴可不容易。$B$B他们在撤离家园时，将很多存粮留在了原址。我们需要粮食！$B$B去桑德玛尔废墟南面、东面和西南寻找食物。$B$B小心，$c！那片废墟的战事依然激烈。
text.progress: Got some eats?
text.completion: It's good - hardly a worm or weevil to be found! This is a lifesaver to the folk who fled here for survival.
text.completed: Bring the food to Fanny Thundermar at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Never Leave a Dinner Behind
english.objectives: Gather 10 Wildhammer Food Stores from the Thundermar Ruins.
english.description: Supplies are short, $n. We've got refugees coming into Thundermar from up and down the ridge - that's a lot of mouths to feed.$B$BPlenty of food stores were left behind as people pulled their families to safety. We need that food!$B$BScour the Thundermar ruins south, east, and southwest of here for food stores.$B$BCareful, $c! The fighting around the ruins is pretty intense.
english.progress: Got some eats?
english.completion: It's good - hardly a worm or weevil to be found! This is a lifesaver to the folk who fled here for survival.
english.completed: Bring the food to Fanny Thundermar at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 重创龙喉兽人
text.objectives: 杀死龙喉劫掠者，收集8枚龙喉徽记。桑德玛尔废墟中带名字的生物也会掉落徽记。
text.description: 龙喉兽人！$B$B<科林啐了一口。>$B$B怪物，全是怪物。自从上一次战争，我们和龙喉兽人在暮光高地的冲突就没有停止过。如今他们与部落联手了？$B$B想要说服蛮锤部族与联盟结盟，就与龙喉兽人开战并证明你的实力。投身桑德玛尔废墟南面及西南的激战。杀死龙喉劫掠者，并收集龙喉氏族最伟大的战士才有资格佩戴的徽章。然后再来找我谈结盟的事吧。
text.progress: How goes the fight, $c?
text.completion: Look at that! That's quite a collection of trophies you have there. I'll spread the word. If a single Alliance $c can do this, imagine what the rest of your lot can accomplish!
text.completed: Bring the Insigias to Colin Thundermar at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Dragonmaw Takedown
english.objectives: Kill Dragonmaw Marauders and collect 8 Dragonmaw Insignias. Named characters within the Thundermar Ruins will also carry insignias.
english.description: The Dragonmaw!$B$B<Colin spits.>$B$BMonsters, all of them. We've fought them up and down these highlands since the last war. And now they're joining forces with the Horde?$B$BIf you're going to convince us Wildhammers to unite under the Alliance banner, you'd best prove yourself against the Dragonmaw. Wade into the battle that's raging in the Thundermar ruins to the south and southwest. Kill Dragonmaw marauders and collect the insignias that their greatest warriors wear. Then we'll talk.
english.progress: How goes the fight, $c?
english.completion: Look at that! That's quite a collection of trophies you have there. I'll spread the word. If a single Alliance $c can do this, imagine what the rest of your lot can accomplish!
english.completed: Bring the Insigias to Colin Thundermar at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 古墓的诅咒
text.objectives: 消灭6个发疯的挖掘者和机械师米歇特韦德。
text.description: 尼斐塞特并非我们的神圣墓穴所面临的唯一威胁。$B$B几周前，有一支侏儒探险队跑到我们的地界来了。$B$B他们没有听从我们的警告，一路挖进了一座被诅咒的墓穴。$B$B整个探险队都遭到了可怕的诅咒，完全失去了心智。$B$B他们现在正试图进入奥丹姆最深的墓穴，对我们造成了严重威胁。$B$B到太阳之石平台去，让他们扭曲的灵魂彻底解脱吧。
text.completion: They couldn't be saved, $n.  The ancient curse that fell upon them is irrevocable.
text.completed: Return to Sun Prophet Tumet at Nahom in Uldum.

english.title: The Curse of the Tombs
english.objectives: Slay 6 Crazed Diggers and Mekgineer Mixeltweed.
english.description: The Neferset are not the only threat to our sacred tombs.$B$BA gnomish expedition stumbled upon our lands a few weeks ago.$B$BThey did not heed our warnings and dug too deep within a cursed vault.$B$BTheir entire expedition is now afflicted by a terrible curse that has robbed them of their sanity and taken control of their minds.$B$BThey now seek access to the deepest vaults of Uldum and pose a great threat. $B$BGo to the Sunstone Terrace and put their wretched souls out of their misery.
english.completion: They couldn't be saved, $n.  The ancient curse that fell upon them is irrevocable.
english.completed: Return to Sun Prophet Tumet at Nahom in Uldum.

text.title: 工头
text.objectives: 杀掉格拉布托克。
text.description: 看来要想弄清楚下面发生了什么事，我们就得一路杀进死亡矿井！工头格拉布托克将是你遇到的第一个劲敌，一名强大的食人魔法师。要当心，他既有种族天生的蛮力，又能辅以邪恶的法术！$B$B带上这个通信装置，以便我们在进行调查的时候保持联络。到下面后要小心。
text.completion: <Bzzzzzzzzzzzzt.>$B$BNicely done! A clean kill. Now continue on and see what else you can find! We'll crack this case wide open with you on our side, I just know it.
text.completed: Speak to Lieutenant Horatio Laine inside the Deadmines.
text.giverWindow: 他可不好对付。

english.title: The Foreman
english.objectives: Kill Glubtok.
english.description: If we're to find out what's going on down here it looks like we're going to have to fight our way through the entire Deadmines! Glubtok the Foreman will be the first major foe you encounter, a powerful ogre magi. Be careful, he possesses the brute strength of his race backed by his wicked spellcasting!$B$BTake this communicator so that I can keep in touch with you as we continue our investigation. Be careful down there.
english.completion: <Bzzzzzzzzzzzzt.>$B$BNicely done! A clean kill. Now continue on and see what else you can find! We'll crack this case wide open with you on our side, I just know it.
english.completed: Speak to Lieutenant Horatio Laine inside the Deadmines.
english.giverWindow: He won't go down easily.

text.title: 最黑暗的深处
text.objectives: 杀死失落者赫尔恩古斯。
text.description: 整个沼泽的海洋生物活动都很异常。鱼人，是的，不过在此之前还有海地精、龙虾人……那天我甚至在海滩上看见了纳迦。$B$B有什么在召唤他们，还让他们骚动不安。这些生物大多都被吸引到西边的雄鹿沼泽洞穴里去了。那里面有什么东西，如果它变得再强大一些，说不定我们也得搭进去……$B$B你要在此之前阻止它。
text.completion: Oh my. It sounds like you ran across quite a sinister being. I wonder what one of those was doing all the way out here...
text.completed: Return to Baba Bogbrew at Stagalbog in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: The Darkest Depths
english.objectives: Slay Hr'nglth the Lost.
english.description: I've been seeing sea creatures acting oddly through the whole swamp. The murlocs, yes, but before that the gilblins, and the makrura... I even saw some naga wander ashore the other day.$B$BSomething's calling them here, and working them into a frenzy to boot. Many of the creatures have been drawn to Stagalbog Cavern to the west. Something's down there, and if it gets any stronger we'll all start wandering in there too...$B$BYou should put a stop to whatever it is before that happens.
english.completion: Oh my. It sounds like you ran across quite a sinister being. I wonder what one of those was doing all the way out here...
english.completed: Return to Baba Bogbrew at Stagalbog in Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 木匠
text.objectives: 打败赫利克斯·破甲。
text.description: <哔——>$B$B喂，你能听见吗？好极了！看来赫利克斯在负责建造一根巨大的船桅。你觉得他们该不会是想把迪菲亚主宰舰完工吧？$B$B你最好去调查一下，$n，别担心脏了手！在必要的情况下，你可以使用致命的应对手段，还有，就实话和你说了吧，这种必要的情况很有可能会发生。
text.completion: <Bzzzzzzzzzzzzt.>$B$BHey, it's Horatio. That was intense! I'm watching your progress on the Stormwind Communicator's Spyatron X3 application.$B$BThey sure are using a lot of heavily fortified doors to hide their work. Keep pushing forward and see what you find next. I bet it'll be a huge clue!
text.completed: Speak to Lieutenant Horatio Laine inside the Deadmines.
text.giverWindow: 常常被看见骑着一头凶猛的伐木场巨怪。

english.title: The Carpenter
english.objectives: Defeat Helix Gearbreaker.
english.description: <Bzzzzzzzzzzzzt.>$B$BHello, can you hear me? Excellent!$B$BIt looks like Helix is in charge of building an enormous mast. You don't think they're trying to finish the Defias Juggernaut, do you?$B$BYou'd better go investigate $n, and don't be afraid to get your hands dirty! You have clearance to use deadly force if necessary and, let's face it, it's probably going to be necessary.
english.completion: <Bzzzzzzzzzzzzt.>$B$BHey, it's Horatio. That was intense! I'm watching your progress on the Stormwind Communicator's Spyatron X3 application.$B$BThey sure are using a lot of heavily fortified doors to hide their work. Keep pushing forward and see what you find next. I bet it'll be a huge clue!
english.completed: Speak to Lieutenant Horatio Laine inside the Deadmines.
english.giverWindow: Often seen riding a ferocious lumbering oaf.
english.turninWindow: It's starting to come together now.

text.title: 人工智能
text.objectives: 跟奥丹姆勘测员前哨的A.I.D.A.终端谈一谈。
text.description: <移动终端里发出一个女声，向你讲话。>$B$B紧急代码：55-729。$B$B远征队员的上级大脑皮层功能受到损害。$B$B请到你最近的终端处报告，前往太阳之石平台东南部，进行进一步分析。
text.progress: <The terminal whirrs as its mechanisms become active.>
text.completion: Scanning subject... Cerebral cortex diagnostics indicate the absence of "tomb curse" phenomenon. Diagnostics did reveal frequent head trauma.  The user would do well to exercise more caution around blunt objects in the future.

english.title: Artificial Intelligence
english.objectives: Speak to the A.I.D.A. terminal at the Surveyor's Outpost  in Uldum.
english.description: <A feminine voice addresses you over the portable terminal.>$B$BEmergency code: 55-729.$B$BUpper cerebral cortex functions in expedition members have been compromised.$B$BPlease report to your nearest terminal location, to the southeast of the Sunstone Terrace, for further analysis.
english.progress: <The terminal whirrs as its mechanisms become active.>
english.completion: Scanning subject... Cerebral cortex diagnostics indicate the absence of "tomb curse" phenomenon. Diagnostics did reveal frequent head trauma.  The user would do well to exercise more caution around blunt objects in the future.

text.title: 分心拆弹
text.objectives: 拆除太阳王陵墓的第一堆、第二堆和第三堆集束炸弹，并关闭4个不稳定的炸弹机器人。
text.description: 诅咒毁坏了远征队员的高级脑功能，但我的计算表明他们被压抑的青春期潜意识依然对现实意像产生受激反应。$B$B启用这个全息投影仪来引开他们。$B$B他们目前正在古墓东侧安置炸药，打算进入奥丹姆的秘密通道。$B$B他们想要取得奥丹姆下面危险的起源再造科技，一定要阻止他们。
text.completion: Well done, $n.  The expedition has already doomed itself. There is no need for it to endanger the rest of the world as well.
text.completed: Return to the A.I.D.A. Terminal.

english.title: A Disarming Distraction
english.objectives: Disarm the First, Second and Third Bomb Clusters and deactivate 4 Unstable Bomb Bots at the Tomb of the Sun King.
english.description: The curse has taken over the expedition members' higher brain functions, but my calculations reveal their suppressed adolescent subconscious can still be stimulated by realistic imagery.$B$BUtilize this holo-projector to distract them.$B$BThey are currently setting up explosives at the tomb to the east to attempt to gain access to secret passages in Uldum.$B$BThey seek dangerous re-origination technology beneath Uldum and must be stopped.
english.completion: Well done, $n.  The expedition has already doomed itself. There is no need for it to endanger the rest of the world as well.
english.completed: Return to the A.I.D.A. Terminal.

objectiveDetails.description: 关闭不稳定的炸弹机器人

text.title: 熔光镇，走着！
text.objectives: 乘坐绝不坠毁号前往荒芜之地，然后向埃迪·弗罗菲兹报到。
text.description: 嘿，$r，听好了。我有一个你绝对不愿错过的工作机会。$b$b我们是从熔光镇来的，那是荒芜之地的一座新兴地精城镇。那里可是遍地金币哟，$g先生:夫人;。而且还没有这么多僵尸……或者神经过敏的银色圣骑士。$b$b不，那里是一片蛮荒之地，而我们正在招募像你这样的人，去帮助我们征服它。不管你什么时候想通了……我们都恭候大驾。
text.completion: Nice landing!
text.completed: 去找荒芜之地熔光码头的埃迪·弗罗菲兹。

english.title: Fuselight, Ho!
english.objectives: Ride The Uncrashable to the Badlands, then report to Eddie Flofizzle.
english.description: Hey, $r, listen up.  I got a job opportunity that you aren't gonna want to miss out on.$b$bWe been sent up here from Fuselight, a new goblin town way down in the Badlands.  Lots of money to be had down there, yes $g sir: ma'am;.  And not nearly so many zombies... or uptight Argent paladin-types.$b$bNope, it's an untamed wilderness down there, and we're looking for someone like you to help us tame it.  Whenever you're ready... we'll be waiting.
english.completion: Nice landing!
english.completed: Report to Eddie Flofizzle at Fuselight-by-the-Sea in the Badlands.

text.title: 前往熔光镇
text.objectives: 使用熔光码头后面的传送器登上山崖，然后向荒芜之地熔光镇的道尔夫·柏拉木报到。
text.description: $r，这里就像天堂。我的梦想就是居住在海边恬静的小镇，潜心研究炸药。$B$B但是，不是所有人都喜欢安静……特别是像你这样喜欢冒险的英雄。 $B$B我们在镇子后面安装了一台传送器，可以将你送上山崖。你可以从那里快速前往西边，抵达荒芜之地的熔光镇。$B$B你可以在那里找到事儿做的。告诉他们，是弗罗菲兹派你去的。
text.completion: Welcome to Fuselight!

english.title: To Fuselight Proper
english.objectives: Use the Teleporter in the back of Fuselight-by-the-Sea to port up the mountain, then report to Dolph Blasto at Fuselight in the Badlands.
english.description: This, $r, is paradise.  I've always wanted to live in a nice quiet town by the sea so I can focus on my explosions without any distractions.$b$bQuiet's not for everybody, though... 'specially the adventuring hero-type, like yourself.$b$bWe've installed a teleporter in the backside of town that'll take you up to the top of the cliffs.  From there, you can take the quick ride west into Fuselight proper, within the Badlands.$b$bThere should be more for you to do up there.  Tell 'em that Flo sent you.
english.completion: Welcome to Fuselight!

text.title: 奇怪的请求
text.objectives: 将道尔夫的包裹交给荒芜之地莱瑟罗峡谷的瑞亚。
text.description: 说说别的事吧。我有件包裹需要递送。$B$B不久前，有位女士路过我们的镇子，想要寻找压缩火药粉、淬火秘银弹壳以及防护眼镜。我们有大量可出售的火药粉和弹壳，但是防护眼镜比较难找。$B$B长话短说，我搞到眼镜了，但是她已经返回莱瑟罗峡谷从事研究工作啦。你愿意送这个包裹给她吗？
text.progress: Ahh... you've found me.  Good.
text.completion: Thank you, $r.  You may keep the goggles, as they have already served their purpose: they brought you to me.
text.completed: Report to Rhea at Lethlor Ravine in the Badlands.

english.title: A Strange Request
english.objectives: Bring Dolph's Package to Rhea at Lethlor Ravine in the Badlands.
english.description: On to other matters.  I have a package that I need delivered.$b$bA young lady came by our town not long ago, looking for compressed blasting powder, a tempered mithril bomb casing, and some safety goggles.  Naturally, we had plenty of blasting powder and bomb casings to sell her, but the safety goggles were a little harder to find.$b$bLong story short, I've got the goggles, but she's already returned to her studies down in Lethlor Ravine.  Will you bring these down to her?
english.progress: Ahh... you've found me.  Good.
english.completion: Thank you, $r.  You may keep the goggles, as they have already served their purpose: they brought you to me.
english.completed: Report to Rhea at Lethlor Ravine in the Badlands.

text.title: 第一份样本：狂野黑龙卵
text.objectives: 收集6枚狂野黑龙蛋。
text.description: 我在用黑龙做实验。准确地说，我对黑龙是如何繁殖的这一课题很感兴趣。$b$b我目前的实验需要大量黑龙蛋，这也正是我来莱瑟罗峡谷的原因。我当然也可以自己收集黑龙蛋，不过如果你帮我的话，我想你会得到一些好处的。$b$b你可以在峡谷边缘一带找到它们。要当心在上空盘旋的守护者——它们可不会跟偷蛋贼善罢甘休。
text.progress: Have you brought the eggs?
text.completion: Thank you for gathering these so quickly, $n.
text.completed: Return to Rhea at Lethlor Ravine in the Badlands.

english.title: First Sample: Wild Eggs
english.objectives: Obtain 6 Wild Black Dragon Eggs.
english.description: I am experimenting with black dragons.  Specifically, I am interested in how they procreate.$b$bMy current experiments require plenty of black dragon eggs, which is why I am here in Lethlor Ravine.  I'd gather the eggs myself, but I think you'll benefit from helping me out.$b$bYou will find them along the edges of the ravine.  Beware the guardians that circle above - they do not appreciate stolen eggs.
english.progress: Have you brought the eggs?
english.completion: Thank you for gathering these so quickly, $n.
english.completed: Return to Rhea at Lethlor Ravine in the Badlands.

text.title: 第二份样本：雏龙
text.objectives: 收集10具滚烫的雏龙尸体。
text.description: 我还得请你帮一个忙。我要你去弄一些在附近飞来飞去的黑龙幼崽的尸体来。干掉它们，把尸体带回来给我。
text.progress: Have you done as I asked?
text.completion: This grisly task was necessary, $n.$b$bAll will be revealed to you soon.  For now, know this:$b$bI am no ordinary goblin.$b$bI serve a mistress of unimaginable power, and her motives here are not as dark as they might seem.
text.completed: Return to Rhea at Lethlor Ravine in the Badlands.

english.title: Second Sample: Whelps
english.objectives: Obtain 10 Scalding Whelp Corpses.
english.description: I need another favor from you.  I need you to obtain the bodies of the black dragon whelplings that fly nearby.  Slay them, and bring the corpses to me.
english.progress: Have you done as I asked?
english.completion: This grisly task was necessary, $n.$b$bAll will be revealed to you soon.  For now, know this:$b$bI am no ordinary goblin.$b$bI serve a mistress of unimaginable power, and her motives here are not as dark as they might seem.
english.completed: Return to Rhea at Lethlor Ravine in the Badlands.

text.title: Back Under Cover
text.objectives: Put on your Recruit's Robe, go to Mirror Lake Orchard and get the Book of Incantations from Overseer Sylandra. Read from the Book of Incantations near the Cultist Altar to practice the ritual.
text.description: The cultists seem assured of their victory, even as we detain more and more of them. We must find out more about the ritual mentioned by the cultist you questioned.$B$BThese rituals seem to be the core of the cult's plan to attack Stormwind. I'm going to give you one of the robes taken from the arrested cultists. Put it on and go back to the cultist outpost at Mirror Lake Orchard in Elwynn Forest and see if you can get the cultists there to let you in on the plan.
text.progress: It's good to see you again, $n. We were worried that the tyrant Wrynn's guards had thrown you into the Stockade.
text.completion: You need to familiarize yourself with the portal ritual quickly. We need to send as many teams into Stormwind as we can. They're discovering and arresting more of our brothers each day.
text.completed: Return to Overseer Sylandra at Mirror Lake Orchard in Elwynn Forest.

english.title: Back Under Cover
english.objectives: Put on your Recruit's Robe, go to Mirror Lake Orchard and get the Book of Incantations from Overseer Sylandra. Read from the Book of Incantations near the Cultist Altar to practice the ritual.
english.description: The cultists seem assured of their victory, even as we detain more and more of them. We must find out more about the ritual mentioned by the cultist you questioned.$B$BThese rituals seem to be the core of the cult's plan to attack Stormwind. I'm going to give you one of the robes taken from the arrested cultists. Put it on and go back to the cultist outpost at Mirror Lake Orchard in Elwynn Forest and see if you can get the cultists there to let you in on the plan.
english.progress: It's good to see you again, $n. We were worried that the tyrant Wrynn's guards had thrown you into the Stockade.
english.completion: You need to familiarize yourself with the portal ritual quickly. We need to send as many teams into Stormwind as we can. They're discovering and arresting more of our brothers each day.
english.completed: Return to Overseer Sylandra at Mirror Lake Orchard in Elwynn Forest.

text.title: 第二步：放血者
text.objectives: 杀死屠宰房的放血者古穆拉。
text.description: 这里的巨魔让我堕落的兄弟们永远地长眠于噩梦中。他们用邪神的血让绿龙感染、堕落，然后收集他们体内成长的邪恶力量。他们就像牲畜一样被蓄养着……$B$B这种恶心的野蛮行径不能再继续下去了。回到面具大厅，走另一条路，前往屠宰房。在那里，放血者古穆拉为邪恶肮脏的仪式采集着尸体。他不配继续活着！
text.giverWindow: 他开始腐蚀我的族类之时便给自己埋下了灭亡的种子。

english.title: Step Two: The Bloodletter
english.objectives: Slay Gomora the Bloodletter in the Butchery.
english.description: The trolls here perpetuate the fall of my brethren to the nightmare. They infect and corrupt green dragons with the blood of their foul god, and then harvest the evil that has grown within them. They are being farmed like livestock...$B$BThis disgusting savagery cannot continue. Return to where you left the Hall of Masks and take the other corridor towards the Butchery. Gomora the Bloodletter harvests corpses for these foul and evil rituals there. Take his undeserved life from him!
english.giverWindow: When he chose to corrupt my kin, he purchased his own demise.

text.title: 瑞亚的身份
text.objectives: 得知瑞亚的真实身份。
text.description: 我之前提到过了，我不是普通的地精。你想必已经猜到了我的真实身份。$b$b请允许我向你展示我的真正形态。既然你已经证明了自己是个可信赖的伙伴，我也会将我的计划向你全盘托出。
text.completion: My true name is Rheastrasza, and I am an envoy of Alexstrasza herself, the Aspect of the red dragonflight.$b$bWith Deathwing currently occupied with other matters, we are going to find a way to redeem the black dragonflight.$b$bAnd you are going to help us.
text.completed: Speak with Rheastrasza at Lethlor Ravine in the Badlands.

english.title: Rhea Revealed
english.objectives: Learn Rhea's true identity.
english.description: As I hinted earlier, I am no ordinary goblin.  You may have already guessed my true identity.$b$bAllow me to show you my true form.  As you have proven yourself trustworthy, I will also share with you the details of my plan.
english.completion: My true name is Rheastrasza, and I am an envoy of Alexstrasza herself, the Aspect of the red dragonflight.$b$bWith Deathwing currently occupied with other matters, we are going to find a way to redeem the black dragonflight.$b$bAnd you are going to help us.
english.completed: Speak with Rheastrasza at Lethlor Ravine in the Badlands.

text.title: 掀起面纱
text.objectives: 观看瑞亚最后的研究成果。
text.description: 黑龙曾是高贵的龙族，是大地的守护者。如今，他们却成为威胁这片土地的祸害。真讽刺。$B$B尽管如此，我和我的女主人都相信，前方还存在一丝希望。黑龙一族将摆脱死亡之翼背叛行为的阴影，再次以大地守护者的身份骄傲地翱翔晴空。$B$B我要让你看看。闭上眼睛，看看我最后的研究成果吧。
text.completion: We will find a shred of good within these dragons, $n.  Whether it is in the wild eggs you found, the bodies of the whelplings you slew, or the eggs that we have encouraged Nyxondra to lay... we will find an untainted black dragon.
text.completed: Speak with Rhea at Lethlor Ravine in the Badlands.
text.objective1: 观看瑞亚最后的研究成果。

english.title: Lifting the Veil
english.objectives: Witness the final piece of Rhea's studies.
english.description: The black dragonflight was once noble.  They were the earth warders, protecting the very land itself.  How ironic that they would become the worst menace the land has known.$b$bI believe that there remains a sliver of hope, however, and so does my mistress.  The black dragonflight will live beyond Deathwing's treachery, and will soar as the noble earth warders once again.$b$bI wish to show you something.  Close your eyes, and I will reveal to you the final part of my studies.
english.completion: We will find a shred of good within these dragons, $n.  Whether it is in the wild eggs you found, the bodies of the whelplings you slew, or the eggs that we have encouraged Nyxondra to lay... we will find an untainted black dragon.
english.completed: Speak with Rhea at Lethlor Ravine in the Badlands.
english.objective1: Witness the final piece of Rhea's studies

objectiveDetails.description: 观看瑞亚最后的研究成果

text.title: 第三份样本：尼希昂卓拉的龙卵
text.objectives: 收集3枚尼希昂卓拉的龙卵。
text.description: 尼希昂卓拉被强行关押了起来。她从自己的族群中被隔离开来，藏在他们的产卵地的正中间。她在产卵，但远在她看到它们孵化之前，那些蛋就会被拿走。$b$b残忍吗？也许吧……但比起他们黑龙一族对我的女主人所做的事来，这又算得了什么呢。$b$b向我证明一下我可以相信你，$n。拿到尼希昂卓拉的蛋，把它们带到这里来。你必须先制服尼希昂卓拉才能拿走蛋。
text.progress: Remember, $n... this is for the good of the black dragonflight.  We are here to redeem them, not to hurt them.  This is but a step in their recovery.
text.completion: You have done everything that I have asked you, without question.  Our job here in Lethlor Ravine is done.$b$bIt is now time that I revealed everything to you.
text.completed: Return to Rhea at Lethlor Ravine in the Badlands.

english.title: Third Sample: Implanted Eggs
english.objectives: Obtain 3 of Nyxondra's Eggs.
english.description: Nyxondra is being held against her will.  She is hidden from her brood, right in the middle of their breeding grounds.  She lays eggs, but they will be taken away before she can see them hatch.$b$bCruel?  Perhaps... but not nearly as cruel as the treatment that their dragonflight showed my mistress.$b$bShow me that I can trust you, $n.  Take Nyxondra's eggs, and bring them here.  You will need to beat Nyxondra into submission before you can take them.
english.progress: Remember, $n... this is for the good of the black dragonflight.  We are here to redeem them, not to hurt them.  This is but a step in their recovery.
english.completion: You have done everything that I have asked you, without question.  Our job here in Lethlor Ravine is done.$b$bIt is now time that I revealed everything to you.
english.completed: Return to Rhea at Lethlor Ravine in the Badlands.

text.title: 尊敬的布拉姆博士
text.objectives: 将黑龙样本交给荒芜之地阿戈莫德的营地的耶柔米·布拉姆博士。
text.description: 关于是否向你表明身份这件事，我可是经过精心计算的，$n。我既要取得你的信任，又不能继续待在莱瑟罗峡谷，因为黑龙已经识破了我的真实面目。$B$B但是你可以在不惊动它们的情况下离开这里。来，带上我们的研究成果，往西走吧。将这些样本送往阿戈莫德的营地，那里有一位侏儒，他知道该如何处理此事。$B$B快，$n！此地不宜久留！
text.progress: Dr. H. Blam, at your service.  How can I be of assistance to you today?
text.completion: Ooh!  Science stuff!  Let's see what you've got here...$b$bWild eggs?  Blech.  Useless.  These are never any good.$b$bOoooh, what's this?  Some sort of... pre-engineered egg?  This looks promising, but I don't want to know what Rhea had to do to get it.$b$bHmm... yes, some very nice corpses.  Very nice indeed.$b$bAlright, I'll see what I can do.
text.completed: Report to Dr. Hieronymus Blam at Agmond's End in the Badlands.

english.title: The Venerable Doctor Blam
english.objectives: Bring the Black Dragon Samples to Dr. Hieronymus Blam at Agmond's End in the Badlands.
english.description: I made a calculated decision in revealing my identity to you, $n.  I needed you to trust me, but I can no longer stay here in Lethlor Ravine, as my cover has quite clearly been blown.$b$bYou may be able to slip away unnoticed, however.  Here, take the results of our research, and bring them west.  At Agmond's End, you will find a gnome who knows what to do with these samples.$b$bHurry, $n!  You mustn't loiter here any longer than necessary!
english.progress: Dr. H. Blam, at your service.  How can I be of assistance to you today?
english.completion: Ooh!  Science stuff!  Let's see what you've got here...$b$bWild eggs?  Blech.  Useless.  These are never any good.$b$bOoooh, what's this?  Some sort of... pre-engineered egg?  This looks promising, but I don't want to know what Rhea had to do to get it.$b$bHmm... yes, some very nice corpses.  Very nice indeed.$b$bAlright, I'll see what I can do.
english.completed: Report to Dr. Hieronymus Blam at Agmond's End in the Badlands.

text.title: 第三步：预言者
text.objectives: 击败预言者迦玛兰。
text.description: 目前唯一阻止我的就是预言者迦玛兰本人了。他是这里阿塔莱巨魔的领袖，一个下贱的操纵者。$B$B要知道，你面对的不仅仅是一个疯狂的巨魔，$n，而是某种黑暗力量的棋子。这种力量超越了你的理解，但你并非孤身作战，我的力量和绿龙军团的意志与你同在。$B$B穿过仪式大厅，进入白骨大厅，前往召唤者之穴。在那里的深处，你将发现迦玛兰。
text.completion: He has escaped! I should have known it would not be so easy. The path is clear, $n. It is time to return.
text.giverWindow: 阿塔莱的领袖

english.title: Step Three: Prophet
english.objectives: Defeat Jammal'an the Prophet.
english.description: All that yet stands between me and the temple is Prophet Jammal'an himself. He is the leader of the Atal'ai trolls here, a foul manipulator.$B$BKnow that you do not face a mere crazed troll, $n, but an instrument of forces beyond your darkest comprehension. Yet you do not fight alone; my strength and the will of the Green Dragonflight go with you.$B$BProceed to the Den of the Caller, left through the Hall of Ritual, and then down into the Hall of Bones. At the bottom, you will find Jammal'an.
english.completion: He has escaped! I should have known it would not be so easy. The path is clear, $n. It is time to return.
english.giverWindow: Leader of the Atal'ai

text.title: 撼动军心
text.objectives: 在柯什营地杀死9名火烟食人魔。
text.description: 毫无疑问，熔光镇迫在眉睫的威胁就是西北方的食人魔。$b$b我们的邻居原本以战士居多，但是越来越多的食人魔开始了魔法研究。我可不愿意跟食人魔法师大军交手。$b$b去杀死一些火烟食人魔。希望他们能以此为戒，不敢冒犯熔光镇。
text.completion: I wonder where all of these ogre-magi are coming from?  Curious times, indeed.
text.completed: Return to Dolph Blastus at Fuselight in the Badlands.

english.title: Easily Swayed
english.objectives: Slay 9 Dustbelcher ogres at Camp Kosh.
english.description: The most immediate threat to Fuselight is, without argument, the colony of ogres to the northwest.$b$bMost of our ogre neighbors used to be warrior-types, but it seems that more and more of them are practicing magic.  I won't have an army of ogre-magi at my doorstep.$b$bGo take out some of those Dustbelcher ogres.  Hopefully they'll get the picture and avoid messing with the might of Fuselight.
english.completion: I wonder where all of these ogre-magi are coming from?  Curious times, indeed.
english.completed: Return to Dolph Blastus at Fuselight in the Badlands.

text.title: 事情不顺的时候，就使诈
text.objectives: 从柯什营地的食人魔法师训导者手中夺得一根训导者之杖。
text.description: 我的发明一次又一次地失败！讨厌！$b$b我决定了。我要使诈，我要用魔法。$b$b我需要的只是一个坚固的活塞。它必须足够小，才能塞进狭窄的铜管；它必须足够硬，才能承受反复的冲击力。北面食人魔法师的魔杖应该可用。$b$b就我所知，训导者手中的杖子最上等。
text.progress: I don't like to stoop to using magic on my inventions, but this is somewhat of an emergency.
text.completion: A perfect fit!  My goat puncher is finally finished!
text.completed: Return to Garyanne Fleezlebop at Fuselight in the Badlands.

english.title: When the Going Gets Tough, Cheat
english.objectives: Obtain an Instructor's Rod from an Ogre-Mage Instructor at Camp Kosh.
english.description: I just can't get my invention to work!  Gah!$b$bThat's it, I've decided.  I'm going to cheat and use magic.$b$bWhat my invention really needs is a solid piston that's thin enough to fit through a narrow copper tube, but strong enough to withstand repeated impact without breaking.  The magical rods carried by those ogre magi to the north should work perfectly.$b$bFrom what I can tell, only the instructors carry the strong staves.
english.progress: I don't like to stoop to using magic on my inventions, but this is somewhat of an emergency.
english.completion: A perfect fit!  My goat puncher is finally finished!
english.completed: Return to Garyanne Fleezlebop at Fuselight in the Badlands.

text.title: 山羊时间，宝贝
text.objectives: 对熔光镇的12只公山羊使用嘉瑞妮的公山羊打击者。
text.description: 不知你注意到了没有，山羊在熔光镇制造了一些小麻烦。它们什么都吃，甚至喜欢上了我们留做不时之需的齿轮和装置。$b$b这种事真讨厌啊！$b$b大多数公山羊都在悬崖边缘游荡。使用这件装置，轻轻地“推”它们一下。
text.progress: It's their own fault for standing so close to the edge
text.completion: Well done!  I have no doubt that those goats will be back, but they'll think twice before they nibble my cogs again!
text.completed: Return to Garyanne Fleezlebop at Fuselight in the Badlands.

english.title: It's Goat Time, Baby
english.objectives: Use Garyanne's Goat Puncher on 12 Billy Goats in Fuselight.
english.description: We have a little bit of a goat problem here in Fuselight, in case you haven't noticed.  They'll eat anything, and they seem to have taken a liking to the piles of cogs and gears that we tend to leave sitting around.$b$bIt's getting really annoying!$b$bYou'll find most of the billy goats wandering around the edge of town, near the cliff's edge.  Use this device on them to give 'em a little "nudge".
english.progress: It's their own fault for standing so close to the edge
english.completion: Well done!  I have no doubt that those goats will be back, but they'll think twice before they nibble my cogs again!
english.completed: Return to Garyanne Fleezlebop at Fuselight in the Badlands.

text.title: 核心访问码
text.objectives: 从疯狂的焊钩处获得核心访问码。
text.description: 远征队员的数量异常庞大，用户$n。$B$B用通常手段对付他们预计将花掉你2700136.5个小时。$B$B我们可以利用远征队履带式载具中的强力能量源。$B$B为此，我们需要聚变核心的访问码。$B$B持有访问码的机械师焊钩位于东南方的观星塔。$B$B我已经将干扰频段载入了一个扰频器中。用它来暂时解除焊钩的防御。
text.progress: Did you succeed, $n?  I estimated your chances of survival at 68.5%.
text.completion: Excellent job, user $n.  We must obtain access to the fusion core now.
text.completed: Return to the A.I.D.A. Terminal

english.title: Core Access Codes
english.objectives: Obtain the Core Access Codes from Twizzleflux the Insane.
english.description: The expedition's numbers are extremely large, user $n.$B$BDealing with them by conventional means would take you an estimated 2,700,136.5 hours.$B$BWe can make use of a powerful source of energy held within expedition's crawler vehicle.$B$BWe will need the fusion core's access codes to accomplish this.$B$BMekgineer Twizzleflux has these codes and can be found at the Starwatch Tower to the southeast.$B$BI've uploaded jamming frequencies to a scrambler.  Use it to temporarily disable Twizzleflux's defenses.
english.progress: Did you succeed, $n?  I estimated your chances of survival at 68.5%.
english.completion: Excellent job, user $n.  We must obtain access to the fusion core now.
english.completed: Return to the A.I.D.A. Terminal

text.title: 侵入威布森
text.objectives: 侵入M.A.C.深潜者顶部的主机威布森。
text.description: 赋值为真。新的远征队员已经从海路抵达。$B$B我的扫描仪检测到他们已经出现诅咒迹象。$B$B你必须加紧登上M.A.C.深潜者。访问码将赋予我们聚变核心的功能控制权，但还有一层安全保护需要通过。$B$B用户$n，我必须要你侵入一台极其复杂，名为“威布森”的主机。$B$B不要担心，我会为你提供进一步的指示。
text.completion: I am in control, user $n.  But I cannot keep the core temperature stable indefinitely.
text.completed: Go to the Fusion Core on top of the M.A.C. Diver in Uldum.

english.title: Hacking the Wibson
english.objectives: Hack the Wibson Mainframe on top of the M.A.C. Diver.
english.description: It is true.  New expedition crews have arrived by sea.$B$BMy scanners detect that they already have been afflicted by the curse phenomenon.$B$BYou must hurry and go aboard the M.A.C. Diver.  The access codes will give us control over the fusion core's functions, but there is still a layer of security we must bypass.$B$BUser $n, I must ask you to hack a very sophisticated mainframe known as the "Wibson."$B$BDo not worry I will provide you with further instructions.
english.completion: I am in control, user $n.  But I cannot keep the core temperature stable indefinitely.
english.completed: Go to the Fusion Core on top of the M.A.C. Diver in Uldum.

text.title: 聚变核心
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个疯狂的侏儒。
text.description: 我已经将我的程序下载至聚变核心，将其完全控制。$B$B我在内部区域制造了一部分空气，以防用户$n被蒸发。$B$B我将放弃所有移动功能，把我的回路集中以便稳定核心。$B$B到山下去尽可能地吸收远征队员。$B$B问题解答：聚变核心可以将那些被诅咒的侏儒转移到其他位面去。$B$B用户$n，你不必有所顾虑。根据我的计算，在吸收过程中，侏儒“总体上”不会受到伤害。
text.completion: It is done, user $n.  I thank you for your assistance with this unfortunate task.

english.title: Gnomebliteration
english.objectives: Obliterate 1000 Crazed Gnomes.
english.description: I have downloaded my program to the fusion core and have complete control over it.$B$BI've created a small pocket of air inside to avoid vaporizing user $n.$B$BI will yield control of all movement functions so I can dedicate my cycles to keeping the core stable.$B$BGo down the hill and neutralize as many of the expedition members as possible.$B$BMy analysis reveals you might feel... "guilt" as a result of such high fatality numbers.$B$BUser $n, you must be assured that expedition members are without hope.
english.completion: It is done, user $n.  I thank you for your assistance with this unfortunate task.

text.title: I Said the Words...
text.objectives: Disrupt the cultist rituals in the Dwarven District, the Park, and the Cathedral District by reading the incorrect words from the Book of Incantations.
text.description: Now that you're familiar with the ritual, it's time for you to perform it in the city. Dozens of our brethren have already infiltrated the city and made their way to the ritual sites.$B$BI want you to visit the portal ritual sites in Stormwind's Dwarven District, Park district, and Cathedral Square. The teams there will have made most of the preparations and all you need to is read the last part of the incantation from the book.$B$BVery soon, $n, Stormwind will find itself awash in wind and water.
text.completion: You've done an excellent job tracking down and combating the cultists, but I fear they are right about one thing. We will never know if we've gotten them all.
text.completed: Return to Justine Demalier in Stormwind's Trade District.

english.title: I Said the Words...
english.objectives: Disrupt the cultist rituals in the Dwarven District, the Park, and the Cathedral District by reading the incorrect words from the Book of Incantations.
english.description: Now that you're familiar with the ritual, it's time for you to perform it in the city. Dozens of our brethren have already infiltrated the city and made their way to the ritual sites.$B$BI want you to visit the portal ritual sites in Stormwind's Dwarven District, Park district, and Cathedral Square. The teams there will have made most of the preparations and all you need to is read the last part of the incantation from the book.$B$BVery soon, $n, Stormwind will find itself awash in wind and water.
english.completion: You've done an excellent job tracking down and combating the cultists, but I fear they are right about one thing. We will never know if we've gotten them all.
english.completed: Return to Justine Demalier in Stormwind's Trade District.

text.title: 阴谋诡计
text.objectives: 摧毁死神5000。
text.description: <哔——>$B$B<哔——>$B$B喂喂？$n，你在吗？你还活着吗？喂？$B$B哦，太好了，你还在！洛丹伦在上，他们造的那是什么东西？某种机械怪兽！你得阻止他们完成那个……那个……东西！$B$B别管规定了，尽你一切手段制止他们！
text.completion: <Bzzzzzzzzzzzzt.>$B$BYou're nearing the heart of their domain. There will likely be an extremely fortified door protecting the inner sanctum of the entire Defias operation. See if you can find anything that might pry it open!$B$BI suggest a stealthy method!
text.completed: Speak to Lieutenant Horatio Laine inside the Deadmines.
text.giverWindow: 你不能让他们完成那个……东西！

english.title: The Machination
english.objectives: Destroy the Foe Reaper 5000.
english.description: <Bzzzzzzzzzzzzt.>$B$B<Bzzzzzzzzzzzzt.>$B$BHe-hello? $n, are you there? Are you still alive? Hello?$B$BOh good, you're still there! What in the name of Lordareon are they building? It's some sort of mechanized monstrosity! You have to stop them from completing that...that...thing! $B$BThrow out the rules, do whatever you have to do to thwart them!
english.completion: <Bzzzzzzzzzzzzt.>$B$BYou're nearing the heart of their domain. There will likely be an extremely fortified door protecting the inner sanctum of the entire Defias operation. See if you can find anything that might pry it open!$B$BI suggest a stealthy method!
english.completed: Speak to Lieutenant Horatio Laine inside the Deadmines.
english.giverWindow: You can't let them finish that...thing!
english.turninWindow: Stealth is the way to go!

text.title: 马迪亚斯需要你
text.objectives: 跟暮光高地暮光堡垒的马迪亚斯·肖尔大师谈一谈。
text.description: 我们相处得非常愉快。我真是舍不得你离开啊。但是马迪亚斯想见你。$B$B他说有要紧事要找你！$B$B等你完事之后要不要回来找我喝一杯什么的，$g伙计:妹子;？
text.completion: Good, you're back. We know where Cho'gall's ultimate weapon is located!

english.title: Mathias Needs You
english.objectives: Speak with Master Mathias Shaw at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.
english.description: We've had some good times. I'm really sorry to see you go. But, Mathias says he needs you.$B$BHe said it's urgent!$B$BSo, you want to grab a drink or something after whatever, $g buddy : lady;?
english.completion: Good, you're back. We know where Cho'gall's ultimate weapon is located!

text.title: 迦罗娜需要你
text.objectives: 跟暮光高地暮光堡垒的半兽人迦罗娜谈一谈。
text.description: 我们相处得非常愉快。我真是舍不得你离开啊。但是迦罗娜想见你。$B$B她说有要紧事要找你！$B$B等你完事之后要不要回来找我喝一杯什么的，$g伙计:妹子;？
text.completion: Good, you're back. It's about time. We know where Cho'gall's ultimate weapon is located!

english.title: Garona Needs You
english.objectives: Speak with Garona Halforcen at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.
english.description: We've had some good times. I'm really sorry to see you go. But, Garona says she needs you.$B$BShe said it's urgent!$B$BSo, you want to grab a drink or something after whatever, $g buddy : lady;?
english.completion: Good, you're back. It's about time. We know where Cho'gall's ultimate weapon is located!

text.title: 暮光神锤
text.objectives: 找到暮光神锤。
text.description: 在你进入矿洞后，我设法找到了暮光神锤的所在。他们在南面的暮光祭坛打造了这把武器。$B$B更重要的是，暮光教徒们犯了一个严重的错误：古加尔独自监督了武器最终的锻造过程。$B$B军情七处牺牲了不少人手才查明这些信息。
text.completion: The Hammer of Twilight floats in the middle of the altar, unprotected....

english.title: The Hammer of Twilight
english.objectives: Get to the Hammer of Twilight.
english.description: While you were in the mine, I was able to figure out where the Hammer of Twilight is being kept. They created it at the Altar of Twilight to the south.$B$BMore important than that, the cultists have made a critical error: Cho'gall is personally overseeing its final construction.$B$BMany SI:7 died to bring us this information.
english.completion: The Hammer of Twilight floats in the middle of the altar, unprotected....

text.title: 撕心狼将军
text.objectives: 杀死撕心狼将军。
text.description: <哔——>$B$B我不敢相信……他们几乎要完成重建了！我们的时间不多，$n。$B$B梵妮莎的左右手撕心狼将军应该就在船上。只要他还活着，就不会让我们把她抓住。你得爬上未完工的主宰舰，找到撕心狼，杀掉他好让我们进入最上层甲板梵妮莎的单间。$B$B要小心，将军中了狼人的诅咒，他将会十分乐意把他的爪子插进你的身体里！
text.completion: <Bzzzzzzzzzzzzt.>$B$BYour exploits have gained quite the following in the intelligence community, $n. Many top members of SI:7 have been earnestly watching you infiltrate the Deadmines through their own Stormwind Communicators.$B$BMathias Shaw himself wants to speak with you! I'll transfer you over momentarily.
text.completed: Speak to Lieutenant Horatio Laine inside the Deadmines.
text.giverWindow: 小心前行！

english.title: The Admiral
english.objectives: Kill Admiral Ripsnarl.
english.description: <Bzzzzzzzzzzzzt.>$B$BI can't believe it...they're almost done rebuilding it! We don't have much time, $n.$B$BAdmiral Ripsnarl, Vanessa's right hand man, is bound to be on board. We'll never get to her if he's still alive to do anything about it. You're going to need to scale the unfinished Juggernaut, find Ripsnarl, and kill him so we can get to Vanessa's private quarters on the top deck.$B$BBe careful, the Admiral bears the worgen curse and would take much pleasure in digging his claws into you!
english.completion: <Bzzzzzzzzzzzzt.>$B$BYour exploits have gained quite the following in the intelligence community, $n. Many top members of SI:7 have been earnestly watching you infiltrate the Deadmines through their own Stormwind Communicators.$B$BMathias Shaw himself wants to speak with you! I'll transfer you over momentarily.
english.completed: Speak to Lieutenant Horatio Laine inside the Deadmines.
english.giverWindow: Approach with caution!

text.title: 暮光神锤
text.objectives: 找到暮光神锤。
text.description: 在你进入矿洞后，我设法找到了暮光神锤的所在。他们在南面的暮光祭坛打造了这把武器。$B$B更重要的是，暮光教徒们犯了一个严重的错误：古加尔独自监督了武器最终的锻造过程。$B$B<迦罗娜开始打磨剑刃。>$B$B库卡隆牺牲了不少人手才查明这些信息。
text.completion: The Hammer of Twilight floats in the middle of the altar, unprotected....

english.title: The Hammer of Twilight
english.objectives: Get to the Hammer of Twilight.
english.description: While you were in the mine, I was able to figure out where the Hammer of Twilight is being kept. They created it at the Altar of Twilight to the south.$B$BMore important than that, the cultists have made a critical error: Cho'gall is personally overseeing its final construction.$B$B<Garona begins sharpening her blades.>$B$BMany Kor'kron died to bring us this information.
english.completion: The Hammer of Twilight floats in the middle of the altar, unprotected....

text.title: 碎颅者魔山
text.objectives: 存活并杀死碎颅者魔山。
text.description: 这是陷阱！古加尔诱使你找到暮光神锤，这样他手下的戈隆就可以趁机除掉你。$B$B活下来并杀死碎颅者魔山。
text.completion: You did it, lad! You beat that damned gronn and sent Cho'gall packing into the Twilight Bastion. Don't you worry. With your help and that of your friends, we'll get in there and we'll kill Cho'gall once and for all!
text.completed: Speak with Kurdran Wildhammer at Victor's Point in the Twilight Highlands.
text.giverWindow: 干掉他！

english.title: Skullcrusher the Mountain
english.objectives: Survive and then slay Skullcrusher the Mountain.
english.description: It was a trap! Cho'gall lured you in with the Hammer of Twilight so that his gronn could finish you off.$B$BSurvive and slay Skullcrusher the Mountain!
english.completion: You did it, lad! You beat that damned gronn and sent Cho'gall packing into the Twilight Bastion. Don't you worry. With your help and that of your friends, we'll get in there and we'll kill Cho'gall once and for all!
english.completed: Speak with Kurdran Wildhammer at Victor's Point in the Twilight Highlands.
english.giverWindow: Bring him down!

objectiveDetails.description: 在碎颅者的反手一击中存活

text.title: 碎颅者魔山
text.objectives: 存活并杀死碎颅者魔山。
text.description: 这是陷阱！古加尔诱使你找到暮光神锤，这样他手下的戈隆就可以趁机除掉你。$B$B活下来并杀死碎颅者魔山。
text.completion: You did it, $n! You beat that damned gronn and sent Cho'gall packing into the Twilight Bastion. Don't you worry. With your help and that of your friends, we'll get in there and we'll kill Cho'gall once and for all!
text.completed: Speak with Warlord Zaela at Crushblow in the Twilight Highlands.
text.giverWindow: 干掉他！
