english.objectives: Survive and then slay Skullcrusher the Mountain.
english.description: It was a trap! Cho'gall lured you in with the Hammer of Twilight so that his gronn could finish you off.$B$BSurvive and slay Skullcrusher the Mountain!
english.completion: You did it, $n! You beat that damned gronn and sent Cho'gall packing into the Twilight Bastion. Don't you worry. With your help and that of your friends, we'll get in there and we'll kill Cho'gall once and for all!
english.completed: Speak with Warlord Zaela at Crushblow in the Twilight Highlands.
english.giverWindow: Bring him down!

objectiveDetails.description: 在碎颅者的反手一击中存活

text.title: 穴居人的麻烦
text.objectives: 进入布拉姆式炮台，抵御四波穴居人的攻击。
text.description: 我得暂时停下抵御穴居人的工作，花些时间来分析这些样本。进入一架炮台，尽你所能地杀死穴居人吧。我就待在这里进行研究了。$B$B炮台有两种技能：普通射击和电流过载，你可以趁大批敌人逼近的时候再用第二种技能！哈哈，祝你好运。$B$B噢，你要当心那些行动迟缓的大个子穴居人。最好别让他们靠近你。
text.progress: Not quite done yet.  Need some more time.
text.completion: The results are in.  I've identified traces of corruption in all three samples you brought me.  Rhea will be quite disappointed.
text.completed: Return to Dr. Hieronymus Blam at Agmond's End in the Badlands.

english.title: Troggish Troubles
english.objectives: Enter a Blam Turret, then survive four waves of trogg attacks.
english.description: I'll need some time to analyze these samples, as well as a break from this trogg-shooting duty.  Go man one of my turrets and take out as many troggs as you can.  I'll be here studying.$b$bThe turrets have two abilities: a regular shot, as well as an electrical overload, for when too many enemies get close!  Heh, heh.  Good luck.$b$bOh, and look out for the big, slow troggs.  You probably don't want to let them anywhere near you.
english.progress: Not quite done yet.  Need some more time.
english.completion: The results are in.  I've identified traces of corruption in all three samples you brought me.  Rhea will be quite disappointed.
english.completed: Return to Dr. Hieronymus Blam at Agmond's End in the Badlands.

text.title: 迪菲亚兄弟会首脑
text.objectives: 杀掉迪菲亚兄弟会首脑。
text.description: 你好呀，$n。我听说不少有关你的事情。仔细听好，你只有一次机会。$B$B新任的迪菲亚兄弟会首脑一定就在这茅屋里策划着整个行动。她父亲组建的组织胁迫和屠杀了数百名无辜的群众，为了他们，我要你进去把她干掉。$B$B她居然让你如此接近她的地盘，而没有逃跑，还在伺机而动，这我很惊讶，不过看来我们是走运了。
text.completion: You very well may have saved all of Stormwind with your efforts here today, $n. Vanessa may still be out there, but she is an insignificant threat now that the Juggernaut will be placed under our careful watch. Thank you.
text.completed: Speak to Lieutenant Horatio Laine inside the Deadmines.
text.giverWindow: 兄弟会要断送在这里。

english.title: The Defias Kingpin
english.objectives: Kill the Defias Kingpin.
english.description: Hello there, $n. I've heard a great deal about you. Listen closely, you're only going to have one solid shot at this.$B$BThe new Defias Kingpin must be inside the hut orchestrating this entire operation. I want you to go inside and take her down, for the sake of the hundreds of innocent people the organization her father started has killed and terrorized.$B$BI'm shocked that she would let you get so close to her domain without fleeing and waiting until more favorable conditions, but it seems we're in luck.
english.completion: You very well may have saved all of Stormwind with your efforts here today, $n. Vanessa may still be out there, but she is an insignificant threat now that the Juggernaut will be placed under our careful watch. Thank you.
english.completed: Speak to Lieutenant Horatio Laine inside the Deadmines.
english.giverWindow: The Brotherhood ends here.

text.title: 尘风挖掘场
text.objectives: 跟荒芜之地尘风挖掘场的首席勘探员杜尔林谈一谈。
text.description: 我有个想法，稍微有点不切实际。不过我骨子里就喜欢挑战。$B$B探险者协会在北面的沙地下发现了一处泰坦遗址。说到比龙类更古老更聪明的种族，那就是泰坦了。我甚至听说是泰坦创造了龙呢。$B$B前往北面营地，跟首席勘探员杜尔林谈一谈。他对泰坦的了解比我多。$B$B我说什么来着？这事儿是有点不切实际啦。
text.completion: Titans?  You wanna know about titans?$b$bYou came to the right place, $g lad: lass;.  We're on the brink of somethin' big.
text.completed: 去找荒芜之地尘风挖掘场的首席勘探员杜尔林。

english.title: Dustwind Dig
english.objectives: Speak with Lead Prospector Durdin at Dustwind Dig in the Badlands.
english.description: I've got an idea, but it's a bit of a long shot.  Thankfully, long shots happen to be a specialty of mine.$b$bNorth of here, the Explorers' League has uncovered a new set of titan ruins beneath the sands.  If there's anything older and wiser than dragons, it's titans.  Heck, I've heard rumors that the titans CREATED the dragons.$b$bTalk to Lead Prospector Durdin at the camp to the north.  He'll have more information than I do about these titans.$b$bWhat did I tell you?  It's a long shot.
english.completion: Titans?  You wanna know about titans?$b$bYou came to the right place, $g lad: lass;.  We're on the brink of somethin' big.
english.completed: Report to Lead Prospector Durdin at Dustwind Dig in the Badlands.

text.title: 爱情、战争和考古学都是不择手段的
text.objectives: 取回破损的圣杯、满是尘土的花瓶、土灵符文碑刻和穴居人工具。
text.description: 重要的事优先。我总不能坐在这里跟你详细地介绍我们在遗址里发现了什么吧。我们还有一堆问题有待解决呢！$b$b眼下最麻烦的事就是从墓穴另一端涌来的神圣遗物学会流氓。他们偷走了我们挖到的宝贝！这帮家伙难道不知道挖掘是矮人的专利吗？$b$b杀死神圣遗物学会 "挖掘者"——虽然我更愿意称呼他们为强盗，夺回珍贵的古器。$b$b然后我们再来谈谈泰坦的故事。
text.progress: Your bags look heavy.  Heavy with liberated artifacts, I presume?
text.completion: Chalice... worthless.$b$bVase... counterfeit.$b$bHieroglyph... interesting, but rather common.$b$bWhat's this?  I've never seen trogg craftsmanship of this caliber!  You've stumbled upon something rare indeed, $n.$b$bAlright, fine.  Let's talk titans, shall we?
text.completed: Return to Lead Prospector Durdin at Dustwind Dig in the Badlands.

english.title: All's Fair in Love, War, and Archaeology
english.objectives: Obtain a Broken Chalice, a Dusty Vase, an Earthen Hieroglyph, and a Trogg Tool.
english.description: First things first, though.  I'm not just going to sit here and tell you everything we've discovered down in those ruins.  We've got problems to take care of!$b$bMost pressing is those upstart Reliquary hooligans, just on the other side of the tomb.  They're makin' off with all of our loot!  Don't they know that diggin's dwarf work?$b$bHunt down a few of their "excavators" - more like bandits, if you ask me - and bring some of these precious artifacts back to me.$b$bTHEN we'll talk titans.
english.progress: Your bags look heavy.  Heavy with liberated artifacts, I presume?
english.completion: Chalice... worthless.$b$bVase... counterfeit.$b$bHieroglyph... interesting, but rather common.$b$bWhat's this?  I've never seen trogg craftsmanship of this caliber!  You've stumbled upon something rare indeed, $n.$b$bAlright, fine.  Let's talk titans, shall we?
english.completed: Return to Lead Prospector Durdin at Dustwind Dig in the Badlands.

text.title: 远古的保卫者
text.objectives: 调查戒卫和哨兵。
text.description: 你听到墓穴中央的房间中传来一阵隆隆声。那两尊大雕像看样子确实很可疑。
text.completion: With your inspection complete, the statues return to their original positions.  Something seems different in the room, however...
text.completed: Inspect the Titan's Trove within the Tomb of the Watchers in the Badlands.

english.title: Ancient Protectors
english.objectives: Investigate The Warden and The Sentinel.
english.description: You heard a good amount of rumbling happen in the tomb's central chamber.  Those two large statues did look awfully suspicious.
english.completion: With your inspection complete, the statues return to their original positions.  Something seems different in the room, however...
english.completed: Inspect the Titan's Trove within the Tomb of the Watchers in the Badlands.

text.title: 返回布拉姆身边
text.objectives: 将守护者之眼带回荒芜之地的阿戈莫德的营地，交给耶柔米·布拉姆博士。
text.description: 你在箱子中找到了一件圆形的小设备，放在一张垫子上。$b$b如果说这座墓穴中确实有泰坦圣物，那肯定就是它无疑了。你决定将它带回去交给布拉姆博士。
text.progress: Well?  Has our long shot paid off?
text.completion: Just one tiny little device? I never did understand those titans. Very well!  Let's see what this peeper can do.
text.completed: Report to Dr. Hieronymus Blam at Agmond's End in the Badlands.

english.title: Return to Blam
english.objectives: Bring the Eye of the Watchers to Dr. Hieronymus Blam at Agmond's End in the Badlands.
english.description: Inside the chest, you find a small, circular device, resting upon a cushion.$b$bIf there are any titan artifacts to be found here in the tomb, this is it.  You resolve to bring it back to Dr. Blam.
english.progress: Well?  Has our long shot paid off?
english.completion: Just one tiny little device? I never did understand those titans. Very well!  Let's see what this peeper can do.
english.completed: Report to Dr. Hieronymus Blam at Agmond's End in the Badlands.

text.title: 黑潮
text.objectives: 杀死6名斯通纳德食人魔。
text.description: 战斗的走向和我所期望的一样。他们的战士几近力竭，我则派出了骑兵。$B$B我没料到的是食人魔。我们的骑士和那些蛮兵不相上下，但他们需要援助。$B$B我要你马上返回战场，$n。很少有人能独立扳倒食人魔，但我想你靠得住。别让我失望。
text.completion: Going toe to toe with ogres is impressive, $n. I'm glad I've got soldiers like you out here.
text.completed: Return to Joanna Blueheart at Marshtide Watch in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: Tides of Darkness
english.objectives: Slay 6 Stonard Ogres.
english.description: The battle's proceeding just the way I wanted it. With their warriors nearly exhausted, I've sent in our cavalry.$B$BWhat I wasn't expecting was ogres. Our knights are well matched against the brutes, but they're going to need help.$B$BI need you back on the field right away, $n. Few can bring down an ogre on foot, but I think I can count on you. Don't disappoint me.
english.completion: Going toe to toe with ogres is impressive, $n. I'm glad I've got soldiers like you out here.
english.completed: Return to Joanna Blueheart at Marshtide Watch in Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 戒卫的棋卒
text.objectives: 在荒芜之地的观察者的陵墓中，找到戒卫的棋卒的用途。
text.description: 那些细皮嫩肉的神圣遗物学会成员刚来的时候，我们惊慌失措，大家乱哄哄地抢救文物。$b$b那天的考古行动可真是糟糕透顶。$b$b幸运的是，奥尔达捡到了这尊翡翠小雕像。我们觉得它可能是某种钥匙，不过我们找不到用它来打开的东西。也许你的运气会比我们更好点。
text.completion: <The statue clicks into place on the large stone slab.>

english.title: The Warden's Pawn
english.objectives: Find a use for the Warden's Pawn within the Tomb of the Watchers in the Badlands.
english.description: Once those Reliquary honks got here, we panicked, and we all just started looting indiscriminately.$b$bA lot of bad archaeology happened that day.$b$bLuckily, Olga happened upon this small jade statue.  We thought it to be a key of some sort, but can't figure out what it opens.  Maybe you'll have some better luck with it.
english.completion: <The statue clicks into place on the large stone slab.>

text.title: 哨兵的棋卒
text.objectives: 在荒芜之地的观察者的陵墓中，找到哨兵的棋卒的用途。
text.description: 我们刚刚发现有一个血望者那边的神圣遗物学会杂碎偷走了这尊雕像。我们把他抓了个正着，夺回了雕像，不过这事还没完。$b$b这雕像似乎是某种钥匙，不过我在那片废墟里找不到什么锁可以开。你有兴趣试试看吗？
text.completion: <The statue slides into place on the cold marble slab.>

english.title: The Sentinel's Pawn
english.objectives: Find a use for the Sentinel's Pawn within the Tomb of the Watchers in the Badlands.
english.description: We very nearly had this statue stolen from us by one of Bloodwatcher's Reliquary stooges.  We managed to catch him in the act, and we've retrieved the statue, but it hasn't really paid off.$b$bIt appears to be a key of some sort, but I can't find the lock anywhere inside those ruins.  You feel like giving it a try?
english.completion: <The statue slides into place on the cold marble slab.>

text.title: 生命之水
text.objectives: 使用生命之水从铸炉之主芬雷的尸体上提取信息。
text.description: 带上生命之水，将它倒在淹死的矮人尸体上。$B$B生前他与金属为伍，如今湖水浸透他的肉身。你想知道的一切，生命之水都会让他告诉你。$B$B你知晓答案后，请立即离开我的领地。
text.completion: The Hammer of Twilight? And you say you got this information out of a drowned Wildhammer dwarf? You're kidding, right?
text.completed: Speak with Garona Halforcen at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Water of Life
english.objectives: Use the Water of Life to extract information from the Corpse of Forgemaster Finlay.
english.description: Take my Water of Life and pass it into the corpse of the drowned dwarf.$B$BHe was a worker of metals in life, and though his body now feeds my loch, the Water will allow him to tell you what you want to know.$B$BThen take your information and be gone from my demesne.
english.completion: The Hammer of Twilight? And you say you got this information out of a drowned Wildhammer dwarf? You're kidding, right?
english.completed: Speak with Garona Halforcen at the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: I Said the Words...
text.objectives: Disrupt the cultist rituals in the Drag, the Valley of Honor, and near the city's West Gate by reading the incorrect words from the Book of Incantations.
text.description: Now that you're familiar with the ritual, it's time for you to perform it in the city. Dozens of our brethren have already made their way to the ritual sites.$B$BI want you to visit the portal ritual sites on the second level of the Drag, in the Valley of Honor near the Hall of the Brave, and near Orgrimmar's west gate. The teams there will have made most of the preparations and all you need to do is read the last part of the incantation from the book.$B$BVery soon the city will be consumed in flame.
text.completion: You've brought many of these traitors to justice, $n, and yet their numbers keep growing. I fear we won't be able to stomp out all these rituals in time...
text.completed: Return to Blood Guard Torek in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.

english.title: I Said the Words...
english.objectives: Disrupt the cultist rituals in the Drag, the Valley of Honor, and near the city's West Gate by reading the incorrect words from the Book of Incantations.
english.description: Now that you're familiar with the ritual, it's time for you to perform it in the city. Dozens of our brethren have already made their way to the ritual sites.$B$BI want you to visit the portal ritual sites on the second level of the Drag, in the Valley of Honor near the Hall of the Brave, and near Orgrimmar's west gate. The teams there will have made most of the preparations and all you need to do is read the last part of the incantation from the book.$B$BVery soon the city will be consumed in flame.
english.completion: You've brought many of these traitors to justice, $n, and yet their numbers keep growing. I fear we won't be able to stomp out all these rituals in time...
english.completed: Return to Blood Guard Torek in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.

objectiveDetails.description: Disrupt Ritual in Valley of Honor

text.title: Back Under Cover
text.objectives: Put on your Recruit's Robe, go to the Jaggedswine Farm and get the Book of Incantations from Overseer Jintak. Read from the Book of Incantations near the Cultist Altar to practice the ritual.
text.description: The cultists seem assured of their victory, although we have captured many of them. We must find out more about the ritual mentioned by the cultist you questioned.$B$BThese rituals must be the core of their plans to attack Orgrimmar.$B$BTake one of the robes from the arrested cultists; it's not like they're going to need them anymore. Put it on and go back to the cultist outpost at the Jaggedswine Farm in Durotar and see what you can learn about these rituals and their place in the cult's plans.
text.progress: It's good to see you again, $n. We thought the Warchief might have gotten his hands on you.
text.completion: You need to familiarize yourself with the portal ritual quickly. We've sent dozens of brothers into the city, but only so many can evade capture. We're relying on you, $n.
text.completed: Return to Overseer Jintak at the Jaggedswine Farm in Durotar.

english.objectives: Put on your Recruit's Robe, go to the Jaggedswine Farm and get the Book of Incantations from Overseer Jintak. Read from the Book of Incantations near the Cultist Altar to practice the ritual.

text.title: Show Me Your Papers
text.objectives: Go to the front gates of Orgrimmar, read the Warchief's Proclamation and search 5 Orgrimmar Citizens. Keep anything suspicious that you find.
text.description: My men recently discovered a group of cultists attempting to sneak into the city. The flow of traffic into Orgrimmar has come to a halt. The Warchief has decreed that all visitors must be searched before they can enter the gates. Take this copy of his proclamation and read it to the people assembled at the front gates, then assist the guards there in searching those who wish to enter.
text.completion: So there were more cultists waiting to be admitted to the city? It's a good thing that you caught them, $n. Reading over the note that you found, it seems they're planning something big.
text.completed: Return to Blood Guard Torek in the Valley of Strength.

english.title: Show Me Your Papers
english.objectives: Go to the front gates of Orgrimmar, read the Warchief's Proclamation and search 5 Orgrimmar Citizens. Keep anything suspicious that you find.
english.description: My men recently discovered a group of cultists attempting to sneak into the city. The flow of traffic into Orgrimmar has come to a halt. The Warchief has decreed that all visitors must be searched before they can enter the gates. Take this copy of his proclamation and read it to the people assembled at the front gates, then assist the guards there in searching those who wish to enter.
english.completion: So there were more cultists waiting to be admitted to the city? It's a good thing that you caught them, $n. Reading over the note that you found, it seems they're planning something big.
english.completed: Return to Blood Guard Torek in the Valley of Strength.

text.title: Arrest the Infiltrators
text.objectives: Use the Heavy Manacles to arrest 5 Cultist Infiltrators and bring them to Warden Gartok Ragefist at the Ring of Valor in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. After you've returned with your prisoners, question the Detained Cultist.
text.description: The note you found can only mean one thing. The warchief's proclamation was too late; they already have infiltrators at work in the city.$B$BThis note contains instructions and locations for cultists to meet, but it doesn't say what they're doing. Our enemies have grown smarter. It's going to be tough to track down all of them, but we have to get as many as we can. Use these cuffs to arrest the infiltrators and then deliver them to Warden Gartok Ragefist at the Ring of Valor in the Valley of Honor.
text.completion: So they're preparing some kind of ritual all over the city? Orgrimmar city is infested with cultists and their sympathizers and the warchief is at wit's end. We must do something!
text.completed: Return to Blood Guard Torek in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.

english.title: Arrest the Infiltrators
english.objectives: Use the Heavy Manacles to arrest 5 Cultist Infiltrators and bring them to Warden Gartok Ragefist at the Ring of Valor in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. After you've returned with your prisoners, question the Detained Cultist.
english.description: The note you found can only mean one thing. The warchief's proclamation was too late; they already have infiltrators at work in the city.$B$BThis note contains instructions and locations for cultists to meet, but it doesn't say what they're doing. Our enemies have grown smarter. It's going to be tough to track down all of them, but we have to get as many as we can. Use these cuffs to arrest the infiltrators and then deliver them to Warden Gartok Ragefist at the Ring of Valor in the Valley of Honor.
english.completion: So they're preparing some kind of ritual all over the city? Orgrimmar city is infested with cultists and their sympathizers and the warchief is at wit's end. We must do something!
english.completed: Return to Blood Guard Torek in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.

objectiveDetails.description: Arrested Cultists brought to Ring of Valor

text.title: 松一口气
text.objectives: 消灭8名被制服的纵火者。
text.description: 我已经让小伙子们在镇子四周形成防御战线，阻止那些从撕裂的大地里来的元素。他们都是好小伙，守得很严实，可就算是最结实的矮人，最后也会累。$B$B他们分班倒：休息一小时，站一小时的岗。人手有限，我只能做到这样了。$B$B如果你想帮忙的话，就挑一条防线，顶一班岗。让我的小伙子们好歇口气。等你杀掉几只元素后再来找我。
text.completion: Good work, boy. Good to have another capable set of hands about.
text.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard at Firebeard's Patrol in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Welcome Relief
english.objectives: Kill 8 Subjugated Firestarters.
english.description: I've got boys formin' defensive lines on all sides of the town, keepin' back the elementals streaming from the torn ground. They're good lads and they've been holdin' firm, but even the sturdiest dwarf tires eventually.$B$BThey're split into shifts: one hour of rest for every hour on the line. Best I can get'm with the men we have.$B$BIf you want to be helpin', pick a line and take up a shift. Give some of my boys a welcome breather. Report back in once you've killed several of the elementals.
english.completion: Good work, boy. Good to have another capable set of hands about.
english.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard at Firebeard's Patrol in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 我们唯一的家
text.objectives: 扑灭焰须巡逻营的50处火苗。
text.description: 我们败退的程度比我想象得还要严重，但我不打算放弃，将家园拱手让给这些混账。他们可以把它烧掉、将其洗劫一空、在断壁残垣上唾骂，但我们还是要打回去。$B$B话虽这么说，最好还是别让它被烧了。我让几个小伙子从井里打水来，想把火给扑灭。要是你也来的话，可以把桶从他们手里接过来，就不用来回跑了。
text.completion: Thanks for your help. Every little bit makes a difference. We'll keep the water going until we can push the Twilight back.
text.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard at Firebeard's Patrol in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: The Only Homes We Have
english.objectives: Extinguish 50 fires at Firebeard's Patrol.
english.description: We've already been pushed back farther than I'd hoped, but I'm not about to give up our homes to these mongrels. They may burn them, pillage them, and spit on the rubbled remains, but we'll still fight to take them back.$B$BThat being said, I rather like them not burnt. I have the boys running buckets from the well to try to keep the fire down. If you'd join them, they can help out by tossing you buckets so you don't have to make the runs.
english.completion: Thanks for your help. Every little bit makes a difference. We'll keep the water going until we can push the Twilight back.
english.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard at Firebeard's Patrol in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 小小的安慰
text.objectives: 找到并归还米艾拉的风干玫瑰、帕尔兰的象牙锤以及阿普里卡的玩偶。
text.description: 我想，你就是那个来帮助科甘的新面孔吧？很高兴见到你。也许你可以替在这里避难的蛮锤矮人帮一两个忙。$B$B我们都不得不仓皇撤到这座建筑里来，许多人把宝贵的东西都遗落在附近我们被毁的家园里了。你能不能去把它们找回来？你可以给愁云惨雾的灵魂带来快乐。
text.progress: Were you able to find their valuables. I know it seems so minor, but little things make a big difference to some people in times like these.
text.completion: You are very generous. Thank you. There's a lot of darkness in our world these days. We appreciate the light that you've brought here.
text.completed: Return to Cailin Longfellow at Firebeard's Patrol in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Small Comforts
english.objectives: Find and return Meara's Dried Roses, Parlan's Ivory Hammer, and Aprika's Doll.
english.description: You're the new face that's meant to be helping Keegan out I take it? Pleasure to meet you. Maybe you can lend a favor or two more to the troubled Wildhammer that have made refuge here.$B$BWe were all forced to retreat to this building quickly, and some of us left behind things of great value in our destroyed homes nearby. Would you mind bringing them back after you go out there? You would bring happiness to some very troubled souls.
english.progress: Were you able to find their valuables. I know it seems so minor, but little things make a big difference to some people in times like these.
english.completion: You are very generous. Thank you. There's a lot of darkness in our world these days. We appreciate the light that you've brought here.
english.completed: Return to Cailin Longfellow at Firebeard's Patrol in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 光荣的使命
text.objectives: 跟焰须墓地的伊安·焰须谈一谈。
text.description: 我的副手伊安，背着我们一位英雄的遗体，到西边墓地去了。我命他从手头的兵力里组织一支狮鹫骑士部队来。我想让你帮忙。$B$B我只想把这个任务的紧迫性告诉你。我们没法永远地守住城堡，暮光之锤和龙喉兽人总会杀进来的。执行狮鹫空中部队的计划，是我们从战场纷争中幸存的唯一希望。
text.completion: Greetings, $r. Sent by Keegan?

english.title: Honorable Bearing
english.objectives: Speak to Iain Firebeard at the Firebeard Cemetery.
english.description: Iain, my second in command, bore the body of one of our fallen heroes to the cathedral to the west. He's the man I've put in charge of reforming a wing of gryphon riders from whatever scattered forces he can find. I would like you to help him.$B$BI should impress upon you the urgency of this task. We will not be able to hold here forever; the Twilight's Hammer or the Dragonmaw orcs will eventually overwhelm us. Putting together an active gryphon wing may be our only hope for surviving these conflicts.
english.completion: Greetings, $r. Sent by Keegan?

text.title: 穆兰氏族
text.objectives: 跟杀戮熔炉竞技场的道格拉斯·穆兰谈一谈。
text.description: 要想把整个狮鹫飞行队集结起来，我们就要赶快，趁幸存者们还没离开或是被干掉之前行动。我的目标是那几组抱成团的骑士。我打算稍后出发去找桑德玛尔骑士和摩尔骑士。$B$B我最后一次见到穆兰时，他们正朝西边出发，前往杀戮熔炉竞技场。去看看你是否能说服道格拉斯·穆兰加入科甘——他还欠他两三个人情呢。
text.completion: Iain sent ya? You don't look like a Firebeard to me. Why exactly should I be listenin' to anything you say?

english.title: Clan Mullan
english.objectives: Speak to Duglas Mullan at the Crucible of Carnage.
english.description: If we're going to pull a full gryphon wing back together, we're going to need to move fast to gather the survivors before they leave or get picked off. I've got a bead on a few groups of riders that stuck together. I'm leavin' to find the Thundermar riders and the Moore riders shortly.$B$BThe Mullans were heading up west to the Crucible of Carnage last I saw. Go see if you can convince Duglas Mullan to join up with Keegan - he should owe him a favor or three.
english.completion: Iain sent ya? You don't look like a Firebeard to me. Why exactly should I be listenin' to anything you say?

text.title: 顽固如多伊尔
text.objectives: 跟高地森林的克兰·多伊尔谈一谈。
text.description: 大家最后一次看到多伊尔骑士的时候，他们正在南边黑曜石森林边缘的林子里出没。他们是一伙固执的家伙，要说服他们加入，得费一番口舌。$B$B最好的办法就是告诉他们，凯琳·朗费罗同我们一起躲在镇子里。她是克兰·多伊尔的软肋，把她搬出来，应该就能将他和他的小伙子们拖回来了。
text.completion: It seems the Doyles suffered the worst of the attacking Twilight drakes. It's clear that they fought to the end: not a single rider's footprint more than a few yards from his gryphon. It's doubtful there were any survivors.

english.title: Stubborn as a Doyle
english.objectives: Speak to Keeland Doyle in the Highland Forest.
english.description: The Doyle riders were last spotted convergin' in the trees to the south, on the border of the Obsidian Forest. They're a stubborn bunch and are likely to take some convincin' if they're going to join up with us.$B$BYour best bet with Keeland Doyle is to tell'm Cailin Longfellow's taken up shelter with us back at the town. Keeland's got a good soft spot for her and she just might be enough to convince him to drag all his boys along.
english.completion: It seems the Doyles suffered the worst of the attacking Twilight drakes. It's clear that they fought to the end: not a single rider's footprint more than a few yards from his gryphon. It's doubtful there were any survivors.

text.title: 焰须怒吼
text.objectives: 跟哥沙克战争营地的马凯伊·焰须谈一谈。
text.description: 我还要你去吞噬裂口另一边的哥沙克战争营地，寻找马凯伊和他的人。$B$B龙喉没能撑过第一波进攻，马凯伊打算从他们的营地里抢些东西好给我们补给。那里估计不会有多少必需品，不过他们可能需要人手帮忙搬东西，然后才能回科甘那儿去。$B$B要是有必要的话，帮老伊安催催他们。
text.completion: Bout that time, eh? Help us wrap things up then.

english.title: Firebeard Bellows
english.objectives: Speak to Mackay Firebeard at the Gorshak War Camp.
english.description: I also need ya to seek out Mackay and his men on the other side of the Devouring Breach, at the Gorshak War Camp.$B$BThe Dragonmaw didn't survive the initial onslaught, and Mackay's lookin' to ransack what he can of their camp to supply our fight. There shouldn't be much convincin' necessary, but they'll likely want a hand wrappin' things up there before they make their way back to Keegan.$B$BGive'm a boot in the arse from ol' Iain if ya have to.
english.completion: Bout that time, eh? Help us wrap things up then.

text.title: 战斗精神
text.objectives: 挑战并击败一名穆兰狮鹫骑士。
text.description: 科甘要穆兰跟他们一块儿飞？如果我为了一名矮人而飞翔，那名矮人就只有是他。然而，我不知道他为什么派一个外人来找我——按标准这可不大礼貌。$B$B我猜你跟我的小伙子们撑不到20秒，不管是在酒吧里还是在战场上。看看你能否证明我错了。下去跟他们中的一个打上一场，然后我再考虑跟科甘一起飞的事情。
text.completion: That's the stuff! Not half bad. You've got a bit of fight in ya after all.
text.completed: Speak to Duglas Mullan at the Crucible of Carnage in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: The Fighting Spirit
english.objectives: Challenge and defeat one of the Mullan Gryphon Riders.
english.description: Keegan wants the Mullans to take wing with'm eh? If there's a dwarf I'd fly for, he'd be it. Still, I don't get why he'd be sendin' an outsider to be recruitin' me - not right polite by my standards.$B$BI'm guessin' ya don't last 20 seconds with any of my boys, at the bar or in the battlefield. Prove me wrong. Take one of'm down in a fight and then I'll think about flyin' with ol' Keegan.
english.completion: That's the stuff! Not half bad. You've got a bit of fight in ya after all.
english.completed: Speak to Duglas Mullan at the Crucible of Carnage in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 战斗的味道
text.objectives: 找到8头穆兰狮鹫，将它们送回到狮鹫骑士的身边。
text.description: 别叫道格拉斯给骗了，穆兰很渴望再次高飞，若要给我们一个必须飞行的理由，这个理由就是焰须。$B$B我们让狮鹫到南边的高地森林去觅食了，让它们稍稍远离战斗的喧嚣。它们该好好休息。$B$B要是你想让我们再度回到天上，就帮忙把我们的狮鹫给带回来。$B$B拿上这根焦黑的高地桦木。我们训练的时候就用它——只要它们闻到这个味道，就会直接回来找我们。
text.completion: Good on you. I always feel like a part of me is missing when my gryphon isn't nearby. I can't speak for Duglas or the rest of the clan, but I'll be ready to ride at Firebeard's call.
text.completed: Return to Edana Mullan at the Crucible of Carnage in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: The Scent of Battle
english.objectives: Find 8 Mullan Gryphons and dispatch them back to their gryphon riders.
english.description: Don't let Duglas fool you, the Mullans have been itchin' to take wing again, and if there's anyone we'd do it for, it's Firebeard.$B$BWe left our gryphons in the Highland Forest to the south to hunt and to get away from the sounds of battle for a bit. They deserved a rest.$B$BIf you want us back in the air soon, you'd do well to help us bring our gryphons back in.$B$BTake this piece of charred highland birch. We use it during training - as soon as they smell it, they'll come straight back to us.
english.completion: Good on you. I always feel like a part of me is missing when my gryphon isn't nearby. I can't speak for Duglas or the rest of the clan, but I'll be ready to ride at Firebeard's call.
english.completed: Return to Edana Mullan at the Crucible of Carnage in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 穆兰氏族的忠诚
text.objectives: 把穆兰氏族的消息报告给焰须墓地的伊安·焰须。
text.description: 你说得很对。让科甘放心吧。我们的人一到齐就去镇子里见他。$B$B虽然你不是蛮锤的一员，但你依然很厉害。看来你也不是吃白饭的。$B$B不过，还没见过你喝酒呢。那可是真正的考验。
text.completion: Ya got the Mullans. Good news! They're worth more than their weight in a fight, and they ain't exactly skinny.

english.title: The Loyalty of Clan Mullan
english.objectives: Return the news on Clan Mullan to Iain Firebeard at the Firebeard Cemetery.
english.description: Your point's made. Keegan can count on us. We'll meet'm back at town as soon as all the boys are rallied up.$B$BYou're tough for not bein' a Wildhammer. Guess they breed'm good where you come from too.$B$BStill, haven't seen ya drink yet. That'll be the real test.
english.completion: Ya got the Mullans. Good news! They're worth more than their weight in a fight, and they ain't exactly skinny.

text.title: 死得其所
text.objectives: 击败6名龙喉游荡者。
text.description: 暮光之锤洗劫了这座镇子，把居住在里面的大多数龙喉兽人都给杀了。不过仍然有几个幸存者，而且他们对我们大摇大摆地拿走补给不是很高兴。$B$B那倒也没关系。$B$B因为呢，我也对他们攻击我的小伙子不是很高兴。把他们干掉，赶走——我不管，别让他们来捣乱就行了。
text.completion: That's more like it. Let's finish gatherin' up supplies and get back to Keegan.
text.completed: Return to Mackay Firebeard at Gorshak War Camp in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Death Worthy of a Dragonmaw
english.objectives: Defeat 6 Dragonmaw Stragglers.
english.description: The Twilight sacked this town, killin' most of the Dragonmaw that lived in it. A few survived though, and they're not right keen on us takin' liberties with their supplies.$B$BNot that that matters much.$B$BWell, I'm not right keen on them attackin' my boys. Kill'm off, chase'm out - I don't care, just get'm gone.
english.completion: That's more like it. Let's finish gatherin' up supplies and get back to Keegan.
english.completed: Return to Mackay Firebeard at Gorshak War Camp in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 有什么用什么
text.objectives: 将8件龙喉武器交给哥沙克战争营地的布罗姆·铸锤。
text.description: 到后方去多铸造一些武器？哈！铸锤家的人从来不怕打仗！谁说需要安全待在家里才能制作武器的？再说了——这里有的是原材料。那些龙喉武器根本没用，不过可以熔掉做成真正的好兵刃。给我带8把龙喉武器来，我好用它们打造出真正的兵器。
text.progress: How many have you got so far?
text.completion: Yer a good lad.  Have me thanks and a little gold for yer troubles.
text.completed: Return to Brom Forgehammer.

english.title: Anything We Can Get
english.objectives: Bring 8 Dragonmaw weapons to Brom Forgehammer at Gorshak War Camp.
english.description: Stay back and forge more weapons?  Pah!  A Forgehammer has ne'er been afraid of battle!  Who needs the safety of home to make weapons?  Besides - there is oodles of raw material out here.  Those Dragonmaw weapons are worthless, but they can be smelted down to make actual weapons.  Bring me 8 Dragonmaw weapons so me daughter and I can forge real weapons out of them.
english.progress: How many have you got so far?
english.completion: Yer a good lad.  Have me thanks and a little gold for yer troubles.
english.completed: Return to Brom Forgehammer.

text.title: 给小伙子们的
text.objectives: 把铸锤的武器交给焰须墓地的伊安·焰须。
text.description: 清理了营地，还替铸锤跑了腿？对一个小小的$C来说干得不赖啊。把这些交给焰须墓地的伊安，他会好好奖赏你的。
text.progress: 看看是谁来了？
text.completion: Hah! Looks like their raid went mighty well then. I'll have to buy ol' Forgehammer a round once we finish with this mess.

english.title: Somethin' for the Boys
english.objectives: Bring Forgehammer's weapons to Iain Firebeard at the Firebeard Cemetery.
english.description: Cleaned up the camp and ran errands for Forgehammer?  Not bad for a wee $C.  Take these to Iain at Firebeard Cemetery, and he should reward you for a job well done.
english.progress: What have we here?
english.completion: Hah! Looks like their raid went mighty well then. I'll have to buy ol' Forgehammer a round once we finish with this mess.

text.title: 私人请求
text.objectives: 跟焰须巡逻营的科甘·焰须谈一谈。
text.description: 多伊尔真令人感到遗憾。我们这么多人都逃了出来，已经是奇迹了，所以也不奇怪。$B$B桑德玛尔的那些蠢货就是懦夫。哪怕告诉他们是科甘的要求，他们也不愿踏出镇子半步。不过，我说服了摩尔，这样就至少有三个氏族了。$B$B科甘说等你回来后，他想要亲自见你。去镇子里找他。
text.completion: It seems you had some luck bringin' riders back. Well timed too - we just pushed the elementals back, so we should have the arm room to lead an attack right away. Thank you, $n. You're a good $r.

english.title: Personal Request
english.objectives: Speak to Keegan Firebeard at Firebeard's Patrol.
english.description: Shame about the Doyles. It's a fair miracle that as many of us made it out as is though, so can't count it as much of a surprise.$B$BThose louts at Thundermar are cowards. Even after tellin' them it was Keegan askin', they won't set foot outside of their town. I did rope in the Moores though, so that's at least three clans' worth.$B$BKeegan wanted to hear from ya personally when you returned. Go find'm in town.
english.completion: It seems you had some luck bringin' riders back. Well timed too - we just pushed the elementals back, so we should have the arm room to lead an attack right away. Thank you, $n. You're a good $r.

text.title: 挥动战锤
text.objectives: 骑上焰须巡逻营的一头狮鹫，杀死12名暮光风暴扭曲者和塞维亚斯·风惧。
text.description: 多亏了你和伊安，我们有了足够的骑士，可以对暮光展开反击了。$B$B我们接受过骑乘作战训练，不过让副骑手操控风暴之锤会更有效。我想你或许可以尝试一下这份荣誉。$B$B挑一头狮鹫加入战斗。不过最好要快——我们打算一小时内就把所有的暮光都从那些飘动的石头上撵下去。
text.completion: Now that's how it's done, lad! With a real gryphon wing back together, we can take the fight to the rest of the Twilight. You're welcome to fly with us anytime.
text.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard at Firebeard's Patrol in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Dropping the Hammer
english.objectives: Kill 12 Twilight Stormbenders and Servias Windterror using one of the gryphons at Firebeard's Patrol.
english.description: Thanks to you and Iain, we've got enough riders together that we can take the fight back to the Twilight.$B$BWe're trained to fight while ridin', but a second rider to handle the Stormhammer tends to be more efficient. I thought you might enjoy the honor.$B$BPick your gryphon and join the fight. Best be quick about it though - we're aimin' to clear every last one of those Twilight off of those floatin' rocks before the hour's out.
english.completion: Now that's how it's done, lad! With a real gryphon wing back together, we can take the fight to the rest of the Twilight. You're welcome to fly with us anytime.
english.completed: Return to Keegan Firebeard at Firebeard's Patrol in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 风蛇出没
text.objectives: 收集5颗完整的雄鹿沼泽毒蛇之心。
text.description: 沼桨镇建立之前，我就住在这里了，煮煮我的药剂，过得安宁祥和。我对这片沼泽了如指掌。$B$B最近野生动物有所变化。你也许在雄鹿沼泽看见过一些带翅膀的蛇，它们是风蛇，已经很久没有在这里出现过了。$B$B如果我想得没错的话，它们也非常适合作为药材。能不能好心帮我把它们的心拿来？
text.progress: Don't be squeamish now.
text.completion: Let's have a look then... Mmm, oh dear. That's what I thought these were. They might still be usable, but it's horrid to have such things in my backyard.
text.completed: Return to Baba Bogbrew at Stagalbog in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: Slithering Signs
english.objectives: Collect 5 Intact Stagalbog Serpent Hearts.
english.description: I settled here well before Bogpaddle was founded, to brew my potions and find some peace and quiet. I know this swamp like the back of my old, gnarly hand.$B$BThere's been a change in the wildlife recently. Those winged snakes you may have seen in the stagalbog are wind serpents, and they haven't been seen around here for ages.$B$BThey're also prime for ingredients if they're the kind I'm thinking of. Be a dear and gather me some of their hearts, will you?
english.progress: Don't be squeamish now.
english.completion: Let's have a look then... Mmm, oh dear. That's what I thought these were. They might still be usable, but it's horrid to have such things in my backyard.
english.completed: Return to Baba Bogbrew at Stagalbog in Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 兽人与人类
text.objectives: 杀死8名斯通纳德战士。
text.description: 世界战乱纷起，我们最不需要的就是后院里有个部落的聚居地。赤脊山、暮色森林，甚至艾尔文距离这儿都要花一天的路程。$B$B我们得先发制人，而我可不想让部落有喘息的机会。所以你就上阵吧。拿件武器，加入血腥沼泽剩余的部队，开始杀兽人。$B$B你觉得差不多了就回来报告。我要你活着回来……这是命令。解散！
text.completion: More black on you than red... that's what I like to see. Looks like you've got what it takes, $n.
text.completed: Return to Joanna Blueheart at Marshtide Watch in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: Orcs and Humans
english.objectives: Slay 8 Stonard Warriors.
english.description: With war raging across the entire world, the last thing we need is a Horde settlement right in our backyard. Redridge, Duskwood, even Elwynn itself are all a day's march from here.$B$BWe've made the first strike, and I don't plan to give the Horde a chance to catch their breath. So consider yourself deployed. Grab a weapon, join the rest of the troops out in the Bloodmire, and start killing orcs.$B$BReport back here after you've done some damage. I want you back alive...and that's an order. Dismissed!
english.completion: More black on you than red... that's what I like to see. Looks like you've got what it takes, $n.
english.completed: Return to Joanna Blueheart at Marshtide Watch in Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 伐木场巨怪
text.objectives: 杀死5个斯通纳德苦工。
text.description: 我要确保胜利的果实。拥有更多的资源还不够，我们得让敌人什么都拿不到。$B$B斯通纳德的军队都指望从附近的林子里获得木材。砍树的兽人苦工也许不是战士，但他们憎恨起人类来可一点都不含糊。$B$B别手软。我要你杀掉那些苦工，彻底切断斯通纳德的补给线。
text.completion: We've had strikes on our own lumber line while you've been gone. This should at least put us on equal footing for gathering rates. Good work, $n.
text.completed: Return to Joanna Blueheart at Marshtide Watch in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: Lumbering Oafs
english.objectives: Slay 5 Stonard Peons.
english.description: I want victory to be totally assured here. Having more resources isn't enough; we need to make sure the enemy has nothing.$B$BStonard's forces depend on the lumber gathered from the surrounding woods. The orcish peons that chop the lumber may not be warriors, but they still know nothing but hate for humans.$B$BShow no mercy. I want those peons killed and the supply of lumber to Stonard cut off completely.
english.completion: We've had strikes on our own lumber line while you've been gone. This should at least put us on equal footing for gathering rates. Good work, $n.
english.completed: Return to Joanna Blueheart at Marshtide Watch in Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 矮人的需求
text.objectives: 取回15杯暗影烈酒。
text.description: 别误会，我跟其他矮人一样喜欢挖掘。只是……哎，我们挖个不停，却很少喝酒。一想到这点，我就觉得我应该丢下锄头，回铁炉堡去。$b$b不过今天不行啦。我还有活儿要干。$b$b铁趾挖掘场的黑铁矮人酿的酒很香，能在沙漠地带酿出这种品质的酒已经很好啦，挖掘场就在北面。你可以去取一些给我吗？
text.progress: <Sigrun licks his lips in anticipation.>
text.completion: Wow, this stuff is strong!  I knew they had beer, but I never expected them to have shadowstout!  That's my favorite shadowbeer!
text.completed: Return to Sigrun Ironhew at Dustwind Dig in the Badlands.

english.title: A Dwarf's Got Needs
english.objectives: Obtain 15 mugs of Shadowstout.
english.description: I can appreciate a good diggin' as much as any other dwarf, don't get me wrong.  It's just that... well, we do so much diggin', and so little drinkin', that sometimes I wonder if I should just hang up me shovel and head back to Ironforge.$b$bBut not today.  I've got some diggin' in me yet.$b$bThose Dark Iron dwarves at Hammertoe's Digsite - just north of here - make some powerful fine beer, right here in the desert.  You think you could pick up a few for me?
english.progress: <Sigrun licks his lips in anticipation.>
english.completion: Wow, this stuff is strong!  I knew they had beer, but I never expected them to have shadowstout!  That's my favorite shadowbeer!
english.completed: Return to Sigrun Ironhew at Dustwind Dig in the Badlands.

text.title: 好东西
text.objectives: 在苦痛堡垒的底楼搜寻财宝。
text.description: 如果你有兴趣的话，我倒有个小小的提议。$B$B在杜尔林和其他勘探员抵达前，黑铁矮人就来到了这里。就是说，他们是第一批开进泰坦遗址的家伙，也不知道掠走了多少好东西。我敢打赌，黑铁矮人将这些财宝藏在了西北方的苦痛堡垒。$B$B你的能力肯定不止打倒矮人这么简单啦。前往要塞寻找泰坦的财宝吧。$B$B我本来想随你同行的，但是我喝醉了。
text.progress: 这么快就回来了？
text.completion: Now here's some treasure!  I was beginning to worry that these weren't titan ruins at all! I'll show these to Durdin.  Thanks again, $n.
text.completed: Return to Sigrun Ironhew at Dustwind Dig in the Badlands.

english.title: The Good Stuff
english.objectives: Search for treasure in the bottom floor of Angor Fortress.
english.description: I've got a little proposition for you, if you're interested.$b$bThose Dark Irons were here before Durdin and his crew arrived.  That means that, once these titan ruins opened up, the dark irons were the first ones in there, lootin' all the good stuff.  I'll bet they've still got those treasures locked up inside Angor Fortress, northwest of here.$b$bYou've more than proven your ability to wallop a dwarf.  Head on into that fortress and wallop your way to titan treasure.$b$bI'd go with, but I'm drunk.
english.progress: Back so soon?
english.completion: Now here's some treasure!  I was beginning to worry that these weren't titan ruins at all! I'll show these to Durdin.  Thanks again, $n.
english.completed: Return to Sigrun Ironhew at Dustwind Dig in the Badlands.

text.title: 劫胖济贫
text.objectives: 收集6块火烟之肉和10张火烟丝绸。
text.description: 我们非常缺乏补给品，陌生人。黑龙在我们的狩猎场肆虐横行，根本就没办法补充食物储备啊。$b$b不过，我们西南方的食人魔却有我们急需的东西。你可以在他们的洞穴里找到大量的肉和手工制品。$b$b他们也许会反抗你。别掉以轻心。
text.progress: Welcome back.
text.completion: I imagine those ogres weren't too much trouble for you.  Here - some coin for your troubles.
text.completed: Return to Victoria Dolen at Dragon's Mouth in the Badlands.

english.title: Survival of the Fattest
english.objectives: Obtain 6 pieces of Dustbelcher Meat and 10 sheets of Dustbelcher Silk.
english.description: We're hard-up for supplies, stranger.  With the black dragons raining destruction on what would be our hunting grounds, we have no way to get food.$b$bThe ogres to our southwest, however, have exactly what we need.  Within their grotto you should find plenty of meat and crafting supplies.$b$bThey may put up a fight.  Be on your guard.
english.progress: Welcome back.
english.completion: I imagine those ogres weren't too much trouble for you.  Here - some coin for your troubles.
english.completed: Return to Victoria Dolen at Dragon's Mouth in the Badlands.

text.title: 前往巨龙峡口
text.objectives: 将净化过的黑龙蛋交给荒芜之地巨龙峡口的瑞亚。
text.description: <布拉姆博士一言不发地盯着这枚卵，他眨了眨眼，然后抬头注视着你。>$B$B你……你看见了吧？难以置信！我关于泰坦的理论得到了证实！当然，这全靠你的帮助。$B$B我们要把这件事告诉瑞亚。她已经离开莱瑟罗峡谷了，大概是因为她在雏龙面前转换到真实面目时彻底暴露了身份吧。瑞亚去了西边一座名叫巨龙峡口的联盟营地。$B$B她正等着你呢。还有这枚卵。
text.progress: That's some precious cargo you carry there, $n.
text.completion: I'll take that egg out of your hands now.  We need to get this egg incubated... and hidden, quickly.  There are lots of angry dragons looking for this. It's good to see you again, by the way.
text.completed: Report to Rhea at Dragon's Mouth in the Badlands.

english.title: Into the Dragon's Mouth
english.objectives: Bring the Purified Black Dragon Egg to Rhea at Dragon's Mouth in the Badlands.
english.description: <Dr. Blam stares at the egg in awed silence, blinks a few times, then looks up at you.>$b$bD... did you see that?  Incredible!  My titan thing idea worked!  With your help, of course.$b$bWe'll want to get this back to Rhea.  She's not at Lethlor Ravine anymore; it sounds like she blew her cover pretty well when she transformed into her true form in front of all those whelps.  She's now in the west, staying at an Alliance camp called Dragon's Mouth.$b$bShe'll be waiting for you.  And for that egg.
english.progress: That's some precious cargo you carry there, $n.
english.completion: I'll take that egg out of your hands now.  We need to get this egg incubated... and hidden, quickly.  There are lots of angry dragons looking for this. It's good to see you again, by the way.
english.completed: Report to Rhea at Dragon's Mouth in the Badlands.

text.title: 三位矮人
text.objectives: 跟荒芜之地巨龙峡口的埃瑞克谈一谈。
text.description: 在匆忙逃离莱瑟罗峡谷时，我忘记拴住尼希昂卓拉了。她自由了，并向其他黑龙发出了警报。它们一眨眼的功夫就能飞来这里，寻找黑龙卵。$B$B我来负责藏匿它。你就去对付更麻烦的黑龙危机吧。当然，你需要帮助。$B$B跟营地另一边的埃瑞克谈一谈。他和他的兄弟们会很乐意帮助你的。
text.completion: You're the $r we've been waiting for?  It's about time you got here.  My legs could use a stretch. Come on boys!  Let's go kill us some black dragons!

english.title: The Swift, the Fierce, and the Stout
english.objectives: Speak with Eric "The Swift" at Dragon's Mouth in the Badlands.
english.description: In my haste to escape from Lethlor Ravine, I forgot to tie up one loose end: Nyxondra.  She's free, and she's sounded the alarm among the black dragonflight.  Half the flight is here in the western Badlands, combing for this egg.$b$bI'll take care of hiding the egg.  You're going to take care of some of the more troublesome dragons.  And you'll have help.$b$bTalk to Eric, over on the other side of camp.  He and his brothers will be joining you.
english.completion: You're the $r we've been waiting for?  It's about time you got here.  My legs could use a stretch. Come on boys!  Let's go kill us some black dragons!

text.title: 全能的埃瑞克
text.objectives: 使用埃瑞克的冲锋和埃瑞克的随身药水。
text.description: 在我们与黑龙展开殊死搏杀前，我得告诉你我的作战方式。$b$b我以身手敏捷而著称，那是因为：我会径直冲向敌人——用头盔，令他们眩晕几秒钟。我会携带一些药水，以备不时之需。$b$b要不我们先来练习练习？进入战场，试试我的能力吧。
text.completion: I'm not what you'd call "very strong" or "battle-hardened", but I get the job done my own way. Lookin' forward to fightin' with you.  I never fought with a fancy-lookin' $c before.
text.completed: Speak with Eric "The Swift" in the Badlands.

english.title: Eric, the Utility Dwarf
english.objectives: Use Eric's Charge and Eric's Pocket Potion.
english.description: Before we get too crazy what with the dragon-killin', let me tell you a little bit about how I fight.$b$b"The Swift" is what they call me, and here's why: I'll dash straight into your enemies - helmet first, mind you - and stun 'em for a few seconds.  I also keep a few potions with me for tight spots.$b$bWhy don't we practice fightin' together?  Head out into the field, and try out my abilities.
english.completion: I'm not what you'd call "very strong" or "battle-hardened", but I get the job done my own way. Lookin' forward to fightin' with you.  I never fought with a fancy-lookin' $c before.
english.completed: Speak with Eric "The Swift" in the Badlands.

objectiveDetails.description: 使用埃瑞克的随身药水

text.title: 龙群之怒
text.objectives: 杀死歼灭者卡拉然和4个暗翔士兵。
text.description: 你好，$n。看来你们四个彼此之间已经很熟了。$b$b这里是我要指派给你的第一个任务。卡拉然，一条力量强大的远古黑龙，也加入了搜寻我们所保护的那颗蛋的行动。我们必须在他靠得太近之前阻止他。$b$b你要前往漫尘盆地去找到他和他的爪牙，就在巨龙峡口的东北边。去把他干掉。你很可能需要借助你新结识的矮人伙伴们的帮助。
text.completion: One less dragon to worry about, one step closer to redemption.  Onward, my soldiers!
text.giverWindow: 龙卵还很脆弱，我们必须阻止这只黑龙。
text.turninWindow: 还有一些事情需要处理。

english.title: The Wrath of a Dragonflight
english.objectives: Slay Kalaran the Annihilator and 4 Darkflight Soldiers.
english.description: Hello, $n.  It looks like you four have had time to become well-acquainted.$b$bI have my first assignment for you.  Kalaran, an ancient black dragon of considerable power, has joined in the hunt for the egg we are protecting.  We need to stop him before he gets too close.$b$bYou will find him and his minions at the Dustbowl, northeast of Dragon's Mouth.  Hunt him down and defeat him.  You will likely need the help of your new dwarven allies.
english.completion: One less dragon to worry about, one step closer to redemption.  Onward, my soldiers!
english.giverWindow: We need to strike at the black dragonflight while the egg is still vulnerable.
english.turninWindow: There's still work to be done.

text.title: 永无止尽的搜寻
text.objectives: 击败基拉卡将军、莫达尔以及6只黑龙。
text.description: 黑龙意味着麻烦。巨龙峡口西北方的新卡加斯原本是部落的地盘，如今却被黑龙占据了一大半。基拉卡将军以及他的勇士莫达尔统领着这支黑龙军团。必须阻止它们。$b$b虽然龙族从不介入部落与联盟之间的纷争，但是我充分理解你踏入新卡加斯所要承担的风险。英雄……保重。
text.completion: Two more dangerous black dragons have been removed from this egg hunt.  Your greatest task, however, still awaits.
text.giverWindow: 莫达尔和基拉卡领导着黑龙军团的核心力量。
text.turninWindow: 我们最大的挑战还在后面…

english.title: Their Hunt Continues
english.objectives: Defeat General Jirakka, Moldarr, and 6 Blackflight dragonspawn.
english.description: The black dragonflight means business.  It appears that they've taken over a large portion of New Kargath, the large Horde settlement northwest of Dragon's Mouth.  Their troops are under the command of General Jirakka and his champion, Moldarr.  They must be stopped.$b$bWe dragons do not take part in the squabbles between Horde and Alliance, but I do understand the risk you take in entering New Kargath.  Please, heroes... be careful.
english.completion: Two more dangerous black dragons have been removed from this egg hunt.  Your greatest task, however, still awaits.
english.giverWindow: Moldarr and Jirakka lead the core of the black flight's forces.

text.title: 悲痛与愤怒
text.objectives: 杀死尼希昂卓拉和12条尼希昂卓拉雏龙。
text.description: 我最悔恨的事就是我们——不，是我——对待尼希昂卓拉的方式。我强迫她产卵，然后我用它们来做实验。一遍又一遍，一遍又一遍。$b$b虽然我自己也是母亲，但我仍然无法想象她要承受怎样的悲痛。$b$b不……我不能脆弱。毕竟，我们的工作是为了黑龙一族的未来。她的牺牲是必要的。$b$b她在新卡加斯西北边的卡加斯废墟盘旋，因愤怒而变得疯狂。求求你们，英雄们……让她摆脱痛苦吧。
text.completion: Just think... Nyxondra may end up being the mother of the new black dragonflight.  In death, she has given a gift to the future generations of Azeroth.
text.giverWindow: 尼希昂卓拉，原谅我…

english.title: The Sorrow and the Fury
english.objectives: Slay Nyxondra and 12 of Nyxondra's Broodlings.
english.description: My greatest regret is the treatment that we - no, I - gave to Nyxondra.  I forced her to lay eggs, then I performed experiments on them.  Over, and over, and over again.$b$bEven as a mother myself, I can only imagine her sorrow.$b$bNo... I mustn't be weak.  Our work is, after all, for the benefit of future generations of black dragons.  Her sacrifice was necessary.$b$bShe circles the Ruins of Kargath, northwest of New Kargath, insane with fury.  Please, heroes... put her out of her misery.
english.completion: Just think... Nyxondra may end up being the mother of the new black dragonflight.  In death, she has given a gift to the future generations of Azeroth.
english.giverWindow: Nyxondra, forgive me...

text.title: 隐藏的龙巢
text.objectives: 与荒芜之地隐藏的龙巢的瑞亚交谈。
text.description: 那条大黑龙已经离开了荒芜之地，现在又可以安全地挪动这只蛋了。你可以在一处小高地上找到我，就在新卡加斯的北边。$b$b到那里去找我吧。
text.completion: The egg must always be moving.  We are not safe anywhere. Deathwing, even in his madness, knows all the hidden places in this world.  The egg must not rest.
text.giverWindow: 到北边和我碰头。

english.title: The Hidden Clutch
english.objectives: Speak with Rhea at The Hidden Clutch in the Badlands.
english.description: With the major black dragons out of the Badlands, it is now safe to move the egg again.  You will find me on a small plateau, north of New Kargath.$b$bCome and find me.
english.completion: The egg must always be moving.  We are not safe anywhere. Deathwing, even in his madness, knows all the hidden places in this world.  The egg must not rest.
english.giverWindow: Meet me in the north.

text.title: 顽固的肥佬
text.objectives: 杀死12名火烟食人魔，火烟虐待者或是火烟萨满祭司都可以。
text.description: 我还以为黑龙会来找我们的麻烦呢，但是它们似乎对新卡加斯更感兴趣，因此放过了我们的小营地。话虽如此，我还是派出了强者随时警惕黑龙的动向，不让它们轻易靠近。$b$b眼下还有一个没解决的麻烦，那就是西南方的食人魔营地。有一小撮食人魔开始在营地外围游荡。$b$b我们不可能坐视不管，等着他们发动突袭。趁食人魔有所行动前，削减他们的数量。
text.completion: Thank you, $r.  However, I'm afraid I don't have much to give you, other than this passionate round of applause. Oh, I do have these.  Here, take your pick.
text.completed: Return to Terrance Storm at Dragon's Mouth in the Badlands.

english.title: Half-Ton Holdouts
english.objectives: Slay 12 Dustbelcher Combatants.  You may kill Dustbelcher Maulers or Dustbelcher Shaman.
english.description: I'd say we have a dragon problem, but it seems like they're a little more interested in New Kargath then they are in our small encampment.  Nevertheless, I've got top men focused on keeping the dragons at bay.$b$bOne problem that has gone unchecked, however, is the ogre camp to our southwest.  A small army of combatants seems to have appeared outside of their hovel.$b$bWe can't sit and wait for them to flank us, soldier.  Thin their ranks before they thin ours.
english.completion: Thank you, $r.  However, I'm afraid I don't have much to give you, other than this passionate round of applause. Oh, I do have these.  Here, take your pick.
english.completed: Return to Terrance Storm at Dragon's Mouth in the Badlands.

text.title: 玻璃弓箭手巴尔洛戈
text.objectives: 使用巴尔洛戈的英灵神殿射击和巴尔洛戈的战吼。
text.description: 在我拉弓瞄准黑龙之前，还是介绍一下自己吧。$b$b我叫巴尔洛戈，是这支小队的打手。我的剑刃如同鳄鱼的牙齿一样锋利，我的弓箭如同女妖的歌声一般催命。但是我的体力消耗得很快，可不像我那两位兄弟那么能抗的。$b$b只要你一声令下，我就瞄准敌人的心脏射一箭。我还能鼓舞我的兄弟，让他们进入狂热的激战状态。$b$b要不我们试试一起作战吧？
text.completion: I think you're ready, $n.  You're getting the hang of this.
text.completed: Speak with Baelog in the Badlands.

english.title: Baelog, the Glass Cannon
english.objectives: Use Baelog's Valhalla Shot and Baelog's Warcry.
english.description: Before I start droppin' arrows on those dragons, I'd better introduce myself.$b$bI'm Baelog, the muscle of this group.  My sword bites like a crocolisk, and my arrows sing like banshees.  I tend to wear down quickly, however, and can't take as much punishment as either of my two brothers.$b$bYou give the word, and I'll send an aimed shot right through your target's heart.  I can also cheer my brothers on, sending 'em into a battle-fueled frenzy.$b$bWhy don't we go try fighting together?
english.completion: I think you're ready, $n.  You're getting the hang of this.
english.completed: Speak with Baelog in the Badlands.

objectiveDetails.description: 使用巴尔洛戈的英灵神殿射击

text.title: 大胖子奥拉夫
text.objectives: 使用奥拉夫的盾墙和奥拉夫的无畏咆哮。
text.description: 你可能没注意到，我的体型比普通的矮人大了许多。$b$b我相信，我那两个兄弟是不会遇到太多麻烦的。他们很小，而且没有大盾牌。我很大，完全可以应付好几个敌人！如果我小心一点的话，凭借盾牌就能化解所有的攻击！$b$b我还可以保护你。来吧，让我们练习练习。我会确保敌人都冲着我来的，你会很安全啦。
text.completion: See?  No need to worry when Olaf is around.  Just let me know, and I'll protect you from the monsters.
text.completed: Speak with Olaf in the Badlands.

english.title: Olaf, the Big Fella'
english.objectives: Use Olaf's Shield Wall and Olaf's Mighty Shout.
english.description: You may not have noticed, but I'm pretty big, as far as dwarves go.$b$bI make sure that my two brothers here don't get into too much trouble.  They're small, and they don't have a big shield like me.  I'm big, and I can handle a few monsters hitting me!  Plus, if I'm careful, I can usually get them to hit my shield instead!$b$bI can protect you, too.  Come on, let's go practice for a bit.  I'll make sure the enemies attack me, and not you.
english.completion: See?  No need to worry when Olaf is around.  Just let me know, and I'll protect you from the monsters.
english.completed: Speak with Olaf in the Badlands.

objectiveDetails.description: 使用奥拉夫的无畏咆哮

text.title: 阻止扩散
text.objectives: 摧毁6枚爬蛇卵。
text.description: 杀死在河中肆虐的邪恶生物远远不够，$n。$B$B这些怪物的下一代已经快要在我们的神圣河水中孵化出来了。$B$B去找到它们邪恶的卵，并将其摧毁。
text.completion: I thank you, $n.  This will make our prophetic visions that much clearer.
text.completed: Return to High Priest Amet at the Vir'naal Dam in Uldum.

english.title: Stopping the Spread
english.objectives: Destroy 6 Slitherer Eggs.
english.description: Slaying the foul creatures that plague the river will not be enough, $n.$B$BA new generation of these monstrosities already threatens to spawn within our holy waters.$B$BSeek their foul eggs and destroy them.
english.completion: I thank you, $n.  This will make our prophetic visions that much clearer.
english.completed: Return to High Priest Amet at the Vir'naal Dam in Uldum.

text.title: 水中的入侵者
text.objectives: 杀死8条静水爬蛇。
text.description: 在奥丹姆的保护罩落下不久，维尔纳尔河就被一种可怕的污染所影响了。$B$B不管是蓄意人为还是无心之故，都不重要。$B$B结果都是一样的。河水变得阴暗，我们的预视能力也遭到了蒙蔽，无法看到未来为我们准备了怎样的命运。$B$B看看外面，$c。这些可鄙的生物绝不允许生活在我们清澈的河水中。$B$B杀掉它们，让大河再度将预言赐予我们。
text.completion: Yes, $n.  I can feel the disruption in the river fading. Yet, I feel the source of this taint still lingers.
text.completed: Return to High Priest Amet inside the Vir'naal Dam in Uldum.

english.title: Trespassers in the Water
english.objectives: Slay 8 Stillwater Slitherers.
english.description: Shortly after Uldum's protective barriers fell, the Vir'naal river became afflicted with a terrible corruption.$B$BWhether it was brought here maliciously or accidentally is not of great significance.$B$BThe result is the same.  As the river becomes clouded so does our ability to peer into what the future holds for us.$B$BLook outside, $c.  These foul creatures were never meant to live in the pristine waters of our river.$B$BSlay them so that the river may grant us visions once again.
english.completion: Yes, $n.  I can feel the disruption in the river fading. Yet, I feel the source of this taint still lingers.
english.completed: Return to High Priest Amet inside the Vir'naal Dam in Uldum.

text.title: 堕落的根源
text.objectives: 到维尔纳尔河东北的源头杀掉鳞蛇之母海文娜。
text.description: 你或许治好了问题的标，$n。但我一直在研究这些污秽的畜生，发现这些卵不是它们下的。$B$B是溪水把卵带到了大坝这里，所以我们要到上游去找产下这些卵的家伙。$B$B到东北方去，到河流的主源头去，解决掉堕落的根源。
text.completion: Yes.  The waters are clearing up. I am certain I will be visited by a vision before the High Council meets. Be warned, $r.  My vote will only be swayed by what I see. You might have helped us greatly here today, but if the vision sways me to make a case against war then that is the way my vote will be cast.
text.completed: Return to High Priest Amet inside the Nilos Dam.
text.giverWindow: 没有了鳞蛇之母……就不会有更多卵了。

english.title: The Root of the Corruption
english.objectives: Go to the northeastern source of the Vir'naal River and slay Scalemother Hevna.
english.description: You might have dealt with the symptoms of our problem, $n.  But I've been studying these foul beasts and the eggs are not laid here by them.$B$BThe stream from the current carries their eggs to the dam, but whatever is laying them will be found upstream.$B$BGo northeast, to the river's main source, and deal with the root of the corruption.
english.completion: Yes.  The waters are clearing up. I am certain I will be visited by a vision before the High Council meets. Be warned, $r.  My vote will only be swayed by what I see. You might have helped us greatly here today, but if the vision sways me to make a case against war then that is the way my vote will be cast.
english.completed: Return to High Priest Amet inside the Nilos Dam.
english.giverWindow: No more Scalemother... no more eggs.

text.title: 远古武器
text.objectives: 获得古老的托维尔军备物资。
text.description: 尽管我们还没有正式开战，尼斐塞特却对侵入他们领地的人毫不手软，不是俘虏就是杀掉。$B$B法奥瑞斯国王拒绝做出反应，哪怕他们在我们的土地上，走私从我们祖先的陵墓里偷来的圣物。$B$B我的斥候报告说尼斐塞特计划在南边运送一大批掠来的武器。$B$B我已经指示你招募的劳工协助你。当你找到走私者时，用这个号角召集他们，把武器夺回来。
text.progress: You've returned, $n.  How did the operation go?
text.completion: This is quite timely.  I will distribute these armaments to my best men and to the laborers that you recruited. I've a feeling they'll show as much courage as my best trained captains.
text.completed: Return to High Commander Kamses at the Ramkahen Legion Outpost in Uldum.

english.title: Ancient Weapons
english.objectives: Retrieve the Ancient Tol'vir Armaments
english.description: Though we aren't formally at war yet, the Neferset do not hesitate to imprison or kill all who trespass upon their territories.$B$BKing Phaoris refuses to reciprocate, even when they use our lands to smuggle stolen relics from the tombs of our ancestors.$B$BMy scouts report that the Neferset are about to move a major shipment of looted weapons south of here.$B$BI've instructed the laborers you recruited to assist you.  Call upon them with this horn when you find the smugglers and recover the weapons.
english.progress: You've returned, $n.  How did the operation go?
english.completion: This is quite timely.  I will distribute these armaments to my best men and to the laborers that you recruited. I've a feeling they'll show as much courage as my best trained captains.
english.completed: Return to High Commander Kamses at the Ramkahen Legion Outpost in Uldum.

text.title: 德莱尼水晶
text.objectives: 从农田避难所收集5颗德莱尼水晶。
text.description: 住在农田避难所的失落者乍一看同我们没有区别，但他们是怪物……在我们前往艾泽拉斯旅途中，被残酷的境遇逼疯的怪物。他们一度是我们的弟兄，如今却在东边的农田避难所里，抓走或杀死任何靠近的人。$B$B他们还偷走了对我们而言极为神圣的东西——德莱尼水晶。$B$B我们缺乏武力，无法从他们建造在农田避难所的小屋和营火里夺回被偷走的德莱尼水晶。但如果没有那些水晶……总有一天我们也将迷失方向。
text.progress: 你夺回德莱尼水晶了吗?
text.completion: 谢谢你，$N。我们会铭记你的恩德。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Holaaru at Marshtide Watch in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: Draenethyst Crystals
english.objectives: Collect 5 Draenethyst Crystals from the Fallow Sanctuary.
english.description: The lost ones who live in the Fallow Sanctuary look as we look, but they are monsters... driven mad by the rigors of our journey to Azeroth.  Once our brethren, they now live in the Fallow Sanctuary to the west, catching or killing any who wander near.$B$BAnd they have stolen something sacred to us--draenethyst crystals.$B$BWe lack the force to enter the Fallow Sanctuary and reclaim our stolen draenethyst from among their huts and campfires, but without those crystals... we too may lose our way.
english.progress: Do you have the crystals?
english.completion: Thank you, $n.  We, are in your debt.
english.completed: Return to Holaaru at Marshtide Watch in Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 死者的感激
text.objectives: Acquire some Bread of the Dead and give it to the Cheerful Goblin Spirit in Orgrimmar's graveyard.$B$BUse an Orange Marigold to see the otherwise invisible spirit.
text.description: 真高兴能再次见到朋友和亲人，不过也许我做得有些太夸张了……我已经吃光了他们为我准备的一切！$B$B能不能帮我一个忙，再给我拿来一些那种美味的悼念糕饼？我会非常感激你的……$B$B我想，那边的查普曼正在出售食谱。
text.progress: You don't have any Bread of the Dead, do you?
text.completion: Ah, more delicious Bread of the Dead, thank you! Please, take this in return... a little something fun for the holiday.
text.completed: Return to Cheerful Goblin Spirit in Durotar.

english.title: The Grateful Dead
english.objectives: Acquire some Bread of the Dead and give it to the Cheerful Goblin Spirit in Orgrimmar's graveyard.$B$BUse an Orange Marigold to see the otherwise invisible spirit.
english.description: It's good to visit with friends and family again, though I may have overdone it... I've already eaten everything they made for me!$B$BMight I trouble you for some more of that delicious Bread of the Dead? I'd be most grateful...$B$BChapman there sells the recipe, I think.
english.progress: You don't have any Bread of the Dead, do you?
english.completion: Ah, more delicious Bread of the Dead, thank you! Please, take this in return... a little something fun for the holiday.
english.completed: Return to Cheerful Goblin Spirit in Durotar.

text.title: 只是开始
text.objectives: 杀掉格拉布托克。
text.description: 我怀念那些日子，强大的食人魔集团军陪伴着部落进军战场，可悲的联盟在他们的凶猛面前瑟瑟发抖。也许在我归天之前，那些日子还会回来。$B$B不过，眼下情况不一样。一名食人魔法师格拉布托克加入了卑鄙的迪菲亚兄弟会，当了他们采矿行动的工头。可悲的傻瓜！为我，为了部落的灵魂和荣耀，结束他的生命！
text.completion: Do not be alarmed, $n. I am close to you, waiting in the shadows. You've done well. You must continue the mission here - I am too valuable to risk my life against petty criminals like these.
text.completed: Speak to Kagtha inside the Deadmines.
text.giverWindow: 他可不好对付。
text.turninWindow: 你还没有完成呢，年轻人。

english.title: Only the Beginning
english.objectives: Kill Glubtok.
english.description: I miss the days when legions of powerful ogres marched by the Horde's side into battle, the pathetic Alliance cowering at their ferocity. Perhaps those days will return before I am gone to the ancestors.$B$BHowever, that is not the case now. An ogre magi, Glubtok, has joined forces with the despicable Defias Brotherhood and acts as Foreman over their mining operations. The pathetic fool! End his life for me, and for the spirit and glory of the Horde!
english.completion: Do not be alarmed, $n. I am close to you, waiting in the shadows. You've done well. You must continue the mission here - I am too valuable to risk my life against petty criminals like these.
english.completed: Speak to Kagtha inside the Deadmines.
english.giverWindow: He won't go down easily.

text.title: 援兵遭拒
text.objectives: 杀死3名斯通纳德术士。
text.description: 光是杀掉食人魔是不够的。食人魔被召唤到战场上的速度实在是太快了。$B$B我需要你绕到敌后去，找到他们的召唤者。兽人在利用他们的术士搬来援兵。$B$B干掉术士们，传送门自然就会关闭。他们人数不多，一次迅速精确的打击就能置敌人于死地。
text.completion: Once again, well done. With a few more pushes the battle will be ours.
text.completed: Return to Joanna Blueheart at Marshtide Watch in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: Reinforcements Denied
english.objectives: Slay 3 Stonard Warlocks.
english.description: Just killing ogres won't be enough. The ogres themselves are being summoned onto the battlefield far too rapidly.$B$BI need you to go far behind the enemy line and seek out their summoners. The orcs are using warlocks to bring their reinforcements in.$B$BCut down the warlocks, and the portals should close. There aren't many of them; a quick, surgical strike should cripple the enemy.
english.completion: Once again, well done. With a few more pushes the battle will be ours.
english.completed: Return to Joanna Blueheart at Marshtide Watch in Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 叛徒！！！
text.objectives: 打败赫利克斯·破甲。
text.description: 你发现的那些与迪菲亚同流合污的地精，已经正式被判决为锈水财阀、碎手、以及部落的叛徒！$B$B我还没有被归化到碎手里去，因此我坚贞的忠诚还属于我的人民。赫利克斯·破甲显然没有这样的信念，他还在为迪菲亚主宰舰制造船桅。你是否愿意代表迈赫米小姐和我，去把赫利克斯“处理”掉？
text.completion: My employers do not take kindly to traitors. On the flip side, they are renown for their kindness towards the loyal! You deserve to be rewarded!
text.completed: Return to Slinky Sharpshiv inside the Deadmines.
text.giverWindow: 常常被看见骑着一头凶猛的伐木场巨怪。

english.title: Traitors!!!
english.objectives: Defeat Helix Gearbreaker.
english.description: The goblins you'll find working with the Defias are officially traitors to the Bilgewater Cartel, the Shattered Hand, and the Horde itself!$B$BI haven't yet been initiated into the Shattered Hand, so my loyalties lie strongly with my people. Helix Gearbreaker apparently has no time for such associations, and works on building a mast for the Defias Juggernaut. On behalf of Miss Mayhem and myself, would you kindly 'dispose' of Helix?
english.completion: My employers do not take kindly to traitors. On the flip side, they are renown for their kindness towards the loyal! You deserve to be rewarded!
english.completed: Return to Slinky Sharpshiv inside the Deadmines.
english.giverWindow: Often seen riding a ferocious lumbering oaf.

text.title: 标记阵亡者
text.objectives: 使用败亡之旗标记7名阵亡的沼泽之潮步兵。
text.description: 我们所获得的成果大过我们的牺牲，不过牺牲还是太大了。有太多的勇士为联盟献出了生命。不管战斗有多惨烈，我都要让他们得到厚葬。$B$B把这些旗子带上，你若发现阵亡士兵，就把插在他们身边。保护结界无法让他们完全免除污染，但总比什么都没有要强。我也能从远处有个概念，我们到底损失了多少人。
text.completion: Thank you, $n. Those soldiers deserve better than to be left face down in the mud.
text.completed: Return to Joanna Blueheart at Marshtide Watch in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: Marking the Fallen
english.objectives: Use the Banner of the Fallen to mark 7 Fallen Marshtide Footmen.
english.description: We've taken more than we've lost, but we've still lost too much. Too many brave have given their lives for the Alliance out there.I want to make sure they're given proper honors no matter how fierce this battle gets.$B$BTake these flags out with you and place one on any fallen soldier you see. The protective wards on them won't offer much protection against any defilement, but it's better than nothing. I'll be able to better judge how many we've lost from a distance, as well.
english.completion: Thank you, $n. Those soldiers deserve better than to be left face down in the mud.
english.completed: Return to Joanna Blueheart at Marshtide Watch in Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 死者的感激
text.objectives: Acquire some Bread of the Dead and give it to the Cheerful Worgen Spirit in Darnassus' graveyard.$B$BUse an Orange Marigold to see the otherwise invisible spirit.
text.description: 真高兴能再次见到朋友和亲人，不过也许我做得有些太夸张了……我已经吃光了他们为我准备的一切！$B$B能不能帮我一个忙，再给我拿来一些那种美味的悼念糕饼？我会非常感激你的……$B$B我想，那边的查普曼正在出售食谱。
text.progress: You don't have any Bread of the Dead, do you?
text.completion: Ah, more delicious Bread of the Dead, thank you! Please, take this in return... a little something fun for the holiday.
text.completed: Return to Cheerful Worgen Spirit at Darnassus' graveyard in Teldrassil.

english.title: The Grateful Dead
english.objectives: Acquire some Bread of the Dead and give it to the Cheerful Worgen Spirit in Darnassus' graveyard.$B$BUse an Orange Marigold to see the otherwise invisible spirit.
english.description: It's good to visit with friends and family again, though I may have overdone it... I've already eaten everything they made for me!$B$BMight I trouble you for some more of that delicious Bread of the Dead? I'd be most grateful...$B$BChapman there sells the recipe, I think.
english.progress: You don't have any Bread of the Dead, do you?
english.completion: Ah, more delicious Bread of the Dead, thank you! Please, take this in return... a little something fun for the holiday.
english.completed: Return to Cheerful Worgen Spirit at Darnassus' graveyard in Teldrassil.

text.title: 还没好
text.objectives: 摧毁死神5000。
text.description: 等我完善了原型机，它就会让部落的战斗形式彻底改头换面！一直以来的问题是，它们的能量源不允许做出复杂的战斗机动或是采用大型结构。而同联盟战斗，这两点都是必要的特性。$B$B迪菲亚在诸如赫利克斯这样的地精叛徒协助下，几乎完成了死神5000，一台居然能运转的巨型傀儡！$B$B我们可不能让它公诸于众，对不对？否则我会丧失客户的！
text.completion: Brilliant! Now all I have to do is finish my work, and my Mayhem Reapers will cause...mayhem...on any Horde front! And there won't be any Defias knockoffs to steal my profits!
text.completed: Return to Miss Mayhem inside the Deadmines.
text.giverWindow: 摧毁它！不能让他们偷走我的客户！

english.title: Not Quite There
english.objectives: Destroy the Foe Reaper 5000.
english.description: These prototypes are going to change the face of Horde warfare when I perfect them! The issue I've been having is that their power sources don't allow for complicated combat maneuvers or large frames, both highly desired traits when it comes to fighting Alliance.$B$BThe Defias, with some help from goblin traitors like Helix, have almost completed the Foe Reaper 5000, a massive golem that will actually work!$B$BWe can't have that going public, can we? I'll lose customers!
english.completion: Brilliant! Now all I have to do is finish my work, and my Mayhem Reapers will cause...mayhem...on any Horde front! And there won't be any Defias knockoffs to steal my profits!
english.completed: Return to Miss Mayhem inside the Deadmines.
english.giverWindow: Destroy it!  You can't let them steal my customers!

text.title: 完美的计划……糟糕的执行
text.objectives: 杀死撕心狼将军。
text.description: 迪菲亚计划完成主宰舰，将暴风城夷为平地。任何一个真正的兽人都会毫不犹豫地为这个崇高目的而献身！$B$B梵妮莎的计划执行起来却有致命之处。战舰东拼西凑，船员几乎毫无训练，最重要的是，他们里面还有一个狼人！$B$B他的名字叫做撕心狼将军，以酋长的名义，一定要把他无情地杀掉。Lok'tar ogar！
text.completion: It's a shame that he was both a human and a worgen. Had he been a proud orc warrior I'd have liked to charge into battle alongside such a fierce combatant. We can speak of ill-fated desires another day. It is time to take what is ours from the enemy.
text.completed: Speak to Kagtha inside the Deadmines.
text.giverWindow: 小心前行！
text.turninWindow: 他是个值得尊敬的对手。

english.title: Good Intentions...Poor Execution
english.objectives: Kill Admiral Ripsnarl.
english.description: The Defias plan to finish their Juggernaut and use it to lay waste to Stormwind. It is a noble cause any true orc warrior would embrace without a single thought!$B$BVanessa's fault lies in her execution of their plan. The ship is poorly constructed, the crew practically untrained, and, worst of all, there's a worgen in their midst!$B$BHis name is Admiral Ripsnarl, and he must be mercilessly slain in the name of the Warchief. Lok'tar ogar!
english.completion: It's a shame that he was both a human and a worgen. Had he been a proud orc warrior I'd have liked to charge into battle alongside such a fierce combatant. We can speak of ill-fated desires another day. It is time to take what is ours from the enemy.
english.completed: Speak to Kagtha inside the Deadmines.
english.giverWindow: Approach with caution!

text.title: 攻击斯通纳德
text.objectives: 杀死6名斯通纳德防御者。
text.description: 就是现在，$n。我们要对斯通纳德进行最后一击。$B$B我不应该再提醒大家了，但我还是要说一遍：我们不是兽人，我们不会由于复仇和怨恨而变得像他们一样。我们不会把斯通纳德夷为平地，然后在废墟上欢呼雀跃。$B$B不，我要用正确的方法。我要精准的打击。高昂起你的头，打倒任何一个胆敢捡起武器的兽人。
text.completion: You've followed orders well, $n. On behalf of the crown, I'm rewarding you for your bravery on the battlefield.
text.completed: Return to Joanna Blueheart at Marshtide Watch.

english.title: Assault on Stonard
english.objectives: Slay 6 Stonard Defenders.
english.description: This is it, $n. We've made our final push into Stonard itself.$B$BI shouldn't have to remind anyone, but I'll say it anyway: We're not orcs, and we're not going to become them out of revenge or spite. Stonard will not be burned to the ground for us to dance on the ashes.$B$BNo, I want this done right. I want this surgical. Hold your head high and strike down any orc that picks up a weapon.
english.completion: You've followed orders well, $n. On behalf of the crown, I'm rewarding you for your bravery on the battlefield.
english.completed: Return to Joanna Blueheart at Marshtide Watch.

text.title: 迪菲亚兄弟会首脑
text.objectives: 杀掉迪菲亚兄弟会首脑。
text.description: 碎手氏族已经沉寂了多年。$B$B但这样的岁月就要到头了！$B$B有了你的帮助，碎手很快将浴火重生，$n。为了部落，杀掉迪菲亚兄弟会首脑，缴获她的船！我们会将它改装成一条体面的兽人战舰，用它将暴风城最终夷为平地。$B$B所有幸存者都会把我们不可阻挡的力量在艾泽拉斯口耳相传，在我们的强大面前颤抖！$B$B现在去吧，范克里夫的死亡将是你目前为止最伟大的胜利，英雄。
text.completion: COWARD!!! Vanessa VanCleef is a dirty human coward! How dare she flee from battle against the Horde and leave her unworthy subordinate to fight! No matter. Her ship is reward enough. The citizens of Stormwind will bear first hand witness to our awe inspiring power using a ship made in part by the very architect of their city!
text.completed: Speak to Kagtha inside the Deadmines.
text.giverWindow: 荣耀归于碎手！

english.title: The Defias Kingpin
english.objectives: Kill the Defias Kingpin.
english.description: The Shattered Hand has laid mostly quiet for years now.$B$BNo more!$B$BYou will be the instrument of our rebirth, $n. Slay the Defias Kingpin and commandeer her ship for the Horde! We will outfit it as a proper orc warship and use it to finally lay waste to Stormwind$B$BAny survivors will spread word of our unstoppable power across all of Azeroth, and all will tremble before our might!$B$BGo now, VanCleef's death will be your greatest triumph yet hero.
english.completion: COWARD!!! Vanessa VanCleef is a dirty human coward! How dare she flee from battle against the Horde and leave her unworthy subordinate to fight! No matter. Her ship is reward enough. The citizens of Stormwind will bear first hand witness to our awe inspiring power using a ship made in part by the very architect of their city!
english.completed: Speak to Kagtha inside the Deadmines.
english.giverWindow: Glory to the Shattered Hand!

text.title: 切断补给
text.objectives: 缴获5箱斯通纳德补给。
text.description: 我们也许不会把斯通纳德夷为平地，但我是不想再进去了。$B$B我要你把镇子里能找到的补给都收集起来。没有了食物，不出一天他们就会毫无战力。$B$B镇子里应该到处都是箱子。
text.progress: 情况如何？
text.completion: Good work, $n. With this, it's only a matter of time until the orcs are fleeing for the portal or begging for surrender.
text.completed: Return to Joanna Blueheart at Marshtide Watch in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: Cutting Supply
english.objectives: Seize 5 crates of Stonard Supplies.
english.description: We may not be flattening Stonard into dust, but I don't want to have to go in there a second time.$B$BI want you to gather any supplies you see in the town while you're there. Without food, they won't have any fighters after more than a day.$B$BThere should be crates scattered all over town.
english.progress: What's the situation?
english.completion: Good work, $n. With this, it's only a matter of time until the orcs are fleeing for the portal or begging for surrender.
english.completed: Return to Joanna Blueheart at Marshtide Watch in Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 兽人与人类
text.objectives: 消灭10名沼泽之潮步兵。
text.description: 战争在沼泽里打响，$n。卑鄙的人类在城市北边定居，把军队开到了我们的家门口。$B$B沼泽里没有什么好给他们的。他们来此唯一的目的就是攻打我们，无缘无故。我们不会让他们获得胜利的喜悦！$B$B我们人手不足，每一个健全的兽人都要上战场。去，尽你所能杀掉那些人类。
text.completion: We will fight to the last orc, $n. I hope you'll keep yourself alive long enough to properly destroy these trespassers.
text.completed: Return to Dispatch Commander Ruag at Stonard in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: Orcs and Humans
english.objectives: Slay 10 Marshtide Footmen.
english.description: War rages in the swamp, $n. Vicious humans have settled north of the city and brought an army to our doorstep.$B$BThere is nothing in this swamp for them. Their sole reason for coming here is to attack us, unprovoked. We will not give them the pleasure of victory!$B$BWe are undermanned and I need every able orc to take to the battlefield. Go, and slay as many humans as you can.
english.completion: We will fight to the last orc, $n. I hope you'll keep yourself alive long enough to properly destroy these trespassers.
english.completed: Return to Dispatch Commander Ruag at Stonard in Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 伐木场巨怪
text.objectives: 消灭5名沼泽之潮农夫。
text.description: 联盟人数众多。他们劳师动众，就为了这么一个聚居点。但我们不会放弃！$B$B只要失去了资源，他们的士兵就会占下风。人类的农民在沼泽之潮哨站外的林子里忙于砍伐木材，重建他们摇摇欲坠的防御墙。$B$B夺走他们的木头，以及他们的性命。
text.completion: No true member of the Horde should find pleasure in killing such terrified weaklings... without challenge, victory has no true thrill. But your dirty work has helped stave off the Alliance and protect our homes here. Be proud of your work for the Horde.
text.completed: Return to Dispatch Commander Ruag at Stonard in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: Lumbering Oafs
english.objectives: Slay 5 Marshtide Peasants.
english.description: We are outnumbered by the Alliance. In their fear they send an army to crush a single settlement. But we will not give!$B$BWithout resources, their soldiers will be at a disadvantage. Human peasants busy themselves in the woods outside Marshtide Watch, gathering lumber to rebuild their crumbling walls.$B$BDeny them the wood, and their lives.
english.completion: No true member of the Horde should find pleasure in killing such terrified weaklings... without challenge, victory has no true thrill. But your dirty work has helped stave off the Alliance and protect our homes here. Be proud of your work for the Horde.
english.completed: Return to Dispatch Commander Ruag at Stonard in Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 黑潮
text.objectives: 消灭6名沼泽之潮骑士。
