text.description: 我们损失巨大，$n。巨槌要塞从诅咒之地派了食人魔来援助我们，但他们只能派那么多，而且就在此时，联盟还对他们展开了进攻。$B$B联盟用骑士来对付我们的食人魔，该战略在第二次兽人战争时就成效显著。我们需要最强的战士才能扭转战局！$B$B回到浴血泥潭，$n，打倒那些骑士！
text.completion: You are a true champion, $n, to take the lives of so many on the battlefield. I hope it will be enough to save Stonard.
text.completed: Return to Dispatch Commander Ruag at Stonard in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: Tides of Darkness
english.objectives: Slay 6 Marshtide Knights.
english.description: We have suffered many losses, $n. Dreadmaul Hold has sent ogres from the Blasted Lands as reinforcements, but they can only send so many; the Alliance attacks them as well, even as we speak.$B$BThe Alliance has countered our ogres with mounted knights, a strategy that served them well in the Second War. We will need our strongest warriors to turn the tide of battle!$B$BReturn to the Bloodmire, $n, and bring down those knights!
english.completion: You are a true champion, $n, to take the lives of so many on the battlefield. I hope it will be enough to save Stonard.
english.completed: Return to Dispatch Commander Ruag at Stonard in Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 援兵遭阻
text.objectives: 消灭3名沼泽之潮法师。
text.description: 联盟让他们的法师在要塞后面召唤更多的援军，直接投入战场。必须阻止他们！$B$B他们人数不多，但只需一道传送门就足以扭转战局了。攻击他们的法师，关掉那些传送门！
text.completion: With no link to the outside, the Alliance must rely on what they've brought to the swamp. We shall see if they can handle our home environment.
text.completed: Return to Dispatch Commander Ruag at Stonard in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: Reinforcements Denied
english.objectives: Slay 3 Marshtide Mages.
english.description: The Alliance has brought in their mages to summon more reinforcements directly to the battlefield from beyond their fortress. This must be stopped!$B$BTheir numbers are few, but a single portal can turn the tide of battle. Attack their mages and shut off those portals!
english.completion: With no link to the outside, the Alliance must rely on what they've brought to the swamp. We shall see if they can handle our home environment.
english.completed: Return to Dispatch Commander Ruag at Stonard in Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 标记阵亡者
text.objectives: 使用败亡之旗标记7名阵亡的斯通纳德战士。
text.description: 为了给我们带来胜利，许多战士英勇献身，$n。真正的兽人命该如此。$B$B我看到联盟从阵亡将士的身上搜刮战利品，像仓鼠一般侵占着我们的东西。决不能让他们如此侮辱我们战场上的英雄们。$B$B把这个结界带到浴血泥潭，将它们插在我们阵亡战士的身边。我将会看着，看看到底有多少人倒下了，并缅怀他们荣誉的牺牲。愿万灵庇佑我们施以敬意。
text.completion: You honor both the dead and the living with your courage, $n.
text.completed: Return to Dispatch Commander Ruag at Stonard in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: Marking the Fallen
english.objectives: Use the Banner of the Fallen to mark 7 Fallen Stonard Warriors.
english.description: Many warriors have met death to bring us victory, $n. The fate of a true orc.$B$BI have seen the way the Alliance loots the bodies of our fallen, clutching at our goods like packrats. They will not defile our fallen heroes on this field.$B$BTake these wards with you to the Bloodmire. Place them on the bodies of our fallen warriors. I will be watching, to see how many have fallen, and to honor their sacrifice. Let us hope the spirits give us aid for our respect.
english.completion: You honor both the dead and the living with your courage, $n.
english.completed: Return to Dispatch Commander Ruag at Stonard in Swamp of Sorrows.

objectiveDetails.description: 标记阵亡的斯通纳德战士

text.title: 我们遭到了攻击！
text.objectives: 消灭12名沼泽之潮入侵者。
text.description: 联盟兵临城下了！$B$B你的行动拖住了他们，削弱了他们的兵力，$n，但说到底，我们还是人手不足。这是我们最后的一战。不成功便成仁……$B$B英勇杀敌，$n。眼下他们已经打到城墙里来了。把人类狗赶出斯通纳德，为了部落！
text.completion: The Alliance is driven out! Stonard will be safe, thanks to your ferocity. Lok'tar Ogar!
text.completed: Return to Dispatch Commander Ruag at Stonard in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: We're Under Attack!
english.objectives: Slay 12 Marshtide Invaders.
english.description: The Alliance are at our walls!$B$BYour actions delayed them and weakened their forces, $n, but in the end we are outnumbered. This is our last stand. Victory or death...$B$BFight with honor, $n. They are within the walls as we speak. Drive the human dogs from Stonard, for the Horde!
english.completion: The Alliance is driven out! Stonard will be safe, thanks to your ferocity. Lok'tar Ogar!
english.completed: Return to Dispatch Commander Ruag at Stonard in Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 瑞亚丝塔萨的礼物
text.objectives: 等待瑞亚从隐藏的龙巢中把蛋拿回来。
text.description: 在这里等着。我去把蛋拿回来。
text.completed: Read Rhea's Note within the Hidden Clutch in the Badlands.

english.title: Rheastrasza's Gift
english.objectives: Wait as Rhea retrieves the egg from the Hidden Clutch.
english.description: Wait here.  I will retrieve the egg.
english.completed: Read Rhea's Note within the Hidden Clutch in the Badlands.

text.title: 龙蛋仍在成长
text.objectives: 等待瑞亚从隐藏的龙巢中把蛋拿回来。
text.completion: You were not the only mortal that Rheastrasza confided in.  I too earned the dragon's trust. I have already moved the real purified egg on to a safer location, away from the Badlands.  It will continue to grow, out of Deathwing's sight. The red dragonflight is as benevolent as it is powerful.  It was Rheastrasza's final wish that I give this to you.

english.title: The Egg Lives On
english.objectives: Wait as Rhea retrieves the egg from the Hidden Clutch.
english.completion: You were not the only mortal that Rheastrasza confided in.  I too earned the dragon's trust. I have already moved the real purified egg on to a safer location, away from the Badlands.  It will continue to grow, out of Deathwing's sight. The red dragonflight is as benevolent as it is powerful.  It was Rheastrasza's final wish that I give this to you.

text.title: 失落者
text.objectives: 到农田避难所去消灭12名失落者。
text.description: 多年前，黑暗之门关闭的时候，我们许多来到这片土地的人都被悔恨和恐惧吞噬了。在绝望中，他们诅咒圣光，沉浸在暴力和憎恨中。$B$B这些堕落的灵魂就是如今的失落者，他们比丧尽天良的怪物好不了多少，会攻击任何胆敢靠近的人。一天天过去，他们更为堕落，而当他们相继死去时，就开始从避难所里绑架无辜的人……$B$B那些人已经没救了，$n。必须终结他们的痛苦。你愿意让他们安息吗？
text.completion: It still pains my heart to have asked you to do this, though I know there is no other way. You have saved those of us still holding on from a terrible menace.
text.completed: Return to Holaaru at Marshtide Watch in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: The Lost Ones
english.objectives: Slay 12 Lost Ones in the Fallow Sanctuary.
english.description: When the Dark Portal closed many years ago, regret and fear seized many of us who had come to these lands. In their despair, they cursed the name of the Light, and sank into violence and hatred.$B$BThese fallen souls are now the Lost Ones, little more than mindless monsters, attacking all who approach. They grow more corrupt by the day, and as they die off, they have begun to kidnap from the Harborage..$B$BThey are beyond help, $n. Their suffering must end. Will you put them from their misery?
english.completion: It still pains my heart to have asked you to do this, though I know there is no other way. You have saved those of us still holding on from a terrible menace.
english.completed: Return to Holaaru at Marshtide Watch in Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 杀戮熔炉竞技场：血眼斗士！
text.objectives: 进入杀戮熔炉竞技场，击败胡尔德普！
text.description: 我还在想你什么时候才会出现呢，$n！鲜血竞技场的前任冠军在这里参赛可是大事一桩哩！我们都会发财的，朋友！发大财！$B$B总之，这是一座古老的龙喉竞技场，没花多少工夫改造就可以拿来用了。我派了些人四处吆喝，就有来自艾泽拉斯各个角落的强力党来参赛。是时候赚些大钱啦！$B$B你知道规矩的，$n。等你准备好了就告诉我，让我们拉开这场大戏的帷幕吧！
text.completed: 去找暮光高地杀戮熔炉竞技场的巨魔仆从伍迪。

english.title: The Crucible of Carnage: The Bloodeye Bruiser!
english.objectives: Get in the arena at the Crucible of Carnage and defeat Hurp'derp!
english.description: I was wondering when you'd show up, $n! Having a past champion of the Ring of Blood here will be a huge draw! We're gonna be rich, buddy! RICH!$B$BAnyway, this is some old Dragonmaw fighting pit. Didn't take much modification to tune it up to our uses. I put out a few feelers, and got some heavy hitters from all around Azeroth to join in the carnage. Bout time to make some gold!$B$BYou know the drill, $n. When you're ready, let me know and we'll get this show on the road!
english.completed: Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant at the Crucible of Carnage in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 杀戮熔炉竞技场：血眼斗士！
text.objectives: 进入杀戮熔炉竞技场，击败胡尔德普！
text.description: 哎哟，这不是痛苦斗兽场的前任冠军，$n嘛！有你在这里，我很快就能大赚一笔啦！我们要在钱堆里打滚啦，伙计！富得流油！$B$B总之，这是一座古老的龙喉竞技场，没花多少工夫改造就可以拿来用了。我派了些人四处吆喝，就有来自艾泽拉斯各个角落的强力党来参赛。是时候赚些大钱啦！$B$B你知道规矩的，$n。等你准备好了就告诉我，让我们拉开这场大戏的帷幕吧！
text.completed: 去找暮光高地杀戮熔炉竞技场的巨魔仆从伍迪。

english.title: The Crucible of Carnage: The Bloodeye Bruiser!
english.objectives: Get in the arena at the Crucible of Carnage and defeat Hurp'derp!
english.description: Well well, if it isn't the once champion of anguish, $n! I'm seeing good money in the future now that you're here! We're gonna be rollin in the dough, buddy! Filthy RICH!$B$BAnyway, this is some old Dragonmaw fighting pit. Didn't take much modification to tune it up to our uses. I put out a few feelers, and got some heavy hitters from all around Azeroth to join in the carnage. Bout time to make some gold!$B$BYou know the drill, $n. When you're ready, let me know and we'll get this show on the road!
english.completed: Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant at the Crucible of Carnage in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 杀戮熔炉竞技场：血眼斗士！
text.objectives: 进入杀戮熔炉竞技场，击败胡尔德普！
text.description: 我跟你说，伙计，这地方离碧野千里的纳格兰的大草原和血腥残酷的祖达克很远，但是呢，哪里有金币，哪里就有我！那么，欢迎来到暮高，朋友。$B$B你是刚来这座竞技场的，我就跟你简单明了地说吧。我是这里的竞技场组织者，旁边这位活泼的巨魔是我的保镖伍迪。你是这里的主角，当你想要作战的时候，告诉我一声，我就给你安排比赛。$B$B如果你已经准备就绪，还带来了一组伙伴，我们就可以开始了！你觉得呢？
text.completion: Not bad, friend. You might make some gold out here - if you manage to stay alive.
text.completed: 去找暮光高地杀戮熔炉竞技场的巨魔仆从伍迪。
text.giverWindow: 血眼氏族对击溃对手颇有心得。

english.title: The Crucible of Carnage: The Bloodeye Bruiser!
english.objectives: Get in the arena at the Crucible of Carnage and defeat Hurp'derp!
english.description: I'll tell you what, buddy, this place is a far cry from the rolling plains of Nagrand or the bloodbowl in Zul'Drak, but hey, I go where the gold's at! So welcome to Twi-Hi, pal.$B$BYou're new to this pit, so let me set you straight. I'm the fight promoter and this feisty troll next to me is Wodin, my bodyguard. You're the entertainment. When you wanna fight, let me know and I'll set up the match.$B$BIf you're ready and got a group of friends with you, we can start! What do you say?
english.completion: Not bad, friend. You might make some gold out here - if you manage to stay alive.
english.completed: Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant at the Crucible of Carnage in the Twilight Highlands.
english.giverWindow: The Bloodeye Clan's contribution to combatant crushing.

text.title: 杀戮熔炉竞技场：致命的龙喉！
text.objectives: 进入杀戮熔炉竞技场，击败托格·掠龙者！
text.description: 你肯定会喜欢这一场的！龙喉兽人听说你要进入竞技场参赛，他们决定要确保你无法活着离开。$B$B是时候来一场精彩的$r对兽人的大战了！等你准备好了就告诉我！
text.completion: No love in your heart for orcs I see. You really made a mess of that guy.
text.completed: 去找暮光高地杀戮熔炉竞技场的巨魔仆从伍迪。
text.giverWindow: 击溃一条黑龙的意志是成为龙喉勇士的第一步。这样的勇士是不会独自进入竞技场的。
text.turninWindow: 没有一种爱像巨魔的爱。

english.title: The Crucible of Carnage: The Deadly Dragonmaw!
english.objectives: Get in the arena at the Crucible of Carnage and defeat Torg Drakeflayer!
english.description: You're going to love this one! The Dragonmaw heard you were entering the arena and they're determined to make sure you don't leave it.$B$BTime for some good ol' $r on orc action! Let me know when you're ready to do this!
english.completion: No love in your heart for orcs I see. You really made a mess of that guy.
english.completed: Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant at the Crucible of Carnage in the Twilight Highlands.
english.giverWindow: Breaking the will of a black dragon is the first step towards becoming a Dragonmaw champion. This champion will not be entering the arena alone.
english.turninWindow: Ain't no lovin' like troll lovin'.

text.title: 杀戮熔炉竞技场：固执的蛮锤！
text.objectives: 进入杀戮熔炉竞技场，击败萨利·碎膝！
text.description: 你肯定会喜欢这一场的！蛮锤矮人听说你要进入竞技场参赛，他们决定要确保你无法活着离开。$B$B是时候来一场精彩的$r对矮人的大战了！等你准备好了就告诉我！
text.completion: No love in your heart for dwarves I see. You really made a mess of that guy.
text.completed: 去找暮光高地杀戮熔炉竞技场的巨魔仆从伍迪。
text.giverWindow: 小心你的脚趾。
text.turninWindow: 没有一种爱像巨魔的爱。

english.title: The Crucible of Carnage: The Wayward Wildhammer!
english.objectives: Get in the arena at the Crucible of Carnage and defeat Sully Kneecapper!
english.description: You're going to love this one! The Wildhammer heard you were entering the arena and they're determined to make sure you don't leave it.$B$BTime for some good ol' $r on dwarf action! Let me know when you're ready to do this!
english.completion: No love in your heart for dwarves I see. You really made a mess of that guy.
english.completed: Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant at the Crucible of Carnage in the Twilight Highlands.
english.giverWindow: Mind your toes.
english.turninWindow: Ain't no lovin' like troll lovin'.

text.title: 杀戮熔炉竞技场：卡尔德的造物！
text.objectives: 进入杀戮熔炉竞技场，击败拼装巨人！
text.description: 残酷而血腥，下一场比赛肯定会令观众感到血脉喷张。卡尔德·格雷整合了失败的挑战者的所有能力，制造了这个完美的勇士。$B$B这个拼装巨人是一部顶尖的作战机器。你做好恶战一场的准备了吗？！我已经准备好了！只需跟我说一声，就可以开始比赛了！
text.completion: Wow! When I saw that... thing stumble into the arena, I thought you didn't stand a chance. But you proved me wrong. You tore it apart! Grizzly business.
text.completed: 去找暮光高地杀戮熔炉竞技场的巨魔仆从伍迪。
text.giverWindow: 由之前在竞技场中战斗过的斗士的躯体，拼接而成的怪物。

english.title: The Crucible of Carnage: Calder's Creation!
english.objectives: Get in the arena at the Crucible of Carnage and defeat the Cadaver Collage!
english.description: Grim and gory, this next match is sure to have the crowd groanin' one way or another. Calder Gray has been gathering the bodyparts of defeated challengers and building the perfect champion.$B$BThis thing is the ultimate cobbled collaboration of corpsified combatants. A magnificent mashup of mangled monstrosities. Are you ready to get messy?! Cause I am! Let me know when you're ready so we can get this thing started!
english.completion: Wow! When I saw that... thing stumble into the arena, I thought you didn't stand a chance. But you proved me wrong. You tore it apart! Grizzly business.
english.completed: Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant at the Crucible of Carnage in the Twilight Highlands.
english.giverWindow: The gruesome assimilation of the crucible's previous combatants.
english.turninWindow: Wodin knows just how you like it.

text.title: 杀戮熔炉竞技场：剔骨男爵！
text.objectives: 进入杀戮熔炉竞技场，击败吉奥弗雷·塔尔文领主！
text.description: 这一场绝对会让你打得灰头土脸，朋友。接下来出场的是一位久经沙场的优雅战士！他从吉尔尼斯赶来，要证明自己是艾泽拉斯最强大的战士。$B$B你最好绑紧鞋带，扎紧裤腰，因为战斗会非常激烈。等你准备好挨揍的时候就知我一声。
text.completion: You really pulled that one out. I thought you were done for sure when he wolfed and started tearing up the arena. I guess I should know by now that you don't go down easy.
text.end: 击败吉奥弗雷·塔尔文领主
text.completed: 去找暮光高地杀戮熔炉竞技场的巨魔仆从伍迪。
text.giverWindow: 支配杀戮熔炉竞技场的勇士，吉奥弗雷·塔尔文领主至今未尝一败。
text.turninWindow: 四年来从没有换过衣服。

english.title: The Crucible of Carnage: The Earl of Evisceration!
english.objectives: Get in the arena at the Crucible of Carnage and defeat Lord Geoffery Tulvan!
english.description: You're going to have your hands full with this one, pal. We've got a seasoned gentleman warrior here! He hails from Gilneas, and he's out to prove that he's the best warrior this side of Azeroth.$B$BYou better pull up those boots and zip up those pants, because it's going to get downright feral up in here. Give me the word when you're down for some punishment.
english.completion: You really pulled that one out. I thought you were done for sure when he wolfed and started tearing up the arena. I guess I should know by now that you don't go down easy.
english.completed: Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant at the Crucible of Carnage in the Twilight Highlands.
english.giverWindow: The reigning champion of the Crucible of Carnage, Lord Geoffery Tulvan is undefeated in the arena.
english.turninWindow: Four years running, and still no change of clothes.

text.title: 杀戮熔炉竞技场：暮光的恐惧！
text.objectives: 进入杀戮熔炉竞技场，击败吞噬者余烬之痕！
text.description: 接下来出场的是一位足以令你恨到牙根痒痒的选手。起初我不太确定是否要让他上场，不过比赛就是比赛！我又怎么能拒绝唾手可得的钱呢？！$B$B这个家伙从暮光堡垒赶来，可谓蛮力十足。你最好身手快一点，注意身后！等你准备好了就告诉我。
text.completion: Looks like this title is yours! You really pulled that one out of the fire. Congratulations. I hope the coin serves you well.
text.completed: 去找暮光高地杀戮熔炉竞技场的巨魔仆从伍迪。
text.giverWindow: 孤注一掷吧。如果余烬之痕没有死在场中，整个竞技场都会被他的怒火烧尽。

english.title: The Crucible of Carnage: The Twilight Terror!
english.objectives: Get in the arena at the Crucible of Carnage and defeat Emberscar the Devourer!
english.description: We've got someone you'll really love to hate this time around. I wasn't sure at first if I should let him into the pit, but a fight's a fight! And who am I to turn down some guaranteed cash?!$B$BThis guy hails from the Twilight Citadel itself, and comes toting a toasty punch. Better move fast and watch your back! Just give me the word when you're ready for some action.
english.completion: Looks like this title is yours! You really pulled that one out of the fire. Congratulations. I hope the coin serves you well.
english.completed: Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant at the Crucible of Carnage in the Twilight Highlands.
english.giverWindow: All bets are off.  If Emberscar is not stopped in the pit, the entire arena shall surely be consumed in the flames of his furor.

text.title: 龙与神庙
text.objectives: 跟阿塔哈卡神庙外部台阶顶部的伊萨里奥斯勋爵谈一谈。
text.description: 这些风蛇一定是从阿塔哈卡神庙来的。我已经有头绪了……$B$B几天前，曾经有人来拜访过我，让我注意类似的事情。他是个名叫伊萨里奥斯的精灵。我想他一定没料到我能看透他的真身……他是一条伪装起来的绿龙，毫无疑问，他是来这里帮助他沦落的兄弟们。$B$B他显然也知道了什么。伊萨里奥斯已经去神庙那儿了，也许你最好跟上他。黑暗的势力正在活动。
text.completion: The goblin sent you? She has a cunning eye, that one. She speaks the truth. I am here to stem the tide of corruption seeping from this temple. If you would save your people from a wicked fate, $n, I ask for your assistance.

english.title: The Dragon and the Temple
english.objectives: Speak with Lord Itharius atop the outer steps of the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.
english.description: These serpents must be from the Temple of Atal'Hakkar. I already had a hint...$B$BNot a few days ago, I had a visitor stop by and ask me to keep an eye out for such things. An elf by the name of Itharius. I'm sure he didn't think I could see through his form... he was a green dragon in disguise, come here to help his fallen brothers no doubt.$B$BHe may very well be on to something. Itharius left for the temple itself. Perhaps you'd better go look for him there. Dark things are afoot.
english.completion: The goblin sent you? She has a cunning eye, that one. She speaks the truth. I am here to stem the tide of corruption seeping from this temple. If you would save your people from a wicked fate, $n, I ask for your assistance.

text.title: 到沼泽之潮哨站去
text.objectives: 跟沼泽之潮哨站的琼娜·布鲁哈特谈一谈。
text.description: 不管你是否在神殿里帮我，你的人都要知道这里发生了什么事。$B$B在神殿的北边，你们联盟的人类建立了凡人所称为沼泽之潮哨站的地方。和部落的战争蔓延在沼泽里，就我所能预知，这场浩大争端的走向只能更为糟糕。$B$B干预你们凡人的事务并非我的职责，$n。我只是要求你警告你们的人，告诉他们神殿里究竟潜藏着什么。
text.completion: Trouble within the temple... I wish we could spare forces to deal with it. The war with Stonard is already raging, and we need every man we can get.

english.title: To Marshtide Watch
english.objectives: Speak with Joanna Blueheart at Marshtide Watch.
english.description: Regardless of whether you assist me within the temple, your people must be told of what is brewing here.$B$BNorth of the temple, humans of your mortal Alliance have built what they call Marshtide Watch. They war with the Horde across the swamp, a raging conflict that I forsee only worsening.$B$BIt is not my role to interfere in mortal affairs, $n. I simply ask you bring warning to your people of what lurks within the temple.
english.completion: Trouble within the temple... I wish we could spare forces to deal with it. The war with Stonard is already raging, and we need every man we can get.

text.title: 去斯通纳德
text.objectives: 跟悲伤沼泽斯通纳德的分队指挥官鲁尔格谈一谈。
text.description: 不管你是否在神殿里帮我的忙，你们的人都要知道这里发生了什么事。$B$B部落的镇子斯通纳德就坐落在神殿的西南方。兽人们正在沼泽里和新到来的人类展开战争，就我所能预知的情况，这场浩大争端的走向只能更为糟糕。$B$B干预你们凡人事务并非我的职责，$n。我只是要求你警告你们的人，告诉他们神殿里究竟潜藏着什么。
text.completion: We have no time to send orcs to the temple, $n. The humans come, and they are many. Stonard must be defended!

english.title: To Stonard
english.objectives: Speak with Dispatch Commander Ruag at Stonard in Swamp of Sorrows.
english.description: Regardless of whether you assist me within the temple, your people must be told of what is brewing here.$B$BSouthwest of the temple is the Horde town of Stonard. The orcs there wage war with the new human arrivals to the swamp, a raging conflict that I forsee only worsening.$B$BIt is not my role to interfere in mortal affairs, $n. I simply ask you bring warning to your people of what lurks within the temple.
english.completion: We have no time to send orcs to the temple, $n. The humans come, and they are many. Stonard must be defended!

text.title: 艾维娜的遗产
text.objectives: 去找海加尔山艾维娜圣殿的楚伦娜。
text.description: 其它地方也需要你的能力，$n。$B$B就在世界之树西南方，你可以找到艾维娜圣殿，猛禽德鲁伊的家。艾维娜乃是所有飞行生物的守护神，一万年前为了这个世界献出了自己的生命。$B$B我感应到她的圣殿受到了威胁，那些保卫她的德鲁伊也在劫难逃。去找楚伦娜，她是那些飞行德鲁伊中最聪明的一个，就在圣殿深处。
text.completion: Ysera herself sent you to me? Oh! It's a honor to speak with a representative of the aspects. It's true that our shrine is in jeopardy. The harpies we once sheltered in our boughs have suddenly turned against us. But please, don't rejoin the fight until you are ready. Our shrine is no mere battleground. Use its peace and power to center yourself.
text.completed: 去找海加尔山艾维娜圣殿的楚伦娜。

english.title: Aviana's Legacy
english.objectives: Locate Choluna at the Shrine of Aviana in Mount Hyjal.
english.description: Your expertise is needed elsewhere, $n.$B$BJust southwest of the World Tree you will find the Shrine of Aviana, home to the Druids of the Talon. Aviana, the matron of all winged creatures, gave her life for this world ten thousand years ago.$B$BI sense her shrine is being threatened, as are the druids who guard it. Seek out Choluna, one of the wisest of the winged druids, deep within the shrine.
english.completion: Ysera herself sent you to me? Oh! It's a honor to speak with a representative of the aspects. It's true that our shrine is in jeopardy. The harpies we once sheltered in our boughs have suddenly turned against us. But please, don't rejoin the fight until you are ready. Our shrine is no mere battleground. Use its peace and power to center yourself.
english.completed: Locate Choluna at the Shrine of Aviana in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: 祝祷之花
text.objectives: 从流沙泥潭收集10株祝祷之花。
text.description: 我已经对破碎者的苦难进行了多年的研究。使他们堕落的污秽能量不仅仅扭曲了他们的躯体，也夺走了圣光的慰藉。他们无法感受到其温暖。$B$B我不能让玛格图尔沦入黑暗，$n。在他恶化之前，我就在研究祝祷之花，那是一种生长在流沙泥潭里的花朵。哪怕是在最黑暗的阴影下，它也坚韧不拔。我请求你，为我，也为了玛格图尔，将这些花朵收集来。
text.progress: Have you brought the prayerblossom?
text.completion: Prayerblossom has been used by the Broken as a remedy since they settled in this swamp. If it soothes the physical form, it might be used for more powerful healing...
text.completed: Return to Anchorite Avuun at the Harborage in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: Prayerblossom
english.objectives: Collect 10 sprigs of Prayerblossom from the Shifting Mire.
english.description: I have worked for years to try to cure the affliction of the Broken. The foul energies that corrupted them did  more than twist their bodies; it took the comfort of the Light from them. They cannot feel its warmth.$B$BI cannot let Magtoor pass on in darkness, $n. Before he worsened, I was studying prayerblossom, a flower that grows in the shifting mire. It grows hardy in even the darkest shade. I beg of you, gather these flowers for me, for Magtoor's sake.
english.progress: Have you brought the prayerblossom?
english.completion: Prayerblossom has been used by the Broken as a remedy since they settled in this swamp. If it soothes the physical form, it might be used for more powerful healing...
english.completed: Return to Anchorite Avuun at the Harborage in Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 泥潭的秘密
text.objectives: 从移动的潭泥身上收集10份充满活力的淤泥样本。
text.description: 流沙泥潭因其所表现出的一种独特现象而得名。在某种力量的作用下，极其细小的淤泥会聚在一起，自己移动，仿佛活着一般。$B$B我本担心这可能是某种腐化之力，但研究结果却恰恰相反。无论是什么力量让土壤变得如此有活力，它都是天性正面的。也许如此充沛的生命力可以注入到破碎者中，使他们恢复以前的样子。$B$B那些淤泥也许不是很好收集，$n。但拜托你，采集一些来。
text.progress: Did you get those samples?
text.completion: It will have to be purified, but this will be most helpful. Thank you.
text.completed: Return to Anchorite Avuun at The Harborage in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: Secrets of the Mire
english.objectives: Collect 10 samples of Invigorated Silt from Shifting Mireglobs.
english.description: The Shifting Mire takes its name from a unique phenomenon. By some force, the extremely fine silt will collect, and move on its own accord, travelling as if alive.$B$BI originally worried this was some corruptive force, but my studies have shown the opposite; whatever energy invigorates this soil is positive in nature. Perhaps such vibrant life can be imparted onto the Broken to reawaken what they once were.$B$BThe silt may not take kindly to being collected, $n. But please, help gather it.
english.progress: Did you get those samples?
english.completion: It will have to be purified, but this will be most helpful. Thank you.
english.completed: Return to Anchorite Avuun at The Harborage in Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 低能者协会
text.objectives: 取回15顶黑铁的罩帽。
text.description: 我需要你的帮助，$n。我正在研究的领域属于“防御考古学”。$B$B我决定在显眼的地方埋下一些非魔法的物体，让联盟的白痴们误以为自己找到了什么宝贝。$B$B嗯……北面的铁趾挖掘场和苦痛堡垒有很多黑铁矮人。将他们的罩帽带回来给我。没错，罩帽。$B$B只要将其做旧，就可以拿来糊弄矮人了。
text.progress: <Lidia waits expectantly.>
text.completion: Excellent!  We'll bury these immediately.  Those Explorers' League dimwits will never suspect us!
text.completed: Return to Lidia Sunglow at Bloodwatcher Point in the Badlands.

english.title: The Morons' League
english.objectives: Obtain 15 Dark Iron Heads.
english.description: I need your help in a little project I'm working on, $n.  It falls into a realm I like to call "defensive archaeology".$b$bI like to bury non-magical items in conspicuous places to fool those Alliance idiots into thinking they've found something valuable.$b$bHmm... Dark Iron dwarves wander Hammertoe's Digsite and Angor Fortress, to the north.  Bring their heads back to me.  Yes, that's right, their heads.$b$bOnce the flesh is stripped, we can use those skulls to interfere with the dwarves' work.
english.progress: <Lidia waits expectantly.>
english.completion: Excellent!  We'll bury these immediately.  Those Explorers' League dimwits will never suspect us!
english.completed: Return to Lidia Sunglow at Bloodwatcher Point in the Badlands.

text.title: 强取豪夺
text.objectives: 在苦痛堡垒的底楼搜寻财宝。
text.description: 如果你有兴趣的话，我倒有个小小的提议。$B$B在我们抵达前，黑铁矮人就来到了这里。就是说，他们是第一批开进泰坦遗址的家伙，也不知道掠走了多少好东西。我敢打赌，黑铁矮人将这些财宝藏在了西北方的苦痛堡垒。$B$B我要你找到财宝的下落……然后偷走它。
text.progress: 这么快就回来了？
text.completion: I knew it!  The High Examiner will be pleased to see this. Nice work, $r.
text.completed: Return to Aoren Sunglow at Bloodwatcher Point in the Badlands.

english.title: Forcible Acquisition
english.objectives: Search for treasure in the bottom floor of Angor Fortress.
english.description: I've got a little proposition for you, if you're interested.$b$bThe Dark Iron dwarves were here long before we arrived.  That means that, once these titan ruins opened up, the Dark Irons were the first ones in there, looting all the choice items.  I'll bet they've still got those treasures locked up inside Angor Fortress, northwest of here.$b$bI want you to find such a treasure... then steal it.
english.progress: Back so soon?
english.completion: I knew it!  The High Examiner will be pleased to see this. Nice work, $r.
english.completed: Return to Aoren Sunglow at Bloodwatcher Point in the Badlands.

text.title: 劫胖济贫
text.objectives: 收集6块火烟之肉和10张火烟丝绸。
text.description: 我们非常缺乏补给品，陌生人。黑龙在我们的狩猎场肆虐横行，根本就没办法补充食物储备啊。$b$b不过，我们南方的食人魔却有我们急需的东西。你可以在他们的洞穴里找到大量的肉和手工制品。$b$b他们也许会反抗你。别掉以轻心。
text.progress: Welcome back.
text.completion: I imagine those ogres weren't too much trouble for you.  Here - some coin for your troubles.
text.completed: Return to Aidan Summerwind at New Kargath in the Badlands.

english.title: Survival of the Fattest
english.objectives: Obtain 6 pieces of Dustbelcher Meat and 10 sheets of Dustbelcher Silk.
english.description: We're hard-up for supplies, stranger.  With the black dragons raining destruction on our hunting grounds, we have no way to get food.$b$bThe ogres to our south, however, have exactly what we need.  Within their grotto you should find plenty of meat and crafting supplies.$b$bThey may put up a fight.  Be on your guard.
english.progress: Welcome back.
english.completion: I imagine those ogres weren't too much trouble for you.  Here - some coin for your troubles.
english.completed: Return to Aidan Summerwind at New Kargath in the Badlands.

text.title: 顽固的肥佬
text.objectives: 杀死12名火烟食人魔，火烟虐待者或是火烟萨满祭司都成。
text.description: 黑龙的麻烦已经得以控制。我可不容许你这样傲慢的$c破坏我们的作战计划。$B$B你想干活是吧？那好吧，我给你派个活儿。调查西南方的食人魔营地。我听说，有一小撮食人魔开始在营地外围游荡。$B$B我们不可能坐视不管，等着他们发动突袭……黑龙已经够麻烦的了。趁食人魔打过来之前，削减他们的数量。
text.completion: You've got the hint of a hero in you, $r. Now get out of my battlefield.
text.completed: Return to Gorn at New Kargath in the Badlands.

english.title: Half-Ton Holdouts
english.objectives: Slay 12 Dustbelcher Combatants.  You may kill Dustbelcher Maulers or Dustbelcher Shaman.
english.description: My grunts have got this dragon problem under control.  Besides, I can't have an upstart $c like you barging in and ruining our battle plans.$b$bYou want work?  Fine, I'll give you work.  Investigate the ogre camp to our southwest.  From what I've heard, a small army of combatants seems to have appeared outside of their hovel.$b$bWe can't sit and wait for them to flank us, soldier... especially while we're already embroiled with black dragons.  Thin their ranks before they thin ours.
english.completion: You've got the hint of a hero in you, $r. Now get out of my battlefield.
english.completed: Return to Gorn at New Kargath in the Badlands.

text.title: 血望者营地
text.objectives: 跟荒芜之地血望者营地的高阶考察者泰瑟兰·血望者谈一谈。
text.description: 我有个想法，稍微有点不切实际。不过我骨子里就喜欢挑战。$b$b神圣遗物学会在北面的沙地下发现了一处泰坦遗址。说到比龙类更古老更聪明的种族，那就是泰坦了。我甚至听说是泰坦创造了龙呢。$b$b前往西北方的营地，跟高阶考察者泰瑟兰·血望者谈一谈。他对泰坦的了解比我多。$b$b我说什么来着？这事儿是有点不切实际啦。
text.completion: Titans?  You come to me, asking about titans? You've come to the right place, as we're on the brink of discovering something big.  You will, however, need to earn your keep first.
text.completed: 向荒芜之地血望者营地的高阶考察者泰瑟兰·血望者报到。

english.title: Bloodwatcher Point
english.objectives: Speak with High Examiner Tae'thelan Bloodwatcher at Bloodwatcher Point in the Badlands.
english.description: I've got an idea, but it's a bit of a long shot.  Thankfully, long shots happen to be a specialty of mine.$b$bNorth of here, the Reliquary has uncovered a new set of titan ruins beneath the sands.  If there's anything older and wiser than dragons, it's titans.  Heck, I've heard rumors that the titans CREATED the dragons.$b$bTalk to High Examiner Tae'thelan Bloodwatcher at their camp to the northeast.  He'll have more information than I do about these titans.$b$bWhat did I tell you?  It's a long shot.
english.completion: Titans?  You come to me, asking about titans? You've come to the right place, as we're on the brink of discovering something big.  You will, however, need to earn your keep first.
english.completed: Report to High Examiner Tae'thelan Bloodwatcher at Bloodwatcher Point in the Badlands.

enders.name: 高阶考察者泰瑟兰·血望者

text.title: 无关历史，能量而已
text.objectives: 取回破损的圣杯、满是尘土的花瓶、土灵符文碑刻和穴居人工具。
text.description: 探险者协会的确拥有丰富的挖掘经验。但是他们缺乏利用出土古器的意识。这帮蠢货将无价的宝物堆放在博物馆里，却对它们蕴含的能量视而不见。$B$B矮人都是白痴啊。幸运的是，要杀掉他们也很容易。$B$B你可以在北面的峡谷中发现正在干活的矮人。从这群废物的手中夺得宝物，将它们带回来给我。
text.progress: You've returned with liberated artifacts, I presume?
text.completion: Chalice... worthless. Vase... counterfeit. Hieroglyph... interesting, but rather common. What's this?  I've never seen trogg craftsmanship of this caliber!  You've stumbled upon something rare indeed, $n. We must not be so hasty as to overlook the troggs.  They may be simple, but they know things about the deep, hidden places of this world. You've performed well enough.  Let's talk titans, shall we?
text.completed: Return to High Examiner Tae'thelan Bloodwatcher at Bloodwatcher Point in the Badlands.

english.title: It's Not About History, It's About Power
english.objectives: Obtain a Broken Chalice, a Dusty Vase, an Earthen Hieroglyph, and a Trogg Tool.
english.description: The Explorers' League may have a yeoman's knowledge of the actual act of digging.  What they lack, however, is the good sense to USE the artifacts that they dig up.  They stow their treasures in stagnant museums instead of using these items of power for their true purpose.$b$bThe dwarves are fools.  Fortunately, they die easily.$b$bYou'll find them digging into canyon walls north of here.  Take whatever you can out of their stubby-fingered hands, then return it to me.
english.progress: You've returned with liberated artifacts, I presume?
english.completion: Chalice... worthless. Vase... counterfeit. Hieroglyph... interesting, but rather common. What's this?  I've never seen trogg craftsmanship of this caliber!  You've stumbled upon something rare indeed, $n. We must not be so hasty as to overlook the troggs.  They may be simple, but they know things about the deep, hidden places of this world. You've performed well enough.  Let's talk titans, shall we?
english.completed: Return to High Examiner Tae'thelan Bloodwatcher at Bloodwatcher Point in the Badlands.

starters.name: 高阶考察者泰瑟兰·血望者

enders.name: 高阶考察者泰瑟兰·血望者

text.title: 戒卫的棋卒
text.objectives: 在荒芜之地的观察者的陵墓中，找到戒卫的棋卒的用途。
text.description: 我们从这片废墟中找到的几件有价值的东西中，有这样一尊翡翠小雕像。$b$b我们觉得它可能是某种钥匙，不过我们找不到用它来打开的东西。所以，这东西对我来说毫无价值。$B$B也许你的运气会比我们更好点。
text.completion: <The statue clicks into place on the large stone slab.>

english.title: The Warden's Pawn
english.objectives: Find a use for the Warden's Pawn within the Tomb of the Watchers in the Badlands.
english.description: One of the few items of worth that we managed to loot from these ruins is this small jade statue.$b$bWe believe it to be a key of some sort, but we're unable to determine what it opens.  As such, it is useless to me.$b$bPerhaps you'll have some better luck with it.
english.completion: <The statue clicks into place on the large stone slab.>

starters.name: 高阶考察者泰瑟兰·血望者

text.title: 哨兵的棋卒
text.objectives: 在荒芜之地的观察者的陵墓中，找到哨兵的棋卒的用途。
text.description: 我们在一名探险者协会的考古学家的尸体上找到了这尊红色的雕像。可悲的是，并不是我们杀掉他的。当地的野生动物已经把事情办妥了。$B$B这尊雕像做工精良，不过显然不具备什么魔法能量。你可以把它拿去，随便你怎么用它。
text.completion: <The statue slides into place on the cold marble slab.>

english.title: The Sentinel's Pawn
english.objectives: Find a use for the Sentinel's Pawn within the Tomb of the Watchers in the Badlands.
english.description: We found this small red statue on the corpse of one of those Explorers' League archaeologists.  Sadly, it wasn't us who killed him.  The local wildlife had already taken care of that.$b$bThe statue is well-crafted, but apparently bereft of magical power.  You may use it for whatever means you deem necessary.
english.completion: <The statue slides into place on the cold marble slab.>

starters.name: 高阶考察者泰瑟兰·血望者

text.title: 戒卫的游戏
text.objectives: 将戒卫的棋卒传送到面向里边的位置，以完成戒卫的游戏。
text.description: 你看到这尊雕像分裂成了两座，然后是四座，然后是八座一模一样的雕像，以方阵排列。$b$b你听到了一个声音，不是从你的耳朵传进来的，而是直接传入你的心灵：$b$b   “真正的戒卫不会面向外界，寻求危机的迹象。$b  真正的戒卫总是检视自己，专注于保护他的内心。”$b$b也许这是一道谜题？

english.title: The Warden's Game
english.objectives: Complete the Warden's Game by teleporting the Warden's Pawns into inward-facing positions.
english.description: You see the statue split into two, then four, then eight identical statues in a square formation.$b$bYou hear a voice, not through your ears, but in the back of your mind:$b$b   "A true warden does not face OUTWARD, searching for signs of danger.$b  A true warden keeps his gaze INWARD, always focused on protecting his quarry."$b$bPerhaps this is a riddle of some sort?

text.title: 哨兵的游戏
text.objectives: 连接两座红色雕像，以完成哨兵的游戏。
text.description: 当你把这尊雕像放回原位之后，屋里出现了一些新的石像。其中又有一座红宝石色的雕像，在屋中的一处遥远角落的围栏中。你听到了一个声音：$B$B  “哨兵在注视。$b  哨兵在保卫。$b   哨兵预见的，永不会落空。”$b$b屋中另一边的那座红色雕像看样子很重要。也许你应该把这两座红色雕像连起来试试看？

english.title: The Sentinel's Game
english.objectives: Complete the Sentinel's Game by connecting the two red statues.
english.description: As you place the statue in its place, several other stone statues appear in the room.  One more ruby-colored statue also appears, in a small enclosure on the far end of the room.  You hear a voice:$b$b  "The Sentinel watches.$b  The Sentinel protects.$b   The Sentinel's vision never falters."$b$bThat red statue on the other side of the room looks important.  Perhaps you should try to connect the two red statues?

text.title: 远古的保卫者
text.objectives: 调查戒卫和哨兵。
text.description: 你听到墓穴中央的房间中传来一阵隆隆声。那两尊大雕像看样子确实很可疑。
text.completed: Inspect the Titan's Trove within the Tomb of the Watchers in the Badlands.

english.title: Ancient Protectors
english.objectives: Investigate The Warden and The Sentinel.
english.description: You heard a good amount of rumbling happen in the tomb's central chamber.  Those two large statues did look awfully suspicious.
english.completed: Inspect the Titan's Trove within the Tomb of the Watchers in the Badlands.

starters.name: 高阶考察者泰瑟兰·血望者

text.title: 返回布拉姆身边
text.objectives: 将守护者之眼带回荒芜之地的阿戈莫德的营地，交给耶柔米·布拉姆博士。
text.description: 你在箱子中找到了一件圆形的小设备，放在一张垫子上。$b$b如果说这座墓穴中确实有泰坦圣物，那肯定就是它无疑了。你决定将它带回去交给布拉姆博士。
text.progress: Well?  Has our long shot paid off?
text.completion: Just one tiny little device? I never did understand those titans. Very well!  Let's see what this peeper can do.
text.completed: Report to Dr. Hieronymus Blam at Agmond's End in the Badlands.

english.title: Return to Blam
english.objectives: Bring the Eye of the Watchers to Dr. Hieronymus Blam at Agmond's End in the Badlands.
english.description: Inside the chest, you find a small, circular device, resting upon a cushion.$b$bIf there are any titan artifacts to be found here in the tomb, this is it.  You resolve to bring it back to Dr. Blam.
english.progress: Well?  Has our long shot paid off?
english.completion: Just one tiny little device? I never did understand those titans. Very well!  Let's see what this peeper can do.
english.completed: Report to Dr. Hieronymus Blam at Agmond's End in the Badlands.

text.title: 新卡加斯
text.objectives: 将净化过的黑龙蛋交给荒芜之地巨龙峡口的瑞亚。
text.description: <布拉姆博士一言不发地盯着这枚卵，他眨了眨眼，然后抬头注视着你。>$B$B你……你看见了吧？难以置信！我关于泰坦的理论得到了证实！当然，这全靠你的帮助。$B$B我们要把这件事告诉瑞亚。她已经离开莱瑟罗峡谷了，大概是因为她在雏龙面前转换到真实面目时彻底暴露了身份吧。瑞亚去了西边一座名叫新卡加斯的部落营地。$B$B她正等着你呢。还有这枚卵。
text.progress: That's some precious cargo you carry there, $n.
text.completion: I'll take that egg out of your hands now.  We need to get this egg incubated... and hidden, quickly.  There are lots of angry dragons looking for this. It's good to see you again, by the way.
text.completed: Report to Rhea at New Kargath in the Badlands.

english.title: New Kargath
english.objectives: Bring the Purified Black Dragon Egg to Rhea at New Kargath in the Badlands.
english.description: <Dr. Blam stares at the egg in awed silence, blinks a few times, then looks up at you.>$b$bD... did you see that?  Incredible!  My titan thing idea worked!  With your help, of course.$b$bWe'll want to get these back to Rhea.  She's not at Lethlor Ravine anymore; it sounds like she blew her cover when she transformed into her true form in front of all those whelps.  She's now in the west, staying at a large Horde establishment dubbed "New Kargath".$b$bShe'll be waiting for you.  And for that egg.
english.progress: That's some precious cargo you carry there, $n.
english.completion: I'll take that egg out of your hands now.  We need to get this egg incubated... and hidden, quickly.  There are lots of angry dragons looking for this. It's good to see you again, by the way.
english.completed: Report to Rhea at New Kargath in the Badlands.

text.title: 恶狗团
text.objectives: 跟荒芜之地新卡加斯的阿玛卡尔谈一谈。
text.description: 在匆忙逃离莱瑟罗峡谷时，我忘记拴住尼希昂卓拉了。她自由了，并向其他黑龙发出了警报。它们一眨眼的功夫就能飞来这里，寻找黑龙卵。$b$b我来负责藏匿它。你就去对付更麻烦的黑龙危机吧。当然，你需要帮助。$b$b我雇了一批佣兵。你可以在旅店里找到他们。
text.completion: You're the $r we've been waiting for?  It's about time you got here.  My legs could use a stretch. Come on boys!  Let's go kill us some black dragons!

english.title: The Bad Dogs
english.objectives: Speak with Amakkar at New Kargath in the Badlands.
english.description: In my haste to escape from Lethlor Ravine, I forgot to tie up one loose end: Nyxondra.  She's free, and she's sounded the alarm among the black dragonflight.  Half the flight is here in the western Badlands, combing for this egg.$b$bI'll take care of hiding the egg.  You're going to take care of some of the more troublesome dragons.  And you'll have help.$b$bI've paid off a couple of mercenaries to help you.  You'll find them inside this inn.
english.completion: You're the $r we've been waiting for?  It's about time you got here.  My legs could use a stretch. Come on boys!  Let's go kill us some black dragons!

text.title: 全能的阿玛卡尔
text.objectives: 使用阿玛卡尔的肾击和 阿玛卡尔的随身药水。
text.description: 在我们与黑龙展开殊死搏杀前，我得告诉你我的作战方式。$b$b跟其他两人不同，我并不强壮，身型也不魁梧，但是我懂得不少小花招。只要你一声令下，我就会径直冲向敌人，令他们眩晕几秒钟。我还会携带一些药水，以备不时之需。$b$b要不我们先来练习练习？进入战场，你很快就会知道真正的兽人是如何作战的了。
text.completion: I'm looking forward to fighting with you.
text.completed: Speak with Amakkar in the Badlands.

english.title: Amakkar, Jack of All Trades
english.objectives: Use Amakkar's Kidney Shot and Amakkar's Pocket Potion.
english.description: Before we get too crazy with the dragon-killing, let me tell you a little bit about how I fight.$b$bI'm not terribly strong or stalwart like these other two, but I've got a few tricks.  At your command I'll stun your enemies to keep 'em held still.  I also make sure to keep a few potions around for tight spots.$b$bWhy don't we practice fighting together?  Head out into the field, and you can see what it's like to fight with a real orc.
english.completion: I'm looking forward to fighting with you.
english.completed: Speak with Amakkar in the Badlands.

objectiveDetails.description: 使用阿玛卡尔的随身药水

text.title: 主攻手朱里克斯
text.objectives: 使用朱里克斯的火焰冲击和朱里克斯的时间扭曲。
text.description: 噢，你想聊聊？好吧。$b$b我叫朱里克斯，是这支小队的无脑打手。我也是火力最猛的佣兵。我跟其他两人合作的唯一理由就是，我需要肉盾令自己免受伤害。$b$b听着，你是这场行动的指挥者。只要你一声令下，我就会瞄准敌人的心脏发射火球。如果情况不妙的话，我还可以扭曲时间，帮你赢得进攻的机会。$b$b要不我们试试一起作战吧？
text.completion: I think you're ready, $n.  You're getting the hang of this.
text.completed: Speak with Jurrix Whitemane in the Badlands.

english.title: Jurrix the Striker
english.objectives: Use Jurrix's Fiery Blast and Jurrix's Time Warp.
english.description: Oh, you want to talk?  Fine.$b$bI'm Jurrix, the only merc here with half a brain.  The only one with any bite to my attacks, too.  The only reason I keep these meat shields around is to keep myself from getting killed.$b$bListen, you're the boss of this operation.  You give the word, and I'll send a fireball right through your target's heart.  If things start getting hectic, I can even warp time a bit so you can fit in a few extra attacks.$b$bWhy don't we go try fighting together?
english.completion: I think you're ready, $n.  You're getting the hang of this.
english.completed: Speak with Jurrix Whitemane in the Badlands.

objectiveDetails.description: 使用朱里克斯的火焰冲击
使用朱里克斯的时间扭曲

text.title: 大块头加戈尔
text.objectives: 使用加戈尔的盾墙和加戈尔的无畏咆哮。
text.description: 你可能没注意到，我的体型比普通的兽人大了许多。$b$b我相信，我那两个伙伴是不会遇到太多麻烦的。他们很小，而且没有大盾牌。我很大，完全可以应付好几个敌人！如果我小心一点的话，凭借盾牌就能化解所有的攻击！$b$b我还可以保护你。来吧，让我们练习练习。我会确保敌人都冲着我来的，你会很安全啦。
text.completion: See?  No need to worry when Gargal is around.  Just let me know, and I'll protect you from the monsters.
text.completed: Speak with Gargal in the Badlands.

english.title: Gargal, the Behemoth
english.objectives: Use Gargal's Shield Wall and Gargal's Mighty Shout.
english.description: You may not have noticed, but I'm pretty big, as far as orcs go.$b$bI make sure that my two pals here don't get into too much trouble.  They're small, and they don't have a big shield like me.  I'm big, and I can handle a few monsters hitting me!  Plus, if I'm careful, I can usually get them to hit my shield instead!$b$bI can protect you, too.  Come on, let's go practice for a bit.  I'll make sure the enemies attack me, and not you.
english.completion: See?  No need to worry when Gargal is around.  Just let me know, and I'll protect you from the monsters.
english.completed: Speak with Gargal in the Badlands.

objectiveDetails.description: 使用加戈尔的无畏咆哮

text.title: 龙群之怒
text.objectives: 杀死歼灭者卡拉然和4个暗翔士兵。
text.description: 你好，$n。看来你们四个彼此之间已经很熟了。$b$b这里是我要指派给你的第一个任务。卡拉然，一条颇具力量的远古黑龙，已经加入了搜寻我们所保护的那颗蛋的行动。我们必须在他靠得太近之前阻止他。$b$b你要前往漫尘盆地去找到他和他的爪牙，就在新卡加斯的东边。去把他干掉。你很可能需要借助你新结识的雇佣兵伙伴们的帮助。
text.completion: One less dragon to worry about, one step closer to redemption.  Onward, my soldiers!
text.giverWindow: 龙卵还很脆弱，我们必须阻止这只黑龙。
text.turninWindow: 还有一些事情需要处理。

english.title: The Wrath of a Dragonflight
english.objectives: Slay Kalaran the Annihilator and 4 Darkflight Soldiers.
english.description: Hello, $n.  It looks like you four have had time to become well-acquainted.$b$bI have my first assignment for you.  Kalaran, an ancient black dragon of considerable power, has joined in the hunt for the egg we are protecting.  We need to stop him before he gets too close.$b$bYou will find him and his minions at the Dustbowl, east of New Kargath.  Hunt him down and defeat him.  You will likely need the help of your new mercenary allies.
english.completion: One less dragon to worry about, one step closer to redemption.  Onward, my soldiers!
english.giverWindow: We need to strike at the black dragonflight while the egg is still vulnerable.
english.turninWindow: There's still work to be done.

text.title: 永无止尽的搜寻
text.objectives: 击败基拉卡将军、莫达尔以及6只黑龙。
text.description: 黑龙意味着麻烦。你应该也注意到了，他们占据了新卡加斯的大部分区域。基拉卡将军以及他的勇士莫达尔统领着这支黑龙军团。必须阻止它们。
text.completion: Two more dangerous black dragons have been removed from this egg hunt.  Your greatest task, however, still awaits.
text.giverWindow: 莫达尔和基拉卡领导着黑龙军团的核心力量。
text.turninWindow: 我们最大的挑战还在后面…

english.title: Their Hunt Continues
english.objectives: Defeat General Jirakka, Moldarr, and 6 Blackflight dragonspawn.
english.description: The black dragonflight means business.  As you've probably already noticed, they've taken over a large portion of New Kargath.  These troops are under the command of General Jirakka and his champion, Moldarr.  They must be stopped.
english.completion: Two more dangerous black dragons have been removed from this egg hunt.  Your greatest task, however, still awaits.
english.giverWindow: Moldarr and Jirakka lead the core of the black flight's forces.

text.title: 悲痛与愤怒
text.objectives: 杀死尼希昂卓拉和12条尼希昂卓拉雏龙。
text.description: 我最悔恨的事就是我们——不，是我——对待尼希昂卓拉的方式。我强迫她产卵，然后我用它们来做实验。一遍又一遍，一遍又一遍。$b$b虽然我自己也是母亲，但我仍然无法想象她要承受怎样的悲痛。$b$b不……我不能脆弱。毕竟，我们的工作是为了黑龙一族的未来。她的牺牲是必要的。$b$b她在新卡加斯西北边的卡加斯废墟盘旋，因愤怒而变得疯狂。求求你们，英雄们……让她摆脱痛苦吧。
text.completion: Just think... Nyxondra may end up being the mother of the new black dragonflight.  In death, she has given a gift to the future generations of Azeroth.
text.giverWindow: 尼希昂卓拉，原谅我…

english.title: The Sorrow and the Fury
english.objectives: Slay Nyxondra and 12 of Nyxondra's Broodlings.
english.description: My greatest regret is the treatment that we - no, I - gave to Nyxondra.  I forced her to lay eggs, then I performed experiments on them.  Over, and over, and over again.$b$bEven as a mother myself, I can only imagine her sorrow.$b$bNo... I mustn't be weak.  Our work is, after all, for the benefit of future generations of black dragons.  Her sacrifice was necessary.$b$bShe circles the Ruins of Kargath, northwest of New Kargath, insane with fury.  Please, heroes... put her out of her misery.
english.completion: Just think... Nyxondra may end up being the mother of the new black dragonflight.  In death, she has given a gift to the future generations of Azeroth.
english.giverWindow: Nyxondra, forgive me...

text.title: 隐藏的龙巢
text.objectives: 与荒芜之地隐藏的龙巢的瑞亚交谈。
text.description: 那条大黑龙已经离开了荒芜之地，现在又可以安全地挪动这只蛋了。你可以在一处小高地上找到我，就在新卡加斯的北边。$b$b到那里去找我吧。
text.completion: The egg must always be moving.  We are not safe anywhere. Deathwing, even in his madness, knows all the hidden places in this world.  The egg must not rest.
text.giverWindow: 到北边和我碰头。

english.title: The Hidden Clutch
english.objectives: Speak with Rhea at The Hidden Clutch in the Badlands.
english.description: With the major black dragons out of the Badlands, it is now safe to move the egg again.  You will find me on a small plateau, north of New Kargath.$b$bCome and find me.
english.completion: The egg must always be moving.  We are not safe anywhere. Deathwing, even in his madness, knows all the hidden places in this world.  The egg must not rest.
english.giverWindow: Meet me in the north.

text.title: 瑞亚丝塔萨的礼物
text.objectives: 等待瑞亚从隐藏的龙巢中把蛋拿回来。
text.description: 在这里等着。我去把蛋拿回来。
text.completed: Read Rhea's Note within the Hidden Clutch in the Badlands.

english.title: Rheastrasza's Gift
english.objectives: Wait as Rhea retrieves the egg from the Hidden Clutch.
english.description: Wait here.  I will retrieve the egg.
english.completed: Read Rhea's Note within the Hidden Clutch in the Badlands.

text.title: 他眼里的光芒
text.objectives: 跟太阳方尖碑的哈里森·琼斯谈一谈。
text.description: 如果你要找哈里森的话，你刚好错过他。$b$b他不停地唠叨着他最新的发现，还有一切是如何开始说得通之类的。$b$b总之……对我来说，他绝对说不通。$b$b我试着说服他留下来，和我一起欣赏沙漠里的落日，但他眼里一旦放光，就听不进去别人的话了。$b$b也许你愿意去探望探望他？他朝南边的巨石那里去了。
text.completion: It would seem that I'm not the only one interested in these obelisks...

english.title: That Gleam in his Eye
english.objectives: Speak to Harrison Jones at the Obelisk of the Sun.
english.description: If you're looking for Harrison, you just missed him.$b$bHe was going on and on about his latest discovery, and how everything was beginning to make sense.$b$bWhatever... he certainly wasn't making sense to me.$b$bI tried to convince him to stay here and just enjoy a few desert sunsets with me, but there's no talking to him when he gets that gleam in his eye.$b$bPerhaps you'd be willing to check in on him?$b$bHe was headed to that big monolith, south of here.
english.completion: It would seem that I'm not the only one interested in these obelisks...

text.title: 我得对付这家伙
text.objectives: 杀掉10名司克诺兹空降步兵。
text.description: 来得正好，$n。$b$b看来我不是唯一一个对这些方尖碑感兴趣的人，而这些家伙们不大愿意同别人交换意见……$b$b我想我能对付这一个。$b$b也许你可以在他的朋友赶过来之前，把他们处理掉？
text.completion: That's a relief. Thanks, $n. Turns out I've got my hands full here.
text.completed: 跟太阳方尖碑的哈里森·琼斯谈一谈。

english.title: I've Got This Guy
english.objectives: Kill 10 Schnottz Air Troopers.
english.description: Good timing, $n.$b$bSeems I'm not the only one interested in these obelisks, and these fellas aren't inclined to compare notes...$b$bI think I can handle this guy.$b$bMaybe you could take care of a few of his friends before they make their way over here?
english.completion: That's a relief. Thanks, $n. Turns out I've got my hands full here.
english.completed: Speak to Harrison Jones at the Obelisk of the Sun.

objectiveDetails.description: 杀掉司克诺兹空降步兵

text.title: 他们不知道手里拿着什么
text.objectives: 制作泰坦激活设备。
text.description: 听着，$n。我没有太多时间闲谈。$b$b这些部队正在从地下挖掘圣物，把我们需要的远古科技夺走！$b$b我要你去他们的箱子里找远古激活设备的部件。军官们应该有密码，可以让你打开箱子。$b$b动作快点！$b$b别让他们把这东西装上飞机！
text.progress: Have you got the titan activation device, $n?
text.completion: That's it! Good work, $n!
text.completed: 跟太阳方尖碑的哈里森·琼斯谈一谈。

english.title: They Don't Know What They've Got Here
english.objectives: Create the Titan Activation Device.
english.description: Listen, $n. I don't have a lot of time to talk here.$b$bThese guys are excavating relics from this site and taking pieces of ancient technology that we need!$b$bI need you to check their crates for pieces of an ancient activation device. The officers should have the codes you'll need to open them.$b$bHurry!$b$bWe can't let them load this stuff into their planes!
english.progress: Have you got the titan activation device, $n?
english.completion: That's it! Good work, $n!
english.completed: Speak to Harrison Jones at the Obelisk of the Sun.

text.title: 纯粹之泉
text.objectives: 从纯粹之泉元素身上收集6份纯粹之泉微粒。
text.description: 玛格图尔曾和我谈起过破碎者所研习的萨满魔法。伟大的努波顿曾经说过，元素之道，在某种方面上，亦可能是圣光之道。$B$B我只能寄希望于此了。纯粹之泉洞穴附近聚集的元素是由真正的原始之水所筑。他们也许暴力而混沌，但从他们身上收集的纯水，将会是引导圣光祝福的最佳媒介。$B$B求求你，把这水给我带来，$n。
text.progress: Have the elements given up their source?
text.completion: Such clarity... let us hope this will aid poor Magtoor.
text.completed: Return to Anchorite Avuun at the Harborage in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: The Purespring
english.objectives: Collect 6 Purespring Motes from Purespring Elementals.
english.description: Magtoor has told me of the shamanism that the Broken practice. The great Nobundo once said that the path of the elements may, in a way, be another way to the Light.$B$BI can only hope there is some truth in this. The elementals that gather near Purespring Cavern to the south are a source of truly pristine water. They can be chaotic and violent, but the pure water harvested from them will be the perfect conduit for the blessing of the Light.$B$BPlease, bring me this water, $n.
english.progress: Have the elements given up their source?
english.completion: Such clarity... let us hope this will aid poor Magtoor.
english.completed: Return to Anchorite Avuun at the Harborage in Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 点火
text.objectives: 拿到烈日之镜。
text.description: 这家伙就是不服输！$b$b你干得很好，孩子。$b$b根据我的研究，下面应该有一座泰坦雕像。用这个装置激活它，然后把它打碎。$b$b假如我的理论正确，那雕像应该蕴藏着重启这个方尖碑的关键。
text.progress: Time to see if this old mechanism still works...
text.completion: According to Harrison's notes, placing the lens upon this dais should re-activate this obelisk. Exactly what that means remains to be seen...
text.completed: Place the Lens of the Sun on the Elevated Platform in the Chamber of the Sun.

english.title: Ignition
english.objectives: Recover the Lens of the Sun.
english.description: This guy just won't go down!$b$bYou're doin' great, kid. Only one thing left to do.$b$bAccording to my research, there should be a titan statue down below. Use the device to activate it, then break it down.$b$bIf my theory is correct, that statue holds the key to reactivating this obelisk.
english.progress: Time to see if this old mechanism still works...
english.completion: According to Harrison's notes, placing the lens upon this dais should re-activate this obelisk. Exactly what that means remains to be seen...
english.completed: Place the Lens of the Sun on the Elevated Platform in the Chamber of the Sun.

text.title: 迷雾的呼吸
text.objectives: 从迷雾劣魔身上收集5颗烟尘水晶。
text.description: 劣魔是游荡在东边迷雾谷里的森林精灵。尽管它们和小鬼相似，但我对它们进行了研究后，并没有发现任何恶魔的迹象。目前就我所知，它们还没有堕落。$B$B它们居住在山谷里，随风而动，随心召唤着阵阵微风。这种纯粹的空气或许能和我为可怜的玛格图尔准备的治疗药混合。$B$B求求你，$n，从劣魔的身体上为我收集烟尘水晶。我必须把所有可能的治疗方法都试一试。
text.progress: 你夺回德莱尼水晶了吗?
text.completion: I can only hope this will lead to a cure, $n. Thank you for bringing it to me.
text.completed: Return to Anchorite Avuun at The Harborage in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: Breath of Mist
english.objectives: Collect 5 Smoky Crystals from Misty Grell.
english.description: The Grell are forest spirits that wander the Misty Valley to the east. Though they resemble imps, I have found no demonic traces among the ones I've studied. They are, as far as I can tell, uncorrupted. $B$BThose that dwell in the valley move as one with the wind, summoning gusts of breeze at their whim. This pure air may be incorporated into my remedy for poor Magtoor.$B$BPlease, $n, gather the smoky crystals found within the grells' bodies for me. I must exhaust every potential cure.
english.progress: Do you have the crystals?
english.completion: I can only hope this will lead to a cure, $n. Thank you for bringing it to me.
english.completed: Return to Anchorite Avuun at The Harborage in Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 机尾炮手！
text.objectives: 使用追踪炮来保护司克诺兹轰炸机。
text.description: 好了，我已经把这家伙打蔫了，你来帮我把他解决掉如何？$b$b我有一个逃脱计划，但需要过人的胆识和一点点运气。$b$b你干不干，$n？$b$b跟我来就是了……
text.completion: Good work back there, $n. Looks like we've lost them, for now at least.
text.completed: Defend the Schnottz Bomber until Harrison can land.

english.title: Tailgunner!
english.objectives: Use the tailgun to defend the Schnottz Bomber.
english.description: Okay, I've softened this guy up, how about you help me finish him off?$b$bI've got a plan for our escape, but it'll require a lot of guts and a little luck.$b$bYou up for it, $n?$b$bJust follow my lead...
english.completion: Good work back there, $n. Looks like we've lost them, for now at least.
english.completed: Defend the Schnottz Bomber until Harrison can land.

text.title: 尼卡·血痕
text.objectives: 跟断矛路口的尼卡·血痕谈一谈。
text.description: 要从袭击中恢复，并为下一次进攻做好准备，还有许多事情要做。我需要所有斥候协调一致。$B$B尼卡·血痕受训于恶劣的荒芜之地，是我们最好的追踪者。她被派到西边的断矛路口去监视联盟的活动了。$B$B去找尼卡，$n。告诉她斯通纳德所发生的一切。无论她有什么需要，努力协助她。
text.completion: I hope the sight of my sniveling amuses you, $n. It will be the only joy here.

english.title: Neeka Bloodscar
english.objectives: Speak with Neeka Bloodscar at Splinterspear Junction.
english.description: There is much work to do in recovering from the assault and bracing ourselves for the next one. I will need coordination from all of our scouts.$B$BNeeka Bloodscar is our finest tracker, trained in the harsh Badlands. She has been sent west to Splinterspear Junction to watch for Alliance activity.$B$BGo to Neeka, $n. Tell her of what has occured in Stonard. Assist her in any way she requires.
english.completion: I hope the sight of my sniveling amuses you, $n. It will be the only joy here.

text.title: 祝祷之花
text.objectives: 从流沙泥潭收集10株祝祷之花。
text.description: 我已经毁了，$c。赫格拉姆是我的力量，而现在这力量随着鲜血，从他那裂开的伤口里不住地流出来。伤口太深，难以治疗，皮肉也无法愈合。$B$B他在恐惧中低语，被痛苦和高烧所折磨。我无法离开他。现在不行。拜托，我惭愧地请求你帮我采些草药来。$B$B沼泽里生长的祝祷之花素有止痛疗伤之效。数量足够的话，或许能缓解他的疼痛。
text.progress: Have you brought the prayerblossom?
text.completion: I will grind these and try to get him to eat. Thank you.
text.completed: Return to Neeka Bloodscar at Splinterspear Junction in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: Prayerblossom
english.objectives: Collect 10 sprigs of Prayerblossom from the Shifting Mire.
english.description: I have been ruined, $c. I placed my strength in Helgrum, and now it bleeds from his gaping wounds. Wounds too deep to heal, flesh that refuses to knit.$B$BHe murmurs in fear, consumed by fever and pain. I cannot leave his side. Not now. Please, I ask you in shame to gather herbs for me.$B$BThe prayerblossom that grows in the swamp is an old remedy for soothing. With enough of it, his pain might be stilled.
english.progress: Have you brought the prayerblossom?
english.completion: I will grind these and try to get him to eat. Thank you.
english.completed: Return to Neeka Bloodscar at Splinterspear Junction in Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 泥潭的秘密
text.objectives: 从移动的潭泥身上收集10份充满活力的淤泥样本。
text.description: 沼泽的空气让赫格拉姆的伤口化了脓。鼓胀流脓，让他的最后一刻充满了痛苦。我必须找东西给他敷上。$B$B魂灵在这泥潭里游荡，它们栖身在泥巴里，把生命赐予一团团小块的泥土，推着它们移动。$B$B凉爽纯净的泥土里的魂灵可以令他舒适。拜托你，我不能离开他的身边，请帮我收集一些来。
text.progress: Helgrum still breathes. Do you have the mud?
text.completion: At least I can soothe him with my own hands while he still breathes. Thank you, $n.
text.completed: Return to Neeka Bloodscar at Splinterspear Junction in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: Secrets of the Mire
english.objectives: Collect 10 samples of Invigorated Silt from Shifting Mireglobs.
english.description: Helgrum's wounds fester in the swamp air. They swell and ooze, filling his final moments with suffering. I must have something to coat them with.$B$BThe spirits move through this mire. They inhabit the mud itself, pushing it along in clumps of fine soil that take on lives of their own$B$BThe spirits of the cool, pure mud will offer him some comfort. Please, gather it for me, for I cannot abandon his side.
english.progress: Helgrum still breathes. Do you have the mud?
english.completion: At least I can soothe him with my own hands while he still breathes. Thank you, $n.
english.completed: Return to Neeka Bloodscar at Splinterspear Junction in Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 纯粹之泉
text.objectives: 从纯粹之泉元素身上收集8份纯粹之泉微粒。
text.description: 赫格拉姆的呼吸变慢了。他的大限快到了。$B$B我需要水。在纯粹之泉洞穴的池塘里有元素在游荡。从它们身上流出来的水是这片沼泽里最纯净的。$B$B就算我冒险离开赫格拉姆，我颤抖的手也无法握住斧子。我必须再一次求你可怜，也为了他的宽慰。将元素的微尘带给我，让他最后喝上一口纯净和提神的饮料吧。
text.progress: You've returned.
text.completion: He can only drink so much. The rest might be used for washing his body, after...
text.completed: Return to Neeka Bloodscar at Splinterspear Junction in Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: The Purespring
english.objectives: Collect 8 Purespring Motes from Purespring Elementals.
english.description: Helgrum's breathing slows. His time is near.$B$BI need water. Elementals roam the ponds of Purespring Cavern. The water that flows from them is the purest in this swamp.$B$BEven if I could risk leaving Helgrum's side, my axe would shudder in my hand. I must beg you once again to pity me, for his comfort. Bring me the motes of the elementals, that his final drink may be pure and refreshing.
english.progress: You've returned.
english.completion: He can only drink so much. The rest might be used for washing his body, after...
english.completed: Return to Neeka Bloodscar at Splinterspear Junction in Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 最后的遗憾
text.objectives: 获得暮牙的皮。
text.description: 既然我已经卑躬屈膝过了，索性就将人情求到底吧。我还有最后一件事我要你帮忙，一个羞耻的兽人最后的请求。$B$B赫格拉姆非常看重一头猎物，吃食人魔的暮牙，迷雾谷最强大的黑豹。他永远不会允许自己轻易放过那头野兽。尽管他十分想要将其猎杀，但我们的侦察任务过于重要。$B$B如果他无法在现世捕杀暮牙，那他可以在来世继续。继续他的狩猎，把暮牙的皮带来给我。
text.progress: Has Duskfang shown himself?
text.completion: With Duskfang to shroud his body, he will carry the animal's spirit with him into the afterlife. Listen to me. An old superstitious fool. I'm so sorry, Helgrum...
text.completed: Return to Neeka Bloodscar at Splinterspear Junction in Swamp of Sorrows.
text.giverWindow: 迷雾谷的暮牙，以食人魔为食

english.title: Last Regrets
english.objectives: Collect Duskfang's Hide.
english.description: If I am reduced to groveling, I may as well ask everything I can. There is one last favor I would ask of you, one more task a shamed orc pleads for.$B$BHelgrum had a prized prey. Duskfang, eater of ogres, the great panther of Misty Valley. He would never allow himself the leisure of stalking it. Though he wanted badly to hunt, our scouting duties were too important.$B$BIf he cannot hunt Duskfang in this world, he can hunt the beast in the next. Take up the hunt for him; bring Duskfang's pelt to me.
english.progress: Has Duskfang shown himself?
english.completion: With Duskfang to shroud his body, he will carry the animal's spirit with him into the afterlife. Listen to me. An old superstitious fool. I'm so sorry, Helgrum...
english.completed: Return to Neeka Bloodscar at Splinterspear Junction in Swamp of Sorrows.
english.giverWindow: Duskfang of the Misty Valley, Eater of Ogres

text.title: 最后一口气
text.objectives: 见证赫格拉姆的最后一刻。
text.description: 他开始抖动了……$B$B别离开，$n。拜托你，同我一起为赫格拉姆送终。你已经为他做了许多事。
text.completion: He is gone. He is right. I must be strong for him...
text.completed: 跟尼卡·血痕谈一谈。

english.title: With Dying Breath
english.objectives: Witness Helgrum's last moments.
english.description: He stirs...$B$BDo not leave, $n. Please, honor Helgrum with me. You have done so much for him.
english.completion: He is gone. He is right. I must be strong for him...
english.completed: Speak with Neeka Bloodscar.

text.title: 泰坦的宝藏
text.objectives: 调查守护者的宝藏。
text.description: 第二个守护者倒在地上之后，一口箱子出现在屋子后面。莫非这就是它们在保护的东西？
text.completion: You peer into the chest...
text.completed: 调查荒芜之地观察者的陵墓里的守护者宝藏。

english.title: The Titans' Trove
english.objectives: Investigate the Trove of the Watchers.
english.description: As the second defender falls to the ground, a chest appears in the back of the chamber.  Could this be what they were protecting?
english.completion: You peer into the chest...
english.completed: Inspect the Trove of the Watchers within the Tomb of the Watchers in the Badlands.

text.title: 泰坦的宝藏
text.objectives: 调查守护者的宝藏。
text.description: 第二个守护者倒在地上之后，一口箱子出现在屋子后面。莫非这就是它们在保护的东西？
text.completion: You peer into the chest...
text.completed: 调查荒芜之地观察者的陵墓里的守护者宝藏。

english.title: The Titans' Trove
english.objectives: Investigate the Trove of the Watchers.
english.description: As the second defender falls to the ground, a chest appears in the back of the chamber.  Could this be what they were protecting?
english.completion: You peer into the chest...
english.completed: Inspect the Trove of the Watchers within the Tomb of the Watchers in the Badlands.

text.title: 绿龙军团的祝福
text.objectives: 跟阿塔哈卡神庙顶部的伊萨里奥斯勋爵谈一谈。
text.description: 你做得很好，$n。迦玛兰逃脱了我们的掌握，但他的溃退为我进入神庙铺平了道路。$B$B待在原地不要动。我将从翡翠梦境里牵引你的灵魂，加速你的归来。$B$B这也许会让你略有睡意。
text.completion: You have performed a great service for me and my kind, $n. Accept this as a symbol of my gratitude, and of your courage.
text.giverWindow: 回来让我奖赏你。

english.title: Blessing of the Green Dragonflight
english.objectives: Speak with Lord Itharius atop the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.
english.description: You have done well, $n. Jammal'an may have escaped our grasp, but his retreat paves the way for me to enter the temple as I desire.$B$BStay where you are and do not move. I will hasten your return by pulling your spirit to me through the Emerald Dream.$B$BThis may cause slight drowsiness.
english.completion: You have performed a great service for me and my kind, $n. Accept this as a symbol of my gratitude, and of your courage.
english.giverWindow: Return to me for your reward.

text.title: 神庙之心
text.objectives: 跟阿塔哈卡神庙里的伊萨里奥斯勋爵谈一谈。
text.description: 我必须坦诚，我在这桩事务中藏有私心。在这里堕落的第一群绿龙里，有一条是我的哥哥，伊兰尼库斯。$B$B我以为伊兰尼库斯牺牲了，永远迷失在噩梦最黑暗的裂隙中，但我听说他的影子从神庙里浮现而出。我不知道那真的是他，抑或只是一个空虚哀痛的回响。$B$B如果你愿意进一步帮助我，就回到面具大厅，穿过拱廊进入神庙真正的圣殿。我将在那里等你。
text.completion: I am pleased to see you once again, $n. You are truly noble to assist me further.

english.title: The Heart of the Temple
english.objectives: Speak with Lord Itharius again inside the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.
english.description: I must confess I have a more personal involvement in this affair. One of the first of the green dragons corrupted here was my brother, Eranikus.$B$BI thought Eranikus gone, lost forever to the darkest rifts of nightmare, but I have heard that his shade has emerged within the temple. I know not whether it is truly him, or an empty, mournful echo.$B$BIf you wish to help me further, return to the Hall of Masks and journey through the archway into the true sanctum of the temple. I will find you there.
english.completion: I am pleased to see you once again, $n. You are truly noble to assist me further.

text.title: 鲁尔格的报告
text.objectives: 将断矛报告交给斯通纳德的分队指挥官鲁尔格。
text.description: 这是鲁尔格的报告，$n。告诉他，他的斥候还在岗位上。$B$B别提起赫格拉姆，我不想用悲伤的消息打扰别人。$B$B我必须坚强。我们都必须坚强。
text.progress: 有事吗?
text.completion: I see.  Thank you for this information, $n.
text.completed: Report to Dispatch Commander Ruag at Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows.

english.title: Ruag's Report
english.objectives: Deliver the Splinterspear Report to Dispatch Commander Ruag in Stonard.
english.description: Here is Ruag's report, $n. Let him know his scout is still here.$B$BDo not speak of Helgrum. I will not distract others with news of tragedy.$B$BI have to be strong. We all have to be strong.
english.progress: Yes?
english.completion: I see.  Thank you for this information, $n.
english.completed: Report to Dispatch Commander Ruag at Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 闻风而动
text.objectives: 击败灰葬男爵。
text.description: 在一里之外，我就能闻到高弗雷和他的同伙们。他们藏踪匿迹的本领可真是可怜到家了。这个错误将最终导致他们灭亡。$B$B他们中的一个就在附近，尽管他的气味在死后稍稍有所变化，但我相当肯定那就是灰葬男爵。去把他撕成碎片，我要确保被遗忘者无法干涉我们的任务。
text.completion: The scent of freshly spilled traitor blood fills my nostrils, and it is absolutely invigorating. However, my bloodlust will not be sated until Godfrey lies on the floor as a lifeless heap. He thinks an army of mindless corpses can stop the wrath of the Bloodfang? We'll gnaw on their bones for years to come after our work is done!
text.completed: Return to Packleader Ivar Bloodfang.
text.giverWindow: 他就在附近。

english.title: Sniffing Them Out
english.objectives: Kill Baron Ashbury.
english.description: I could smell Godfrey and his companions a mile away from here. They did an exceedingly poor job covering their tracks in flight. It will be the mistake that puts the final nail in their coffins.$B$BOne of them is very close, and though the scent has changed slightly in undeath, I'm fairly certain it's Ashbury's. Go inside and tear him to pieces, we'll ensure the Forsaken do not intervene with our task.
english.completion: The scent of freshly spilled traitor blood fills my nostrils, and it is absolutely invigorating. However, my bloodlust will not be sated until Godfrey lies on the floor as a lifeless heap. He thinks an army of mindless corpses can stop the wrath of the Bloodfang? We'll gnaw on their bones for years to come after our work is done!
english.completed: Return to Packleader Ivar Bloodfang.
english.giverWindow: He's near.

text.title: 避难营
text.objectives: 将德莱尼水晶送给学者阿弗恩。
text.description: 学者阿弗恩是我未遭腐化的同胞，按其他种族的说法，就是德莱尼人。他来避难营是要帮助我们，找到治愈我们的方法。正是他派我来收集这些水晶。$B$B现在他照看着一个病得非常厉害的朋友……尽管消息已经被送到埃索达去了，目前他还是孤立无援。你是否能把这些水晶给他带去，$n？你可能是唯一一个能够援助他的人了。
text.completion: Thank you, $c. I am afraid it may be too late... but I refuse to give up, even if the Exodar itself does not hear my cries.

english.title: The Harborage
english.objectives: Deliver the Draenethyst Crystals to Anchorite Avuun.
english.description: Anchorite Avuun is one of our uncorrupted bretheren, what other races know as Draenei. He came to The Harborage to heal us, and try to find a cure. It is he who sent me here to collect these crystals.$B$BHe watches over a very sick friend now... and despite sending word to the Exodar itself, he has not found any aid so far. Could you bring these crystals to him, $n? You may be the only one able to assist him.
english.completion: Thank you, $c. I am afraid it may be too late... but I refuse to give up, even if the Exodar itself does not hear my cries.

text.title: 前往诅咒之地
text.objectives: 前往诅咒之地跟守望堡的恩诺哈尔·雷酒谈一谈。
text.description: 我们感谢你在这片沼泽中提供的帮助，$n。我正想告诉你，我收到了守望堡的来函。$B$B诺哈尔·雷酒请求帮忙调查赤色海岸的船骸，但我们还没有人愿意去，而我又不能离开避难营。$B$B守望堡坐落在诅咒之地，悲伤沼泽的南方。行路时别靠斯通纳德太近。
text.completion: Ah, has Avuun sent ye? Good, good...

english.title: Onward to the Blasted Lands
english.objectives: Journey to the Blasted Lands and speak with Enohar Thunderbrew in Nethergarde Keep.
english.description: We appreciate your assistance here in this swamp, $n.  I would like to inform you that I have received correspondance from Nethergarde Keep.$b$bEnohar Thunderbrew has requested help in investigating the shipwrecks of the Red Reaches, but we have had none willing to make the journey, and I could not leave the Harborage.$B$BNethergarde Keep sits in the Blasted Lands, south of the Swamp of Sorrows.  Do not journey too close to Stonard on your way.
english.completion: Ah, has Avuun sent ye? Good, good...

text.title: 武装到牙齿
text.objectives: 杀死席瓦莱恩男爵和指挥官斯普林瓦尔。
text.description: 我们进攻城堡时遇到了一个意料之外的麻烦，$n。看来席瓦莱恩男爵和指挥官斯普林瓦尔的奴仆们死后还像生前一样，服侍着主人们。高弗雷把他们作为挡箭牌阻碍着我们。$B$B别担心，这些对我们而言不过是小菜一碟。把席瓦莱恩和斯普林瓦尔一同消灭，不仅能让他们的守卫变成无头苍蝇，也会让我们进一步地接近最终的目标。
text.progress: It is infuriating that we have to kill these ghost soldiers when they are completely outside the main objective, but it must be done. Godfrey is a cunning foe indeed.
text.completion: We're nearly there, $n. The time is now to charge further ahead and take out Walden!
text.completed: Return to Packleader Ivar Bloodfang.
text.giverWindow: 真没想到。

english.title: Armored to the Teeth
english.objectives: Kill Baron Silverlaine and Commander Springvale.
english.description: We've hit an unexpected snag in our assault on the keep, $n. It seems the servants that tended to Baron Silverlaine and Commander Springvale in life do so now in death as well, and Godfrey has placed them directly between us and him.$B$BNot to worry, we won't let them be anything more than a minor inconvenience. Eliminate Silverlaine and Springvale both and not only will their guards no longer have masters to direct them, it will place us that much closer to our final goal.
english.progress: It is infuriating that we have to kill these ghost soldiers when they are completely outside the main objective, but it must be done. Godfrey is a cunning foe indeed.
english.completion: We're nearly there, $n. The time is now to charge further ahead and take out Walden!
english.completed: Return to Packleader Ivar Bloodfang.
english.giverWindow: This was unexpected.

text.title: 消灭爪牙
text.objectives: 杀死沃登勋爵。
text.description: 看来沃登勋爵终于意识到我们的存在，加固了防御。但这已经没用了……没什么能阻止我们的部队。$B$B通向他的道路上遍布天灾的爪牙，但我相信你可以把道路清理出来，让我们其他人畅行无阻。一旦我们杀掉沃登，就能直取他那怯懦的首领。
text.completion: It won't be long now before the entire keep is ours, thanks to your valiant efforts.
text.completed: Return to Packleader Ivar Bloodfang.
text.giverWindow: 目前为止最为狡猾的敌人。

english.title: Fighting Tooth and Claw
english.objectives: Kill Lord Walden.
english.description: It appears that Lord Walden has finally taken notice to our presence and has heightened his defenses. It's worthless really... nothing will deter our pack.$B$BThe path ahead to him is rife with powerful Scourge minions, but I trust that you will be able to clear the path for the rest of us to follow in. Once we kill Walden, it should be a straight shot to his cowardly leader.
english.completion: It won't be long now before the entire keep is ours, thanks to your valiant efforts.
english.completed: Return to Packleader Ivar Bloodfang.
english.giverWindow: A cunning foe thus far.

text.title: 叛徒！
text.objectives: 藏在尼斐塞特之叶后面，揭开尼斐塞特的秘密。
text.description: 求你了，陌生人。你必须帮帮我。$B$B我来这里调查尼斐塞特的一个强大的新盟友抵达的事情，但是我最亲密的盟友背叛了我，只好放弃了行动。$B$B到我们上方东边的平台去，查明我未能获得的情报。你千万不要被那些尼斐塞特人发现。也许你可以躲在平台上的大型植物后面，隐藏你的踪迹。$B$B帮我这个忙，我就帮你的朋友回到安全的地方去。
text.completion: A djinn!  We must escape as soon as possible. This unholy alliance of the Neferset with the minions of Deathwing does not bode well for us.
text.completed: Return to Prince Nadun at the Lost City of the Tol'vir in Uldum

english.title: Traitors!
english.objectives: Hide behind the Neferset Frond and Uncover the Neferset Secret.
english.description: Please, stranger.  You must help me.$B$BI came here to investigate the arrival of a powerful ally to the Neferset, only to be betrayed by my closest allies and given up to the enemy.$B$BGo to the terrace above us to the east and find the information I failed to uncover.  You'll need to hide from the Neferset.  Perhaps you can hide behind one of the large plants on the platform to conceal your presence.$B$BDo this for me and I will help your friends find their way to safety.
english.completion: A djinn!  We must escape as soon as possible. This unholy alliance of the Neferset with the minions of Deathwing does not bode well for us.
english.completed: Return to Prince Nadun at the Lost City of the Tol'vir in Uldum

text.title: 熏他们的眼
text.objectives: 在奥丹姆的托维尔失落之城中烧毁干草堆。
text.description: 我不知道你朋友在酝酿什么疯狂的计划，但如果我们想要逃出去的话，就需要想办法分散敌人的注意力。$B$B从那座火盆上拿一把火炬，去放几把火。$B$B也许，如果我们让那些尼斐塞特渣滓的注意力分散几分钟，就能获得合适的机会。
text.completion: Yes.  I hear the Neferset calling each other to the east.  This might yet work.
text.completed: Return to Prince Nadun at the Lost City of the Tol'vir in Uldum.

english.title: Smoke in Their Eyes
english.objectives: Burn Stacks of Hay inside the Lost City of the Tol'vir in Uldum.
english.description: I'm not sure what knuckle-headed plan your friend is concocting, but we're going to need a distraction if we're to stand a chance of escaping.$B$BTake the torch from that brazier and go start some fires.$B$BPerhaps if we divert the Neferset scum's attention away for a few minutes, we'll have the opportunity we need.
english.completion: Yes.  I hear the Neferset calling each other to the east.  This might yet work.
english.completed: Return to Prince Nadun at the Lost City of the Tol'vir in Uldum.

text.title: 巴德的计划
text.objectives: 获得6件尼斐塞特护甲。
text.description: 我想到一个点子！相信我，这次是好点子！$B$B去从那些猫人身上弄点亮闪闪的护甲来。$B$B这个计划绝对靠谱。相信我，没错的。
text.progress: Did you get the pieces, $n?
text.completion: Excellent.  You'll see, this can't possibly go wrong!
text.completed: Return to Budd at the Lost City of the Tol'vir in Uldum.

english.title: Budd's Plan
english.objectives: Obtain 6 pieces of Neferset Armor.
english.description: I've an idea!  Trust me, it's a good one this time!$B$BGet some of those shiny armor pieces the cat-people wear.$B$BThis plan cannot fail.  Trust me.
english.progress: Did you get the pieces, $n?
english.completion: Excellent.  You'll see, this can't possibly go wrong!
english.completed: Return to Budd at the Lost City of the Tol'vir in Uldum.

text.title: 高效挖掘技巧
text.objectives: Bring 'Efficient Excavations' to Belloc Brightblade in Schnottz's Landing.
text.description: This manual describes outlandish theories on how to efficiently manage large groups of workers as they engage in the manual labor of various types of excavation.$b$bIt becomes clear to you that the author of the book is the figure in charge of the over-aggressive pillagers here.$b$bPerhaps an introduction is in order.
text.giverWindow: You can only assume that this picture is of the self-absorbed author.

english.title: Efficient Excavations
english.objectives: Bring 'Efficient Excavations' to Belloc Brightblade in Schnottz's Landing.
english.description: This manual describes outlandish theories on how to efficiently manage large groups of workers as they engage in the manual labor of various types of excavation.$b$bIt becomes clear to you that the author of the book is the figure in charge of the over-aggressive pillagers here.$b$bPerhaps an introduction is in order.
english.giverWindow: You can only assume that this picture is of the self-absorbed author.

text.title: 东方好客
text.objectives: 贝洛克·辉刃要你同司克诺兹登陆点的客人们打成一片。
text.description: 恐怕元首现在非常忙。$b$b如此规模的行动，这些天来的各种需求让他应接不暇。$b$b既然你要等着跟他交谈，为什么不和我们的客人们聊聊呢？$b$b我们邀请了艾泽拉斯最为杰出的人物，来见证我们揭开这一地区的秘密。$b$b我相信，你一定会觉得他们是很有意思的人。
text.completion: I trust that you had no troubles fitting in with our guests, hmm?
text.completed: Speak to Belloc Brightblade in Schnottz's Landing.

english.title: Eastern Hospitality
english.objectives: Belloc Brightblade wants you to mingle with the guests at Schnottz's Landing.
english.description: The commander is quite busy now, I'm afraid.$b$bThe demands of an operation such as this require much of his attention these days.$b$bWhile you wait to speak with him, why don't you mingle with some of our guests?$b$bWe have invited a variety of Azeroth's most illustrious figures to be present when we unlock the secrets of this region.$b$bI am confident that you will find them most captivating.
english.completion: I trust that you had no troubles fitting in with our guests, hmm?
english.completed: Speak to Belloc Brightblade in Schnottz's Landing.

objectiveDetails.description: 跟一名优雅的绅士交流
跟一名新锐艺术家交流
跟一名新晋女演员交流

text.title: 进入灭世者之痕
text.objectives: 在荒芜之地的灭世者之痕寻找迷失者塞尔杜林。
text.description: 荒芜之地居住了一些非比寻常的人物，其中一些很早就来到了这里。$B$B比方说，这镇上原本有三位绅士。我忘记了他们的名字……那个矮人好像叫塞尔杜林？总之，几天前他们带上一堆麦酒往南边去了，从此再无消息。我认为他们是去了灭世者之痕。$B$B你愿意寻找他们的下落吗？我想知道他们是否安好。
text.completion: They sent you to check up on us?  Pshh... I've been around this desert longer than any of those chumps.  We're just soaking in some of the scenery and telling stories about old times. You like telling stories?

english.title: Down to the Scar
english.objectives: Find Theldurin the Lost at the Scar of the Worldbreaker in the Badlands.
english.description: The Badlands are home to some unusual people, many of whom have been here for quite a long time.$b$bFor example, there were three gentlemen who were staying here in town.  I forget their names... the dwarf was Theldurin, I think?  Anyhow, they headed south with a pack full of ale a couple of days ago, and haven't been heard from since.  I think they were headed to that big scar.$b$bWould you mind checking in on them?  I'd like to make sure that they're alright.
english.completion: They sent you to check up on us?  Pshh... I've been around this desert longer than any of those chumps.  We're just soaking in some of the scenery and telling stories about old times. You like telling stories?

text.title: 皮货商的最爱
text.objectives: 收集5张沙漠土狼毛皮
text.description: 元首对那些表示忠诚的人十分慷慨，我正好知道怎样才能取悦于他。$b$b在建起这支……呃……劳动大军前，他是做动物皮毛生意的。$b$b他在制皮上颇有造诣。哪怕是用最最破烂的皮子，他也能创造出奇迹来。$b$b据说，在东边干涸的绿洲里居住着一些品种稀有的土狼。$b$b它们的毛皮将会是一件心思独到的礼物。
