text.progress: Were you successful in your hunt?
text.completion: Oh, these are exquisite! The commander will be able to make a winter uniform with these.
text.completed: Speak to Belloc Brightblade in Schnottz's Landing.

english.title: A Favor for the Furrier
english.objectives: Collect 5 Desert Coyote Pelts.
english.description: The commander can be most generous to those who demonstrate their loyalty, and I know of something that you can do to curry favor with him.$b$bBefore building up his... ehh... workforce, he dealt in the furs of animals.$b$bHe is quite skilled in the art of leatherworking. The furrier can do wonders with even the most tattered pelts.$b$bThe dried oasis to the east is said to be home to a rare breed of coyote.$b$bTheir furs would make a very thoughtful gift.
english.progress: Were you successful in your hunt?
english.completion: Oh, these are exquisite! The commander will be able to make a winter uniform with these.
english.completed: Speak to Belloc Brightblade in Schnottz's Landing.

text.title: 拉他们下鸟
text.objectives: 使用尖利的肉钩击落4名桑德玛尔狮鹫骑手，并将其击败。
text.description: 一只龙喉幼龙的威力抵得上一打蛮锤狮鹫骑士。他们不过是狮鹫身上的寄生虫，一旦跌下坐骑，这些所谓的骑士就一无是处了。$B$B部落$c，以你这样的实力，也能轻松地解决他们。$B$B狮鹫骑士在溅血谷地以北的河流上空盘旋。趁他们飞近时，抛出这枚弯钩，惯性会将他们甩离坐骑，直直地跌落在你的脚边。消灭他们！你总说部落是如何如何强大，消灭桑德玛尔狮鹫骑手，我就相信你的话。
text.completion: You look a little battered. Those dwarves didn't give you any challenge, did they? Still, that was an impressive show.
text.completed: Return to Narkrall Rakeclaw at Bloodgulch in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Drag 'em Down
english.objectives: Use the Barbed Fleshhook to dismount and kill 4 Thundermar Gryphon Riders.
english.description: A single Dragonmaw drake is worth a dozen Wildhammer gryphon-riders. Take them off of their lice-ridden birds and they're nothing.$B$BEven you can slay them easily, Horde-$c.$B$BHunt gryphon riders flying over the river north of Bloodgulch. Take this hook and fling it at them as they fly by. Their momentum will hurl them from their mount, right to your feet. Finish them! Kill a few Thundermar gryphon riders and I'll believe your Horde is as mighty as you say.
english.completion: You look a little battered. Those dwarves didn't give you any challenge, did they? Still, that was an impressive show.
english.completed: Return to Narkrall Rakeclaw at Bloodgulch in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 毁灭
text.objectives: 寻找瑞亚丝塔萨。
text.description: 海岸已经安全了。如果瑞亚丝塔萨或龙蛋能够奇迹般地躲开死亡之翼的烈焰，那么他们很可能急需你的帮助。
text.completion: Heroes: If you are reading this, then my suspicions were correct.  Deathwing has found us.  The egg is destroyed, as am I. This was, actually, the plan from the beginning.  You see... the egg that Deathwing destroyed was not the egg he sought. It was mine.
text.completed: 在荒芜之地的隐藏的龙巢寻找瑞亚丝塔萨的踪迹。

english.title: Devastation
english.objectives: Search for Rheastrasza.
english.description: The coast is clear.  If Rheastrasza or the egg were able to miraculously evade Deathwing's flames, they would probably need your assistance as soon as possible.
english.completion: Heroes: If you are reading this, then my suspicions were correct.  Deathwing has found us.  The egg is destroyed, as am I. This was, actually, the plan from the beginning.  You see... the egg that Deathwing destroyed was not the egg he sought. It was mine.
english.completed: Search for any sign of Rheastrasza within the Hidden Clutch in the Badlands.

text.title: 地震旷野
text.objectives: 与深岩之洲地震旷野的斯雷特·流沙谈一谈。
text.description: 在你帮助我们之前，先得对付南边石母塞拉赞恩的部队。地震旷野的元素和巨人开始集结了。$B$B它们也在寻求世界之柱中部碎片。它们会在我们同石头穴居人交战时发动进攻，令我们无法反击。$B$B我已经派高阶地占师出发了。去找斯雷特·流沙，按他所说的去做。
text.completion: Good, $r, you're here. We'll have to act fast if we're to prevent Therazane's forces from attacking.

english.title: The Quaking Fields
english.objectives: Speak with Slate Quicksand at the Quaking Fields in Deepholm.
english.description: Before you can help us here, you're going have to deal with Therazane, the Stone Mother's, forces to the south. The elementals and giants upon the Quaking Fields are being mustered.$B$BThey too are after the middle fragment of the World Pillar. They'll attack us amidst our war with the stone troggs and we'll be unable to repel them.$B$BI've sent the arch geomancer ahead. Get to Slate Quicksand and do as he asks.
english.completion: Good, $r, you're here. We'll have to act fast if we're to prevent Therazane's forces from attacking.

text.title: 裂地之斧
text.objectives: 消灭5名碎裂的翡翠巨人。
text.description: 翡翠巨人是石母手下最厉害的生物。一定要优先从战场上除掉它们。我把石父岩幔的斧子带来，就是为了这一刻。用它砍碎那些巨人。$B$B这样它们就会被切成更为合适的大小，让你好收拾。
text.completion: Thank you, $n. Without all of their giants, Therazane's forces will have a harder time taking Stonehearth. Now, if you please, hand back the axe. I'll keep it safe until you can rescue the Stonefather.
text.completed: Return to Slate Quicksand at the Quaking Fields in Deepholm.

english.title: The Axe of Earthly Sundering
english.objectives: Slay 5 Sundered Emerald Colossi.
english.description: The emerald colossi are the greatest of the Stone Mother's creatures. They must be the first to be removed from the field.$B$BI brought Stonefather Oremantle's axe for just this task. Use it to sunder the giants.$B$BThat should bring them down to a more manageable size for you to finish off.
english.completion: Thank you, $n. Without all of their giants, Therazane's forces will have a harder time taking Stonehearth. Now, if you please, hand back the axe. I'll keep it safe until you can rescue the Stonefather.
english.completed: Return to Slate Quicksand at the Quaking Fields in Deepholm.

text.title: 元素矿砂
text.objectives: 收集6份元素矿砂。
text.description: 你一定要对付塞拉赞恩的部队领袖。不过，要想让你安全快捷地到他那里，我必须举行一个仪式。$B$B去野外从狂暴者身上收集一些元素矿砂来。只要一定的数量，我就可以让你与大地融为一体，送你到想去的地方。
text.progress: Have you all that is required?
text.completion: These should do. I'll just need a moment to prepare the ritual.
text.completed: Return to Slate Quicksand at the Quaking Fields in Deepholm.

english.title: Elemental Ore
english.objectives: Collect 6 Elemental Ore.
english.description: You're going to have to deal with the leader of Therazane's forces here. However, to get you to him quickly and safely, I'm going to need to perform a ritual.$B$BGo out into the field and collect elemental ore from the ragers. With enough of it, I should be able to make you one with the ground to get you where you need to go.
english.progress: Have you all that is required?
english.completion: These should do. I'll just need a moment to prepare the ritual.
english.completed: Return to Slate Quicksand at the Quaking Fields in Deepholm.

text.title: 合二为一
text.objectives: 完成合二为一仪式。
text.description: 此处的石母军队领袖，是强大的土元素领主阿瓦兰奇奥。走运的是，暮光之锤邪教徒打算入侵他的巢穴。他们打算把他的元素和他们的意志结合在一起。$B$B我们将利用这混乱的战局。我召唤的大地仪式将让你和土地合二为一。它可以把你神不知鬼不觉地带到阿瓦兰奇奥身边。$B$B把他除掉的任务就交给你了。
text.completion: Now that the ritual is complete and you are near Avalanchion, there's only one thing left to do.
text.turninWindow: 阿瓦兰奇奥就在前面。你知道该怎么做。

english.title: One With the Ground
english.objectives: Complete the One With the Ground ritual.
english.description: The leader of the Stone Mother's forces here is the great earth elemental lord, Avalanchion. Luckily for us, the Twilight's Hammer cultists have decided to invade his lair. They're seeking to bind his elementals to their will.$B$BWe will take advantage of the chaos. The earth ritual that I invoke will make you one with the ground. It will take you near to Avalanchion without alerting him to your presence.$B$BIt's up to you to finish him.
english.completion: Now that the ritual is complete and you are near Avalanchion, there's only one thing left to do.
english.turninWindow: Avalanchion is just ahead. You know what to do.

text.title: 山崩地裂
text.objectives: 杀死阿瓦兰奇奥。
text.description: 阿瓦兰奇奥就站在你面前。杀掉他，阻止塞拉赞恩的军队攻打巨石之炉。
text.completion: You've done what few others could have. Defeating Avalanchion was no small feat. I'm impressed, $n. Will you help us with our war against the stone troggs so that we can rescue the Stonefather?
text.completed: Report back to Crag Rockcrusher at Stonehearth in Deepholm.
text.giverWindow: 杀死他，阻止即将对巨石之炉发动的进攻。

english.title: Bring Down the Avalanche
english.objectives: Slay Avalanchion.
english.description: Avalanchion stands before you. Slay him to keep Therazane's forces from attacking Stonehearth.
english.completion: You've done what few others could have. Defeating Avalanchion was no small feat. I'm impressed, $n. Will you help us with our war against the stone troggs so that we can rescue the Stonefather?
english.completed: Report back to Crag Rockcrusher at Stonehearth in Deepholm.
english.giverWindow: Slay him to prevent the impending attack upon Stonehearth.

text.title: 山崩地裂
text.objectives: 杀死阿瓦兰奇奥。
text.description: 你必须回去杀死阿瓦兰奇奥，不然塞拉赞恩的军队就会攻打巨石之炉！
text.completion: You've done what few others could have. Defeating Avalanchion was no small feat. I'm impressed, $n. Will you help us with our war against the stone troggs so that we can rescue the Stonefather?
text.completed: Report back to Crag Rockcrusher at Stonehearth in Deepholm.
text.giverWindow: 杀死他，阻止即将对巨石之炉发动的进攻。

english.title: Bring Down the Avalanche
english.objectives: Slay Avalanchion.
english.description: You have to go back and slay Avalanchion to keep Therazane's forces from attacking Stonehearth!
english.completion: You've done what few others could have. Defeating Avalanchion was no small feat. I'm impressed, $n. Will you help us with our war against the stone troggs so that we can rescue the Stonefather?
english.completed: Report back to Crag Rockcrusher at Stonehearth in Deepholm.
english.giverWindow: Slay him to prevent the impending attack upon Stonehearth.

text.title: 英雄归来
text.objectives: 觐见深岩之洲巨石之炉的石父岩幔。
text.description: 石父在巨石之炉的南面等你回来。$B$B把自己弄得像样点。你将受到英雄般的欢迎！
text.completion: Our $g hero : heroine; returns!$B$BYou have saved my people, $n. You have earned that which you seek.

english.title: The Hero Returns
english.objectives: Present yourself to Stonefather Oremantle at Stonehearth in Deepholm.
english.description: The Stonefather is waiting for you back south at Stonehearth.$B$BMake yourself presentable. You've earned a heroes welcome!
english.completion: Our $g hero : heroine; returns!$B$BYou have saved my people, $n. You have earned that which you seek.

text.title: 中部碎片
text.objectives: 拿到世界之柱中部碎片。
text.description: 我把巨石之炉的钥匙交给你。有了它，你就可以打开我家的宝库，拿到世界之柱的中部碎片。$B$B要保证碎片的安全，$n。一定要尽快将它送到深岩之洲的大地神殿中心！$B$B这里将永远欢迎你。
text.progress: You've returned. Did you recover the middle fragment?
text.completion: The Middle Fragment of the World Pillar!$B$BThank you, $n. I can only imagine what you had to go through to get this to us. I'll see to it that it's placed within the center of the chamber.
text.completed: Deliver the Middle Fragment of the World Pillar to Earthcaller Yevaa at the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.

english.title: The Middle Fragment
english.objectives: Recover the Middle Fragment of the World Pillar.
english.description: I present you with the key to Stonehearth. With it you may unlock the vault to my home and recover the middle fragment of the World Pillar.$B$BKeep the fragment safe, $n. Make certain to get it to the Temple of Earth in the middle of Deepholm as quickly as possible!$B$BKnow that you are always welcome here.
english.progress: You've returned. Did you recover the middle fragment?
english.completion: The Middle Fragment of the World Pillar!$B$BThank you, $n. I can only imagine what you had to go through to get this to us. I'll see to it that it's placed within the center of the chamber.
english.completed: Deliver the Middle Fragment of the World Pillar to Earthcaller Yevaa at the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.

text.title: 沙漠之狐
text.objectives: 司克诺兹要你把沙漠之狐给他带去。
text.description: 这里还有很多事情要做，$r。$b$b我们都对这里的古代科技抱有极大的热情，对吧？$b$b也许我们可以互相帮助一下？$b$b那么，我们就摒弃彼此之间的误会吧，嗯？$b$b你瞧，东边有一只狡猾的动物，我一直在猎捕它。你能不能把那只动物当做你诚意的表示给我拿来呢？$b$b然后没准我就可以让你参加我的行动……
text.progress: Have you captured zhe Desert Fox, $c?
text.completion: You've done it! Perhaps I can trust you vizh more serious matters, hmm?
text.completed: Speak with Schnottz in Schnottz's Landing.

english.title: The Desert Fox
english.objectives: Schnottz wants you to bring him the Desert Fox.
english.description: Zhere is much to be done in zhis region, $r.$b$bVe bozh haf a burning passion for zhe ancient technologies here, do ve not?$b$bPerhaps zhere is a vay for us to vork togezher?$b$bLet us put zhe misunderstandinks of zhe past behind us zhen, hmm?$b$bNow, zhere is an elusive animal in zhe region to zhe east zhat I have been huntink. Brink me zhis creature as a token of your sincerity, hmm?$b$bZhen maybe I let you in on my operation...
english.progress: Have you captured zhe Desert Fox, $c?
english.completion: You've done it! Perhaps I can trust you vizh more serious matters, hmm?
english.completed: Speak with Schnottz in Schnottz's Landing.

text.title: 肮脏的鸟
text.objectives: 你要杀掉8只染病的兀鹫。
text.description: 干枯的绿洲的天空中充斥着这些可恶的秃鹫。$b$b它们就像是传播疾病的啮齿动物，只不过带着翅膀，这些生物没有一点好处，只会造成难以名状的痛苦。$b$b把这些祸害从天上除掉，让这里变得更加美好。

english.title: Dirty Birds
english.objectives: You are to slay 8 Diseased Vultures.
english.description: The sky above the Shriveled Oasis is littered with these nasty vultures.$b$bLike infectious rodents with wings, these creatures serve no great purpose and inflict untold misery.$b$bRid the skies of this nuisance and leave the region better than you found it.

text.title: 时髦主义
text.objectives: 贝洛克·辉刃要你收集10件步兵制服。
text.description: 我们的军纪十分严明，从不怠慢。$b$b我们的部队要随时穿着制服正装。这有助于管理，避免误伤事故，而且让部队看起来很漂亮！$b$b我们管这叫，时髦主义。$b$b最近我们制服紧缺。我必须要你从阵亡的士兵身上把他们的制服给拿回来。$b$b你可以在东边阿蒙遗迹找到那些可怜的家伙们。
text.progress: Were you able to recover the uniforms we need?
text.completion: Most efficient work, $c. You should rise rapidly through the ranks.
text.completed: Speak to Belloc Brightblade at Schnottz's Landing.

english.title: Fashionism
english.objectives: Belloc Brightblade wants you to collect 10 Trooper Uniforms.
english.description: We have a strict policy among our ranks, one that we take most seriously.$b$bOur troops are to dress in official uniform at all times. This helps with organization, friendly fire incidents are reduced, and it keeps the troops looking wonderful!$b$bWe call it, Fashionism.$b$bWe've been running low on uniforms lately. I must ask that you recover them from the troopers that have fallen in the line of duty.$b$bYou should find plenty of the poor fellows east of here, at the Ruins of Ammon.
english.progress: Were you able to recover the uniforms we need?
english.completion: Most efficient work, $c. You should rise rapidly through the ranks.
english.completed: Speak to Belloc Brightblade at Schnottz's Landing.

text.title: 偶像崇拜
text.objectives: 元首司克诺兹要你收集8尊保存完好的神像。
text.description: 有件事情我要处理，$r。$b$b我最信任的顾问中了远古的诅咒。一种把人变成火鸡的妖术，真没想到！$b$b我已经研究多日，想给他找到解药，我终于做好举行仪式的准备了。$b$b我需要附近废墟里的几尊塑像。你要立刻把它们拿来！$b$b解散！
text.progress: Haff you brought me zhe idols, $r?
text.completion: Zhese look to be of sufficient quality. Vizh zhese, ve are vone shtep closah to zhe cleansink ritual.
text.completed: Speak to Commander Schnottz at Schnottz's Landing.

english.title: Idolatry
english.objectives: Commander Schnottz wants you to collect 8 Well-preserved Idols.
english.description: Zhere is somezhink I need handled, $r.$b$bMy most trusted advisor has run afoul of an ancient curse. A hex zhat has transformed zhe man into a turkey, of all zhings!$b$bI haff studied for days to discover a remedy for his condition, and finally I am ready to conduct zhe ritual.$b$bI vill reqvire several idols from zhe nearby ruins. You are to brink zhem to me at vonce!$b$bDismissed!
english.progress: Haff you brought me zhe idols, $r?
english.completion: Zhese look to be of sufficient quality. Vizh zhese, ve are vone shtep closah to zhe cleansink ritual.
english.completed: Speak to Commander Schnottz at Schnottz's Landing.

text.title: 愤怒的鬼魂
text.objectives: 元首司克诺兹要你用特许质子加速炮收集5份狂怒幽魂精华。
text.description: 在我不得不人道毁灭他之前，温克曼博士都是我最好的研究员之一。$b$b不过，他把他最了不起的成就之一留给了我。在对抗施加一定法术的超自然对手时，这件武器能够吸取目标的精华。$b$b它在我即将举行的仪式中至关重要。$b$b你是问，这事儿和你有什么关系？很简单。你能够有幸来收集素材。$b$b这武器经过校准之后，可以对东边神殿的狂怒的鬼灵产生作用。
text.progress: Vell, little $gman:lady;? Vere you successful?
text.completion: Very goot! You have earned yourself a place at zhe ritual. You shall be among zhe first to velcome Gobbles back to his... original form.
text.completed: Speak to Commander Schnottz in Schnottz's Landing.

english.title: Angered Spirits
english.objectives: Commander Schnottz wants you to use the L.P.A.C. to collect 5 Furious Spectral Essences.
english.description: Doctor Venkman vas vone of my greatest researchers, until he had to be put out of my misery.$b$bHe did leave me vizh vone of his greatest accomplishments, zhough. Against zhe properly attuned supernatural adversary, zhis veapon vill siphon zhe target's essence.$b$bIt is of key importance in zhe ritual I vill be attemptink.$b$bVhere do you come in, you ask? Simple. You have zhe priviledge of collecting zhe material.$b$bZhe veapon is calibrated to vork on zhe Furious Specters in zhe temple to zhe east.
english.progress: Vell, little $gman:lady;? Vere you successful?
english.completion: Very goot! You have earned yourself a place at zhe ritual. You shall be among zhe first to velcome Gobbles back to his... original form.
english.completed: Speak to Commander Schnottz in Schnottz's Landing.

text.title: 削减蜘蛛的数量
text.objectives: 在黑暗森林杀死12名黑暗森林潜伏者。黑暗森林位于此地以西，穿过岛屿中心的桥梁就到。
text.description: 数周来，我们努力想在黑暗森林取得立足之地，但是这片森林里到处都是蜘蛛。帮我个忙吧，如果你能适当削减它们的数量，我们就有机会组织攻击行动了。$b$b当心，有报告称先前有部落军队抵达了此地。
text.progress: 殺蜘蛛的任務進行得如何？
text.completion: 殺蜘蛛的工作做得很好，$n。照這個情況，我們馬上就能攻下這個森林了。
text.completed: Report back to Camp Commander Brack at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.

english.title: Thinning the Brood
english.objectives: Kill 12 Darkwood Lurkers in The Darkwood.  The Darkwood forest is just west of here, across the bridge on the central island.
english.description: We have been trying to get a foothold in The Darkwood for weeks now but that forest is infested with spiders.  Do me a favor and see if you can thin them out enough for us to set up an attack.$b$bCareful out there, I have heard reports of Horde troops nearby earlier in the week.
english.completion: Nice work on those spiders $n.  At this rate, we will be taking that forest in no time.
english.completed: Report back to Camp Commander Brack at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.

text.title: 纯黑的石之心
text.objectives: 取回一块黑钻之心。
text.description: 大地在流血，$c。他们像切割血肉一样撕裂了大地。$B$B暮光教徒自以为行事隐秘，他们指挥元素生物执行各项邪恶的计划，殊不知正是这些元素生物暴露了他们的罪行。东北边的那片废墟就是黑色裂口，去那里寻找黑曜石奴隶。$B$B摧毁它们的躯体，找到一块完美的黑钻之心。我会试着从中剥离出它的灵魂。
text.progress: The heart. A stone heart, of purest black. Have you found one?
text.completion: What have we, what have we - breaches, the breaches number three. Two heads, one wholly given to its master. I see the future. A hammer united. A mountain shattered. Oh - OH!
text.completed: Take the heart to Mallia at Bloodgulch in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Paint it Black
english.objectives: Acquire a Black Diamond Heart.
english.description: The ground bleeds, $c. They tear it open, as one would gouge flesh.$B$BThese cultists relish their secrecy but the very elementals they use for their misdeeds can betray them. Seek out Obsidian Stoneslaves northeast of here, among the ruined earth we have named the Black Breach.$B$BShatter their bodies and find for me a perfect heart of black diamond. I will look into this heart. And I will bare its soul.
english.progress: The heart. A stone heart, of purest black. Have you found one?
english.completion: What have we, what have we - breaches, the breaches number three. Two heads, one wholly given to its master. I see the future. A hammer united. A mountain shattered. Oh - OH!
english.completed: Take the heart to Mallia at Bloodgulch in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 暮光的幻象
text.objectives: 在黑色裂口寻找暮光之眼。
text.description: 古加尔利用强大的魔法宝珠“暮光之眼”来观察爪牙们的动向。$B$B在海加尔山，海加尔的守护者曾经设法找到并操控了其中一颗宝珠。我们也必须这么做。希望我们能透过宝珠，窥探古加尔巢穴的动静。$B$B越过东北方的河流，在黑色裂口寻找暮光之眼。无论如何，都要把它带回来给我！
text.completion: <The Eye sits before you, humming ominously with dark energies.>$B$B<Without warning, the orb rotates, as if to look at you. You sense a malevolent presence, as though the orb is alive.>
text.completed: 在黑色裂口寻找暮光之眼。

english.title: A Vision of Twilight
english.objectives: Locate an Eye of Twilight within the Black Breach.
english.description: Cho'gall keeps track of his minions through powerful magical orbs: "The Eyes of Twilight."$B$BIn Mount Hyjal, the Guardians of Hyjal managed to find and manipulate one to their own ends. We must do the same. I want one of those orbs, and I want to use it to peer into the very heart of Cho'gall's lair.$B$BSearch the Black Breach, across the river to the northeast, and find an Eye of Twilight. Do whatever you need to bring it back to me!
english.completion: <The Eye sits before you, humming ominously with dark energies.>$B$B<Without warning, the orb rotates, as if to look at you. You sense a malevolent presence, as though the orb is alive.>
english.completed: Locate an Eye of Twilight within the Black Breach.

text.title: 粘糊糊的任务
text.objectives: 从黑暗森林的黑暗森林蛛母身上收集4个粘性丝囊。黑暗森林位于此地以西，穿过岛屿中心的桥梁就到。
text.description: 这座岛上很难找到足够的供给，至少过去是这样。$b$b幸运的是，我们发现此地以西的黑暗森林盛产蛛丝。不过呢，只有蛛母的丝囊才能抽出好丝来。我要你收集4个丝囊。$b$b那样应该够我完成最后这批衬衣了吧。
text.progress: Were you able to gather the sticky silk glands?
text.completion: These glands will do nicely.  We are grateful for your help, $n.
text.completed: Report back to Camp Commander Brack at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.

english.title: A Sticky Task
english.objectives: Collect 4 Sticky Silk Glands from Darkwood Broodmother spiders in The Darkwood.  The Darkwood forest is just west of here, across the bridge on the central island.
english.description: Finding supplies on the island has been difficult, to say the least.$b$bFortunately, we have found a good supply of silk in The Darkwood, just west of here.  The bad part of this story is that the silk comes from the glands on Broodmother spiders.  I need you to gather 4 of these for me.$b$bThat should be just enough to finish up this last set of shirts.
english.progress: Were you able to gather the sticky silk glands?
english.completion: These glands will do nicely.  We are grateful for your help, $n.
english.completed: Report back to Camp Commander Brack at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.

text.title: 被遗忘的灵魂
text.objectives: 在遗忘山丘释放6名被折磨的灵魂。用手直接触摸墓碑，即可引导灵魂。遗忘山丘位于正西方，穿过黑暗森林和不眠前线就是了。
text.description: 许多士兵在这座岛上不幸丧命，$n。我们必须尽可能地对亡者表达敬意，才不枉他们的牺牲。$b$b我要你前往正西方的遗忘山丘，令兄弟们被折磨的灵魂得以解脱。要当心，据说那片区域有亡灵出没。
text.progress: 你解放我們的遺民弟兄了嗎？
text.completion: 願他們的靈魂安息。
text.completed: Report back to Lieutenant Farnsworth at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.

english.title: The Forgotten
english.objectives: Release the spirits of 6 tortured souls at Forgotten Hill.  Souls can be channeled by touching your hands directly to the gravestones.  Forgotten Hill is due west of here, past The Darkwood and The Restless Front.
english.description: Many soldiers died on this island $n.  It is only fair that we pay our respects to them in any way that we can.$b$bI need you to travel to Forgotten Hill, due west of here and release our brothers in arms' tortured souls away from this place.  Do be careful over there, reports of undead have been ongoing in the area.
english.completion: May their souls rest in peace.
english.completed: Report back to Lieutenant Farnsworth at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.

text.title: 哥培尔！
text.objectives: 当你做好见证仪式的准备后就跟元首司克诺兹谈一谈。
text.description: 终于！将哥培尔从那可恶的诅咒中解放出来的时候到了！$b$b现在注意了，$r，保持警惕。我举行仪式的时候一定不能有人打扰。$b$b你将周围警戒好了就告诉我！$b$b现在，出发！

english.title: Gobbles!
english.objectives: Schnottz wants you to speak with him when you are prepared to witness the ritual.
english.description: At last! Zhe time has come to set my Gobbles free of zhat nasty curse!$b$bPay attention now, $r, and stay on guard. Zhere can be no interruptions vhile I perform zhe ritual.$b$bLet me know vhen you haf secured zhe perimeter!$b$bNow, move it!

objectiveDetails.description: 见证哥培尔的变形仪式

text.title: 献祭总是必须的
text.objectives: 击败10名漆黑萨满。
text.description: <暮光之眼的“声音”在你四周回荡，仿佛它来自四面八方。>$B$B你想借用我的视域，$r？那就得付出代价。暮光教徒一直献祭蛮锤矮人的精华以示诚意，但我还是很饿。或许你可以做得更好。$B$B击败我的旧主子，我的视域就属于你。献上漆黑萨满的精华吧。精华就是精华。
text.completion: Ah, the succulent thrill of life extinguished. Do you feel it, $c? Do you relish it as I do? No, I see not. You fight to protect the lives of others. Pity.
text.completed: Return to the Eye of Twilight within the Black Breach in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: We All Must Sacrifice
english.objectives: Slay 10 Shaman of the Black.
english.description: <The eye speaks to you, its 'voice' reverberating as if coming from everywhere at once.>$B$BYou seek my sight, $r? My powers come at a price. These disciples of the twilight have been honoring me with the blood of Wildhammer dwarves from the nearby ruins, but still I thirst. Perhaps you can do better.$B$BSlay my old masters, and my vision is yours. Honor me with the slaughter of the Shaman of the Black. Blood is blood, after all.
english.completion: Ah, the succulent thrill of life extinguished. Do you feel it, $c? Do you relish it as I do? No, I see not. You fight to protect the lives of others. Pity.
english.completed: Return to the Eye of Twilight within the Black Breach in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 探险者们
text.objectives: 跟深岩之洲大地神殿的探险者莫维谈一谈。
text.description: 我们探险者协会的一队人就在神殿西北的大厅里。$B$B关于暮光之锤的阴谋，他们最近的呼声日渐升高。$B$B$n，你能不能好心去看看他们有什么需要？
text.completion: Oh gosh! Someone's finally here to help us?

english.title: The Explorers
english.objectives: Speak with Explorer Mowi at the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.
english.description: We have a contingent of the Explorers' League in the chamber just to the northwest inside the temple.$B$BThey've been making increasing noises about something that the Twilight's Hammer is up to.$B$B$n, would you be a dear and see what they need?
english.completion: Oh gosh! Someone's finally here to help us?

text.title: 神圣遗物学会
text.objectives: 跟深岩之洲大地神殿的考察者罗威谈一谈。
text.description: 神殿东北的大厅里有我们的一队神圣遗物学会的会员。$B$B关于暮光之锤的阴谋，他们最近的呼声日渐升高。$B$B$n，你能不能好心去看看他们有什么需要？
text.completion: Ah, it's about time someone came to speak with us on matters most urgent.

english.title: The Reliquary
english.objectives: Speak with Examiner Rowe at the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.
english.description: We have a contingent of the Reliquary in the chamber just to the northeast inside the temple.$B$BThey've been making increasing noises about something that the Twilight's Hammer is up to.$B$B$n, would you be a dear and see what they need?
english.completion: Ah, it's about time someone came to speak with us on matters most urgent.

text.title: 洞察之眼
text.objectives: 将暮光之眼交给暮光高地溅血谷地的半兽人迦罗娜。
text.description: 好吧，$r。你以鲜血换取了我的服务。带我去见半兽人迦罗娜吧。$B$B没错，我已经知道你会带我去见她了。迦罗娜疯狂地寻求复仇，这不是什么秘密。我很乐意目睹这一切的进展。
text.progress: Did you have any luck within the Black Breach?
text.completion: You found one? I've been searching everywhere. Give it here! Some of these eyes are won over with riddles or verse. Others require magic. What did this one demand? Ah, it's no matter. What matters is that it's ours.
text.completed: Take the Eye of Twilight to Garona Halforcen at Bloodgulch in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: The Eyes Have It
english.objectives: Take the Eye of Twilight to Garona Halforcen at Bloodgulch in Twilight Highlands.
english.description: Very well then, $r. You have purchased my services in blood. Take me back to Garona Halforcen.$B$BOh yes, I already know where you're taking me. Garona's relentless quest for vengeance is no secret. It will be a delight to watch it unfold.
english.progress: Did you have any luck within the Black Breach?
english.completion: You found one? I've been searching everywhere. Give it here! Some of these eyes are won over with riddles or verse. Others require magic. What did this one demand? Ah, it's no matter. What matters is that it's ours.
english.completed: Take the Eye of Twilight to Garona Halforcen at Bloodgulch in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 窥视
text.objectives: 凝视暮光之眼。
text.description: 这颗宝珠令我不寒而栗。古加尔利用它们操控爪牙的一举一动，现在轮到暮光之眼为我们服务了。$B$B让我瞧瞧……嗯，雾蒙蒙的。我只能看见你。为什么它只让我看到你呢？$B$B<迦罗娜将暮光之眼递到你面前。>$B$B凝视它，告诉我你看到的景象。窥视古加尔的巢穴！他在做什么？是否有重兵把守？告诉我！
text.completion: You've gone pale, $c. What did the Eye show you? You saw Cho'gall? Wait - Cho'gall saw you? He's watching us? He's watching us right now!? Damn this stupid dark magic! I'm going to have to infiltrate Cho'gall's stronghold myself.
text.completed: Talk to Garona Halforcen at Bloodgulch in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Eye Spy
english.objectives: Peer into the Eye of Twilight for Garona.
english.description: This terrible thing makes my hair stand on end. Cho'gall uses these to control his minions - now it's time to use it against him.$B$BLet me see... hmm, it's all cloudy. All I can see is you. Why is it showing me you?$B$B<Garona sets the eye out in front of her.>$B$BLook into the eye and tell me what you see. Peer into Cho'gall's lair! What is he doing? Is he heavily guarded? Tell me!
english.completion: You've gone pale, $c. What did the Eye show you? You saw Cho'gall? Wait - Cho'gall saw you? He's watching us? He's watching us right now!? Damn this stupid dark magic! I'm going to have to infiltrate Cho'gall's stronghold myself.
english.completed: Talk to Garona Halforcen at Bloodgulch in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 隆克的任务
text.objectives: 从温和的作战傀儡身上获得15个调节过的飞轮。
text.description: 隆克从荒芜之地来。其他的食人魔想让隆克打架。$b$b隆克讨厌打架。隆克想学东西。$b$b隆克在南边看到了机器。齿轮做的机器。$b$b也许你礼貌点，机器会把齿轮分你些？然后也许隆克就可以有一个齿轮，也能学习机器了。
text.progress: You get gears?  How you get them?
text.completion: You didn't... KILL the machines to get these, right?. Right?
text.completed: Return to Lunk at Thorium Advance in Searing Gorge.

english.title: Lunk's Task
english.objectives: Obtain 15 Tempered Flywheels from Tempered War Golems.
english.description: Lunk came from the Badlands.  Other ogres try to make Lunk fight.$b$bLunk hate fighting.  Lunk want to learn.$b$bLunk sees machines to the south.  Machines made of gears.$b$bMaybe if you ask nicely, machines will give you some gears?  Then maybe Lunk can have a gear, and learn about machines too.
english.progress: You get gears?  How you get them?
english.completion: You didn't... KILL the machines to get these, right?. Right?
english.completed: Return to Lunk at Thorium Advance in Searing Gorge.

text.title: 隆克不杀
text.completion: No!  You are the same as Thorium Brotherhood dwarf.$B$B"Kill dwarf.  Kill spider.  Kill machine.  Kill, kill, kill."$B$BLunk come to gorge to go on adventure, not to go on murder spree.$B$BGoodbye, .  You kill too much.

english.title: Lunk No Kill
english.completion: No!  You are the same as Thorium Brotherhood dwarf.$B$B"Kill dwarf.  Kill spider.  Kill machine.  Kill, kill, kill."$B$BLunk come to gorge to go on adventure, not to go on murder spree.$B$BGoodbye, .  You kill too much.

text.title: 有效抗毒剂
text.objectives: 获得14份晶网毒液的样本。
text.description: 隆克走了可真遗憾。我刚开始喜欢有他陪着。$b$b那么好吧，回到正事上来！$b$b远征军里能够硬充军医的，也只有我了，但是我手头抗毒剂短缺。我们需要很多的抗毒剂。$b$b有效抗毒的关键总是来源于毒液本身。从附近的晶网蜘蛛着手应该是个不错的开始。如果你把它们杀掉，或许可以在它们下颚的毒囊里提取到毒液。
text.progress: Well well, you certainly operate quickly!  You do have the venom, right?
text.completion: This... this is way more than I expected.  This will last us for months!
text.completed: Return to Prisanne Dustcropper at Thorium Advance in Searing Gorge.

english.title: A Proper Antivenom
english.objectives: Obtain 14 samples of Glassweb Venom.
english.description: Shame that Lunk left.  I was beginning to enjoy his company.$b$bOh well, back to work!$b$bI'm the closest thing that this expedition has to a medical officer, and I'm running low on antivenom.  We tend to need a lot of antivenom.$b$bThe key to a proper antivenom is ALWAYS to start with the poison itself.  The glassweb spiders nearby should be a good place to start.  If you kill them, you can probably extract some venom from the sacs within their jaws.
english.progress: Well well, you certainly operate quickly!  You do have the venom, right?
english.completion: This... this is way more than I expected.  This will last us for months!
english.completed: Return to Prisanne Dustcropper at Thorium Advance in Searing Gorge.

text.title: 隆克的冒险：蜘蛛骑士
text.objectives: 削弱7只晶网蜘蛛以便隆克可以骑上它们。
text.description: 隆克看你喜欢杀东西。让隆克教你另一个办法。$b$b隆克一直想骑在蜘蛛的背上。隆克喜欢乐子。不过，蜘蛛跑得太快了。总是溜走。$b$b我们同心协力。你和蜘蛛交手，直到它虚弱不堪。然后隆克骑到蜘蛛背上跑一圈。$b$b也许隆克还能给你多收集一些毒液！不用开杀戒！
text.completion: Lunk is very happy that you let him ride on the spiders.  Lunk is also happy that $n was able to do $n's adventures without killing anything.$b$bMaybe Lunk see you later.

english.title: Lunk's Adventure: Spider Rider
english.objectives: Weaken 7 Glassweb Spiders so Lunk can ride them.
english.description: Lunk sees you like to kill things.  Let Lunk teach you another way.$b$bLunk always wanted to ride on spider's back.  Looks like fun.  Spiders move too fast, though.  Always slip away.$b$bWe work together.  You fight spider until it gets weak and tired.  Then Lunk jump on spider's back and ride around.$b$bMaybe Lunk even gather some venom for you!  No have to kill!
english.completion: Lunk is very happy that you let him ride on the spiders.  Lunk is also happy that $n was able to do $n's adventures without killing anything.$b$bMaybe Lunk see you later.

text.title: 越少越好
text.objectives: 消灭10名黑铁地质学家或黑铁巡逻兵。
text.description: 我不是什么战士……我顶多算是个采矿的矮人。杰克和普利斯也一样。还有隆克……好吧，你可能会以为他是个大个儿的打手，可他是我们中最无可救药的胆小鬼。$b$b我的意思是说，你能来真是太好了。$b$b看起来我们瑟银兄弟会很快就要和其他的黑铁矮人开战了。我是认真地在想，咱们是不是能在开打之前，就把他们最棒的人先除掉一些。先从南边的地质学家和巡逻兵下手吧。
text.completion: 谢谢你。
text.completed: Return to Burrian Coalpart at Thorium Advance in Searing Gorge.

english.title: The Fewer, the Better
english.objectives: Slay 10 Dark Iron Geologists or Dark Iron Watchmen.
english.description: I'm not much of a fighter... I'm more of a mining dwarf.  Same goes for Jack and Pris.  And Lunk... well, you'd think he'd be a big fighter, but he's the biggest wimp of all of us.$b$bWhat I'm saying is, it's good that you came here when you did.$b$bIt seems likely that we in the Thorium Brotherhood are going to be fighting the other Dark Iron dwarves soon.  I'm thinking we should pick off some of their finest before the war starts in earnest.  Start with the geologists and watchmen to the south.
english.completion: Thank you.
english.completed: Return to Burrian Coalpart at Thorium Advance in Searing Gorge.

objectiveDetails.description: 杀死黑铁地质学家或巡逻兵

text.title: 格格不入
text.objectives: 获得8只燃灰小鸡。
text.description: 灼热峡谷是个环境极其恶劣的地方。我们周遭可没有大堆毛茸茸的野生动物。$b$b之前我们尝试过圈养一些野生动物，但我们没有足够的食物来喂饱它们。反倒是附近的蜘蛛靠着捕食小鸡变得越来越肥—它们本来就挺危险了。$b$b我们肯定没法一劳永逸的干掉那些蜘蛛，但去捕捉一些小鸡倒是个不错的主意。这样不仅可以喂饱兄弟会，那些小鸡也不必痛苦地死在蜘蛛的毒牙下了。
text.progress: Those poor animals.
text.completion: You've got quick hands if you were able to gather this many in such a short time. Excellent work, $n.  I'll make sure these ones don't go to waste.
text.completed: Return to Burrian Coalpart at Thorium Advance in Searing Gorge.

english.title: Out of Place
english.objectives: Obtain 8 Ash Chickens.
english.description: The gorge is an unforgiving place.  We don't get a whole lot of fuzzy wildlife wandering around here.$b$bWe tried bringing in some wild game, but they haven't fared well at all.  There's just no food for them to eat.  Now the nearby spiders - which were already dangerous - are getting big and fat on chicken meat.$b$bWe'll never get rid of all the spiders, but we can salvage what few chickens remain.  Not only will you be feeding the Brotherhood, you'll be saving them a painful death by spider bite.
english.progress: Those poor animals.
english.completion: You've got quick hands if you were able to gather this many in such a short time. Excellent work, $n.  I'll make sure these ones don't go to waste.
english.completed: Return to Burrian Coalpart at Thorium Advance in Searing Gorge.

text.title: 在峡谷形成之前
text.objectives: 获得玛尔戈的巨角。
text.description: 狂暴的玛尔戈是一只在这附近常能看见的老雷霆蜥蜴。传说在峡谷还没有形成之前，它就生活在这里了。传说还说它吃了我的兄弟巴纳巴斯。$b$b我不管它有多老，从鼻子尖放出的又是什么魔法，我就要它死。为了巴纳巴斯。$b$b它就在南边的悬崖那儿徘徊，你可以到那里找到它。
text.progress: Bring me the horn, $n.
text.completion: Yup, this was Margol's horn alright.  No doubt about it. Barnabas was a digger, like me.  He never stood a chance in combat against the beast.  I'm glad you were here to set things right.
text.completed: Return to Burrian Coalpart at Thorium Advance in Searing Gorge.
text.giverWindow: 灼热峡谷的远古守卫者。

english.title: A Lumbering Relic
english.objectives: Obtain Margol's Gigantic Horn.
english.description: Margol the Rager's an old thunder lizard seen round these parts.  Legend has it that he's been here in the gorge since before it was even a gorge.  Legend also has it that he ate my brother Barnabas.$b$bI don't care how old he is or what kind of magic he shoots out of his nose.  I just want him dead.  For Barnabas' sake.$b$bYou'll find him wandering the cliffs to the south of here.
english.progress: Bring me the horn, $n.
english.completion: Yup, this was Margol's horn alright.  No doubt about it. Barnabas was a digger, like me.  He never stood a chance in combat against the beast.  I'm glad you were here to set things right.
english.completed: Return to Burrian Coalpart at Thorium Advance in Searing Gorge.
english.giverWindow: The ancient warden of Searing Gorge.

text.title: 一个新主人……是谁？
text.objectives: 从煤渣工地的格拉维斯·煤渣手中获得黑铁备忘录。
text.description: $R！你来得正是时候。$b$b消息是这样的：峡谷里的黑铁矮人行为异常，瑟银兄弟会打算查个究竟。工头奥菲斯特不喜欢惊喜。$b$b我们怀疑他们有了一个新的首脑。我有理由相信北边的格拉维斯·煤渣知道他是谁。$b$b即便是在灼热峡谷这里，你的英勇事迹也被人们所传颂，$n。跟煤渣打交道应该不会太难。
text.progress: Any news?
text.completion: Let's see... Overseer Maltorius... we're quite familiar with him and his work. What's this?  The "archduke"?  That sounds promising.
text.completed: Return to Jack Rockleg at Thorium Advance in Searing Gorge.
text.giverWindow: 这名矮人应该知道黑铁发生了什么事。

english.title: A New Master... But Who?
english.objectives: Obtain the Dark Iron Memo from Gravius Grimesilt at Grimesilt Worksite.
english.description: You've arrived just in time.$b$bHere's the skinny: the Dark Iron dwarves in the gorge have been acting strangely, and the Thorium Brotherhood intends to find out why.  Overseer Oilfist doesn't like surprises.$b$bWe suspect that they're following orders from some new leader.  I have reason to believe that Gravius Grimesilt, just south of here, knows who it is.$b$bEven here in Searing Gorge, we've begun to hear tales of your exploits, $n.  You should have no problem with Grimesilt.
english.progress: Any news?
english.completion: Let's see... Overseer Maltorius... we're quite familiar with him and his work. What's this?  The "archduke"?  That sounds promising.
english.completed: Return to Jack Rockleg at Thorium Advance in Searing Gorge.
english.giverWindow: This dwarf should know what's happening with the Dark Irons.

text.title: 挖掘头目锡须
text.objectives: 杀死大熔炉里的黑铁挖掘者和黑铁步兵，直到挖掘头目锡须现身。然后杀掉挖掘头目锡须，拿到他的黑色烬石。
text.description: 煤渣并非我想象得那样高高在上。我们得把他的上司干掉，看看他知道些什么。$b$b那人名叫挖掘头目锡须，负责大熔炉里的黑铁挖掘行动，就在西北边。他的挖掘者和步兵在大熔炉的东边巡逻，没日没夜地朝下挖。$b$b他不经常在现场露脸，不过假如你把他的人杀掉一些，他就不得不出来对付你。
text.progress: If Dinwhisker doesn't have what we seek, I'm not sure what we'll do next.
text.completion: A... an ember?  What is this thing?
text.completed: Return to Jack Rockleg at Thorium Advance in Searing Gorge.
text.giverWindow: 锡须是煤渣的上级。希望他知道得多一点。

english.title: Dig-Boss Dinwhisker
english.objectives: Kill Dark Iron Excavators and Dark Iron Footmen within the Cauldron until Dig-Boss Dinwhisker appears.  Then slay Dig-Boss Dinwhisker and obtain his Dark Ember.
english.description: Grimesilt wasn't as high up on the chain as I thought.  We'll have to take out his superior and find out what he knows.$b$bDig-Boss Dinwhisker's his name, and he runs the Dark Iron digging operations within the Cauldron, just northwest of here.  His excavators and footmen patrol the eastern side of the Cauldron, digging downward, day and night.$b$bHe's not known to show his face out in the field very often, but if you slay enough of his men, he'll be forced to come out and deal with you.
english.progress: If Dinwhisker doesn't have what we seek, I'm not sure what we'll do next.
english.completion: A... an ember?  What is this thing?
english.completed: Return to Jack Rockleg at Thorium Advance in Searing Gorge.
english.giverWindow: Dinwhisker is Grimesilt's superior.  Hopefully he has more information.

text.title: 瑟银哨塔：兄弟会的所在
text.objectives: 去找灼热峡谷瑟银哨塔的奥菲斯特。
text.description: 你……你看见了吗？这就是我们一直在找的缺失的那一块！我们得把这消息带给瑟银哨塔的人。$b$b虽然众所周知，黑铁矮人过去一直都与火焰领主有所来往，但他们还从未将火焰元素的势力扩大到灼热峡谷如此之广的范围。$b$b瑟银哨塔就在这里的西北面。你可以发现它就坐落于可以俯瞰漫火平原的峭壁上。把这份信息直接交到工头奥菲斯特手上。
text.completion: Do I know you, $r? Sounds like another one of Ragnaros' minions.  I don't like the sound of that.

english.title: Thorium Point: The Seat of the Brotherhood
english.objectives: Report to Overseer Oilfist at Thorium Point in Searing Gorge.
english.description: Did... did you see that?  This is the missing piece we've been looking for!  We have to take this information back to someone at Thorium Point.$b$bThe Dark Irons have been known to consort with the firelord in the past, but never before have they brought their kind this far out into Searing Gorge.$b$bThorium Point is west and north of here.  You will find it nestled in the cliffs that overlook Pyrox Flats.  Take this information straight to Overseer Oilfist.
english.completion: Do I know you, $r? Sounds like another one of Ragnaros' minions.  I don't like the sound of that.

text.title: 回收残骸
text.objectives: 你要从居住在遗忘山丘的食尸鬼那里取回9根被诅咒腿骨。遗忘山丘位于岛屿西侧，穿过遗忘前线就是了。
text.description: 自从我们夺回这座凄凉的岛屿后，僵尸和食尸鬼就一直在遗忘山丘肆虐。好几次我们都想彻底清理这些家伙，但他们还是三番五次地卷土重来。$b$b有一位中尉指出，杀死食尸鬼后应该取走大腿骨，这样他们就不能在夜里复生了。你能帮我们处理一下这件事吗？
text.progress: Were you able to recover the femur bones?  Better for you to try than me.
text.completion: I didn't think you would be able to do it, $n.  You are just full of surprises aren't you?
text.completed: Report back to Lieutenant Farnsworth at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.

english.title: Salvaging the Remains
english.objectives: You need to recover 9 Cursed Femur bones from the ghouls that inhabit Forgotten Hill.  Forgotten Hill is on the west side of the island, just past The Forgotten Front.
english.description: Forgotten Hill has been overrun with zombies and ghouls ever since we reclaimed this wretched isle.  We have tried to clear them out many times but they always seem to come back.$b$bOne of our lieutenants recommended taking the ghouls' bones when we kill them in hopes that they can't reincarnate overnight.  Think you can help us out with this one?
english.progress: Were you able to recover the femur bones?  Better for you to try than me.
english.completion: I didn't think you would be able to do it, $n.  You are just full of surprises aren't you?
english.completed: Report back to Lieutenant Farnsworth at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.

text.title: 康纳中尉
text.objectives: 在遗忘山丘找到并杀死康纳中尉。遗忘山丘位于岛屿的极西侧。
text.description: 第一次听说康纳中尉时，我还是个暴风城监狱的年轻新兵。我们都不曾料到他会死在托尔巴拉德。不幸的是，他的灵魂依然在这座凄凉的岛上游荡并制造混乱，扰乱我军的士气。$B$B我要你结束他的……以及我们的痛苦。
text.completion: Hey, you made it back alive!  Can't say you were the first one to try this task, but you are definitely the first one to make it back alive.
text.completed: Report back to Lieutenant Farnsworth at Baradin Base Camp once you have dealt with Connor.
text.giverWindow: 没人想死在这里，但是天不遂人愿啊。

english.title: First Lieutenant Connor
english.objectives: Find and kill First Lieutenant Connor at Forgotten Hill.  You will find Forgotten Hill on the far west side of the island.
english.description: The first time I heard about Lt. Connor, I was just a young recruit in the Stormwind stockades.  None of us could believe he ended up here on Tol Barad.  Sadly, he still roams these wretched islands, wreaking havoc on our troops morale.$b$bI need you to put an end to his misery... and ours.
english.completion: Hey, you made it back alive!  Can't say you were the first one to try this task, but you are definitely the first one to make it back alive.
english.completed: Report back to Lieutenant Farnsworth at Baradin Base Camp once you have dealt with Connor.
english.giverWindow: No one wanted to end up here, but we don't always get what we want.

text.title: 狼群之怒
text.objectives: 杀死高弗雷勋爵。
text.description: 啊，胜利的甜蜜味道！我的人眼下应该正在把高弗雷撕成碎片。去他的老巢拿属于你的战利品吧——你当之无愧！$B$B本以为他会更难对付一点的呢……
text.completion: We did it, $n! At terrible cost...but victory is ours. This keep could serve well as a home for me and my pack, though we tend to prefer more natural habitats. It may be best to leave it as a reminder of Godfrey's betrayal and of the Bloodfang warriors that died here in battle.
text.completed: Return to Packleader Ivar Bloodfang.
text.giverWindow: 为了血牙！

english.title: Fury of the Pack
english.objectives: Kill Lord Godfrey.
english.description: Ah, the sweet scent of victory! My men should be tearing Godfrey to pieces even as we speak. Go up to his domain and collect your share of the spoils - you've earned it!$B$BYou'd think that he would have been more difficult to defeat...
english.completion: We did it, $n! At terrible cost...but victory is ours. This keep could serve well as a home for me and my pack, though we tend to prefer more natural habitats. It may be best to leave it as a reminder of Godfrey's betrayal and of the Bloodfang warriors that died here in battle.
english.completed: Return to Packleader Ivar Bloodfang.
english.giverWindow: For the Bloodfang!

text.title: 派上用场
text.objectives: 元首司克诺兹要你说服6名懈怠的劳工认真工作。
text.description: 我们会怀念哥培尔的，但任务不能受影响。$b$b也许你还可以做点什么来弥补一下。$b$b拿上一件你找回来的制服。穿上它，我的工人就不会表现得过于……进攻性。$b$b最近，他们的士气有点低落。有些工人拒绝干活。$b$b真是狗胆包天！$b$b去找到这些懒惰的蠢货，让他们知道，不干活就吃不了兜着走！
text.completion: Vell done, $c. Zhere may be hope for you yet.
text.completed: Speak to Commander Schnottz in Schnottz's Landing.

english.title: Make Yourself Useful
english.objectives: Commander Schnottz wants you to persuade 6 Slacking Laborers to get to work.
english.description: Gobbles vill be sorely missed, but zhe mission must not suffer.$b$bPerhaps zhere is somezhink you can do to redeem yourself.$b$bTake vone of zhe uniforms you recovered. Vhile vearink it, my vorkers vill not behave so... aggressively.$b$bLately, zheir morale has been a bit lackink. Some of zhe vorkers are refusing to perform zheir labors.$b$bAuch, zhe audacity!$b$bFind zhese lazy imbeciles and convince zhem zhat zhey must get to vork... or else!
english.completion: Vell done, $c. Zhere may be hope for you yet.
english.completed: Speak to Commander Schnottz in Schnottz's Landing.

text.title: P·哈里斯船长
text.objectives: 杀死失落希望海角的P·哈里斯船长。失落希望海角位于此地以西北的海边，找到船只残骸就是了。
text.description: 在托尔巴拉德的这几周，失落希望海角一直是我们的伤心地。半数的供给船只在那里触礁沉没。$b$b更糟糕的是，一群亡灵船员占领了海角。我们试图削减他们的数量，但是这帮家伙还是三番五次地折返。我们只能采取终极手段了，就是除掉他们的船长。你可以在海边的船只上找到他。$b$b哦，希望你不怎么怕鲨鱼。
text.progress: 你有看到那隻巨大的鯊魚嗎？如果我是你的話，我絕對不會靠近牠身邊50碼以內。
text.completion: 你做到了!也許我們現在終於可以讓船隻進港了。謝謝你 $n。
text.completed: Report back to Camp Commander Brack at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.
text.giverWindow: 杀死船长，他的爪牙们就会一哄而散了。

english.title: Captain P. Harris
english.objectives: You have been tasked with killing Captain P. Harris at the Cape of Lost Hope.  The Cape of Lost Hope can be found northwest of here, along the coast.  Just look for the shipwrecks.
english.description: The Cape of Lost Hope has been a sore in our side for weeks here on Tol Barad.  Half of our supply ships end up on the rocks down there.$b$bTo make matters worse, it's been overrun by a gang of undead sailors.  We have tried thinning the ranks, but they just seem to keep coming back.  Our last resort is to try and take out the captain that they report to.  You should be able to find him on a ship, just off the shoreline.$b$bOh, and I hope you are not too scared of sharks.
english.completion: You did it!  Maybe we can finally get some ships into port now.  Thank you $n.
english.completed: Report back to Camp Commander Brack at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.
english.giverWindow: Take out the captain, and his minions will fall.

text.title: 激怒敌人
text.objectives: 营地协调员巴拉克要你在失落希望海角杀死8名海难水手。失落希望海角位于此地西北的海边。
text.description: 这些日子里，我们跟失落希望海角的亡灵冲突不断。船只一旦沉没，他们的队伍就愈发壮大了。$b$b你能帮我们削减亡灵的数量吗？我知道你不可能杀光他们，但是在这节骨眼上，稍微削减敌人的数量也是很有帮助的。$b$b小心部落，有报告称他们近来一直在海滩活动。
text.completion: Nice work on the undead up there $n.  We really appreciate the help.
text.completed: Report back to Camp Commander Brack at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.

english.title: Rattling Their Cages
english.objectives: Camp Coordinator Brack has asked you to kill 8 Shipwrecked Sailors at the Cape of Lost Hope.  The cape is located due northwest of here, on the beach.
english.description: We have been having issues with the undead down at the Cape of Lost Hope for a while now.  Every time a new ship wrecks, they end up getting more undead to join their ranks.$b$bCan you do us a favor and thin out the ranks up there?  I know you won't be able to kill them all, but anything you can do will help at this point.$b$bKeep an eye out for horde, we have been getting reports of them ambushing the beach lately.
english.completion: Nice work on the undead up there $n.  We really appreciate the help.
english.completed: Report back to Camp Commander Brack at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.

text.title: 鼓舞士气
text.objectives: 从失落希望海角的船只残骸中取回6桶南海朗姆酒。失落希望海角位于此地以北的海边。
text.description: 最近我方的士气十分低迷，$n。我们想尽了办法来振奋大家的精神，但是鼓舞士气的重要供给……朗姆酒就快喝光了。$b$b我接到了来自前线的步兵的报告，据说失落希望海角的船只残骸中储有大量的南海朗姆酒。你能去那里调查一下吗？$b$b如果找到朗姆酒，就带回来吧。
text.progress: Were you able to recover the rum?  I would try but I am deathly afraid of the water.  Not to mention that crazy shark.
text.completion: This rum will really help us out, $n.  They might not feel great in the morning but at least they will go to sleep happy.
text.completed: Report back to Camp Coordinator Brack at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.

english.title: Boosting Morale
english.objectives: You have been asked to recover 6 Barrels of Southsea Rum from the shipwrecks on the Cape of Lost Hope.  The cape can be found north of here, along the coast.
english.description: Morale is low these days, $n.  We make every effort we can to keep the troops in high spirits but we are running low on our main supply of morale booster... rum.$b$bI have been getting reports from our infantry to the south that the shipwrecks on the Cape of Lost Hope still have a good supply of southsea rum in their wrecked hulls.  Can you head up there and investigate?$b$bBring back any rum you can find.
english.progress: Were you able to recover the rum?  I would try but I am deathly afraid of the water.  Not to mention that crazy shark.
english.completion: This rum will really help us out, $n.  They might not feel great in the morning but at least they will go to sleep happy.
english.completed: Report back to Camp Coordinator Brack at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.

text.title: 当心鬼魂！
text.objectives: 格雷中士要你从维尔松船坞取回15片船坞木料。维尔松船坞位于此地西北方的海岸上，你可以从那里的鬼魂身上找到木料。
text.description: 你去过维尔松船坞吗，$n？除非你有充分的理由，否则别轻易涉足。不幸的是，我正需要你去那里跑一趟。$b$b自从我们夺回岛屿以来，供给就一直处于短缺状态。那座满是鬼魂的船坞储有很多木料，我们曾经派了好些人去收集木料，但是他们都没能回来。$b$b你能帮帮我们吗？
text.progress: 那些鬼嚇到你了嗎？
text.completion: 我沒想到你真的能辦到，$n。你的能力真是讓人讚嘆，不是嗎？
text.completed: Report back to Sergeant Gray at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.

english.title: Watch Out For Splinters!
english.objectives: Sergeant Gray has asked you to recover 15 pieces of Shipyard Lumber from the Wellson Shipyard.  The lumber can be recovered from the ghosts in the shipyard or found lying around the premises.  The shipyard can be found northwest of here, on the coast.
english.description: Have you been over to the Wellson Shipyard yet, $n?  Best to stay away from there unless you have a good reason to venture in.  Unfortunately, that is exactly what I need you to do.$b$bYou see, we have been short on supplies ever since we recaptured the island.  That ghost ridden shipyard is overflowing with lumber but every time we send an escort to recover the lumber, they never make it back.$b$bCan you help us out?
english.progress: Did the ghosts scare you off?
english.completion: I didn't think you would be able to do it, $n.  You are just full of surprises aren't you?
english.completed: Report back to Sergeant Gray at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.

text.title: 这是我们的土地
text.objectives: 击败灰葬男爵。
text.description: 你以为一帮狼人的乌合之众就能阻止我了吗？哈！$B$B既然影牙城堡从前是洛丹伦王国的领地，那么现在也应当是被遗忘者的墓地。高弗雷和他的帮凶最多只是小障碍，我们自然很乐意把这些不忠于黑暗女王的祸害除掉。$B$B灰葬男爵驻守在城堡前方，毫无防备。第一个目标要选对，不是么？
text.completion: Ah, very well done! They've gotten a hold of powerful allies, but clearly nothing a $c-champion of the Banshee Queen can't handle!
text.completed: Return to Deathstalker Commander Belmont.
text.giverWindow: 轻松拿下一城。

english.title: This Land is Our Land
english.objectives: Kill Baron Ashbury.
english.description: Did you think that a handful of worgen vermin could stop me? Hah!$B$BShadowfang Keep was part of the Lordaeron kingdom in life, so it is quite fitting that it should belong to the Forsaken in death. Godfrey and his accomplices are minor obstacles at best, and of course we're all happy to take them out for their treachery against the Dark Lady.$B$BAshbury has positioned himself near the front of the keep, leaving him wide open to attack. Start us out on the right foot, would you?
english.completion: Ah, very well done! They've gotten a hold of powerful allies, but clearly nothing a $c-champion of the Banshee Queen can't handle!
english.completed: Return to Deathstalker Commander Belmont.
english.giverWindow: An easy first target.

starters.name: 死亡猎手指挥官贝尔蒙特

enders.name: 死亡猎手指挥官贝尔蒙特

text.title: 通缉令：工头维尔松
text.objectives: 杀死维尔松船坞的工头维尔松。维尔松船坞位于此地西北方，就在西部的海岸上。
text.description: 工头维尔松一直是我们的心头大患。他的船坞拥有大量物资储备，如果我们有办法拿到的话……那些东西都可以派上大用场。$B$B他手下的爪牙防范严密，我们很难在船坞取得落脚点。我要你这次彻底除掉维尔松。当心，$n，有报告称可恶的部落在这片区域活动。
text.completion: Great work $n.  I will report your efforts to our highest in command immediately.
text.completed: Report back to Sergeant Gray at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.
text.giverWindow: 曾经不可一世的工头维尔松，已然失宠。

english.title: WANTED: Foreman Wellson
english.objectives: Kill Foreman Wellson at the Wellson Shipyard.  The shipyard can be found northwest of here, on the western coast.
english.description: Foreman Wellson has been a pain in our side since we got here.  His shipyard holds a large amount of supplies that would be extremely useful to us... if we could get to them.$b$bHe keeps a close watch over his minions and makes it very difficult for us to get a foothold on the shipyard.  I need you to take out Wellson for good this time.  Be careful $n, we have been receiving reports of filthy Horde all around the area.
english.completion: Great work $n.  I will report your efforts to our highest in command immediately.
english.completed: Report back to Sergeant Gray at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.
english.giverWindow: Once a great man, Foreman Wellson has fallen from grace.

text.title: 都怪这些胖手指
text.objectives: 摧毁15座重型作战傀儡。
text.description: 不幸的是，我不像以前那么能打了，都是这胖手指的错。你瞧，这儿的气候加上气压低下，让我的手指水肿不堪。它们就好像是巨型的塞尔萨玛血肠，它们就是……$B$B你得帮我执行我的计划。$B$B头一件事：把峡谷的那些重型作战傀儡捣个稀巴烂。动手干吧。
text.completion: 你是个优秀的$G小夥子:姑娘;，真的。我会报答你一样礼物。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Hansel Heavyhands at Thorium Point in Searing Gorge.

english.title: Curse These Fat Fingers
english.objectives: Kill 12 Heavy War Golems.
english.description: Unfortunately, I can't dish out the beats like I used to, due to this here fat finger problem.  Ye see, the climate out here combined with the lack o' air pressure makes me fingers expand.  They're like gigantic Thelsamar Blood Sausages, they are...$B$BYe're gonna have to carry out me orders of business and what have ye.$B$BFirst on me agenda: Poundin' the livin' daylights out o' the heavy war golems o' the Gorge.  Get crackin'.
english.completion: Ye're a good lad, ye are. I got ye a lil' present fer yer troubles.
english.completed: Return to Hansel Heavyhands at Thorium Point in Searing Gorge.

text.title: 侦察必需品
text.objectives: 把冶炼鼓风机和侦察员的望远镜找到并带回来。
text.description: 我们以前在这里有很多东西的。我记得有个望远镜，还有一个冶炼鼓风机在这儿。$b$b我很肯定它们被黑铁矮人偷走了。是的，我知道我是一个黑铁矮人！我说的是住在峡谷里的那些坏矮人。$B$B你最好去问问那些在南边干活的锻造师。他们很有可能在用类似的工具。
text.progress: 如果你是来领取奖励的，那麽你必须把被盗的物品交给我。
text.completion: Fantastic work!
text.completed: Return to Taskmaster Scrange at Thorium Point in Searing Gorge.

english.title: Recon Essentials
english.objectives: Find and return the Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass.
english.description: We used to have more stuff around here.  I think there was a spyglass somewhere nearby, along with a smithing tuyere.$b$bI'm pretty certain that they've been stolen by Dark Iron dwarves.  Yes, I know that I'm a Dark Iron dwarf!  I'm talking about the bad ones that live down in that gorge.$B$BYou'd best check the steamsmiths that work just south of here.  They'd be most likely to use tools like these.
english.progress: If you're here for the reward, you're gonna have to give me the stolen goods.
english.completion: Fantastic work!
english.completed: Return to Taskmaster Scrange at Thorium Point in Searing Gorge.

text.title: 鬼魂毁灭者
text.objectives: 前往营地东北的拉尔戈的瞭望台杀死任意14只鬼魂。
text.description: 看见营地那边的山丘了吗？那就是拉尔戈的瞭望台，紧挨着它扎营真不是什么好事。自从我们搭建营地以来，鬼魂生物就一直来滋事。$b$b你能去那里教训一下它们吗？让它们知道，我们可不打算撤离。削减鬼魂的数量，它们就会规矩一点了。$b$b先谢谢你的帮助啊，$n。
text.progress: 誰怕鬼呀？我才不怕。嗯，可能天黑的時候會稍微怕一點。
text.completion: 幹得好，$n!我們很快就不會聽見那些鬼叫的聲音了。
text.completed: Report back to Sergeant Gray at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.

english.title: Ghostbuster
english.objectives: Kill 14 ghosts of any type at Largo's Overlook, just northeast of base camp.
english.description: See that hill just beyond our base camp?  That's Largo's Overlook and it's not a fun place to setup camp next to.  We have been dealing with those spirits and spectres ever since we setup base camp.$b$bCan you head up there and let them know we don't plan on leaving anytime soon?  A few good kills on their ranks should put them in line.$b$bThanks for your help on this, $n.
english.completion: Great work, $n!  We should not hear from the ghosts again anytime soon.
english.completed: Report back to Sergeant Gray at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.

objectiveDetails.description: 杀死拉尔戈的瞭望台周围的鬼魂

text.title: 黑暗议会
text.objectives: 获得奇乌比之球、莱萨里奥之球，以及芬尼斯特之球，将它们组成暮光三色宝珠。
text.description: 我还有一个任务要交给你。这个任务是从工头那儿直接交代下来的。看来他对还没有找到“大公”这件事十分震惊。$b$b他要我们除掉在西边观火岭处作业的三名暮光官员。他们是奇乌比、莱萨里奥，以及芬尼斯特，每人都带着某种特殊的石头。把三块石头组合在一起，然后带回来。$b$b听好了，如果工头下令，那你就别多问。干就是了。
text.progress: Ye got the thing?
text.completion: This thing is strange, $n.  I don't know what to make of it.  It ain't natural, that's for sure.
text.completed: Return to Hansel Heavyhands at Thorium Point in Searing Gorge.

english.title: Dark Ministry
english.objectives: Obtain Kiyuubi's Spherule, Letherio's Spherule, and Finister's Spherule, then combine them into a Twilight Tripetricine.
english.description: I got one more assignment for ye.  This one comes straight down from the Overseer himself.  Seems he was pretty shook up once he heard about that "Archduke" ye discovered.$b$bHe's asked for us to hunt down three Twilight ministers that work over in Firewatch Ridge, to the west.  Kiyuubi, Letherio, and Finister are their names, and they each carry some sort o' special rock.  Combine all three and bring 'em back here.$b$bListen, when the Overseer gives orders, ye don't ask questions.  Ye just do it.
english.progress: Ye got the thing?
english.completion: This thing is strange, $n.  I don't know what to make of it.  It ain't natural, that's for sure.
english.completed: Return to Hansel Heavyhands at Thorium Point in Searing Gorge.

text.title: 必须消灭蜘蛛
text.objectives: 杀死灼热峡谷的15只熔岩蜘蛛。
text.description: 正常大小的蜘蛛，我可以对付。$b$b巨型晶网蜘蛛让我不舒服，可它们还远不是我要担心的。$b$b但是熔岩蜘蛛呢？<洛洛尔耸了耸肩。> 熔岩蜘蛛太吓人了。它们是超大型的蜘蛛。还住在熔岩里。$b$b我刚拿到上星期的饷，我会付你一大笔钱，让你去把它们杀掉。灼热峡谷里到处都是。
text.completion: There's no way you coulda killed all the spiders in the gorge, but you definitely made a dent. Fine, here's what I promised ya.  Don't spend it all in one place.  Unless it's at Thorium Point.
text.completed: Return to Lookout Captain Lolo Longstriker at Thorium Point in Searing Gorge.

english.title: The Spiders Have to Go
english.objectives: Slay 9 Lava Spiders within Searing Gorge.
english.description: Normal-size spiders, I can handle.$b$bGiant glassweb spiders make me uncomfortable, but they're far enough away that I don't worry too much.$b$bBut lava spiders?  <Lolo shudders.>  Lava spiders are SCARY.  They're enormous spiders.  That live in LAVA.$b$bI just got paid for my last week of work, and I'll pay you well to kill those things.  You'll find 'em all over Searing Gorge.
english.completion: There's no way you coulda killed all the spiders in the gorge, but you definitely made a dent. Fine, here's what I promised ya.  Don't spend it all in one place.  Unless it's at Thorium Point.
english.completed: Return to Lookout Captain Lolo Longstriker at Thorium Point in Searing Gorge.

text.title: 强火不灭
text.objectives: 收集10个充焰锻炉烧瓶。你必须在灼热峡谷对活着的元素身上使用锻炉烧瓶。
text.description: 我们打铁，我们熔钢，我们弄到蜘蛛肉就烤起来。运气好的话还有灌木小鸡。我的意思是，这么多的工作，意味着我们需要大量的火力。$b$b幸运的是，我们不偏不倚，正好位于火城的中央。$b$b当然了，最好的火还是来自于元素。灼热峡谷到处都是，但它们总是位于熔岩附近。给，带上这个瓶子，在元素身上使用。$b$b哦，我有没有提到，你提取样本的时候，元素一定要是活着的？
text.progress: Oilfist says he's gonna have us makin' firebombs soon.  All the more need for those flasks.
text.completion: Yeeeeeeowch!  Don't just go puttin' this stuff into a dwarf's open hand.  This stuff is burnin' up! Now me hands are gonna get even more swollen...
text.completed: Return to Hansel Heavyhands at Thorium Point in Searing Gorge.

english.title: Heat That Just Don't Quit
english.objectives: Obtain 10 Filled Furnace Flasks.  You must use the Furnace Flasks on living elementals within Searing Gorge.
english.description: We smith, we smelt, we roast up whatever spider meat we can get.  Bush chicken if we're lucky.  Point is, all o' this work means we need lots and lots of fire.$b$bGood thing we're smack dab in the middle of firetown.$b$bO' course, the best fire comes from the elementals.  You'll find 'em all over Searing Gorge, but always near lava.  Here, take these flasks and use 'em on the elementals.$b$bOh, did I mention the elementals gotta be alive when you gather your sample?
english.progress: Oilfist says he's gonna have us makin' firebombs soon.  All the more need for those flasks.
english.completion: Yeeeeeeowch!  Don't just go puttin' this stuff into a dwarf's open hand.  This stuff is burnin' up! Now me hands are gonna get even more swollen...
english.completed: Return to Hansel Heavyhands at Thorium Point in Searing Gorge.

text.title: 暮光颈环
text.objectives: 收集20个暮光颈环。
text.description: 你看见那些暮光之锤邪教徒佩戴的夸张项链了吗？上面的宝石比汉瑟尔的拳头还要大！$b$b只要几颗那种汉堡大小的宝石，我就能让铁匠生意步入下一个新高度。给我弄点项圈来，我不会让你白干的。
text.progress: A ruby-hilted hammer... it has a nice ring to it.
text.completion: Hmm... the gems looked... sparklier from afar.  Up close, they look kind of dingy. Ah well!  A little spit and polish should do the trick, and if not, I can use 'em to practice my disenchanting.
text.completed: Return to Master Smith Burninate at Thorium Point in Searing Gorge.

english.title: Twilight Collars
english.objectives: Obtain 20 Twilight Collars.
english.description: Have ye seen the ridiculous necklaces those Twilight's Hammer cultists all wear?  The gems on those things are bigger than Hansel's fist!$b$bA few hamburger-sized jewels like that, and Burninate over there could really push his blacksmithing business to the next level.  Fetch those collars, and he'll make it worth your while.
english.progress: A ruby-hilted hammer... it has a nice ring to it.
english.completion: Hmm... the gems looked... sparklier from afar.  Up close, they look kind of dingy. Ah well!  A little spit and polish should do the trick, and if not, I can use 'em to practice my disenchanting.
english.completed: Return to Master Smith Burninate at Thorium Point in Searing Gorge.

text.title: 隆克的冒险：昏昏欲睡的小矮人
text.objectives: 削弱7名黑铁锻造师，以便隆克可以让他们睡着。
text.description: 你在干嘛？你为什么要杀人？你要从矮人身上拿东西？啊，隆克明白了。隆克有个更好的办法。$b$b听好：你去和矮人打，但是不要杀掉！一直打到矮人累了。然后隆克就帮忙让矮人睡着。矮人们脾气那么不好可能是因为他们睡不好。$b$b来吧！相信隆克。
text.completion: Dwarfs is going to sleep good tonight.$b$bLunk hopes you got everything you were looking for.  Now time to go off and find other adventures.$b$bBye!

english.title: Lunk's Adventure: Cranky Little Dwarfs
english.objectives: Weaken 7 Dark Iron Steamsmiths so Lunk can help them fall asleep.
english.description: What you doing?  Why you kill?$b$bYou need to get things from dwarfs?  Ah, Lunk understand.  Lunk have a better way.$b$bListen: you go fight dwarf, but do not kill!  Just fight until dwarf get tired.  Then Lunk will help dwarf fall asleep.  Dwarfs probably just cranky because they don't get sleep.$b$bCome on!  Trust Lunk.
english.completion: Dwarfs is going to sleep good tonight.$b$bLunk hopes you got everything you were looking for.  Now time to go off and find other adventures.$b$bBye!

text.title: 月棘的故事
text.objectives: 听萨麦尔讲他的故事。
text.description: 你愿意协助我吗，凡人？听听我的故事吧。
text.completion: 我可以在这只笼子里听天由命，但祈祷文必须要被发现!$B$B
text.completed: 去灼热峡谷，找观火岭的萨麦尔·月棘。

english.title: Lunthistle's Tale
english.objectives: Hear Zamael tell his tale.
english.description: Will you assist me, mortal? Hear my tale.
english.completion: I have accepted my fate here in this cage, but the prayer must be found.
english.completed: Return to Zamael Lunthistle at Firewatch Ridge in Searing Gorge.

text.title: 艾露恩祷言
text.objectives: 找到并阅读艾露恩祷言。
text.description: 你愿意协助我吗，凡人？你愿意帮助我找到艾露恩祷言吗？$B$B正如我所说，祷言被刻在一块黄金石板上。我相信他们把它锁在污秽的箱子里了，就在山岭底部洞穴的入口附近。$B$B如果你拿回我的祷言，不要把它带回来。相反，花点时间阅读它。$b$b考虑到我所犯下的罪行，要求宽恕也许太过奢侈，但我不会放弃希望。
text.progress: <You glance over the night elf's prayer.>
text.completion: As your eyes pass over the words of Zamael's prayer, you feel the tablet grow lighter.$b$bA wave of warmth passes over you, and the tablet is gone.

english.title: Prayer to Elune
english.objectives: Find and read the Prayer to Elune.
english.description: Will you assist me, mortal?  Will you find the prayer to Elune?$B$BAs I stated, the prayer was etched onto a golden tablet.  I believe they hold it within one of their vile chests, near the entrance to their cave at the bottom of the ridge.$B$BIf you do recover my prayer, don't bring it back to me.  Instead, take the time to read through it.$b$bAbsolution may be asking too much, based on the sins I've committed.  But that won't stop me from holding out hope.
english.progress: <You glance over the night elf's prayer.>
english.completion: As your eyes pass over the words of Zamael's prayer, you feel the tablet grow lighter.$b$bA wave of warmth passes over you, and the tablet is gone.

text.title: 在山丘领主的大厅里
text.objectives: 与灼热峡谷铸铁峰的山丘领主伦达恩谈谈。
text.description: 瑟银兄弟会并没有自己的武装——除了几个守卫，还有我，没了。如果想要成功突袭峡谷里的黑铁矮人，我们还需要些帮手。$b$b山丘领主伦达恩就在峡谷南边的那座塔顶上。他没有和暮光教徒或者火元素勾结，但也没有加入兄弟会。也许现在正是我们去拜访他的好时机。如果能有他的帮助，我们兴许就有了几分胜算。
text.completion: And who might you be? Ah, an emissary from the Thorium Brotherhood.  They're looking for my support?  Fine, I might be willin' to help out... ...for a price.

english.title: In the Hall of the Mountain-Lord
english.objectives: Speak with Mountain-Lord Rendan at Iron Summit in Searing Gorge.
english.description: The Thorium Brotherhood doesn't maintain a militia - just a few guards, and me, and that's it.  If we're to successfully strike against the Dark Irons of the gorge, we're gonna need help.$b$bMountain-Lord Rendan sits atop that tower across the gorge, to our south.  He doesn't consort with Twilight folks or fire elementals, but he hasn't joined the brotherhood either.  Maybe it's time we paid him a visit.  With his help, we might just stand a chance.
english.completion: And who might you be? Ah, an emissary from the Thorium Brotherhood.  They're looking for my support?  Fine, I might be willin' to help out... ...for a price.

text.title: 炮弹！
text.objectives: 前往拉尔戈的瞭望台，为格雷中士收集4堆炮弹。拉尔戈的瞭望台位于营地东北方。
text.description: 自从我们在这里扎营以来，拉尔戈和他的爪牙们就一直在窃取我们的军备。这件事令我感到非常挫折。$b$b有报告称拉尔戈将偷来的炮弹堆放在可以鸟瞰水面的塔楼中。你能去那里取回一些炮弹吗？$b$b$n，要当心部落哦。
text.progress: Did you find the cannonballs?
text.completion: Good job on the recovery effort $n. These cannonballs should last us a while.
text.completed: Report back to Sergeant Gray at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.

english.title: Cannonball!
english.objectives: You need to recover 4 Stacks of Cannonballs from Largo's Overlook for Sergeant Gray.  You can find Largo's Overlook just northeast of the base camp.
english.description: Largo and his minions have been stealing our supplies ever since we setup camp here.  It's frustrating to say the least.$b$bWe have heard reports that he is stockpiling cannonballs in the towers overlooking the water up on his overlook.  Can you head up there and try to recover some of them for us?$b$b$n, don't forget to keep a watch out for horde too.
english.progress: Did you find the cannonballs?
english.completion: Good job on the recovery effort $n. These cannonballs should last us a while.
english.completed: Report back to Sergeant Gray at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.

text.title: 瘟疫……到处都是瘟疫！
text.objectives: 杀死席瓦莱恩男爵和指挥官斯普林瓦尔。
text.description: 瘟疫最关键的是，它虽然表面上消退了，但残余症状依然毒害不浅！: 然而，我们完事之前，还有很大一片区域要清理，此外还有不少高弗雷的防御力量在碍事。$B$B看起来那些生前服侍席瓦莱恩男爵和指挥官斯普林瓦尔的人，死后还在守护着他们，高弗雷就用这些鬼魂来阻扰我们。让他们看看被遗忘者坚强的意志！
text.completion: Cromush has both a thick skull and a fool's brain, and we'll use that to our advantage. By the time anybody finds out about the plague's true potency, it'll be far too late. Thank you for keeping quiet during his tirade. I promise you won't regret it.
text.completed: Return to Deathstalker Commander Belmont.
text.giverWindow: 真没想到。

english.title: Plague...Plague Everywhere!
english.objectives: Kill Baron Silverlaine and Commander Springvale.
english.description: The best part about this plague is that even when it visually fades away, the remaining residue is still quite potent! However, we still have an enormous area to cover before we're done, with plenty of Godfrey's defenses in the way.$B$BIt appears that the spirits that served Baron Silverlaine and Commander Springvale in life now guard them in death, and Godfrey is using them to deter us. Show them all the iron will of the Forsaken!
english.completion: Cromush has both a thick skull and a fool's brain, and we'll use that to our advantage. By the time anybody finds out about the plague's true potency, it'll be far too late. Thank you for keeping quiet during his tirade. I promise you won't regret it.
english.completed: Return to Deathstalker Commander Belmont.
english.giverWindow: This was unexpected.

starters.name: 死亡猎手指挥官贝尔蒙特

enders.name: 死亡猎手指挥官贝尔蒙特

text.title: 卢姆波要蜂蜜
text.objectives: 用卢姆波的蘸蜜棒在死木村里的蜂巢中采集10团死木蜂蜜滴液。
text.description: 卢姆波饥饿！$B$B死木混蛋的蜂蜜都是从木喉部落偷来的！我们看见……呃，卢姆波看见他们偷的！现在卢姆波要那些蜂蜜！$B$B拿上这根……这根棒子！是的，这根棒子。拿上这根棒子，用它从死木村的蜂巢里把蜂蜜偷来。$B$B卢姆波一定要拥有尽可能多的蜂蜜。这很重要。
text.progress: Ruumbo can smell whether you have honey or not!
text.completion: Honey! Delicious honey! Well done, ugly creature! You may put the honey...put the honey down right there. No, to the left. Yes, there. Just leave it there.
text.completed: Return to the Totem of Ruumbo at Deadwood Village in Felwood.

english.title: Ruumbo Demands Honey
english.objectives: Collect 10 Deadwood Honey Globs from the hives in Deadwood Village using Ruumbo's Honey Stick.
english.description: Ruumbo hungers!$B$BThe Deadwood jerks have stolen all their honey from the Timbermaw tribe! We saw...er, Ruumbo saw them do it! Now Ruumbo must have that honey!$B$BTake this... this stick! Yes, this stick. Take this stick and use it to steal the honey from their beehives in Deadwood Village.$B$BRuumbo must have as much honey as possible. This is vital.
english.progress: Ruumbo can smell whether you have honey or not!
english.completion: Honey! Delicious honey! Well done, ugly creature! You may put the honey...put the honey down right there. No, to the left. Yes, there. Just leave it there.
english.completed: Return to the Totem of Ruumbo at Deadwood Village in Felwood.

text.title: 战斗地带
text.objectives: 元首司克诺兹要你操纵攻城坦克的一门炮塔，消灭7个破碎的守卫者，然后向他复命。
text.description: 看样子你又有了一个将功赎罪的机会，$r。$b$b这个小小的紧急情况使我损失了几个坦克炮手。$b$b你觉得自己有能力填补他们的空缺吗？$b$b我的坦克就在营地的西边。去把这愚蠢的窘局打破！
text.completion: Auch! If I vere an inch or two taller, I'd be dead!
text.completed: Speak to Commander Schnottz in Schnottz's Landing.

english.title: Battlezone
english.objectives: Commander Schnottz wants you to man one of the siege tank turrets and use it to defeat 7 Decrepit Watchers, then report back to him.
english.description: It vould appear zhat anozher opportunity has arisen for you to redeem yourself, $r.$b$bZhis little emergency has set me back a few tank gunnahs.$b$bYou zhink you have vhat it takes to fill in for vone of zhem?$b$bMy tanks are just vest of zhe camp. Get out zhere and put an end to zhis silliness!
english.completion: Auch! If I vere an inch or two taller, I'd be dead!
english.completed: Speak to Commander Schnottz in Schnottz's Landing.

text.title: 夺回拉尔戈的瞭望台
text.objectives: 格雷中士要你前往拉尔戈的瞭望台杀死指挥官拉尔戈。拉尔戈的瞭望台位于营地的东北方。
text.description: 要夺回拉尔戈的瞭望台，只有一个办法。$B$B你应该知道怎么做吧，$n。这些日子拉尔戈的妄想症挺严重的，他多半待在塔楼上指望着假想中的海军尽早登陆呢，所以去楼顶找他准没错。
text.completion: Ha, we finally got Largo!  Nice one, $n.
text.completed: Report back to Sergeant Gray at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.
text.giverWindow: 祝你好运。

english.title: Taking the Overlook Back
english.objectives: Sergeant Gray has asked you to kill Commander Largo at Largo's Overlook.  The overlook is just northeast of the base camp.
english.description: There is only one way for us to take Largo's Overlook back.$b$bI think you know what we need to do $n.  Largo is pretty paranoid these days so you should be able to find him on top of the tower, looking for his imaginary navy to finally arrive.
english.completion: Ha, we finally got Largo!  Nice one, $n.
english.completed: Report back to Sergeant Gray at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.
english.giverWindow: Good luck with this one.

text.title: 磁铁的原理是什么呢？
text.objectives: 取回7块攻城坦克废料。在不眠前线使用磁性废料收集器寻找废料。不眠前线位于此地正西方，穿过第二座桥梁就到。
text.description: 我们很难在这座岛上找到有用的机械配件，$n。瞧，有一大堆攻城坦克等着修理，我们却没有可用的零件。$b$b第二军团来报，西边的战场上有废弃的攻城坦克配件。或许可以去那里碰碰运气？$b$b要在旧时的战场上寻找小件的东西可不容易，带上磁性废料收集器吧，你会用得着的。
text.progress: 那個磁鐵裝置玩意真的有用嗎？
text.completion: 這些零件真的幫了我們大忙，$n！誰想得到你能在那些古老垃圾裡頭找到這麼有用的東西？
text.completed: Report back to Commander Lieutenant Farnsworth at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.

english.title: Magnets, How Do They Work?
english.objectives: You have been tasked with recovering 7 pieces of Siege Engine Scrap.  Use the Magnetized Scrap Collector in The Restless Front to find the scraps.  The Restless Front is due west, just past the second bridge.
english.description: Getting useful machine parts out here on the island has been difficult, $n.  We have been trying to repair the broken siege engines here in camp but we keep running out of useful parts.$b$bOur second regiment reported some wrecked out siege engines in a old battlefield to the west.  Maybe we could find some parts over there?$B$bYou are going to have trouble finding anything in that old battlefield so take this magnetized scrap collector and put it to some good use.
english.progress: Did that magnet contraptaion actually work?
english.completion: These parts will really help us out, $n!  Who would have thought you can find stuff this useful in all that old junk?
english.completed: Report back to Commander Lieutenant Farnsworth at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.

text.title: 教训他们！
text.objectives: 马克要你调查卡塔图陵墓。
text.description: 能逃出来真走运，$c。我不确定咱们不把那些伏兵处理掉，我会不会过意得去。$b$b不如你回到卡塔图陵墓去给那些小混蛋们一点颜色看看！$b$b没记错的话，就往东北走，奥丹姆的入口里面就是。$b$b你看什么？我显然不在状态！
text.completion: Good to see ya, kid. Would've been even better if you'd have been here to help me take care of these little savages...
text.completed: Speak with Harrison Jones at Khartut's Tomb.

english.title: Take it to 'Em!
english.objectives: Mack wants you to investigate Khartut's Tomb.
english.description: We was lucky to escape, $c. I'm not sure I'd feel right if we didn't take care of them ambushers.$b$bHows about you git back up to Khartut's tomb and give them little buggers what fer!$b$bIt's off to the northeast, just inside the entrance to Uldum if'n I recollect correctly.$b$bWhat're you looking at? I sure ain't in no condition to do it!
english.completion: Good to see ya, kid. Would've been even better if you'd have been here to help me take care of these little savages...
english.completed: Speak with Harrison Jones at Khartut's Tomb.

text.title: 卢姆波要正义
text.objectives: 杀死任意种类的15名死木熊怪。
text.description: 你！游荡者！向伟大的木喉神灵卢姆波的威严致敬吧！$B$B听从我的意愿！邪恶的死木部落住在我身后的村子里！他们是彻头彻尾的混蛋！$B$B我是说，他们……他们用邪恶的罪行玷污了我的名字！他们骚扰着我心爱的木喉部落，伤害了他们！$B$B我命令你为我伸张正义！打败死木，我就会赐予你我的……我的眷顾！是的！卢姆波的眷顾！
text.completion: It worked! I mean, uh, YES, the will of Ruumbo has been carried out! You have done well, creature! You may have these shiny coins!
text.completed: Return to the Totem of Ruumbo at Deadwood Village in Felwood.

english.title: Ruumbo Demands Justice
english.objectives: Slay 15 Deadwood furbolg of any type.
english.description: You! Wanderer! Bow before the might of Ruumbo, great god of the Timbermaw tribe!$B$BHear my will! The evil Deadwood tribe lives in the village behind me! They are big jerks!$B$BI mean, they...they sully my name with their wicked misdeeds! They persecute my cherished Timbermaw tribe and hurt them!$B$BI demand you inflict my justice! Defeat the Deadwood and I will give you my... my favor! Yes! The favor of RUUMBO!
english.completion: It worked! I mean, uh, YES, the will of Ruumbo has been carried out! You have done well, creature! You may have these shiny coins!
english.completed: Return to the Totem of Ruumbo at Deadwood Village in Felwood.

text.title: 为卢姆波跳舞！
text.objectives: 给卢姆波跳段难看的舞。
text.description: 你做得非常好，$r！你的勇敢，还有你带来的美味蜂蜜让卢姆波十分高兴。$B$B现在，你必须……必须跳舞！是的！$B$B为卢姆波跳舞！跳吧！
text.completion: Those two brats... I should have known! They were smart enough to hush whenever I went to examine the totem. I'll be sure to find them and drag them back to Timbermaw Hold by the ears! Thank you for looking into it...
text.completed: Return to Grazle at the Emerald Sanctuary and tell him what happened.

english.title: Dance for Ruumbo!
english.objectives: Do a silly dance for Ruumbo.
english.description: You have done well, $r! Ruumbo is pleased by your bravery, and the delicious honey you have given Ruumbo.$B$BNow, you must... you must dance! Yes!$B$BDance for Ruumbo! Dance!
english.completion: Those two brats... I should have known! They were smart enough to hush whenever I went to examine the totem. I'll be sure to find them and drag them back to Timbermaw Hold by the ears! Thank you for looking into it...
english.completed: Return to Grazle at the Emerald Sanctuary and tell him what happened.

text.title: 活人才会听命令
text.objectives: 杀死沃登勋爵。
text.description: 毫无疑问，我们不会理会克鲁姆什那些关于瘟疫的废话。不过，他的蛮力倒是非常有用，可以带领我的人在前方群敌中杀出一条血路来直取高弗雷座下最为强大的副手沃登勋爵。$B$B你把他干掉之后，我就去沃登的大厅找你。我们被遗忘者完全占领影牙城堡的时刻终于要到来了！
text.progress: You have your orders, $n.
text.completion: The time has come! Godfrey will fall!
text.completed: Return to Deathstalker Commander Belmont.
text.giverWindow: 他反应不过来的。

english.title: Orders Are For the Living
english.objectives: Kill Lord Walden.
english.description: Unsurprisingly, we aren't going to listen to Cromush about the plague. However, his brute strength will come in handy for muscling my men through the many foes ahead on the path to Godfrey, the most powerful being his right hand man, Lord Walden.$B$BI'll meet you in Walden's chamber after you finish him off. Then, at long last, we can completely take Shadowfang Keep for the Forsaken!
english.progress: You have your orders, $n.
english.completion: The time has come! Godfrey will fall!
english.completed: Return to Deathstalker Commander Belmont.
english.giverWindow: He won't even see it coming.

starters.name: 死亡猎手指挥官贝尔蒙特

enders.name: 死亡猎手指挥官贝尔蒙特

text.title: 碧火的堕落
text.objectives: 在碧火谷杀死12名碧火萨特或碧火魔仆。
