text.description: 净化这片森林的过程举步维艰。我们每一次的成功，都伴随着一个新的挑战。$B$B碧火萨特的侵害由来已久。他们旨在腐化这片森林，正如我们旨在净化它一样。现在，我们要采取行动，开始将他们永远逐出费伍德森林。$B$B到西边的碧火谷，把他们从森林里赶出去。你可以在死木村围墙北边找到入口，留意他们邪恶的旗帜。
text.completion: The Emerald Circle thanks you, $n. If we all work together here, we can purge these demons from our midst.
text.completed: Return to Tenell Leafrunner at the Emerald Sanctuary in Felwood.

english.title: The Corruption of the Jadefire
english.objectives: Slay 12 Jadefire Satyr or Jadefire Felsworn in Jadefire Glen.
english.description: The cleansing of this forest has been a grueling process. For every success we have achieved, a new challenge has arisen.$B$BThe Jadefire satyr have been a constant nuisance. They seek to corrupt the forest just as we seek to cleanse it. Now, we have taken steps to begin eradicating them from Felwood entirely.$B$BTravel to Jadefire Glen to the west and rid the forest of their presence. You'll find the entrance just north of the walls of Deadwood Village; look for their vile banners.
english.completion: The Emerald Circle thanks you, $n. If we all work together here, we can purge these demons from our midst.
english.completed: Return to Tenell Leafrunner at the Emerald Sanctuary in Felwood.

text.title: 甜蜜、无情的复仇
text.objectives: 杀死高弗雷勋爵。
text.description: 一切顺利的话，你将径直进入高弗雷的私人领地，获取一份配得上热切而年轻的$c的奖赏。$B$B不过，高弗雷是个狡猾的敌人，因此最好速战速决，以防万一。他将为对黑暗女王所做的一切付出代价！
text.completion: For a moment there, I thought all was lost. Even when surrounded by the worgen in Gilneas I had higher hopes! But you proved me wrong $n. I will see to it that Sylvanas herself hears of your triumph here today. Don't worry about the mess here, I will gladly see to it myself.
text.completed: Return to Deathstalker Commander Belmont.
text.giverWindow: 为了希尔瓦娜斯！

english.title: Sweet, Merciless Revenge
english.objectives: Kill Lord Godfrey.
english.description: If all goes well you'll just be able to walk right into Godfrey's personal domain and take a reward fitting for such an eager young $c.$B$BGodfrey is a cunning foe, though, so it may be wise to head up there quickly just in case you're needed. He will pay for what he did to the Dark Lady!
english.completion: For a moment there, I thought all was lost. Even when surrounded by the worgen in Gilneas I had higher hopes! But you proved me wrong $n. I will see to it that Sylvanas herself hears of your triumph here today. Don't worry about the mess here, I will gladly see to it myself.
english.completed: Return to Deathstalker Commander Belmont.
english.giverWindow: For Sylvanas!

text.title: 多伊尔的命运
text.objectives: 把多伊尔氏族的消息告诉焰须墓地的伊安·焰须。
text.description: 看来多伊尔已经参加了他们的最后一场战斗。把他们的命运告诉伊安。
text.completion: That's a right shame. Stubborn as they were to speak to, they were just as stubborn in a fight. Would have been good to have 'em. Once this is done, we'll have to send some boys out to bring them back for a proper send off.

english.title: The Fate of the Doyles
english.objectives: Return the news of Clan Doyle to Iain Firebeard at the Firebeard Cemetery.
english.description: It seems the Doyles already joined their last fight. Iain will want to know of their fate.
english.completion: That's a right shame. Stubborn as they were to speak to, they were just as stubborn in a fight. Would have been good to have 'em. Once this is done, we'll have to send some boys out to bring them back for a proper send off.

text.title: 能人所不能
text.objectives: 削弱伊普斯，用强化伏魔袋将他俘虏。
text.description: 萨特将他们那腐败的月墙用一道无法穿透的恶魔之火屏蔽起来。他们的部队一定有什么办法可以穿过去。$B$B审问萨特将是徒劳的，但陪伴他们的小鬼却很容易开口。而且，我想到了一个特别的人选……$B$B在东边的山脚下，游荡着一只孤独的小鬼，离群索居。他应该很好对付。在战斗中削弱他，然后用这个附魔的袋子将他抓住。问话的事情就交给我来……
text.completion: Imps are creatures of deception. With so many of them spotted at Shadowlurk Ridge, I'm positive something is being hidden there. Our little friend will tell us exactly how to find it... if he doesn't want to go back in the sack.
text.completed: Return to Arcanist Delaris at the Ruins of Constellas in Felwood.

english.title: Do the Imp-Possible
english.objectives: Weaken Impsy and use the Enchanted Imp Sack to capture him.
english.description: The satyr hide their corrupted moonwell behind an impenetrable barrier of demonic fire. Their forces must have some way of getting through it.$B$BInterrogating the satyr will be useless, but the imps they consort with will be easily swayed. I have a specific one in mind, as well...$B$BIn the foothills to the east, a lone imp has been seen wandering, far from the other demons. He should prove easy pickings. Weaken him with combat, and then use this enchanted sack to capture him. Then I'll do the talking...
english.completion: Imps are creatures of deception. With so many of them spotted at Shadowlurk Ridge, I'm positive something is being hidden there. Our little friend will tell us exactly how to find it... if he doesn't want to go back in the sack.
english.completed: Return to Arcanist Delaris at the Ruins of Constellas in Felwood.

text.title: 懦夫的理由
text.objectives: 跟桑德玛尔的科林·桑德玛尔谈一谈。
text.description: 我们在这里已经安全了，但还有许多蛮锤需要援助。我们的空军可以提供帮助，但想要彻底剿除暮光，部队实力就必须继续壮大。$B$B我打算和科林·桑德玛尔谈一谈。只有懦夫才会对同胞的呼唤视而不见，尤其是在这种危急的时刻。$B$B到桑德玛尔去，找到科林，让他给一个理由。我可不会让一个懦夫来担任蛮锤的领袖。
text.completion: Here here, WOT!? He calls ME a COWARD!? Just like a Firebeard, all hot air and not a lick of sense. I've been bearing the brunt of a Dragonmaw invasion from the south, much of Thundermar is in ruins, and do any of the other clans stick up to help? NO! Ol' Thundermar is on his own he is, and you'd better believe I'm usin' everything in my arsenal just to stem the tide.

english.title: A Coward's Due
english.objectives: Speak to Colin Thundermar in Thundermar.
english.description: We may be safe here, but there are a lot of Wildhammer who could still use support. Our wing can offer that, but we need to keep bolsterin' our forces if we're going to clear the Twilight completely.$B$BI'm going to have words with Colin Thundermar. Only a coward turns down the callin' of his people, especially in a time this dire.$B$BGo to Thundermar, find Colin and get a real explanation out of'm. I won't be putting up with cowardice in a Wildhammer leader.
english.completion: Here here, WOT!? He calls ME a COWARD!? Just like a Firebeard, all hot air and not a lick of sense. I've been bearing the brunt of a Dragonmaw invasion from the south, much of Thundermar is in ruins, and do any of the other clans stick up to help? NO! Ol' Thundermar is on his own he is, and you'd better believe I'm usin' everything in my arsenal just to stem the tide.

text.title: 危机管理
text.objectives: 贝洛克·辉刃要你打消司克诺兹登陆点的客人们的顾虑。
text.description: 眼下有一个比较微妙的情况，需要有……外来者帮忙解决。$b$b你看，一场不幸的事故使我们的某些访客变得心神不宁。放心，我们的高层正在理清细节。$b$b与此同时呢，如果你能去安抚那些过于敏感的访客，那就太好啦。$b$b好好处理这件事，我保证元首会听到你的事迹！
text.completion: Hmm, still a bit frazzled, are they? Well, you know what they say. Time heals all wounds. Except for those of the ambassador, of course...
text.completed: Speak to Belloc Brightblade at Schnottz's Landing.

english.title: Crisis Management
english.objectives: Belloc Brightblade wants you to reassure the guests at Schnottz's Landing.
english.description: There is a delicate situation that calls for the... objective discretion of an outsider.$b$bYou see, an unfortunate incident has upset some of our guests. Rest assured, our top men are sorting out the details.$b$bIn the meantime, it would be wonderful if you could calm our more squeamish visitors.$b$bHandle this well, and the furrier is sure to hear of it!
english.completion: Hmm, still a bit frazzled, are they? Well, you know what they say. Time heals all wounds. Except for those of the ambassador, of course...
english.completed: Speak to Belloc Brightblade at Schnottz's Landing.

If you so choose, head to Ragefire Chasm and speak with Stone Guard Kurjack, head of the defense initiative, to end the threat to Orgrimmar once and for all.

text.title: 围攻！
text.objectives: 杀掉9名黑铁神射手。
text.description: 工头奥菲斯特要我加入战斗，他可真会挑时候。我的山峰正在遭受围攻！$b$b我的矮人不是不能处理，但也不是说我就能简单地收拾收拾，把几个矮人送到地狱般的峡谷去那么简单。$b$b这么说吧：你把他们派来围攻我们要塞的神射手干掉，我就考虑你的提议。他们就溜达在平原的东边。
text.completion: If nothin' else, you bought us some time, and some room to open up our supply lines through this siege. Yer a fine $c.
text.completed: Return to Mountain-Lord Rendan at Iron Summit in Searing Gorge.

english.title: Siege!
english.objectives: Slay 9 Dark Iron Marksmen.
english.description: That Overseer Oilfist couldn't'a picked a worse time to ask me to join a fight.  My summit's already under siege!$b$bIt's nothin' my guards can't handle, but still, it won't be easy for me to just pick up and send some dwarves into that infernal gorge.$b$bTell ya what: you take out their marksman that're holding our fortress under siege, and I'll consider your offer.  Ye'll find 'em slinkin' around the flats to the east.
english.completion: If nothin' else, you bought us some time, and some room to open up our supply lines through this siege. Yer a fine $c.
english.completed: Return to Mountain-Lord Rendan at Iron Summit in Searing Gorge.

text.title: 点着它们！
text.objectives: 用惩戒火炬点燃大熔炉附近的四座高塔。
text.description: 不知道你注意到没有，我的塔比峡谷里所有其他的塔都要高。有些矮人对于能挖多深而感到自豪，但我不。有时我觉得自己该是个蛮锤矮人。$b$b不过，我还是不喜欢那些塔的样子。高高耸起，不过是在给我的塔搔脚底心。给，拿上这火炬，点燃塔顶的火盆。他们会后悔当初干嘛要把它们建起来。
text.completion: Looks like ye know how to light things on fire!  An admirable trait in any $r, for sure.
text.completed: Return to Mountain-Lord Rendan at Iron Summit in Searing Gorge.

english.title: Set Them Ablaze!
english.objectives: Use the Torch of Retribution on the four towers surrounding the Cauldron.
english.description: I'm not sure if ye've noticed, but my tower's much taller than any o' the other towers here around the Gorge.  Some dwarves pride themselves at how deep they can dig, but not me.  Sometimes I think I shoulda been born a Wildhammer.$b$bI still don't like the sight o' those other towers, though.  Reachin' up like that, ticklin' my tower's feet.  Here, take this torch, an' use it on the braziers atop those other towers.  They'll be sorry they ever built 'em to begin with.
english.completion: Looks like ye know how to light things on fire!  An admirable trait in any $r, for sure.
english.completed: Return to Mountain-Lord Rendan at Iron Summit in Searing Gorge.

text.title: 他们的子弹造得比我们好
text.objectives: 获得200颗黑铁子弹。
text.description: 这些挖掘峡谷的矮人至少有一件事情做得不错：他们制造的子弹质量很高。我没法进行仿造，于是我只好尽量把他们的子弹偷来。$b$b你想要我帮忙？那就先从下面的神射手身上给我弄几百发子弹来。$b$b我想他们会很乐意一次给你一颗，不过从弹药箱里去拿可能会更快一些。
text.progress: A real $c woulda caught the bullets with his teeth.
text.completion: I'll just divvy these up amongst the guards.  Ye have my thanks.
text.completed: Return to Mountain-Lord Rendan at Iron Summit in Searing Gorge.

english.title: They Build a Better Bullet
english.objectives: Obtain 200 Dark Iron Bullets.
english.description: Those gorge-digging dwarves do at least one thing right: they make very high-quality bullets.  I've been unable to reproduce their results, so I've taken to stealing whatever bullets of theirs that I can find.$b$bYe want my help?  Get me a couple hundred bullets from those marksmen below.$b$bI'm sure they'll be happy to give ye their bullets one at a time, but you might find it faster just to look for the crates filled with them.
english.progress: A real $c woulda caught the bullets with his teeth.
english.completion: I'll just divvy these up amongst the guards.  Ye have my thanks.
english.completed: Return to Mountain-Lord Rendan at Iron Summit in Searing Gorge.

text.title: 给布里维普的特别货物
text.objectives: 将激冻冰弹交给千针石林沉没的挖掘场的布里维普。
text.description: 我有了一个新的合伙人，我最好的伙伴，布里维普。我们说话的这当口，他正在为我们全新的冰激凌帝国缔造基础呢！$B$B他把我们的冷却液拖船、库存，还有雇员都带到西南边的沉没的挖掘场去了。不幸的是，我现在没办法把那东西送过去……一样十分重要的东西：我们超级绝密的激冻冰弹！$B$B你不介意把它给他带去吧，对不对，$n？
text.progress: That's not what I think it is? Is it?!
text.completion: That must be the new I-Scream Cryocannon! Ain't she a beauty?! I'm going to let you in on a secret, my good friend: the groundwork for a vast mercantile empire is being laid right here! Tell me... how do you feel about ice cream?

english.title: Special Delivery for Brivelthwerp
english.objectives: Deliver the I-Scream Cryocannon to Brivelthwerp at the Sunken Dig Site in Thousand Needles.
english.description: I have a new business partner, my best buddy, Brivelthwerp. Even as we speak, he's building up the infrastructure for our new ice cream empire!$B$BHe took our coolant tug, inventory, and employees southwest to the Sunken Dig Site. Unfortunately, I don't currently have a way to deliver something to him... something extremely important: our super-secret I-Scream Cryocannon!$B$BYou don't mind taking it to him, do you, $n?
english.progress: That's not what I think it is? Is it?!
english.completion: That must be the new I-Scream Cryocannon! Ain't she a beauty?! I'm going to let you in on a secret, my good friend: the groundwork for a vast mercantile empire is being laid right here! Tell me... how do you feel about ice cream?

text.title: 火囊的秘密
text.objectives: 获得6副火囊。
text.description: 有很多关于熏火龙的事情我们还不知道。它们从哪儿来？它们是如何在平原上生存下来的？还有它们的肉为什么这么难吃？$b$b我相信，了解这些史前野兽的关键，就要从火囊着手。每条熏火龙都有一副火囊。我想要几副来研究研究。$b$b你可以在偏西边的铸铁峰那里找到熏火龙。
text.progress: I'm finally getting my hands on those lizard gizzards!
text.completion: Ooh, these are nice.  Now, leave me alone with my gizzards.  I've got studying to do! Yes, very interesting.  Very interesting indeed...
text.completed: Return to Agnes Flimshale at Iron Summit in Searing Gorge.

english.title: The Mysteries of the Fire-Gizzard
english.objectives: Obtain 6 Fire-Gizzards.
english.description: There's so much we don't know about the incendosaurs.  Where did they come from?  How do they survive out here on the flats?  And why do they taste so bad?$b$bThe key to understanding these prehistoric beasts, I believe, starts with the fire-gizzard.  Every incendosaur has one.  I'd like a few of them to study.$b$bYou'll find incendosaurs circling the foot of Iron Summit, mostly to the west.
english.progress: I'm finally getting my hands on those lizard gizzards!
english.completion: Ooh, these are nice.  Now, leave me alone with my gizzards.  I've got studying to do! Yes, very interesting.  Very interesting indeed...
english.completed: Return to Agnes Flimshale at Iron Summit in Searing Gorge.

text.title: 说客
text.objectives: 想办法说服山丘领主伦达恩加入瑟银兄弟会。
text.description: 干嘛？你怎么还在这儿？哦，我是不是答应你还有瑟银兄弟会要帮他们打仗来着？$b$b我扯谎了。$b$b我现在分不出人手来。我知道我说过会帮忙，但你现在是不可能说服我离开铸铁峰的。绝对不可能。
text.completion: Well well well.  Look who come searching for Lunk this time! This sounds like case for Lunk's unique brand of no-kill problem-solve.
text.completed: 跟灼热峡谷铸铁峰的隆克谈一谈。

english.title: Deceit
english.objectives: Find a way to convince Mountain-Lord Rendan to join the Thorium Brotherhood.
english.description: What?  Why're you still here?  Oh, did I promise that I'd help you and the Thorium Brotherhood in yer fight?$b$bI lied.$b$bI just can't spare the men right now.  I know I said I'd help, but there's absolutely no way you can convince me to leave Iron Summit right now.  Absolutely no way.
english.completion: Well well well.  Look who come searching for Lunk this time! This sounds like case for Lunk's unique brand of no-kill problem-solve.
english.completed: Speak with Lunk at Iron Summit in Searing Gorge.

text.title: 隆克的冒险：伦达恩的弱点
text.objectives: 与三名铸铁峰守卫交谈，让他们加入你的舞蹈团。
text.description: 隆克不聪明，但隆克会观察。今天，隆克观察到山丘矮人喜欢看人跳舞。$b$b隆克喜欢跳舞！$n喜欢跳舞！大概吧！$b$b或许我们可以找些喜欢跳舞的矮人来。然后我们去跟山丘矮人谈谈，他就会听$n的了。
text.completion: Did I stutter?  I believe I clearly stated that I... won't... Wow, ye've got some good moves there!  I'm impressed!
text.completed: Report to Mountain-Lord Rendan at Iron Summit in Searing Gorge.

english.title: Lunk's Adventure: Rendan's Weakness
english.objectives: Speak with three Iron Summit Guards and ask them to join your dance.
english.description: Lunk not smart, but Lunk notice things.  Today, Lunk notice that Mountain-Dwarf likes to watch people dance.$b$bLunk like to dance!  $n like to dance!  Probably!$b$bMaybe we find some more dwarfs that like to dance.  Then we go talk to Mountain-Dwarf, and he will listen to $n.
english.completion: Did I stutter?  I believe I clearly stated that I... won't... Wow, ye've got some good moves there!  I'm impressed!
english.completed: Report to Mountain-Lord Rendan at Iron Summit in Searing Gorge.

objectiveDetails.description: 组织一个三矮人康加舞团

text.title: 山丘领主的支援
text.objectives: 把你的成功报告给灼热峡谷瑟银哨塔的工头奥菲斯特。
text.description: 好吧，好吧！要是我知道你这么会跳舞，一开始我就不会让你去做那些杂活儿。$b$b告诉工头奥菲斯特，我会加入他。咱们熔渣之池见啦，$g小子:姑娘;！只要瑟银哨塔和铸铁峰的兵力联合起来，那些峡谷矮人死都不知道怎么死的！
text.completion: So, Rendan's on our side?  About time that oaf came around. Let's get moving, then.
text.completed: 去找灼热峡谷瑟银哨塔的工头奥菲斯特。

english.title: The Mountain-Lord's Support
english.objectives: Report your success to Overseer Oilfist at Thorium Point in Searing Gorge.
english.description: Alright, alright!  If I knew ye could dance like that, I wouldn't'a asked ye to do all that stuff earlier.$b$bTell Overseer Oilfist that I'll be joinin' ye.  I'll meet ye in the slag pit, $g lad: lass;!  With the combined forces of Thorium Point and Iron Summit, those gorge-dwarves won't know what hit 'em!
english.completion: So, Rendan's on our side?  About time that oaf came around. Let's get moving, then.
english.completed: Report to Overseer Oilfist at Thorium Point in Searing Gorge.

text.title: 高地的竞技场
text.objectives: 跟暮光高地杀戮熔炉竞技场的巨魔仆从伍迪谈一谈。
text.description: 你挺有斗志的嘛，$c。你说不定能应付杀戮熔炉竞技场的挑战。$B$B什么！？你没听说过杀戮熔炉竞技场？自从那个谄媚的地精古尔戈索克和他的巨魔死党来到暮光高地开设店铺起，就一直在散发关于竞技场的传单。据说来自艾泽拉斯各地的英雄在那里一决生死。你应该叫上几个好朋友去看看。$B$B杀戮熔炉竞技场就在西南方，去颅骨堆中间找巨魔仆从伍迪吧。
text.completion: Hey, you're one big strong heap of $c. Can you handle the crucible? We got bookies are standing by!
text.completed: 跟暮光高地杀戮熔炉竞技场的巨魔仆从伍迪交谈。

english.title: Blood in the Highlands
english.objectives: Talk to Wodin the Troll-Servant at the Crucible of Carnage in Twilight Highlands.
english.description: You've got some fight in you, $c. You might do well in the crucible.$B$BWhat!? You haven't heard of the Crucible of Carnage? That smarmy goblin Gurgthock and his Troll sidekick have been plastering us with leaflets ever since he set up shop here in the Highlands. Champions from all over Azeroth fight to the death in there. You should gather up some friends and see how you fare.$B$BThe Crucible is just to the southwest. Look for Wodin the Troll-Servant somewhere in the middle of a ring of bones.
english.completion: Hey, you're one big strong heap of $c. Can you handle the crucible? We got bookies are standing by!
english.completed: Talk to Wodin the Troll-Servant at the Crucible of Carnage in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: Adventurers Wanted: Maraudon
text.objectives: Speak with Zaetar's Spirit.
text.description: The Warchief has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Maraudon, in western Desolace, immediately!$B$BHealing Maraudon from its current corruption would great help the entirety of Desolace! If you so choose, head to Maraudon and speak with Zaetar's Spirit, he will guide you.

english.title: Adventurers Wanted: Maraudon
english.objectives: Speak with Zaetar's Spirit.
english.description: The Warchief has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Maraudon, in western Desolace, immediately!$B$BHealing Maraudon from its current corruption would great help the entirety of Desolace! If you so choose, head to Maraudon and speak with Zaetar's Spirit, he will guide you.

text.title: Adventurers Wanted: Maraudon
text.objectives: Speak with Zaetar's Spirit.
text.description: King Varian Wrynn has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Maraudon, in western Desolace, immediately!$B$BHealing Maraudon from its current corruption would great help the entirety of Desolace! If you so choose, head to Maraudon and speak with Zaetar's Spirit, he will guide you.

english.objectives: Speak with Zaetar's Spirit.
english.description: King Varian Wrynn has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Maraudon, in western Desolace, immediately!$B$BHealing Maraudon from its current corruption would great help the entirety of Desolace! If you so choose, head to Maraudon and speak with Zaetar's Spirit, he will guide you.

text.title: 诱饵
text.objectives: 取得一具新鲜的狮鹫残骸。
text.description: 地面作战对你来说不成问题，$n。我也同意。$B$B但是龙喉兽人是天空和陆地的霸主。除非你也能轻松驾驭幼龙，否则部落对我来说就毫无价值。$B$B我倒要看看你能不能从溅血谷地带回一只幼龙。$B$B首先，你需要诱饵。去西边或是东北边的丛林杀死一只游荡的狮鹫。记得选未经驯服的狮鹫！幼龙可不喜欢带有矮人体臭的狮鹫血。$B$B取得一具狮鹫的残骸，接下来你自然就知道该怎么办了。
text.progress: <You gather up the fresh carcass.>
text.completion: <You gather up the fresh carcass.>
text.completed: Get a Fresh Gryphon Carcass.

english.title: Bait and Throttle
english.objectives: Get a Fresh Gryphon Carcass.
english.description: You can hold your own on the ground, $n. I'll give you that.$B$BBut we Dragonmaw dominate the skies as well as land. Until you can prove to me you can handle a drake as well as a Dragonmaw, your Horde is nothing to me.$B$BLet's see if you can wrangle one back to Bloodgulch.$B$BFirst you'll need bait. Go out and kill one of the gryphons that wander the woods west or northeast of here. Make sure it's untamed! Drakes hate the stink of dwarf on their food.$B$BGet the gryphon carcass and you'll know what to do.
english.progress: <You gather up the fresh carcass.>
english.completion: <You gather up the fresh carcass.>
english.completed: Get a Fresh Gryphon Carcass.

text.title: 给布里维普的特别货物
text.objectives: 将激冻冰弹交给千针石林沉没的挖掘场的布里维普。
text.description: 我最近入手了一件东西，需要交给一个叫做布里维普的侏儒。我更愿意叫他白痴维普。$B$B总而言之，我要你把它带到西南边的沉没的挖掘场里去交给他。他在那里打着自己的算盘，肯定和钱有关……我闻得出来！$B$B密切注意他的一举一动，$n，看你是不是能在他那儿分一杯羹。大杯的！
text.progress: That's not what I think it is? Is it?!
text.completion: Welcome, friend, welcome! I'm going to give you the chance to get involved at the ground level of a once-in-a-lifetime opportuntity. The entrepreneurial spirit knows nothing of the differences between the Alliance and the Horde! Tell me... how do you feel about ice cream?

english.title: Special Delivery for Brivelthwerp
english.objectives: Deliver the I-Scream Cryocannon to Brivelthwerp at the Sunken Dig Site in Thousand Needles.
english.description: I recently came into possession of something that needs to be delivered to a gnome that goes by the name, Brivelthwerp. It's more like Briveltwerp if you ask me.$B$BI want you to take it to him in the southwest, down at the Sunken Dig Site. He's up to something and there's moolah involved... I can smell it!$B$BKeep an eye on what he's doing, $n, and see if you can't get a cut of his profits. A big cut!
english.progress: That's not what I think it is? Is it?!
english.completion: Welcome, friend, welcome! I'm going to give you the chance to get involved at the ground level of a once-in-a-lifetime opportuntity. The entrepreneurial spirit knows nothing of the differences between the Alliance and the Horde! Tell me... how do you feel about ice cream?

text.title: 驯龙记
text.objectives: 吸引一只被引诱的黑色幼龙，向它发起攻击直到幼龙进入虚弱状态，然后乘坐它返回溅血谷地。
text.description: <你将新鲜的狮鹫残骸搭在肩膀上，任由它的翅膀垂到地面。>$B$B<高地黑色幼龙在杀戮熔炉竞技场西南方的低矮山丘处筑巢。>$B$B<如果将狮鹫残骸丢在那附近，肯定会有幼龙飞来进食。你可以趁它无暇防范时发起进攻，直到幼龙进入虚弱状态。那时你就可以骑上它飞翔了。>
text.completion: That was an impressive aerial display, $n, but I wish it had come at a better time. Narkrall is a great warrior, but he's also an impatient fool. He's about to get himself killed ... and we're about to lose one of our most important weapons in the battle for the Highlands!
text.completed: Talk to Zaela at Bloodgulch in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: How to Maim Your Dragon
english.objectives: Lure in a Baited Black Drake, attack it until it is weak, and then ride it back to Bloodgulch.
english.description: <You sling the gore-spattered gryphon corpse over your shoulder, its wings dragging to the ground.>$B$B<Highland Black Drakes roost just southwest of the Crucible of Carnage, along a ring of low mountain peaks.>$B$B<If you drop the gryphon corpse there, a drake is sure to start feeding. With its guard down, you should be able to attack it until it is weak enough to mount and fly.>
english.completion: That was an impressive aerial display, $n, but I wish it had come at a better time. Narkrall is a great warrior, but he's also an impatient fool. He's about to get himself killed ... and we're about to lose one of our most important weapons in the battle for the Highlands!
english.completed: Talk to Zaela at Bloodgulch in Twilight Highlands.

objectiveDetails.description: 捕获被引诱的黑色幼龙

text.title: 碰触所未及
text.objectives: 在提克迪奥斯的魔印使用相位血气药水变换至虚空相位，寻找提克迪奥斯之爪。
text.description: 我在软泥怪里加入了一滴我自己的精华。到西边匿影山边缘去寻找一个发光的魔印。站在上面，集中精神，将这东西都倒在你身上。它应该足以使你变换到虚空相位，让看到那儿到底有什么。$B$B你不会是一个人……看守萨特宝藏的，是他们所能召唤出的最大的虚空行者。打败他，宝藏就是你的了。$B$B一定要活着回来，不然这疯娘儿们会把我活烤了的！
text.progress: Can you hear me in there, $n? Do you have the claw?
text.completion: The Claw of Tichondrius... You hold a piece of the very demon that led the Legion to these woods, $n. Better for it to be in our hands than with the satyr. Hold still. I'm going to pull you back to our plane and make sure you and the claw arrive here safely...
text.completed: Return to Arcanist Delaris at the Ruins of Constellas in Felwood.
text.giverWindow: 虚空的守护者，他拿着你寻找的钥匙。

english.title: Touch the Untouchable
english.objectives: Use the Phaseblood Potion at the Sigil of Tichondrius to shift into the nether, and search for the Claw of Tichondrius.
english.description: I've added a drop of my very own essence to the ooze. Look for a glowing sigil to the west, at the edge of Shadowlurk Ridge. Stand on it, concentrate, and pour this stuff all over yourself. It should be enough to shift you into the nether and let you see what's REALLY there.$B$BYou won't be alone... the satyr's treasure is being guarded by the biggest voidstalker they could summon. Defeat him, and the treasure is yours.$B$BAnd come back in one piece, or this crazy broad's gonna fry me!
english.progress: Can you hear me in there, $n? Do you have the claw?
english.completion: The Claw of Tichondrius... You hold a piece of the very demon that led the Legion to these woods, $n. Better for it to be in our hands than with the satyr. Hold still. I'm going to pull you back to our plane and make sure you and the claw arrive here safely...
english.completed: Return to Arcanist Delaris at the Ruins of Constellas in Felwood.
english.giverWindow: Warden of the nether, he holds the key you seek.

text.title: 世上最棒的味道！
text.objectives: 收集8铲异种蝎粘液。
text.description: 我们的脚下是一个洞。非常大！作为我们的新冷库再合适不过了。它大得足以装下我们所有的库存，还有富余空间。$B$B不幸的是，我们几乎要完成管线的敷设时，虫子突然钻了出来，把我的雇员都给杀了！$B$B我怎么会知道有这么一出？$B$B不过这让我有了一个了不起的主意：异种蝎口味冰激凌。我们会大有斩获的！$B$B我现在就差原料了。
text.progress: You got enough bug goo for the first batch?
text.completion: Oh yeah! This is going to be the greatest flavor in the world! Look out, Tigule and Foror!!!
text.completed: Return to Brivelthwerp at the Sunken Dig Site in Thousand Needles.

english.title: The Greatest Flavor in the World!
english.objectives: Collect 8 Scoops of Silithid Goo.
english.description: Below us is a cave. It's huge! The perfect location for our new refrigerated vault. It's big enough to hold all of our inventory with room to grow.$B$BUnfortunately, when we were almost done equipping all of the pipes, bugs burrowed up out of nowhere and killed all of my employees!$B$BHow was I supposed to know?$B$BBut it gave me a great idea: silithid-flavored ice cream. We'll make a killing!$B$BAll I need now are the ingredients.
english.progress: You got enough bug goo for the first batch?
english.completion: Oh yeah! This is going to be the greatest flavor in the world! Look out, Tigule and Foror!!!
english.completed: Return to Brivelthwerp at the Sunken Dig Site in Thousand Needles.

text.title: 收尾工作
text.objectives: 在不眠前线杀死5名不眠的步兵。不眠前线位于岛屿西侧，就在遗忘山丘前。
text.description: 本周我们一直在不眠前线收集有用的废料。每当我们有所收获准备折返营地时，就会遭到不眠的步兵的攻击。你能跑一趟，去那里清剿他们吗？
text.completion: It's about time someone took those guys out.
text.completed: Report back to Lieutenant Farnsworth at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.

english.title: Finish The Job
english.objectives: Kill 5 Restless Infantry at the Restless Front.  You can find the front on the west side of the island, just before Forgotten Hill.
english.description: We have been trying to collect useful scraps from the front all week.  Every time we gather a batch to bring back to camp, we get assaulted by the restless infantry in the area.  Can you head over there and clear them out?
english.completion: It's about time someone took those guys out.
english.completed: Report back to Lieutenant Farnsworth at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.

text.title: 冰冻管道
text.objectives: 用激冻冰弹冰冻洞里的四处管道。
text.description: 该发射激冻冰弹了！$B$B我们借鉴了赛艇上的霜冻炮的科技。这正是我们侏儒所擅长的事情，把其他所有东西都做得大些，自然就能实现小型化了！$B$B我要你把这门炮带到洞里去，冰冻我们设在墙上的管道。这样就能发动它们。
text.completion: Do you hear that, $n? That's the sweet hum of the refrigeration kicking in. We'll be able to store our inventory down there in no time. Thank you!
text.completed: Return to Brivelthwerp at the Sunken Dig Site in Thousand Needles.

english.title: Freezing the Pipes
english.objectives: Use the I-Scream Cryocannon to freeze the four pipes inside the cave.
english.description: It's time to break out the I-Scream Cryocannon!$B$BWe lifted the tech from the frost cannons on the river boats. If it's one thing that we gnomes are good at, it's miniaturization by way of making everything else that much bigger!$B$BI need you to take the cannon down there into the cave and freeze the pipes we setup in the walls. That'll jumpstart them.
english.completion: Do you hear that, $n? That's the sweet hum of the refrigeration kicking in. We'll be able to store our inventory down there in no time. Thank you!
english.completed: Return to Brivelthwerp at the Sunken Dig Site in Thousand Needles.

text.title: 先干掉聪明的家伙
text.objectives: 杀掉虫巢控制者。
text.description: 洞穴深处有某种脑袋聪明的虫子。它管着下面所有的异种蝎。$B$B我的冰激凌正在融化！要是那东西在里面，我怎么才能建立我的冰激凌帝国，把库存卖出去呢？
text.completion: Outstanding! Nothing can stop us from being the greatest purveyors of ice cream in all of Azeroth!
text.completed: Return to Brivelthwerp at the Sunken Dig Site in Thousand Needles.
text.giverWindow: 为了冰激凌帝国未来的繁荣，杀掉虫巢控制者！

english.title: That Smart One's Gotta Go
english.objectives: Slay the Hive Controller.
english.description: There's some kind of smart brain bug in the back of the cave. It's in charge of all of the silithid down there.$B$BMy ice cream is melting! How am I supposed to launch my ice cream empire, and save my inventory, if that thing's in there?!
english.completion: Outstanding! Nothing can stop us from being the greatest purveyors of ice cream in all of Azeroth!
english.completed: Return to Brivelthwerp at the Sunken Dig Site in Thousand Needles.
english.giverWindow: Slay it for the future prosperity of the Ice Cream Empire!

text.title: 视见所未见
text.objectives: 从克斯特拉斯废墟收集8批被诅咒的软泥怪。
text.description: 是的，是的，你那神气活现的法师朋友一针见血。匿影山的小鬼们把萨特屏障的钥匙藏在虚空中。它就在那里，但你看不见也摸不着，除非变换相位。$B$B我猜你是不走运了，因为只有小鬼才做得到！因此你应该闭上眼睛，转过身去，放我走……$B$B只是开个玩笑！别伤害我！我需要这些废墟附近的被诅咒的软泥怪。给我多弄一些来，足以把你从头到脚都盖住那么多！
text.progress: You got that slime?
text.completion: Oh good, you're back! Don't leave me alone with her! She's crazy! Gimme that, I'll have you seeing the invisible in no time!
text.completed: Return to Impsy at the Ruins of Constellas in Felwood.

english.title: See the Invisible
english.objectives: Collect 8 batches of Cursed Ooze from the Ruins of Constellas.
english.description: Yeah, yeah, your stuck-up mage friend there hit it on the nose. The imps over at Shadowlurk Ridge are hiding the key to the satyr's barrier in the nether. It's right there, but you can't see it or touch it unless you're shifted.$B$BI guess you're out of luck though, because only imps can phase shift! So you should just close your eyes, turn around, and let me go...$B$BIt was just a joke! Don't hurt me! I'll need slime from the cursed oozes around these ruins. Bring me enough to cover you from head to toe!
english.progress: You got that slime?
english.completion: Oh good, you're back! Don't leave me alone with her! She's crazy! Gimme that, I'll have you seeing the invisible in no time!
english.completed: Return to Impsy at the Ruins of Constellas in Felwood.

text.title: 巨鲨“坦克”
text.objectives: 杀死在失落希望海角游弋的巨鲨坦克。失落希望海角位于此地以南的北部海岸线。
text.description: 我恨鲨鱼。我的人都恨鲨鱼。这就是我们要你做的事情，$n。$b$b我要你去失落希望海角，干掉一条名叫坦克的鲨鱼。坦克可不是好惹的，所以如果我是你的话，我会多带几个朋友一起去。
text.completion: No way, you actually killed him?  We are having shark tacos tonight for sure!
text.completed: Report back to Camp Commander Brack at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.
text.giverWindow: 这家伙咬人一点也不痛。

english.title: Shark Tank
english.objectives: You have been tasked to kill Tank, a large shark cruising the waters of the Cape of Lost Hope.  The cape can be found north of here, along the northern coastline.
english.description: I hate sharks.  All of my troops hate sharks too.  This is where you come in, $n.$b$bI need you to head up to the Cape of Lost Hope and take out a huge shark named Tank.  Tank is not to be trifled with so I would bring a few friends if I were you.
english.completion: No way, you actually killed him?  We are having shark tacos tonight for sure!
english.completed: Report back to Camp Commander Brack at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.
english.giverWindow: Jaws has nothing on this guy.

text.title: 我们都吵着要冰激凌……然后就死了！
text.objectives: 把拖船的拖钩挂在10名死去的雇员身上。
text.description: 别搞错了……我看起来欢呼雀跃，其实内心悲痛欲绝。我所有的朋友和雇员都死了。$B$B你能帮我一个忙吗？你能不能游下去，把拖船的拖钩挂在我死去的雇员身上？我好把他们拉上来。
text.completion: Thank you, $n. They gave their lives for ice cream.
text.completed: Return to Brivelthwerp at the Sunken Dig Site in Thousand Needles.

english.title: We All Scream for Ice Cream... and then Die!
english.objectives: Attach the tug's tow hook to 10 Dead Employees.
english.description: Don't get me wrong... I'm cheerful on the outside, but inside I'm just terribly torn to pieces. All of my friends and employees are dead.$B$BCould you do me a favor? Would you swim down there and attach the tug's tow hook to my dead employees? I'll reel them in.
english.completion: Thank you, $n. They gave their lives for ice cream.
english.completed: Return to Brivelthwerp at the Sunken Dig Site in Thousand Needles.

text.title: 行动：搅拌大熔炉
text.objectives: 跟瑟银哨塔的飞行管理员谈一谈，然后用兄弟会飞行器的机炮杀掉大熔炉防御者，直到该地区可以安全进入为止。
text.description: 我要把你派到一架飞行器上去，$n。$b$b你的任务就是缓解我们在熔渣之池的着陆压力。在瑟银哨塔跟你的飞行管理员谈谈，然后飞到峡谷下面去。$b$b等你接近着陆点的时候，无疑会有成群的黑铁矮人在等着你。用飞行器上的机炮尽可能地把他们干掉，然后降落在山洞入口处。你到的时候，伦达恩应该在那里等着你。
text.completion: Well, here we are. I hope you're ready, $n.
text.completed: Report to Mountain-Lord Rendan at the entrance to the Slag Pit in Searing Gorge.

english.title: Operation: Stir the Cauldron
english.objectives: Speak to the Thorium Point flight master, then use the Brotherhood Flying Machine's guns to kill Cauldron Defenders until the area is safe for entry.
english.description: I'm putting you on a flying machine, $n.$b$bYou'll be responsible for softening our landing into the slag pit.  Speak with your flight master here in Thorium Point, then fly down to the gorge.$b$bOnce you near your landing point, there will undoubtedly be hordes of Dark Iron dwarves waiting for you.  Use our flying machine's guns to take out as many of them as you can, then land at the cavern's entrance.  Rendan should be waiting for you by the time you arrive.
english.completion: Well, here we are. I hope you're ready, $n.
english.completed: Report to Mountain-Lord Rendan at the entrance to the Slag Pit in Searing Gorge.

objectiveDetails.description: 寻找进入熔渣之池的入口

text.title: 隆克喜欢你的风格
text.completion: Lunk heared that you used the stone to banish fire-lizard.  You saved Gorge, and you didn't even kill!$b$bLunk so proud.  Lunk happy to be $n's teacher.$b$bMaybe you take this.  Lunk doesn't need it.  Lunk too busy adventuring!

english.title: Lunk Like Your Style
english.completion: Lunk heared that you used the stone to banish fire-lizard.  You saved Gorge, and you didn't even kill!$b$bLunk so proud.  Lunk happy to be $n's teacher.$b$bMaybe you take this.  Lunk doesn't need it.  Lunk too busy adventuring!

text.title: 奴隶制可不好
text.objectives: 杀掉10名黑铁工头或黑铁奴隶贩子。
text.description: 我是个富有的矮人，跟工头玛托留斯差不多。但是，我的财富是通过努力工作和明智的决策，而不是奴役他人聚集而来的。$b$b好吧，我只稍稍奴役了一下。几乎等于没有。$b$b总之，我在这个山洞里看到的头一件事情，就是奴隶主和工头。这我无法忍受！你进入山洞的时候，一路尽量把他们都杀掉。把你的战果报告给熔渣之池更深处的艾沃奈斯。
text.completion: You've done good.  I don't like slavery either.
text.completed: Report to Evonice Sootsmoker within the Slag Pit in Searing Gorge.

english.title: Slavery is Bad
english.objectives: Slay 10 Dark Iron Taskmasters or Dark Iron Slavers.
english.description: Much like Overseer Maltorius, I'm a rich dwarf.  However, I earned my riches through hard work and wise decisions, not through slavery.$b$bOK fine, very little slavery.  Hardly any.$b$bAnyhow, the first thing that I see inside these caverns are slavedrivers and taskmasters.  I won't stand for this!  As you progress through the cavern, kill as many as you can.  Report your results to Evonice Sootsmoker, deeper within the Slag Pit.
english.completion: You've done good.  I don't like slavery either.
english.completed: Report to Evonice Sootsmoker within the Slag Pit in Searing Gorge.

objectiveDetails.description: 杀死黑铁工头或奴隶贩子

text.title: 甜蜜、恐怖的自由
text.objectives: 解救12名奴隶工。如果他们拒绝，就杀掉他们。
text.description: 当然，我们想把这里的奴隶尽可能地解放出来。大多数人会很乐意加入我们，迫不及待的对抗他们的压迫者。$b$b然而，有时你会发现有些奴隶拒绝获得营救。这是个很奇怪的现象，通常被称作“敦霍尔德症候群”。$b$b无论如何，你都得试着把他们放出来。要是他们拒绝，就像敌人那样威胁他们。把你的战果报告给熔渣之池更深处的艾沃奈斯。
text.completion: Strange how so many slaves cope poorly with freedom.  It's a shame to have to do what we do, but such are the truths of war. Now, we must move on to more pressing tasks.
text.completed: Report to Evonice Sootsmoker within the Slag Pit in Searing Gorge.

english.title: Sweet, Horrible Freedom
english.objectives: Free 12 Slave Workers.  If they resist, kill them.
english.description: Of course, we'll want to free as many slaves as we can while we're here.  Most of them will likely join forces with us, anxious to fight against their captors.$b$bHowever, sometimes you will find that slaves are resistant to being freed.  It's a strange phenomenon, often called "Durnholde Syndrome".$b$bEither way, you should try to free them.  If they resist, treat them as enemies.  Report your results to Evonice Sootsmoker, deeper within the Slag Pit.
english.completion: Strange how so many slaves cope poorly with freedom.  It's a shame to have to do what we do, but such are the truths of war. Now, we must move on to more pressing tasks.
english.completed: Report to Evonice Sootsmoker within the Slag Pit in Searing Gorge.

text.title: 复活吧，奥比斯顿
text.objectives: 使用苏塔拉祭坛，然后杀掉黑衣拉索里克和奥比斯顿。
text.description: 工头玛托留斯是这里管事的人，但他并非熔渣之池唯一一个有权势的矮人。黑衣拉索里克和他可怕的傀儡奥比斯顿，就埋伏在这条走廊前面。$b$b干扰拉索里克的祭坛，应该就能把他俩召唤出来。找到祭坛，召唤拉索里克并杀掉他。完成任务后去找艾沃奈斯。
text.completion: A fight well-fought, $n!  I'm beginning to feel the tide turn. Now, when you're ready, let's hit these Dark Irons where it really hurts!
text.completed: Report to Evonice Sootsmoker within the Slag Pit in Searing Gorge.

english.title: Rise, Obsidion
english.objectives: Use the Altar of Suntara, then slay Lathoric the Black and Obsidion.
english.description: Overseer Maltorius is in charge here, but he's not the only dwarf of power within the Slag Pit.  Lathoric the Black and his horrifying golem, Obsidion, loom just down this corridor.$b$bInterfering with Lathoric's altar should summon both of them.  Find it, then summon Lathoric and kill him.  Report to Evonice Sootsmoker when you're finished.
english.completion: A fight well-fought, $n!  I'm beginning to feel the tide turn. Now, when you're ready, let's hit these Dark Irons where it really hurts!
english.completed: Report to Evonice Sootsmoker within the Slag Pit in Searing Gorge.

text.title: 让他们死于睡眠不足
text.objectives: 获取16个黑铁枕头。
text.description: 关于矮人，尤其是黑铁矮人，有一个公认的事实，那就是他们需要休息！大量的休息！$B$B现在我问你，他们没枕头还怎么休息？没错，$n，休息不了。这就是你要去把他们的枕头拿出来的原因。$b$b等你完成之后，就去告诉监工斯克兰格。他在洞穴更深一点的地方，和汉瑟尔一起执行一项秘密计划。
text.progress: What?  Pillows? What?
text.completion: I see Evonice is up to her old tricks again.  I guess I'll just... um... hang onto these pillows for a while. The important part is that you're here.  We're going to need your help.
text.completed: Report to Taskmaster Scrange within the Slag Pit in Searing Gorge.

english.title: Kill 'em With Sleep Deprivation
english.objectives: Obtain 16 Dark Iron Pillows.
english.description: It's a little known fact that dwarves, particularly of the Dark Iron variety, need rest! Lots of rest!$B$BNow I ask you; How can they sleep without pillows?  Exactly, $n, they can't.  This is why you must steal their pillows.$b$bOnce you've finished your cushion-thievery, talk with Taskmaster Scrange.  He's a bit deeper in the cave, working on a covert project with Hansel.
english.progress: What?  Pillows? What?
english.completion: I see Evonice is up to her old tricks again.  I guess I'll just... um... hang onto these pillows for a while. The important part is that you're here.  We're going to need your help.
english.completed: Report to Taskmaster Scrange within the Slag Pit in Searing Gorge.

text.title: 瞧它的尺码！
text.objectives: 将比拉凯琳的枕头带给灼热峡谷的艾沃奈斯。
text.description: 哎呀呀……真是个惊喜。女仆有一只巨大而华丽的枕头，而现在它归你了。艾沃奈斯肯定捺不住想要它。把它给她带去，看你的辛苦是不是能从她那儿换点好东西来。
text.progress: That is one huge pillow! Where'd you get it from?
text.completion: 啧啧……这难道不是个惊喜吗？这实在就是个惊喜啊。比拉凯琳的巨大而精美的枕头现在是你的囊中之物啦。$B$B艾沃奈斯肯定很想将她那脏兮兮的小手放在枕头上。把枕头交给她，看看她是否会奖励你点什么。$N！

english.title: Look at the Size of It!
english.objectives: Take Chambermaid Pillaclencher's Pillow to Evonice Sootsmoker in the Searing Gorge.
english.description: Well, well, well... Isn't this a surprise. The Chambermaid had a gigantic ornate pillow and now it's yours. Evonice Sootsmoker will definitely want to get her grubby little hands all over this item. Take it to her and see if she'll offer you any goodies for your trouble.
english.progress: That is one huge pillow! Where'd you get it from?
english.completion: This is better than even I could have thought possible! The Chambermaid's magical pillow is mine! You better believe you're going to get a nice reward for this accomplishment, $n!

text.title: 占领要塞
text.objectives: 杀死法尔森要塞的要塞领主法尔森。法尔森要塞位于岛屿北端。
text.description: 你看见岛屿北端的要塞了吗，$n？那里是要塞领主法尔森的老巢。$b$b法尔森有一帮忠心耿耿的追随者，自从我们来到这里，他们就一直找我们的麻烦。我们曾经派出侦察小队潜入要塞，探明了法尔森的具体位置。$b$b你能帮我们除掉他吗？
text.progress: 堡主法森死了嗎？
text.completion: 你殺死他了？我們試著殺掉那傢伙已經好幾週了！我們都很感謝你，$n。
text.completed: Report back to Commander Marcus Johnson at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.
text.giverWindow: 他的追随者非常忠心。别低估他们。

english.title: Claiming The Keep
english.objectives: You have been asked to kill Keep Lord Farson at the Farson Hold.  Farson Hold can be found on the north side of the island.
english.description: Have you seen the keep on the north side of the island, $n?  That is where Keep Lord Farson runs his operation from.$b$bFarson has a small group of dedicated followers and they have been giving us trouble since we got here.  We sent a small group to investigate and they reported back on his exact position within the keep.$b$bCan you finish him off for us?
english.completion: You killed him?  We have been trying to take that guy out for weeks!  We thank you, $n.
english.completed: Report back to Commander Marcus Johnson at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.
english.giverWindow: His followers are very loyal.  Do not underestimate them.

text.title: 扭曲的关系
text.objectives: 跟汉瑟尔·重拳交谈，帮助他攻打工头玛托留斯和暮光领主阿卡库斯。
text.description: 汉瑟尔和我来这儿是要执行一个秘密任务：杀掉工头玛托留斯。我们的主要目的不变——打败卡尔烬德大公——不过能干掉熔渣之池臭名昭著的工头，总不是件坏事。$b$b问题是，汉瑟尔本以为只需要对付一个矮人，结果看来玛托留斯有客人……一名暮光之锤的使节！$b$b跟汉瑟尔谈谈，帮帮他。然后从这条走廊下去，沿着外面的平台去找工头奥菲斯特。
text.completion: Twilight's Hammer, eh?  I should've expected as much.  I'm glad you arrived to help them out when you did. It looks like, despite all odds, we've pressed our offensive to the doorstep of Calcinder's lair.  It's now time to finish the job.
text.completed: Report to Overseer Oilfist within the Slag Pit in Searing Gorge.

english.title: Twisted Twilight Ties
english.objectives: Speak with Hansel Heavyhands and help him assault Overseer Maltorius and Twilight-Lord Arkkus.
english.description: Hansel and I came here on a secret mission: kill Overseer Maltorius.  While our main goal still remains the same - defeating Archduke Calcinder - it can't hurt to take out the infamous overseer of the Slag Pit while we're here.$b$bProblem is, Hansel was only prepared to fight one dwarf, but it looks like Maltorius has a visitor... an emissary from the Twilight's Hammer!$b$bSpeak with Hansel and help him out.  Then proceed down this corridor and along the balcony outside to find Overseer Oilfist.
english.completion: Twilight's Hammer, eh?  I should've expected as much.  I'm glad you arrived to help them out when you did. It looks like, despite all odds, we've pressed our offensive to the doorstep of Calcinder's lair.  It's now time to finish the job.
english.completed: Report to Overseer Oilfist within the Slag Pit in Searing Gorge.

text.title: 卡尔烬德大公的爪牙
text.objectives: 消灭6名灼热烈焰幽魂。
text.description: 挖得太深会有这样的问题，$n。你在地下找到最丰富的矿脉，同时你也就会找到最邪恶的生物。$b$b比如说火元素。$b$b卡尔烬德的爪牙就游荡在前面的洞穴里。每一个都携带着卡尔烬德邪恶的一部分。尽你所能把它们杀掉，不要手下留情。
text.completion: The remains of Calcinder's minions lie smoldering at your feet.  Oilfist will be relieved to hear that you succeeded.

english.title: Minions of Calcinder
english.objectives: Slay 6 Searing Flamewraiths.
english.description: There is such a thing as digging too deep, $n.  While you'll find the richest mineral veins deep below the surface, you'll also find the most evil creatures.$b$bLike fire elementals.$b$bCalcinder's minions roam the cavern ahead.  Every one of them holds a piece of Calcinder's evil within it.  Slay as many as you can, and show no remorse.
english.completion: The remains of Calcinder's minions lie smoldering at your feet.  Oilfist will be relieved to hear that you succeeded.

text.title: 送回老家
text.objectives: 削弱卡尔烬德大公，然后用神圣三色宝珠将其放逐。
text.description: 卡尔烬德大公就爬行在这个山洞的深处。我们就要把他杀掉了……但我们不会那么做。$b$b杀掉卡尔烬德毫无意义。他的侍僧能轻松将其复活。相对地，我们要将他放逐。$b$b我之前不是要你从暮光之锤那儿收集来一颗宝贵的石头吗。你现在可以用它来对付卡尔烬德了。挑战他，把他削弱，然后对他使用这个装置。他就会从这个世界被放逐出去。$b$b祝你好运，勇敢的$n。
text.completion: Archduke Calcinder has been banished from Azeroth.  All that remains is a small, ashy spot where he once stood.$b$bYour work here is done.
text.giverWindow: 我不能忍受在距离瑟银哨塔如此之近的地方，有拉格纳罗斯的爪牙存在。他从什么地方来，就把他送回什么地方去。

english.title: From Whence He Came
english.objectives: Weaken Archduke Calcinder, then use the Sanctified Tripetricine to banish him.
english.description: Archduke Calcinder squirms in the back of this very cavern.  We are close to killing him... but that is not what we are going to do.$b$bSlaying Calcinder here means nothing.  His acolytes can easily revive him.  Instead, we are going to banish him.$b$bI asked you to gather a precious stone from the Twilight's Hammer earlier.  You will now use it against Calcinder.  Engage him, weaken him, then use this device on him.  He will be banished from this realm.$b$bGood luck, brave $n.
english.completion: Archduke Calcinder has been banished from Azeroth.  All that remains is a small, ashy spot where he once stood.$b$bYour work here is done.
english.giverWindow: I won't stand to have any minion of Ragnaros this close to Thorium Point.  Send him back where he belongs.

text.title: 绝不浪费武器
text.objectives: 从托尔巴拉德日常区域北端的法尔森要塞取回12支生锈的步枪。
text.description: 这个鸟不拉屎的破地方很难搞到军备。我们艰难地击退了部落的每一次进攻，完全是靠棍棒和石头取胜的。$B$B有报告称，岛屿南端的要塞领主法尔森拥有大量的步枪储备。你能去那里调查一下吗？$B$B千万小心，$n。法尔森的追随者会不惜一切代价保护他们的主子的。
text.progress: Any luck with those rifles?
text.completion: Thanks for rounding these up for us, $n.  Kind of hard to fight a battle without any guns.
text.completed: Report back to Commander Marcus Johnson at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.

english.title: Leave No Weapon Behind
english.objectives: Retrieve 12 Rusty Rifles from Farson Hold on the north side of Tol Barad Peninsula.
english.description: Battle supplies are hard to come by on this rock.  Every time we hold off another horde attack, it feels like we are fighting with sticks and stones.$B$BReports have come in that Keep Lord Farson on the north side of the island has a large stockpile of rifles that we could use.  Can you head down there and check it out?$b$bBe careful $n, Farson's followers will do anything to protect him.
english.progress: Any luck with those rifles?
english.completion: Thanks for rounding these up for us, $n.  Kind of hard to fight a battle without any guns.
english.completed: Report back to Commander Marcus Johnson at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.

text.title: 欢迎来到兄弟会
text.objectives: 去找灼热峡谷瑟银哨塔的工头奥菲斯特。
text.description: 你应该回到瑟银哨塔去。工头奥菲斯特和瑟银兄弟会的其他人想要知道，你在对抗卡尔烬德的战事中表现如何。
text.completion: Our task is complete, and it's all thanks to you, $n.  I'd like to offer you your choice from our coffers.  In addition, I intend to make you a full-fledged member of our order. Welcome to the Thorium Brotherhood, $n.  I'm proud to call you a brother.

english.title: Welcome to the Brotherhood
english.objectives: Report to Overseer Oilfist at Thorium Point in Searing Gorge.
english.description: You should return to Thorium Point.  Overseer Oilfist and the rest of the Thorium Brotherhood will be wondering how you fared in the fight against Calcinder.
english.completion: Our task is complete, and it's all thanks to you, $n.  I'd like to offer you your choice from our coffers.  In addition, I intend to make you a full-fledged member of our order. Welcome to the Thorium Brotherhood, $n.  I'm proud to call you a brother.

text.title: 设身处地
text.objectives: 护送一名法尔森要塞囚犯逃往安全区域。法尔森要塞位于小岛的西北端。
text.description: 前几周，我们派出了至少3支侦察小队，去调查法尔森要塞。可悲的是，他们一个都没回来，更别提什么情报了。$B$B目前，我们只能寄希望于他们被活捉当囚犯了。我要你去潜入那座要塞，帮助我们的士兵逃回来。这可不是一项简单的任务，$n，但是如果说还有谁能帮忙的话，那就是你了。
text.completion: You saved our men!  No words can express our gratitude $n.
text.completed: 任务完成之后，去找巴拉丁营地的指挥官马库斯·约翰森。
text.giverWindow: 这个人好像需要帮助。

english.title: Walk A Mile In Their Shoes
english.objectives: Escort a Farson Hold Prisoner to safety.  The hold is located on the northwestern tip of the island.
english.description: We have sent at least 3 different recon groups to investigate Farson Hold in the last few weeks.  Sadly, not one of them has returned back with any info.$B$BAt this point, all we can hope is that they are being held alive as prisoners.  I need you to infiltrate the keep and help get our soldiers back.  This won't be easy $n, but if anyone can help us, it's you.
english.completion: You saved our men!  No words can express our gratitude $n.
english.completed: Report back to Commander Marcus Johnson at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.
english.giverWindow: This guy looks like he could use some help.

text.title: Adventurers Wanted: The Sunken Temple
text.objectives: Speak with Lord Itharius.
text.description: The Warchief has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to the Sunken Temple, not far from Stonard, immediately!$B$BThe Atal'ai trolls within are attempting to summon forth Hakkar the Soulflayer! If you so choose, head to the Sunken Temple and speak with the green dragon Lord Itharius, who is prepared to put an end to these dangerous trolls.

english.title: Adventurers Wanted: The Sunken Temple
english.objectives: Speak with Lord Itharius.
english.description: The Warchief has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to the Sunken Temple, not far from Stonard, immediately!$B$BThe Atal'ai trolls within are attempting to summon forth Hakkar the Soulflayer! If you so choose, head to the Sunken Temple and speak with the green dragon Lord Itharius, who is prepared to put an end to these dangerous trolls.

text.title: Adventurers Wanted: The Sunken Temple
text.objectives: Speak with Lord Itharius.
text.description: King Varian Wrynn has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to the Sunken Temple, not far from Marshtide Watch, immediately!$B$BThe Atal'ai trolls within are attempting to summon forth Hakkar the Soulflayer! If you so choose, head to the Sunken Temple and speak with the green dragon Lord Itharius, who is prepared to put an end to these dangerous trolls.

english.title: Adventurers Wanted: The Sunken Temple
english.objectives: Speak with Lord Itharius.
english.description: King Varian Wrynn has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to the Sunken Temple, not far from Marshtide Watch, immediately!$B$BThe Atal'ai trolls within are attempting to summon forth Hakkar the Soulflayer! If you so choose, head to the Sunken Temple and speak with the green dragon Lord Itharius, who is prepared to put an end to these dangerous trolls.

text.title: 征召冒险者：黑石深渊
text.objectives: 与摩根交谈。
text.description: 安度因·乌瑞恩国王要求所有身强力壮的冒险者前往摩根的岗哨西北边的黑石深渊，立即动身！$B$B黑铁矮人对赤脊山的公民造成了巨大的威胁！如果你愿意响应号召，就前往黑石深渊，与摩根谈谈。她失踪许久后再次出现，誓要向黑铁矮人之国复仇。
text.completion: You look eager to kill a few hundred Dark Irons in justice's name. Perfect.

english.title: Adventurers Wanted: Blackrock Depths
english.objectives: Speak with Morgan.
english.description: King Varian Wrynn has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Blackrock Depths, northwest of Morgan's Vigil, immediately!$B$BThe Dark Iron dwarves pose a serious threat to the citizens of Redridge! If you so choose, head to Blackrock Depths and speak with Morgan, who has returned from her extended absence and wishes to enact her vengeance on the Dark Iron nation.
english.completion: You look eager to kill a few hundred Dark Irons in justice's name. Perfect.

text.title: 征召冒险者：黑石深渊
text.objectives: 与执行官努兹拉克交谈。
text.description: 酋长要求所有身强力壮的冒险者前往烈焰峰西边的黑石深渊，立即动身！$B$B黑铁矮人已经攻击了联盟控制下的赤脊山，如果不加以限制的话，他们很快就要威胁到我们在艾泽拉斯南部的寥寥几个据点了。$B$B如果你愿意响应号召，就前往黑石深渊，与执行官努兹拉克谈谈。他正在重新组建卡加斯远征军，以求彻底消灭黑铁矮人。
text.completion: We've managed to take this small area, but to do anything more we'll need your help.

english.title: Adventurers Wanted: Blackrock Depths
english.objectives: Speak with High Executioner Nuzrak.
english.description: The Warchief has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Blackrock Depths, west of Flame Crest, immediately!$B$BThe Dark Iron dwarves have already attacked Alliance-held Redridge, and if left unchecked, may soon threaten our few Horde footholds in southern Azeroth.$b$bIf you so choose, head to Blackrock Depths and speak with High Executioner Nuzrak, who is reforming the Kargath Expeditionary Force to finish off the Dark Irons once and for all.
english.completion: We've managed to take this small area, but to do anything more we'll need your help.

text.title: Adventurers Wanted: Blackrock Spire
text.objectives: Speak with Acride.
text.description: The Warchief has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Blackrock Spire, west of Flame Crest, immediately!$B$BNefarian's armies and Rend Blackhand's followers threaten the very existence of the Horde! If you so choose, head to Blackrock Spire and speak with Acride, our only contact within that may be able to help us stop the impending invasion.

english.title: Adventurers Wanted: Blackrock Spire
english.objectives: Speak with Acride.
english.description: The Warchief has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Blackrock Spire, west of Flame Crest, immediately!$B$BNefarian's armies and Rend Blackhand's followers threaten the very existence of the Horde! If you so choose, head to Blackrock Spire and speak with Acride, our only contact within that may be able to help us stop the impending invasion.

text.title: 征召冒险者：黑石塔
text.objectives: 与阿克莱德交谈。
text.description: 安度因·乌瑞恩国王要求所有身强力壮的冒险者前往摩根的岗哨西北边的黑石塔，立即动身！$B$B奈法利安的军队和雷德·黑手的爪牙正威胁着王国的主权！如果你愿意响应号召，就前往黑石塔，与阿克莱德谈谈。他是我们在那里唯一的联系人，也许你可以帮助我们阻止这场即将到来的入侵。

english.title: Adventurers Wanted: Blackrock Spire
english.objectives: Speak with Acride.
english.description: King Varian Wrynn has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Blackrock Spire, northwest of Morgan's Vigil, immediately!$B$BNefarian's armies and Rend Blackhand's followers threaten the entirety of His Majesty's kingdom! If you so choose, head to Blackrock Spire and speak with Acride, our only contact within that may be able to help us stop the impending invasion.

text.title: Adventurers Wanted: Dire Maul Warpwood Quarter
text.objectives: Speak with Furgus Warpwood.
text.description: King Varian Wrynn has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Dire Maul's Warpwood Quarter, east of Feathermoon Stronghold, immediately!$B$BAlzzin the Wildshaper has corrupted the area and could take over the entire Maul! If you so choose, head to the Warpwood Quarter and speak with Furgus Warpwood, one of the few uncorrupt beings left inside alive.

If you so choose, head to the Capital Gardens and speak with Estulan, a recently discovered pure Highborne seeking to reclaim the fallen city for his people.

If you so choose, head to Northern Dire Maul and speak with the Druid of the Talon already sent there as a forward scout.

text.description: The Warchief has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Stratholme's main gate, due north from Plaguewood, immediately!$B$BThe Dreadlord Balnazzar has slain the Scarlet Crusade and resurrected them as the Risen! If you so choose, head to the main gate and speak with Crusade Commander Eligor Dawnbringer, leader of the Argent Crusade effort to retake Stratholme for its true owners.

If you so choose, head to the service gate and speak with Crusade Commander Eligor Dawnbringer, leader of the Argent Crusade effort to retake Stratholme for its true owners.

text.description: King Varian Wrynn has requested that any able-bodied adventurer head to Scholomance, east of Andorhal, immediately!$B$BRas Frostwhisper and Darkmaster Gandling are still hard at work training powerful sorcerers for the scourge! If you so choose, head to Scholomance and speak with Weldon Barov, last living son of Barov and heir to much of the surrounding lands.

text.title: 克罗姆加的力量
text.completion: You may now make use of the Krom'gar stockpile, $n! For a small fee I will sell you armaments of battle, useful for crushing your enemies! The availability of what I sell depends upon your rank in the army. Visit my shop whenever you earn a new rank.$B$BLOK'TAR OGAR!

english.title: Might of the Krom'gar
english.completion: You may now make use of the Krom'gar stockpile, $n! For a small fee I will sell you armaments of battle, useful for crushing your enemies! The availability of what I sell depends upon your rank in the army. Visit my shop whenever you earn a new rank.$B$BLOK'TAR OGAR!

text.title: 风巢的麻烦
text.objectives: 跟千针石林风巢的帕奥卡·迅山谈一谈。
text.description: 谢谢你的帮忙，$n。你应该跟西南方风巢的帕奥卡·迅山谈谈。$B$B也许他知道恐怖图腾巫婆长老的所在？
text.completion: I know nothing of the Elder Crone, Magatha. What I do know is that the Twilight's Hammer is destroying Highperch. Will you help me to stop them, $c?

english.title: Trouble at Highperch
english.objectives: Speak with Pao'ka Swiftmountain at Highperch in Thousand Needles.
english.description: Thank you for your help, $n. You should speak with Pao'ka Swiftmountain at Highperch to the southwest.$B$BPerhaps he will know the whereabouts of the Elder Crone?
english.completion: I know nothing of the Elder Crone, Magatha. What I do know is that the Twilight's Hammer is destroying Highperch. Will you help me to stop them, $c?

text.title: 解救傲爪幼崽
text.objectives: 解救12条风巢傲爪幼崽。
text.description: 捕猎者正在围捕所有年幼的双足飞龙。$n，你是否愿意去把那些傲爪幼崽救出来？
text.completion: They're precious. One day they'll grow strong, but until then, they must be protected.
text.completed: Return to Pao'ka Swiftmountain at Highperch in Thousand Needles.

english.title: Free the Pridelings
english.objectives: Free 12 Highperch Pridelings.
english.description: The trappers are rounding up all of the young wind riders. $n, will you go out there and free the pridelings?
english.completion: They're precious. One day they'll grow strong, but until then, they must be protected.
english.completed: Return to Pao'ka Swiftmountain at Highperch in Thousand Needles.

text.title: 诱捕者都去死！
text.objectives: 收集8张诱捕者之网。
text.description: 这些肮脏的暮光诱捕者只有一个结局！死！$B$B把他们的网带回来给我，$n。
text.progress: What insanity could drive someone to do such horrible things?
text.completion: There'll be no more trapping this day!
text.completed: Return to Pao'ka Swiftmountain at Highperch in Thousand Needles.

english.title: Death to all Trappers!
english.objectives: Collect 8 Trapper Nets.
english.description: There's only one answer for those filthy Twilight's Hammer trappers! Death!$B$BBring me their nets, $n.
english.progress: What insanity could drive someone to do such horrible things?
english.completion: There'll be no more trapping this day!
english.completed: Return to Pao'ka Swiftmountain at Highperch in Thousand Needles.

text.title: 释放锐爪飞心
text.objectives: 帮助锐爪飞心摆脱束缚。
text.description: 暮光之锤囚禁了风巢飞龙的族长。你必须赶往东边的斜坡搭救锐爪飞心，不然整个族群就会陷入群龙无首的混乱！
text.completion: The great Heartrazor is a majestic creature. He has told me of his gratitude and fondness for you, $n.
text.completed: Return to Pao'ka Swiftmountain at Highperch in Thousand Needles.

english.title: Release Heartrazor
english.objectives: Release Heartrazor from all bonds restraining him.
english.description: The Twilight's Hammer have the alpha male of Highperch pinned down. You must head east up the ramp and release Heartrazor before the pride loses it's patriarch!
english.completion: The great Heartrazor is a majestic creature. He has told me of his gratitude and fondness for you, $n.
english.completed: Return to Pao'ka Swiftmountain at Highperch in Thousand Needles.

text.title: 大酋长的命令：希尔斯布莱德丘陵！
text.objectives: 去找希尔斯布莱德丘陵南点大门的高级执行官达萨利亚。
text.description: 所有身强力壮的部落成员，从此刻起都要向希尔斯布莱德丘陵南点大门的高级执行官达萨利亚报到。被遗忘者的战争机器正在全力开动，为部落夺取洛丹伦！$B$B要前往南点大门，就沿着南边的路穿越银松森林，然后走东边的岔路进入希尔斯布莱德丘陵。$B$B前进吧，$g兄弟:姐妹;！命运在召唤！
text.completion: I was wondering when reinforcements would show up. Suit up, $n. It's time to dispense some justice!

english.title: Warchief's Command: Hillsbrad Foothills!
english.objectives: Report to High Executor Darthalia at Southpoint Gate in Hillsbrad Foothills.
english.description: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to High Executor Darthalia at Southpoint Gate in Hillsbrad Foothills. The Forsaken war machine marches ever onward, securing Lordaeron for the Horde!$B$BTo reach Southpoint Gate you must follow the road south through Silverpine Forest and take the east fork leading into Hillsbrad Foothills.$B$BOnward, $g brother:sister;! Destiny calls!
english.completion: I was wondering when reinforcements would show up. Suit up, $n. It's time to dispense some justice!

text.title: 珍贵的货物
text.objectives: 缴获一颗暮光之锤门石。存放门石的箱子钥匙应该在持矛守卫身上。
text.description: 峡谷深处的大门被关闭了。我们的侦察表明，他们的车队里载着一些箱子，里面的某种石头可以打开大门。$B$B去守卫的尸体上找一把箱子钥匙来。找到以后，就用它打开车队里的一个箱子，将门石给我带来。
text.progress: You know, we could probably just blow the gates, but knowing our demoman, we're probably better off dodging the risk.
text.completion: Good going. Doesn't look like much, does it?
text.completed: Return to Patch at Dragonmaw Pass in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Precious Goods
english.objectives: Retrieve a Twilight Caravan Gatestone. The Spearwardens should carry keys that can get you into the gatestone chests.
english.description: The gates further down the canyon are shut. Our scouting revealed some kind of stone that they carry in chests in their caravans that they use to open the gates.$B$BGet down there and look for a chest key on the bodies of the guards. When you find it, use it on one of those chests on the caravan wagons and bring the gatestone back to me.
english.progress: You know, we could probably just blow the gates, but knowing our demoman, we're probably better off dodging the risk.
english.completion: Good going. Doesn't look like much, does it?
english.completed: Return to Patch at Dragonmaw Pass in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 轻松杀敌
text.objectives: 杀死8名暮光持矛守卫。
text.description: 伏击很顺利。大多数卫兵都死了，少数还被压制在马车那里。$B$B就在峡谷下面，你可以在西边看到他们。过去把他们都干掉，我们好发动进攻。
text.completion: Excellent. Now we can start pushing our ground forces up towards Grim Batol.
text.completed: Return to Patch at Dragonmaw Pass in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Easy Pickings
english.objectives: Kill 8 Twilight Spearwarders.
english.description: The ambush launched smoothly. Most of the guards are dead, but a few are still pinned down with the wagons.$B$BYou can see them just to our west, in the canyon below. Get in there and clear them out so we can get this attack on the move.
english.completion: Excellent. Now we can start pushing our ground forces up towards Grim Batol.
english.completed: Return to Patch at Dragonmaw Pass in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 只要钥匙合适
text.objectives: 带领地精小队前去关闭的龙喉大门。$B$B如果你失去了地精小队，就去找督军克罗格。
text.description: 巨龙已经在格瑞姆巴托的天空上展开了战斗。我们该把地面上的人派出去占领大门了。$B$B我要你知道，胜负在此一举，$c。暮光之锤在高地的所有增援都仰仗格瑞姆巴托。如果我们不把他们在这里切断，后面的战斗就无法胜利。$B$B我要派地精小队和你一起去。到东南边的大门那里，把它打开。补丁可以给你下达进一步的指示。
text.completion: Works like a charm, every time.
text.completed: Speak to Patch at Wyrms' Bend in the Twilight Highlands.$B$BSpeak to Warlord Krogg at Wyrms' Bend in the Twilight Highlands if you are no longer with Patch.

english.title: If The Key Fits
english.objectives: Lead the Gob Squad to the closed Dragonmaw Gate.$B$BIf you lose the Gob Squad, return to Warlord Krogg for reassignment.
english.description: The wyrms have already taken the battle to the sky above Grim Batol. It's up to us to move our men in by ground and secure the gates.$B$BI want you to know what is at stake here, $c. Grim Batol is the source of Twilight's Hammer reinforcements to all of the highlands. If we do not cut them off here, we will not win the battles ahead.$B$BI'm sending the Gob Squad with you. Get to the gate to the southeast and get it open. Patch should have any further instructions you'll need from there.
english.completion: Works like a charm, every time.
english.completed: Speak to Patch at Wyrms' Bend in the Twilight Highlands.$B$BSpeak to Warlord Krogg at Wyrms' Bend in the Twilight Highlands if you are no longer with Patch.

text.title: 前进
text.objectives: 带领地精小队通过北部龙喉大门，前往格瑞姆巴托入口。$B$B如果你失去了地精小队，就去找巨龙曲径的督军克罗格。
text.description: 目前为止一切顺利。过了这扇大门，我们就能找到格瑞姆巴托的入口。$B$B我收到命令，要占领入口，阻止敌人增援，其他人则穿过小道，通过被我们清理的峡谷。我想假如我们动作快的话，还能让钟摆找点乐子。$B$B我们出发前往西南边的峡谷吧——应该很快就能找到下一座大门了。
text.progress: 欢迎你，$R。
text.completion: The gate is clear. Once your people finish clearing the canyon, we will speak to your leaders about the next move.
text.completed: Speak to Calen near the entrance to Grim Batol in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Pressing Forward
english.objectives: Bring the Gob Squad past the northern Dragonmaw Gate to the entrance of Grim Batol.$B$BIf you are separated from the Gob Squad, return to Warlord Krogg in Wyrms' Bend to be reassigned.
english.description: Good work so far. We should find the entrance to Grim Batol just past the next gate.$B$BI was ordered to secure the entrance and block off reinforcements while the rest of our men press through the path we've cleared up the canyon. I'm thinking if we get there soon enough, maybe I can let Ticker have a little more fun.$B$BLet's get moving down the canyon to the southwest - we should find the next gate pretty quickly.
english.progress: Welcome, $r.
english.completion: The gate is clear. Once your people finish clearing the canyon, we will speak to your leaders about the next move.
english.completed: Speak to Calen near the entrance to Grim Batol in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 铺路
text.objectives: 消灭30名暮光之锤邪教徒，沿着巨龙曲径一路杀向格瑞姆巴托的入口。
text.description: 我接受的命令是护送你前往南方，穿过龙喉大门，来到格瑞姆巴托入口处。我们已经清出了一条道路，以便其他人能够跟着我们去占领入口。$B$B我简单翻译一下吧：把会动弹的统统杀掉，要是你觉得还挺过瘾，也没什么不好意思的。$B$B小伙子们都不耐烦了。咱们走吧。
text.completion: We make it look easy.
text.completed: Speak to Patch at Wyrms' Bend in the Twilight Highlands.$B$BSpeak to Warlord Krogg at Wyrms' Bend in the Twilight Highlands if you are no longer with Patch.

english.title: Paving the Way
english.objectives: Kill 30 Twilight's Hammer cultists along Wyrm's Bend as you fight towards the entrance to Grim Batol.
english.description: My orders are to accompany you south through the Dragonmaw Gates towards the entrance of Grim Batol. We're to clear a path so that the rest of the men can follow us up and secure the entrance.$B$BTranslation: kill everything that moves, and don't be ashamed if you have a good time doing it.$B$BThe boys are getting antsy. Let's go.
english.completion: We make it look easy.
english.completed: Speak to Patch at Wyrms' Bend in the Twilight Highlands.$B$BSpeak to Warlord Krogg at Wyrms' Bend in the Twilight Highlands if you are no longer with Patch.

objectiveDetails.description: 杀死巨龙曲径的邪教徒

text.title: 任务给予者的体验
text.objectives: 指派3项任务。
text.description: $g伙计:姑娘;，来根雪茄吧。你很快就会扬名立万，成为被遗忘者的高阶官员了。没错，好日子就要开始啦！$B$B我要你将这些指令分发给前来找活儿干的底层人员。把哪项任务分给谁，全凭你的决定。$B$B如果你准备好了，就骑上我忠实的骸骨战马吧——他们肯定会看到你的，然后开始体验全新的生活吧！呃，你站那里等着就成。
text.completion: So how was it? Everything that you dreamed it would be? Exciting, no?$B$BNo?$B$B<Darthalia sighs.>$B$BI can see that you're a true $g hero:heroine;. You need action. I guess a "desk job" isn't for you.
text.completed: Report to High Executor Darthalia at Southpoint Gate in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: Welcome to the Machine
english.objectives: Hand out 3 Quests.
english.description: Come in here dear $g boy:girl;, have a cigar. You're gonna go far and fly high as a ranking officer of the Forsaken. Yes, indeed, this is the good life and you are going to live it!$B$BI want you to take these orders and dispense them to the lowly scrubs that come along looking for work. Who you give what to is wholly at your discretion.$B$BWhen you're ready, mount up on my trusty skeletal steed - so they don't miss you - and start living the life! Which means just stand there and wait.
english.completion: So how was it? Everything that you dreamed it would be? Exciting, no?$B$BNo?$B$B<Darthalia sighs.>$B$BI can see that you're a true $g hero:heroine;. You need action. I guess a "desk job" isn't for you.
english.completed: Report to High Executor Darthalia at Southpoint Gate in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 格瑞姆巴托的大门
text.objectives: 跟巨龙曲径的督军克罗格谈一谈。
text.description: 克罗格对峡谷发动了进攻。他刚刚穿过东南边的大门。$B$B我要把小队集中起来，加入战斗。咱们下面见。
text.completion: The canyon is well fortified, but the distraction that the dragons are providing should be enough to allow us to break through.

english.title: The Gates of Grim Batol
english.objectives: Speak to Warlord Krogg in Wyrms' Bend.
english.description: Kroggs started the assault to push up the canyon. He's just past the gate to our southeast.$B$BI'm going to get the squad together to join the attack. We'll meet you down there.
english.completion: The canyon is well fortified, but the distraction that the dragons are providing should be enough to allow us to break through.

text.title: 暮光天空之主
text.objectives: 乘坐锐爪飞心抵达暮光之巢，挑战暮光天空之主里克托芬。
text.description: 暮光天空之主里克托芬就在东南方高处的暮光之巢。无论我们怎么努力，只要还没有杀掉他，风巢飞龙就没有存活的希望。$B$B虽然锐爪飞心受了重伤，不能陪你作战，但是他可以载你一程。接下来就靠你自己了，$n。$B$B祝你好运。
text.completion: The pridelings did what? They must love you deeply for freeing them. Thank you, $n. You've saved Highperch!
text.completed: Return to Pao'ka Swiftmountain at Highperch in Thousand Needles.
text.giverWindow: 杀死暮光天空之主里克托芬！
text.giverTarget: 暮光天空之主里克托芬

english.title: The Twilight Skymaster
english.objectives: Get a flight from Heartrazor to the Twilight Aerie and deal with Twilight Skymaster Richtofen.
english.description: Twilight Skymaster Richtofen is at the Twilight Aerie up above and to the southeast. No matter what we do down here, if he's not dealt with, all hope is lost for Highperch.$B$BWhile Heartrazor is too injured to help you with the fight, he can fly you up there. The rest is up to you, $n.$B$BGood luck.
english.completion: The pridelings did what? They must love you deeply for freeing them. Thank you, $n. You've saved Highperch!
english.completed: Return to Pao'ka Swiftmountain at Highperch in Thousand Needles.
english.giverWindow: Shoot him out of the skies!

objectiveDetails.description: 杀死暮光天空之主里克托芬

text.title: 拉沙科拉克
text.objectives: 获得拉沙科拉克的缚能护腕。
text.description: 基于你送来的情报，我相信这个“大公”的爪牙已经把注意转向了瑟银哨塔。$b$b他的名字叫做拉沙科拉克，就徘徊在我们南边的熔岩池里。他看起来和潜伏在附近的火元素很像，只有一个小小的不同：戴在其手腕上的缚能护腕。$b$b找到他，把那对护腕带给我，$n。在卷入一场元素战争之前，我需要证据来证明我们确实陷入了危险。
text.progress: I won't fight any elementals until we have proven that they pose a threat to us.
text.completion: It is, unfortunately, as I expected.  These bracers bear the indelible mark of the firelord and his minions. Very well.  With no Horde or Alliance forces anywhere near this godforsaken gorge, it falls upon the Thorium Brotherhood to stop this Archduke before he spreads any more of his evil.
text.completed: Return to Overseer Oilfist at Thorium Point in Searing Gorge.
text.giverWindow: 他游荡到了瑟银哨塔的入口。他想干吗？

english.title: Rasha'krak
english.objectives: Obtain Rasha'krak's Bracers of Binding.
english.description: Based on this information you've delivered, I believe that one of this "Archduke's" minions may already have turned its eyes toward Thorium Point.$b$bHis name is Rasha'krak, and he patrols the lava pools just to our south.  He looks like the latent fire elementals that rage nearby, except for one small difference: the bracers of binding that encircle his wrists.$b$bFind him and bring these bracers to me, $n.  I need proof that we are in danger before we involve ourselves in elemental wars.
english.progress: I won't fight any elementals until we have proven that they pose a threat to us.
english.completion: It is, unfortunately, as I expected.  These bracers bear the indelible mark of the firelord and his minions. Very well.  With no Horde or Alliance forces anywhere near this godforsaken gorge, it falls upon the Thorium Brotherhood to stop this Archduke before he spreads any more of his evil.
english.completed: Return to Overseer Oilfist at Thorium Point in Searing Gorge.
english.giverWindow: He patrols the entrance to Thorium Point.  What does he want?

text.title: 说话的图腾
text.objectives: 跟死木村附近卢姆波的图腾谈一谈。
text.description: 南边的熊怪村是死木部族的家，他们也是木喉的宿敌。他们像许多其他熊怪一样堕落而污秽，这片森林的污染使他们发狂。$B$B不过，村子附近发生了不同寻常的事情。来这里的旅行者们说路边的图腾对他们开口说话了。$B$B每次我接近的时候却什么都没有听到。也许它会跟你说话，$n？或许你可以帮我查清楚到底发生了什么事。
text.completion: You... yes, you! I have chosen you, $r, as my champion! You will do the work of Ruumbo!

english.title: A Talking Totem
english.objectives: Speak with the Totem of Ruumbo near Deadwood Village.
english.description: The furbolg village to the south is the home of the Deadwood tribe, sworn enemies of the Timbermaw. They are corrupted and foul like so many others, driven mad by the taint of these woods.$B$BSomething unusual has occured near the village though. Travelers coming here have said that the totem next to the road has spoken to them.$B$BI have heard nothing every time I approach it. Perhaps it will speak to you, $n? Maybe you can find out what's going on for me.
english.completion: You... yes, you! I have chosen you, $r, as my champion! You will do the work of Ruumbo!

text.title: 马迪亚斯的命令
text.objectives: 跟龙喉小径的马迪亚斯·肖尔大师谈一谈。
text.description: 最近的事件表明，坚守阵地，并对格瑞姆巴托展开零星的进攻根本不足以保护我们的人，更别提将其收复了。我们需要更具进攻性，我们得直击他们的要害。$B$B我同意派巨龙去协助你的指挥官们。他们已经制定了一份攻打格瑞姆巴托的计划，你最好先把注意力集中在那里。$B$B你应该可以在龙喉小径找到马迪亚斯·肖尔，那地方就在我们下面南方的峡谷里。
text.completion: The red dragons have agreed to help! No small feat, I'm sure. You have the thanks of the Alliance. We'd already laid out plans for our ambush on a Twilight caravan by the time the dragons contacted us. They're helping by cutting off their retreat. The battle still rages. You can definitely be of aid.

english.title: Mathias' Command
english.objectives: Speak to Master Mathias Shaw in Dragonmaw Pass.
english.description: Recent events make it even more apparent that holing up here and making sporadic attacks on Grim Batol isn't enough to keep our kind safe, much less retake Grim Batol. We need to be more aggressive, we need to strike into their heart.$B$BI've agreed to send dragons to the aid of your commanders. They were already hatching a plan to strike at Grim Batol, so you should focus your attention there first.$B$BYou should be able to find Mathias Shaw in Dragonmaw Pass, in the canyon below us to the south.
english.completion: The red dragons have agreed to help! No small feat, I'm sure. You have the thanks of the Alliance. We'd already laid out plans for our ambush on a Twilight caravan by the time the dragons contacted us. They're helping by cutting off their retreat. The battle still rages. You can definitely be of aid.

text.title: 挑战支配权
text.objectives: 在克斯特拉斯废墟杀死8名碧火盗贼或碧火捕猎者。
text.description: 是时候对碧火萨特进行最后一次进攻了！$B$B假如你做好准备，要冲破他们肮脏的屏障，对付他们首领的话，那么我还要求你帮我们处理掉那些低级的萨特。我们的德鲁伊作战很凶猛，但有了你的力量，战局就能被扭转过来。$B$B让那些碧火萨特知道，这片土地不再处于他们的权力支配之下！
text.completion: A few of the remaining satyr have fled into the deeper woods, but they have taken heavy losses. Good job, $n.
text.completed: Return to Eridan Bluewind at the Ruins of Constellas in Felwood.

english.title: Fight the Power
english.objectives: Slay 8 Jadefire Rogues or Jadefire Shadowstalkers at the Ruins of Constellas.
english.description: It's time for the final push against the Jadefire!$B$BIf you're prepared to break through their foul barrier and bring the fight to their leader, I'd also ask your help against the lesser satyr. Our druids fight ferociously, but your strength can help turn the battle.$B$BShow the Jadefire that their power will no longer hold sway over these lands!
english.completion: A few of the remaining satyr have fled into the deeper woods, but they have taken heavy losses. Good job, $n.
english.completed: Return to Eridan Bluewind at the Ruins of Constellas in Felwood.

objectiveDetails.description: 杀死碧火盗贼或捕猎者

text.title: 轻松杀敌
text.objectives: 杀死8名暮光持矛守卫。
text.description: 伏击很顺利。大多数卫兵都死了，少数还被压制在马车那里。$B$B就在峡谷下面，你可以在西边看到他们。过去把他们都干掉，我们朝峡谷进发。
text.completion: Excellent. Now we can start pushing our ground forces up towards Grim Batol.
text.completed: Return to Master Mathias Shaw at Dragonmaw Pass in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Easy Pickings
english.objectives: Kill 8 Twilight Spearwardens.
english.description: The ambush launched smoothly. Most of the guards are dead, but a few are still pinned down with the wagons.$B$BGet in there and clear them out so we can push forward into the canyons.
english.completion: Excellent. Now we can start pushing our ground forces up towards Grim Batol.
english.completed: Return to Master Mathias Shaw at Dragonmaw Pass in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 珍贵的货物
text.objectives: 缴获一颗暮光之锤门石。存放门石的箱子钥匙应该在持矛守卫身上。
text.description: 峡谷深处的大门被关闭了。我们的侦察表明，他们的车队里载着一些箱子，里面的某种石头可以打开大门。$B$B去守卫的尸体上找一把箱子钥匙来。找到以后，就用它打开车队里的一个箱子，将门石给我带来。
text.progress: They've grown overconfident. More and more, that seems the downfall of the most powerful armies.
text.completion: Good going. Doesn't look like much, does it?
text.completed: Return to Master Mathias Shaw at Dragonmaw Pass in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Precious Goods
english.objectives: Retrieve a Twilight Caravan Gatestone. The Spearwardens should carry keys that can get you into the gatestone chests.
english.description: The gates further down the canyon are shut. Our scouting revealed a stone that they carried in chests in their caravans that they used to open the gates.$B$BGet down there and look for a chest key on the bodies of the guards. When you find it, use it on one of those chests on the caravan wagons and bring the gatestone back to me.
english.progress: They've grown overconfident. More and more, that seems the downfall of the most powerful armies.
english.completion: Good going. Doesn't look like much, does it?
english.completed: Return to Master Mathias Shaw at Dragonmaw Pass in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 无情者卡文
text.objectives: 从无情者卡文身上获得尼斐塞特之匙。
text.description: 在尼斐塞特人同死亡之翼签订协议之前，卡文就以残忍著称。他以别人的痛苦为乐，如今更是几近疯狂。$B$B他掌握着解开我们枷锁的钥匙。$B$B他就居住在我右边的这幢建筑里。$B$B找到他，把钥匙拿走。不要心慈手软。他可是杀人不眨眼的。
text.progress: You're back.  Do you have the key?
text.completion: Excellent, $n.  We will make our way out of here soon enough.
text.completed: Return to Prince Nadun at the Lost City of the Tol'vir in Uldum.

english.title: Kavem the Callous
english.objectives: Obtain the Neferset Key from Kavem the Callous.
