english.description: Kavem was cruel enough before the Neferset signed up with Deathwing.  His pleasure in deriving pain now borders on the insane.$B$BIt is he who now holds the keys to our shackles.$B$BHe dwells in the building next to us, to my right.$B$BFind him and take the key from him.  Do not hesitate or show him mercy.  He will slit your throat and think nothing of it.
english.progress: You're back.  Do you have the key?
english.completion: Excellent, $n.  We will make our way out of here soon enough.
english.completed: Return to Prince Nadun at the Lost City of the Tol'vir in Uldum.

text.title: The Gates of Grim Batol (NOT NEEDED?)

english.title: The Gates of Grim Batol (NOT NEEDED?)

text.title: 铺路
text.objectives: 消灭30名暮光之锤邪教徒，沿着巨龙曲径一路杀向格瑞姆巴托的入口。
text.description: 我接受的命令是护送你前往南方，穿过龙喉大门，来到格瑞姆巴托入口处。我们已经清出了一条道路，以便其他人能够跟着我们去占领入口。$B$B我简单翻译一下吧：把会动弹的统统杀掉，要是你觉得还挺过瘾，也没什么不好意思的。$B$B小伙子们都不耐烦了。咱们走吧。
text.completion: We make it look easy.
text.completed: Speak to the Highbank Leuitenant at Wyrms' Bend in the Twilight Highlands.$B$BSpeak to Master Mathias Shaw at Wyrms' Bend in the Twilight Highlands if you are no longer with your squad.

english.title: Paving the Way
english.objectives: Kill 30 Twilight's Hammer cultists along Wyrm's Bend as you fight towards the entrance to Grim Batol.
english.description: My orders are to accompany you south through the Dragonmaw Gates towards the entrance of Grim Batol. We're to clear a path so that the rest of the men can follow us up and secure the entrance.$B$BTranslation: kill everything that moves, and don't be ashamed if you have a good time doing it.$B$BThe boys are getting antsy. Let's go.
english.completion: We make it look easy.
english.completed: Speak to the Highbank Leuitenant at Wyrms' Bend in the Twilight Highlands.$B$BSpeak to Master Mathias Shaw at Wyrms' Bend in the Twilight Highlands if you are no longer with your squad.

objectiveDetails.description: 杀死巨龙曲径的邪教徒

text.title: 只要钥匙合适
text.objectives: 带领滩头堡小队前去关闭的龙喉大门。$B$B如果你失去了小队，就去找马迪亚斯·肖尔大师。
text.description: 巨龙已经在格瑞姆巴托的天空上展开了战斗。我们该把地面上的人派出去占领大门了。$B$B我要你知道，胜负在此一举，$c。暮光之锤在高地的所有增援都仰仗格瑞姆巴托。如果我们不把他们在这里切断，后面的战斗就无法胜利。$B$B我要从滩头堡派出一支小队和你一起去。到东南边的大门那里，把它打开。你的上尉可以给你下达进一步的指示。
text.completion: Like a well-oiled machine.
text.completed: Speak your Highbank Leutitenant at Wyrms' Bend in the Twilight Highlands.$B$BSpeak to Master Mathias shaw at Wyrms' Bend in the Twilight Highlands if you are no longer with your squad.

english.title: If The Key Fits
english.objectives: Lead squad from Highbank to the closed Dragonmaw Gate.$B$BIf you lose your squad, return to Master Mathias Shaw for reassignment.
english.description: The wyrms have already taken the battle to the sky above Grim Batol. It's up to us to move our men in by ground and secure the gates.$B$BI want you to know what is at stake here, $c. Grim Batol is the source of Twilight's Hammer reinforcements to all of the highlands. If we do not cut them off here, we will not win the battles ahead.$B$BI'm sending a squad from Highbank with you. Get to the gate to the southeast and get it open. Your lieutenant should have any further instructions you'll need from there.
english.completion: Like a well-oiled machine.
english.completed: Speak your Highbank Leutitenant at Wyrms' Bend in the Twilight Highlands.$B$BSpeak to Master Mathias shaw at Wyrms' Bend in the Twilight Highlands if you are no longer with your squad.

text.title: 前进
text.objectives: 带领小队通过北部龙喉大门，前往格瑞姆巴托入口。$B$B如果你和小队走散，就去找巨龙曲径的找马迪亚斯·肖尔大师。
text.description: 目前为止一切顺利。$B$B过了这扇大门，我们就能找到格瑞姆巴托的入口。我收到命令，要占领入口，阻止敌人增援，其他人则穿过小道，通过被我们清理的峡谷。$B$B我们出发前往西南边的峡谷吧——应该很快就能找到下一座大门了。
text.completion: The gate is clear. Once your people finish clearing the canyon, we will speak to your leaders about the next move.
text.completed: Speak to Calen near the entrance to Grim Batol in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Pressing Forward
english.objectives: Bring your squad past the northern Dragonmaw Gate to the entrance of Grim Batol.$B$BIf you are separated from your squad, return to Master Mathias Shaw in Wyrms' Bend to be reassigned.
english.description: Good work so far.$B$BWe should find the entrance to Grim Batol just past the next gate. I was ordered to secure the entrance and block off reinforcements while the rest of our men press through the path we've cleared up the canyon.$B$BLet's get moving down the canyon to the southwest - we should find the next gate pretty quickly.
english.completion: The gate is clear. Once your people finish clearing the canyon, we will speak to your leaders about the next move.
english.completed: Speak to Calen near the entrance to Grim Batol in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 碧玉矿洞的麻烦
text.objectives: 向希尔斯布莱德丘陵碧玉矿洞的凯东上尉报到。
text.description: 碧玉矿洞的农场生产陷入了停滞不前的窘境。凯东上尉命令我们立即派出帮手。他说，矿洞蜘蛛拒绝服从命令并开始四下逃窜。更糟糕的是，海滩上的鱼人还跑来偷窃我们的补给品。我要你去那里调查情况。帮助凯东和驯蛛人吧，$n。$B$B碧玉矿洞就坐落在东南方的海滩附近。
text.completion: We're in a bit of a bind, $c. Sarus' spiders are starting to get a little uppity as we've been unable to feed them for days. If we leave the murlocs will overtake our post! Furthermore, Warden Stillwater over at the Sludge Fields is demanding that we send him more humans! He is insatiable! We need help!

english.title: Trouble at Azurelode
english.objectives: Report to Captain Keyton at the Azurelode Mine in Hillsbrad Foothills.
english.description: Productivity from our spider farm at the Azurelode Mine is at a standstill. Captain Keyton has requested that we send help immediately. Keyton claims that the mine spiders refuse command and are running rampant. Furthermore, a group of coastal murlocs are raiding our supplies. I want you to go down there and check things out. Help out Keyton and the spider-handler, $n.$B$BYou'll find Azurelode Mine to the southeast, near the coast.
english.completion: We're in a bit of a bind, $c. Sarus' spiders are starting to get a little uppity as we've been unable to feed them for days. If we leave the murlocs will overtake our post! Furthermore, Warden Stillwater over at the Sludge Fields is demanding that we send him more humans! He is insatiable! We need help!

text.title: 逃离失落之城
text.objectives: 救出纳顿亲王，然后跟奥丹姆拉穆卡恒的法奥瑞斯国王谈一谈。
text.description: 一切就绪了！解开我的锁链，把你的朋友们救出来吧。$B$B我们要趁那些尼斐塞特渣滓有所发现之前赶快行动！$B$B如果我们成功逃离，就去找我的兄弟法奥瑞斯国王索要奖赏。
text.completion: It is true then?  An outsider rescued Prince Nadun from the Neferset? We are truly in your debt, stranger.

english.title: Escape From the Lost City
english.objectives: Free Prince Nadun and speak to King Phaoris at Ramkahen in Uldum.
english.description: Everything is ready!  Undo my chains and set your friends free.$B$BWe must move quickly before the Neferset scum realize we're up to something!$B$BIf we make it, see my brother, King Phaoris for a reward.
english.completion: It is true then?  An outsider rescued Prince Nadun from the Neferset? We are truly in your debt, stranger.

text.title: 无攻不破
text.objectives: 杀死萨瓦瑟拉斯。
text.description: 有了这爪子，我们就做好了准备，可以突破碧火萨特的防御了。$B$B到西北边的废墟里去。就在萨特的前线后方，你将会找到一条狭窄的小道，可以通往他们堕落的月井。在那里，有一道巨大的恶魔火焰之墙阻挡着道路，但提克迪奥斯之爪可以将其驱散。$B$B在那道屏障后面，你就能找到他们的领军人物，守护着堕落月井的萨瓦瑟拉斯。把他杀掉！
text.completion: See what can get done with a little cooperation? I'll make sure the claw is given to people responsible enough to contain such things... assuming it can't be destroyed.
text.completed: Return to Arcanist Delaris at the Ruins of Constellas in Felwood.
text.giverWindow: 碧火萨特的邪恶公爵。

english.title: Break the Unbreakable
english.objectives: Slay Xavathras.
english.description: With the claw, we are ready to break through the Jadefire's defenses.$B$BHead into the ruins to the northwest. Beyond the frontline of the satyr you'll find a narrow pass heading to their corrupted moonwell. An enormous wall of demonic flame bars the path, but the Claw of Tichondrius should be able to dispel it.$B$BBeyond the barrier you will find the leader of these forces, Xavathras, guarding the corrupted moonwell. Slay him once you are through!
english.completion: See what can get done with a little cooperation? I'll make sure the claw is given to people responsible enough to contain such things... assuming it can't be destroyed.
english.completed: Return to Arcanist Delaris at the Ruins of Constellas in Felwood.
english.giverWindow: Vile Duke of the Jadefire.

text.title: 惊人的产量
text.objectives: 取回60枚爬行者之卵。
text.description: 蜘蛛驯养场坐落在南点大门的东南方。这些年来，我们与希尔斯布莱德丘陵的蜘蛛族群相处得十分融洽，并逐渐开始饲养这些可爱的小动物。如今，它们已经成为家庭的宠物以及战场上的猛兽！真是一种多样化的生物！$B$B我要你进入东南方的原野，小心地采集我们在熊身上布下的蛛卵。将它们交给矿洞的萨露丝。
text.progress: Have you brought my harvest?
text.completion: Wonderful! Now to place these eggs into a nice, dark alcove inside the mine and let the miracle of life happen!
text.completed: Deliver the Creeper Eggs to Spider-Handler Sarus at Azurelode Mine in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: Glorious Harvest
english.objectives: Recover 60 Creeper Eggs.
english.description: Directly southeast of Southpoint Gate you will find our spider domestication operations. Through the years we have grown a kinship with the spiders of Hillsbrad and have managed to domesticate and breed the adorable little critters. Spiders now serve us as regular household pets and beasts of battle! Such diverse creatures they are!$B$BI need you to head into the fields to the southeast and carefully harvest the eggs that we have incubating on the bears. Deliver the harvest to Sarus at the mine.
english.progress: Have you brought my harvest?
english.completion: Wonderful! Now to place these eggs into a nice, dark alcove inside the mine and let the miracle of life happen!
english.completed: Deliver the Creeper Eggs to Spider-Handler Sarus at Azurelode Mine in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 雄风尽失
text.objectives: 杀死8头被感染的熊。
text.description: 熊是卑鄙的生物，我们的生活因此饱受折磨。但是聪明的被遗忘者想出了一个法子，可以一劳永逸地解决野熊的麻烦。$B$B那些被感染的熊总是侵扰我们的营地。被遗忘者们把它们引向了蜘蛛驯养场。蜘蛛的毒液将大大地削弱那些讨厌的生物。$B$B去处理掉那些被感染的熊，保护营地的安全。
text.completion: The bear gods are cruel masters. They will continue to populate this world with bears until the end of days. It is our right as civilized people to make use of this nuisance - for the betterment of us all!
text.completed: Report to Spider-Handler Sarus at Azurelode Mine in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: Past Their Prime
english.objectives: Kill 8 Infested Bears.
english.description: Bears are soulless beasts put upon this earth to torment us. Only through Forsaken ingenuity have we devised a way to make use of the bears so that they may serve some purpose! We use the bears at our spider farm as living egg feeders. Our spiders lay their eggs in the bear flesh and the eggs thrive off of the meat and blood of the beasts.$B$BAfter they have served their purpose the monsters must be put down. Travel southeast and kill the infested bears that have lived past their prime.
english.completion: The bear gods are cruel masters. They will continue to populate this world with bears until the end of days. It is our right as civilized people to make use of this nuisance - for the betterment of us all!
english.completed: Report to Spider-Handler Sarus at Azurelode Mine in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 悲泣的紫罗兰
text.objectives: 采摘8株悲泣的紫罗兰。
text.description: 攻打加德纳尔之前，我们必须做好完全的准备。加德纳尔里那些术士和恶魔的魔法十分强大，我们杀进去之前需要保护结界。$B$B我们现在只差一种材料：悲泣的紫罗兰，这种花生长在敌人要塞西北面的山上。$B$B去摘一些悲泣的紫罗兰，然后去战场上找到我的助手，他知道下一步应该怎么做。
text.progress: Have you found the crying violet yet, $n? We need them quickly.
text.completion: Wonderful. Greta chose wisely when she asked you to perform this task. I will work the herbs immediately...
text.completed: Deliver the Crying Violet to Andalar Shadevale at Jaedenar in Felwood.

english.title: Crying Violet
english.objectives: Collect 8 Crying Violets.
english.description: We must prepare carefully before assaulting Jaedenar. The magic of the warlocks and demons within Jaedenar is strong, and we will need wards of our own before entering.$B$BWe need only one more ingredient: Crying Violet, which grows in the hills near the enemy's stronghold to the northwest. $B$BGather the crying violet, then meet my assistant in the field. He will know what to do next.
english.progress: Have you found the crying violet yet, $n? We need them quickly.
english.completion: Wonderful. Greta chose wisely when she asked you to perform this task. I will work the herbs immediately...
english.completed: Deliver the Crying Violet to Andalar Shadevale at Jaedenar in Felwood.

text.title: 清理地牢
text.objectives: 你的任务是在巴拉丁监狱东边的咒怨地牢中杀死任意9个幽灵。
text.description: 你来得可真是时候啊，$n。我们已经占领了托尔巴拉德，但战斗才刚刚开始。$B$B我们在这里的东边发现了一座监狱，得靠你去清理一下。那地方塞满了不知被关押了多久的幽灵。$b$b尽可能多地清理那里的幽灵，然后回来向我报告。
text.completion: You made it back out alive?  You are a stronger man than I, $n.
text.completed: Report back to Commander Stevens at Baradin Hold when you are done.

english.title: Clearing the Depths
english.objectives: You have been asked to kill 9 ghosts of any type in the Cursed Depths, just east of Baradin Hold.
english.description: You are a sight for sore eyes, $n.  Now that we have claimed Tol Barad, the battle has just begun.$B$BWe discovered a cell block just east of here that we need you to clear out.  Turns out that its chock full of ghosts that have been locked up down there for who knows how long.$b$bClear out as much as you can and report back to me when you are done.
english.completion: You made it back out alive?  You are a stronger man than I, $n.
english.completed: Report back to Commander Stevens at Baradin Hold when you are done.

text.title: 被囚禁的大法师
text.objectives: 你必须杀死巴拉丁监狱东边的咒怨地牢中的大法师加鲁斯，然后取回他的法杖。
text.description: 自从我们踏上托尔巴拉德的土地，就一直在努力清理咒怨地牢的牢房。似乎每次我们即将大功告成时，那个大法师就会冒出来，把我们打回去。$B$B现在既然我们已经占领岛屿了，就该再试一次。你去跑一趟，把他的法杖给我带回来，作为你完成任务的证据。
text.progress: Have you been able to take out the Archmage?
text.completion: Galus is dead?  Fantastic work $n, now we can send down the cleanup crew and get that cellblock ready for new prisoners.
text.completed: Report back to Commander Stevens at Baradin Hold when you are done.
text.giverWindow: 他拿着那把法杖的日子不会太长了。

english.title: The Imprisoned Archmage
english.objectives: You must kill Archmage Galus and return with his Staff from the Cursed Depths, just east of Baradin Hold.
english.description: We have been trying to clear out the Cursed Depths cellblock since we landed on Tol Barad.  It seems that everytime we get close, that archmage shows up and pushes us back.$B$BNow that we have claimed the island, it's time we take another shot.  Head down there and bring me back his staff as proof that you have finished the job.
english.progress: Have you been able to take out the Archmage?
english.completion: Galus is dead?  Fantastic work $n, now we can send down the cleanup crew and get that cellblock ready for new prisoners.
english.completed: Report back to Commander Stevens at Baradin Hold when you are done.
english.giverWindow: He won't have that staff for long.

text.title: 源自腐败的净化
text.objectives: 用加德纳尔中央被污染的月井水装满空壶。
text.description: 你给我带来的这些花是必须的材料。$B$B恶魔火盆生成了保护屏障笼罩着暗影堡。如果想要将暗影议会赶出费伍德森林，我们就必须先熄灭那些火盆。$B$B这个瓶子里已经注入了悲泣的紫罗兰和自然的魔法。到加德纳尔中央去，在瓶中装满被污染的月井水，然后再回到我这儿来。
text.progress: Do you have the waters from the corrupted moonwell?
text.completion: This will do nicely, $n.
text.completed: Return to Andalar Shadevale at Jaedenar in Felwood.

english.title: Purity From Corruption
english.objectives: Fill the Empty Canteen with water from the corrupted moon well in the center of Jaedenar.
english.description: The flowers you brought me were the essential ingredient.$B$BProtective barriers surround Shadow Hold, projected from demonic braziers. If we are to drive the Shadow Council from Felwood, then those braziers must be extinguished.$B$BThis vial has been infused with Crying Violet and the magic of the wilds. Fill it at the corrupted moonwell in the center of Jaedenar and return to me.
english.progress: Do you have the waters from the corrupted moonwell?
english.completion: This will do nicely, $n.
english.completed: Return to Andalar Shadevale at Jaedenar in Felwood.

text.title: 以史为鉴
text.objectives: 你的任务是在巴拉丁监狱东边的咒怨地牢中收集4本满是灰尘的狱中日记。
text.description: 现在我们终于在这座该死的岛上有了立足之地，可以开始调查它是如何变成现在这番模样的了。我们的士兵在东边的咒怨地牢入口一带发现了一些日记。$B$B基地里的那些老学究对这些日记颇感兴趣。我要你去尽快给我找四本日记回来。$B$B$n，多加小心，那地方到处都是亡灵。
text.progress: Were you able to recover the journals?  Reports mentioned that they were sighted both in and out of the cells down there.
text.completion: These journals are in excellent condition $n.  We will begin deciphering them immediately.  Only time will tell what secrets they hold.
text.completed: Report back to Commander Stevens at Baradin Hold when you are done.

english.title: Learning From The Past
english.objectives: You have been asked to recover four Dusty Prison Journals from the Cursed Depths, just east of Baradin Hold.
english.description: Now that we finally have a hold on this wretched island, we can start to investigate how it got in this condition.  Some of our troops have discovered journals around the entrance to the Cursed Depths cellblock just east of here.$B$BThese journals are of particular interest to our elder scribes back at base camp.  I need you to recover four of them and bring them back to me as fast as you can.$B$B$n, be careful down there, that place is crawling with undead.
english.progress: Were you able to recover the journals?  Reports mentioned that they were sighted both in and out of the cells down there.
english.completion: These journals are in excellent condition $n.  We will begin deciphering them immediately.  Only time will tell what secrets they hold.
english.completed: Report back to Commander Stevens at Baradin Hold when you are done.

text.title: 加德纳尔大军
text.objectives: 杀死12名加德纳尔邪恶势力的成员。
text.description: 暗影议会一直腐化着这片土地。在西北边的加德纳尔，他们崇拜着燃烧军团的恶魔，试图为他们的主子打开前往艾泽拉斯的通道。$B$B加德纳尔的土地上充斥着加德纳尔猎犬、守护者、精兵和教徒。这些渣滓为隐藏在地底那些更为邪恶的力量卖命。为了森林不再受苦，必须先干掉他们！
text.completion: Good, $n! With their numbers weakened, we can soon begin our assault on their forces deep within Shadow Hold.
text.completed: Meet Andalar Shadevale at Jaedenar in Felwood.

english.title: Forces of Jaedenar
english.objectives: Slay 12 Jaedenar Forces.
english.description: The Shadow Council perpetuates the corruption of this land. At Jaedenar in the northwest, they worship the demons of the Burning Legion, and work to open the path for their masters to return to this world.$B$BThe grounds are patrolled by Jaedenar Hounds, Guardians, Adepts, and Cultists - thugs that act as lookout for the more vile forces beneath. They will be the first to die so that these forests may no longer suffer!
english.completion: Good, $n! With their numbers weakened, we can soon begin our assault on their forces deep within Shadow Hold.
english.completed: Meet Andalar Shadevale at Jaedenar in Felwood.

objectiveDetails.description: 杀死加德纳尔的邪恶势力成员

text.title: 巨大的问题
text.objectives: 你的任务是杀死普罗布里姆，一只在托尔巴拉德的路上游荡的巨型双头魔。
text.description: 我们终于占领了这块天杀的乱石堆，随即发现有一只巨大的双头魔在到处游荡，杀死我们的巡逻兵！$B$B$n，我要你带几个人去干掉那只双头魔。绝不能让那样的怪物随便乱跑，制造灾难。$B$B要提高警惕，前线报告称，他拿着一棵大树当武器，而且他真的会拿这玩意来砸你。
text.completion: You actually killed him?!  I can't believe it!
text.completed: Report back to Sergeant Parker at Baradin Hold when you are done.
text.giverWindow: 祝你好运。

english.title: A Huge Problem
english.objectives: You have been asked to kill Problim, a giant ettin that roams the paths of Tol Barad.
english.description: We finally capture this godforsaken rock and then we find out that there is a huge ettin roaming around, taking out our sentry patrols!$B$B$n, I need you to round up a few friends and take that ettin down.  We can't have a beast like that roaming around, wreaking havoc.$B$BStay alert, reports from the front say that he is carrying a huge tree as a weapon, and he is not afraid to use it.
english.completion: You actually killed him?!  I can't believe it!
english.completed: Report back to Sergeant Parker at Baradin Hold when you are done.
english.giverWindow: Good luck on this one.

text.title: 恶魔之链
text.objectives: 获得恶魔之链。
text.description: 纳克拉尔把他控制这一地区幼龙的秘密告诉了我。我以为恶魔之链只是一个传说，没想到东西一直都在他身上。$B$B现在这蠢货就要失去它了！$B$B他的死活对我来说无关重要，但龙喉不能失去这件神器。跟着他到南边的桑德玛尔去。那座城市一定一团混乱，你应该可以不被人发现地摸进去。把恶魔之链给我带回来，就算要杀掉纳克拉尔也不要紧。$B$B找到那个神器，$n！
text.progress: Do you have it? Yes? The fate of the Dragonmaw depends on the Demon Chain!
text.completion: If the stories are true, $n, it was on this length of chain that Deathwing had once fastened the Demon Soul, forged in his bid to control the other dragonflights. The Demon Stone has long been destroyed but perhaps this hunk of elementium holds some residual power... You've done a great thing today.
text.completed: Bring the Demon Chain to Zaela at Bloodgulch in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: The Demon Chain
english.objectives: Acquire the Demon Chain.
english.description: Narkrall revealed to me the secret of his influence over the drakes in this area. I thought the Demon Chain was a myth, but he's had it all along.$B$BAnd now the fool is about to lose it!$B$BHis life is meaningless to me but the Dragonmaw can't afford to lose that artifact. Follow him north, up to Thundermar. The city will be in chaos, so you may be able to land undetected. Return to me with the Demon Chain, even if you have to remove it from Narkrall's corpse.$B$BFind that artifact, $n!
english.progress: Do you have it? Yes? The fate of the Dragonmaw depends on the Demon Chain!
english.completion: If the stories are true, $n, it was on this length of chain that Deathwing had once fastened the Demon Soul, forged in his bid to control the other dragonflights. The Demon Stone has long been destroyed but perhaps this hunk of elementium holds some residual power... You've done a great thing today.
english.completed: Bring the Demon Chain to Zaela at Bloodgulch in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 前往暮光壁垒
text.objectives: 跟千针石林暮光壁垒的拉克塔·风歌谈一谈。
text.description: $n，在你和那些小双足飞龙一起对付天空之主的时候，拉克塔·风歌曾来拜访我。她想让你去东边的暮光壁垒找她。$B$B那里一定是暮光之锤关押玛加萨·恐怖图腾的地方。
text.completion: I'm glad that you made it. Don't mind my new clothes. It seemed prudent to blend in.

english.title: On to the Bulwark
english.objectives: Speak with Lakota Windsong at the Twilight Bulwark in Thousand Needles.
english.description: $n, while you and the pridelings were taking care of the skymaster, Lakota Windsong came by. She told me to tell you to meet her east at the Twilight Bulwark.$B$BThat must be where they're holding Magatha Grimtotem.
english.completion: I'm glad that you made it. Don't mind my new clothes. It seemed prudent to blend in.

text.title: 收集伪装
text.objectives: 收集10片暮光之锤护甲。
text.description: 我有个计划，可以让你安全地接近他们的首领。但是首先你得找件衣服穿。$B$B我建议到那边用他们的护甲好了。
text.progress: How much of that armor have you collected? You're going to want to be well disguised for the next thing that you're going to have to do.
text.completion: You sure don't fool around, do you, $n? Well, it'll have to do.
text.completed: Return to Lakota Windsong at the Twilight Bulwark in Thousand Needles.

english.title: Something to Wear
english.objectives: Collect 10 pieces of Twilight's Hammer Armor.
english.description: I've got an idea for how you can get close to their leaders without getting killed. But first, you're going to need to find something to wear.$B$BMy suggestion is that you head up there and get their armor from them.
english.progress: How much of that armor have you collected? You're going to want to be well disguised for the next thing that you're going to have to do.
english.completion: You sure don't fool around, do you, $n? Well, it'll have to do.
english.completed: Return to Lakota Windsong at the Twilight Bulwark in Thousand Needles.

text.title: 熄灭保护之焰
text.objectives: 用净化过的月亮井水熄灭暗影堡里的保护火盆。
text.description: 暗影堡各处都分布着火盆。$B$B进入通向暗影堡的地下通道，然后沿着地下通道走。把所有火盆里的火焰都熄灭，议会设下的保护至少能够被打破一阵子。
text.completion: With the Braziers gone, the druids of the Emerald Circle can enter Shadow Hold and clear out the last of the cultists. In time, it may even be used as the barrow den it once was. You have my thanks, $n. Please take this reward.
text.completed: Return to Greta Mosshoof at Wildheart Point in Felwood.

english.title: Dousing the Flames of Protection
english.objectives: Use the Purified Moon Well Water to douse the four Braziers of Protection within Shadow Hold.
english.description: The braziers are spread throughout Shadow Hold.$B$BEnter the tunnel into Shadow Hold, and follow it through the underground passageways. Douse each of the brazier's flames and the protections the Council has set up will fall for at least a short period of time.
english.completion: With the Braziers gone, the druids of the Emerald Circle can enter Shadow Hold and clear out the last of the cultists. In time, it may even be used as the barrow den it once was. You have my thanks, $n. Please take this reward.
english.completed: Return to Greta Mosshoof at Wildheart Point in Felwood.

text.title: 释放囚犯
text.objectives: 从暮光狱卒手中救出5名壁垒囚犯。
text.description: 暮光之锤的囚犯不止玛加萨一人。$B$B在你往南前进的路上，不妨顺手救出一些囚犯来。
text.completion: You give so much of yourself without requiring anything in return. The people of Thousand Needles are grateful, as am I.
text.completed: Return to Lakota Windsong at the Twilight Bulwark in Thousand Needles.

english.title: Break Them Out
english.objectives: Rescue 5 Bulwark Prisoners from the Twilight Jailers.
english.description: Magatha's not the only one that the Twilight's Hammer have taken prisoner.$B$BWhile you're up there to the south, you should break as many of them out as you can.
english.completion: You give so much of yourself without requiring anything in return. The people of Thousand Needles are grateful, as am I.
english.completed: Return to Lakota Windsong at the Twilight Bulwark in Thousand Needles.

text.title: 核心集团
text.objectives: 在暗影堡内杀死12名防御者。
text.description: 哨兵既然都消灭了，暗影议会的高层人员就是下一个目标。$B$B在堕落的兽穴深处，你可以找到强大的加德纳尔术士、执行者、暗法师和军团士兵。$B$B只有打败他们，这片土地才能得到拯救！
text.completion: The cleansing of Shadow Hold will take much time and effort, but without your defeat of the Shadow Council, it would not be possible at all. Thank you, $n.
text.completed: Return to Jessir Moonbow at Wildheart Point in Felwood.

english.title: The Inner Circle
english.objectives: Slay 12 defenders inside Shadow Hold.
english.description: With their outer sentries gone, the greater members of the Shadow Council are next.$B$BDeep within the corrupted barrow dens you'll find powerful Jaedenar Warlocks, Hunters, Enforcers, Darkweavers, and Legionnaires.$B$BThey must be defeated if these lands are to be saved!
english.completion: The cleansing of Shadow Hold will take much time and effort, but without your defeat of the Shadow Council, it would not be possible at all. Thank you, $n.
english.completed: Return to Jessir Moonbow at Wildheart Point in Felwood.

text.title: 恶魔王子
text.objectives: 杀死萨瓦利斯王子。
text.description: 蔓延在费伍德森林的碧火萨特同暗影议会直接联手。$B$B指挥这些萨特的，是古老而强大的萨瓦利斯王子。有人说他是第一个萨特萨维斯的儿子，被萨格拉斯本人祝福过。$B$B不管怎么说，我们要想驱散萨特，收复兽穴，他就必须得死。深入暗影堡，把他杀掉。不要留情，他也不会心慈手软的。
text.completion: The demons begin to fall! Take heed, $c. You will find even stronger foes deeper within Shadow Hold.
text.giverWindow: 碧火萨特的主宰

english.title: The Demon Prince
english.objectives: Slay Prince Xavalis.
english.description: The Jadefire satyr that have overrun so much of Felwood work directly with the Shadow Council.$B$BThese satyr answer directly to the ancient and powerful Prince Xavalis. Some say he is the son of Xavius, the first satyr, blessed by Sargeras himself.$B$BWhatever his nature, he must die if we are to scatter the Jadefire and reclaim our barrow dens. Journey deep into Shadow Hold and slay him. Show him no mercy; he will have none for you.
english.completion: The demons begin to fall! Take heed, $c. You will find even stronger foes deeper within Shadow Hold.
english.giverWindow: Overlord of the Jadefire Satyr
english.turninWindow: The Legion will be driven from the depths!

text.title: 不友善的村落
text.objectives: 指挥官马库斯·约翰森要你前往洛斯贝格村杀死14名村民。洛斯贝格村位于营地以北，就在右边。
text.description: 你去过洛斯贝格村吗，$n？如果你正要往那里走，我建议你带上一把利刃。$B$B村子里的居民看起来挺正常的，却在背地里做坏事。有报告称村民们会趁士兵形单影只时杀死他们。我们简直受够啦，我要你去那里清理一下门户。$B$B尽可能地除掉那些村民，然后回来向我复命。
text.progress: 你有弄清楚那個村莊發生什麼事嗎？似乎有什麼不對…
text.completion: 就跟你說那個村莊裡都是瘋子。把那裡清乾淨真是做得好，$n。
text.completed: Report back to Commander Marcus Johnson at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.

english.title: Not The Friendliest Town
english.objectives: Commander Marcus Johnson has asked you to kill 14 villagers in Rustberg Village.  Rustberg Village is just north of base camp, on the right side.
english.description: Have you been up to Rustberg Village yet $n?  I would suggest you bring a sharpened blade if you are heading that direction.$b$bThe folks in that town look alright but something suspicious is going on in there.  Reports have been coming in that they are picking off our soldiers left and right.  We have had just about enough of that, so I need you to head down there and do a little cleaning house for us.$B$BTake down as many as you can and report back when you are done.
english.completion: Told you that village was full of wackos.  Nice job clearing it out $n.
english.completed: Report back to Commander Marcus Johnson at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.

text.title: 双子女妖
text.objectives: 杀死米莱恩和萨莉亚。
text.description: 米莱恩和萨莉亚是暗影领主费尔丹的私人仆从。别被她们欺骗了！$B$B这些邪恶的魅魔用她们的魅力和肮脏的魔法将凡人骗进暗影堡深处。那些被她们掌握的人不是受到了洗脑，就是被费尔丹献祭给了他的恶魔主子。$B$B这两人形影不离，战斗起来合作无间，可算是个不小的威胁。深入暗影堡，杀掉她们。
text.completion: Another demonic menace gone. It is time to find their master.
text.giverWindow: 你必须抵御住她们罪恶的诱惑。

english.title: Twin Temptresses
english.objectives: Slay Moora and Salia.
english.description: Moora and Salia are the personal servants of Shadow Lord Fel'dan. Do not be deceived by them!$B$BThese foul succubi use their wiles and foul magic to draw mortals deep into Shadow Hold. Those in their grasp undergo brainwashing, or are sacrificed by Fel'dan to his demonic masters.$B$BThe two fight as one and are never found apart, making them a considerable threat. Proceed further into Shadow Hold and slay them.
english.completion: Another demonic menace gone. It is time to find their master.
english.giverWindow: You must resist their sinister temptations.

text.title: 高效挖掘技巧
text.objectives: 把《高效挖掘技巧》交给司克诺兹登陆点的贝洛克·辉刃。
text.description: 这本手册描述了诸多古怪的理论，关于在大群工人从事大规模挖掘作业时，如何进行最为有效的管理。$b$b稍稍把材料阅读了一遍，你就明白过来，这本册子的作者就是此地那些过于积极的掠夺者们的头领。$b$b封底的一张地图表明作者在奥丹姆西南地区有一座碉堡。$b$b也许该跟他见上一见。
text.completion: Oh look, it's one of little Schnottz's pamphlets. I'll just be taking that from you, if you don't mind.
text.giverWindow: 你只能认为封面上画的是固执己见的作者像。

english.title: Efficient Excavations
english.objectives: Bring 'Efficient Excavations' to Belloc Brightblade in Schnottz's Landing.
english.description: This manual describes outlandish theories on how to most efficiently manage large groups of workers as they engage in massive excavation projects.$b$bAfter a quick skim of the material, it becomes clear to you that the author of the book is the figure in charge of the over-aggressive pillagers here.$b$bA map on the back cover indicates that the author has a bunker in the southwest region of Uldum.$b$bPerhaps an introduction is in order.
english.completion: Oh look, it's one of little Schnottz's pamphlets. I'll just be taking that from you, if you don't mind.
english.giverWindow: You can only assume that the picture on the cover is of the self-absorbed author.

text.title: 愤怒释放
text.objectives: 去咽喉洞跟扎伊拉谈一谈。杀掉托斯。
text.description: 在对桑德玛尔失败的进攻中，纳克拉尔的幼龙托斯存活了下来，如今这个生物从他的前任主人手里解放了出来。$B$B托斯想要对龙喉复仇，并且已经蹂躏了溅血谷地。他还会再次前来，直到我们将它消灭。该是恶魔之链上场的时候了。$B$B托斯以前的老巢是西边山里的一个小山洞，我们把那里变成了一个叫做“咽喉洞”的小营地。$B$B去咽喉洞找我，我们一起把托斯干掉。
text.completion: Once free of the chain, Torth died rather than submit again. I admire the creature. I will have his hide fashioned into a set of armor. This much is clear to me now: The Dragonmaw cannot stand alone if the Alliance backs the Wildhammer. Narkrall proved that. And you have proven the might of the Horde, again and again. I will rebuild our drake wings and take up position outside the Bastion of Twilight. You should continue to help out here in the Gullet and elsewhere in the Highlands.
text.completed: Speak with Zaela at the Gullet in Twilight Highlands.
text.giverWindow: 到咽喉洞去见我，我们一起摧毁托斯。

english.title: Fury Unbound
english.objectives: Travel to the Gullet and speak with Zaela. Kill Torth.
english.description: Narkrall's drake Torth survived the failed attack on Thundermar, and now the creature is free from his former master.$B$BTorth seeks vengeance against the Dragonmaw, and has already strafed Bloodgulch once. He will keep returning until we skewer him for good. It is time to put the Demon Chain to work.$B$BTorth's old nest is a small cave in the hills west of here that we have turned into a small camp called "The Gullet."$B$BMeet me at the Gullet and we will finish Torth off.
english.completion: Once free of the chain, Torth died rather than submit again. I admire the creature. I will have his hide fashioned into a set of armor. This much is clear to me now: The Dragonmaw cannot stand alone if the Alliance backs the Wildhammer. Narkrall proved that. And you have proven the might of the Horde, again and again. I will rebuild our drake wings and take up position outside the Bastion of Twilight. You should continue to help out here in the Gullet and elsewhere in the Highlands.
english.completed: Speak with Zaela at the Gullet in Twilight Highlands.
english.giverWindow: Meet me in the Gullet and we will destroy Torth together.

text.title: 眼前的复仇
text.objectives: 跟塔卡赫特平原的总督忒内斯、太阳王封印的太阳祭司阿萨瑞斯，以及玛莱特的阿萨克谈一谈。
text.description: 你已经获得了封赏，我想我可以跟你坦白直说了。$B$B你为我的王国做出了极大的贡献，但你同时也打破了脆弱的和平进程。$B$B我一直想要通过外交手段来赎回我的兄弟，为的就是避免流血。$B$B现在，敌人一定想要报复。$B$B去跟东边塔卡赫特平原的总督忒内斯、北边太阳王封印的太阳祭司阿萨瑞斯，以及西边玛莱特的阿萨克谈一谈。查清楚敌人要进攻哪里。
text.completion: Orsis!  Of course! How could I not have seen this?
text.completed: Return to King Phaoris at Ramkahen in Uldum.

english.title: Impending Retribution
english.objectives: Speak to Nomarch Teneth at the Tahret Grounds, Sun Priest Asaris at the Seal of the Sun King, and Asaq at Mar'at.
english.description: Now that you've been suitably rewarded, I hope I can speak with you frankly.$B$BYou've done my kingdom a great favor, but you've also unbalanced a fragile peace process.$B$BI was pursuing my brother's release strictly through diplomatic means in order to avoid bloodshed.$B$BNow, the enemy is sure to seek retaliation.$B$BSpeak to Nomarch Teneth at the Tahret Grounds to the east, Sun Priest Asaris at the Seal of the Sun King to the north and Asaq at Mar'at to the west.  Find out where the enemy will strike.
english.completion: Orsis!  Of course! How could I not have seen this?
english.completed: Return to King Phaoris at Ramkahen in Uldum.

objectiveDetails.description: 跟太阳祭司阿萨瑞斯谈一谈

text.title: 奥拉基尔的复仇
text.objectives: 跟奥丹姆玛莱特外阿萨德贸易站的纳顿亲王谈一谈。
text.description: 听着，$n。袭击奥西斯的不是一般的沙尘暴。它是奥拉基尔的爪牙。$B$B空气元素领主同死亡之翼形成了牢固的同盟，派人来攻打我的人只不过是时间问题。$B$B奥西斯的进攻只是一个警告。我们必须赶快行动，尽一切可能援助我们的兄弟。$B$B去找玛莱特外阿萨德贸易站的纳顿。我马上着手准备接纳难民和伤员。
text.completion: Do you see what Deathwing's minions have done?  Great Orsis is now all but buried in the sand!

english.title: Al'Akir's Vengeance
english.objectives: Speak to Prince Nadun at the Arsad Trade Post outside Mar'at in Uldum.
english.description: Listen, $n.  What struck Orsis was no natural sandstorm.  It was the minions of Al'Akir.$B$BThe elemental lord of air is firmly allied with Deathwing and it was only a matter of time before he set his subjects upon my people.$B$BOrsis has been attacked as a warning to us.  We must move quickly to offer our brethren what aid we can.$B$BMeet with Nadun at the Arsad Trade Post outside of Mar'at.  I will begin preparations to take care of the displaced and wounded.
english.completion: Do you see what Deathwing's minions have done?  Great Orsis is now all but buried in the sand!

text.title: 当心身后！
text.objectives: 暗杀编码大师迪萨克、指挥官速熔和元素师斯塔隆。
text.description: 暮光壁垒的三位首领非常强大，绝不能低估他们的实力，$n。幸运的是，这件伪装可以将你装扮成暮光教徒的模样。$B$B穿上伪装，分别与编码大师迪萨克、指挥官速熔和元素师斯塔隆交谈。令他们转过身，然后快速发起攻击！
text.completion: Now that those three are dealt with, the combined forces from Freewind Post should be able to handle the rest of the cultists here.
text.completed: Return to Lakota Windsong at the Twilight Bulwark in Thousand Needles.

english.title: Behind You!
english.objectives: Assassinate Codemaster Deethuk, Commander Fastfuse, and Elementalist Starion.
english.description: The three leaders of the Bulwark are powerful and not to be underestimated, $n. Fortunately for us, you now have a disguise to make you look like one of the Twilight cultists.$B$BYou should put the disguise on and speak with Codemaster Deethuk, Commander Fastfuse, and Elementalist Starion each alone. Get them to turn their backs on you, and when they do, strike quickly!
english.completion: Now that those three are dealt with, the combined forces from Freewind Post should be able to handle the rest of the cultists here.
english.completed: Return to Lakota Windsong at the Twilight Bulwark in Thousand Needles.

text.title: 弄点黑鲈鱼来
text.objectives: 从洛斯贝格村取回22条洛斯贝格黑鲈鱼。你可以在村后礁石群的鱼线上找到这种鱼。洛斯贝格村位于营地正北方，就在右边。
text.description: 洛斯贝格村。那座村落被诅咒了，这对我们来说也算是件好事，$n。我都不知道这帮强盗是如何学会钓鱼的，不过我也没时间刨根问底了。$B$B我要你去那里弄点鱼来，能弄多少是多少啦。自从我们夺回岛屿后，吃得简直跟狗屎一样，这次行动简直是储备军粮的绝佳机会。$B$B当心潜伏者，据说村落中到处都是他们的身影。
text.progress: Were you able to pull off the heist and get us some fish?
text.completion: These fish will do nicely, $n.  Keeping the troops fed and in good condition is our number one priority and you really came through for us here.
text.completed: Report back to Commander Marcus Johnson at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.

english.title: Teach A Man To Fish.... Or Steal
english.objectives: You must steal 22 Rustberg Seabass from Rustberg Village.  The fish can be found on string stands at the docks, round back of the village.  Rustberg Village is due north of base camp, on the right side.
english.description: Rustberg Village.  That place is a curse and a blessing for us, $n.  I have no clue where bandits learned to fish as well as they do but I have no time to worry about that now.$B$BI need you to head down there and steal as many of their fish reserves as possible.  We have been living off scraps since we retook the island and this is our best chance at some solid food reserves.$B$BKeep an eye out for stealthers up there, reports have told us they are prevalent inside the village walls.
english.progress: Were you able to pull off the heist and get us some fish?
english.completion: These fish will do nicely, $n.  Keeping the troops fed and in good condition is our number one priority and you really came through for us here.
english.completed: Report back to Commander Marcus Johnson at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.

text.title: 人类的侵扰
text.objectives: 俘虏8名希尔斯布莱德人类。
text.description: 碧玉矿洞原本是联盟在希尔斯布莱德丘陵的矿业中心。现在它已经成为我们的蜘蛛养殖场，但是从某种程度上讲，人类依然占据着这里。$B$B<凯东咧嘴一笑。>$B$B说正事吧！药渣农场的看守者斯蒂沃特需要更多的人类劳工。我要你带上镣铐进入矿洞，抓捕希尔斯布莱德的人类劳工。$B$B将他们从蛛网中放出来，然后打到他们投降，乖乖戴上镣铐为止。
text.completion: These will do nicely. I do wonder what the warden has planned for them. Last I heard the Sludge Fields were overrun by some very bad things.
text.completed: Return to Captain Keyton at the Azurelode Mine in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: Human Infestation
english.objectives: Capture 8 Hillsbrad Humans.
english.description: This mine was once the heart of Alliance mining operations in Hillsbrad. It now serves as a breeding ground for our loyal spiders, though, the humans still occupy it - in a way.$B$B<Keyton grins.>$B$BBut onto business! Warden Stillwater has called for more workers at the Sludge Fields. I want you to enter the mine with these shackles and capture Hillsbrad humans for labor in the fields.$B$BBreak them out of their web paralysis and beat them into submission before you use the shackles.
english.completion: These will do nicely. I do wonder what the warden has planned for them. Last I heard the Sludge Fields were overrun by some very bad things.
english.completed: Return to Captain Keyton at the Azurelode Mine in Hillsbrad Foothills.

objectiveDetails.description: 俘虏希尔斯布莱德人类

text.title: 编码大师的编码
text.objectives: 取回编码大师的编码。
text.description: $n，束缚玛加萨的装置经过了编码处理。只有拿到编码才能救她。$B$B编码大师迪萨克将储存编码的设备放在身边，他就在东南方的暮光壁垒。$B$B去取回编码吧。
text.progress: Do you have the codes to the Elder Crone's bonds?
text.completion: Good. Now there's only one thing left to do.
text.completed: Return to Lakota Windsong at the Twilight Bulwark in Thousand Needles.

english.title: Codemaster's Code
english.objectives: Obtain the Codemaster's Code.
english.description: $n, the bonds holding Magatha are specially encoded. She can only be released if we get those codes.$B$BThere's a device near Codemaster Deethuk in the Bulwark to the southeast. It contains the codes.$B$BPlease obtain them.
english.progress: Do you have the codes to the Elder Crone's bonds?
english.completion: Good. Now there's only one thing left to do.
english.completed: Return to Lakota Windsong at the Twilight Bulwark in Thousand Needles.

text.title: 巫婆长老
text.objectives: 关闭玛加萨联结控制器。
text.description: 编码到手了。你只需前往暮光壁垒的东部区域，释放巫婆长老。$B$B祝你好运，$n。谢谢你所做的一切。

english.title: The Elder Crone
english.objectives: Disable Magatha's Bonds Controller.
english.description: You have the code. Now all you have to do is head to the eastern section of the Bulwark and free the Elder Crone.$B$BGood luck, $n. Thank you for all you've done.

text.title: 太阳之王圣物
text.objectives: 夺回4件太阳之王圣物。
text.description: 太阳王封印是拉穆卡恒的一种防御机制。$B$B当奥丹姆的屏障降下的时候，我们发现塔纳利斯的废土游骑兵侵入了边境。$B$B他们向西进发的时候攻击了这一圣地，劫走了为其提供能量的圣物。$B$B把圣物给我们夺回来。没有它们我们对沙漠的进攻将束手无策。
text.progress: Did you succeed?
text.completion: Thank you.  The rumors I'd heard about you are proving true after all.
text.completed: Return to Sun Priest Asaris in Uldum.

english.title: Relics of the Sun King
english.objectives: Obtain 4 Relics of the Sun King.
english.description: The Seal of the Sun King serves as a defense mechanism for Ramkahen.$B$BWhen the barrier around Uldum fell, we began to see Wastewander outriders from Tanaris filter into our borders.$B$BThey attacked this holy site on their way west and robbed it of the relics which once provided its power.$B$BRecover the relics for us.  Without them we are powerless to defend against attacks from the desert.
english.progress: Did you succeed?
english.completion: Thank you.  The rumors I'd heard about you are proving true after all.
english.completed: Return to Sun Priest Asaris in Uldum.

text.title: 前往暮光凋零法阵
text.objectives: 跟千针石林暮光凋零法阵的玛加萨·恐怖图腾谈一谈。
text.description: 玛加萨要你去东边的暮光凋零法阵找她。
text.completion: It took you long enough. Do you think that we are playing games here?

english.title: To the Withering
english.objectives: Speak with Magatha Grimtotem at the Twilight Withering in Thousand Needles.
english.description: According to Magatha, she'll meet you just outside of the Twilight Withering to the east.
english.completion: It took you long enough. Do you think that we are playing games here?

text.title: 前往暮光凋零法阵
text.objectives: 跟千针石林暮光凋零法阵的玛加萨·恐怖图腾谈一谈。
text.description: 别让巫婆长老等太久，$n。$B$B她让你去东边的暮光凋零法阵找她。

english.title: To the Withering
english.objectives: Speak with Magatha Grimtotem at the Twilight Withering in Thousand Needles.
english.description: You should not keep the Elder Crone waiting, $n.$B$BShe said that she'd be up top and just outside of the Twilight Withering to the east.

text.title: 可恶的小偷！
text.objectives: 取回6箱被遗忘者营地“补给品”。
text.description: 此地正南方是一片宽阔的海滩，海岸线从西边一直延伸到东边，我们将其称为西部海岸。西部海岸上有两种东西：鱼人和被盗的“补给品”。$B$B<凯东弯起手指，做了个引号的手势。>$B$B这些可恶的鱼人趁我们不注意的时候偷走了“补给品”。$B$B我和萨露丝得留在这里。你去西部海岸取回我们的“补给品”吧！
text.progress: Recover our "supplies," $n!
text.completion: At least we'll be prepared for any future incidents. Moving "supplies" like this around is a risky proposition. You never know who is going to open their big fat mouth.$B$B<Keyton raises what appears to be an eyebrow at you.>
text.completed: Return to Captain Keyton at the Azurelode Mine in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: Thieving Little Monsters!
english.objectives: Recover 6 Forsaken Camp "Supplies."
english.description: The long stretch of coastline directly south of our position that extends from west to east is known as the Western Strand. Along the Western Strand you will find two things: murlocs and our stolen "supplies."$B$B<Keyton puts his hands in the air and makes quotation marks with his fingers.>$B$BThose damned thieving murlocs struck while our backs were turned and took our "supplies."$B$BSarus and I cannot leave this post. We need you to head to the Western Strand and recover those "supplies!"
english.progress: Recover our "supplies," $n!
english.completion: At least we'll be prepared for any future incidents. Moving "supplies" like this around is a risky proposition. You never know who is going to open their big fat mouth.$B$B<Keyton raises what appears to be an eyebrow at you.>
english.completed: Return to Captain Keyton at the Azurelode Mine in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 毒血解毒剂
text.objectives: 用8具血毒沙漠蝎尸体里的毒液装满解毒药剂瓶。
text.description: 废土强盗来袭时，俄希特试图保卫这块圣地。$B$B他们用的似乎是血毒沙漠蝎身上的强力毒液。$B$B拿上这个瓶子，从它们的尸体里把毒液收集过来，我好制作一瓶解毒剂。我怕俄希特的时间可能不多了。
text.completion: Thank you, $n.  We might yet save Iset.
text.completed: Return to Sun Priest Asaris at the Seal of the Sun King in Uldum.

english.title: Venomblood Antidote
english.objectives: Fill the Antidote Vial with the the poison of 8 Venomblood Scorpid corpses.
english.description: Iset attempted to defend this holy ground when the Wastewander bandits ransacked it.$B$BThey appear to have used the potent toxin present in the venomblood scorpids.$B$BTake this vial and collect venom from their corpses so that I may concoct an antidote.  I fear Iset might not have much time.
english.completion: Thank you, $n.  We might yet save Iset.
english.completed: Return to Sun Priest Asaris at the Seal of the Sun King in Uldum.

text.title: 海滩上的美餐！
text.objectives: 前往西部海岸，让饥饿的矿洞蜘蛛吃下12只鱼头怪。
text.description: 这些蜘蛛很饿，而且烦躁不安！它们好些日子没吃东西了，竟然开始将人类俘虏视为食物。这样可不妙。药渣农场还需要这些劳工呢。$B$B我要你带上一只饥饿的矿洞蜘蛛前往西部海岸，喂它吃那些鱼头怪。你杀什么它就吃什么！喂得越饱越好！
text.completion: This should keep it happy and content for a few days. You've done a good thing here, $n!
text.completed: Return to Spider-Handler Sarus at the Azurelode Mine in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: Coastal Delicacies!
english.objectives: Feed the Hungry Mine Spider 12 Murlocs from the Western Strand.
english.description: My spiders are hungry and agitated! They haven't eaten for days and are starting to sample our human captives. We can't have that. We need those humans for use in the Sludge Fields.$B$BI want you to take one of my hungry mine spiders out and feed it murlocs from the Western Strand, south of here. Whatever you kill, it'll eat! The more the better!
english.completion: This should keep it happy and content for a few days. You've done a good thing here, $n!
english.completed: Return to Spider-Handler Sarus at the Azurelode Mine in Hillsbrad Foothills.

objectiveDetails.description: 喂饥饿的矿洞蜘蛛吃下鱼头怪

text.title: 你的颜色是紫色
text.objectives: 收集8片暮光衣物布块。
text.description: 据我目前所知，洞穴外面的黏肠食人魔还没有加入暮光之锤。要是我们够聪明的话，就可以让两者自相残杀。$B$B我在希利苏斯学了一招，可以用得上。首先我们需要给你弄一套邪教徒的袍子。$B$B到南边的暮光裂口去杀掉几个暮光扭风者。除了破坏他们的阴谋之外，你还能有机会获得衣物的布块。
text.progress: This is good, $n. With heroes like you stirring up trouble out here, we'll keep the cult distracted from our main invasion.$B$BDo you have a disguise?
text.completion: What did you manage to get? I suppose we can piece something together from this. After all, you're not joining the cult. We just need to fool a few ogres.
text.completed: Take the scraps to Rotgrum at The Gullet in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Purple is Your Color
english.objectives: Gather up 8 Twilight Garment Scraps.
english.description: So far as I can tell, the Glopgut Ogres right outside the cave here have not yet joined up with the Twilight's Hammer. If we're clever, we can turn the two groups against each other.$B$BLet's roll with a little trick I learned in Silithus. First we'll need to put together a set of cultist robes for you.$B$BHead south of here and kill some Twilight Windwarpers in the Twilight Breach. Aside from disrupting whatever they're up to, it'll give you a chance to collect garment scraps.
english.progress: This is good, $n. With heroes like you stirring up trouble out here, we'll keep the cult distracted from our main invasion.$B$BDo you have a disguise?
english.completion: What did you manage to get? I suppose we can piece something together from this. After all, you're not joining the cult. We just need to fool a few ogres.
english.completed: Take the scraps to Rotgrum at The Gullet in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 屠宰腐化者
text.objectives: 从怒爪熊或魔爪狼身上收集10张腐化之皮。
text.description: 令人恶心的恶魔腐蚀弥漫在整座森林里。土壤里，树木中，动物身上……都透露着浓浓的邪能魔法。$B$B我们翡翠议会誓要净化这片森林，并为此做好了长期战斗的准备。有些生命还有救，但附近漫游的熊和狼都已经扭曲得太深了。$B$B我们必须结束它们的苦难，确保它们的尸体不会进一步散播污染。捕杀那些熊和狼，把它们的皮带来给我。
text.progress: I must have the pelts to purge them of the leftover demon essence.
text.completion: I will see these are burned swiftly and safely, $n. You have my thanks.
text.completed: Return to Taronn Redfeather at the Emerald Sanctuary in Felwood.

english.title: Culling the Corrupted
english.objectives: Collect 10 Corrupted Pelts from Angerclaw Bears or Felpaw Wolves.
english.description: The sickening corruption of demons pervades this entire forest. The soil, the trees, the animals... all grow thick with fel magics.$B$BWe of the Emerald Circle have sworn to cleanse this forest, and doing so requires a constant battle. While some life here can still be healed, the bears and wolves that wander nearby have been twisted too far.$B$BWe must end their suffering, and ensure their bodies do not spread the taint further. Hunt the bears and wolves, and return to me with their hides.
english.progress: I must have the pelts to purge them of the leftover demon essence.
english.completion: I will see these are burned swiftly and safely, $n. You have my thanks.
english.completed: Return to Taronn Redfeather at the Emerald Sanctuary in Felwood.

text.title: 风中的低语
text.objectives: 获得一枚风语者咒符以及5份漩流之息。
text.description: 你听到了吗，$c？洞里有声音。他们想要交谈，可他们没有呼吸。$B$B咱们想办法聆听。暮光之锤，他们同风交谈。到南边的暮光裂口去，在营地里拿到风语者咒符。它就在一根石柱的顶端。$B$B我们还需要元素的呼吸！杀掉风暴漩涡，把你所需要的东西拿走。
text.progress: Shhh, $n! Listen. Listen...
text.completion: Dat's de stuff, mon! Now can you hear dem? De spirits, dey be talkin', but dey say nothing nice. Let us bring dem to de light.
text.completed: Return to Buunu at The Gullet in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Whispers in the Wind
english.objectives: Collect a Windspeaker charm and 5 Breath of the Vortex.
english.description: You hear dem, $c? De voices from de cave. Dey want to talk, but dey ain't got no breath.$B$BLet's find a way to listen. De Twilight's Hammer, dey talk to de wind. Go to de Twilight Breach south of here, and grab de Windspeaker Charm from de camp. It'll be atop a stone pillar.$B$BWe'll need us de breath of the elementals, too! Slay de Storm Vortexes and take what joo need.
english.progress: Shhh, $n! Listen. Listen...
english.completion: Dat's de stuff, mon! Now can you hear dem? De spirits, dey be talkin', but dey say nothing nice. Let us bring dem to de light.
english.completed: Return to Buunu at The Gullet in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 奥术盟友
text.objectives: 跟克斯特拉斯废墟的奥术师德拉莉丝谈一谈。
text.description: 任何愿意同费伍德森林恶魔作战的人，翡翠议会都立誓接受他们的帮助。尽管我的人长期以来都对奥术敬而远之，但这样的有利因素我们无法拒绝。$B$B奥术师德拉莉丝是一名幸存下来的上层精灵法师，她帮我们同碧火萨特战斗。沿着路向北，你就能在我们俯瞰克斯特拉斯废墟的营地那里找到她。$B$B假如你愿意帮忙净化费伍德森林，那就像遵从我的要求那样也听从她的指示。
text.completion: There is little time for talk, $c. The druids fight valiantly against the satyr, but fel sorcery blocks their path. Luckily, I have a plan...

english.title: An Arcane Ally
english.objectives: Speak with Arcanist Delaris at the Ruins of Constellas.
english.description: The Emerald Circle is sworn to accept the help of any who wish to fight the demons of Felwood. Though my people have long shunned the arcane, we cannot afford to deny ourselves such advantage here.$B$BArcanist Delaris, a surviving Highborne mage, helps us battle the Jadefire satyr. Follow the road to the north, and you will find her at our encampment overlooking the Ruins of Constellas.$B$BIf you wish to help cleanse Felwood, follow her requests as you have mine.
english.completion: There is little time for talk, $c. The druids fight valiantly against the satyr, but fel sorcery blocks their path. Luckily, I have a plan...

text.title: 伪装杀人
text.objectives: 杀死10只黏肠食人魔。在黏肠峡谷里你的暮光之锤伪装将自动生效。
text.description: 你的伪装准备好了，$n。只要你到北边的黏肠峡谷去，你这一身暮光之锤的打扮就会骗过食人魔。$B$B接下来的计划很简单：你杀掉一些黏肠食人魔，然后嫁祸给邪教。准备好到食人魔营地里去大闹一场了吗？我想是的。
text.completion: Hah! I'm sure Twilight's Hammer wanted to number those ogres among their ranks. Now they'll probably have to fight them off instead. This is good, $n. With one well-placed $c we managed to do the work of a small army. I'll let Warlord Krogg know of your work here!
text.completed: Return to Rotgrum at The Gullet in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Dressed to Kill
english.objectives: Kill 10 Glopgut Ogres. Your Twilight's Hammer disguise will automatically apply while inside Glopgut's Hollow.
english.description: Your disguise is ready, $n. Whenever you go north into Glopgut's Hollow now, your Twilight's Hammer regalia will fool the ogres.$B$BThe rest of the plan is simple: you kill a bunch of Glopgut ogres, and they blame the cult. Are you ready to create some havoc in the ogre camp? I thought so.
english.completion: Hah! I'm sure Twilight's Hammer wanted to number those ogres among their ranks. Now they'll probably have to fight them off instead. This is good, $n. With one well-placed $c we managed to do the work of a small army. I'll let Warlord Krogg know of your work here!
english.completed: Return to Rotgrum at The Gullet in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 加德纳尔在等待
text.objectives: 把巧匠的草药带给野心之心哨站的格雷塔·苔蹄。
text.description: 你看见的那些守卫爪子的邪教徒是暗影议会的成员，他们是邪恶的术士，最近多次尝试要将恶魔带到艾泽拉斯来。$B$B北边便是加德纳尔，那地方因崇拜基尔加丹而命名。在它地下深处蜿蜒着暗影堡，从前曾是一座兽穴，如今是暗影议会在艾泽拉斯的要塞。$B$B带上这些草药，到北边的野性之心哨站去找格雷塔·苔蹄，她要用来永远净化暗影堡。
text.progress: Greetings, $c. What brings you here?
text.completion: Ah, just what I was expecting. With these herbs, our preparations for Jaedenar are nearly ready.

english.title: Jaedenar Awaits
english.objectives: Deliver the Arcanist's Herbs to Greta Mosshoof at Wildheart Point.
english.description: The cultists you saw guarding the claw were members of the Shadow Council, foul warlocks behind nearly every attempt to bring demons into Azeroth.$B$BNorth of here is Jaedenar, named in worship of Kil'Jaeden himself. Deep beneath it stretches Shadow Hold, a former barrow den and the Shadow Council's own stronghold on Azeroth.$B$BTake these herbs north to Wildheart Point, on the east side of the road. Greta Mosshoof will need them for her plan to purify Shadow Hold for good.
english.progress: Greetings, $c. What brings you here?
english.completion: Ah, just what I was expecting. With these herbs, our preparations for Jaedenar are nearly ready.

text.title: 暗影领主费尔丹
text.objectives: 杀死暗影领主费尔丹。
text.description: 暗影领主费尔丹在深处等待着，$n。$B$B你杀掉了他喜爱的宠物，让他盛怒无比。就算没有米莱恩和萨莉亚，他还是不可小觑。$B$B小心他的黑暗之力，他现在与其说是一名兽人，倒不如更像是一个恶魔。
text.completion: The Shadow Council is broken! One task remains...
text.giverWindow: 暗影议会扭曲而堕落的首脑。
text.turninWindow: 我们的任务就要完成了。暗影堡终将被收复。

english.title: Shadow Lord Fel'dan
english.objectives: Slay Shadow Lord Fel'dan.
english.description: Shadow Lord Fel'dan awaits further in the depths, $n.$B$BHis wrath will be unmatched now that you have slain his beloved pets. Even without Moora and Salia at his side, he is a terrible force to be reckoned with.$B$BBeware his dark powers; he is nearly more demon than orc by now.
english.completion: The Shadow Council is broken! One task remains...
english.giverWindow: The twisted and corrupted leader of the Shadow Council.
english.turninWindow: Our task is nearly done. Shadow Hold will be reclaimed.

text.title: 泥鳃的鳍……是吗？
text.objectives: 将泥鳃的鳍交给希尔斯布莱德丘陵碧玉矿洞的凯东上尉。
text.description: 这东西像是泥鳃的鳍，又不太像。说不定碧玉矿洞的某人会对你杀掉的这只鱼人感兴趣呢。也许压根没有人在乎这件事，但是值得一试呀。$B$B返回希尔斯布莱德丘陵西南方的碧玉矿洞将泥鳃的鳍，总之将这玩意儿交给凯东上尉吧。
text.progress: Do I look like some kind of murloc scientist?
text.completion: Muckgill you say? Never heard of him. What is this anyway? Some kind of fin or something?

english.title: Muckgill's Flipper or Something...
english.objectives: Deliver Muckgill's Flipper back to Captain Keyton at the Azurelode Mine in Hillsbrad Foothills.
english.description: This looks like Muckgill's flipper or something. Maybe there's somebody that cares that you killed this murloc back at the Azurelode Mine camp. Probably not, but it's worth a shot.$B$BTake Muckgill's fin or whatever it might be back to Captain Keyton at the Azurelode Mine in southwestern Hillsbrad.
english.progress: Do I look like some kind of murloc scientist?
english.completion: Muckgill you say? Never heard of him. What is this anyway? Some kind of fin or something?

text.title: 魔王贝恩霍勒
text.objectives: 杀死魔王贝恩霍勒。
text.description: 现在潜伏在暗影堡深处的，只剩最后一股力量了：魔王贝恩霍勒。$B$B暗影议会效命于他，即便是费尔丹也不过是他的一个工具，用来在这片土地上做好准备，让燃烧军团再进行一次的入侵。$B$B小心前进，$n。恐惧魔王可是恐怖的敌人。不要畏惧，赢得胜利！
text.completion: Truly incredible, $n. To journey within the very lair of evil here and slay every fiend that stands before you... I am overwhelmed. The Emerald Circle thanks you for your work here in Felwood. As for Andalar, we will send scouts to rescue him at once. He shall have a hero's welcome.
text.completed: Return to Farlus Wildheart at Wildheart Point in Felwood.
text.giverWindow: 他在暗影堡的最深处等待着。

english.title: Lord Banehollow
english.objectives: Slay Lord Banehollow.
english.description: Only one final power remains lurking in the depths of Shadow Hold now: Lord Banehollow.$B$BThe Shadow Council here serves his whims, and even Fel'dan was a mere instrument for him to prepare this land for another invasion of the Burning Legion.$B$BProceed carefully, $n. A dreadlord is a terrifying foe. Stand tall and triumph!
english.completion: Truly incredible, $n. To journey within the very lair of evil here and slay every fiend that stands before you... I am overwhelmed. The Emerald Circle thanks you for your work here in Felwood. As for Andalar, we will send scouts to rescue him at once. He shall have a hero's welcome.
english.completed: Return to Farlus Wildheart at Wildheart Point in Felwood.
english.giverWindow: He awaits in the deepest corner of Shadow Hold.

text.title: 逃出深矿
text.objectives: 护送杜马斯抵达安全地点。
text.description: <厚厚的蛛网中传来杜马斯的声音。>$B$B嗨！这里到处都是蜘蛛！上尉派我来这里处理危机并抓捕人类劳工！这鬼地方到底是哪儿啊？很热！我……$B$B<杜马斯喋喋不休地诉说着他的遭遇。>$B$B你或许应该带他逃出这里，返回安全的地方。你也可以不管他，但是他被困在矿洞里都是你的错。
text.completion: Have you ever heard the saying "survival of the fittest?" What you're doing conflicts with natural law, $g buddy:lady;! This idiot should have died in the mines. There's no telling what kind of harm he'll cause to himself or another person now that you've saved him from his inevitable demise.$B$BAnd you know who's fault that'll be, right?
text.end: 护送杜马斯抵达安全地点！
text.completed: 跟希尔斯布莱德丘陵碧玉矿洞的凯东上尉谈一谈。

english.title: Deep Mine Rescue
english.objectives: Escort Dumass to Safety!
english.description: <You can hear Dumass speaking through the webbing.>$B$BHI! SPIDERS EVERYWHERE! THE CAPTAIN SENT ME TO SAVE THE WORLD AND CAPTURE HUMANS! WHAT IS THIS PLACE ANYWAY? IT'S SO HOT! I...$B$B<Dumass goes on and on about his situation.>$B$BPerhaps you should cut him free and get him back to safety. Or you can just leave him here, though it's your fault that he's stuck in this mine.
english.completion: Have you ever heard the saying "survival of the fittest?" What you're doing conflicts with natural law, $g buddy:lady;! This idiot should have died in the mines. There's no telling what kind of harm he'll cause to himself or another person now that you've saved him from his inevitable demise.$B$BAnd you know who's fault that'll be, right?
english.completed: Speak to Captain Keyton at the Azurelode Mine in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 四种暮光元素
text.objectives: 收集4种暮光元素：空气、土、火以及水元素。
text.description: 暮光之锤召唤出来一只畸形生物。它叫做源质畸体，是四种元素生物的合体，拥有各自强大的能量。$B$B想要让千针石林避免被毁灭的命运，你必须摧毁它。但是首先，你需要突破它的防护罩。$B$B去东边的暮光凋零法阵，收集四种暮光元素吧。
text.progress: Do you have all of the elements, $c?
text.completion: I'll combine them into a suitable form. I'll keep it's use simple.
text.completed: Return to Magatha Grimtotem at the Twilight Withering in Thousand Needles.

english.title: Four Twilight Elements
english.objectives: Collect the four Twilight Elements: Air, Earth, Fire, and Water.
english.description: The Twilight's Hammer have summoned a monstrosity. It's a combination of the four elements infused with the power of their special ore, Elementium.$B$BIf you want to save your precious Thousand Needles from total destruction, you're going to have to destroy it. But first, you'll need a few things to get through its protective shielding.$B$BGo east into the Withering and bring back the four Twilight elements.
english.progress: Do you have all of the elements, $c?
english.completion: I'll combine them into a suitable form. I'll keep it's use simple.
english.completed: Return to Magatha Grimtotem at the Twilight Withering in Thousand Needles.

text.title: 脱离束缚
text.objectives: 释放束缚怒火和束缚气旋。
text.description: 暮光之锤禁锢了两只强大的元素生物。他们将束缚怒火和束缚气旋的能量注入到心像体内。$B$B一旦心像吸尽能量，他就会爆炸。千针石林以及周遭的区域都会化为灰烬。
text.completion: A simple task for a simple boy. Let us see if you have what it takes to finish the job.
text.completed: Return to Magatha Grimtotem at the Twilight Withering in Thousand Needles.

english.title: Unbound
english.objectives: Unbind the Bound Fury and the Bound Vortex.
english.description: There are two very powerful elementals that the Twilight's Hammer have bound. They are using the bound Fury and Vortex to infuse Animus with a great deal of power.$B$BWhen Animus has absorbed enough of their power, he will explode. The rest of Thousand Needles and much of the surrounding lands, will be obliterated.
english.completion: A simple task for a simple boy. Let us see if you have what it takes to finish the job.
english.completed: Return to Magatha Grimtotem at the Twilight Withering in Thousand Needles.

text.title: 末日石
text.objectives: 收集末日石。
text.description: 心像体内有一件被称为末日石的古器。它的功能之一就是吸收大量能量。$B$B暮光教徒企图令末日石过载并通过元素增强能量……以此引发大爆炸。$B$B把末日石带回来。当然，我只是想妥善保管它。
text.progress: Do you have the Doomstone, $c?
text.completion: Surprising... you lived. I thank you for doing my dirty work, $c. You kept my hands clean while ridding me of some incompetent Grimtotem leaders. Not only do I have the Rattle of Bones, the Writ of History, and the Drums of War, but I now have the ultimate artifact: the Doomstone!
text.completed: Return to Magatha Grimtotem at the Twilight Withering in Thousand Needles.
text.giverWindow: 从畸怒邪灵那里夺得末日石！

english.title: The Doomstone
english.objectives: Collect the Doomstone.
english.description: At the core of Animus is an artifact known as the Doomstone. One of its properties is an ability to absorb a great deal of energy.$B$BThis is how the cultists are trying to set off the explosion... by overloading the stone and amplifying the power through the elemental.$B$BBring me the Doomstone. For safe keeping, of course.
english.progress: Do you have the Doomstone, $c?
english.completion: Surprising... you lived. I thank you for doing my dirty work, $c. You kept my hands clean while ridding me of some incompetent Grimtotem leaders. Not only do I have the Rattle of Bones, the Writ of History, and the Drums of War, but I now have the ultimate artifact: the Doomstone!
english.completed: Return to Magatha Grimtotem at the Twilight Withering in Thousand Needles.
english.giverWindow: He has the Doomstone within him!

text.title: 传递消息
text.objectives: 跟千针石林菲兹尔和普兹克的赛艇平台的菲兹尔·铜栓谈一谈。
text.description: 考虑到你如此忠心地为我服务，我在此赦免你的罪孽。带上它，从我的眼前消失吧。告诉你的人民，过去的事情既往不咎。$B$B$n，别让我再看见你，否则我会杀了你。
text.completion: Wow, she's evil! But, what does it mean, $n? Is Magatha going to destroy us? Is she in charge of the Twilight's Hammer now? Whatever happens, you've delivered us from our enemies. Please allow me to show you our gratitude.

english.title: Spread the Word
english.objectives: Speak with Fizzle Brassbolts on Fizzle & Pozzik's Speedbarge in Thousand Needles.
english.description: For rendering me faithful service, I grant you your life. Take it and be gone from my sight. Let your people know of all that has transpired.$B$BAnd $n, if we ever cross paths again, you will die.
english.completion: Wow, she's evil! But, what does it mean, $n? Is Magatha going to destroy us? Is she in charge of the Twilight's Hammer now? Whatever happens, you've delivered us from our enemies. Please allow me to show you our gratitude.

text.title: 传递消息
text.objectives: 跟千针石林菲兹尔和普兹克的赛艇平台的普兹克谈一谈。
text.description: 考虑到你如此忠心地为我服务，我在此赦免你的罪孽。带上它，从我的眼前消失吧。告诉你的人民，过去的事情既往不咎。$B$B$n，别让我再看见你，否则我会杀了你。
text.completion: Wow, she's evil! But, what does it mean, $n? Is Magatha going to destroy us? Is she in charge of the Twilight's Hammer now? Whatever happens, you've delivered us from our enemies. Please allow me to show you our gratitude.

english.title: Spread the Word
english.objectives: Speak with Pozzik on Fizzle & Pozzik's Speedbarge in Thousand Needles.
english.description: For rendering me faithful service, I grant you your life. Take it and be gone from my sight. Let your people know of all that has transpired.$B$BAnd $n, if ever we cross paths again, you will die.
english.completion: Wow, she's evil! But, what does it mean, $n? Is Magatha going to destroy us? Is she in charge of the Twilight's Hammer now? Whatever happens, you've delivered us from our enemies. Please allow me to show you our gratitude.

text.title: 沼泽之饵
text.objectives: 你的任务是从托尔巴拉德的巴拉丁鳄鱼身上收集8张鳄鱼皮。你可以在巴拉丁监狱西边的沼泽中找到鳄鱼。
text.description: 在这样的地方，补给是很不容易找到的，$c。自从占领了这座岛，我们就开始了侦察，但前景不太妙。$B$B幸运的是，我们刚刚收到了一份侦察报告，说是在这座基地西边有一处沼泽，里面有许多鳄鱼。那些鳄鱼的皮对我们的制皮匠来说是很有用的材料。去给我尽量弄一些回来。
text.progress: You cleared out that swamp yet?
text.completion: Looks like you were able to get the croc hides that we needed.  Thanks $n, your contributions will not go unnoticed.
text.completed: Report back to Sergeant Parker at Baradin Hold when you are done.

english.title: Swamp Bait
english.objectives: You have been tasked with collecting 8 Crocolisk Hides from the Baradin Crocolisks on Tol Barad.  The crocolisks can be found in the swamp, just west of Baradin Hold.
english.description: Supplies are never easy to find in a place like this, $c.  We have been scouting since we captured the island but things are not looking good.$B$BFortunately, we just  received a scouting report that a swamp full of crocs is just west of our base camp here.  The hides off those crocs will come in handy for our leatherworkers.  Bring back as many as you can.
english.progress: You cleared out that swamp yet?
english.completion: Looks like you were able to get the croc hides that we needed.  Thanks $n, your contributions will not go unnoticed.
english.completed: Report back to Sergeant Parker at Baradin Hold when you are done.

text.title: 负隅顽抗
text.objectives: 你的任务是在托尔巴拉德杀死12名部落步兵。你可以在托尔巴拉德的熔渣车间、典狱官岗哨和铁甲兵营找到他们。
text.description: 我们费了好大力气才占领了这座岛，$r。我们解决了大部分部落渣滓，但我还是能闻到他们的恶臭。$b$b我要去你去调查一下熔渣车间、典狱官岗哨和铁甲兵营。见到部落就格杀勿论。$B$B你知道俗话是怎么说的，死了的部落才是好部落！
text.completion: Those filthy horde never stood a chance.  Nice work, $n.
text.completed: Report back to Sergeant Parker at Baradin Hold when you are done.

english.title: The Leftovers
english.objectives: You have been instructed to kill 12 Horde Infantry on Tol Barad.  You can find the holdouts in The Slagworks, Warden's Vigil and the Ironclad Garrison, here on Tol Barad.
english.description: We fought hard to capture this island, $r.  We cleared out most of the horde scum but I can still smell their foul stench in the air.$b$bI need you to investigate the slagworks, warden's vigil and the ironclad garrison.  Kill any horde that you find.$B$BYou know what they say, the only good horde is a dead horde!
english.completion: Those filthy horde never stood a chance.  Nice work, $n.
english.completed: Report back to Sergeant Parker at Baradin Hold when you are done.

text.title: Seek Brother Silverhallow
text.objectives: Speak with Brother Silverhallow in the Goblin Slums of Orgrimmar.
text.description: I just received word that you are needed in Orgrimmar, $n. Brother Silverhallow has asked for you to return to the city as quickly as you are able. His message didn't include any other information, and the matter seemed urgent.$B$BLook for Brother Silverhallow in the Goblin Slums of Orgrimmar.
text.completion: I'm glad to see you received my message.

english.title: Seek Brother Silverhallow
english.objectives: Speak with Brother Silverhallow in the Goblin Slums of Orgrimmar.
english.description: I just received word that you are needed in Orgrimmar, $n. Brother Silverhallow has asked for you to return to the city as quickly as you are able. His message didn't include any other information, and the matter seemed urgent.$B$BLook for Brother Silverhallow in the Goblin Slums of Orgrimmar.
english.completion: I'm glad to see you received my message.

text.title: 恶魔监狱
text.objectives: 你的任务是在巴拉丁监狱西北边的恶魔监狱中杀死任意10个恶魔。
text.description: 你听说过恶魔监狱吗，$n？这是岛上的一座旧牢房。问题是，那里到处都是恶魔。我们打算用它来关押岛上的部落残党，但是以目前的情况来看，这个计划没法实施。$B$B我要你去干掉那些恶魔。搞定之后回来向我报告。
text.completion: D-Block is all clear?  Good work, $n.  We will send down a crew to start cleaning up right away.
text.completed: Report back to 2nd Lieutenant Wansworth at Baradin Hold when you are done.

english.title: D-Block
english.objectives: You have been instructed to kill 10 demons of any type in the D-Block, just northwest of Baradin Hold.
english.description: Have you heard of the D-Block yet $n?  It's one of the old cellblocks here on the island.  Problem is, it's infested with demons.  We planned on using it to lock up the leftover Horde we found on the island, but that is not going to happen in its current state.$B$BI need you to head down there and clear those demons out.  Report back to me when you are done.
english.completion: D-Block is all clear?  Good work, $n.  We will send down a crew to start cleaning up right away.
english.completed: Report back to 2nd Lieutenant Wansworth at Baradin Hold when you are done.

text.title: 索格的夜光
text.objectives: 在黏肠峡谷获得灵魂之光。
text.description: 为了能看见神灵，我们需要一种特别的光。一种能够点燃内心的光。灵魂之光。$B$B在海加尔吃了我们的亏之后，暮光之锤就用它们来找出叛徒。他们把其中一份作为礼物送给了黏肠食人魔。$B$B在北边的黏肠峡谷，你可以找到大块头索格。灵魂之光在他手里。至少在你把它拿过来之前是这样的。
text.progress: De light of souls. Does you have it, mon?
text.completion: Ah, dis be it, mon. We be ready to bring dem spirits out de shadows now.
text.completed: Bring the Light of Souls to Buunu at The Gullet in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Thog's Nightlight
english.objectives: Get the Light of Souls from Glopgut's Hollow.
english.description: To see de spirits, we need a special light. A light that lights up one's insides. De light of souls.$B$BTwilight's Hammer uses dem to root out traitors after what we did to dem in Hyjal. Dey just gave one to de Glopgut ogres as a gift.$B$BInside de Glopgut Hollow to de north, you'll find de great big brute Thog. He's got him a Light of Souls. At least, he will until you take it from him.
english.progress: De light of souls. Does you have it, mon?
english.completion: Ah, dis be it, mon. We be ready to bring dem spirits out de shadows now.
english.completed: Bring the Light of Souls to Buunu at The Gullet in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 向卡沃·爆弹报告
text.objectives: 去找诺莫瑞根的卡沃·爆弹。
text.description: 我正打算准备让我的人离开这里。我们已经守不住了。我要你到前面大房间中央的一个前沿阵地去。$B$B卡沃·爆弹就在那里。他会给你作进一步的指示。祝你好运，$n，我们地面上见。
text.completion: Did Nevin send you ahead? That means he's getting ready to end the mission, but there are still survivors to be rescued. We have to help them!
text.completed: 去找诺莫瑞根的卡沃·爆弹。

english.title: Report to Carvo Blastbolt
english.objectives: Report to Carvo Blastbolt in Gnomeregan.
english.description: I'm going to start preparing my men to leave this place. We can't hold out here any longer. I want you to move to a forward position in the middle of the large room ahead.$B$BYou should find Carvo Blastbolt there. He'll give you further instructions. Good luck, $n, and I'll see you on the surface.
english.completion: Did Nevin send you ahead? That means he's getting ready to end the mission, but there are still survivors to be rescued. We have to help them!
english.completed: Report to Carvo Blastbolt in Gnomeregan.

text.title: 药渣农场的麻烦
text.objectives: 向希尔斯布莱德丘陵药渣农场的看守者斯蒂沃特报到。
text.description: 北面药渣农场的看守者斯蒂沃特发来求救信号。书信上写得不清不楚的，但是药渣农场看来发生了暴动，许多守卫都被杀害了。斯蒂沃特指出，如果想去救急，记得走农场西边的后门。$B$B他还要求谨慎行事，不希望这场小小的*咳嗽*暴动闹得人尽皆知。
text.completion: Who are you? Did Sylvanas send you? Everything is FINE! Yes, perfectly fine! I've got it all under control!$B$BWell, fine all things considered that is... We've got a few problems that perhaps you could help with, $c.

english.title: Trouble at the Sludge Fields
english.objectives: Report to Warden Stillwater at the Sludge Fields in Hillsbrad Foothills.
english.description: Warden Stillwater, over at the Sludge Fields, north of here, has sent out a distress signal. The missive wasn't clear, but from what I could make of the letter there's a riot happening at the Sludge Fields and most of the guards have been killed. The warden has warned that any would-be-heroes approach from the back entry, located on the western side of the Sludge Fields.$B$BHe's also asked for discretion. He doesn't want news of this little *ahem* uprising to surface.
english.completion: Who are you? Did Sylvanas send you? Everything is FINE! Yes, perfectly fine! I've got it all under control!$B$BWell, fine all things considered that is... We've got a few problems that perhaps you could help with, $c.

text.title: 撤到装载室！
text.objectives: 跟着S.A.F.E操作员去找装载室的格菲尔·卷簧。
text.description: 能把其他幸存者集合起来，干得很出色！他们——还有你——就是S.A.F.E.小队不断下来的原因。除非我们找到并营救每一个可能的幸存者，不然内温是不会休息的。$B$B我已经把我的人派往装载室去进行净化处理。请跟着他们，抵达之后去找格菲尔·卷簧。她会帮你做好净化处理的准备，让你到地面上去。
text.completion: It's good to meet you, $c. We rarely come across survivors as strong and capable as you are. I can help get you decontaminated and on your way out of here.
text.completed: 跟着S.A.F.E操作员去找装载室的格菲尔·卷簧。

english.title: Withdraw to the Loading Room!
english.objectives: Follow the S.A.F.E. Operatives to Gaffer Coilspring in the Loading Room.
english.description: Excellent job gathering the other survivors! They - and you - are the reason S.A.F.E. teams keep coming down here. Nevin won't rest until we've found and rescued every possible survivor.$B$BI'm sending my men to the Loading Room to prepare for decontamination. Please follow them and meet up with Gaffer Coilspring when you arrive. She'll set you up for decontamination and have you on your way to the surface.
english.completion: It's good to meet you, $c. We rarely come across survivors as strong and capable as you are. I can help get you decontaminated and on your way out of here.
english.completed: Follow the S.A.F.E. Operatives to Gaffer Coilspring in the Loading Room.

text.title: 夜色中的恐怖
text.objectives: 跟咽喉洞的尤彻克谈一谈。在灵魂国度里，访问山洞三处祭坛时用灵魂之光来保证自己的安全。
text.description: 我的朋友尤彻克已经在山洞里了。我们在里面设立了三个祭坛。你所要做的就是把每个祭坛里的魂能给逼出来。$B$B去山洞里跟尤彻克交谈。他会让你灵魂出窍，把你置于灵魂国度。一路小心！要是你看见一个幽灵般的生物，不要慌张。用灵魂之光照耀它一会儿，就能将其永远消灭。光芒能够保证你的安全。现在去净化那三座祭坛吧！
text.completion: You see! De dead be nothing to be scared of. You brought de light to de darkness, mon, and never flinched. We can use dis cave now as a base of operations in de northern Highlands. You're de best, $n!
text.completed: Speak with Buunu at The Gullet in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Night Terrors
english.objectives: Talk to Uchek in The Gullet. From the spirit realm, use your Light of Souls to keep yourself safe while you visit the three shrines inside the cave.
english.description: Me friend Uchek is in de cave already. We set up three shrines inside. All you gotta do is flush out de bad juju from each one, mon.$B$BGo inside de cave here and talk to Uchek. He put you in a trance, put you in de spirit realm. Tread carefully! If you see a ghostly beast, you don't be panicking. Shine de Light of Souls on de beast for a moment or two, and de light will send 'em away for good. De light will keep you safe. Now go cleanse de three shrines!
english.completion: You see! De dead be nothing to be scared of. You brought de light to de darkness, mon, and never flinched. We can use dis cave now as a base of operations in de northern Highlands. You're de best, $n!
english.completed: Speak with Buunu at The Gullet in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 血染天边一片红
text.objectives: 加入对黑龙军团的进攻。
text.description: 眼下，死亡之翼暂时被其他事务缠住了，我们有了一个非常险恶的任务，由女王亲自带队。这个任务就是消灭黑龙军团。$B$B如果你能提供帮助，我将十分欢迎。跟我谈谈，我就会把你送上下一班飞行行动，加入战斗。
text.completion: It seems you are still with us. I'm somewhat appreciative of that. Thank you.
text.completed: Speak to Lirastrasza just northwest of the Obsidian Forest in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: And the Sky Streaked Red
english.objectives: Join the assault on the black dragonflight.
english.description: With Deathwing otherwise occupied, we have a grim and daunting task ahead of us, under charge of the queen herself. The black dragonflight is to be wiped out.$B$BI would welcome your aid in this, if it is offered. As soon as you are ready, I will send you with the next flight joining the attack.
english.completion: It seems you are still with us. I'm somewhat appreciative of that. Thank you.
english.completed: Speak to Lirastrasza just northwest of the Obsidian Forest in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 无辜
text.objectives: 取得一只获救的红色雏龙、一只获救的绿色雏龙、一只获救的蓝色雏龙和一只获救的青铜雏龙。
text.description: 燃烧平原上的黑石兽人在为一个黑暗的主人卖命——他用活物来进行扭曲的实验，以创造属于自己的怪兽军队。他的实验品中，有许多像他本人一样堕落的家伙，但其他人则是完全无辜的。$b$b在南边的雏龙丘陵，他们将雏龙捆在地上，准备拿它们进行这种邪恶的实验。我不能容忍这种事。破坏它们的锁链，把雏龙带回来给我……让它们获得安全。
text.progress: I hope we weren't too late.
text.completion: I will see to it that these dragons are taken care of.
text.completed: Return to Mouton Flamestar at Flamestar Post in Burning Steppes.

english.title: Done Nothing Wrong
english.objectives: Obtain a Freed Red Whelpling, a Freed Green Whelpling, a Freed Blue Whelpling, and a Freed Bronze Whelpling.
english.description: The Blackrock orcs of the steppes serve a dark master -  one who performs twisted experiments on living creatures to create his own menagerie of abominations.  Many of his test subjects are as corrupted as their master, but others are completely innocent.$b$bIn the whelping downs to the south, they chain baby dragons to the ground, preparing them for such experiments.  I will not stand for this.  Break their fetters and return the hatchlings to me... to safety.
english.progress: I hope we weren't too late.
english.completion: I will see to it that these dragons are taken care of.
english.completed: Return to Mouton Flamestar at Flamestar Post in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 一抹黑
text.objectives: 用猎龙者之钩抓住8条黑曜石火翼龙，将它们杀掉。
text.description: 暮光幼龙猎人会使用恶毒的工具把我们盘旋在天上的幼龙钩下来。钩子会卡在它们的鳞片下，让暮光牢牢地攫住，直到他们将我们的同胞拉到地面上来。$B$B我们已经从和平中走了出来。放弃了他们痛改前非的希望。对黑龙军团，我们唯一的慈悲就是将他们狂热追求的毁灭赐予他们。$B$B用这些钩子消灭南边的黑曜石火翼龙。使用得当的话，你在空中也可以腾挪得开。
text.completion: You seem to have made use of the disturbing implements with ease. I take solace in knowing that some tools of evil can ultimately still lead to safeguarding life. Nothing is without purpose.
text.completed: Return to Lirastrasza just northwest of the Obsidian Forest in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Blackout
english.objectives: Slay 8 Obsidian Pyrewings after using the Wyrmhunter Hooks to reach them.
english.description: The Twilight Drakehunters used vicious implements to drag our circling drakes from the sky. Hooks that buried into their scales and held the Twilight secure while they brought our kin to the ground.$B$BWe are past the point of peace. Past hope for their redemption. The only mercy we have left to offer the black flight is the oblivion that they so passionately pursue.$B$BUse these hooks to slay the Obsidian Pyrewings to the south. They should allow you much maneuverability in the air if used right.
english.completion: You seem to have made use of the disturbing implements with ease. I take solace in knowing that some tools of evil can ultimately still lead to safeguarding life. Nothing is without purpose.
