english.completed: Return to Lirastrasza just northwest of the Obsidian Forest in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 燃烧的复仇
text.objectives: 杀死5名黑石驭龙者和5只火鳞小龙。
text.description: 黑石兽人永不停歇。他们集结在东边的战场平原上，随时准备发动进攻。$b$b他们曾经攻击过我的家乡。我来到这里就是为了确保这种事情不再发生。$b$b如果你对人类还有一丁点爱心，就应该做同样的事。去证明你自己吧。前往南方的雏龙丘陵，杀死他们的雏龙和刚刚孵化的黑龙。向我证明你已经做好了投入战争的准备。
text.completion: So you're in, then? Good.
text.completed: Return to John J. Keeshan at Flamestar Post in Burning Steppes.

english.title: Burning Vengeance
english.objectives: Slay 5 Blackrock Whelpers and 5 Flamescale Broodlings.
english.description: The Blackrock orcs are ceaseless.  They swarm atop the battle-plains to the east, poised to strike at any moment.$b$bThey already attacked my homeland once.  I'm here to make sure it doesn't happen again.$b$bIf you hold any love for mankind, you'll do the same.  So prove yourself.  Travel south, to the Whelping Downs, and slay their whelpers and the hatchling black dragons.  Prove to me that you're ready for this war.
english.completion: So you're in, then? Good.
english.completed: Return to John J. Keeshan at Flamestar Post in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 照耀黑暗
text.objectives: 在黑曜石之树中空的下方使用阿莱克丝塔萨之泪。
text.description: 南边那棵巨大的石化树一度是伟大的生命象征。我们的象征。因为黑龙军团，我们丧失了这片森林，它从此就被污染和石化了，几乎无法复原。$B$B但并非没有希望。我带来了一件强大的工具，可以实施治疗。大树或许还有救，只要有足够的时间和运气，或许还有你的一点小小努力。$B$B带上阿莱克丝塔萨之泪，在大树中空的内部使用它。
text.completion: You've started a wonderful thing this day, amidst all of this blood shed. It may take many years, but this ravaged land will be restored. It will be beautiful again.
text.completed: Return to Velastrasza just northwest of the Obsidian Forest in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Shining Through the Dark
english.objectives: Use Alexstrasza's Tear within the hollow beneath the Obsidian Tree.
english.description: The great petrified tree that lies before us to the south was once a beacon of great life. Our beacon. We lost this forest to the black flight, and it has since been corrupted and petrified. Nearly unredeemable.$B$BBut all is not without hope. I've brought a powerful tool to begin the healing process. The tree may still be saved, with much time and fortune, and with perhaps a little effort from you.$B$BBring this, Alexstrasza's Tear, and use it within the hollowed heart of the tree.
english.completion: You've started a wonderful thing this day, amidst all of this blood shed. It may take many years, but this ravaged land will be restored. It will be beautiful again.
english.completed: Return to Velastrasza just northwest of the Obsidian Forest in the Twilight Highlands.

objectiveDetails.description: 种植阿莱克丝塔萨之泪

text.title: 跟着小家伙回家
text.objectives: 在黑曜石龙卵上使用母神之焰，释放雏龙。跟着这些孵出来的小家伙找到它们母亲的巢穴。
text.description: 在黑曜石森林的西南边，你可以找到一些黑龙蛋。许多蛋只要用合适的火焰稍稍刺激一下就能孵化，雏龙孵出来的时候，会哭叫着寻找母亲。$B$B别担心，我是不会把净化雏龙这个任务强加给你的。我只想让你跟着它们回家，去找它们的妈妈。她才是我们需要面对的敌人。
text.completion: Lirastraza sent me ahead to the lair, suspecting the black dragon we are seeking may still be here. Judging by the hatchlings, it seems she was not mistaken.
text.completed: Speak to Baleflame within the Obsidian Lair in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Following the Young Home
english.objectives: Use the Mother's Flame on Obsidian Eggs to release whelps. Follow those hatchlings to the lair of their mother.
english.description: In the southwestern portion of the Obsidian Forest, you will find some of the black egg clutches. Many of the eggs can be hatched at any time with a bit of prodding from the right flame, and as the whelplings hatch, they will cry out and flock for their mother.$B$BDo not worry, if this purging is to be taken to the whelps, that is not a task that I will force on you. I simply want you to let them out and follow them home as they seek their mother. It is she who we must confront.
english.completion: Lirastraza sent me ahead to the lair, suspecting the black dragon we are seeking may still be here. Judging by the hatchlings, it seems she was not mistaken.
english.completed: Speak to Baleflame within the Obsidian Lair in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 囤积军备
text.objectives: 收集5根尖利的毒蝎钩刺。
text.description: 如果我们要向黑石氏族开战，就要先制定计划。我的上校已经把计划准备好了——现在只需要执行。$b$b我需要蝎子的毒刺……你能找到的最锋利的那种。燃烧平原上到处都是蝎子，不过西边的峡谷中最多。$b$b不用操心它们是用来干什么的，你很快就会知道了。
text.progress: 这麽快就回来了?
text.completion: Those scorpids are easy to underestimate.  You're lucky you didn't end up on the end of one of these barbs.  Or maybe you're just good. I'll add these to the stockpile.  We're not done yet, $r.
text.completed: Return to John J. Keeshan at Flamestar Post in Burning Steppes.

english.title: Stocking Up
english.objectives: Obtain 5 Razor-Sharp Scorpid Barbs.
english.description: If we're going to wage war against the Blackrock clan, we're going to need to plan ahead.  My colonel has already put the plan together - now it's time to execute.$b$bI need scorpid stingers... the sharpest ones you can find.  Scorpids are all over the steppes, but you can find most of them in the gulch to the west.$b$bDon't worry about what they're for.  You'll find out soon enough.
english.progress: Back already?
english.completion: Those scorpids are easy to underestimate.  You're lucky you didn't end up on the end of one of these barbs.  Or maybe you're just good. I'll add these to the stockpile.  We're not done yet, $r.
english.completed: Return to John J. Keeshan at Flamestar Post in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 未来的计划
text.objectives: 收集11张灰烬座狼之皮。
text.description: 我们需要座狼的毛皮，大量。至于是不是裂开了、烧坏了、沾血了，都无所谓，只要大量就行。$b$b实际上，如果有点残缺就最好了。$b$b你可以到西边或者东边去找座狼。
text.progress: Let's take a look at those hides.
text.completion: Believe me, $n... I'm just as anxious to get to the killing as you are.  We've got to keep to the plan.  The armageddon will come soon enough. I'll keep these hides here.
text.completed: Return to John J. Keeshan at Flamestar Post in Burning Steppes.

english.title: A Future Project
english.objectives: Obtain 11 Ember Worg Hides.
english.description: We'll need worg hides, and lots of them.  It doesn't matter if they're torn, burned, or bloody, but we need plenty of them.$b$bActually, it's probably better if they're a little beat-up.$b$bYou'll find worgs both to the west and to the east of here.
english.progress: Let's take a look at those hides.
english.completion: Believe me, $n... I'm just as anxious to get to the killing as you are.  We've got to keep to the plan.  The armageddon will come soon enough. I'll keep these hides here.
english.completed: Return to John J. Keeshan at Flamestar Post in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 软泥猎人
text.objectives: 收集9堆黑曜斑点软泥。
text.description: 希望你不是个怕弄脏自己的人。看你的风尘仆仆的样子，这应该不是问题。$b$b在北边的熔岩边上，有一堆堆的暗色泥土。我需要这东西。$b$b如果你不问问题，只管埋头执行命令就最好了，$n。
text.progress: You'll want to watch out for those obsidian elementals.  They have a tendency to sneak up on you.
text.completion: This is exactly what we need. Don't worry, $n... the orc-killing will come soon enough.
text.completed: Return to John J. Keeshan at Flamestar Post in Burning Steppes.

english.title: Mud Hunter
english.objectives: Obtain 9 piles of Obsidian-Flecked Mud.
english.description: Hope you're not afraid of getting dirty.  Judging by the looks of you, that won't be a problem.$b$bTo the north, at the lava's edge, you'll find piles of dark mud.  I need it.$b$bIt'd be best if you didn't ask questions, and focused your efforts on following orders, $n.
english.progress: You'll want to watch out for those obsidian elementals.  They have a tendency to sneak up on you.
english.completion: This is exactly what we need. Don't worry, $n... the orc-killing will come soon enough.
english.completed: Return to John J. Keeshan at Flamestar Post in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 风暴祭坛
text.objectives: 与风暴祭坛附近的戈瑟奇·邪眼交谈。
text.description: 托德曼上校正在东边等我们。不过，在我们出发之前，还需要收集一点东西。这一次，你要从一个名叫戈瑟奇·邪眼的术士那里去拿件东西。$b$b你大概可以在西北边的风暴祭坛附近找到他。告诉他，他必须帮我们的忙。我们需要沙子、苹果酒和宝珠。$b$b他知道这是什么意思。
text.completion: Gah!  Who are you? Oh, so Keeshan sent you?  Good.  Would ya mind sticking around for a while?  It's nothing big... I just need you to kill some warlocks for me.
text.completed: 去找燃烧平原风暴祭坛的戈瑟奇·邪眼。

english.title: The Sand, the Cider, and the Orb
english.objectives: Speak with Gorzeeki Wildeyes near the Altar of Storms.
english.description: Colonel Troteman is waiting for us to the east.  Before we head out though, we need to gather some more stuff.  This time, you'll be taking it from a warlock by the name of Gorzeeki Wildeyes.$b$bYou'll probably find him to the northwest, near the Altar of Storms.  Tell him he's going to help us out.  We need the sand, the cider, and the orb.$b$bHe'll know what it means.
english.completion: Gah!  Who are you? Oh, so Keeshan sent you?  Good.  Would ya mind sticking around for a while?  It's nothing big... I just need you to kill some warlocks for me.
english.completed: Report to Gorzeeki Wildeyes at the Altar of Storms in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 好东西都在术士那里
text.objectives: 取回一把沉睡之砂、一壶魔能泻药以及一颗澄澈的玻璃球。
text.description: 基沙恩说他需要物资？我多得是物资呀！问题是，我被术士们赶出了家园，他们还不许我回去。$b$b<戈瑟奇打量着你。>$b$b你说不定可以溜进去。前往北面，取回一把沉睡之砂、一壶魔能泻药和一颗澄澈的玻璃球。没错，他要的就是这些东西。$b$b噢，如果你不小心杀死了几名兽人，我是不会感到难过的。
text.progress: Let's see if you managed to get everything.
text.completion: I hope that's what Keeshan was looking for.  It's not doing me much good right now, anyhow.
text.completed: Return to Gorzeeki Wildeyes at the Altar of Storms in Burning Steppes.

english.title: Warlocks Have the Neatest Stuff
english.objectives: Obtain a handful of Slumber Sand, a jug of Fel Slider Cider, and a Clear Glass Orb.
english.description: Keeshan said he needs supplies?  I've got plenty of supplies!  Problem is, those warlocks have kicked me out of my home, and they're not letting me back in.$b$b<Gorzeeki sizes you up.>$b$bYou might be able to get in, though.  Head north, and grab some of my slumber sand, my fel slider cider, and a clear glass orb.  I'm pretty sure that's what he wants.$b$bOh, and if you happen to accidentally kill any of those orcs while you're up there, I wouldn't be terribly upset.
english.progress: Let's see if you managed to get everything.
english.completion: I hope that's what Keeshan was looking for.  It's not doing me much good right now, anyhow.
english.completed: Return to Gorzeeki Wildeyes at the Altar of Storms in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 对付耐格什
text.objectives: 杀死暗影耐格什。
text.description: 暗影耐格什是北面那群术士的头目。黑石兽人一露面，这个蠢货就将我赶出了家园。哼，他们都是坏蛋，但是耐格什尤其讨厌。$b$b我要想回到祭坛的话，他就必须死。
text.completion: Knowing the way those orcs operate, there'll be another one to take his place soon.  I'll see if I can't sneak back into the altar before that happens. Thanks, buddy.
text.completed: Return to Gorzeeki Wildeyes at the Altar of Storms in Burning Steppes.

english.title: Shadow Boxing
english.objectives: Slay Ner'gosh the Shadow.
english.description: Ner'gosh the Shadow is the leader of those warlocks to our north.  He's the jerk that kicked me out of my home once those Blackrock orcs started showing up.  Well, they're all jerks, but he's the jerkiest.$b$bIf I'm ever going to move back in near the Altar, Ner'gosh has to go.
english.completion: Knowing the way those orcs operate, there'll be another one to take his place soon.  I'll see if I can't sneak back into the altar before that happens. Thanks, buddy.
english.completed: Return to Gorzeeki Wildeyes at the Altar of Storms in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 向基沙恩复命
text.objectives: 将术士补给品交给燃烧平原焰星哨站的约翰·J·基沙恩。
text.description: 我想我和你之间的任务已经清了。等我胆量足够了，我会赶走剩余的术士的。$b$b给，别忘记带上这些物资。
text.progress: It looks like you managed to deal with Gorzeeki.
text.completion: Good, good, good.  We can move on.  Our war takes us east, away from Blackrock Mountain... for now.
text.completed: Report to John J. Keeshan at Flamestar Post in Burning Steppes.

english.title: Return to Keeshan
english.objectives: Bring the Warlock's Supplies back to John J. Keeshan at Flamestar Post in Burning Steppes.
english.description: Well I suppose I'm done with you here.  I'll go shoo those other warlocks out when I build up the courage.$b$bHere, don't forget those supplies.
english.progress: It looks like you managed to deal with Gorzeeki.
english.completion: Good, good, good.  We can move on.  Our war takes us east, away from Blackrock Mountain... for now.
english.completed: Report to John J. Keeshan at Flamestar Post in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 凿握据点，燃烧平原的中心
text.objectives: 在你前往凿握据点的途中杀死任意15名黑石大军的成员。
text.description: 我们要启程前往位于燃烧平原中心的凿握据点，与瑟银兄弟会和托尔曼会合。$b$b你知道瑟银兄弟会吗？兄弟会的黑铁矮人们不止一次地帮助我脱离险境。现在，我们又需要他们伸出援手了。$b$b我们将穿越黑齿营地。沿途不如杀一些兽人玩玩？我的手正痒痒呢。
text.completion: You'll have to excuse me, but we're not taking visitors right now.  I'll ask you to leave Chiselgrip out the same door you came in. Oh, Keeshan... is that you?
text.completed: Report to Stebben Oreknuckle at Chiselgrip in Burning Steppes.

english.title: Chiselgrip, the Heart of the Steppes
english.objectives: Kill any 15 Blackrock troops on your way to Chiselgrip.
english.description: We're headed to Chiselgrip, right in the center of these steppes.  We'll rendezvous with the Thorium Brotherhood there, as well as with Troteman.$b$bYou familiar with the Brotherhood?  Those dark iron dwarves have helped me out more than once.  We may need their help again.$b$bWe'll pass through Black Tooth Hovel on our way there.  What do you say we kill a few orcs while we travel?  I'm getting a little restless here in this camp.
english.completion: You'll have to excuse me, but we're not taking visitors right now.  I'll ask you to leave Chiselgrip out the same door you came in. Oh, Keeshan... is that you?
english.completed: Report to Stebben Oreknuckle at Chiselgrip in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 斯瓦诺斯
text.objectives: 你必须杀死恶魔监狱中的斯瓦诺斯，并带回它的诅咒颈环。斯瓦诺斯就在巴拉丁监狱西北边的恶魔监狱中。
text.description: 你在占领这座岛的过程中表现得很出色，$c。现在，我们既然已经占领了岛屿，就要用这些牢房关押囚犯。恶魔监狱是个特别难以清理的地方，不幸的是，这里到处都是形形色色的恶魔。$B$B我们成功地削减了恶魔的数量，但是有一只巨大的熔火犬冲出了牢笼，正在那里大肆破坏。我要你去干掉它，把它的颈环拿回来。
text.progress: Is the core hound dead?
text.completion: Svarnos is finally dead?  Looks like we can finally get to work setting up that cellblock then.  Thank you $n.
text.completed: Report back to 2nd Lieutenant Wansworth at Baradin Hold when you are done.
text.giverWindow: 我从来都不喜欢绿色。

english.title: Svarnos
english.objectives: You must kill Svarnos in the D-Block and return with his Cursed Collar.  Svarnos can be found in the D-Block, just northwest of Baradin Hold.
english.description: Excellent work on the island capture, $c.  Now that we have claimed the island, we need to make these cellblocks useable for prisoners.  D-Block has been especially hard to clear out.  Unfortunately it has become overrun with demons of all sorts.$B$BWe have been able to thin out the demons but a large core hound has broken its way out of its cell and is wreaking havoc down there.  I need you to kill him and bring back his collar.
english.progress: Is the core hound dead?
english.completion: Svarnos is finally dead?  Looks like we can finally get to work setting up that cellblock then.  Thank you $n.
english.completed: Report back to 2nd Lieutenant Wansworth at Baradin Hold when you are done.
english.giverWindow: Green never was my favorite color.

text.title: 被诅咒的镣铐
text.objectives: 你的任务是从巴拉丁监狱西北边的恶魔监狱取回8条被诅咒的镣铐。
text.description: 你去过恶魔监狱了吗，$n？每次我们差不多把那些牢房里的恶魔清理干净的时候，他们都会很快卷土重来。我们发现他们是从散布在该地区的被诅咒的镣铐中钻出来的。这就是我要交给你的任务了，$n。$B$B我要你去尽可能收集那些镣铐，把它们带回来交给我。我们会立即摧毁这些东西。
text.progress: Did you find many shackles?  Reports mentioned that they were all over the place down there.
text.completion: The shackles!  We will begin the process of destroying these shackles immediately $n.  Thank you for your help.
text.completed: Report back to 2nd Lieutenant Wansworth at Baradin Hold when you are done.

english.title: Cursed Shackles
english.objectives: You have been asked to recover 8 Cursed Shackles from the D-Block, just northwest of Baradin Hold.
english.description: Have you been down in the D-Block yet, $n?  Every time we clear that infested cellblock out, the demons seem to return rather quickly.  We learned that they regenerate from the cursed shackles scattered around the area.  That's where you come in to the picture $n.$B$BI need you to retrieve as many of those shackles as you can and bring them back to me.  We will destroy them immediately.
english.progress: Did you find many shackles?  Reports mentioned that they were all over the place down there.
english.completion: The shackles!  We will begin the process of destroying these shackles immediately $n.  Thank you for your help.
english.completed: Report back to 2nd Lieutenant Wansworth at Baradin Hold when you are done.

text.title: 还早得很哪！
text.objectives: 你做好护送元首司克诺兹离开燃烧的建筑的准备后，就跟他谈谈。
text.description: 好了，$r！这回来真的！$b$b有人以为他们能够把我轻易干掉，啊？$b$b咱们走着瞧！什么都无法阻止我！无法阻止！$b$b<司克诺兹看着熊熊的火舌。>$b$b也许我们应该离开这里。$b$b赶快！时间紧迫！
text.completion: It is times like zhese, zhat one learns who his friends really are...
text.completed: Speak to Commander Schnottz in Schnottz's Landing.

english.title: Missed Me By Zhat Much!
english.objectives: Speak to Commander Schnottz when you are ready to accompany him out of the burning building.
english.description: Okay, $r! Zhis just got real!$b$bSomevone zhinks zhat zhey can get rid of me zhat easily, hmm?$b$bVe shall see about zhat! Nozhink can shtop zhis vork! Nozhink!$b$b<Schnottz looks around at the encroaching flames.>$b$bVe should probably get out of here.$b$bHuury up! Time is vastink!
english.completion: It is times like zhese, zhat one learns who his friends really are...
english.completed: Speak to Commander Schnottz in Schnottz's Landing.

objectiveDetails.description: 护送司克诺兹到安全地带

text.title: 监狱暴动
text.objectives: 你的任务是去巴拉丁监狱西南边的矿渣洞杀死任意10名囚犯。
text.description: 我们已经占领了岛屿，就该让这里的资源发挥作用了。我们在西南边找到了一座废弃的监狱，需要派你去侦察一下，$n。$B$B报告称，那里有许多被关押了多年的囚犯。尽你所能清理该地，解决之后回来向我报告。
text.completion: You cleared that area out?  Looks like you might be more useful to us that we thought, $r.
text.completed: Report back to Marshal Fallows at Baradin Hold when you are done.

english.title: Prison Revolt
english.objectives: You have been instructed to kill 10 prisoners of any type in The Hole, just southwest of Baradin Hold.
english.description: We have the island, now we need to put the resources here to work.  We found an abandoned cellblock just southwest of here and we need you to go check it out $n.$B$BReports have come back that it is overrun with prisoners that have been stuck down there for years.  Do whatever you need to do to clear that place out.  Report back to me when you are done.
english.completion: You cleared that area out?  Looks like you might be more useful to us that we thought, $r.
english.completed: Report back to Marshal Fallows at Baradin Hold when you are done.

text.title: 做正确的事
text.objectives: 尝试铲除15棵食人花苗
text.description: 这真是恐怖的场景。不知道是谁将所有的食人花苗埋在了土里，这可不是一般的庄稼。$B$B你可以终结这一切。用这根铁铲干掉他们吧。$B$B要做正确的事。
text.completion: Undoubtedly you did the right thing. Hopefully the humans that you saved will show similar mercy to you should the time of your planting ever come.$B$BThis is all assuming you rescued the humans and didn't splatter their brains all over the dirt - of course.$B$BKeep the shovel as a reminder of the horrors of the Sludge Fields and the depravity of mortals.

english.title: Do the Right Thing
english.objectives: "Save" 15 Human Seedlings.
english.description: You have come upon a horrific scene. Someone or something has buried all of the humans up to their necks in a manner consistent with planting. The ghouls, which are seemingly tending the field of human seedlings, periodically jump to the nearest human and devour its head!$B$BYou can end this right here and now. Take this shovel and "save" the humans.$B$BDo the right thing.
english.completion: Undoubtedly you did the right thing. Hopefully the humans that you saved will show similar mercy to you should the time of your planting ever come.$B$BThis is all assuming you rescued the humans and didn't splatter their brains all over the dirt - of course.$B$BKeep the shovel as a reminder of the horrors of the Sludge Fields and the depravity of mortals.

text.title: 被污染的软泥怪
text.objectives: 杀死8只被污染的软泥怪。
text.description: 一切都因温娜·哈萨德而起。她是血毒岗哨的被遗忘者药剂师，研究用灌注恶魔能量的软泥怪对付联盟的办法。$B$B我们警告过她，这太冒风险了，而她不听，我们又没有及时行动。现在她和血毒岗哨的所有人都变成了毫无心智的泥浆怪……$B$B那些被她用来实验的恶心软泥怪还游荡在东边和南边的池子附近。我请求你，$c，摧毁它们，防止它们再度作恶。
text.completion: My rage quells at the news... perhaps I will find it easier to rest and heal now.$B$BMaybe my stomach will settle as well. Urgh...
text.completed: Return to Altsoba Ragetotem at Bloodvenom Post in Felwood.

english.title: The Tainted Ooze
english.objectives: Slay 8 Tainted Oozes.
english.description: This all started with Winna Hazzard. She was a forsaken apothecary at Bloodvenom Post, researching ways to use the demonic ooze here against the Alliance.$B$BWe warned her she was going too far, but she didn't listen, and we did not act fast enough. Now her and everyone at Bloodvenom Post are nothing more than mindless slime creatures...$B$BThe disgusting oozes she used for this still roam near the pools to the east and south. I beg you, $c, destroy them so that others cannot commit such evil.
english.completion: My rage quells at the news... perhaps I will find it easier to rest and heal now.$B$BMaybe my stomach will settle as well. Urgh...
english.completed: Return to Altsoba Ragetotem at Bloodvenom Post in Felwood.

text.title: 有始有终
text.objectives: 杀死10条黑曜石龙族。
text.description: 黑曜石龙族遍布在我们的南边。它们绝无可能把我们击退，但是谁也说不好战事宁静下来后，又会有怎样新的威胁浮现。$B$B我要你飞过去，把它们干掉，这样我们就能把这片土地从黑龙军团的污染中净化出来。
text.completion: You've proven a great ally. I would have never expected such upon our first meeting.
text.completed: Return to Lirastrasza just northwest of the Obsidian Forest in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: A Fitting End
english.objectives: Kill 10 Obsidian wyrmkin.
english.description: The Obsidian wyrmkin litter the landscape to our south. They're in no position to push back against us, but one can never tell what new threats the ebb of battle may bring.$B$BI want you to take the fight to the wyrmkin. Clear them out so that we may proceed with purging this land of the polluting presence of the black dragonflight.
english.completion: You've proven a great ally. I would have never expected such upon our first meeting.
english.completed: Return to Lirastrasza just northwest of the Obsidian Forest in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 无人生还
text.objectives: 评估药渣农场的形势。
text.description: 农场戒严！禁止进出！我们还在评估局势，想要查明究竟发生了什么事。我的看法是，人类劳工吃下了奇怪的蘑菇，变异成可怕的亡灵怪。我的意思是，还能是什么原因啊？这不过是座农场！我们在这里种植蘑菇！还有药渣！对，药渣！$B$B四下看看，$c。你既然来了，就解决这个难题。$B$B你自己看看吧！
text.completion: As you can see, they're all monsters! Most of my guards died and the ones that managed to escape are now holding down the barricades, preventing any of these potentially dangerous creatures from getting out.$B$BWe need your help!
text.completed: 去找希尔斯布莱德药渣农场的看守者斯蒂沃特。

english.title: No One Here Gets Out Alive
english.objectives: Assess the situation at the Sludge Fields.
english.description: This farm is under lockdown! Nothing gets in and nothing gets out! We're still assessing the situation to try and figure out exactly what happened, but my theory is that the laborers ate the mushrooms and somehow mutated into hideous undead monsters. I mean, how else could this have happened? This is just a farm! We grow mushrooms here! And sludge! Yes, sludge!$B$BTake a look around, $c, because now that you're here you can't leave until this issue is resolved.$B$BSee for yourself!
english.completion: As you can see, they're all monsters! Most of my guards died and the ones that managed to escape are now holding down the barricades, preventing any of these potentially dangerous creatures from getting out.$B$BWe need your help!
english.end: Assess the situation at the Sludge Fields.
english.completed: Speak with Warden Stillwater at the Sludge Fields in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 锁定！
text.objectives: 元首司克诺兹要你观察司克诺兹登陆点的客人们。
text.description: 那座建筑不会自己爆炸！$b$b有人想害我，除非我找到凶手，不然你不准休息！$b$b从客人们开始。去找他们，观察他们的一举一动，然后回来告诉我。$b$b要是他们知道什么情况的话，我就会审问他们！$b$b解散！
text.completion: Zhey know nozhink, you say? Very vell, zhen. Zhe search goes on...
text.completed: Speak with Commander Schnottz in Schnottz's Landing.

english.title: Lockdown!
english.objectives: Commander Schnottz wants you to observe the guests in Schnottz's Landing.
english.description: Zhat buildink did not explode by itself!$b$bSomevone is tryink to do me in, and you von't rest until I find out who!$b$bShtaht vizh zhe guests. Visit vizh zhem, observe zheir demeanor, and zhen report back to me.$b$bIf zhey know anyzhink at all, I vill haff zhem interrogated!$b$bDismissed!
english.completion: Zhey know nozhink, you say? Very vell, zhen. Zhe search goes on...
english.completed: Speak with Commander Schnottz in Schnottz's Landing.

text.title: 大逃亡
text.objectives: 司克诺兹登陆点的多产的作家要你从司克诺兹水手那里拿到6件崭新的制服。
text.description: 拜托了，$c！我们需要你的帮助！$b$b我们被困在这座建筑里了。元首在那里长篇大论，情绪激动，不知道他打算怎么处置我们！$b$b也许要是你帮忙弄几套制服来，我们就可以溜走了。$b$b我现在才明白，我们压根不该来这儿。$b$b只要你帮我们逃走，我就把这里所发生的真相写出来。$b$b衣服可以从船上那些人的身上扒下来。
text.progress: Were you able to find us some uniforms, $r?
text.completion: These are perfect, $c. Wish us luck!
text.completed: Speak to the Prolific Writer in Schnott's Landing.

english.title: The Great Escape
english.objectives: The Prolific Writer in Schnottz's Landing wants you to collect 6 Fresh Uniforms from Schnottz Sea Sailors.
english.description: Please, $c! We need your help!$b$bWe're being kept in this building against our will. And with the commander on such a tirade, there's no telling what he might do to us!$b$bPerhaps if you were to secure some uniforms for us, we could sneak away.$b$bWe never should have come here. I see that now.$b$bIf you help us escape, I will write the TRUTH of what has happened here.$b$bThe men on those ships are all dressed in the garb we need.
english.progress: Were you able to find us some uniforms, $r?
english.completion: These are perfect, $c. Wish us luck!
english.completed: Speak to the Prolific Writer in Schnott's Landing.

text.title: 发出信息
text.objectives: 元首司克诺兹要你去杀掉玛尔贡船长、科克船长，以及克隆卡船长。
text.description: 这个地区到处都是我的耳目，$r。$b$b我已经听说了部队里的一些风言风语。我一直在容忍这种可悲的行为——但现在我忍不下去了！$b$b我要明确地提醒大家，内斗是不被允许的！$b$b你要去码头消灭那几个到我船上来的船长。他们是不满情绪最严重的一帮家伙。$b$b等这事完了之后，我将对通讯进行监控，再决定下一步该怎么做。$b$b解散！
text.completion: Very good, $r...
text.completed: Report to Commander Schnottz in Schnottz's Landing.

english.title: Sending a Message
english.objectives: Commander Schnottz wants you to kill Captain Margun, Captain Cork, and Captain Kronkh
english.description: I haf eyes and ears in every corner of zhis region, $r.$b$bI haf heard of zhe murmurings zhat go on amonkst my troops. I haf been most tolerant of zhis pathetic behavior - until now!$b$bI vill send zhe message to everyvone in my ranks, zhat dissension vill not be tolerated!$b$bYou are to exterminate zhe captains aboard my ships in dock. Zhey haf been amonk zhe most disgruntled.$b$bVhen zhis has been done, I vill monitor zhe communications and determine vhat to do next.$b$bDismissed!
english.completion: Very good, $r...
english.completed: Report to Commander Schnottz in Schnottz's Landing.

text.title: 希尔斯布莱德之战
text.objectives: 将希尔斯布莱德之战交给希尔斯布莱德丘陵药渣农场的看守者斯蒂沃特。
text.description: 这本日志记录了书记员赫拉斯·怀特斯蒂德最后62天的生活。满篇都是对看守者斯蒂沃特以及他在药渣农场的种种作为的指控。$B$B你应该把它交给看守者。他应该会对此作出解释的吧。
text.progress: 这是什么？
text.completion: <Warden Stillwater flips through the journal, reading under his breath.>$B$BRamblings of a mad man! Clearly he had been ingesting the mushrooms. It is good that you brought this to me, $n. I will burn it myself!

english.title: The Battle for Hillsbrad
english.objectives: Deliver the Battle for Hillsbrad to Warden Stillwater at the Sludge Fields in Hillsbrad Foothills.
english.description: The journal documents the last 62 days of Clerk Horrace Whitesteed's life. In it is written damning allegations against Warden Stillwater and his activities at the Sludge Fields.$B$BYou should show this to the warden. He will undoubtedly have an explanation for what is written in this journal.
english.progress: What's this?
english.completion: <Warden Stillwater flips through the journal, reading under his breath.>$B$BRamblings of a mad man! Clearly he had been ingesting the mushrooms. It is good that you brought this to me, $n. I will burn it myself!

text.title: 谨慎行事
text.objectives: 杀死平民维尔克斯和书记员赫拉斯·怀特斯蒂德。
text.description: 我们必须毁灭所有证据，$n！我说的是证据？我是指发疯的亡灵！总之，谨慎为妙。我们不能让这些家伙逃出药渣农场，外面的人也不需要了解这里究竟发生了什么！$B$B东南方本是一座废弃的蘑菇农场，你可以在那里找到复生的平民维尔克斯和书记员赫拉斯·怀特斯蒂德。这两个家伙可制造了不少的麻烦。杀掉他们！
text.completion: Well done! Wilkes was hanged after we discovered that he was ingesting mass quantities of mushrooms and other highly toxic substances. After he died he awoke, reborn as an undead geist. Many of my guards fell to Wilkes before he ran off into hiding. Fearing something like this might happen again, we incinerated the Clerk until only bones were left!$B$BWhy would they willingly ingest toxic substances? I have no idea! This is a farm, $g sir:miss;, nothing more!
text.completed: Return to Warden Stillwater at the Sludge Fields in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: Discretion is Key
english.objectives: Kill Citizen Wilkes and Clerk Horrace Whitesteed.
english.description: We must destroy all of the evidence, $n! Did I say evidence? I meant crazed undead! Anyway, discretion is key. We must not let the rampaging undead make it out of the Sludge Fields and no one outside of this institution must know about what happened here!$B$BDirectly southeast of here in what used to be the old mushroom farm you'll find a reanimated fiend known as Citizen Wilkes and his cohort, Clerk Horrace Whitesteed. They have been causing huge problems for my guards. Find them and kill them!
english.completion: Well done! Wilkes was hanged after we discovered that he was ingesting mass quantities of mushrooms and other highly toxic substances. After he died he awoke, reborn as an undead geist. Many of my guards fell to Wilkes before he ran off into hiding. Fearing something like this might happen again, we incinerated the Clerk until only bones were left!$B$BWhy would they willingly ingest toxic substances? I have no idea! This is a farm, $g sir:miss;, nothing more!
english.completed: Return to Warden Stillwater at the Sludge Fields in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 最薄弱的一环
text.objectives: 跟奥丹姆拉穆卡恒军团前哨的萨赫特谈一谈。
text.description: 据说链条的关键就在于其最为薄弱的一环上。$B$B我赞同这个理论，并且加以了扩展。$B$B与其把薄弱的环节去掉，我们不如……加强它。$B$B其他的环节为了不成为最薄弱的，同时也就会加倍努力。$B$B就拿我的军队来说吧，薄弱的环节是一个叫做萨赫特的人。$B$B他就在阶梯下面训练。$B$B先让他从简单点的任务做起。比如说，西边山上的土狼之类的。
text.completion: It is a great honor to meet you, $n!  I've heard much about you.

english.title: The Weakest Link
english.objectives: Speak to Salhet at the Ramkahen Legion Outpost in Uldum.
english.description: They say a chain is only as strong as its weakest link.$B$BI subscribe to that theory and expand upon it.$B$BRather than removing that weak link, one must... strengthen it.$B$BThe other links will step up their performance out of fear of they themselves becoming the weakest link.$B$BIn my army's case, our weak link has a name.  Salhet.$B$BYou'll find him training near the bottom of those stairs.$B$BStart him off with something easy.  The hyenas on the hills to the west, perhaps.
english.completion: It is a great honor to meet you, $n!  I've heard much about you.

text.title: 为了科学！
text.objectives: 取回6份肉块样本。
text.description: 样本……对……我们必须拿到样本！这些，呃，实验品……我是说，我们要研究这些不幸的劳工。$B$B去东南方的农场杀死食尸鬼，从尸体上取回肉块样本。将它们带回来给我！$B$B<阿尔瑙德搓着双手，莫名其妙地露出邪恶的笑容。>$B$B要进行试验！
text.progress: 为了科学！
text.completion: These samples will give us a better understanding of the mindless undead. Take these coins as a reward.
text.completed: Return the Flesh Samples to Flesh-Shaper Arnauld at the Sludge Fields in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: For Science!
english.objectives: Recover 6 Flesh Samples.
english.description: Samples... yes... must have samples! These, ah, experiments... I mean, these unfortunate laborers must be studied.$B$BTravel southeast to the first farm and kill the risen ghouls. From their decrepit corpses you must recover flesh samples. Bring them to me!$B$B<Arnauld wrings his hands together and laughs maniacally for no discernible reason.>$B$BMust test!
english.progress: For science!
english.completion: These samples will give us a better understanding of the mindless undead. Take these coins as a reward.
english.completed: Return the Flesh Samples to Flesh-Shaper Arnauld at the Sludge Fields in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 兵贵补给
text.objectives: 剥制20张硬化鳄鱼皮。
text.description: 你会注意到，我们的备战工作稍有不足。$B$B托维尔部落已经数千年未逢敌手了。$B$B尽管如此，泰坦为我们先祖所编制的战斗规程还在。某些已经成为了我们的本能，而某些则借由传统代代流传。$B$B可要是缺乏补给，这些都是白搭。我们需要武器。我们需要铠甲。$B$B附近河床鳄鱼的皮能做出最好的护甲。帮我们弄一些来。
text.progress: I am glad to see you don't think you're above this sort of task.
text.completion: Excellent job, $n.  You might not think this adds up to much, but this might very well be the difference between life and death to one of our soldiers.
text.completed: Return to Sergeant Mehat at the Ramkahen Legion Outpost in Uldum

english.title: The Element of Supplies
english.objectives: Collect 20 Hardened Crocolisk Hides.
english.description: You'll notice that we're slightly ill prepared for battle.$B$BThe tol'vir tribes had never seen any sort of major confrontation for thousands of years.$B$BAll the combat protocols that the titans programmed into our ancestors are still there, though.  Some are part of our instincts, some get passed on as tradition.$B$BBut none of this can compensate for lack of supplies.  We need weapons.  We need armor.$B$BThe best armor is lined with the skin of the riverbed crocolisks nearby.  Help us gather some.
english.progress: I am glad to see you don't think you're above this sort of task.
english.completion: Excellent job, $n.  You might not think this adds up to much, but this might very well be the difference between life and death to one of our soldiers.
english.completed: Return to Sergeant Mehat at the Ramkahen Legion Outpost in Uldum

text.title: 铸犁为剑
text.objectives: 招募8名拉穆卡恒劳工。
text.description: 我们兵力庞大，但我担心要投入拉穆卡恒和奥西斯全部的托维尔人，才能与尼斐塞特部落一决雌雄。$B$B我要你先行一步，为我们招兵买马。$B$B到河对面的埃卡赫莱平原，去把那里工作的劳工征召进来。
text.completion: You are a born leader, $n.  It'll be good to have you by our side when war comes to these lands.
text.completed: Return to High Commander Kamses at the Ramkahen Legion Outpost.

english.title: Ploughshares to Swords
english.objectives: Recruit 8 Ramkahen Laborers.
english.description: We have a sizeable army, but I'm afraid the coming showdown with the Neferset hordes will demand that all able-bodied tol'vir of Ramkahen and Orsis join in the fight.$B$BI want you to be at the forefront of our recruiting efforts.$B$BGo across the river, to the Akhenet Fields, and recruit the laborers that work there.
english.completion: You are a born leader, $n.  It'll be good to have you by our side when war comes to these lands.
english.completed: Return to High Commander Kamses at the Ramkahen Legion Outpost.

text.title: 完美的伪装
text.objectives: 从裁缝桌上拿取适当数量的材料，交给凿握据点的萨拉隆·巨钉。
text.description: 根据你的体重、体格和体型，我们要把你假扮成一个兽人。他们的军队里大部分都是兽人，所以你很容易混进去。$b$b你对裁缝有了解吗？如果没有的话，就把这个当成你的第一课吧。我的工作台就在那边，上面有所有必要的材料。$b$b去拿一些你觉得有用的东西，把它们拿来交给我。萨拉隆会帮你料理一切。
text.completion: That's it?  That's your disguise? I'm feeling less confident about our chances.  It was nice knowing you, kid.
text.completed: Report to John J. Keeshan at Chiselgrip in Burning Steppes.

english.title: A Perfect Costume
english.objectives: Bring the appropriate amount of supplies from the Tailoring Table to Thelaron Direneedle at Chiselgrip.
english.description: Judging by your weight, build, and size, we're going to dress you as an orc.  Their army is made mostly of orcs, so you'll fit right in.$b$bDo you know much about tailoring?  If not, then consider this your first lesson.  My crafting table over there has all the necessary supplies on it.$b$bGo ahead and grab whatever you think is necessary, then bring it here.  Thelaron will fix you right up.
english.completion: That's it?  That's your disguise? I'm feeling less confident about our chances.  It was nice knowing you, kid.
english.completed: Report to John J. Keeshan at Chiselgrip in Burning Steppes.

text.objectives: 从裁缝桌上拿取适当数量的材料，交给凿握据点的萨拉隆·巨钉。
text.description: 根据你的体重、体格和体型，我们要把你假扮成一个食人魔。火腹食人魔一直在为黑石兽人卖力，所以你很容易混进去。$b$b你对裁缝有了解吗？如果没有的话，就把这个当成你的第一课吧。我的工作台就在那边，上面有所有必要的材料。$b$b去拿一些你觉得有用的东西，把它们拿来交给我。萨拉隆会帮你料理一切。

The Smolderthorn trolls have always worked with the Blackrock orcs, so you'll fit right in.$b$bDo you know much about tailoring?  If not, then consider this your first lesson.  My crafting table over there has all the necessary supplies on it.$b$bGo ahead and grab whatever you think is necessary, then bring it here.  Thelaron will fix you right up.

text.title: 失踪的小伙
text.objectives: 在希尔斯布莱德丘陵的药渣农场找到强尼·傲森。
text.description:
就在昨天，我派他去正东方的农场调查情况。真是度日如年啊！

他是完美的真正化身。他金色的发辫勾勒出完美的血精灵面庞……展现出强大的力量。我本不想派他出去的，但他坚持如此！我怎么能拒绝他呢？

但是，可怜的强尼·傲森再也没有回来！我很担心，$n。快去找他吧！
text.completion: <Johnny is sobbing loudly.>$B$BTw... Twinkles!!!! Th... It killed her!$B$B<Johnny continues to cry. Little snot bubbles form in his nostrils.>

english.title: Little Girl Lost
english.objectives: Find Johnny "Jenny" Awesome at the Sludge Fields in Hillsbrad Foothills.
english.description: It was only yesterday that I sent her out to investigate the farm directly east of here, but it feels like an eternity has passed!$B$BI knew it was true love the minute I saw her. Her lovely blonde locks and the way they framed her perfect blood elf face... She melted my shriveled heart. I didn't want to send her out, but she was so demanding! I had to give her what she asked for! Who could refuse such a vision?$B$BAlas, poor Jenny Awesome has not returned! I fear the worst, $n. Find her!
english.completion: <Johnny is sobbing loudly.>$B$BTw... Twinkles!!!! Th... It killed her!$B$B<Johnny continues to cry. Little snot bubbles form in his nostrils.>

text.title: 泥浆怪问题
text.objectives: 采集7朵翡翠伞菇。
text.description: 这个可怜的家伙差点就没能从血毒岗哨里逃出来！我们得把感染消除，不然他就会像所有其他人一样变成泥浆怪。$B$B在亮绿色的水源边长着很多蘑菇，比如说东边瀑布下的池塘。它们大多数都不是什么好东西……我要你采的是发着亮绿色光芒的那种！$B$B有了它们，我就能做一些好吃的来帮助这个可怜的牛头人。快别耽搁了！
text.progress: Remember, it's the bright green glowing ones!
text.completion: Most people think the green glow is demonic corruption... but if you've got an eye for shades and hues like me, you can tell it's the energies of the emerald dream! These little guys aren't being corrupted by the waters, they're doing their best to purify it!$B$BNow we'll mash 'em up and make a nice yummy paste for Mr. Tauren to eat and feel all better.
text.completed: Return to Kelnir Leafsong at Bloodvenom Post in Felwood.

english.title: A Slimy Situation
english.objectives: Collect 7 Emerald Shimmercaps.
english.description: This poor fellow here barely escaped Bloodvenom Post with his life! If we're going to keep him from turning into a slime creature like all the others, we've got to treat the infection.$B$BMushrooms like to grow near the bright green waters around here, like the pond to the east beneath the falls. Most of them are no good... I need you to collect the bright green glowing ones!$B$BIf I have those, I'll be able to whip up something tasty to help this poor tauren. Don't take too long now!
english.progress: Remember, it's the bright green glowing ones!
english.completion: Most people think the green glow is demonic corruption... but if you've got an eye for shades and hues like me, you can tell it's the energies of the emerald dream! These little guys aren't being corrupted by the waters, they're doing their best to purify it!$B$BNow we'll mash 'em up and make a nice yummy paste for Mr. Tauren to eat and feel all better.
english.completed: Return to Kelnir Leafsong at Bloodvenom Post in Felwood.

text.title: 温娜的小猫
text.objectives: 从温娜的小猫身上获得小猫的耳标。
text.description: 牛头人先生把血毒岗哨的很多事都告诉了我。他说温娜·哈萨德还在那里！$B$B她基本上已经算完蛋了，但她所变成的东西正在大量产生新的泥浆怪。我们得阻止它！$B$B还好，我有一个计划。牛头人先生说温娜以前养过一只小猫。她给它喂食腐化的泥浆怪汁水，然后它就跑到林子里去了。我在东南边血毒哨塔再远一点的地方看到有类似的东西出没，但是它可比小猫可要大多了！去看看那只猫咪是不是有个耳标……
text.progress: Did you find the kitten?
text.completion: Poor little kitty, suffering out there in the woods for so long! You did a good thing for it, $n. And probably for all the travelers it's been eating.$B$BThis tag will be handy...
text.completed: Return to Kelnir Leafsong at Bloodvenom Post in Felwood.
text.giverWindow: 小猫长大了……

english.title: Winna's Kitten
english.objectives: Collect Kitty's Eartag from Winna's Kitten.
english.description: Mr. Tauren here's told me a lot about what happened at Bloodvenom Post. He says Winna Hazzard is still there!$B$BShe's pretty far gone, but what's left of her is making a bunch of new slime. We've got to stop it!$B$BLuckily, I have a plan. Mr. Tauren said Winna used to have a kitten. She fed it corrupted slime water and it ran off into the woods. I saw something lurking to the southeast just past the Bloodvenom Tower, but it sure was bigger than a kitten! Go see if the kitty has a tag...
english.progress: Did you find the kitten?
english.completion: Poor little kitty, suffering out there in the woods for so long! You did a good thing for it, $n. And probably for all the travelers it's been eating.$B$BThis tag will be handy...
english.completed: Return to Kelnir Leafsong at Bloodvenom Post in Felwood.
english.giverWindow: Kitty has grown up...

text.title: 释放林度恩
text.objectives: 取回林度恩的牢笼钥匙。
text.description: 这里才不是农场！斯蒂沃特一直在利用希尔斯布莱德的人类做活体试验。这里的畸体生物都是他的创作。$B$B这还不是最糟糕的，$c。拥有牢笼钥匙的畸体本是被遗忘者。斯蒂沃特的试验产生的副作用将被遗忘者也变成了无脑的僵尸。不然他为什么这么害怕这件事传出去？因为他知道，一旦走漏风声，他就死定了。$B$B让我离开这里！被感染的药渣农场守卫身上就有钥匙！
text.progress: Get the key!
text.completion: <Lydon takes the key from you.>$B$BI'll let myself out, thanks.$B$BI have never been so angry! Stillwater won't get away with this. I will present his head to the Banshee Queen myself.$B$BYou and I will work together, $n.$B$BI don't know about the little girl here, but I'd prefer she stayed behind.
text.completed: Return to Master Apothecary Lydon at the Sludge Fields in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: Freedom for Lydon
english.objectives: Recover Lydon's Cage Key.
english.description: This place is no farm! Stillwater has been experimenting on the humans of Hillsbrad. The monstrosities here are all his creations.$B$BThat's not the worst of it, $c. The aberrations that have the key to my cage are former Forsaken. Stillwater's experiments have the side effect of turning Forsaken into mindless zombies. Why do you think he's so afraid of letting this get out? He knows that such a crime is punishable by true death.$B$BGet me out of here! The infected sludge guards outside have the key!
english.progress: Get the key!
english.completion: <Lydon takes the key from you.>$B$BI'll let myself out, thanks.$B$BI have never been so angry! Stillwater won't get away with this. I will present his head to the Banshee Queen myself.$B$BYou and I will work together, $n.$B$BI don't know about the little girl here, but I'd prefer she stayed behind.
english.completed: Return to Master Apothecary Lydon at the Sludge Fields in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 进展顺利
text.objectives: 帮助萨赫特消灭8头血吼土狼。
text.description: 高阶指挥官卡姆塞斯要交给我一个特别任务？$B$B等等……别告诉我。又是土狼，对不对？$B$B很好，我要全力以赴。$B$B去观日者山岭找我。$B$B我不会让你失望的。
text.progress: What's the tally?
text.completion: Well... that wasn't all that great, was it?
text.completed: Speak to Salhet at Sunwatcher's Ridge in Uldum.

english.title: Shaping Up
english.objectives: Help Salhet slay 8 Bloodsnarl Hyenas.
english.description: High Commander Kamses has a special mission for me?$B$BWait... don't tell me.  It's hyenas again, right?$B$BVery well, I shall do my best.$B$BMeet with me at the Sunwatcher's Ridge.$B$BI won't disappoint you.
english.progress: What's the tally?
english.completion: Well... that wasn't all that great, was it?
english.completed: Speak to Salhet at Sunwatcher's Ridge in Uldum.

objectiveDetails.description: 帮助萨赫特击败血吼土狼

text.title: 淬元素之火
text.objectives: 收集8柄淬火长矛。
text.description: 首当其冲的要务：我们需要弹药。足以穿透黑龙皮的强大弹药。$B$B桑德玛尔西边有一个蛮锤的镇子，被不受束缚的火元素所占领。所有被留在那场火灾中的武器，都淬上了元素之火。它们比我在这个熔炉里造出来的任何东西都要坚硬！$B$B到洪堡焚烧峡谷去帮我找些长矛来，$n。越尖越好。
text.progress: Spears, yes? My rapid-fire speargun would be rendered ineffective without them.
text.completion: Look at that - OW! Pointy! Hot! These spears should cut through that dragonhide like an electric cheese-slicing apparatus through butter.
text.completed: Bring the spears to Nivvet Channelock at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Tempered in Elemental Flame
english.objectives: Collect 8 Tempered Spears.
english.description: First things first: We're going to need ammunition. Ammunition powerful enough to pierce the armored hide of a black drake. $B$BWest of Thundermar is a Wildhammer town that's been overrun with unbound fire elementals. Any weapons left behind in that conflagration will have been tempered in elemental flame. Tougher than anything I could whip up at this forge!$B$BFind me spears in the Humboldt Conflagration, $n. The pointier the better.
english.progress: Spears, yes? My rapid-fire speargun would be rendered ineffective without them.
english.completion: Look at that - OW! Pointy! Hot! These spears should cut through that dragonhide like an electric cheese-slicing apparatus through butter.
english.completed: Bring the spears to Nivvet Channelock at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 非凡之物
text.objectives: 收集5粒熔火之怒。
text.description: 我有一个计划，将这个大小的标准矛枪的推荐扭力增大三倍，但根据我的计算，这武器一开火就会炸膛，说不定还会把这个星球一劈两半。$B$B只要有纯净元素之火来进行熔接，我就可以把壳体焊得比以前牢固100倍。$B$B不受束缚的余烬恶魔就在西边洪堡焚烧峡谷出没。把它们消灭掉，将留下来的熔火之怒带来给我！
text.progress: Do you have the molten fury? No no, don't put it in my hand. Here, use the tongs!
text.completion: Marvelous! I'll smelt this down into a delicious soup. An angry soup. Of molten metal.
text.completed: Return to Nivvet Channelock at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Hot Stuff
english.objectives: Collect 5 pellets of Molten Fury.
english.description: I have a plan to quadruple the recommended torque for a standard speargun of this size, but according to my calculations the act of firing the weapon would shatter the casing. And possibly cleave the planet in two.$B$BI can weld together a chassis 100-times stronger if I had a good source of pure elemental flame for the smelting.$B$BUnbound Emberfiends are roiling around west of here, in the Humboldt Conflagration. Killing them should render them down to pellets of molten fury. Bring me some!
english.progress: Do you have the molten fury? No no, don't put it in my hand. Here, use the tongs!
english.completion: Marvelous! I'll smelt this down into a delicious soup. An angry soup. Of molten metal.
english.completed: Return to Nivvet Channelock at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 处理哈萨德
text.objectives: 用小猫的耳标吸引温娜·哈萨德的注意，然后杀掉她。
text.description: 就在西边血毒岗哨的后面，温娜被紧紧包裹在泥浆怪的源头里。她让它保持流动，而它则为她提供安全！但要是你能吸引她的注意……$B$B把这只耳标带上，给温娜看看。只要她还残存着哪怕一丝丝的良知，也许就能管用。也许她对丢失的可怜小猫的悔意会浮上心头，再一次地感到抱歉，并从泥浆怪里走出来！$B$B然后说不定你就能杀掉她，阻止泥浆怪了。耶！
text.completion: Hooray! The forest will be safer now!$B$BYou're such a hero, $n! With everything you've done for me and Mr. Tauren and the trees and animals and flowers, you deserve a reward!$B$BYay!
text.completed: Return to Kelnir Leafsong at Bloodvenom Post in Felwood.
text.giverWindow: 她看起来有点不一样了……

english.title: Hazzard Disposal
english.objectives: Use Kitty's Eartag to get Winna Hazzard's attention, and then slay her.
english.description: Winna's hooked tight into the source of the slime itself, at the very back of Bloodvenom Post to the west. She makes sure it keeps flowing, and it keeps her safe! But if you can get her attention...$B$BTake the eartag and show it to Winna. If there's even a little, tiny bit of her left, maybe it'll get through. Maybe her regret for her poor lost kitty will come to the surface and she'll feel sorry just one more time, and come out of the slime!$B$BAnd then maybe you can kill her and stop the slime. Yay!
english.completion: Hooray! The forest will be safer now!$B$BYou're such a hero, $n! With everything you've done for me and Mr. Tauren and the trees and animals and flowers, you deserve a reward!$B$BYay!
english.completed: Return to Kelnir Leafsong at Bloodvenom Post in Felwood.
english.giverWindow: She looks a little different now...

text.title: 清理血毒岗哨
text.objectives: 杀死6个血毒淤泥奴隶。
text.description: 呕呜……$B$B你能不能……呕……能不能请你……呕！$B$B很抱歉，我还是有点……呃，我的肚子。如果你要去西边的血毒岗哨的话，能不能请你呕呕……$B$B帮……帮我的朋友们解除痛苦。现在就去。也是为你好。呜呜呜呕……
text.completion: Thank you, $c. I'm feeling much better now, and can appreciate the news that those abominations are gone.$B$BYou still might not want to stand too close, just in case...
text.completed: Return to Altsoba Ragetotem at Bloodvenom Post in Felwood.

english.title: Cleanup at Bloodvenom Post
english.objectives: Slay 6 Bloodvenom Slimeslaves.
english.description: Blurgh...$B$BCould you... ugh... could you please... URGH!$B$BExcuse me, I'm still a little... ugh, my stomach. If you're going to Bloodvenom Post to the west, could you please HUUURGH...$B$BJust... just put what's left of my friends out of their misery. Go RIGHT NOW. For your own good. Uuuuurghh...
english.completion: Thank you, $c. I'm feeling much better now, and can appreciate the news that those abominations are gone.$B$BYou still might not want to stand too close, just in case...
english.completed: Return to Altsoba Ragetotem at Bloodvenom Post in Felwood.

text.title: 潜能
text.objectives: 收集10个扭曲的源质环圈。
text.description: 你也知道，常规弹簧里所储存的能量，等于弹簧弹性的一半乘以位移的平方。但是如果你使用一根源质弹簧，那这数字就可观啦！天文数字啊！$B$B我的秘密武器需要源质线圈，正好暮光之锤的邪教徒会用类似的线圈来束缚大地元素。$B$B东边那个叫做黑色裂口的可怕地方有不少黑曜石奴隶，它们身上就有这种弹簧。
text.progress: If you start pulling heaps of elementium coils out of your backpack right now, you're going to make me one happy gnome!
text.completion: Terrific! These coils will decompress with the force of a thousand suns! That's just a rough approximation of course, don't hold me accountable for those numbers.
text.completed: Return to Nivvet Chennelock at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Potential Energy
english.objectives: Gather up 10 Twisted Elementium Coils.
english.description: As you well know, the amount of energy stored in a conventional spring is equal to one half the spring's elasticity times the displacement squared. Unless you're using an elementium spring. Then the numbers get obscene! Mathematically grotesque!$B$BI need some elementium loops for my secret weapon, and it just so happens that Twilight's Hammer cultists use coils like that to bind earth elementals.$B$BFind them on the Obsidian Stoneslaves east of here, in the terrible region known as the Black Breach.
english.progress: If you start pulling heaps of elementium coils out of your backpack right now, you're going to make me one happy gnome!
english.completion: Terrific! These coils will decompress with the force of a thousand suns! That's just a rough approximation of course, don't hold me accountable for those numbers.
english.completed: Return to Nivvet Chennelock at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 熔岩领主法萨扎尔
text.objectives: 拿到熔岩领主法萨扎尔的徽记。
text.description: 我刚从西边收到可怕的消息——洪堡农场没了。被一道火墙从这个星球上抹掉了！$B$B是暮光之锤干的，幸存者说这是熔岩领主法萨扎尔的杰作。他是一名升腾者——暮光之锤就是这么称呼成为元素的最高阶教徒的。他是纯粹的火焰之物。$B$B要不了多久，他也将成为纯粹的死亡之物！去洪堡焚烧峡谷杀掉熔岩领主法萨扎尔，把他的徽记给我带来！
text.progress: All these years ol' Humboldt throught his worst problems were from the Glopgut ogres up on the ridge. Then the Twilight's Hammer came. In an instant, they set the whole valley ablaze like it were a birthday cake. Heartless.
text.completion: Aye, that's him. Can you believe this thing was human once? That's the Twilight's Hammer for you. What they don't destroy, they corrupt. Thank you, $c.
text.completed: Return to Colin Thundermar at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.
text.giverWindow: 在火焰的中心找到他。

english.title: Magmalord Falthazar
english.objectives: Collect Magmalord Falthazar's Head.
english.description: I just heard the terrible news from the west - we've lost Humboldt's Stead. Wiped off the face of the planet in a wall of fire!$B$BThe Twilight's Hammer is to blame, and the survivors say it were the work of one Magmalord Falthazar. He's an ascendant - that's what they call the highest echelon of Twilight's Hammer cultists who become one with the elements. He's a creature of pure fire.$B$BAnd he'll soon be a creature of pure dead! Go kill Falthazar at the Humboldt Conflagration and bring me his head!
english.progress: All these years ol' Humboldt throught his worst problems were from the Glopgut ogres up on the ridge. Then the Twilight's Hammer came. In an instant, they set the whole valley ablaze like it were a birthday cake. Heartless.
english.completion: Aye, that's him. Can you believe this thing was human once? That's the Twilight's Hammer for you. What they don't destroy, they corrupt. Thank you, $c.
english.completed: Return to Colin Thundermar at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.
english.giverWindow: Seek him out in the center of the blaze.

text.title: 通缉：恶魔猎手
text.objectives: 杀死费隆纳斯·罪行者。
text.description: 自从将碧火小径从萨特手里收复之后，翡翠议会就派遣了大量德鲁伊对废墟进行旷日持久的净化工作。昨天晚上，他们中的几人遭到了谋杀……凶手是一名暗夜精灵。$B$B目击者声称对方是一位恶魔猎手，伊利丹的疯狂信徒。真少见。毫无疑问，他和他的主子一样因为力量而变得疯狂。$B$B我出重金悬赏这名凶手。有人在北边碧火小径下方的山谷里见过他。
text.completion: How noble of you... to blindly kill without question, to come for my head on the barest word of another.$B$BSheathe your fury and hear my tale first. You'll see what noble ignorance has done to these lands.
text.completed: Speak with Feronas Sindweller.
text.giverWindow: 将凶手绳之以法。

english.title: Wanted: The Demon Hunter
english.objectives: Slay Feronas Sindweller.
english.description: Since reclaiming Jadefire Run from the satyr, the Emerald Circle has sent many druids to begin the long task of cleansing the ruins. Last night, several of them were murdered... by a night elf.$B$BThe witnesses say it was a demon hunter, a crazed disciple of Illidan. A rare sight. No doubt he's gone mad with power just like his master.$B$BI'll pay top bounty for proof of this murderer's death. He's been spotted just off the road to the north, in a valley beneath Jadefire Run.
english.completion: How noble of you... to blindly kill without question, to come for my head on the barest word of another.$B$BSheathe your fury and hear my tale first. You'll see what noble ignorance has done to these lands.
english.completed: Speak with Feronas Sindweller.
english.giverWindow: Bring this murderer to justice.

text.title: 火焰与悲哀的宿命
text.objectives: 重温伊利丹同阿尔萨斯一战。
text.description: 我的同类因为我们的所作所为而遭到痛恨……被蔑视，被流放，被指控为深陷堕落、无可救药。$B$B然而，要不是因为某位恶魔猎手的所为，这片树林就将变成燃烧军团在艾泽拉斯最坚实的要塞。我说的正是我的主人，“背叛者”伊利丹·怒风。$B$B你亲眼看看吧。看看当伊利丹第一次被释放出来的时候这里都发生过什么，恐惧魔王提克迪奥斯的恶魔大军又是如何统治着这片森林，没人能够阻止他……
text.completion: And so my master set out to find the skull... risking his own life against an army of demons to find the source of corruption in Felwood. Imagine if he had not! Imagine what these woods would look like if the Skull of Gul'dan had continued its work, undisturbed...
text.completed: 去找费伍德森林的费隆纳斯·罪行者。
text.giverWindow: 伊利丹同死亡骑士阿尔萨斯初次会面就打得不可开交。

english.title: A Destiny of Flame and Sorrow
english.objectives: Relive Illidan's battle with Arthas.
english.description: My kind has always been hated for what we do... despised outcasts, accused of corruption beyond redemption.$B$BYet if it was not for a demon hunter, these very woods would be the greatest stronghold of the Burning Legion on Azeroth. I speak of my master, Illidan Stormrage, the "Betrayer".$B$BSee for yourself. See what occured here when Illidan was first freed, and the demonic forces of the dreadlord Tichondrius ruled this forest completely unopposed...
english.completion: And so my master set out to find the skull... risking his own life against an army of demons to find the source of corruption in Felwood. Imagine if he had not! Imagine what these woods would look like if the Skull of Gul'dan had continued its work, undisturbed...
english.completed: Return to Feronas Sindweller in Felwood.
english.giverWindow: Illidan's first meeting with the death knight Arthas led to a fierce battle.

text.title: 幼儿食品
text.objectives: 杀掉10只铁木鸣蜂来喂养保护者幼苗。
text.description: <小小的幼苗张开叶片，仿佛一只等待哺育的雏鸟。它用非常微弱的声音说道：>$B$B饿……想要……吃虫子……<你可以听到南边黄蜂的振翅声。它们能不能用来喂这个小东西呢？>
text.completion: <The seedling pats its stalk with a rooty arm, as if full. It looks to have grown a bit, too!>

english.title: Buzzers for Baby
english.objectives: Kill 10 Ironwood Buzzers to feed the Seedling Protector.
english.description: <The tiny seedling opens its leaves wide, like a baby bird waiting to be fed. It speaks in a very faint voice:>$B$BHungry... want... bugs...<You can hear the buzzing of wasps to the south. Could they be what the little thing wants to feed on?>
english.completion: <The seedling pats its stalk with a rooty arm, as if full. It looks to have grown a bit, too!>

text.title: 寻找土壤
text.objectives: 将保护者幼苗带到7块肥沃的土壤处。
text.description: <细小的幼株抖动着，示意你朝南走。你勉强能听到一个微弱的声音。>$B$B土壤……$B$B<看上去它想要新鲜的土壤。也许你可以将它引到一块看来更为肥沃的田地里去。>
text.completion: <The seedling coils its roots in what looks like a happy manner.>$B$BGrow... big...

english.title: Seeking Soil
english.objectives: Bring the Seedling Protector to 7 patches of Rich Soil.
english.description: <The tiny sproutling shuffles around, motioning you towards the south. You can barely hear a faint voice.>$B$BSoil...$B$B<It looks like it wants fresh soil. Maybe you should guide it to some of the richer-looking patches.>
english.completion: <The seedling coils its roots in what looks like a happy manner.>$B$BGrow... big...

text.title: 这些根须生来就是为了践踏
text.objectives: 杀死10名铁木践踏者。
text.description: 还有许多其他的灵魂被困在这些腐烂的尸体里……$B$B你有没有看见？北边的铁木践踏者遭受着恶魔的病痛，长满了恶心的霉菌。可怜的灵魂被困在那里面。$B$B你得帮忙。把它们砍倒，灵魂自然就能逃出来。我会将这些灵魂放到自己身体里，等我长大了，大家就可以快乐地在一起。你愿意帮忙吗？
text.completion: So happy! Can you hear us? We're so many friends now.$B$BBigger and bigger, with room for each friend...

english.title: These Roots Were Made For Stompin'
english.objectives: Slay 10 Irontree Stompers.
english.description: There's so many other spirits still trapped in rotting bodies here...$B$BDo you see? The irontree stompers, in the north. They're sick with demon-stuff and icky with mold. Poor spirits inside them can't get out.$B$BYou can help! Chop them down, and the spirits can get out. I'll put the spirits in me and we can all be happy together when I grow up. Will you help? Please?
english.completion: So happy! Can you hear us? We're so many friends now.$B$BBigger and bigger, with room for each friend...

text.title: 日中曲
text.objectives: 将保护者幼树引导至铁木森林的5处阳光照耀之地。
text.description: 我们已经长得这么大……该晒太阳了！该把我们的叶子在太阳下舒展开了！$B$B把我带到太阳那里去！太阳很远，但是阳光会照耀在我们身上。阳光可以让我们再度强大。阳光会透过粗大的树枝，照耀到像我们这些小家伙身上。$B$B在那里！北边能晒到太阳！把我们带上，带着我们起舞吧！
text.completion: So warm and fresh and full of life. We love the sun, it makes us stronger.$B$BSoon now, very soon is the time of growing...

english.title: Singin' in the Sun
english.objectives: Guide the Sapling Protector to 5 shafts of sunlight in Irontree Woods.
english.description: We're growing so much bigger... It's time to shine! Time to spread our leaves to the sun!$B$BTake me to the sun! The sun is far away, but its light comes to us. Its light makes us big and strong again. The light comes down the big branches to the little ones like ours.$B$BOver there! The sun comes to us in the north! Take us with you, take us to dance!
english.completion: So warm and fresh and full of life. We love the sun, it makes us stronger.$B$BSoon now, very soon is the time of growing...

text.title: 典狱官
text.objectives: 你必须杀死矿渣洞的典狱官席尔瓦，并拿到他的钥匙。矿渣洞就在巴拉丁监狱的西南边。
text.description: 我们差不多已经清理了矿渣洞中的暴动囚犯，不过还有一个问题没有解决。典狱官。$b$b典狱官席尔瓦是他们的主人，那些囚犯唯他马首是瞻。如果我们除掉他，就可以把他们全都端掉。去把他解决了，然后把他的钥匙给我带回来。我们可以用那些钥匙进入牢房深处，没准还能找到岛上的水源。
text.progress: Is the warden dead yet?
text.completion: Ahh, the wardens key's.  Another job well done, $n.  These will come in very handy.
text.completed: Report back to Marshal Fallows at Baradin Hold when you are done.
text.giverWindow: 是时候让典狱官提前释放了。

english.title: The Warden
english.objectives: You must kill Warden Silva in The Hole and return with his keys.  The Hole is just southwest of Baradin Hold.
english.description: We have almost finished clearing out the revolting prisoners in The Hole, but one last problem remains.  The warden.$b$bWarden Silva is their master and they will do anything for him.  If we take him out, we take them all out.  Finish him off and bring me back his keys.  We can use those keys to explore deeper into the cellblock and possibly gain access to the water supply here on the island.
english.progress: Is the warden dead yet?
english.completion: Ahh, the wardens key's.  Another job well done, $n.  These will come in very handy.
english.completed: Report back to Marshal Fallows at Baradin Hold when you are done.
english.giverWindow: Time to give the warden an early parole.

text.title: 最后的卫士
text.objectives: 打败枯萎的保护者。
text.description: 啊……谢谢你。小$r。我和其他人尝试过多次，要在这片森林里成长，但都没有成功。$B$B自从森林被毁以来，潜伏在北边的枯萎的保护者是唯一一株成年的古树，但是他的身体遭受着病痛，他的心智已经疯狂。我们既然收集树人的灵魂，那么我也应该把他身体里的灵魂都拯救出来，而不是弃它们于不顾。$B$B打败他，让他的灵魂加入到我的体内，然后我好扎根。
text.completion: Yes... it is time.
text.giverWindow: 生命与重生，源自腐朽与苦难。

english.title: The Last Protector
english.objectives: Defeat the Withered Protector.
english.description: Ahhh... thank you, little $r. I and others have tried so many times to grow in this forest, without success.$B$BThe Withered Protector that lurks in the north is the only ancient to have grown to maturity since the ruining of the forest, but his body is sick and his mind is mad. Just as we gathered the spirits of the treants, I would save those that dwell in him rather than leave them behind.$B$BDefeat him, and let his spirits join me before I set my roots.
english.completion: Yes... it is time.
english.giverWindow: From decay and suffering comes life and rebirth.

text.title: 证明你的忠诚
text.objectives: 在索瑞森废墟杀死10个黑铁矮人。
text.description: 我们当然欢迎你在凿握据点待一段时间，不过我得先知道你是不是朋友。所以呢，我有一件事交给你去做。$b$b我们瑟银兄弟会并不是燃烧平原唯一的黑铁矮人组织。远远不是。我们被黑石山的黑铁矮人压得喘不过气来。虽然我们在凿握据点这里颇为安全，但北边的索瑞森废墟那里仍有不少他们的人时常来骚扰。$b$b证明一下你自己吧，$r。去帮我们杀掉他们。
text.completion: Now that's what I like to see!  Yer alright, $r.
text.completed: Return to Stebben Oreknuckle at Chiselgrip in Burning Steppes.

english.title: Prove Yer Allegiance
english.objectives: Kill 10 Dark Iron dwarves in the Ruins of Thaurissan.
english.description: Yer welcome to stay in Chiselgrip for a time, but I need to know that yer a friend.  So I've got a task for ye.$b$bWe of the Thorium Brotherhood're not the only dark irons here in the steppes.  Far from it.  We're pretty badly outnumbered by the dark irons of Blackrock Mountain.  We've got a safe enough foothold here in Chiselgrip, but even so, they still pester us from as close as the Ruins of Thaurissan, to the north.$b$bProve yerself, $r.  Kill 'em for me.
english.completion: Now that's what I like to see!  Yer alright, $r.
english.completed: Return to Stebben Oreknuckle at Chiselgrip in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 魔像零件
text.objectives: 在索瑞森废墟杀死战争掠夺者，然后从它们掉落的战争掠夺者部件中拾取3个黑曜石活塞、3个排能滤网、3个瑟银齿轮轴和1个石能核心。
text.description: 我们有一些魔像，是当做卫兵用的。北边的那些矮人也有一些魔像，我不知道是干什么用的。$b$b我估计主要是用来杀人吧。$b$b我们自己的魔像需要替换一些备用零件，所以你的工作是这样的：去杀掉他们的魔像，然后找找散落在地上的零件，收集它们。你可能没办法把所有零件都收集起来，所以要仔细挑选。
text.progress: We build these golems ourselves, ye know.  A little mechanical work, a little elemental work... the results aren't half bad, if ye ask me.
text.completion: This is exactly what we needed.  I'll get the boys workin' on the next batch of golems right away.
text.completed: Return to Stebben Oreknuckle at Chiselgrip in Burning Steppes.

english.title: Scrapped Golems
english.objectives: Kill War Reavers in the Ruins of Thaurissan, then loot 3 Obsidian Pistons, 3 Flux Exhaust Sieves, 3 Thorium Gearshafts, and 1 Stone Power Core from the War Reaver Parts that they drop.
english.description: We keep golems here, as guards.  The dwarves to our north also keep golems, but I'm not sure why.$b$bMainly just for killin', I suppose.$b$bWe could use some spare parts for our own golems, so here's what yer gonna do: kill theirs, then look for any parts that might've fallen on the ground.  Salvage what ye can.  Ye probably won't be able to salvage everything, so choose carefully.
english.progress: We build these golems ourselves, ye know.  A little mechanical work, a little elemental work... the results aren't half bad, if ye ask me.
english.completion: This is exactly what we needed.  I'll get the boys workin' on the next batch of golems right away.
english.completed: Return to Stebben Oreknuckle at Chiselgrip in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 魔像训练
text.objectives: 帮助4个凿刻魔像进行战斗训练。
text.description: 你证明了自己能帮大忙，$r。我刚刚在想，你还可以再帮一个忙。$b$b我们的卫兵很强大，但他们不如你那么强大。所以我想，如果你不介意的话，是不是能帮他们进行一些训练呢？只要过去跟一个卫兵交谈，然后打几场就行了。希望他们能学会你的动作，变得更厉害一点。
text.completion: Yer a lifesaver, $n.  With golems like these, we won't have to worry about Dark Irons, Blackrock orcs... maybe even dragons! If ye ever need anything from the Thorium Brotherhood, don't hesitate to ask.  That goes for yer friends, too.
text.completed: Return to Stebben Oreknuckle at Chiselgrip in Burning Steppes.

english.title: Golem Training
english.objectives: Help 4 Chiseled Golems with their combat training.
english.description: Yer provin' to be a pretty big help around here, $r.  I was thinkin ye could help with just one more thing.$b$bOur guards are strong, but they're not as strong as you are.  I was thinkin', maybe if ye wouldn't mind, ye might help some of 'em with their training?  Just go up and talk to one and fight 'em a few times.  Hopefully they'll learn from yer moves and get better.
english.completion: Yer a lifesaver, $n.  With golems like these, we won't have to worry about Dark Irons, Blackrock orcs... maybe even dragons! If ye ever need anything from the Thorium Brotherhood, don't hesitate to ask.  That goes for yer friends, too.
english.completed: Return to Stebben Oreknuckle at Chiselgrip in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 重返森林
text.objectives: 把繁茂的保护者带回到铁木森林中央的土丘上。
text.description: 该说再见了。尽管时间不长，但你把我从幼苗养大。现在我必须重返森林。$B$B把我带到你发现我的那座土丘那儿去。我将在那里扎根，在先辈的古树林荫下成长。
text.completion: Someday I will spread my branches across a renewed forest, full of life and hope.$B$BFarewell, $n. Have patience... and if you live long, you may see me again one day.

english.title: Rejoining the Forest
english.objectives: Bring the Flourishing Protector back to the hill in the center of Irontree Woods.
english.description: It is time to say goodbye now. You have raised me from a seedling, brief though it was, but now I must rejoin the forest.$B$BTake me back to the hill you found me on. There I will set my roots, and grow in the shadow of the ancients that came before me.
english.completion: Someday I will spread my branches across a renewed forest, full of life and hope.$B$BFarewell, $n. Have patience... and if you live long, you may see me again one day.

text.title: 自然与滋养
text.objectives: 在语风林地的月井里装满瓶子，将水浇灌在铁木森林阵亡的古树卫士附近的地上。
text.description: 铁木森林北边的古树卫士们已经牺牲了多年，他们倒下的躯体无情地代表着这片土地所遭受的伤害。$B$B每一年，我们都会从月井里汲水，将它浇灌在他们面前，希望能够滋生新的生命。如果你愿意的话，也可以亲自浇水。$B$B这是一个深思的好机会。带上这个瓶子，到月井处灌满，然后将水浇在古树卫士之间的小土丘顶部。
text.completion: The moonwell water quickly seeps into the ground with a soft glow. A few moments later, a rustling noise is heard, and a small sprout pops up before your eyes.

english.title: Nature and Nurture
english.objectives: Fill the vial at the moonwell in Whisperwind Grove and pour it on the ground between the dead ancient protectors in Irontree Woods.
english.description: The ancient protectors of Irontree Woods to the north have been dead for years, their bodies a grim symbol of the damage to these lands.$B$BEvery season, we take the water from this moonwell, and pour it on the ground before them, hoping it will nurture new life. If you'd like, you can deliver the water yourself.$B$BIt is an excellent opportunity for reflection. Take this vial and fill it at the moonwell, and pour it on the very top of the small hill between the three ancients.
english.completion: The moonwell water quickly seeps into the ground with a soft glow. A few moments later, a rustling noise is heard, and a small sprout pops up before your eyes.

text.title: 准则
text.objectives: 杀死雷恩·盖兹·卡拉巴畸形怪。
text.description: 在看守者受到应得的惩罚之前，我们必须处理这场暴动。我们可不能让这场疫病蔓延。$B$B斯蒂沃特将三名农夫拼凑在一起，创造出一只可怖的畸体，它就在正北方的劳工区。要确保药渣农场的安全，就必须除掉这只怪物！准则问题！
text.completion: Once we deal with the rest of the undead we will confront Stillwater!
text.completed: Speak to Master Apothecary Lydon at the Sludge Fields in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: Protocol
english.objectives: Kill the Ray-Getz-Kalaba Monstrosity.
english.description: Before the warden receives his comeuppance we must deal with the outbreak. We cannot risk this contagion being released into the world.$B$BWithin the laborers' quarters, directly north of here, is a monstrosity Stillwater pieced together out of three farmers. This beast must be destroyed if we are to secure the Sludge Fields! Protocol demands it!
english.completion: Once we deal with the rest of the undead we will confront Stillwater!
english.completed: Speak to Master Apothecary Lydon at the Sludge Fields in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 为烁影报仇
text.objectives: 杀死铁匠维林坦。
text.description: 斯蒂沃特派我去农场调查暴动事件。当我抵达这里后，我和烁影遭到了一只名叫维林坦的畸体的突袭。我跌下马来，只能立即逃走了。但是烁影却待在原地跟畸体扭打起来。她不敌对方，被当做马苗似的种在了农场里。$B$B她为了救我，献出了自己的性命。我必须报仇！为烁影报仇！
text.progress: For Twinkles!
text.completion: She may now ascend to the great horsey heaven in the stars. We will never forget you, Twinkles. NEVER!
text.completed: Speak to Johnny Awesome at the Sludge Fields in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: Do it for Twinkles
english.objectives: Kill the Blacksmith Verringtan.
english.description: Warden Stillwater sent me out into the field to investigate the outbreak. When I arrived, Twinkles and I were charged by the lumbering monstrosity known as Verringtan. I was knocked off of Twinkles and immediately ran for my life. Twinkles, though, stayed behind and fought the beast off. Alas, she was defeated and then summarily planted in the soil as if she were some type of glorious star pony seedling.$B$BShe gave her life to defend me. Vengeance must be mine! If for nothing else, do it for Twinkles!
english.progress: For Twinkles!
english.completion: She may now ascend to the great horsey heaven in the stars. We will never forget you, Twinkles. NEVER!
english.completed: Speak to Johnny Awesome at the Sludge Fields in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 下面的食物
text.objectives: 你的任务是在巴拉丁监狱西南边的矿渣洞中收集12份囚犯的口粮。
text.description: 营地里的物资储备越来越少了，$n。我们最近发现西南边的监狱中储备着多年来没有用掉的干粮。我们要派你去尽可能收集那些干粮，把它们带回营地来。$B$B还有一件事，那座监狱里到处都是逃脱的囚犯，所以你要多加小心。
text.progress: Were you able to recover the rations?  Reports mentioned that they could be found all over the place down there.
text.completion: These rations will really help the troops out $n.  Thank you for your help.
text.completed: Report back to Marshal Fallows at Baradin Hold when you are done.

english.title: Food From Below
english.objectives: You have been asked to recover 12 Cellblock Rations from The Hole, just southwest of Baradin Hold.
english.description: Supplies are running low here in camp, $n.  We have recently learned that the cellblock just southwest of here has a number of rations remaining from years of use.  We need you to gather as many of those as you can and bring them back to camp.$B$BOne more thing, the entire cellblock is overrun with prisoners so be careful.
english.progress: Were you able to recover the rations?  Reports mentioned that they could be found all over the place down there.
english.completion: These rations will really help the troops out $n.  Thank you for your help.
english.completed: Report back to Marshal Fallows at Baradin Hold when you are done.

text.title: 失踪的兄弟
text.objectives: 找到巴鲁姆·铸锤。
text.description: 我的兄弟巴鲁姆不见了！$b$b他是来到这片地区的第一批斥候之一。其他人都安全返回了，可就是没有他的消息。据说在什么地方打混，可他是我唯一的兄弟，我向妈妈保证过要保护他的安全。能不能请你去找他？
text.completion: Don't be looking!  I'm not wearin' me pants!
text.completed: 找到巴鲁姆·铸锤。

english.title: The Lost Brother
english.objectives: Find Bahrum Forgehammer.
english.description: Me brother Bahrum has gone missing!$b$bHe was one of the first scouts in the area.  All the others have returned safely, but there be no sign of him.  Da says he's just dawdlin' somewhere, but he's me only brother, and I promised me mum that I would keep him safe.  Will you please find him?
english.completion: Don't be looking!  I'm not wearin' me pants!
english.completed: Find Bahrum Forgehammer.

text.title: 他们拿走了我的裤子！
text.objectives: 找到巴鲁姆的护腿。
text.description: 我干嘛站在谷物箱里？说来话长，黄蜂和龙喉出现得不是时候。我安全地跑了出来，可那些混蛋拿走了我的护腿！$B$B我的姐姐怕我刮伤，才给我做的，上面还缝着我的名字……要是她知道我把它弄丢了，我非得惭愧死不可。$B$B请帮我把它找回来——我看见偷裤子的贼逃到那边的要塞里去了。我得留在这儿*咳嗽*挡着。不准问蛮锤穿什么做内裤这种问题！
text.progress: Have you found 'em yet?  This grain is pretty itchy.
text.completion: Thank you!  Now turn around so I can put'em on.
text.completed: Bring the legguards to Bahrum at Gorshak War Camp in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: They Took Me Pants!
english.objectives: Find Bahrum's legguards.
english.description: Why I be standing in the grain crate?  Long story short, there were hornets and some Dragonmaw that showed up at a bad time.  I got away safely, but the bastards took off with me legguards!$B$BMy sister made those for me from scratch, even engraved my name on...  I would die of shame if she found out I lost 'em.$B$BPlease find 'em for me - I saw the pant thief going into that fortress over there.  I'm going to stay here for *ahem* cover.$B$BAnd don't be asking what a Wildhammer wears under his kilt!
english.progress: Have you found 'em yet?  This grain is pretty itchy.
english.completion: Thank you!  Now turn around so I can put'em on.
english.completed: Bring the legguards to Bahrum at Gorshak War Camp in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 波恩塞德必须死
text.objectives: 杀死波恩塞德镇长。
text.description: 波恩塞德镇长生前勇猛无比，在希尔斯布莱德一战中战功显赫。死后，他对我们来说是个不小的考验。$B$B波恩塞德就在药渣农场的西北区域，他能操纵强大的奥法能量。我们要一起终结他的统治。
text.completion: Now to bring Warden Stillwater to justice!
text.completed: Speak to Master Apothecary Lydon at the Sludge Fields in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: Burnside Must Fall
english.objectives: Kill Magistrate Burnside.
english.description: Magistrate Burnside was once the mayor of this region. In life he was a formidable adversary in the battle over Hillsbrad. In undeath he will surely test us.$B$BBurnside channels great arcane magic in the northwest section of the Sludge Fields. Lead us there and together we shall put an end to his rule, once and for all.
english.completion: Now to bring Warden Stillwater to justice!
english.completed: Speak to Master Apothecary Lydon at the Sludge Fields in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 失踪的兄弟
text.objectives: 找到巴鲁姆·铸锤。
text.description: Me brother Bahrum has gone missing!$b$bHe was one of the first scouts in the area.  All the others have returned safely, but there be no sign of him.  Da says he's just dawdling somewhere, but he's me only brother, and I promised me mum that I would keep him safe.  Will you please find him?
text.completed: <completion text>

english.title: The Lost Brother
english.objectives: Find Bahrum Forgehammer.
english.description: Me brother Bahrum has gone missing!$b$bHe was one of the first scouts in the area.  All the others have returned safely, but there be no sign of him.  Da says he's just dawdling somewhere, but he's me only brother, and I promised me mum that I would keep him safe.  Will you please find him?
english.completed: <completion text>

text.title: 大地的疫病
text.objectives: 取回看守者斯蒂沃特的徽记。
text.description: 亡灵暴动已被镇压，斯蒂沃特及其追随者接受惩罚的时候到了。这是自天灾入侵以来最大的危机，虽然悲剧得以解除，但是我们必须确保不会再发生类似的事件。彻底处死他们！$B$B来吧，$n！我要摘下斯蒂沃特的徽记！
text.progress: Do not waste my time, $n.
text.completion: I will deliver this head to the Banshee Queen personally. Of course I will make mention of your part in all of this, $n.$B$BAs for your reward - take from Stillwater's cache whatever you desire. You earned it.
text.completed: Give the Head of Warden Stillwater to Master Apothecary Lydon at the Sludge Fields in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: A Blight Upon the Land
english.objectives: Take the Head of Warden Stillwater.
english.description: With the undead outbreak contained, the time has come for Stillwater and his followers to answer for their crimes. Though we averted a tragedy the likes of which has not been seen since the Scourge invaded, we must ensure that such a thing can never happen again. They will all face true death!$B$BCome, $n! I will have Stillwater's head!
english.progress: Do not waste my time, $n.
english.completion: I will deliver this head to the Banshee Queen personally. Of course I will make mention of your part in all of this, $n.$B$BAs for your reward - take from Stillwater's cache whatever you desire. You earned it.
english.completed: Give the Head of Warden Stillwater to Master Apothecary Lydon at the Sludge Fields in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 暮光海滩
text.objectives: 跟暴风城港口的法戈·弗林特洛克谈一谈。
text.description: 时候到了，$c。暴风城已经安全了，我们要让敌人付出代价。向高地进军！$B$B我们海军的主力部队已经出航了，多亏了你之前的努力。不过法戈·弗林特洛克已经准备好了一艘水上飞机，可以把你带过去。$B$B去港口跟弗林特洛克谈一谈，告诉他你会和他一起去高地。他就在岸边。一路平安，$n。
text.completion: A ride to the Highlands, then? I've just the thing! I'll make room for yeh in me seaplane. I'll have to ditch the cat-food I was packing, yeh know, in case we crash in the mountains and ain't rescued fer weeks. On second thought, jes' keep the cat food on yer lap, aye.
text.completed: 跟暮光高地滩头堡的库德兰·蛮锤谈一谈。

english.title: Twilight Shores
english.objectives: Speak with Fargo Flintlocke at Stormwind Harbor.
english.description: The time has come, $c. With Stormwind secure, we will take this fight to the enemy. To the Highlands!$B$BThe bulk of our navy has already shipped out, thanks to your work earlier. But Fargo Flintlocke has prepared a seaplane that can make the journey in double-time.$B$BSpeak with Flintlocke down at the harbor and tell him that you are to accompany him to the Highlands. He will be by the water's edge. Safe journeys, $n.
english.completion: A ride to the Highlands, then? I've just the thing! I'll make room for yeh in me seaplane. I'll have to ditch the cat-food I was packing, yeh know, in case we crash in the mountains and ain't rescued fer weeks. On second thought, jes' keep the cat food on yer lap, aye.
english.completed: Speak with Kurdran Wildhammer at Highbank in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 前往黑齿营地
text.objectives: 跟燃烧平原凿黑齿营地的军需官卡奥辛谈一谈。
text.description: 这件伪装的质量……够粗糙的，不过应该能管用吧。伪装潜入的秘诀就是摆出大摇大摆的模样。你要表现得泰然自若，就没有人会怀疑你。$b$b进入黑齿营地后，直接跟一个叫军需官卡奥辛的兽人取得联络。他不知道你是间谍，所以尽量保持冷静。照他的要求去做。托德曼上校将使用侏儒通讯器向你传达最新指示。$b$b祝你好运，士兵。
text.completion: Where have you been, grunt?  You're late!  Give me one reason why I shouldn't kill you on the spot!

english.title: Into the Black Tooth Hovel
english.objectives: Speak with Quartermaster Kaoshin at the Black Tooth Hovel in Burning Steppes.
english.description: This isn't really the most... convincing disguise I've seen, but it'll work.  Undercover work is all about swagger, anyhow.  Just act like you're supposed to be there, and you'll be fine.$b$bYour contact inside Black Tooth Hovel will be an orc by the name of Quartermaster Kaoshin.  He does NOT know you're a spy, so try and stay cool.$b$bDo whatever Kaoshin asks you.  Colonel Troteman will be in touch via gnomecorder to give you any special instructions.$b$bGood luck out there, soldier.
english.completion: Where have you been, grunt?  You're late!  Give me one reason why I shouldn't kill you on the spot!

text.title: Tapped Out
text.objectives: Harrison Jones wants you to talk to him again in a week or two.
text.description: Listen, $n.$b$bYou know I live to entertain you, and that I strive to keep you pleasantly occupied and whatnot.$b$bBut it just so happens that I've completely run out of ideas.$b$bThat was it!$b$bUsusally as I'm questing with you I can think of a few things to have you do next, which buys me time to cook up some grand objective, but no more.$b$bI'm tapped out. Completely uninspired. Couldn't muster up another idea to save my life.$b$bOh, wait!I know what we can do!$b$bTalk to me in a week or two...

english.title: Tapped Out
