english.objectives: Harrison Jones wants you to talk to him again in a week or two.
english.description: Listen, $n.$b$bYou know I live to entertain you, and that I strive to keep you pleasantly occupied and whatnot.$b$bBut it just so happens that I've completely run out of ideas.$b$bThat was it!$b$bUsusally as I'm questing with you I can think of a few things to have you do next, which buys me time to cook up some grand objective, but no more.$b$bI'm tapped out. Completely uninspired. Couldn't muster up another idea to save my life.$b$bOh, wait!I know what we can do!$b$bTalk to me in a week or two...

text.title: 暮光的幻象
text.objectives: 在黑色裂口寻找暮光之眼。
text.description: 古加尔利用那些有趣的魔法宝珠“暮光之眼”来观察爪牙们的动向。$B$B如果我要是能弄到一颗。希望我们能透过宝珠，窥探古加尔巢穴的动静，给我弄一颗来。$B$B从这里向东，在河流的北方，去黑色裂口寻找暮光之眼。无论如何，都要把它带回来给我！
text.completion: <The Eye sits before you, humming ominously with dark energies.>$B$B<Without warning, the orb rotates, as if to look at you. You sense a malevolent presence, as though the orb is alive.>
text.completed: 在黑色裂口寻找暮光之眼。

english.title: A Vision of Twilight
english.objectives: Locate an Eye of Twilight within the Black Breach.
english.description: Cho'gall keeps track of his minions through these funny magical balls: "The Eyes of Twilight."$B$BIf I could get me hands on one of those, I bet we could use it to look in on Cho'gall and see what his creeps are up to. Get me one!$B$BSearch the Black Breach, east of here and just north of the river. Find me an Eye of Twilight, and do whatever you gotta do to bring it back here.
english.completion: <The Eye sits before you, humming ominously with dark energies.>$B$B<Without warning, the orb rotates, as if to look at you. You sense a malevolent presence, as though the orb is alive.>
english.completed: Locate an Eye of Twilight within the Black Breach.

text.title: 献祭总是必须的
text.objectives: 击败10名漆黑萨满。
text.description: <暮光之眼的“声音”在你四周回荡，仿佛它来自四面八方。>$B$B你想借用我的视域，$r？那就得付出代价。暮光教徒一直献祭蛮锤矮人的精华以示诚意，但我还是很饿。或许你可以做得更好。$B$B击败我的旧主子，我的视域就属于你。献上漆黑萨满的精华吧。精华就是精华。
text.completion: Ah, the succulent thrill of life extinguished. Do you feel it, $c? Do you relish it as I do? No, I see not. You fight to protect the lives of others. Pity.
text.completed: Return to the Eye of Twilight within the Black Breach in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: We All Must Sacrifice
english.objectives: Slay 10 Shaman of the Black.
english.description: <The eye speaks to you, its 'voice' reverberating as if coming from everywhere at once.>$B$BYou seek my sight, $r? My powers come at a price. These disciples of the twilight have been honoring me with the blood of Wildhammer dwarves from the nearby ruins, but still I thirst. Perhaps you can do better.$B$BSlay my old masters, and my vision is yours. Honor me with the slaughter of the Shaman of the Black. Blood is blood, after all.
english.completion: Ah, the succulent thrill of life extinguished. Do you feel it, $c? Do you relish it as I do? No, I see not. You fight to protect the lives of others. Pity.
english.completed: Return to the Eye of Twilight within the Black Breach in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 魔眼的提议
text.objectives: 将暮光之眼带给暮光高地桑德玛尔的低阶萨满布朗迪。
text.description: 非常好，$r。我坚贞地侍奉你。把我带到桑德玛尔的“低阶萨满”那儿去。$B$B哦，是的，我已经知道你要把我交给谁了。布朗迪粗手笨脚、一身酒气，根本不值一提。可是你——你却让我着迷，$r。想想看，我的远见加上你的能力，携起手来，我们就能在这个可悲的世界里横行……
text.progress: You again? Wot? You bring me somethun'?
text.completion: You found one? A gen-u-ine Eye of Twilight? Lemme see. Oh Gods. It's lookin' at me. It's lookin' right back! I need a drink. Can you face that thing toward the wall or somethin'?
text.completed: 将暮光之眼带给暮光高地桑德玛尔的低阶萨满布朗迪。

english.title: The Eyes Have It
english.objectives: Take the Eye of Twilight to Low Shaman Blundy at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.
english.description: Very well then, $r. You have purchased my services in blood. Take me back to the "Low Shaman" of Thundermar.$B$BOh yes, I already know where you're taking me. Blundy's meager, ale-soaked abilities are trivial. But you - you fascinate me, $r. With my sight and your abilities, imagine the havoc we could unleash into this pathetic world together...
english.progress: You again? Wot? You bring me somethun'?
english.completion: You found one? A gen-u-ine Eye of Twilight? Lemme see. Oh Gods. It's lookin' at me. It's lookin' right back! I need a drink. Can you face that thing toward the wall or somethin'?
english.completed: Take the Eye of Twilight to Low Shaman Blundy at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 间谍魔眼
text.objectives: 按低阶萨满布朗迪的要求窥视暮光之眼。
text.description: 我老实说吧，$n。那东西让我起鸡皮疙瘩，但看在你费那么大劲把它带来，我想咱们还是让它派点用场吧。$B$B你先来。$B$B盯着眼睛，让它显示古加尔的暮光堡垒内部。我们得弄明白那两个脑袋的胖混球打算干什么，然后再来对付他。
text.completion: What did you see, $n? Cho'gall? Wait - he saw YOU!? Oh aye, that wee sneaky eye! It looks both ways. That cheeky looker! Where's me hammer!?
text.completed: Talk to Low Shaman Blundy at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Eye Spy
english.objectives: Peer into the Eye of Twilight for Low Shaman Blundy.
english.description: I'll be honest, $n. That thing gives me the willy-willies. But seein' as you went to all the trouble of bringin' it here, I s'pose we ought to put it to use.$B$BYou first.$B$BPeer into the eye and ask it to show you inside Cho'gall's Bastion of Twilight. We'll find out what that fat two-headed bugger is up to, and use it against him.
english.completion: What did you see, $n? Cho'gall? Wait - he saw YOU!? Oh aye, that wee sneaky eye! It looks both ways. That cheeky looker! Where's me hammer!?
english.completed: Talk to Low Shaman Blundy at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 苦力
text.objectives: 用力擦拭7双黑石战靴。
text.description: 呸！今天我正好缺人手，你太幸运了。不干的话，我这一整周都会让你背黑锅。$b$b官员和高阶士兵需要擦鞋服务。他们的靴子就放在营帐前。$b$b我要能从鞋面上看见我的倒影，步兵！赶紧干活去！
text.completion: Hmph.  Good work, grunt.
text.completed: Return to Quartermaster Kaoshin at Black Tooth Hovel in Burning Steppes.

english.title: Grunt Work
english.objectives: Vigorously polish 7 pairs of Blackrock Boots.
english.description: Bah!  You're lucky I'm short-handed today.  Otherwise I'd make you my personal whipping $g boy: girl; for the week.$b$bThe officers and high-ranking soldiers need their boots polished.  They've left them out in front of their huts.$b$bI want to see my reflection in those boots, grunt!  Get to work!
english.completion: Hmph.  Good work, grunt.
english.completed: Return to Quartermaster Kaoshin at Black Tooth Hovel in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 战略偷袭
text.objectives: 对灰烬之柱顶端的巫毒师提曼，座狼兽栏处的座狼驭手欧萨娜以及巡逻到熔岩池附近的格尔洛普使用尖利的毒蝎钩刺。
text.description: <静电干扰声>$n……$n，听得见吗？是我，托德曼。$B$B听着，我们刚刚收到有关下一项任务的情报。你需要解决三名目标人物。第一，巫毒师提曼，你可以在灰烬之柱顶端找到他。第二，座狼驭手欧萨娜，他就在中央区域的座狼兽栏处。第三，南面熔岩池附近的格尔洛普。$b$b在你的背包里找到毒蝎钩刺。找准时机下手吧。
text.completion: Not only did you pull off the executions, you made them all look like accidents! You were the right $r for this undercover work.  Good job, soldier.
text.giverWindow: 准备好采取行动了么？我已经准备好了。
text.turninWindow: 你用起这种武器来很顺手，孩子。

english.title: Strategic Cuts
english.objectives: Use the Razor-Sharp Scorpid Barb on Voodooist Timan atop the Pillar of Ash, Worgmistress Othana in the worg pens, and Gorlop when he is near the lava pools.
english.description: <Static> $n... $n, can you hear me?  It's Troteman.$b$bListen, we've just received the final bit of intel for your next mission.  There are three marks that we'd like you to take down.  The first is Voodooist Timan, whom you'll find atop the Pillar of Ash.  Worgmistress Othana is in the central worg pens.  Finally, Gorlop is near the lava pools to the south.$b$bYou will find the scorpid barbs you harvested packed along with your belongings.  Use the barbs on the marks when the time is right.
english.completion: Not only did you pull off the executions, you made them all look like accidents! You were the right $r for this undercover work.  Good job, soldier.
english.giverWindow: Ready for some assassinations?  I know I am.
english.turninWindow: You're pretty handy with a stinger, kid.

text.title: 最后的血脉
text.objectives: 杀死欧比斯迪。
text.description: 欧比斯迪是能够延续黑龙军团血脉的最后一头成年巨龙。必须把她给杀掉。$B$B如果你成功地杀掉了她，就马上把捷报传给莉拉斯塔萨。她常年征战，就是为了能够看到这一天。$B$B谢谢你在战斗中为我们出力。你是一个强大的盟友。
text.completion: You killed Obsidia within her own lair? Impressive, $r. I'm sorry that I could not be there. You're true to your word, and you most certainly have the bite to back your bellow. Thank you.
text.completed: 跟暮光高地黑曜石森林西北边的莉拉斯塔萨谈一谈。
text.giverWindow: 艾泽拉斯最后一条母黑龙。

english.title: Last of Her Kind
english.objectives: Kill Obsidia.
english.description: Obsidia is one of the last mature dragons that can continue the black dragonflight bloodline. She must be killed.$B$BIf you succeed in killing her, you should inform Lirastrasza immediately of your victory. She's been fighting a long time to see this done.$B$BThank you for being our fang in these battles. You've proven a powerful ally.
english.completion: You killed Obsidia within her own lair? Impressive, $r. I'm sorry that I could not be there. You're true to your word, and you most certainly have the bite to back your bellow. Thank you.
english.completed: Speak to Lirastrasza just northwest of the Obsidian Forest in Twilight Highlands.
english.giverWindow: One of the last breeding black dragons in all of Azeroth.

text.title: 胜利者岗哨
text.objectives: 跟胜利者岗哨的库德兰·蛮锤谈一谈。
text.description: 你所做的一切证明了你的意图和能力。现在我们拿下了格瑞姆巴托，剿灭了黑龙，暮光之锤就被困在了他们的堡垒里。$B$B去找你的首领们。你可以在西北边的胜利者岗哨找到他们。让他们知道开始攻打暮光堡垒的时候，红龙将会遮天蔽日。或许你无法抵偿你的盟友所犯下的所有罪行，但在这场战斗中，我们会站在你们一边。$B$B暮光之锤必将失败。
text.completion: You've done well, $n. We're in the process of preparing the attack now.

english.title: Victors' Point
english.objectives: Speak to Kurdran Wildhammer at Victor's Point.
english.description: You've more than proved your intent and your abilities. With Grim Batol cut off and the black dragons routed, the Twilight's Hammer are cornered in their Citadel.$B$BGo to your leaders. You should find them northwest, at Victors' Point. Let them know that when the attack on the Twilight Citadel begins, the red flight shall fill the skies above. You may not be able to atone for all of the sins your allies have committed, but in this one battle, we shall be by your side.$B$BThe Twilight's Hammer will fall.
english.completion: You've done well, $n. We're in the process of preparing the attack now.

text.title: 粉碎者据点
text.objectives: 跟粉碎者据点的督军扎伊拉谈一谈。
text.description: 你所做的一切远远不限于证明了你的意图和你的能力。现在我们拿下了格瑞姆巴托，剿灭了黑龙，暮光之锤就被困在了他们的堡垒里。$B$B去找你的首领们。你可以在西边的粉碎者据点找到他们。让他们知道开始攻打暮光堡垒的时候，红龙将会遮天蔽日。或许你无法抵偿你的盟友所犯下的所有罪行，但在这场战斗中，我们会站在你们一边。$B$B暮光之锤必将失败。
text.completion: You've done well, $n. We're in the process of preparing the attack now.

english.title: Crushblow
english.objectives: Speak to Warlord Zaela at Crushblow.
english.description: You've more than proved your intent and your abilities. With Grim Batol cut off and the black dragons routed, the Twilight's Hammer are cornered in their Citadel.$B$BGo to your leaders. You should find them west, at Crushblow. Let them know that when the attack on the Twilight Citadel begins, the red flight shall fill the skies above. You may not be able to atone for all of the sins your allies have committed, but in this one battle, we shall be by your side.$B$BThe Twilight's Hammer will fall.
english.completion: You've done well, $n. We're in the process of preparing the attack now.

text.title: 行窃的宵小
text.objectives: 用塔赫莱特王朝之槌猛砸30个沙漠俾格米人。
text.description: 我这儿的工作都不大上台面。$B$B我不大关心战争啦、奥丹姆大厅的奥秘啦之类的事情。$B$B我负责这片地方……这地方长枣子。$B$B现在，这些偷枣子的小兔崽子胆大包天，居然垒成人墙想偷我宝贵的果子。$B$B我不能容忍这样的行为。$B$B拿上这柄泰坦制造、太阳王祝福、天知道还有谁搞过别的什么花样的槌子，去把那些矮子给砸扁！
text.completion: You showed those thieving little scoundrels!  Great job.
text.completed: Return to Nomarch Teneth at the Tahret Grounds.

english.title: Thieving Little Pluckers
english.objectives: Smash 30 Sand Pygmies with the Tahret Dynasty Mallet.
english.description: I don't have the most glamorous job in the world.$B$BI do not concern myself with matters of war or the deep mysteries of the halls of Uldum or what have you.$B$BI am in charge of these grounds... and these grounds grow dates.$B$BNow, these little date-plucking mongrels have gotten gutsy enough to stand on each other's shoulders to try and steal my precious fruit.$B$BI will not stand for this.$B$BTake this mallet, crafted by the titans, blessed by the sun-kings and who-knows-what-else and smash the runts!
english.completion: You showed those thieving little scoundrels!  Great job.
english.completed: Return to Nomarch Teneth at the Tahret Grounds.

text.title: 南海镇的麻烦
text.objectives: 跟希尔斯布莱德丘陵南海镇废墟的瑟尔格·希诺特谈一谈。
text.description: 被俘之前，我是驻守南海镇的炼金师。我的首要任务是在废墟收集软泥怪样本，并确保瘟疫得以安全地传播开来。要不是狼人不断地跑来滋事，我早就完成任务了。$B$B我要你前往南海镇，找到我的学徒瑟尔格·希诺特。确保他一切安好，并转告他等这里的工作一结束我就回去。$B$B南海镇废墟就在东南方的海滩附近。
text.completion: The worgen situation hasn't gotten any better and Helcular is really creeping me out.

english.title: Trouble at Southshore
english.objectives: Speak to Serge Hinott at the Ruins of Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills.
english.description: Before my capture and imprisonment, I was stationed at Southshore. My primary job at the ruins was to take slime samples and make sure that the blight that we released was safely dissipating. Simple and easy if not for the worgen that would continuously harass us.$B$BI need you to head to Southshore and find my apprentice, Serge Hinott. Make sure that he's ok and inform him that I will return once my work here has concluded.$B$BYou'll find the Ruins of Southshore to the southeast, near the coast.
english.completion: The worgen situation hasn't gotten any better and Helcular is really creeping me out.

text.title: 科多兽召唤者号角
text.objectives: 使用召唤者号角召唤7匹黑石作战科多兽返回营地。如果哪只科多兽怀有敌意，就迫使它屈服。
text.description: 好吧，我有一项合法并且重要的任务要交代你。我们要唤回南面草场上的科多兽。索基佐格将军很快就要带领军队前往赤脊山。要是没有科多兽载我，我会掉队的。$b$b靠近科多兽并吹响这支号角，它就会主动返回营地了。$b$b你得仔细点。科多兽的脾气有时候会不太好，揍它们一顿就会听话了。

english.title: The Kodocaller's Horn
english.objectives: Use the Horn of the Callers to call 7 Blackrock War Kodos back to camp.  If a kodo turns hostile, fight it until it submits.
english.description: Alright, I've got some actual, legitimate, important work for you.  We've got to call the kodos in from the grazing lands to the south.  General Thorg'izog says we'll be moving out into Redridge soon, and I won't be caught with my kodos down.$b$bUse this horn near a kodo.  It will return to the camp when it hears the call.$b$bYou'll want to watch out.  Sometimes the kodos get a little feisty, so you need to knock them around a bit before they listen to you.

objectiveDetails.description: 将黑石作战科多兽召唤回营地

text.title: 物归己用
text.objectives: 将召唤者号角还给燃烧平原凿握据点的托德曼上校。
text.description: $n，是我，托德曼。我要你保管好那支号角。我认为我们可以临时想出个办法，把它应用到我们的计划当中。$b$b我非常关心卡奥辛所说的进攻赤脊山到底是怎么回事。虽然新一轮的进攻迫在眉睫，但是我们很多天的时间表都已经排满了。$b$b将号角带回来给我。我在凿握据点等你，到时候详谈。对了，保管好你的伪装。间谍任务还没有完呢。
text.progress: Welcome back, soldier.
text.completion: I didn't count on obtaining an item like this.  I will change our plans accordingly.
text.completed: Report to Colonel Troteman at Chiselgrip in Burning Steppes.
text.giverWindow: 这样一支号角可不仅仅能对科多兽起作用……

english.title: Taking the Horn For Ourselves
english.objectives: Bring the Horn of the Callers back to Colonel Troteman at Chiselgrip in Burning Steppes.
english.description: $n, it's Troteman.  I want you to hold onto that horn.  I'm sure we can improvise and find a way to work it into the plan.$b$bI'm more than a little concerned about what Kaoshin said about attacking Redridge.  We knew another attack was imminent, but our timetables were off by several days.$b$bReturn to me, with the horn.  We will talk again here, in Chiselgrip.  And try not to ruin that disguise.  You're not done with your undercover work yet.
english.progress: Welcome back, soldier.
english.completion: I didn't count on obtaining an item like this.  I will change our plans accordingly.
english.completed: Report to Colonel Troteman at Chiselgrip in Burning Steppes.
english.giverWindow: A horn like that will work on more than just kodos...

text.title: 困境中的针芒
text.objectives: 跟燃烧平原凿握据点的萨拉隆·巨钉谈一谈。
text.description: 就凭我们俩是不可能跟大军抗衡的，$n。直接就被碾压了。因此我们必须严格执行托德曼的计划。$b$b接下来的部分就需要耐心和细致了……我可不擅长，所以要你亲自来。$b$b跟镇上的裁缝萨拉隆·巨钉谈一谈。我已经将收集到的兽皮和泥土交给他了。他要为你测量一下身围。$b$b没错，$n：你需要一件伪装。
text.completion: You need a disguise?  Well, you came to the right place, honey. Let me take a look... mm-hmm.  I know exactly what we'll do.

english.title: A Needle in a Hellhole
english.objectives: Speak with Thelaron Direneedle at Chiselgrip in Burning Steppes.
english.description: You and I can't take on an army, $n.  They'll overwhelm us.  That's why we've got to stick to Troteman's plan.$b$bThe next part of the plan is going to require a bit of subtlety... something that I'm not terribly good at.  That's where you come in.$b$bSpeak with Thelaron Direneedle, the tailor here in town.  I've already given him the hides and mud that we've collected.  He's going to need to size you.$b$bThat's right, $n: you're going undercover.
english.completion: You need a disguise?  Well, you came to the right place, honey. Let me take a look... mm-hmm.  I know exactly what we'll do.

text.title: Vhat's Next?
text.objectives: Commander Schnottz just wants a hug...
text.description: Vhich vay vill zhings turn out? Hmm?$b$bVill I turn on my dark master, whoever zhat might be?$b$bVill I learn to become a more sensitif and compassionate leader? Vill I go so far as to drop my adorable dialect?$b$bOr vill I embrace my aspirations and press forvard at all costs, never satisfied until all of Azerozh is mine?$b$bAnd vhat zhen, hmm?$b$bMaybe it vill all come togezher next veek...$b$b...or maybe zhe veek after zhat...

english.title: Vhat's Next?
english.objectives: Commander Schnottz just wants a hug...
english.description: Vhich vay vill zhings turn out? Hmm?$b$bVill I turn on my dark master, whoever zhat might be?$b$bVill I learn to become a more sensitif and compassionate leader? Vill I go so far as to drop my adorable dialect?$b$bOr vill I embrace my aspirations and press forvard at all costs, never satisfied until all of Azerozh is mine?$b$bAnd vhat zhen, hmm?$b$bMaybe it vill all come togezher next veek...$b$b...or maybe zhe veek after zhat...

objectiveDetails.description: Schnottz can't wait to see what happens next...

text.title: 古尔丹之颅
text.objectives: 重温伊利丹夺走古尔丹之颅一战。
text.description: 伊利丹打算寻找古尔丹之颅。他从恶魔大军中杀出一条血路，用让他被人所憎恨流放的力量，拿到了宝物。$B$B看看他是如何作战的，$c。看着那人是如何同费伍德森林的堕落奋力而战，并将其源头一举消灭的。
text.completion: Now you are beginning to see...
text.completed: 去找费伍德森林的费隆纳斯·罪行者。

english.title: The Skull of Gul'dan
english.objectives: Relive Illidan's battle for the Skull of Gul'dan.
english.description: Illidan set out to find the Skull of Gul'dan. He fought through armies of demons to reach it, slaying them with the power that made him a hated outcast.$B$BSee him in battle, $c. Witness the one that fought the fiercest against the corruptors of Felwood, and struck at its source.
english.completion: Now you are beginning to see...
english.completed: Return to Feronas Sindweller in Felwood.

text.title: 提克迪奥斯的灭亡
text.objectives: 重温伊利丹同提克迪奥斯一战。
text.description: 是的，伊利丹将古尔丹之颅的力量据为己有。$B$B但他有没有带着它遁入黑夜？他有没有为了私欲而使用？不……他做的第一件事，就是用新的力量去攻打恐惧魔王提克迪奥斯！$B$B目睹他的胜利，$c。看看伊利丹是如何从恶魔手中收复费伍德森林的……看看他为此都得到了怎样的报答。
text.completion: Do you see now? For doing what was needed to drive the demons from these lands, my master was banished.$B$BNow these druids pick up the pieces, patting themselves on the back for scrubbing the remaining vestiges of the legion's forces.$b$BBut that is not why I killed them.
text.completed: 去找费伍德森林的费隆纳斯·罪行者。
text.giverWindow: 纳斯雷兹姆的首领，费伍德森林的污染者。

english.title: The Fall of Tichondrius
english.objectives: Relive Illidan's battle with Tichondrius.
english.description: Yes, Illidan took the power of the Skull of Gul'dan for himself.$B$BBut did he flee with it into the night? Did he use it for his own glory? No... his very first action was to use his new power to assault the dreadlord Tichondrius!$B$BWitness his triumph, $c. Witness how Illidan reclaimed Felwood from the demons... and the thanks he was given.
english.completion: Do you see now? For doing what was needed to drive the demons from these lands, my master was banished.$B$BNow these druids pick up the pieces, patting themselves on the back for scrubbing the remaining vestiges of the legion's forces.$b$BBut that is not why I killed them.
english.completed: Return to Feronas Sindweller in Felwood.
english.giverWindow: Leader of the Nathrezim and corruptor of Felwood.

text.title: 与西格妮达·硬炉碰面
text.objectives: 跟暴风城训练大厅的西格妮达·硬炉谈一谈。
text.description: 西格妮达·硬炉捎来口信。她要你尽快前往暴风城旧城区的训练大厅找她。听上去很紧急，$n。
text.completion: It's good to see you again, $n. I wish I could say that I had happy news.
text.completed: 跟暴风城训练大厅的西格妮达·硬炉谈一谈。

english.title: Meet with Ander Germaine
english.objectives: Speak with Ander Germaine at the Command Center south of Stormwind's Old Town.
english.description: Ander Germaine sent a message for you. He wants you to join him at his headquarters in the Command Center in Stormwind's Old Town as quickly as you can. It sounded important, $n.
english.completion: It's good to see you again, $n. I wish I could say that I had happy news.
english.completed: Speak with Ander Germaine at the Command Center south of Stormwind's Old Town.

text.title: 与艾芙琳·索恩碰面
text.objectives: 跟暴风城训练大厅的艾芙琳·索恩谈一谈。
text.description: 我收到一份来自暴风城艾芙琳·索恩的卷轴。她要你去暴风城的训练大厅找她。她没有说找你干嘛，但我觉得肯定是有什么要紧事吧。
text.completion: I see you received my message. An opportunity has presented itself, $n, one which will allow us to demonstrate just how important we are to the success of Stormwind and the Alliance.
text.completed: 跟暴风城训练大厅的艾芙琳·索恩谈一谈。

english.title: Meet with Demisette Cloyce
english.objectives: Speak with Demisette Cloyce in the basement of the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind's Mage District.
english.description: I just received a scroll from Demisette Cloyce in Stormwind. She wants you to pay a visit to the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind. She doesn't mention specifics, but I got the impression that it was a matter of some importance.
english.completion: I see you received my message. An opportunity has presented itself, $n, one which will allow us to demonstrate just how important we are to the success of Stormwind and the Alliance.
english.completed: Speak with Demisette Cloyce in the basement of the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind's Mage District.

text.title: 与达格伦·钢脊碰面
text.objectives: 跟暴风城训练大厅的达格伦·钢脊谈一谈。
text.description: 暴风城的达格伦·钢脊捎来口信——要你立即去见他。他会在暴风城旧城区的训练大厅等你。
text.completion: I'll be brief, $n. Our enemies are gathering and Stormwind needs our help.
text.completed: 跟暴风城训练大厅的达格伦·钢脊谈一谈。

english.title: Meet with Wulf Hansreim
english.objectives: Speak with Wulf Hansreim in the Command Center to the south of Stormwind's Old Town.
english.description: Wulf Hansreim sends word from Stormwind -- he wants to meet with you right away. He'll be in the Command Center just to the south of Stormwind's Old Town.
english.completion: I'll be brief, $n. Our enemies are gathering and Stormwind needs our help.
english.completed: Speak with Wulf Hansreim at the Command Center south of Stormwind's Old Town.

text.title: 混迹在我们当中的骗子
text.objectives: 在碧火小径杀死12名碧火变形者。
text.description: 现在你学会了要消除成见，或许你就能明白我为什么要杀掉那些德鲁伊。$B$B答案很简单：他们根本不是德鲁伊。$B$B恶魔如今表面上伪装成友好的保护者，依然游荡在废墟中。你自己看吧……这幅眼罩被恶魔的血浸过。到北边碧火小径的山丘那里戴上它。就算是天大的傻瓜，用它也能看到任何恶魔的真面目。
text.completion: Enough! Your enthusiasm is impressive, but foolish. Gazing through the veil for too long without practice will break your mind.$B$BThe rest will be mine, $n. For now, I summon you back to me.
text.completed: Return to Feronas Sindweller in Felwood.
text.turninWindow: 初次使用的时间不要太长。

english.title: Deceivers In Our Midst
english.objectives: Slay 12 Jadefire Shifters in Jadefire Run.
english.description: Now that you've had a lesson in keeping an open mind, perhaps you'd like to learn WHY I killed those druids.$B$BThe answer is simple: They are not druids at all.$B$BDemons still roam the ruins, now hiding in plain sight in the guise of friendly caretakers. See for yourself...this blindfold is soaked in demon blood. Take it north up the hills to Jadefire Run and place it on your eyes. It will show even the most oblivious fool the true nature of any demon.
english.completion: Enough! Your enthusiasm is impressive, but foolish. Gazing through the veil for too long without practice will break your mind.$B$BThe rest will be mine, $n. For now, I summon you back to me.
english.completed: Return to Feronas Sindweller in Felwood.
english.turninWindow: Do not drink too deep the first time.

text.title: 与薇卢卡·暗流碰面
text.objectives: 跟暴风城训练大厅的薇卢卡·暗流谈一谈。
text.description: 暴风城军情七处的高阶潜行者训练师薇卢卡·暗流捎来口信，说想跟你谈谈。尽快前往暴风城吧，你可以在旧城区南边的训练大厅找到她。
text.completion: Welcome, $n. We have much to discuss.
text.completed: 跟暴风城训练大厅的薇卢卡·暗流谈一谈。

english.title: Meet with Lord Tony Romano
english.objectives: Speak with Ander Germaine at the Command Center south of Stormwind's Old Town.
english.description: Lord Tony Romano, one of the senior rogue trainers in Stormwind's SI:7, has sent word that he wants to speak with you. Head to Stormwind as soon as you can and look for him in the SI:7 building just south of Old Town.
english.completion: Welcome, $n. We have much to discuss.
english.completed: Speak with Lord Tony Romano at SI:7 headquarters south of Stormwind's Old Town.

text.title: 与弗拉兹勒·霜指碰面
text.objectives: 跟暴风城训练大厅的弗拉兹勒·霜指谈一谈。
text.description: 我收到来自暴风城高阶法师训练师弗拉兹勒·霜指的口信。他要你立即赶往暴风城的训练大厅找他。
text.completion: It's good to see you again, $n. Stormwind has need of your skills.
text.completed: 跟暴风城训练大厅的弗拉兹勒·霜指谈一谈。

english.title: Meet with Maginor Dumas
english.objectives: Speak with Maginor Dumas at the Wizard Sanctum in Stormwind's Mage Quarter.
english.description: I just received a message from Maginor Dumas, the senior mage trainer in Stormwind. He's asking you to join him in the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind as soon as you can travel there.
english.completion: It's good to see you again, $n. Stormwind has need of your skills.
english.completed: Speak with Maginor Dumas at the Wizard Sanctum in Stormwind's Mage Quarter.

text.title: 纳瓦雷克斯的诡计
text.objectives: 杀掉假扮大德鲁伊纳瓦雷克斯的恶魔。
text.description: 我已经追踪这些恶魔伪装者很久了，现在终于查到了他们首脑的所在。他正是大德鲁伊纳瓦雷克斯，翡翠议会的领袖。$B$B恶魔用无辜者作为自己的挡箭牌。要是我进入语风林地追杀他，那些被蒙蔽的保护者就会对我不利……但是你！你可以攻其不备。$B$B回到语风林地去。登上德鲁伊高塔，纳瓦雷克斯就在顶端枝桠丛生的房间里。
text.completion: I find it hard to believe everything you say, but the body of that demon is grim proof.$B$BI will order an investigation into the druids at Jadefire Run right away, and make sure my higher-ups know the demon hunter may be content to remain in exile.
text.completed: Return to Huntress Selura at Whisperwind Grove in Felwood.
text.giverWindow: 这里潜藏着一颗恶魔的心。

english.title: Navarax's Gambit
english.objectives: Slay the demon impersonating Arch Druid Navarax.
english.description: I have been preying on these demonic impostors for some time now, and I have finally gleaned the location of their leader. It is none other than Arch Druid Navarax, the leader of the Emerald Circle.$B$BThe demon shields himself with innocents. If I entered Whisperwind Grove to hunt him, I would be set upon by ignorant protectors... but you! You can catch him unaware.$B$BReturn to Whisperwind Grove. Climb the druid tower and you'll find Navarax at the top, in his room amidst the boughs.
english.completion: I find it hard to believe everything you say, but the body of that demon is grim proof.$B$BI will order an investigation into the druids at Jadefire Run right away, and make sure my higher-ups know the demon hunter may be content to remain in exile.
english.completed: Return to Huntress Selura at Whisperwind Grove in Felwood.
english.giverWindow: Inside lurks the heart of a demon.

text.title: 索基佐格将军
text.objectives: 跟索基佐格将军谈一谈。
text.description: 原来卡奥辛远比我预料中的要有用的多嘛，不过他对我们已经没有什么利用价值了。是时候跟索基佐格将军谈谈了。我觉得你已经准备好了。$b$b他是统领燃烧平原地面部队的“三巨头”之一。索基佐格的据点就是西北边的黑石要塞。穿上伪装跟他谈谈。看看你能不能赢得他的信任。如果有进一步的指示，托德曼会联系你的。
text.completion: More outsiders?  What do you want?
text.completed: 向燃烧平原黑石要塞的索基佐格将军报到。

english.title: General Thorg'izog
english.objectives: Speak with General Thorg'izog.
english.description: Kaoshin turned out to be more helpful than I expected, but we're done with him.  It's time you spoke with the General.  I think you're ready.$b$bGeneral Thorg'izog is one of the "big three" that run the ground forces here in Burning Steppes.  He does so from the Blackrock Stronghold to the northwest.  Put on your disguise and go speak with him.  See if you can earn his trust.  Troteman will be in touch, should we need anything further.
english.completion: More outsiders?  What do you want?
english.completed: Report to General Thorg'izog at Blackrock Stronghold in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 熔岩试炼
text.objectives: 跟维莱特·斯普里通克谈一谈，让他释放熔岩之王克洛博。然后击败熔岩之王克洛博。
text.description: 我想我会最大限度地利用眼前的机会。这帮地精佣兵给我的要塞送来了这只巨大的火元素，以此“感谢”我雇佣他们。我在燃烧平原要这种东西做什么？还嫌这里的火不够多啊。$b$b如果你想找活干，就证明自己的实力吧。跟那个地精谈谈，向他的火元素发起挑战。如果你赢了，你就能赢得我的尊重和认可。
text.progress: What's the matter, are you scared?
text.completion: I had a feeling you'd be the one returning to me.  I like your style, soldier.
text.completed: Return to General Thorg'izog at Blackrock Stronghold in Burning Steppes.

english.title: Trial by Magma
english.objectives: Speak with Wyrtle Spreelthonket and ask him to release Magma Lord Kolob.  Then defeat Magma Lord Kolob in battle.
english.description: I suppose I'll make the most of this situation.  These goblin mercenaries brought this enormous fire elemental to my stronghold as a "thank you" for hiring them.  What am I going to do with an elemental here in the steppes?  That's like bringing sand to the beach.$b$bIf you're looking for work, then prove yourself.  Talk to this goblin here, and challenge his elemental to a fight.  The victor earns my respect, and my time.
english.progress: What's the matter, are you scared?
english.completion: I had a feeling you'd be the one returning to me.  I like your style, soldier.
english.completed: Return to General Thorg'izog at Blackrock Stronghold in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 执行队
text.objectives: 同元首司克诺兹交谈。
text.description: 跟我出去，$r。$b$b我有样东西要给你看。
text.completion: So, this Schnottz character is working with Deathwing!? This is even more distressing than you think...
text.completed: Speak to Harrison Jones at Schnottz's Landing.

english.title: Firing Squad
english.objectives: Speak to Commander Schnottz.
english.description: Come out back vizh me, $r.$b$bZhere is somezhink I vould like you to see.
english.completion: So, this Schnottz character is working with Deathwing!? This is even more distressing than you think...
english.completed: Speak to Harrison Jones at Schnottz's Landing.

text.title: 与艾祖尔安碰面
text.objectives: 跟暴风城训练大厅的艾祖尔安谈一谈。
text.description: 暴风城训练大厅的艾祖尔安捎来口信。他要你下次前往暴风城时去拜访他。训练大厅就在暴风城的旧城区。
text.completion: I wish had good news to share with you, $n, but the truth is that I have asked you here because we have need of your talents.
text.completed: 跟暴风城训练大厅的艾祖尔安谈一谈。

english.title: Meet with Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
english.objectives: Speak with Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker at the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind's Cathedral District.
english.description: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker from the Cathedral of the Light in Stormwind has sent a message for you. He wants to speak with you the next time you're in the city. You should be able to find him in the Cathedral District.
english.completion: I wish had good news to share with you, $n, but the truth is that I have asked you here because we have need of your talents.
english.completed: Speak with Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker at the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind's Cathedral District.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

text.title: 去维尔萨尔找我
text.objectives: 哈里森·琼斯要你去维尔萨尔绿洲找他。
text.description: 那么，听好了，$n。$b$b我知道这些方尖石碑同应许约柜有联系，但还不止这些。$b$b这些柜子似乎有某种重要之处——一个关于造物主称之为起源大厅的地方。$b$b现在我们知道这个司克诺兹和他的人同死亡之翼勾搭上了，这件事迫在眉睫，我们得先处理。$b$b我会到北边的维尔萨尔绿洲去等你，要赶快！他们已经赶在我们的前面了！
text.completion: Ahh, glad you could make it. I could use a hand here.

english.title: Meet Me In Vir'sar
english.objectives: Speak to Harrison Jones at the Oasis of Vir'sar.
english.description: So, listen to this, $n.$b$bI knew that these obelisks were linked to the Coffer of Promise, but there's more to it.$b$bThere appears to be something very important about the coffer - something pertaining to a place the Makers called the Halls of Origination.$b$bNow that we know this Schnottz fellow and his crew are in league with Deathwing, it's all the more urgent that we get to it first.$b$bI'll wait for you north of here, at the Oasis of Vir'sar$b$bHurry! They have a head start on us!
english.completion: Ahh, glad you could make it. I could use a hand here.

text.title: 驾驶猎枪！
text.objectives: 与哈里森一起前往维尔萨尔绿洲。
text.description: 好吧，$n，我就快要搞清楚如何激活这最后一座方尖碑了。$b$b只缺最后一点信息，如果我们走运的话，应该可以在现场找到它们。$b$b补给都已经准备就绪。等你准备好了就告诉我。
text.completed: Speak to Harrison at the Oasis of Vir'sar.

english.title: Riding Shotgun!
english.objectives: Accompany Harrison to the Oasis of Vir'sar.
english.description: Alright, $n, I'm very close to learning how to activate the final obelisk.$b$bOnly a few pieces of information are missing and with any luck, we should be able to find them at the site.$b$bThe supplies are all packed up. Let me know when you're ready to go.
english.completed: Speak to Harrison at the Oasis of Vir'sar.

objectiveDetails.description: 与哈里森一起前往绿洲

text.title: 降低产量
text.objectives: 杀死15名司克诺兹挖掘者或司克诺兹监督者。
text.description: 好了，$n，以下是我了解到的情况。$b$b在一个名叫起源大厅的地方的深处，有一台泰坦造的装置。它的用途是在紧急情况下重置艾泽拉斯的所有生命。如果它被激活的话，就会摧毁这个世界上的所有活物！$b$b理论上，它只能在特定的极端情况下使用，但是如果死亡之翼可以腐蚀泰坦的监护者，就可以用箱子中的东西激活那台装置。$b$b到月亮方尖碑去，$n。阻止他们！
text.completion: Good job with Schnottz's men. Sounds like you gave them something to think about. Hopefully it bought us the time we need.
text.completed: 哈里森·琼斯要你去维尔萨尔绿洲找他。

english.title: Reduced Productivity
english.objectives: Kill 15 Schnottz Excavators or Schnottz Overseers.
english.description: Alright, $n, here's what I've learned.$b$bThere's a titan device deep in a place called the Halls of Origination. It's meant to be an emergency reset switch for all life on Azeroth. If activated, it will destroy every living thing in the world!$b$bNow, it's only meant to be used under certain extreme conditions, but if Deathwing is able to corrupt the titan watchers, he could use the contents of the coffer to trigger the device.$b$bGo to the Obelisk of the Moon, $n. Slow them down!
english.completion: Good job with Schnottz's men. Sounds like you gave them something to think about. Hopefully it bought us the time we need.
english.completed: Speak to Harrison Jones at the Oasis of Vir'sar.

objectiveDetails.description: 在月亮方尖碑杀死司克诺兹雇员

text.title: 遗失的拼图
text.objectives: 收集7张古老的镀铜卷轴。
text.description: 只剩下最后一点特定的信息没收集到了。$b$b在填上这些空之后，我们就可以激活最后一座方尖碑，然后，形势就会变成一场与司克诺兹一伙人比赛谁先找到应许约柜的竞赛。$b$b那些蠢货在玩命挖掘这一地区。他们毁掉的东西比他们挖出来的还多！$b$b到方尖碑去搜刮一下他们的战利品，$n。$b$b也许你可以找到我们需要的最后几块拼图呢。
text.progress: Were you able to find anything interesting, $n?
text.completion: Yes... yes... perfect! I'll need some time to make sense of these, but the information is there. Good work, $n!
text.completed: Speak to Harrison at the Oasis of Vir'sar.

english.title: Missing Pieces
english.objectives: Collect 7 Ancient Copper Scrolls.
english.description: There are just a few specific pieces of information that I'm missing.$b$bOnce those blanks are filled, we'll be ready to activate the final obelisk. Then, it'll be a race to discover the Coffer of Promise before Schnottz and his cronies can.$b$bThose fools are excavating this site as fast as they can. They're ruining more than they're looting!$b$bGo to the obelisk and rummage through their booty, $n.$b$bSee if you can find our missing pieces.
english.progress: Were you able to find anything interesting, $n?
english.completion: Yes... yes... perfect! I'll need some time to make sense of these, but the information is there. Good work, $n!
english.completed: Speak to Harrison at the Oasis of Vir'sar.

text.title: 朋友的朋友
text.objectives: 哈里森要你去跟维尔萨尔绿洲的苏拉赫谈一谈。
text.description: 我得打开行李，四下瞧瞧。与此同时，我想让你去见我的一个老朋友。$b$b苏拉赫跟我是老交情了。他是一个值得信赖的人，这种人如今不多了。$b$b你为什么不去找他谈谈呢。
text.completion: Welcome $c! You and I are going to be good friends! I can tell already.

english.title: Friend of a Friend
english.objectives: Harrison wants you to speak to Sullah at Oasis of Vir'sar.
english.description: I need to unpack and look around the area a bit. In the meantime, I have an old friend I'd like you to meet.$b$bSullah and I go way back. He's a man who can be trusted, and that's pretty rare these days.$b$bWhy don't you go on over and introduce yourself.
english.completion: Welcome $c! You and I are going to be good friends! I can tell already.

text.title: 一对帐篷
text.objectives: 陪苏拉赫前往苏拉赫的表演场。
text.description: 瞧瞧你，我的朋友。大冒险让你的神经都绷在了一起！$b$b你需要放松放松。你太紧张了，这样会累垮的。$b$b相信我，我对放松很拿手。$b$b说到帐篷，我记得我管琼斯要过一对，他带来了。$b$b来吧，朋友。跟我一起过去！
text.completion: Here we are, $n! Great things will happen here... magical things!
text.completed: 与苏拉赫的表演场的苏拉赫交谈。

english.title: Two Tents
english.objectives: Accompany Sullah to Sullah's Sideshow.
english.description: Look at you, my friend. This grand adventure of yours has you in knots!$b$bYou need to relax and unwind. You're too tense, and that's just going to tire you out.$b$bTrust me, I know about relaxing!$b$bSpeaking of tents, I see Jonesy brought me the ones I asked for.$b$bCome, friend. Ride with me!
english.completion: Here we are, $n! Great things will happen here... magical things!
english.completed: Speak to Sullah at Sullah's Sideshow.

text.title: 炮弹发射！
text.objectives: 摧毁10艘维尔松补给船。
text.description: 维尔松船坞不断从海上收到补给品，我们必须切断他们的补给线。他们在码头一带部署了防御火炮，不过如果你能控制火炮的话，我们就可以用炮弹摧毁他们的补给船。$B$B到那边去看看你能做些什么吧。记得向我汇报你的进展。
text.completion: Great work on those supply ships, $n!  We knew you would be good for somethin' around here.
text.completed: Report back to Sergeant Gray at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.

english.title: Bombs Away!
english.objectives: Destroy 10 Ghastly Supply Boats.
english.description: The Wellson Shipyard is constantly receiving supplies from offshore and we need to put a stop to it.  They have setup cannons along the docks for defense but if you can make it to them, we can use them to destroy their supply ships.$B$BHead over there and see what you can do.  Report back to me on your progress.
english.completion: Great work on those supply ships, $n!  We knew you would be good for somethin' around here.
english.completed: Report back to Sergeant Gray at Baradin Base Camp when you are done.

text.title: 萨赫特的秘密
text.objectives: 去找奥丹姆观日者山岭南端的萨赫特。
text.description: 听着，$n。在你对我彻底失望之前，我有样东西要给你看。$B$B你瞧，我算不上是个战士。我协调性不好。$B$B我更擅长的是战术思考。$B$B去山岭南边找我，我演示给你看。
text.completion: Aren't they beautiful?

english.title: Salhet's Secret
english.objectives: Find Salhet at the Southern End of the Sunwatcher's Ridge in Uldum.
english.description: Listen, $n.  Before you give up on me, there's something I'd like to show you.$B$BYou see, I'm not much of a fighter.  I'm not very coordinated.$B$BI'm more of a tactical mind.$B$BMeet me at the southern end of the ridge and I'll show you.
english.completion: Aren't they beautiful?

text.title: 战术家萨赫特
text.objectives: 跟萨赫特谈一谈，杀掉30头血吠食腐者。
text.description: 我还是童子军的时候，就想成为一名将军。$B$B我渴望加入军队。但你也看见了，我的战斗技巧实在是不怎么样。$B$B这不是我第一次被派去杀土狼了。事实上，我经常被派到这里来，逐渐和这些狮子成了好朋友，训练它们帮我完成任务。$B$B它们是我的士兵，我会命令它们去消灭土狼军团。看好！
text.completion: Not bad, huh?  Maybe you can put a word in with the high commander. Maybe he'll put us in charge of our own squad!
text.completed: Return to Salhet at Sunwatcher's Ridge in Uldum.

english.title: Salhet the Tactician
english.objectives: Speak to Salhet and slay 30 Bloodsnarl Scavengers
english.description: Ever since I was a cub, I've always wanted to be a general.$B$BI was eager to join the army.  But as you've seen, my combat skills are not all quite there.$B$BThis is not the first time I've been sent to kill hyenas.  As a matter of fact, I get sent here so often, that I've befriended these lions and trained them to do my bidding.$B$BThey are my soldiers and at my command they will slay legions of hyenas.  Watch!
english.completion: Not bad, huh?  Maybe you can put a word in with the high commander. Maybe he'll put us in charge of our own squad!
english.completed: Return to Salhet at Sunwatcher's Ridge in Uldum.

text.title: 我就是法律，我就是鞭子
text.objectives: 对荣耀之地的20名军人使用黑石训诫棒。如果某位军人识破了你的伪装，你必须在他揭发你之前杀死他。
text.description: 我一直在找像你这样优秀而强壮的士兵。我需要有人维持军队的秩序。$b$b兽人、食人魔和巨魔大军正在要塞外操练，准备进攻赤脊山。我的中士们负责监督他们，但是我希望你能参与协助。$b$b带上这根棍棒，用它教训那些不听话的士兵。我才不关心他们有没有犯错或是队伍没站整齐呢，我就是要让他们挨几下打。我要他们集中精神，训练有素并且绝对服从命令。$b$b去吧。
text.completion: I have a feeling we'll be hearing about you and your exploits for a long time, soldier.  I look forward to fighting by your side in Redridge. You are dismissed.
text.completed: Return to General Thorg'izog at Blackrock Stronghold in Burning Steppes.

english.title: I Am the Law and I Am the Lash
english.objectives: Use the Blackrock Cudgel of Discipline on 20 troops in the Fields of Honor.  If one of the troops discovers your disguise, cudgel him to death before he can unmask you.
english.description: I've been looking for a good, strong soldier like you.  I need someone to keep my troops in line.$b$bOutside the stronghold, you will find orcs, ogres, and trolls preparing for the assault on Redridge.  My sergeants keep them in line, but I'd like you to assist them.$b$bTake this cudgel and discipline a few of my soldiers.  I don't care if they're misbehaving or standing perfectly in line, I want them beaten.  I want them focused, battle-hardened, and obedient.$b$bNow go.
english.completion: I have a feeling we'll be hearing about you and your exploits for a long time, soldier.  I look forward to fighting by your side in Redridge. You are dismissed.
english.completed: Return to General Thorg'izog at Blackrock Stronghold in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 滥用权力
text.objectives: 使用黑石训诫棒杀死5名黑石中士。速战速决，在你暴露身份之前杀死他们。
text.description: $n？是我，托德曼。$b$b看来你已经赢得了索基佐格的信任，他连维持军队秩序的这样的重任都交给了你。我们真是幸运得很。$b$b杀掉他手下的中士吧。他们骑着座狼，在荣耀之地的黑石要塞外围巡逻。用那根棍棒猛敲他们，多敲几下，敲死为止。动作要快，一旦他们发现你不是黑石兽人，他们就会揭穿你的真面目。速战速决，下手要狠，$n。$b$b完毕。
text.completion: Without those sergeants, Thorg'izog will be hard-pressed getting his troops ready for battle. Already the dominoes are beginning to fall, $n.
text.giverWindow: 希望伪装不会暴露……

english.title: Abuse of Power
english.objectives: Kill 5 Blackrock Sergeants using the Blackrock Cudgel of Discipline.  Defeat them quickly, before they have a chance to unmask you.
english.description: $n?  Troteman here.$b$bIt sounds like you have earned Thorg'izog's trust, and he's assigned you to discipline duty.  This is fortunate.$b$bWe need you to take out his sergeants.  You'll find them on wolfback, outside of the Blackrock Stronghold in the Fields of Honor.  Use that cudgel on them, several times, until they die.  You'll have to act fast, because if they realize you're not one of them, they can unmask you.  Strike quickly and ferociously, $n.$b$bTroteman out.
english.completion: Without those sergeants, Thorg'izog will be hard-pressed getting his troops ready for battle. Already the dominoes are beginning to fall, $n.
english.giverWindow: I hope that disguise holds together...

text.title: 把它们从天上打下来！
text.objectives: 用肩扛式猎龙炮消灭8头龙喉黑色幼龙。
text.description: 呃啊！他们来了，$n。他们来了！$B$B我本来指望给整支军队配备肩扛式猎龙炮的，可现在我只有一杆极端昂贵、完全没有经过测试的原型。给，交给你了！$B$B把盘旋在桑德玛尔的龙喉黑色幼龙从天上打下来！
text.completion: You did it, $n! Alliance ingenuity to the rescue. Of course, I don't have anything to help you fight the dismounted riders now that they're on the ground. You're a $c; improvise!
text.completed: Return to Nivvet Channelock at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Tear Them From the Sky!
english.objectives: Use the Shoulder-Mounted Drake-Dropper to slay 8 Dragonmaw Black Drakes.
english.description: Egah! They're here, $n. They're here!$B$BI had hoped to equip a whole army with my shoulder-mounted drake-droppers, but all I have is a single, extremely expensive and wholly untested prototype. Here, take it!$B$BShoot the Dragonmaw black drakes that are circling Thundermar, and drop them from the sky!
english.completion: You did it, $n! Alliance ingenuity to the rescue. Of course, I don't have anything to help you fight the dismounted riders now that they're on the ground. You're a $c; improvise!
english.completed: Return to Nivvet Channelock at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 桑德玛尔背水一战
text.objectives: 徒步杀死8名龙喉掠天战士。
text.description: 一切就交给你和你的联盟朋友了。你把龙喉打得好惨！$B$B他们的不少骑士都掉了下来，可还在朝我们进发，没有人帮忙的话，我的防御者是抵挡不住的。$B$B徒步杀死龙喉掠天战士，桑德玛尔会永远记住你的恩情！
text.completion: You sure know your way around a battlefield, $c. It looks like they're about to fall back. All we need is one decisive blow...
text.completed: Return to Colin Thundermar at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Last Stand at Thundermar
english.objectives: Kill 8 Dragonmaw Skyclaws on foot.
english.description: I'll hand it to you and your Alliance friends. You've really worked the Dragonmaw over!$B$BMany of their riders are dismounted but they're still coming at us, and my defenders will be overrun without help.$B$BKill Dragonmaw Skyclaws on foot and Thundermar will forever be in your debt!
english.completion: You sure know your way around a battlefield, $c. It looks like they're about to fall back. All we need is one decisive blow...
english.completed: Return to Colin Thundermar at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 驯龙者纳克拉尔
text.objectives: 杀死纳克拉尔·掠爪。做好准备后就去跟科林·桑德玛尔谈一谈。
text.description: 龙喉兽人的部队中有一个叫做“纳克拉尔：驯龙者”的。我不知道他是怎么有能力控制这些畜生的，但他胯下的黑色恐怖生物是高地的天空中最残忍恶毒的。$B$B$n，就是纳克拉尔这个恶魔夺走了我父亲的生命，让我肩负起了桑德玛尔的命运。$B$B我一个人无法将其击败，但我见过你的能耐，$c。也许我们可以一起把这事做个了结。$B$B你准备好了就告诉我，我们合力对付纳克拉尔！
text.completion: We did it, $n! Narkrall Rakeclaw lies dead at my feet, and Thundermar has weathered a storm of drakes! This wouldn't have been possible if it weren't for the help of the Alliance. I owe you a debt that I don't think can ever be repaid.
text.completed: Speak with Colin Thundermar at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.
text.giverWindow: 你准备好了就告诉我。我会把他从幼龙身上拽下来，但你得帮忙将他干掉……

english.title: Narkrall, The Drake-Tamer
english.objectives: Slay Narkrall Rakeclaw. Speak with Colin Thundermar when you're ready.
english.description: There's one Dragonmaw among this lot, the one they call "Narkrall: The Drake-Tamer." I don't know where he gets his power over those beasts, but the black terror he rides is as nasty a brute as ever took the skies over the Highlands.$B$B$n, Narkrall is the fiend who took my father's life and left Thundermar in my hands.$B$BI can't take him on alone, but I've seen what you're capable of, $c. Maybe together we can end this.$B$BLet me know when you're ready, and we'll fight Narkrall together!
english.completion: We did it, $n! Narkrall Rakeclaw lies dead at my feet, and Thundermar has weathered a storm of drakes! This wouldn't have been possible if it weren't for the help of the Alliance. I owe you a debt that I don't think can ever be repaid.
english.completed: Speak with Colin Thundermar at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.
english.giverWindow: Speak to me when you're ready. I'll get him off his drake, but I'll need your help finishing him off...

text.title: 奇怪的发声装置？
text.objectives: 检查千针石林黑云峰的骨鸣响器。
text.description: 你看见地上那个发光的发声装置了吗？就在伊莎的小屋外。
text.completion: Interesting....

english.title: What's that Rattle?
english.objectives: Inspect the Rattle of Bones on Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles.
english.description: Did you see that glowing rattle on the ground outside of Isha's hut?
english.completion: Interesting....

text.title: 奇怪的发声装置？
text.objectives: 检查千针石林黑云峰的骨鸣响器。
text.description: 你看见地上那个发光的发声装置了吗？就在伊莎的小屋外。
text.completion: Interesting....

english.title: What's that Rattle?
english.objectives: Inspect the Rattle of Bones on Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles.
english.description: Did you see that glowing rattle on the ground outside of Isha's hut?
english.completion: Interesting....

text.title: 与帕崔斯·兰卡斯特碰面
text.objectives: 跟暴风城训练大厅的帕崔斯·兰卡斯特谈一谈。
text.description: 我收到一份来自训练大厅的卷轴，$n。帕崔斯·兰卡斯特说她想跟你谈谈。你最好尽快去见她。
text.completion: The Light has answered my prayers. At last, you have arrived.
text.completed: 跟暴风城训练大厅的帕崔斯·兰卡斯特谈一谈。

english.title: Meet with High Priestess Laurena
english.objectives: Speak with High Priestess Laurena at the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind's Cathedral District.
english.description: I just received a scroll from the Cathedral of Light, $n. High Priestess Laurena sends word that she wishes to speak with you. You should meet with her as soon as you can.
english.completion: The Light has answered my prayers. At last, you have arrived.
english.completed: Speak with High Priestess Laurena at the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind's Cathedral District.

text.title: 见好就收
text.objectives: 向凿握据点的托德曼上校复命。
text.description: 我们没有针对索基佐格或是黑石地面部队的战略措施了。我们必须继续执行计划的下一阶段。$b$b你处理完要塞的事务就返回凿握据点吧。
text.completion: You alright? Good.  You did a fine job out there, $n.  Now pack up your things.  We're moving out of here.
text.completed: 向燃烧平原凿握据点的托德曼上校报到。
text.giverWindow: 你先回家吧，孩子。我们还有事情要做。

english.title: Enough Damage For One Day
english.objectives: Return to Colonel Troteman at Chiselgrip.
english.description: We do not have any further strategic need for Thorg'izog or the Blackrock ground troops.  We must continue to the next phase of the plan.$b$bWhen you are finished at the stronghold, return to us here in Chiselgrip.
english.completion: You alright? Good.  You did a fine job out there, $n.  Now pack up your things.  We're moving out of here.
english.completed: Report to Colonel Troteman at Chiselgrip in Burning Steppes.
english.giverWindow: Head on back home, kid.  We've got more work to do.

text.title: 与穆尔里克·勇石碰面
text.objectives: 跟暴风城训练大厅的穆尔里克·勇石谈一谈。
text.description: 穆尔里克·勇石的信使刚刚来过，$n。他说有重要的事情想跟你商量，希望你尽快前往暴风城，到旧城区的训练大厅里找他。
text.completion: Welcome, $n. We will need your skills in the continuing battle against Twilight's Hammer.
text.completed: 跟暴风城训练大厅的穆尔里克·勇石谈一谈。

english.title: Meet with Farseer Umbrua
english.objectives: Speak with Farseer Umbrua at the Golden Keg in Stormwind's Dwarven District.
english.description: Farseer Umbrua's messenger just reached me, $n. She has an important matter she wishes to discuss with you and sends word that you should meet her at the Golden Keg in the Dwarven District of Stormwind as soon as you can make it there.
english.completion: Welcome, $n. We will need your skills in the continuing battle against Twilight's Hammer.
english.completed: Speak with Farseer Umbrua at the Golden Keg in Stormwind's Dwarven District.

text.title: 开眼
text.objectives: 用德拉莉丝的棱镜吓跑20只碧火小鬼。
text.description: 你走之前……$B$B我利用和伊普斯“独处”的这段时间，了解了很多关于小鬼的有趣事情。尤其是，他告诉我所有的小鬼最怕一件东西。一件能绝对把它们吓坏的东西。$B$B我觉得这听上去不但好玩，而且还很有用，于是我进行了一些基本的制造。这块棱镜可以投射出……这么说吧，伊普斯所描述的那个影像。$B$B匿影山的小鬼依然成群。你为什么不去替我试探一下它们对这东西的反应呢？
text.completion: I see... their eyes are open Maybe I'll keep Impsy around after all. He's got a lot to teach me...
text.completed: Return to Arcanist Delaris at the Ruins of Constellas in Felwood.

english.title: Open Their Eyes
english.objectives: Use Delaris's Prism to terrify 20 Jadefire Imps.
english.description: Before you go...$B$BI've taken advantage of my "alone time" with Impsy here to learn some interesting facts about imps. Specifically, he ended up telling me the one thing that all imps fear most. Something they're absolutely terrified of.$B$BI thought that sounded useful as well as interesting, so I've done some basic conjuring. This prism will project an image of... well, of what Impsy described.$B$BShadowlurk Ridge is still swarming with imps. Why don't you go test their reaction for me?
english.completion: I see... their eyes are open Maybe I'll keep Impsy around after all. He's got a lot to teach me...
english.completed: Return to Arcanist Delaris at the Ruins of Constellas in Felwood.

text.title: 月光林地的召唤
text.objectives: 跟月光林地永夜港的洛甘纳尔谈一谈。
text.description: 我收到消息称，月光林地的兄弟需要你的帮助，$n。你应该前往月光林地，跟永夜港的洛甘纳尔谈谈。他会告诉你一切的。
text.completion: It's good to see you again, $n. I wish I could say that I had happy news.
text.completed: 跟月光林地永夜港的洛甘纳尔谈一谈。

english.title: Moonglade Calls
english.objectives: Travel to Moonglade and speak with Loganaar in Nighthaven.
english.description: I have received word that our brothers in Moonglade have requested your help, $n. You should travel there and speak with Loganaar in Nighthaven. He will tell you all you need to know.
english.completion: It's good to see you again, $n. I wish I could say that I had happy news.
english.completed: Travel to Moonglade and speak with Loganaar in Nighthaven.

text.description: 戈莫克·魔拳送来一条紧急口信，$n。他要你立即前往奥格瑞玛荣誉谷的兵营里找他，有重要的任务要交代你。
text.completion: The Horde has need of your skills, $n.
text.completed: 与奥格瑞玛兵营的戈莫克·魔拳交谈。

english.objectives: Speak with Grezz Ragefist in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.
english.description: Grezz Ragefist sent an urgent message for you, $n. He wants you to join him immediately in Orgrimmar's Valley of Heroes. He must have a mission of importance for you.
english.completion: The Horde has need of your skills, $n.
english.completed: Speak with Grezz Ragefist in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.

text.title: 回到营地
text.objectives: 去找拉穆卡恒军团前哨的高阶指挥官卡姆塞斯。
text.description: 你怎么想，$n？也许高级指挥官会派几个人给我管。$B$B也许我们可以一起指挥一个团。你怎么说？
text.completion: Salhet?  A tactician, you say? Hah!  Very well, if you'll vouch for him, we might be able to arrange something.

english.title: Return to Camp
english.objectives: Return to High Commander Kamses at the Ramkahen Legion post.
english.description: What do you think, $n?  Maybe the High Commander will give me a few men to command.$B$BMaybe we can marshal a regiment together.  What do you think?
english.completion: Salhet?  A tactician, you say? Hah!  Very well, if you'll vouch for him, we might be able to arrange something.

text.title: 那不是金字塔！
text.objectives: 跟暴风城暴风要塞的哈里森·琼斯谈一谈。
text.description: 奥丹姆造物者遗迹内的建筑物根本不是金字塔。它是一台可以任意配置的多用途巨型机器。$B$B死亡之翼本打算让暮光之锤将它改造成一件武器！$B$B$n，你必须穿过传送门，将这个消息告诉暴风城的哈里森·琼斯。他知道该如何处理的。
text.completion: Uldum? What about it?

english.description: That pyramid at the Maker's Terrace in Uldum is nothing of the sort. It's a giant machine that can be reconfigured for any number of uses.$B$BDeathwing was going to have the Twilight's Hammer turn it into a massive weapon!$B$B$n, you have to take the portal to get this information to Harrison Jones in Stormwind. He'll know what to do.
english.completion: Uldum? What about it?

text.title: 库斯海文峰会
text.objectives: 跟暮光高地库斯海文的拉克伦·迈格拉夫谈一谈。
text.description: 我们把龙喉兽人一顿好打，他们对桑德玛尔的进攻理应停止了。也许蛮锤确实该加入你们联盟——我们桑德玛尔欠你的恩情。$B$B在库斯海文，大萨满拉克伦·迈格拉夫想要召集幸存的蛮锤家族首领，举行一次峰会。让我们齐心协力是件很难的事情，但至少我愿意尝试一下。$B$B飞到北边的库斯海文去，跟拉克伦·迈格拉夫谈一谈。我们那里见！
text.completion: Hello, $c! Keegan Firebeard here has told me all about your heroics down south. Thank you for all of your efforts on behalf of the Wildhammer. I see Colin Thundermar is right behind you. The summit is ready to begin! Please stay and let's see how things unfold...
text.completed: 跟暮光高地库斯海文的拉克伦·迈格拉夫谈一谈。

english.title: The Kirthaven Summit
english.objectives: Speak with Lachlan MacGraff at Kirthaven in Twilight Highlands.
english.description: After the licking we just gave 'em, the Dragonmaw assaults on Thundermar ought to stop. Maybe the Wildhammer do have a place in your Alliance - we Thundermars certainly owe you a debt.$B$BUp in Kirthaven, our Grand Shaman Lachlan MacGraff has been trying to arrange a summit between the surviving Wildhammer family leaders. It's a tall order to get us all to work together, but I'm at least willing to give it a go.$B$BFly up to Kirthaven in the North and talk to Lachlan MacGraff. I'll meet you there!
english.completion: Hello, $c! Keegan Firebeard here has told me all about your heroics down south. Thank you for all of your efforts on behalf of the Wildhammer. I see Colin Thundermar is right behind you. The summit is ready to begin! Please stay and let's see how things unfold...
english.completed: Speak with Lachlan MacGraff at Kirthaven in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 与商队碰面
text.objectives: 跟塔纳利斯灌木谷的埃达尔拉谈一谈。
text.description: 奥丹姆造物者遗迹内的金字塔可以被改造成超级武器，其威力足以终结艾泽拉斯的所有生命。$B$B<哈里森思考了一会。>$B$B你必须继续调查。前往位于卡利姆多最南端的塔纳利斯沙漠地带。那里有一支商队正要出发前往奥丹姆。$B$B也许你可以同行。
text.completion: Harrison sent you, hmm? How fortunate!

english.title: Meetup with the Caravan
english.objectives: Speak with Adarrah at Thistleshrub Valley in Tanaris.
english.description: The pyramid inside of the Maker's Terrace in Uldum can be used as some kind of super weapon that will end all life on Azeroth.$B$B<Harrison thinks a moment.>$B$BYou need to continue the research you've begun. Head to the southern end of Kalimdor, to the desert of Tanaris. There's a caravan there that's about to leave for Uldum.$B$BPerhaps you can tag along.
english.completion: Harrison sent you, hmm? How fortunate!

text.objectives: 与奥格瑞玛兵营的阿瓦罗斯·晨刃交谈。
text.description: 阿瓦罗斯·晨刃捎来紧急消息，$n。他要你下次前往奥格瑞玛时，去荣誉谷的兵营里拜访他。听起来他有重要的任务要交给你呢。

text.description: 黑暗牧师塞希莉要你下次前往奥格瑞玛时去拜访她，她是女妖之王派往奥格瑞玛的代表团成员之一。你可以在奥格瑞玛力量谷的格罗玛什要塞中找到她。想必是重要的事情吧，不然也不会直接找你了，$n。
text.completion: Our enemies stir once more, $n, and you will be at the forefront of battle.

You can find her inside Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength. It must be an important matter for her to send for you so directly, $n.
english.completion: Our enemies stir once more, $n, and you will be at the forefront of battle.
english.completed: Speak with Dark Cleric Cecille at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.

text.title: 血毒岗哨的命运
text.objectives: 跟血毒岗哨的柯尔妮·叶歌谈一谈。
text.description: 攻打加德纳尔的时候，我把一个朋友派到北边的血毒岗哨去了。从前那儿的牛头人偶尔会来拜访我们，但最近他们杳无音信。$B$B我的朋友柯尔妮·叶歌也没有回来。你能不能到北边去看看她，还有血毒岗哨的情况？$B$B要是你找到她，可得注意……像她那样的树妖会让其他种族觉得有点奇怪。
text.completion: Oh, hi! Did Farlus send you? I'm so happy he remembered!$B$BBloodvenom Post is all overrun with awful slime thingies, and this poor tauren is the only one left! We've got to help him!

english.title: The Fate of Bloodvenom Post
english.objectives: Speak with Kelnir Leafsong at Bloodvenom Post.
english.description: While we dealt with Jaedenar, I sent a friend of mine north to Bloodvenom Post. We used to have infrequent visits from the tauren there, but they have stopped coming as of late.$B$BMy friend, Kelnir Leafsong, has yet to return. Would you travel north to check on her and the situation at Bloodvenom?$B$BShould you find her, do be aware... dryads like her tend to strike other races as a bit odd.
english.completion: Oh, hi! Did Farlus send you? I'm so happy he remembered!$B$BBloodvenom Post is all overrun with awful slime thingies, and this poor tauren is the only one left! We've got to help him!

text.title: 语风林地
text.objectives: 跟语风林地的树妖纯林谈一谈。
text.description: 你真是帮了大忙！$B$B我会留在这里照看可怜的牛头人先生，直到他吐得不是那么厉害为止。你为什么不到北边的语风林地去呢？那儿真的很漂亮，而且所有的德鲁伊都很友好！$B$B你应该告诉纯林小姐我很好，我离开太久她会担心的。她可能也会让你帮她照料那些花！很有意思的！
text.completion: Kelnir? Hahaha... Sometimes I wonder if her chatter drove all the other dryads away. But I'm glad she is safe. Welcome to Whisperwind Grove, $c. Hold peace in your heart, and you will find a home here.

english.title: Whisperwind Grove
english.objectives: Speak with Tender Puregrove at Whisperwind Grove.
english.description: You've been such a big help here!$B$BI'm gonna stay here a while and look after poor Mr. Tauren until he stops throwing up so much. Why don't you head north to Whisperwind Grove? It's really pretty there, and all the druids are so friendly!$B$BYou should tell miss Puregrove I'm okay, she'll worry if I'm gone too long. She might ask you to help with her flowers, too! So fun!
english.completion: Kelnir? Hahaha... Sometimes I wonder if her chatter drove all the other dryads away. But I'm glad she is safe. Welcome to Whisperwind Grove, $c. Hold peace in your heart, and you will find a home here.

text.title: 奥格瑞玛之行
text.objectives: 与奥格瑞玛兵营的马丁·古尔乔交谈。
text.description: 一位信使请我传递一份邀请，是牧师训练师马丁·古尔乔发来的，他就在奥格瑞玛的兵营里。$B$B他请你在方便时尽快去见他。兵营就在荣誉谷中。
text.completion: The Horde has need of your talents, $n.
text.completed: 与奥格瑞玛兵营的马丁·古尔乔交谈。

english.title: Meet with Tyelis
english.objectives: Speak with Tyelis at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.
english.description: Tyelis, a member of the the Silvermoon delegation to Orgrimmar, has requested to meet with you next time you're in the city. You can find him inside Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength. It must be an important matter for him to send for you so directly, $n.
english.completion: The Horde has need of your talents, $n.
english.completed: Speak with Tyelis at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.

text.title: 奥格瑞玛之行
text.objectives: 与奥格瑞玛兵营的马丁·古尔乔交谈。
text.description: 一位信使请我传递一份邀请，是牧师训练师马丁·古尔乔发来的，他就在奥格瑞玛的兵营里。$B$B他请你在方便时尽快去见他。兵营就在荣誉谷中。
text.completion: The Horde has need of your talents, $n.
text.completed: 与奥格瑞玛兵营的马丁·古尔乔交谈。

english.title: Meet with Seer Liwatha
english.objectives: Speak with Seer Liwatha in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom.
english.description: Seer Liwatha sends her greetings from the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar, $n. She asked me to convey an invitation to visit her next time you're in the city. It sounded like she has something of importance to discuss with you.
english.completion: The Horde has need of your talents, $n.
english.completed: Speak with Seer Liwatha in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom.

text.title: 奥格瑞玛之行
text.objectives: 与奥格瑞玛兵营的马丁·古尔乔交谈。
text.description: 一位信使请我传递一份邀请，是牧师训练师马丁·古尔乔发来的，他就在奥格瑞玛的兵营里。$B$B他请你在方便时尽快去见他。兵营就在荣誉谷中。
text.completion: The Horde be needin' you, $n.
text.completed: 与奥格瑞玛兵营的马丁·古尔乔交谈。

english.title: Meet with Shadow-Walker Zuru
english.objectives: Speak with Shadow-Walker Zuru in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits.
english.description: Shadow-Walker Zuru, a revered priest trainer, has asked to meet with you in Orgrimmar. You can find him in the Valley of Spirits with the other Darkspear trainers. It must be an important matter for him to send for you so directly, $n.
english.completion: The Horde be needin' you, $n.
english.completed: Speak with Shadow-Walker Zuru in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits.

text.title: 摩根的岗哨
text.objectives: 向燃烧平原摩根的岗哨的奥拉留斯报到。
text.description: 在你的大力帮助下，我们在凿握据点的工作结束了。我们将转移到东边的摩根的岗哨去。$b$b情报显示，那里的居民早已去了黑石山对付黑石兽人，岗哨已是空无一人。我们可以去那里设立营地，执行计划的最后一个阶段。$b$b当然，基沙恩和我都会随你同行的。
text.completion: You've arrived!  And just in time for the friendship ceremony! Captain Winky!  Where'd Captain Winky go? No, don't tell me he got cold feet!

english.title: Morgan's Vigil
english.objectives: Report to Oralius at Morgan's Vigil in Burning Steppes.
english.description: Our work here in Chiselgrip is done, mostly thanks to you.  We'll now be moving on to the east, to Morgan's Vigil.$b$bOur intel indicates that Morgan's Vigil has been vacated, as most of its inhabitants have moved into Blackrock Mountain to fight their own battle against the Blackrocks.  It should serve as a sufficient base of operations for the final stages of our plan.$b$bOf course, Keeshan will be joining you on the road.  As will I.
english.completion: You've arrived!  And just in time for the friendship ceremony! Captain Winky!  Where'd Captain Winky go? No, don't tell me he got cold feet!

text.title: 漆黑的灰烬
text.objectives: 收集9堆黑曜石灰烬。
text.description: 在清除黑石大军的余孽之前，我有一项收集任务要交给你。既然要做，就要做好，也就是说我们必须做好充分的准备。$b$b我需要灰烬，$n。不是普通的灰烬……而是黑曜石元素的灰烬，它们就在西北边的平原上游荡。这种灰烬的颜色黝黑，我们需要它来制作下一件伪装。$b$b别担心，你已经有一件伪装啦。新的一件是给其他人……呃，其他生物……穿的。
text.progress: The ashes of the obsidian elementals are particularly dark - exactly what we need for our purposes.
text.completion: Yes, these will do.  I will get this packed up for you.
text.completed: 返回燃烧平原摩根的岗哨，向托德曼上校复命。

english.title: Blackened Ashes
english.objectives: Obtain 9 piles of Obsidian Ash.
english.description: I need you to do some more gathering before we can go take out the remainder of the Blackrock army.  If we're going to do this, we're going to do it right, and that means being prepared.$b$bI need ash, $n.  Not just any ash... ash from the greater obsidian elementals that roam the plains to the northwest.  The stuff is deep, deep black, which is what we need for our next disguise.$b$bDon't worry, you've already got a disguise.  This one is for someone... well, someTHING... else.
english.progress: The ashes of the obsidian elementals are particularly dark - exactly what we need for our purposes.
english.completion: Yes, these will do.  I will get this packed up for you.
english.completed: Return to Colonel Troteman at Morgan's Vigil in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 潜在的恶魔
text.objectives: 收集18个死亡的烈焰小鬼。
text.description: 西边不远处的熔岩层是烈焰小鬼的家园，这种火焰恶魔生活在燃烧平原有段日子了。说到清除黑石大军，如果小心行事的话，我们或许可以利用这些烈焰小鬼潜入敌人后方并制造混乱。$b$b将它们的尸体带回来给我。要复活这些恶魔非常简单，然后它们就能为我们所用了。
text.progress: The flamekin are weak, but they travel in packs.  Be cautious.
text.completion: To the untrained eye, these will look exactly like imps. We just need to get them to that untrained eye.  I'll work on preparing them for delivery.
text.completed: 返回燃烧平原摩根的岗哨，向托德曼上校复命。

english.title: Latent Demons of the Land
english.objectives: Obtain 18 Fallen Flamekin.
english.description: The lava beds nearby - to the west - play host to flamekin, a brand of fire demon that has long roamed the steppes.  Situations are such in the Blackrock army that, if we are careful, we may be able to sneak some of these flamekin behind enemy lines to cause some havoc.$b$bBring me the bodies of several flamekin.  As demons, they are easily resurrected, and then we can use them for our own purposes.
english.progress: The flamekin are weak, but they travel in packs.  Be cautious.
english.completion: To the untrained eye, these will look exactly like imps. We just need to get them to that untrained eye.  I'll work on preparing them for delivery.
english.completed: Return to Colonel Troteman at Morgan's Vigil in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 美味的狼肉
text.objectives: 对巨型灰烬座狼的尸体使用座狼锯肉刀，收集40块座狼肉排。
text.description: 我们需要新鲜的肉，也就是说你得出去猎狼。燃烧平原这一侧的座狼就是你的狩猎目标。$b$b<托德曼将一柄巨刃递给你。>$b$b杀死巨型灰烬座狼，然后用座狼锯肉刀割下最肥美的肉块。燃烧平原上到处都是座狼，最近的一支族群统领着东北方的土地。
text.progress: 运气如何？
text.completion: This meat looks good... but I think it needs a little "seasoning".  I'll make sure that gets taken care of. Thank you, $n.
text.completed: 返回燃烧平原摩根的岗哨，向托德曼上校复命。

english.title: A Heap of Delicious Worg
english.objectives: Use the Worgsaw on the bodies of slain Giant Ember Worgs to obtain 40 Worg Cutlets.
english.description: We're going to need fresh meat, which means you're going to be hunting worg.  The worg on this side of the steppes should be your target.$b$b<Troteman produces a large blade, which he hands to you.>$b$bHunt the giant ember worgs.  Once you've killed them, use this saw to remove the choicest bits of meat from their bodies.  You will find these worgs all over the steppes, but the closest pack rules the land just to our northeast.
english.progress: Any luck out there?
english.completion: This meat looks good... but I think it needs a little "seasoning".  I'll make sure that gets taken care of. Thank you, $n.
english.completed: Return to Colonel Troteman at Morgan's Vigil in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 血之途
text.objectives: 击败25只黑色龙人或是黑色龙族。
text.description: 我的脚怪痒痒的，又想胡闹一场了。你愿意跑一趟吗，$n？$B$B我打算围着巨槌石绕一圈。在我们采取行动之前，我希望能调查一下黑石大军的情况，说不定还能顺手杀上一些呢。
text.completion: That was exactly what I needed.

english.title: Blood Tour
english.objectives: Kill 25 Black Dragonspawn or Black Wyrmkin.
english.description: My legs are getting a little restless again.  You interested in taking a little tour, $n?$b$bWe're going to take a trip around Dreadmaul Rock.  I'd like to investigate some of the Blackrock army before we make our move, and I figure we might as well kill some of them while we're on the way.
english.completion: That was exactly what I needed.

text.title: 黑龙前锋
text.objectives: 杀死米诺尤斯、幼龙驯养人阿库米、灼烧者特洛玛斯和塔格纳尔·血喉。
text.description: 黑石兽人可不是单干的。你也瞧见了，他们拉拢了火腹食人魔和燃棘巨魔。更为不幸的是，这帮家伙还与黑龙结成了同盟。$b$b兽人和龙族已经派出兵力，驻守在各处的集结点，集结点是以一个长矛挑着龙头骨的图形为标识的。我们得找到这些集结点，在战争开始前除掉驻守在那里的前锋兵力。$b$b准备好了吗？
text.progress: Come on, $n, there's still more of them left.  Our job isn't done.
text.completion: Your kill count is adding up, $n.  We're chipping away at them. And we are going to win.  Redridge will NOT fall to these cowards.
text.completed: Speak with John J. Keeshan.

english.title: Draconic Vanguard
english.objectives: Slay Minyoth, Whelptamer Akumi, Terromath the Seared, and Tugnar Goremaw.
english.description: The Blackrock orcs don't come alone.  You've already seen that they've got the Firegut ogres and Smolderthorn trolls on their side.  Unfortunately for us, they're also teamed up with the black dragonflight.$b$bThe orcs and the dragons have already sent some of their champions to stand guard at rally points, which are marked by a dragon skull on a pike.  You and I are going to find these rally points and take out this vanguard before the battle starts.$b$bReady?
english.progress: Come on, $n, there's still more of them left.  Our job isn't done.
english.completion: Your kill count is adding up, $n.  We're chipping away at them. And we are going to win.  Redridge will NOT fall to these cowards.
english.completed: Speak with John J. Keeshan.

text.title: 与龙的交易
text.objectives: 将获救的雏龙交给燃烧平原滑石的阿克莱德。
text.description: 在我们绕着巨槌石侦察的过程中，还需要做一件事。$b$b还记得你在雏龙丘陵救出的幼龙吗？托德曼一直负责照顾它们，我们得将它们送到更值得托付的人手中。这个人就在巨槌石东北方的滑石。$b$b他叫阿克莱德，或许他会在这场迫在眉睫的战争中，成为获胜的关键。
text.progress: You've arrived, $n.
text.completion: Yes, the whelplings.  I will take care of them. As for the agreement I made with your Colonel Troteman earlier, tell him that I will hold up my end of the bargain.  You will have your dragon for the battle against the orcs. We hold no particular love for the Redridge Mountains, but we do share your grudge against the Blackrock clan.
text.completed: Speak with Acride at Slither Rock in Burning Steppes.

english.title: A Deal With a Dragon
english.objectives: Deliver the Rescued Whelplings to Acride at Slither Rock in Burning Steppes.
english.description: While we are circling around Dreadmaul Rock, there's one more stop that we need to make.$b$bYou remember the hatchlings that you freed from the Whelping Downs?  Troteman's been hanging onto them, and we're going to deliver them to someone who will take care of them better than we can.  He's staying in Slither Rock, to the northeast of Dreadmaul Rock.$b$bHis name is Acride, and he might be the key to victory in the upcoming battle.
english.progress: You've arrived, $n.
english.completion: Yes, the whelplings.  I will take care of them. As for the agreement I made with your Colonel Troteman earlier, tell him that I will hold up my end of the bargain.  You will have your dragon for the battle against the orcs. We hold no particular love for the Redridge Mountains, but we do share your grudge against the Blackrock clan.
english.completed: Speak with Acride at Slither Rock in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 送给索基佐格的货物
text.objectives: 使用黑石伪装，将沾满泻药的肉排交给燃烧平原火腹熔炉的索基佐格将军。如果你需要一件新的黑石伪装，就跟托德曼上校谈一谈。
text.description: 索基佐格将军跟其他食人魔一起待在火腹熔炉，他就在巨槌石西部边缘的洞穴里。我要你将这件货物交到他和食人魔手中。$b$b包裹里是你找来的新鲜狼肉，浸泡在我们从风暴祭坛取回的魔能泻药中。$b$b如果我是你的话，就绝不会碰这玩意儿。$b$b将它交给索基佐格将军。他一定会让食人魔饱餐一顿的；幸运的话，他自己也会来上一口。
text.progress: What've you got there, soldier?
text.completion: Well would you look at that!  My favorite soldier comes through in the clutch! I'll make sure to get this distributed among the ogres. I'll see you in Redridge, soldier.  For the glory of the Blackrock!
text.completed: Speak with General Thorg'izog within Firegut Furnace in Burning Steppes.

english.title: A Delivery for Thorg'izog
english.objectives: Using your Blackrock Disguise, bring the Slider Cider-Marinated Cutlets to General Thorg'izog at Firegut Furnace in Burning Steppes.  Speak with Colonel Troteman if you need a new Blackrock Disguise.
english.description: General Thorg'izog is staying among the ogres in the Firegut Furnace, a cave on the western edge of Dreadmaul Rock.  I'd like you to deliver this to him and the ogres.$b$bInside this package, you will find the worg cutlets you obtained, marinated in the fel slider cider that we took from the Altar of Storms.$b$bI would avoid eating it if I were you.$b$bBring it to General Thorg'izog.  He will make sure that his troops are fed and, with any luck, he will eat some himself.
english.progress: What've you got there, soldier?
english.completion: Well would you look at that!  My favorite soldier comes through in the clutch! I'll make sure to get this distributed among the ogres. I'll see you in Redridge, soldier.  For the glory of the Blackrock!
english.completed: Speak with General Thorg'izog within Firegut Furnace in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 送给尼纳拉克的货物
text.objectives: 使用黑石伪装，潜入颅骨密径，说服龙领主尼纳拉克收下一箱陷入昏睡的烈焰小鬼。如果你需要一件新的黑石伪装，就跟托德曼上校谈一谈。
text.description: 黑石氏族的术士通常在颅骨密径练习魔法，那是一处位于巨槌石东部边缘的洞穴。他们的首领克希鲁恩有别的事情要忙，因此那里暂时由三巨头之一的龙领主尼纳拉克看守。尼纳拉克精通的是如何跟黑龙打交道，他对通灵术就一窍不通了。$b$b我对你抓来的烈焰小鬼使用了沉睡之砂。说服尼纳拉克它们只是术士的小鬼而已。等这帮家伙醒来时，就有好戏看啦。
text.progress: 什麽?
text.completion: What are these?  Oh, are these imps? I'm pretty sure that imps don't just fall asleep in boxes! I'll take your word for it, though.  I don't understand any of this warlock crap.  Leave them in the corner.
text.completed: Speak with Dragon-Lord Neeralak at the Skull Warren in Burning Steppes.

english.title: A Delivery for Neeralak
english.objectives: Using your Blackrock Disguise, sneak into the Skull Warren and convince Dragon-Lord Neeralak to take your Crate of Sleeping Flamekin.  Speak with Colonel Troteman if you need a new Blackrock Disguise.
english.description: The warlocks of the Blackrock Clan often practice their magic in the Skull Warren, a cave on the eastern side of Dreadmaul Rock.  Their leader, Xi'lun, is busy elsewhere, so the cave is currently being held by another of the big three: Dragon-Lord Neeralak.  And Neeralak's expertise is in dragons, not in necromancy.$b$bI've used the slumber sand on those flamekin you captured.  Try to convince Neeralak that they're warlock imps, and not flamekin.  When they wake up, they won't be happy.
english.progress: What?
english.completion: What are these?  Oh, are these imps? I'm pretty sure that imps don't just fall asleep in boxes! I'll take your word for it, though.  I don't understand any of this warlock crap.  Leave them in the corner.
english.completed: Speak with Dragon-Lord Neeralak at the Skull Warren in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 送给克希鲁恩的货物
text.objectives: 使用黑石伪装，将澄澈的玻璃球交给燃烧平原巨槌石的高阶术士克希鲁恩。
text.description: 情报指出，三巨头的最后一名成员高阶术士克希鲁恩在巨槌石顶端的洞穴中秘密策划着他的伟大计划。$b$b他在等一件东西：统御宝珠，想利用它执行强大的仪式。我要你给他的是：$b$b<托德曼递给你一颗玻璃球。>$b$b这颗玻璃球是你从风暴祭坛取回的。它没有任何能量。把这玩意儿交给克希鲁恩，然后祈祷他不会识破吧。
text.progress: I don't have time for games, fool.  Get out of my sight.
text.completion: Pff!  You're late!  Do you know how long I've been waiting for Ner'gosh to deliver this orb? There's something strange about this orb... it's too... Never mind, it must be my nerves talking.  Thank you for the delivery.  For blood and honor!
text.completed: Report to High Warlock Xi'lun at Dreadmaul Rock in Burning Steppes.

english.title: A Delivery for Xi'lun
english.objectives: While using the Blackrock Disguise, deliver the Clear Glass Orb to High Warlock Xi'lun atop Dreadmaul Rock in Burning Steppes.
english.description: Intel tells us that High Warlock Xi'lun - the final member of the Big Three - is within the cave atop Dreadmaul Peak, preparing for his big moment.$b$bHe is waiting for a delivery: an Orb of Domination, with which he can perform a powerful summoning ritual.  I want you to give him this:$b$b<Troteman hands you a glass orb.>$b$bThis is the clear glass orb that you freed from the Altar of Storms.  It is powerless.  Give it to Xi'lun, and cross your fingers that he doesn't notice.
english.progress: I don't have time for games, fool.  Get out of my sight.
english.completion: Pff!  You're late!  Do you know how long I've been waiting for Ner'gosh to deliver this orb? There's something strange about this orb... it's too... Never mind, it must be my nerves talking.  Thank you for the delivery.  For blood and honor!
english.completed: Report to High Warlock Xi'lun at Dreadmaul Rock in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 巨槌石之战
text.objectives: 击败200名黑石入侵者。如果你弄丢了载具，就使用召唤者号角再次召唤它。
text.description: 一切都清楚了，$n。动乱的根源已经找到。所有的线索拼凑成了完整的事件。$b$b坐稳了，跟我来吧。我们要跟阿克莱德谈谈，他回馈恩情的时候到了。然后我们要在黑石大军展开赤脊山的入侵计划之前将其扼杀。
text.completion: Did you see them run?  They didn't know what was happening!  Beautiful! Our job's almost done, $n.  It's time to deliver the deathblow.
text.completed: 返回燃烧平原摩根的岗哨，向托德曼上校复命。

english.title: Assault on Dreadmaul Rock
english.objectives: Slay 200 Blackrock Invaders.  If you should lose your vehicle, use the Horn of the Callers to summon it again.
english.description: This is it, $n.  This is where it hits the fan.  Where all the pieces come together.$b$bStrap in, and come with me.  We're going to go talk to Acride and call in that favor that he owes us.  Then we'll stop this invasion of Redridge before it even starts.
english.completion: Did you see them run?  They didn't know what was happening!  Beautiful! Our job's almost done, $n.  It's time to deliver the deathblow.
english.completed: Return to Colonel Troteman at Morgan's Vigil in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 混战中的荣耀
text.objectives: 杀死索基佐格将军、龙领主尼纳拉克和高阶术士克希鲁恩。
text.description: 你和基沙恩得返回巨槌石。战争过后尚有三名兽人存活，必须除掉他们。$b$b没错，我说的就是三巨头。$b$b索基佐格将军逃回了火腹熔炉，龙领主尼纳拉克躲藏在巨槌石顶端的洞穴中，克希鲁恩则在颅骨密径背后继续和他的术士走狗们谋划着什么。$b$b立下战功吧，$n。杀死这些可怜虫，让他们尝尝赤脊山的英雄的威力！
text.completion: Welcome home, boys.
text.completed: 返回燃烧平原摩根的岗哨，向托德曼上校复命。

english.title: Glory Amidst Chaos
english.objectives: Kill General Thorg'izog, Dragon-Lord Neeralak, and High Warlock Xi'lun.
english.description: You and Keeshan are going back to that mountain.  There's three orcs who survived the attack, and we won't rest until they're dead.$b$bThat's right, I'm talking about the Big Three.$b$bGeneral Thorg'izog crawled back into the Firegut Furnace, and Dragon-Lord Neeralak is cowering in the cave on the mountain's peak.  Xi'lun is in the back of the Skull Warren, plotting with his fellow warlocks.$b$bLeave your mark, $n.  Hunt down those sniveling Blackrocks, and teach them the might of Redridge!
english.completion: Welcome home, boys.
english.completed: Return to Colonel Troteman at Morgan's Vigil in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 战利品
text.objectives: 查验燃烧平原摩根的岗哨的一箱剩余补给品。
text.description: 今天我们颠覆了整个黑石大军，$n。虽然黑石兽人仍然盘踞在他们的塔楼里，但是我相信短期内他们再也不敢轻易进犯赤脊山了。这一切都是你和基沙恩的功劳。$b$b我们在燃烧平原收获了不少物资——我们搜集的这些术士的玩意儿都能派上用场，还有我们用来隐藏龙族的黑曜石灰烬。$b$b但是还剩下了一些东西。在你离开燃烧平原之前，请随意挑选吧。
text.completion: You peer inside, and find...

english.title: The Spoils of War
english.objectives: Inspect the Box of Left Over Supplies at Morgan's Vigil in Burning Steppes.
english.description: We've toppled a giant today, $n.  While the Blackrock orcs still swarm in their spire, I doubt their plans will take them anywhere near Redridge anytime soon.  You and Keeshan saw to that.$b$bI'd say we were fairly resourceful here in Burning Steppes - those warlock supplies we collected certainly came in handy, as did the obsidian ash that we used to conceal our dragon.$b$bThere were, however, some collected items left over.  Please, take your pick before you move on, beyond the steppes.
english.completion: You peer inside, and find...

text.title: 奥格瑞玛之行
text.objectives: 与奥格瑞玛兵营的马丁·古尔乔交谈。
text.description: 一位信使请我传递一份邀请，是牧师训练师马丁·古尔乔发来的，他就在奥格瑞玛的兵营里。$B$B他请你在方便时尽快去见他。兵营就在荣誉谷中。
text.completion: So you got my message. Good. I have an important task for you.
text.completed: 与奥格瑞玛兵营的马丁·古尔乔交谈。

english.title: Meet with Brother Silverhallow
english.objectives: Speak with Brother Silverhallow in Orgrimmar's Goblin Slums.
english.description: Brother Silverhallow sent word that he wishes to speak with you. Next time you're in Orgrimmar, visit him in the Goblin Slums.  It sounded like he had something important on his mind.
english.completion: So you got my message. Good. I have an important task for you.
english.completed: Speak with Brother Silverhallow in Orgrimmar's Goblin Slums.

text.title: 致命性研究
text.objectives: 取回250份枯萎样本。
text.description: 我们曾使用一种相当有效的瘟疫来对付南海镇的人类。你也看见了，效果十分显著。但是，使用瘟疫也会带来副作用，瘟疫一旦蔓延就很难彻底清除。$B$B我要你带上测试工具箱进入原野，调查枯萎软泥怪的致命性。对枯萎软泥怪使用致命性分析器即可。收集到数据后就回来找我。
