text.completion: Oh my. 250? This thing doesn't go past 250. How are you still standing? You should be a puddle of goo by now. Sylvanas will be most displeased with this information. There might be some things we can do to reduce the lethality levels of the area by a few decades, but that still leaves us out by about a hundred or so years.
text.completed: Return to Serge Hinott at the Ruins of Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: Studies in Lethality
english.objectives: Recover 250 Blight Samples.
english.description: We used a fairly potent strain of blight against the humans of Southshore. As you can see, it worked. The trouble with blight use, though, is that blight tends to stick around after it's served its purpose.$B$BWhat I need from you is to take this testing kit and get out into the field to get a lethality count from the blight slimes that we've released into the area. Use the lethality analyzer on the blight slimes sweeping the slime pools. Come back to me when you have some solid data.
english.completion: Oh my. 250? This thing doesn't go past 250. How are you still standing? You should be a puddle of goo by now. Sylvanas will be most displeased with this information. There might be some things we can do to reduce the lethality levels of the area by a few decades, but that still leaves us out by about a hundred or so years.
english.completed: Return to Serge Hinott at the Ruins of Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 绿色生活
text.objectives: 取回8个用过的荒疫之罐。
text.description: 循环利用！这种观念最近很流行。女妖之王颁布了法令，指出从长远来看，被遗忘者应该倡导环境保护。每个人都必须尽到自己的义务，对吧？因此，你得替我们为环境保护作出努力。$B$B南海镇散落着数千个荒疫之罐。我们可以将这些废罐子制成荒疫弹壳。进入南海镇废墟，拾荒去吧。
text.progress: Bring me those canisters!
text.completion: Excellent work, $n. You are incredibly resilient to this blight. We'll have to take you in for testing some time.
text.completed: Return to Serge Hinott at the Ruins of Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: Green Living
english.objectives: Recover 8 Used Blight Canisters.
english.description: Recycling! It's all the craze these days. The Banshee Queen has decreed that we must conserve if we are to prosper as a people. Everyone must do their part, right? With that said, you will be doing our part for us.$B$BThere are likely thousands of blight canister bits and pieces all over Southshore. We can reuse those canisters for more blight bombing goodness. Just head into the ruins here and pick up whatever you can find.
english.progress: Bring me those canisters!
english.completion: Excellent work, $n. You are incredibly resilient to this blight. We'll have to take you in for testing some time.
english.completed: Return to Serge Hinott at the Ruins of Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 设局
text.objectives: 返回燃烧平原摩根的岗哨，向托德曼上校复命。
text.description: $n。看来你和基沙恩顺利完成了任务。我的事儿也都办妥当了。$b$b返回摩根的岗哨吧。我有些包裹要交给那三位巨头：索基佐格、尼纳拉克和克希鲁恩。你已经见过索基佐格将军了。这次你将有机会见到另外两位。$b$b也就是说，在我们杀死他们之前。
text.completion: Good, you're back. I hope you've still got that disguise.  You're going back undercover, $n.
text.giverWindow: 回到摩根的岗哨。要运送的货物已经准备好了。

english.title: Placing the Pawns
english.objectives: Return to Colonel Troteman at Morgan's Vigil in Burning Steppes.
english.description: $n.  It sounds like you and Keeshan have finished with your tasks.  I've also finished mine.$b$bReturn to Morgan's Vigil.  I've prepared a few packages to deliver to the Big Three: Thorg'izog, Neeralak, and Xi'lun.  You've already met General Thorg'izog.  This will be your chance to meet the other two.$b$bThat is, before we kill them.
english.completion: Good, you're back. I hope you've still got that disguise.  You're going back undercover, $n.
english.giverWindow: Come back to Morgan's Vigil.  I've got some deliveries prepared.

choices.name: Breastplate of the Undercover Thorium Brother

text.title: 准备行动
text.objectives: 向燃烧平原摩根的岗哨的托德曼上校报到。
text.description: $n，进来。你懂我的意思吗？$B$B战争就要开始了。我希望你送出了所有的包裹。$B$B现在，我需要你待在摩根的岗哨。
text.giverWindow: 立即返回摩根的岗哨！

english.title: Locked and Loaded
english.objectives: Report to Colonel Troteman at Morgan's Vigil in Burning Steppes.
english.description: $n, come in.  Can you read me?$b$bThe battle is about to start.  I hope you've delivered all of those packages.$b$bI need you here in Morgan's Vigil, NOW.
english.giverWindow: Get back to Morgan's Vigil ASAP!

text.title: 暮光的阴谋
text.objectives: 使用发光的火炬在黑石深渊的住宅区烧毁8本暮光信经。
text.description: 暮光之锤不断地向外渗透自己的势力。在这场战争中，他们一直在寻找新的盟友与我们为敌。如今，暮光之锤正在招募黑石深渊的黑铁矮人加入他们的行列。$B$B茉艾拉对黑铁矮人的统治力日渐薄弱，背弃她的臣民越来越多。我们必须破坏暮光之锤的招募计划。$B$B我要你进入黑石深渊的住宅区，使用这根火炬烧毁暮光之锤分发的小册子。
text.completion: You have done your work well, $n. While this will not stop Twilight's Hammer, it will help sow suspicion between them and the Dark Irons.
text.completed: Return to High Priestess Laurena at the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind's Cathedral District.

english.title: Twilight Scheming
english.objectives: Use the Glowing Torch to destroy 8 copies of The Twilight Creed in the Domicile of Blackrock Depths.
english.description: The influence of Twilight's Hammer reaches far and wide. They search ceaselessly for allies in their battle against us and they are recruiting the Dark Iron dwarves of Blackrock Depths to their cause.$B$BMoira's grip on the Dark Irons is tenuous at best and more of her people fall away from her rule with each day. We must sabotage their recruitment efforts.$B$BI want you to go into Domicile portion of Blackrock Depths and use this torch to burn the books that the Twilight's Hammer is distributing there.
english.completion: You have done your work well, $n. While this will not stop Twilight's Hammer, it will help sow suspicion between them and the Dark Irons.
english.completed: Return to High Priestess Laurena at the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind's Cathedral District.

text.title: 愤怒的软泥怪
text.objectives: 杀死5只愤怒的枯萎软泥怪。
text.description: 这些枯萎软泥怪似乎陷入了狂躁的情绪。它们的外皮层甚至显现出一张模糊的人脸，依稀可见其愤怒的表情。如果这里塞满了狂躁的软泥怪，希诺特肯定会不爽的。$B$B杀死愤怒的枯萎软泥怪，试着寻找它们的滋生之地。
text.completion: All signs indicate to a breeding pool being inside the ruined town hall. You'll need to investigate!
text.completed: 跟希尔斯布莱德丘陵南海镇废墟的瑟尔格·希诺特谈一谈。
text.giverWindow: 或许它还是小软泥怪时就被咬了。

english.title: Angry Scrubbing Bubbles
english.objectives: Kill 5 Angry Blight Slimes.
english.description: These blight slimes seem to be really angry. They've even got a faint outline of an angry humanoid face in their ectoplasm. You don't think Hinott would be too happy about having non-compliant slimes working the slime pools.$B$BKill any angry blight slimes that you see and try to get a lock on a breeding pool.
english.completion: All signs indicate to a breeding pool being inside the ruined town hall. You'll need to investigate!
english.completed: Speak to Serge Hinott at the Ruins of Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills.
english.giverWindow: Perhaps it was beaten as a young slime.

text.title: 污秽的试炼
text.objectives: 杀死软泥怪繁殖者切特。
text.description: 污秽和愤怒的痕迹一直通往城镇大厅的废墟。那里肯定就是软泥怪的滋生之地。深入大厅，击败你撞见的所有软泥怪！$B$B在你成功地除掉软泥怪之母后，就向南海镇废墟的瑟尔格·希诺特汇报这个好消息吧。
text.progress: 有事吗?
text.completion: Perhaps with Chet vanquished, the lethality levels of this place will decrease a tad faster. A job well done, $n!
text.completed: 跟希尔斯布莱德丘陵南海镇废墟的瑟尔格·希诺特谈一谈。
text.giverWindow: 你死定了，白痴！

english.title: Trail of Filth
english.objectives: Kill Chet the Slime-Breeder.
english.description: The trail of filth and anger leads into the ruined town hall. Surely there is a slime breeding pool inside the structure. Fight your way inside and deal with whatever angry slime-breeder that you encounter!$B$BShould you succeed Serge Hinott at the Ruins of Southshore will surely want to hear about it.
english.progress: Yes?
english.completion: Perhaps with Chet vanquished, the lethality levels of this place will decrease a tad faster. A job well done, $n!
english.completed: Speak to Serge Hinott at the Ruins of Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills.
english.giverWindow: You're stewed, buttwad!

text.title: 魔棒的恩赐……
text.objectives: 使用赫尔库拉的魔棒强化8名黑暗游侠。
text.description: 我，精通巫术，受克尔苏加德的亲手栽培，却沦为躺在墓地里的一具僵尸。所幸的是，聪明的学徒塞万德设法取来了这件东西：$B$B<赫尔库拉挥了挥手中的魔棒。>$B$B魔棒的力量令我重获新生。它能赐予，亦能夺走；它无所不能！$B$B前往北面的战地，使用魔棒强化黑暗游侠，帮助他们对付狼人。魔棒能激发他们的勇气。
text.completion: As I said, the rod giveth to our dark rangers and doth taketh away from our enemy!
text.completed: Return to Helcular at the Ruins of Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: Helcular's Rod Giveth...
english.objectives: Use Helcular's Rod to Empower 8 Dark Rangers.
english.description: To think, I, a master of necromancy, trained by Kel'Thuzad himself, was reduced to nothing more than a corpse in a grave. Thankfully, my astute apprentice, Thaivand, managed to find a group of heroes to recover this:$B$B<Helcular whips out his rod.>$B$BIt is through the power of the rod that I was reborn. The rod giveth and the rod taketh away!$B$BTake it now and use it to empower our dark rangers battling the worgen in the field north of us. Renew their vigor with my rod.
english.completion: As I said, the rod giveth to our dark rangers and doth taketh away from our enemy!
english.completed: Return to Helcular at the Ruins of Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 赫尔库拉的命令
text.objectives: 杀死15名血牙遗族猎人。
text.description: 我们的黑暗游侠在原野上搜寻着狼人恐怖份子的踪迹。那些狼人都是被他们的黑暗主人派来对我们执行暗杀计划的。尽管黑暗游侠个个是勇猛的斗士，但是狼人总是群体发动攻击，游侠们很难在数量优势前获胜。$B$B在南海镇废墟附近搜寻血牙遗族猎人。杀死他们！为被遗忘者和洛丹伦而战！
text.completion: We should have killed Bloodfang in Silverpine. It's a shame he still lives. It's an even bigger shame that we have as of yet been unable to turn worgen into undead. Surely there is a way...
text.completed: Return to Helcular at the Ruins of Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: Helcular's Command
english.objectives: Kill 15 Bloodfang Forsaken Hunters.
english.description: Our dark rangers search the fields for worgen terrorists. These worgen have been sent out by their dark masters to hunt and kill us. And though a dark ranger is a formidable combatant, the worgen often attack in packs, which can overwhelm even a dark ranger.$B$BSearch the fields around the ruins of Southshore for Bloodfang forsaken hunters. Kill any that you see! For the Forsaken and for Lordaeron!
english.completion: We should have killed Bloodfang in Silverpine. It's a shame he still lives. It's an even bigger shame that we have as of yet been unable to turn worgen into undead. Surely there is a way...
english.completed: Return to Helcular at the Ruins of Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 该上油了
text.objectives: 用达尔拉的抓钩获得铁木油罐，用它们给7台铁木伐木机上油。
text.description: 铁木工程营有三宝：木材、石油，还有精疲力尽的工人。前两样基本上就是第三样的诱因，不过我做事尽可能讲效率。$B$B我让伐木机干三倍的加班工时，还不给加班费，它们真的没时间来安排维护。$B$B用这抓钩把漂浮在营地周围的油罐弄些来，给伐木机上上油，好不好？
text.completion: Efficiency in the workforce! Wonderful. Maybe I should check on the goblins inside those shredders later.
text.completed: Return to Darla Drilldozer at Irontree Clearing in Felwood.

english.title: It's Time to Oil Up
english.objectives: Use Darla's Grapple to collect Irontree Oil Cans and use them to oil 7 Irontree Shredders.
english.description: Three things come out of Irontree Clearing: lumber, oil, and exhausted workers. The first two are pretty much the cause of the third, but I like to be efficient about things where I can.$B$BI've got our shredders working triple unpaid overtime, and there's really nowhere in the schedule for them to get maintenance.$B$BUse this grappling hook to nab some of the extra oil cans floating around camp and use them to oil up the shredders, would you?
english.completion: Efficiency in the workforce! Wonderful. Maybe I should check on the goblins inside those shredders later.
english.completed: Return to Darla Drilldozer at Irontree Clearing in Felwood.

text.title: 闪光弹之战
text.objectives: 用达尔拉的超强闪光弹让8名刺枝潜伏者显形，将他们杀掉。
text.description: 这个行动目前为止还算隐蔽，但是刺枝林地的狼人打算跟我们一决雌雄。他们尽全力要让我们停工。$B$B一些工人告诉我，他们瞥到狼人就潜伏在旷野附近。带上这些超强闪光弹。它们亮得要死，附近不管有什么东西都能给照出来。$B$B用闪光弹去找潜行的狼人，别让他们活着离开！
text.completion: Mangy curs think they can just waltz in here and ruin my finely-tuned operation. Hah! I told you not to look directly at the flares, right? Oops.
text.completed: Return to Darla Drilldozer at Irontree Clearing in Felwood.

english.title: A Flare Fight
english.objectives: Use Darla's Box of Megaflares to reveal 8 Talonbranch Prowlers and slay them.
english.description: This operation's stayed pretty discreet so far, but the worgen over in Talonbranch Glade have it out for us. They've been trying everything they can to get us shut down.$B$BSome of the workers have told me they've seen glimpses of worgen lurking around the clearing. Take these oversized megaflares. They're bright enough to show anything that gets anywhere near them.$B$BUse the flares to look for prowling worgen, and make sure they don't leave here alive!
english.completion: Mangy curs think they can just waltz in here and ruin my finely-tuned operation. Hah! I told you not to look directly at the flares, right? Oops.
english.completed: Return to Darla Drilldozer at Irontree Clearing in Felwood.

text.title: 把它关掉！把它关掉！
text.objectives: 关闭铁木山洞底部的主控泵机。
text.description: 是那些该死的狼人！他们在我眼皮底下潜入了山洞。$B$B他们一定是把主控泵机搞坏了！要是不去管它，咱们脚下每一条运行的管线都得爆炸。你以为现在的泄漏已经很糟了？更糟的还在后头！$B$B听着，要是你能到山洞里面的主控泵机那儿去，就可以把它关掉，救我们所有人的命！
text.completion: You turn the largest handle you can find on the Master Control Pump, and the rattling noises in the nearby pipes stop. This gives you a few moments to hear the sound of flames outside before a familiar voice cuts in through a tinny, craclikng speaker.

english.title: Turn It Off! Turn It Off!
english.objectives: Shut off the Master Control Pump at the bottom of Irontree Cavern.
english.description: It was those darn worgen! They blew right past me into the cavern.$B$BThey must've messed with the Master Control Pump! If that thing is left on too long, every pipe runnin' under our feet is gonna blow. You think the leaks now are bad? Just wait!$B$BListen, if you can reach the Master Control Pump all the way in the back of the cavern, you can shut it off and save us all!
english.completion: You turn the largest handle you can find on the Master Control Pump, and the rattling noises in the nearby pipes stop. This gives you a few moments to hear the sound of flames outside before a familiar voice cuts in through a tinny, craclikng speaker.

text.title: 抽打和堵口
text.objectives: 抽打7名惊慌的工人，让他们堵住原油喷口。
text.description: 天哪……又来了！你要是听见副队长在外面嚷嚷，那就说明我们这儿燃油全面泄漏了！$B$B听好，外面肯定乱成一锅粥。缺乏睡眠的地精四下乱跑，一个劲儿地尖叫，不知道该做什么好。我要你去把他们抽醒。$B$B对着脸颊反手就是一耳光，准能行！等他们明白过来，就会去把喷口堵上的！
text.completion: It's not working! We're going to have to shut it off at the source. Go talk to the Deputy outside, he'll walk you through it!
text.completed: Return to Darla Drilldozer at Irontree Clearing in Felwood.

english.title: Slap and Cap
english.objectives: Slap 7 Panicked Workers to make them cap the oil gushers.
english.description: Oh for... not again! If you heard the deputy yelling out there, that means we've got a fullblown oil leak on our hands! It's those filthy worgen again!$B$BListen, it's going to be total chaos out there. Sleep-deprived goblins running around screaming and not knowing what to do. I need you to snap the workers back to their senses.$B$BA good, swift backhand across the face should do it! Once they shake themselves off, they'll get to work capping those gushers!
english.completion: It's not working! We're going to have to shut it off at the source. Go talk to the Deputy outside, he'll walk you through it!
english.completed: Return to Darla Drilldozer at Irontree Clearing in Felwood.

text.title: 铁木的伐木机
text.objectives: 消灭9台铁木伐木机。
text.description: 很恶心，对吧？看看他们。可怜的小东西，都无法自食其力。$B$B他们坐在那些大型的金属伐木机里，耀武扬威，把森林锯成木屑。我敢说他们一定以为自己在那里面很安全，温暖又舒适。$B$B告诉他们，他们错了。从营地北边杀出去，尽你所能摧毁那些伐木机。等你手刃了敌人之后，我们就要把这地方永远夷平。
text.completion: This is but the first strike.
text.completed: Return to Alton Redding at Irontree Cavern in Felwood.

english.title: The Shredders of Irontree
english.objectives: Kill 9 Irontree Shredders.
english.description: Disgusting, isn't it? Look at them. Pathetic little things that can't even toil with their own bodies.$B$BThey stomp around in their massive metal shredders, carving the forest to splinters. I bet they think they're safe in there, all warm and cozy.$B$BProve them wrong. Blaze north through the camp and destroy as many shredders as you can. Once you've spilled some blood, we're going to take this place apart for good.
english.completion: This is but the first strike.
english.completed: Return to Alton Redding at Irontree Cavern in Felwood.

text.title: 北方的死木
text.objectives: 杀死魔爪村15名任意种类的死木熊怪。
text.description: 我们西南边有座死木熊怪的营地。堕落弥漫在那里，我希望你在他们成为大问题之前结束这一切。$B$B死木部落的确是邪恶的，但那只是因为恶魔污染了他们的心智。他们的敌意并非天性，但现在他们已经得不到拯救了。本是手足,如今却要自相残杀，这让我很伤心。$B$B拜托你，$n——我要你去做的事情是必须的。只是不要告诉我细节，那些恼人的景象只会徒增我的烦恼。
text.completion: 很高兴你回来了，$N。我希望死木部族对你而言并不难对付。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Nafien near Timbermaw Hold in Felwood.

english.title: Deadwood of the North
english.objectives: Kill 15 Deadwood Furbolg of any kind in Felpaw Village.
english.description: There is a camp of Deadwood furbolgs directly to our southwest.  Corruption permeates the camp, and I wish to put an end to it before they become a problem.$B$BThe Deadwood tribe is evil, but it is the effects of the fel that pollutes their minds.  Their hostility is not truly an innate quality, yet they cannot be helped.  It saddens me that we must fight our own brethren.$B$BPlease, $n - I ask you to do what must be done.  Simply spare me the details; such troublesome images upset me far too much.
english.completion: I sense that you have achieved victory.  Victory... such a hollow word considering what had to be done.  Regardless, you've proven yourself to be worthy of our trust. It may take some time before the Timbermaw welcome you without hostility within the Hold.  Still, your perseverance will erode any suspicion my brethren may have about you.  So long as you never betray us and raise weapons against us, we will find common ground.
english.completed: Return to Nafien near Timbermaw Hold in Felwood.

text.title: 你的油会逃跑吗？
text.objectives: 从原油淤泥怪身上获得10份原油沥青球。
text.description: 上次我们的燃油漏得这么厉害的时候，那些油居然想逃走！$B$B我不知道是怎么回事，可能是这附近的恶魔玩意在作祟，不过在我们原油漏得足够多之后，半数的油滴聚在了一起，打算逃跑。$B$B那可是白白飞走的利润啊！去追上那些原油淤泥怪，把它们宝贵的油给抢回来！
text.progress: That stuff better not still be moving when you bring it back here.
text.completion: Thank goodness the oil is safe! Well done, $n.
text.completed: Return to Darla Drilldozer at Irontree Clearing in Felwood.

english.title: Is Your Oil Running?
english.objectives: Collect 10 Crude Tarballs from Oily Sludges.
english.description: Last time we had an oil leak this bad, the oil itself tried to get away!$B$BI don't know what does it, maybe all the demon goop floating around here, but when we get a big enough crude leak half of it globs together and tries to run away.$B$BThat's profit trying to escape! Go run after those oil sludges and bring back their sweet, precious oil!
english.progress: That stuff better not still be moving when you bring it back here.
english.completion: Thank goodness the oil is safe! Well done, $n.
english.completed: Return to Darla Drilldozer at Irontree Clearing in Felwood.

text.title: 炸弹交易
text.objectives: 从铁木山洞里收集10份铁木炸药。
text.description: 我所有的工人都被那些巨大的泥沼生物赶出了这里的洞穴！达尔拉派我来这里收拾残局，但你有没有看到过那里的情形？我是不会去那里的！$B$B那里有我们留下的大量炸药，我不能让它们无人照管。$B$B我们做个交易吧：你去那里收集炸药，我会在这里等你，保证不会被那些泥沼怪物杀死，如果你也能活着回来，我会付给你酬金的！你觉得怎么样？
text.progress: We had a deal, right? Right?
text.completion: Hey, nice! I'll just take those... carefully... Don't go tellin' the workers I didn't have the guts to go down there myself, you hear? Here's your pay... and a little somethin' extra.
text.completed: Return to Foreman Pikwik at Irontree Cavern in Felwood.

english.title: A Bomb Deal
english.objectives: Collect 8 Irontree Explosives from Irontree Cavern.
english.description: All my workers got driven straight out of the cavern here by those big swamp-lookin' things! Darla's sent me here to pick up the pieces, but have you seen it in there? I ain't goin' in!$B$BThere's a ton of explosives left behind that we can't just leave layin' around$B$B I'll make you a deal: You run in there and get those explosives gathered up, and I will stay here and not get killed by swamp-things, and if you don't either, I'll pay ya! How's that sound?
english.progress: We had a deal, right? Right?
english.completion: Hey, nice! I'll just take those... carefully... Don't go tellin' the workers I didn't have the guts to go down there myself, you hear? Here's your pay... and a little somethin' extra.
english.completed: Return to Foreman Pikwik at Irontree Cavern in Felwood.

text.title: 收集堕落
text.objectives: 从碎痕谷的热能恐兽身上收集8份熵能精华。
text.description: 尽管德鲁伊们对污染这片土地的恶魔力量加以回避，但总还是要面对它的。这些能量是如此混沌，以至于它们作为暴力的实体、纯粹的邪能魔法形式显现，侵害着所有的生命。$B$B我一直在密切注意着这些混沌的野兽，研究着它们的力量。我需要确信它们随着时间增长正在衰弱。把它们掉落的精华给我带来，我好肯定它们正在衰减。
text.progress: Be wary with the essence. It is as poisonous as it is powerful.
text.completion: I can tell just from the size of these that the fel taint is healing. Slowly... but significantly.$B$BThank you, $n. I will ensure these are properly purged.
text.completed: Return to Elessa Starbreeze at Whisperwind Grove in Felwood.

english.title: Collecting Corruption
english.objectives: Collect 8 Entropic Essences from Entropic Horrors in Shatter Scar Vale.
english.description: Though we druids shun the demonic powers infesting this land, it must still be confronted.$B$BShatter Scar Vale to the south seethes with corruption. The energies there are so chaotic that they manifest as violent entities, pure fel magic given form to lash out at all life.$B$BI have been keeping a close eye on these chaotic beasts, and studying their strength. I need to make sure they are still weakening with time. Bring me the essences they drop, so I may ensure they are diminishing.
english.progress: Be wary with the essence. It is as poisonous as it is powerful.
english.completion: I can tell just from the size of these that the fel taint is healing. Slowly... but significantly.$B$BThank you, $n. I will ensure these are properly purged.
english.completed: Return to Elessa Starbreeze at Whisperwind Grove in Felwood.

text.title: 碎裂的邪魔
text.objectives: 从碎痕谷收集9块地狱火残骸。
text.description: 潜伏在碎痕谷的地狱火是可怕的，但不是不能征服的。我们已经消灭了大量的地狱火。$B$B但是，消灭它们只是解决了问题的一部分。我发现，即使在地狱火死后，组成地狱火的石头仍然蕴含着大量的邪恶魔法。$B$B碎痕谷中到处散落着死去的地狱火的残骸，继续腐蚀着那里的土地。如果你能够收集一些这样的石头带给我，我会非常感激的。
text.progress: Do be sure to pick up after your own kills, as well.
text.completion: It's good to see someone who cares about keeping the forest clean. Thank you, $n.
text.completed: Return to Elessa Starbreeze at Whisperwind Grove in Felwood.

english.title: Fel To Pieces
english.objectives: Collect 9 pieces of Infernal Debris from Shatter Scar Vale.
english.description: The infernals that lurk in Shatter Scar Vale are formidable, but not invincible. Much progress has been made in thinning their numbers$B$BDestroying them is only part of the solution, however. I've found that the stone that infernals are made of still contains large amounts of fel magic even after the infernal's death.$B$BThe rubble of slain infernals now litters Shatter Scar Vale, leeching its corruption back into the ground. If you could collect it and bring it to me, I would be grateful.
english.progress: Do be sure to pick up after your own kills, as well.
english.completion: It's good to see someone who cares about keeping the forest clean. Thank you, $n.
english.completed: Return to Elessa Starbreeze at Whisperwind Grove in Felwood.

text.title: 塞纳留斯之息
text.objectives: 从黑石深渊的控火师罗格雷恩身上夺回塞纳留斯之息，并用此神器关闭3座元素之门。
text.description: $n，我们得知塞纳里奥的一件失踪了的神器出现在暮光之锤控火师的手里。控火师罗格雷恩将这件神器——塞纳留斯之息——带到了黑石深渊，用它的力量来打开元素之门。$B$B我们必须阻止罗格雷恩召唤元素为其黑铁盟军效命。从他手上夺回神器，关闭罗格雷恩一直使用的大门。
text.progress: We cannot afford to allow the Dark Iron dwarves to ally with Twilight's Hammer.
text.completion: I'm heartened to have the Breath of Cenarius back where it belongs and I know the rest of the circle will be impressed by your efforts. You may have also set back the plans of the Twilight's Hammer clan a bit, too. Excellent work.
text.completed: Return to Loganaar at Nighthaven in Moonglade.

english.title: The Breath of Cenarius
english.objectives: Recover the Breath of Cenarius from Pyromancer Loregrain in Blackrock Depths and use the artifact to close 3 Elemental Gates.
english.description: $n, we have learned that a missing Cenarion artifact has surfaced in the hands of a Twilight's Hammer pyromancer. Pyromancer Loregrain has taken this artifact, the Breath of Cenarius, into Blackrock Depths and uses its power to open elemental gates.$B$BWe must act to keep Loregrain from summoning elementals to bolster the ranks of his Dark Iron allies. Recover the artifact from him and use its power to close the gates that Loregrain has been using.
english.progress: We cannot afford to allow the Dark Iron dwarves to ally with Twilight's Hammer.
english.completion: I'm heartened to have the Breath of Cenarius back where it belongs and I know the rest of the circle will be impressed by your efforts. You may have also set back the plans of the Twilight's Hammer clan a bit, too. Excellent work.
english.completed: Return to Loganaar at Nighthaven in Moonglade.

text.title: 那是什么气味？
text.objectives: 在希尔斯布莱德丘陵的南海镇废墟找到弑君者奥尔库斯。
text.description: 在你抵达前，有个乘坐冰霜巨龙的兽人经过这里，向我打听“新兵的集合点”。我听不太懂兽人语，就提醒他作为部落的成员，应该尽忠职守，留下来对付狼人的威胁。他嘟囔了一句“这是在煮什么东西”，就往南边的码头去了。$B$B通常我才不关心兽人会不会迷路呢，但是我就很好奇到底是在煮什么东西。去查明真相吧。
text.completion: *GASP* HELP! DROWNING! *GURGLE*

english.title: Can You Smell What the Lok'tar is Cooking?
english.objectives: Find Kingslayer Orkus at the Ruins of Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills.
english.description: Shortly before you arrived an orc flew in upon a frost wyrm and demanded that I direct him to where the 'newbies were hanging out.' Uncertain as to the vernacular, I told him to fulfill his duty as a member of the Horde and deal with the worgen threat of the area. He grumbled something about 'what the lok'tar was cooking' and headed south to the docks.$B$BOrdinarily I wouldn't care about whether or not an orc went missing, but I am genuinely curious about what the lok'tar might be cooking. Find out.
english.completion: *GASP* HELP! DROWNING! *GURGLE*

text.title: *咕噜*救命！*咕噜*
text.objectives: 救弑君者奥尔库斯上岸。
text.description: *咕噜*$B$B救命！*喘气*$B$B奥尔库斯快淹死了！快救救我，任务给予者$n！$B$B*咕*$B$B矮人将我扔进了海里！我不想死！$B$B*咕噜*$B$B就这么淹死真是天大的耻辱。
text.completion: I... uh... the human must have cast some type of mind-altering spell on Orkus. Orkus will explain.
text.completed: 跟希尔斯布莱德丘陵南海镇废墟的弑君者奥尔库斯谈一谈。

english.title: *Gurgle* HELP! *Gurgle*
english.objectives: Help Kingslayer Orkus get out of the water.
english.description: *GURGLE*$B$BHELP!*GASP*$B$BORKUS IS DROWNING! HELP ME, QUEST GIVER $n!$B$B*GLUB*$B$BDwarf threw Orkus into the water! Must not die!$B$B*GURGLE*$B$BThe shame would be too great.
english.completion: I... uh... the human must have cast some type of mind-altering spell on Orkus. Orkus will explain.
english.end: Orkus Safely Escorted Out of the Water
english.completed: Speak to Kingslayer Orkus at the Ruins of Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 单身汉
text.objectives: 跟暮光高地库斯海文的科甘·焰须谈一谈婚姻大事。
text.description: 我们得把事情办成，$n。手段就是联姻！家族间的羁绊让蛮锤的氏族互相抵制。那就要用家族的羁绊把他们联系在一起。这样做风险很大，但这个红娘我们一定要当！$B$B我会去找科林·桑德玛尔谈谈。你是个文雅人——你应该去跟里面的科甘·焰须说说。他很聪明，应该能理解政治联姻。去看看他是不是有心上人了！
text.completion: What? Kurdran's talkin' marriage!? Didn't he just see me an' ol' Thunderface tearing each other new ones? The only eligible Thundermar is Fanny. Now, I'll give you this, she's got the looks allright. All lumpy in the right places, if you hear me. But she's not got that somethun' somethun' a Firebeard looks for in a woman, right?

english.title: The Bachelor
english.objectives: Discuss marriage prospects with Keegan Firebeard at Kirthaven in Twilight Highlands.
english.description: We need to make this work, $n. The answer is in the blood! Family bonds have kept these Wildhammer clans apart from one another. It'll take family bonds to glue 'em back together. It's a long shot, but we're going to have to play matchmaker!$B$BI'll track down Colin Thundermar and talk with him. You're a smooth one - you should talk to Keegan Firebeard inside. He's sharp enough to understand a political marriage. Go find out if he fancies anyone!
english.completion: What? Kurdran's talkin' marriage!? Didn't he just see me an' ol' Thunderface tearing each other new ones? The only eligible Thundermar is Fanny. Now, I'll give you this, she's got the looks allright. All lumpy in the right places, if you hear me. But she's not got that somethun' somethun' a Firebeard looks for in a woman, right?

text.title: 雷矛集合点
text.objectives: 听奥尔库斯讲述关于雷矛集合点的事情。
text.description: 我找到了老巫师赫尔库拉，希望能在对付希尔斯布莱德残存的联盟的行动中起到领导作用。$B$B赫尔库拉派我去猎杀狼人。本来这种小任务是不可能难倒奥尔库斯的，但是我吃了不少迪尔格的超美味奇美拉肉片，导致肚子痛得不得了。因此我惹上了麻烦，被扔进了大海。$B$B你听我说嘛，$n。
text.completion: I will have my vengeance, but first we must heal Kasha.
text.completed: 跟希尔斯布莱德丘陵南海镇废墟的弑君者奥尔库斯谈一谈。

english.title: Stormpike Rendezvous
english.objectives: Learn about the Stormpike Rendezvous from Orkus.
english.description: I tracked down the decrepit necromancer, Helcular, in hopes of getting a lead on Alliance movement within Hillsbrad.$B$BHelcular tasked me with finding and killing worgen. Ordinarily this would not be a problem for Orkus, but I had just eaten several helpings of Dirge's Kickin' Chimaerok chops, causing my bowels to cry out in anguish. That's when the trouble began and how I ended up in the water.$B$BHear Orkus out, $n.
english.completion: I will have my vengeance, but first we must heal Kasha.
english.completed: Speak to Kingslayer Orkus at the Ruins of Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 市场部的梅格斯
text.objectives: 跟科赞卡亚罗贸易公司总部的梅格斯·碎纸机谈一谈。
text.description: 老板，你在矿洞下面的时候，市场部的梅格斯·碎纸机找你。说是有关你新座驾的事情？$B$B出门左转就能找到她了。
text.completion: There he is! I think you're going to like this!

english.title: Megs in Marketing
english.objectives: Speak with Megs Dreadshredder at KTC Headquarters on Kezan.
english.description: Boss, while you were down at the mines, Megs Dreadshredder in marketing was asking for you. Something about your new ride?$B$BShe's right outside the building to the left.
english.completion: There he is! I think you're going to like this!

text.title: 诱捕大师
text.objectives: 苏拉赫要你从奥丹姆的野生动物身上收集5份肉卷。
text.description: 我有一件事你或许不了解，$n……$b$b我家世代都是诱捕大师。我的爷爷把技艺传给了我爸爸，我爸爸又传给了我—用最慈悲的方式捕猎动物。$b$b任何一名诱捕大师都会告诉你，一个有效的陷阱里最重要的组成部分就是诱饵。$b$b我们就从诱饵开始吧。$b$b我这里有一只桶子，我希望你用奥丹姆野生动物身上的肉卷把它装满。
text.progress: Have you got enough to fill my bucket, $n?
text.completion: Fine work, my boy! You'll master this trapping skill in no time.
text.completed: 与苏拉赫的表演场的苏拉赫交谈。

english.title: Master Trapper
english.objectives: Sullah wants you to collect 5 Meat Scraps from the wildlife in Uldum.
english.description: One thing about me that you might not know, $n...$b$bI come from a long line of trappers. My father taught me, as his taught him, to master the art of trapping creatures in a most merciful manner.$b$bAs any master trapper will tell you, the most important ingredient in an effective trap is the bait.$b$bSo let's start there.$b$bFill this bucket with the meat scraps from almost any wild creature in Uldum.
english.progress: Have you got enough to fill my bucket, $n?
english.completion: Fine work, my boy! You'll master this trapping skill in no time.
english.completed: Speak to Sullah at Sullah's Sideshow.

text.title: 潜力无限
text.objectives: 用强化笼子装起5名欢跃的俾格米。
text.description: 有人认为沙漠俾格米不过是一种害虫，过街的老鼠，乃至更糟，一种邪恶的恶魔。$b$b要我说他们根本就是误会了！$b$b正确地加以照料和看养，这些小家伙就可以变成自然慷慨的恩赐。$b$b我要你拿上这些笼子，用它们去抓几个来，我有用处。$b$b把他们装起来之前，你得给他们一顿好打才行，但到头来这还是为了他们好。$b$b你会明白的！$B$B那些俾格米就在南边！
text.completion: Splendid! This is shaping up to be better than I had dared to dream!
text.completed: Speak to Sullah at Sullah's Sideshow in Uldum.

english.title: Unlimited Potential
english.objectives: Use the Reinforced Cage to capture 5 Cavorting Pygmies.
english.description: Some see the little sand pygmy as nothing more than a pest, a vermin, or worse yet, a vile little demon.$b$bI say they are simply misunderstood!$b$bWith the proper care and guidance, these little fellows may just turn out to be a glorious gift of nature.$b$bI would like you to take these cages and use them to capture a few of them for me to work with.$b$bYou will need to give them a sound beating before boxing them up, but in the end it will be for their own good.$b$bYou'll see!$B$BGo south for pygmies!
english.completion: Splendid! This is shaping up to be better than I had dared to dream!
english.completed: Speak to Sullah at Sullah's Sideshow in Uldum.

text.title: 钟爱骆驼
text.objectives: 用苏拉赫的挽具驯服3头骆驼。
text.description: 你好，朋友！$b$b我的寒舍永远欢迎你。$b$b想找些事情做吗？苏拉赫刚好有事相求！$b$b不管怎么说，手里有几头骆驼总是好的，但在我的表演里，它们必不可少！$b$b拿上这副挽具，去把游荡的骆驼制服。$b$b你可能需要，呃，先让它服你的管才行……你知道我什么意思吧？$B$B南边的沙漠里到处都是骆驼。
text.completion: You've done it! I now have camels to spare. Perhaps one day we shall take our show on the road!
text.completed: 与苏拉赫的表演场的苏拉赫交谈。

english.title: Camel Tow
english.objectives: Use Sullah's Harness to tame 3 Camels.
english.description: Greetings, friend!$b$bYou are always most welcome in my humble tent.$b$bLooking for something to do? Sullah has just the thing!$b$bCamels are good to have in hand regardless, but when putting together a performance the likes of my sideshow, they are an absolute must!$b$bTake this harness and use it to subdue a wandering camel.$b$bYou may have to, uhh, humble it a bit first... if you know what I mean.$B$BYou'll find a desert full of wild camels to the south.
english.completion: You've done it! I now have camels to spare. Perhaps one day we shall take our show on the road!
english.completed: Speak to Sullah at Sullah's Sideshow.

text.title: 琼斯找你有事
text.objectives: 与维尔萨尔绿洲的哈里森·琼斯交谈。
text.description: 嘿，$n，你也许应该抽空回琼斯那边去看看。$b$b没准他要跟你说的事情远比我这边的事情更重要呢。
text.completion: Alright, kid. My research is complete. We're about ready to activate the final obelisk.

english.title: Jonesy Sent For You
english.objectives: Speak with Harrison Jones in the Oasis of Vir'sar.
english.description: Listen, $n, you may want to make your way back to Jonesy when you get a moment.$b$bChances are, whatever he's got to talk to you about is more pressing than anything I have for you to do.
english.completion: Alright, kid. My research is complete. We're about ready to activate the final obelisk.

text.title: 振翅高飞
text.objectives: 收集8朵泥头花。
text.description: 卡莎会再次振翅高飞的，$n。要报仇的话就得治好她！但是奥尔库斯必须待在这里陪她。求你啦！$B$B听仔细了，任务给予者。抵达这里后，我花了好几天时间四下转悠，了解地形。东面有一座废弃的农场，那里到处都是豺狼人。但是农场里生长着一种奇特的花——泥头花。替我跑一趟，为卡莎采集泥头花。装满你的背包后就赶紧回来。
text.progress: Have you recovered the mudsnout?
text.completion: This mushroom is toxic to living things, but provides a restorative boost to the undead. Let us see how Kasha reacts.
text.completed: Return to Kingslayer Orkus at the Ruins of Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: Kasha Will Fly Again
english.objectives: Gather 8 Mudsnout Blossoms.
english.description: Kasha will fly again, $n. She must if we are to claim vengeance! Sadly, Orkus must stay here with Kasha. You must help us. I beg of you!$B$BListen carefully, quest giver. When I first arrived here I flew around for days to learn the lay of the land. There is a farm east of here that has long since been abandoned and is now overrun by gnolls. On this farm grows a special type of mushroom known as the mudsnout. Go to the stead and gather mudsnout for Kasha. Return here when your pack is full.
english.progress: Have you recovered the mudsnout?
english.completion: This mushroom is toxic to living things, but provides a restorative boost to the undead. Let us see how Kasha reacts.
english.completed: Return to Kingslayer Orkus at the Ruins of Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 可怖的小兽
text.objectives: 在奈杉德哨岗杀死任意10个豺狼人。
text.description: 豺狼人！这些可怕的小东西就像瘟疫一样难缠——希尔斯布莱德丘陵属于被遗忘者的地盘，用瘟疫来形容它们再合适不过了。在奈杉德哨岗杀死你撞见的所有豺狼人。这也算是为世界除害！

english.title: Terrible Little Creatures
english.objectives: Kill any 10 Gnolls at the Nethander Stead.
english.description: Gnolls! These terrible little creatures are a blight upon any land - which is saying a lot when you consider that Hillsbrad is Forsaken territory. Kill as many of the gnolls at the Nethander Stead as you can. For the good of the world!

objectiveDetails.description: 杀死泥嘴豺狼人或萨满祭司

text.title: 先发制人
text.objectives: 在东部海滩杀死任意15只纳迦。
text.description: 这些文件显示，很快将有一场针对南海镇的攻击。联盟已经被赶出了南海镇，东部海滩的纳迦打算趁机占领镇子。$B$B我们需要你的帮助！$B$B杀死东部海滩的纳迦，并将刺脊进攻计划交给南海镇废墟的赫尔库拉。
text.completion: HAH! Those naga have some balls on them! To think that they could take Southshore from us in our own territory! Such a preposterous notion.$B$B<Helcular laughs.>$B$BYou have done well to thwart their attack - though I do wonder if they could have survived for even a minute in the blight.
text.completed: Report to Helcular at the Ruins of Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: Preemptive Strike
english.objectives: Kill any 15 Naga at the Eastern Strand.
english.description: These plans document what appears to be an imminent attack on Southshore. The naga of the Eastern Strand are planning to take over the town now that the Alliance has been pushed out.$B$BNot if you can help it!$B$BKill all of the naga on the Eastern Strand and report to Helcular at the Ruins of Southshore with the Daggerspine attack plan.
english.completion: HAH! Those naga have some balls on them! To think that they could take Southshore from us in our own territory! Such a preposterous notion.$B$B<Helcular laughs.>$B$BYou have done well to thwart their attack - though I do wonder if they could have survived for even a minute in the blight.
english.completed: Report to Helcular at the Ruins of Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 牵到树那儿去
text.objectives: 杀死8名刺枝防御者。
text.description: 那些癞皮狗以为能在我的地盘上摸来摸去，然后全身而退？我要让他们瞧瞧……$B$B当然啦，我的意思是，你要让他们瞧瞧厉害。你，还有我派到刺枝林地去的那些使斧子的地精雇佣兵大军。$B$B那地方眼下到处都是狼人。正中我们的下怀。到东南边去，加入我们的部队，干掉那些狗崽子。
text.completion: Let's hope we put down enough of them to get the message across.
text.completed: Return to Darla Drilldozer at Irontree Clearing in Felwood.

english.title: Take it to the Tree
english.objectives: Slay 8 Talonbranch Defenders.
english.description: Those mangy curs think they can just snoop around my site and get away with it? I'll show them...$B$BAnd what I mean by that is, of course, that YOU will show them. You and the small army of axe-wielding goblin hires I've sent to Talonbranch Glade.$B$BThe place will be swarming with worgen by now. Just where we want them. Head to the southeast, join up with the rest of our forces, and let some fur fly.
english.completion: Let's hope we put down enough of them to get the message across.
english.completed: Return to Darla Drilldozer at Irontree Clearing in Felwood.

text.title: 捕杀地狱火
text.objectives: 杀死6名地狱火哨兵。
text.description: 第一批踏足这片森林的恶魔就是地狱火。很久以前，这些由石头和恶魔之火构成的强大存在从天而降，为燃烧军团攻城略地。$B$B南边碎痕谷的焦坑就是这些地狱火着陆的地方，而且至今还有许多还在那里游荡。它们是凶猛的敌人，将其杀掉不但是一件值得尝试的挑战，同时也是高尚之举。$B$B任何加入捕杀队伍的人，我都提供奖赏。事成之后再回到这里来。
text.completion: I thank you for hunting in my stead, $c.$B$BI've found I must pace myself... finding too much thrill in hunting demons is a dangerous path.
text.completed: Return to Hurak Wildhorn at Whisperwind Grove in Felwood.

english.title: Hunting the Damned
english.objectives: Slay 6 Infernal Sentries.
english.description: The first demons to set foot in this forest were infernals. Long ago, these powerful beings of stone and demonic fire fell from the sky to take this land for the Burning Legion.$B$BThe charred craters of Shatter Scar Vale to the south are where these infernals landed, and many still wander there. They are fierce foes, and killing them is both a worthy challenge and a noble cause.$B$BI offer reward for those who join the hunt. Return here afterwards.
english.completion: I thank you for hunting in my stead, $c.$B$BI've found I must pace myself... finding too much thrill in hunting demons is a dangerous path.
english.completed: Return to Hurak Wildhorn at Whisperwind Grove in Felwood.

text.title: 克罗苏斯之核
text.objectives: 获得克罗苏斯的恶魔之核。
text.description: 碎痕谷最可怕的恶魔叫做克罗苏斯。尽管多年来许多人都在捕杀他，但是毁灭只会把他变得更强。$B$B一次又一次地，术士们来到这片森林，复活克罗苏斯。他现在就潜伏在东南方，被恶魔之火团团包围，等着妄图将他的力量夺走的人。$B$B我不能让这堕落的循环继续下去了！杀掉克罗苏斯，把他的恶魔之核带给我。
text.progress: The core must be kept away from Shatter Scar Vale.
text.completion: This foul chunk is what those warlocks sought year after year. I will protect it myself, or destroy it if possible, and ensure Kroshius never rises again.
text.completed: Return to Hurak Wildhorn at Whisperwind Grove in Felwood.
text.giverWindow: 夺取他的核心将终结这场循环

english.title: The Core of Kroshius
english.objectives: Obtain Kroshius' Infernal Core.
english.description: The most fearsome demon in Shatter Scar Vale is known as Kroshius. Though many have hunted him over the years, destruction has only made him stronger.$B$BTime after time, warlocks have come to this forest and reanimated Kroshius. He now lurks in the southeast, surrounded by demonic fire, awaiting any who come to try and claim his power.$B$BI will not have this corrupt cycle continue! Kill Kroshius, and bring his infernal core to me.
english.progress: The core must be kept away from Shatter Scar Vale.
english.completion: This foul chunk is what those warlocks sought year after year. I will protect it myself, or destroy it if possible, and ensure Kroshius never rises again.
english.completed: Return to Hurak Wildhorn at Whisperwind Grove in Felwood.
english.giverWindow: Taking his core will end this cycle.

text.title: 送它们一程
text.objectives: 杀死8名邪能腐化巨角鹿。
text.description: 我真的很想把森林里所有的生物都救回来，但你也看到了，有些已经病入膏肓。$B$B我们刚建立语风林地的时候，南边的林子全是漂亮的巨角鹿，庄严而温柔的生物。这里的腐化让它们变得暴力非常，令它们形同枯槁。$B$B就算将其净化，它们所知的也只有痛苦和磨难而已。拜托你，$c，帮我送它们上路。
text.completion: Thank you, $n. They won't spread the corruption any further, and they won't be in pain either.
text.completed: Return to Tender Puregrove at Whisperwind Grove in Felwood.

english.title: Running Their Course
english.objectives: Slay 8 Felrot Coursers.
english.description: I'd love so much to save every creature in the forest, but as you probably have seen, some are just too far gone.$B$BWhen we first founded Whisperwind Grove, the woods just to the south were full of beautiful coursers, majestic and gentle creatures. The corruption here hasn't made them violent, but they've wasted away to nearly nothing.$B$BEven if they were cleansed, they would know only pain and suffering. Please, $c, help put them down for me.
english.completion: Thank you, $n. They won't spread the corruption any further, and they won't be in pain either.
english.completed: Return to Tender Puregrove at Whisperwind Grove in Felwood.

text.title: 给松鼠洗澡
text.objectives: 擦拭6只被污染的松鼠。
text.description: 大型动物常常难以挽救，但你会惊讶，小动物们居然如此坚强。$B$B就拿松鼠来说吧。在被腐蚀过的水里洗过澡之后，它们会把疾病带到距离病原非常远的地方去，但病痛对其自身的影响却很缓慢。事实上，给它们洗一洗，这些松鼠就会清洁起来，而森林也将更为安全！$B$B给，拿上这瓶洗涤液。到南边的林子里，抓住你看到的松鼠，给它们擦一擦……它们会感激不尽的！
text.completion: Aren't they just adorable? It's those little victories that keep me going. We'll save this forest one squirrel at a time.
text.completed: Return to Tender Puregrove at Whisperwind Grove in Felwood.

english.title: Squirrely Clean
english.objectives: Scrub 6 Tainted Squirrels.
english.description: The larger animals are often too far corrupted to save, but you'd be surprised how hardy the little ones are.$B$BTake the squirrels, for example. After washing in corrupted water, they can spread illness far from the original source, but it's slow to affect the squirrels themselves. In fact, a simple washing will result in a clean squirrel and a safer forest!$B$BHere, take this bottle of cleaning mixture. Grab and scrub any squirrel you see in the woods to the south... they'll be thankful for it!
english.completion: Aren't they just adorable? It's those little victories that keep me going. We'll save this forest one squirrel at a time.
english.completed: Return to Tender Puregrove at Whisperwind Grove in Felwood.

text.title: 崔泽尔这笨蛋！
text.objectives: 去找魔爪村的崔泽尔。
text.description: 笨蛋，崔泽尔这笨蛋！我告诉他不要去！$B$B崔泽尔想从魔爪村多偷点钱来……你知道的吧？那地方就在西边。从悬崖这儿就能看见……$B$B总而言之……我跟他说这是个馊主意，可他还是要去，然后死木部落就把他给逮住了，然后……然后……$B$B呜呜……$B$B我不知道他们打算干什么！请你找到他，$R$g先生:小姐;！哪怕他是个笨蛋！我不想让崔泽尔被吃掉！
text.completion: Help! Please help!

english.title: Stupid Drizle!
english.objectives: Find Drizle in Felpaw Village.
english.description: Stupid, stupid Drizle! I told him not to go!$B$BDrizle wanted to steal more honey from Felpaw Village... you know, just west of here? You can see it from the cliff...$B$BAnyway... I told him it was a dumb idea but he went anyway, and then the Deadwood tribe got him, and... and...$B$BSniff...$B$BI don't know what they're gonna do! Please find him, $gMr.:Ms.; $R! Even if he is a dummy! I don't want Drizle to get eaten!
english.completion: Help! Please help!

text.title: 捅马蜂窝
text.objectives: 与苏拉赫的表演场的苏拉赫交谈。
text.description: 哇喔！$b$b听上去，你好像真的吸引了他们的注意力，$n。他们如此警惕，我们绝对不可能混进去的。$b$b肯定有什么办法……$b$b司克诺兹的人激活方尖碑只是时间问题，我得先研究一下你找到的卷轴。你得自己去想办法解决这问题了。$b$b苏拉赫在这一地区颇有些关系。也许他有办法帮我们混进去。
text.completion: You know, I believe I have just the thing!

english.title: Stirred the Hornet's Nest
english.objectives: Speak to Sullah at Sullah's Sideshow.
english.description: Wow!$b$bIt sounds like you really got their attention, $n. We're never getting in there with them on alert like this.$b$bThere must be a way...$b$bIt's just a matter of time before Schnottz's men activate the obelisk and I need to research the scrolls you found. I need you to figure this one out without me.$b$bSullah has connections in these parts. Maybe he has a solution for getting us inside.
english.completion: You know, I believe I have just the thing!

text.title: 酋长的钥匙
text.objectives: 从血喉酋长那里拿到崔泽尔的钥匙。
text.description: 呜呜……我错了！我不是故意要被逮住的！他们抓住了我，把我锁在这里！我不能动，我的腿也动不了，我还饿！$B$B他们说，酋长有钥匙……血喉酋长。他就在营地北边。$B$B但要赶快！求求你！别把我一个人丢在这儿！
text.progress: Did you get the key?
text.completion: Thank you, thank you! I'm getting out of here right away! And if Ferli sent you here... don't tell her I was crying!
text.completed: Return to Drizle at Felpaw Village in Felwood.

english.title: The Chieftain's Key
english.objectives: Retrieve Drizle's Key from Chieftain Bloodmaw.
english.description: Sniff... I'm sorry! I didn't mean to get caught! They grabbed me and put this chain on me and left me here! I can't move and my leg fell asleep and I'm hungry!$B$BThe chief has the key... Chieftain Bloodmaw, the other ones said. He's in the north end of the camp.$B$BBut hurry! Please! Don't leave me alone here!
english.progress: Did you get the key?
english.completion: Thank you, thank you! I'm getting out of here right away! And if Ferli sent you here... don't tell her I was crying!
english.completed: Return to Drizle at Felpaw Village in Felwood.

text.title: 解除熊的武装
text.objectives: 从魔爪村缴获7件死木武器。
text.description: 我宁可尽我们所能从死木部族手下保护我的人民，而不是把他们统统杀光。我们在此之前有一定的进展，如果你打算向木喉部族证明自己的话，我就要求你也这么做。$B$B到西南边去找存放在魔爪村的武器堆。你能找到多少就拿走多少。如果我们解除死木部族的武装，或许就能阻止之后的流血事件。
text.progress: Do you have the weapons?
text.completion: Thank you, $r. An action like this will go a long way towards proving yourself as an ally of the Timbermaw.
text.completed: Return to Nafien at Timbermaw Hold in Felwood.

english.title: Disarming Bears
english.objectives: Collect 7 Deadwood Weapons from Felpaw Village.
english.description: I would prefer to do as much as we can to protect my people from the Deadwood tribe without slaughtering every last one of them. We've taken steps towards this before, and if you wish to prove yourself to the Timbermaw tribe, I would ask you do this as well.$B$BLook for the piles of weapons kept in Felpaw Village to the southwest. Take as many as you find. If we disarm the Deadwood tribe, we may be able to stop some bloodshed later.
english.progress: Do you have the weapons?
english.completion: Thank you, $r. An action like this will go a long way towards proving yourself as an ally of the Timbermaw.
english.completed: Return to Nafien at Timbermaw Hold in Felwood.

text.title: 造物者的遮幕
text.objectives: 引爆7只司克诺兹火药桶。
text.description: 能交到朋友总是有好处的，$c！虽然友善本身就是一种奖励，但也会有更加实际的奖励！$b$b我的朋友最近截获了一批司克诺兹掠夺而来的货物，里面有能帮你大忙的好东西。$b$b那是一件泰坦留下的古器，可以让使用者变得几乎完全隐形。如果你在敌人的营地里使用它，就可以把它们的炸药搭错线，给他们惹些乱子。$b$b每用一次都有一定的持续时间，所以不要离安全地点太远！
text.completion: Hah! I heard it from here! I wish I could've been there to see it!
text.completed: Speak to Harrison Jones at the Oasis of Vir'sar

english.title: Shroud of the Makers
english.objectives: Sabotage 7 Schnottz Powder Kegs.
english.description: It is good to have friends, $c! While kindness is its own reward, there can be tangible benefits too!$b$bSome friends of mine recently intercepted a shipment of Schnottz's plunder and found something that should serve your needs nicely.$b$bIt's a piece of titan technology that renders the user nearly invisible. If you use it in the enemy camp, you might be able to rewire their explosives and make a mess of their operation.$b$bEach charge has a limited duration, so don't stray too far from safety!
english.completion: Hah! I heard it from here! I wish I could've been there to see it!
english.completed: Speak to Harrison Jones at the Oasis of Vir'sar

text.title: 当心爆炸！
text.objectives: 杀掉无尽燃烧者古罗维塔。
text.description: 大地保佑，伙伴！你把那些阀门关掉了可真好。$B$B不幸的是，我们遭殃的中央焚烧调整器遇上了大爆炸！达尔拉小姐已经把她能弄来的工人都派下来将其关闭了，可那些火焰有自己的想法！$B$B是真的！它们到处乱窜，附近有谁就上前逮住！所以达尔拉说，如果你能把山洞里烂摊子收拾好，把元素干掉，她就有一份丰厚的奖赏等着你！
text.completion: Well, my entire operation's nearly been ruined. But you came through in the clinch, $n. It could've been worse! I gotta hand it to you.
text.completed: Return to Darla Drilldozer at Irontree Clearing in Felwood.
text.giverWindow: 这个大混账东西不在我们的工作流程里！

english.title: Fire in the Hole!
english.objectives: Slay Grolvitar the Everburning.
english.description: Land's sakes, pardner! You done shut off those valves but good.$B$BUnfortunately we've had a critical blowout in our gosh-darned central burnoff regulator! Missus Darla's done sent as many workers as she can rustle to go shut it off, but those flames have a mind of their own!$B$BLiterally! They're hoppin' up and grabbin' anyone who comes near! So Darla says if you can muster up out of that cave you're in and beat that elemental, she's got a mighty fine prize in store for ya!
english.completion: Well, my entire operation's nearly been ruined. But you came through in the clinch, $n. It could've been worse! I gotta hand it to you.
english.completed: Return to Darla Drilldozer at Irontree Clearing in Felwood.
english.giverWindow: This big ol' varmint don't belong in our pipelines!

text.title: 我的妹妹，范妮
text.objectives: 跟暮光高地桑德玛尔的范妮·桑德玛尔谈一谈。
text.description: 你走之前，一定要到我身后的旅店里去看看。我的妹妹范妮就在里面。$B$B周围的蛮锤定居点被烧毁后，逃难的人都来到了桑德玛尔，我让范妮来照看他们。她精明强干，不过可能还是需要你的帮助。
text.completion: Me brother sent you? Good! I could use a $c. Can ya hold yer own in a fight?

english.title: My Sister, Fanny
english.objectives: Talk to Fanny Thundermar at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.
english.description: Before you go, be sure to stop by the inn behind me. My sister Fanny is inside.$B$BRefugees are pouring into Thundermar from all of the torched Wildhammer settlements around us, and I put Fanny in charge of 'em. She's tough as talons, that one. But she might need your help.
english.completion: Me brother sent you? Good! I could use a $c. Can ya hold yer own in a fight?

text.title: 绑架小精灵
text.objectives: 用达尔拉的小精灵磁吸器俘虏5只刺枝小精灵。
text.description: 你能相信吗？这儿的狼人居然有小精灵。暗夜精灵把德鲁伊的那套花招教给了他们，现在他们也有了宝贵的小精灵，用不着伤害珍贵的树木，就能获得建筑用的材料了。$B$B要是我们也有那种东西，就可以从工地上的每棵树里再多榨些木头出来。免费的资源，白来的利润！这就是为什么我一直在制作这个控制装置。$B$B到刺枝林地去，用它偷几只小精灵回来。只要瞄准然后按键就行了。
text.completion: Pretty little things, aren't they? I wonder if we can figure out how to make more of them.
text.completed: Return to Darla Drilldozer at Irontree Clearing in Felwood.

english.title: Wisp-napping
english.objectives: Use Darla's Wisp Magnet to collect 5 Talonbranch Wisps.
english.description: Can you believe these worgen here have wisps?  The night elves showed them all that druid junk and now they've got their precious little wisps too, giving them all the building material they want without having to harm any precious trees.$B$BIf we had those things, we could pull extra wood out of every tree in our site. Free resources, free profit! That's why I've been working on this containment device.$B$BHead to Talonbranch Glade and use it to steal some wisps. Just point and press the button.
english.completion: Pretty little things, aren't they? I wonder if we can figure out how to make more of them.
english.completed: Return to Darla Drilldozer at Irontree Clearing in Felwood.

text.title: [DND] ORKUS QUEST FLAG [DO NOT LOCALIZE]
text.objectives: 收集8朵泥头花。
text.description: 卡莎会再次振翅高飞的，$N。要报仇的话就得治好她！但是奥尔库斯必须待在这里陪她。求你啦！$B$B听仔细了，任务给予者。抵达这里后，我花了好几天时间四下转悠，了解地形。东面有一座废弃的农场，那里到处都是豺狼人。但是农场里生长着一种奇特的花——泥头花。替我跑一趟，为卡莎采集泥头花。装满你的背包后就赶紧回来。
text.completed: Return to Kingslayer Orkus at the Ruins of Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: [DND] ORKUS QUEST FLAG [DO NOT LOCALIZE]
english.objectives: Gather 8 Mudsnout Blossoms.
english.description: Kasha will fly again, $n. She must if we are to claim vengeance! Sadly, Orkus must stay here with Kasha. You must help us. I beg of you!$B$BListen carefully, quest giver. When I first arrived here I flew around for days to learn the lay of the land. There is a farm east of here that has long since been abandoned and is now overrun by gnolls. On this farm grows a special type of mushroom known as the mudsnout. Go to the stead and gather mudsnout for Kasha. Return here when your pack is full.
english.completed: Return to Kingslayer Orkus at the Ruins of Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 重操旧业
text.objectives: 飞到铁木工程营去跟达尔拉·钻机谈一谈。
text.description: 所有这些快乐好朋友的事情都很棒，对吧？人们携起手来，治疗森林。但是森林治疗完了会发生什么事呢？就让它这么待着？$B$B我们需要这些木料。部落需要。我收到命令，派所有忠诚的部落士兵——我肯定你是忠诚的——北上前往铁木工程营。$B$B我已经安排角鹰兽管理员让你免费飞到那里去。着陆之后跟达尔拉·钻机谈谈。
text.completion: Fez sent you, hmm? At least he's good for something.

english.title: Back to Business
english.objectives: Take a flight to Irontree Clearing and speak with Darla Drilldozer.
english.description: All this happy friends stuff is great, isn't it? People working together, healing the forest. But what's gonna happen to the forest when it's healed? It's just gonna sit there?$B$BWe need this lumber. The Horde needs it. I've got orders here to send as many loyal Horde soldiers--and I'm sure you're loyal--up north to Irontree Clearing.$B$BI've already arranged for the hippogryph master to give you a free ride over there. Talk to Darla Drilldozer when you touch down.
english.completion: Fez sent you, hmm? At least he's good for something.

text.title: 木喉要塞
text.objectives: 跟木喉要塞的纳菲恩谈一谈。木喉要塞就在东边，过了魔爪村便是。
text.description: 好吧，我知道不大可能，不过问问又不会少块肉。$B$B在我处理这个荒唐的烂摊子的时候，希望你能去跟几只熊谈谈。木喉熊怪控制着东北边的森林，而且他们不是很喜欢我们。$B$B我得要人让他们明白，部落不是那么坏的。沿着路到东北方的木喉要塞去——可别跑去魔爪村了——问问外面的熊怪有没有什么要帮忙的地方没有。
text.completion: We furbolg are not foolish, $n. We will not yield Timbermaw Hold to any askers. However, we are also in dire need of assistance. If you help us, we will grant you our favor and allow you passage.

english.title: Timbermaw Hold
english.objectives: Speak with Nafien at Timbermaw Hold in Felwood. Timbermaw Hold is to the east, past Felpaw Village.
english.description: Okay, I know this is a longshot, but I figure it never hurts to ask.$B$BWhile I deal with the fallout of all the ridiculous nonsense that just went on here, I need you to go speak to some bears. The Timbermaw furbolg control the forests to the northeast, and they're not too fond of us.$B$BI just need someone to give them the idea the Horde isn't all that bad. Head northeast up the road to Timbermaw Hold--don't go into Felpaw village--and ask the furbolg outside if they have any favors they'd like done.
english.completion: We furbolg are not foolish, $n. We will not yield Timbermaw Hold to any askers. However, we are also in dire need of assistance. If you help us, we will grant you our favor and allow you passage.

text.title: 除草
text.objectives: 拔出7株语风鞭笞者，检查它们是否遭到污染。
text.description: 在这种地方，就连摘花或是除草之类的小事都要费九牛二虎之力。$B$B生长在林地四周的鞭笞兰花是自然得到治愈的征兆，但它们也并非完美无瑕。其中一些时常会沾染上恶魔的腐蚀。$B$B我发现最好的检查办法就是把它们拔出来。如果是正常的，那它们只会四下走动一会儿，然后重新扎根。如果不是……那么，你最好做好战斗准备！
text.completion: It's hard work, but it's so rewarding when you see them growing up big and strong. When they're not covered with demonic thorns, that is!
text.completed: Return to Tender Puregrove at Whisperwind Grove in Felwood.

english.title: Weeding the Lawn
english.objectives: Pull up 7 Whisperwind Lashers to check them for corruption.
english.description: In a place like this, even something as simple as growing flowers and pulling weeds can require some heroic effort.$B$BThe orchid lashers that grow on all sides of the grove are a sign of healing. But they're not flawless; some of them do succumb to demonic corruption now and then.$B$BI've found the best way to check is to just pull them up. If they're normal, they'll wander around a bit and reroot themselves. If they aren't... well, you'd better be ready for a fight!
english.completion: It's hard work, but it's so rewarding when you see them growing up big and strong. When they're not covered with demonic thorns, that is!
english.completed: Return to Tender Puregrove at Whisperwind Grove in Felwood.

text.title: 前往赎罪岛
text.objectives: 陪伴弑君者奥尔库斯来到赎罪岛。
text.description: 报仇的时候到了，$n。在你的帮助下，卡莎已无大碍。她会载我们前往赎罪岛，对付雷矛将军范达尔以及他的副官巴琳达·斯通赫尔斯。他们将为自己的行为付出代价。$B$B你准备好了吗？奥尔库斯需要你的帮助。
text.completion: This place is dark... foreboding. It smells of piss and fur. There are definitely worgen here and very likely dwarves.
text.completed: 去找希尔斯布莱德丘陵南海镇废墟的弑君者奥尔库斯。

english.title: The Road to Purgation
english.objectives: Accompany Kingslayer Orkus to Purgation Isle.
english.description: The time of vengeance has come, $n. Kasha can once more fly, thanks to you. She will take us to Purgation Isle so that we may confront the Stormpike dwarf general, Vanndar Stormpike, and his captain, Balinda Stonehearth. BOTH will pay for what they have done.$B$BAre you ready? Orkus cannot do this alone.
english.completion: This place is dark... foreboding. It smells of piss and fur. There are definitely worgen here and very likely dwarves.
english.completed: Speak to Kingslayer Orkus at Purgation Isle in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 麦泽利安的头颅
text.objectives: 将麦泽利安的头颅交给苏拉赫的表演场的苏拉赫。
text.description: 死亡之翼麾下最可怕的一条黑龙的首级，现在已经成了你的战利品。$b$b虽然艾泽拉斯会有许多人付高价收藏这件宝贝，但你感觉到，它应该被收进博物馆，供所有人观看和铭记。$b$b哈里森·琼斯很可能知道如何处理它。$b$b苏拉赫一定会很高兴能把它交给琼斯。
text.progress: You took down that dragon!? Remarkable!
text.completion: Quite an accomplishment, $n. I'll be certain that this gets to Harrison when his expedition here is concluded.

english.title: Myzerian's Head
english.objectives: Take Myzerian's Head to Sullah at Sullah's Sideshow.
english.description: The head of one of Deathwing's most formidable black dragons is now in your possession.$b$bWhile many in Azeroth would pay dearly for such an artifact, something tells you that it belongs in a museum for all to see and remember.$b$bHarrison Jones is likely to have the proper connections.$b$bSullah would certainly be happy to deliver it to him.
english.progress: You took down that dragon!? Remarkable!
english.completion: Quite an accomplishment, $n. I'll be certain that this gets to Harrison when his expedition here is concluded.

text.title: 黏肠峡谷的营救
text.objectives: 去找暮光高地黏肠峡谷的科林·桑德玛尔。
text.description: 真是喝凉水也塞牙。范妮不见了，被食人魔给绑走了！$B$B我不相信桑德玛尔可以独力把她救出来。我会召集我的狮鹫骑士们，提供空中支援。$B$B我肯定他们不介意多一个$c去帮忙，$n。拿上你的装备，去黏肠食人魔营地找科林·桑德玛尔。那地方就在西南边，悬崖下面。赶快行动！
text.completion: Good to have you fighting at my side again, $n! And I see the Firebeards have come as well. I suppose they'll provide a distraction while me and my boys do the heavy lifting.

english.title: Rescue at Glopgut's Hollow
english.objectives: Find Colin Thundermar at Glopgut's Hollow in Twilight Highlands.
english.description: Well speak of the devil in a blue dress. Fanny's gone and gotten herself kidnapped by ogres!$B$BI don't trust the Thundermars to be able to mount a rescue on their own. I'll round up my gryphon riders and provide some air support.$B$BI'm sure they can use an extra $c down there, $n. Grab your gear and look for Colin Thundermar in the Glopgut ogre camp. It's southwest of here, below the cliffs. Hurry now!
english.completion: Good to have you fighting at my side again, $n! And I see the Firebeards have come as well. I suppose they'll provide a distraction while me and my boys do the heavy lifting.

text.title: 寻找范妮
text.objectives: 寻找并营救范妮·桑德玛尔。
text.description: 我们已经开始着手把这座营地给拆了，$n，可哪儿都没有范妮的踪影。或许你能找到她。$B$B西北边我身后的山洞还没有找过。看看你能不能在那里找到范妮！
text.completion: Fanny is safe! I hear Firebeard was in there with you? Nice to hear he's finally pulling his weight. Wait, why are you looking at me like that, $n? Do you know something I don't?
text.completed: Speak with Colin Thundermar at Glopgut's Hollow in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Find Fanny
english.objectives: Find and rescue Fanny Thundermar.
english.description: We've started tearing this camp apart, $n, but there's no sign of Fanny. Maybe you can find her.$B$BWe haven't checked the cave just behind me, to the northwest. See if you can find Fanny in the cave!
english.completion: Fanny is safe! I hear Firebeard was in there with you? Nice to hear he's finally pulling his weight. Wait, why are you looking at me like that, $n? Do you know something I don't?
english.completed: Speak with Colin Thundermar at Glopgut's Hollow in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 揍食人魔
text.objectives: 杀死10名黏肠食人魔（黏肠锤击者、黏肠投石者或者黏肠殴打者皆可）。
text.description: 黏肠食人魔！要我说他们蠢得就像一袋子锤子，相比而言我还更尊敬锤子呢。$B$B多年来我们一次次地将他们的侵袭打退，但假如他们胆敢窃取我们的镇子，我们就要让他们好看。$B$B帮我去揍那些黏肠食人魔！杀掉他们的锤击者、投石者或者殴打者，不管是外面的还是山洞里的——当然最好是后者。叫他们尝尝厉害。
text.completion: Har! My men could learn a lot by watching you work. Well done.
text.completed: Return to Colin Thundermar at Glopgut's Hollow in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Ogre Bashin'
english.objectives: Kill 10 Glopgut ogres (either Glopgut Pounders, Glopgut Hurlers, or Glopgut Bashers).
english.description: Glopgut ogres! I'd say they was dumb as a sack of hammers, but I have more respect for me hammers than that.$B$BWe've fought off their raids for years, but if they're bold enough to steal one of our own, we're gonna have to learn them a lesson.$B$BHelp us smack around some Glopgut ogres! Kill their pounders, hurlers, or bashers either out here or - better - inside the cave. That'll show 'em.
english.completion: Har! My men could learn a lot by watching you work. Well done.
english.completed: Return to Colin Thundermar at Glopgut's Hollow in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 皮克维克身陷危机
text.objectives: 跟铁木山洞的工头皮克维克谈一谈。
text.description: 这儿到底发生了什么事？工头皮克维克应该已经把阀门都关了才对。$B$B我们可以堵漏堵上一整天，但只要中央阀门关着，我们就是在拖延一场剧烈的爆炸。$B$B听好，如果你看重金钱、你的生命，或是两者之和，那你最好到南边的铁木山洞里去，看能不能找到工头皮克维克。
text.completion: It's a disaster down here! The pump's thrown, all my men in there are gone... You gotta help!

english.title: Pikwik in Peril
english.objectives: Speak with Foreman Pikwik at Irontree Cavern.
english.description: What the heck is going on here? Foreman Pikwik should've shut the valves off by now.$B$BWe can cap these leaks all day and if the central valve is off, we're just delaying an enormous explosion.$B$BListen, if you value money, your life, or either combination of the two, you'd better head south to Irontree Cavern and see if you can find Foreman Pikwik.
english.completion: It's a disaster down here! The pump's thrown, all my men in there are gone... You gotta help!

text.title: 狼巢之母
text.objectives: 飞往刺枝林地跟狼巢之母尤尔莉卡谈一谈。
text.description: 距离这里往北一个行程，地精在蹂躏森林、砍伐树木，为部落的战争机器添油加料，中饱他们自己的荷包。这些家伙口蜜腹剑，哄骗这里的德鲁伊睁一只眼闭一只眼，生怕打破微妙的中立。$B$B刺枝林地的狼人受够了。加入我们！角鹰兽管理员可以把你直接带到我们的家去。任何愿意战斗的$r，狼巢之母尤尔莉卡都欢迎。
text.completion: Welcome to the home of my pack, $c. Prepare yourself for war.

english.title: The Denmother
english.objectives: Take a flight to Talonbranch Glade and speak with Denmother Ulrica.
english.description: Barely a crow's flight to the north, goblins ravage this forest, clearcutting it to fuel the war machines of the Horde and line their own pockets. This one pays enough pleasant words and crafted lies to the druids here for them to turn a blind eye, afraid to disturb the tenuous neutrality here.$B$BThe worgen of Talonbranch Glade have had enough. Join us! The hippogryph master can take you directly to our home. Denmother Ulrica will welcome any $r who wishes to fight.
english.completion: Welcome to the home of my pack, $c. Prepare yourself for war.

text.title: 兵临根下
text.objectives: 杀死8名铁木斧兵。
text.description: 地精已经欺负到我们头上来了！$B$B在诉诸暴力之前，我们已经尽一切所能警告地精们离开铁木工程营。他们左耳进右耳出，我们只好还以颜色，他们不但没有放过森林，反倒贪婪得连命都可以搭上。$B$B他们很快就能见识到我们愤怒起来的真正样子！战斗就在北门打响。光荣地加入我们的族群，杀掉那些胆敢对抗我们的地精！
text.completion: May their blood water our tree. You fight well, $n.
text.completed: Return to Denmother Ulrica at Talonbranch Glade in Felwood.

english.title: Enemy at our Roots
english.objectives: Slay 8 Irontree Choppers.
english.description: The goblins are already upon us!$B$BWe have tried everything in our power to warn the goblins to leave Irontree Clearing before we resorted to violence. As they turned a blind ear to us, we struck, and now rather than spare the forest they would lay down their lives for greed.$B$BThey will soon know the full extent of our fury! The battle rages just beyond our northern gate. Join our pack in glory and slay any goblin who dares come before us!
english.completion: May their blood water our tree. You fight well, $n.
english.completed: Return to Denmother Ulrica at Talonbranch Glade in Felwood.

text.title: 林中精灵
text.objectives: 使用疾风软杖召回5只刺枝小精灵。
text.description: 长久以来，我在这里陪伴着狼巢之母，传播塞纳留斯关于自然的教导。她赢得了我的信任，作为回报，我则得到允许将森林的精灵介绍给她的学生们。有小精灵的陪伴是一种莫大的荣耀，也是有益的祝福。$B$B但现在地精在我们头上撒野，想要将小精灵窃走，好用来为非作歹。请你阻止这亵渎的行为！$B$B用这根被祝福的树枝将小精灵们从西边的林子里唤回来，要保护它们的安全。
text.completion: Thank you, $n. Now the Horde will not be able to defile these poor spirits to aid their brutish ways.
text.completed: Return to Lyros Swiftwind at Irontree Clearing in Felwood.

english.title: Wisps of the Woods
english.objectives: Use the Swiftwind Switch to collect 5 Talonbranch Wisps.
english.description: I have toiled long here with the Denmother to spread the teachings of Cenarius and the ways of the wild. She has gained much of my trust, and in return, I have been allowed to introduce the spirits of the forest to her students. The company of wisps is a great honor, as well as a useful blessing.$B$BBut now the goblins descend on us, and seek to steal the wisps for nefarious use. Please, prevent this blasphemy!$B$BCall the wisps back here from the western woods with this blessed branch, and keep them safe.
english.completion: Thank you, $n. Now the Horde will not be able to defile these poor spirits to aid their brutish ways.
english.completed: Return to Lyros Swiftwind at Irontree Clearing in Felwood.

text.title: 进入旷野
text.objectives: 跟铁木山洞附近的阿尔顿·雷丁谈一谈。
text.description: 一定要将铁木工程营夷为平地。要想阻止地精将毁灭散布到整座森林，我们就不能心慈手软。$B$B趁敌人被我们吸引住的时候，我最信任的保护者阿尔顿·雷丁已经带大多数族人绕到他们后面去包抄了。到西边的铁木山洞去找他。
text.completion: Welcome to the pack, $r. Let's hope you don't mind getting a bit uncivilized.

english.title: Into the Clearing
english.objectives: Speak with Alton Redding near Irontree Cavern
english.description: Irontree Clearing must be razed. We can afford no mercy if we want to prevent the goblins from spreading their destruction through the entire forest.$B$BAlton Redding, my most trusted protector, has already led much of the pack around the enemy line to strike while they are distracted here. Seek him out to the west, overlooking Irontree Cavern.
english.completion: Welcome to the pack, $r. Let's hope you don't mind getting a bit uncivilized.

text.title: 自食其油
text.objectives: 破坏铁木山洞深处的主控泵机。
text.description: 我计划利用地精的贪婪和污染，让他们自食其果。他们已经在这片土地上劫掠够了，必须要将其阻止。$B$B在我们脚下的铁木山洞深处，埋设着许多管道，用来将石油抽上地面，输送到整个旷野。这些管道都被连接在山洞底部的一个主控制泵上。$B$B到山洞里去把那口泵毁掉。由此而引起的破坏可以让我们有机会进行最后的突击。
text.completion: You flip a few switches on the pump and crank a large handle all the way to the right. There's a shuddering rumble in the nearby walls.

english.title: Oil and Irony
english.objectives: Sabotage the Master Control Pump at the bottom of Irontree Cavern.
english.description: I plan to use the goblin's greed and pollution against them. Any further despoiling of the land they have already carved here will be worth it to stop their further spread.$B$BDeep within Irontree Cavern, just below us, runs many pipes to pump oil through the ground across the entire clearing. These pipes are attached to a master control pump in the very back of the cavern.$B$BEnter the cavern and sabotage the pump. The ensuing havok will give us opportunity for our final strike.
english.completion: You flip a few switches on the pump and crank a large handle all the way to the right. There's a shuddering rumble in the nearby walls.

text.title: 借来的炸弹
text.objectives: 从铁木山洞里收集8颗铁木炸药。
text.description: 我们脚下铁木山洞里的工人们已经被赶出去了。洞穴里有别的什么动静。$B$B这对我们来说再好不过。我看到他们不少人逃的时候把炸药都丢下了……我们计划的下一部分正要用到这些炸药。$B$B进入洞穴，回收所有你能找到的被遗弃的炸弹。等你把油泵还有这事都完成了，我们就开始最后的总攻。
text.progress: Was I right? How many did you find?
text.completion: Perfect. I've had the pack gather explosives from the rest of the camp as well, and with these, we'll have just enough to get things started once the oil is flowing.
text.completed: Return to Alton Redding at Irontree Cavern in Felwood.

english.title: Borrowed Bombs
english.objectives: Collect 8 Irontree Explosives from Irontree Cavern.
english.description: The workers in Irontree Cavern below us have been driven out already. Something else has overtaken the cave.$B$BThis works in our favor. I spotted at least a few of them dropping explosives as they fled... explosives we'll need for the next part of our plan.$B$BEnter the cave and salvage any abandoned bombs you can find. When you're finished with that and the pump, we'll begin our final assault.
english.progress: Was I right? How many did you find?
english.completion: Perfect. I've had the pack gather explosives from the rest of the camp as well, and with these, we'll have just enough to get things started once the oil is flowing.
english.completed: Return to Alton Redding at Irontree Cavern in Felwood.

text.title: 火爆现场
text.objectives: 用被盗的铁木炸药点燃7座铁木工程营的原油喷口。
text.description: 你破坏了油泵，让整个营地的管道都开始爆裂。地精被井喷吓得惊慌失措，而情况还将会更糟。$B$B把这些拿来的炸药带上，将那些喷口点燃。我们要尽可能地对营地造成伤害，不能让那些石油被用来当成伐木机……或是部落战舰的燃料。
text.completion: Look at them run... the live ones, that is. Glorious.
text.completed: Return to Alton Redding at Irontree Cavern in Felwood.

english.title: Burnout
english.objectives: Use the Stolen Irontree Explosives to ignite 7 Oil Geysers in Irontree Clearing.
english.description: Your pump sabotage has caused pipes to break all over camp. The goblins are in a panic over the geysers, and it's about to get worse.$B$BTake the gathered explosives and use them to set the geysers aflame. We're going to do as much damage to the camp as we can, and keep that oil from being used to fuel shredders... or worse, Horde warships.
english.completion: Look at them run... the live ones, that is. Glorious.
english.completed: Return to Alton Redding at Irontree Cavern in Felwood.

text.title: 血钱
text.objectives: 杀死7名惊慌的工人。
text.description: 可悲的懦夫……看他们仓皇逃窜的样子！$B$B别被愚弄了，$n。一旦他们回过神来，那些地精就会把所有心思都花在砍倒树林上，将其作为部落的战备。$B$B别给他们任何机会。把铁木工程营的工人们毫不留情地杀掉……让他们知道贪婪是要付出代价的！
text.completion: Serves every last one of them right. Let's hope those in charge send the rest of their greedy scavengers somewhere else.
text.completed: Return to Alton Redding at Irontree Cavern in Felwood.

english.title: Bloody Wages
english.objectives: Slay 7 Panicking Workers.
english.description: Sad little cowards... look at them flee in panic!$B$BDon't let it fool you, $n. The second they've regained their wits, those goblins are going to spend every waking moment chopping this forest to bits and sending the pieces to the Horde's war effort.$B$BDon't give them the chance. Kill the workers throughout Irontree Clearing without mercy... show them their greed has a price!
english.completion: Serves every last one of them right. Let's hope those in charge send the rest of their greedy scavengers somewhere else.
english.completed: Return to Alton Redding at Irontree Cavern in Felwood.

text.title: 向狼巢之母报告
text.objectives: 跟刺枝林地的狼巢之母尤尔莉卡谈一谈。
text.description: 地精四散奔逃，他们的装备也遭到了摧毁，他们要么离开，要么留下来被我们轻松干掉。我们已然胜利了。$B$B你战斗得同族群里任何人一样凶猛，$n。去找狼巢之母，把捷报告诉她。我将继续守望。
text.completion: Let the goblins and all the Horde know we will not have offers of peace and sanctuary abused... most of all not in our new home. I am grateful my people have found allies as bold as you, $n. This reward will represent your bond with our pack. You will always be welcome here.

english.title: Report to the Denmother
english.objectives: Speak with Denmother Ulrica at Talonbranch Glade.
english.description: With the goblins scattered and their equipment destroyed, they'll either get the message and leave, or be easy pickings if they choose to stay. We've won here.$B$BYou've fought as fiercely as any member of the pack, $n. Return to the Denmother and let her know of our success. I'll be maintaining my watch.
english.completion: Let the goblins and all the Horde know we will not have offers of peace and sanctuary abused... most of all not in our new home. I am grateful my people have found allies as bold as you, $n. This reward will represent your bond with our pack. You will always be welcome here.

text.title: 戈洛普，戈洛普之子
text.objectives: 跟大地治愈者诺莎拉谈一谈，然后杀掉真菌占卜者戈洛普。
text.description: 戈洛普有一个儿子。他自大得要命，所以给它起名叫戈洛普。于是真菌占卜者的血脉得以延续。$B$B我要你去杀掉这名新的真菌占卜者。你的萨满盟友已经回来了，正在维罗克岩台西南他的山洞里等着你。
text.completion: Perhaps one day, we shall slay these stone troggs more swiftly than they can breed, and in so doing, end the line of fungalmancers forever. In time.
text.completed: Return to Ruberick at Therazane's Throne in Deepholm.
text.giverWindow: 蘑菇种植者本人。

english.title: Glop, Son of Glop
english.objectives: Speak to Earthmender Norsala, then kill Fungalmancer Glop.
english.description: Glop had a son. In his grave hubris, he named it Glop. And so the line of fungalmancers continues.$B$BI require you to slay this new fungalmancer. Your shaman ally has already returned, and awaits you at his cave in the southwest of Verlok Stand.
english.completion: Perhaps one day, we shall slay these stone troggs more swiftly than they can breed, and in so doing, end the line of fungalmancers forever. In time.
english.completed: Return to Ruberick at Therazane's Throne in Deepholm.
english.giverWindow: The Shroomgroomer himself.

text.title: 不休的龙母
text.objectives: 击败埃奥瑟拉。
text.description: 埃奥瑟拉永不停息，顽固不化。她嘲笑我们的统治，得有人提醒一下她的身份。$B$B你帮我拿回来的槌子还在。回到苍白栖地的西边，击打共鸣水晶。$B$B我会在那里等你，尽我所能提供帮助。让她记住教训，$c。
text.completion: You are quite skilled at bending the dragon's will, $r. I would be jealous of your agility, except that it comes with such a fragile frame.
text.completed: Return to Terrath the Steady at Therazane's Throne in Deepholm.
text.giverWindow: 不休的龙母。

english.title: The Restless Brood
english.objectives: Defeat Aeosera.
english.description: Aeosera is restless and stubborn. She scoffs at our dominance, and she needs to be reminded of her place.$B$BI still have the mallet you retrieved for me. Return to the western edge of the Pale Roost and strike the resonating crystal.$B$BI will meet you there and lend what aid I can. Put her back in her place, $c.
english.completion: You are quite skilled at bending the dragon's will, $r. I would be jealous of your agility, except that it comes with such a fragile frame.
english.completed: Return to Terrath the Steady at Therazane's Throne in Deepholm.
english.giverWindow: The restless broodmother.

text.title: 木喉部落
text.objectives: 跟木喉要塞入口处的纳菲恩谈一谈。
text.description: 木喉是熊怪部族里最后一支未遭腐化的。他们在这片土地的边缘上求生存，苦苦地坚守着位于木喉要塞的家。$B$B尽管他们是一种高傲的生物，也是迫切需要援助的。你要是想帮忙的话，从这里沿着路朝北，到木喉要塞的入口处就能找到他们。
text.completion: The druids of Talonbranch Glade have assisted us before. We are still unused to "friendly" worgen in these woods, but our people are also familiar with the sorrows of curses and corruption... Sorrows that I hope you can aid us in, $c.

english.title: The Timbermaw Tribe
english.objectives: Speak with Nafien at the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.
english.description: The Timbermaw furbolg are the last known tribe of uncorrupted furbolg. They huddle on the edge of these lands, ferociously defending their home of Timbermaw Hold.$B$BThough they are proud creatures, they are in need of much assistance. Should you wish to help, follow the road north from here, and seek them out at the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.
english.completion: The druids of Talonbranch Glade have assisted us before. We are still unused to "friendly" worgen in these woods, but our people are also familiar with the sorrows of curses and corruption... Sorrows that I hope you can aid us in, $c.

text.title: 危险的联盟
text.objectives: 在黑石深渊杀死6名火焰驱逐者，并从西区兵营的怒炉将军身上缴获将军的进攻计划书。
text.description: 军情七处关于暮光之锤和黑铁矮人的最新报告令我不安，$n。证据表明他们正在黑石山里准备发动一次联合进攻。面对这样一支联军，我们肯定不能置之不理，不过如果我们能在他们准备好之前就先下手为强，应该就可以破坏其攻势。$B$B你要到黑石深渊去，从西区兵营的怒炉将军身上弄到暮光之锤的战斗计划书。至于支援他的那些元素，不要犹豫，直接干掉。
text.progress: We cannot afford to allow the Dark Iron dwarves to ally with Twilight's Hammer.
text.completion: I'll send these plans to the king and his strategists immediately. If the Dark Irons and their Twilight allies manage to recover and attack, our men will be ready for them. Well done, $n.
text.completed: Return to Ander Germaine at the Command Center south of Stormwind's Old Town.

english.title: A Dangerous Alliance
english.objectives: Kill 6 Fireguard Destroyers and recover the General's Attack Plans from General Angerforge at the West Garrison in Blackrock Depths.
english.description: SI:7's latest report about Twilight's Hammer and Dark Iron activity worries me, $n. There's evidence that they are preparing a joint attack from within Blackrock Mountain. We'll be hard-pressed to turn back such a combined force, but if we act before they're ready to strike, we might be able to blunt the attack.$B$BYou must go into Blackrock Depths and capture the Twilight's Hammer attack plans from General Angerforge in the West Garrison. Do not hesitate to take out the elementals supporting his forces.
english.progress: We cannot afford to allow the Dark Iron dwarves to ally with Twilight's Hammer.
english.completion: I'll send these plans to the king and his strategists immediately. If the Dark Irons and their Twilight allies manage to recover and attack, our men will be ready for them. Well done, $n.
english.completed: Return to Ander Germaine at the Command Center south of Stormwind's Old Town.

text.title: 傀儡统帅的造物
text.objectives: 从黑石深渊制造厂获得5个元素模组，并且拿回元素傀儡蓝图。
text.description: 军情七处有关黑石深渊的最新情报令人很不安，$n。看来暮光之锤在和黑铁工程师阿格曼奇合作制造由元素驱动的战争傀儡。如果这些傀儡被用来对付我们，那么它们就将是一件极其可怕的武器。$B$B你必须将其阻止，$n。在黑石深渊找到制造厂，缴获他用来制造傀儡的蓝图，把用来启动它们的元素模组拿走。
text.progress: We cannot afford to allow those golems to be used against us.
text.completion: I know a couple of engineers who will want to take a look at those plans. They won't be using these golems anytime soon. Good work, $n.
text.completed: Return to Wulf Hansreim at the Command Center south of Stormwind's Old Town.

english.title: The Golem Lord's Creations
english.objectives: Obtain 5 Elemental Modules from the golems in the Manufactory of Blackrock Depths and recover the Elemental Golem Blueprints.
english.description: The latest SI:7 intelligence on Blackrock Depths is troubling, $n. It appears Twilight's Hammer is working with the Dark Iron engineer, Argelmach, to create war golems powered by elementals. These golems could prove to be a devastating weapon if used against us.$B$BYou must prevent that from happening, $n. Find the Manufactory in Blackrock Depths, capture the blueprints he's using to make those golems, and recover the elemental modules he's using to power them.
english.progress: We cannot afford to allow those golems to be used against us.
english.completion: I know a couple of engineers who will want to take a look at those plans. They won't be using these golems anytime soon. Good work, $n.
english.completed: Return to Wulf Hansreim at the Command Center south of Stormwind's Old Town.

text.title: 给纳菲恩的羽毛
