text.completion: 做的好，$N!我会让我的族人都知道你的行为。$B$B记得把你找到的羽毛带给我。只要还有需要，我会继续收下它们。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Nafien in Felwood.

english.title: Feathers for Nafien
english.completion: Well done, $n!  I will make sure that your deeds are known amongst my kind. Remember to bring any of the feathers you find to me.  I will continue to accept them as long as necessary.
english.completed: Return to Nafien in Felwood.

text.title: 给格拉兹的羽毛
text.progress: While you have proven yourself to me, you may need to continue to work toward proving yourself to the suspicious brethren of my tribe.  To that end, I may be able to continue assisting you.$B$BSome of the Deadwood furbolgs wear a distinctive headdress that may be used as a means of proof in thinning their numbers.  Bring me a feather from any headdresses you acquire; for every set of five you bring me, you will earn recognition amongst the Timbermaw.
text.completion: 做的好，$N!我会让我的族人都知道你的行为。$B$B记得把你找到的羽毛带给我。只要还有需要，我会继续收下它们。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Grazle in Felwood.

english.title: Feathers for Grazle
english.progress: While you have proven yourself to me, you may need to continue to work toward proving yourself to the suspicious brethren of my tribe.  To that end, I may be able to continue assisting you.$B$BSome of the Deadwood furbolgs wear a distinctive headdress that may be used as a means of proof in thinning their numbers.  Bring me a feather from any headdresses you acquire; for every set of five you bring me, you will earn recognition amongst the Timbermaw.
english.completion: Well done, $n!  I will make sure that your deeds are known amongst my kind. Remember to bring any of the feathers you find to me.  I will continue to accept them as long as necessary.
english.completed: Return to Grazle in Felwood.

text.title: 他们料不到吧……
text.objectives: 在赎罪岛上杀死8名雷矛矮人和8名血牙哨兵。
text.description: 他们那时候没杀死我，真是犯了个大错。大概以为我会淹死吧。呸！他们要为自己的粗心大意付出代价了。$B$B我们要彻底摧毁这座岛屿，$n。料不到了吧！杀光他们手下的士兵，然后再对付这两个家伙。留意一下有没有进攻计划。如果能拿到的话，我们就可以粉碎他们的入侵行动了！$B$B来吧，$n。
text.completion: Look upon the carnage, $n. You and I make quite the team! Now to find those plans and deal with their leaders.
text.completed: Speak to Kingslayer Orkus at Purgation Isle in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: They Will Never Expect This...
english.objectives: Kill 8 Stormpike Dwarves and 8 Bloodfang Sentries on Purgation Isle.
english.description: They made a mistake by not killing me when they had the chance. Perhaps they thought Orkus would drown. HAH! Now they will pay the price for their carelessness.$B$BYou and I will tear this island apart, $n. They will never expect this! Once all of their soldiers are dead we will confront the leaders. Be on the lookout for attack plans. If we can get our hands on their plans we will be able to put a stop to their whole invasion!$B$BLet's go, $n!
english.completion: Look upon the carnage, $n. You and I make quite the team! Now to find those plans and deal with their leaders.
english.completed: Speak to Kingslayer Orkus at Purgation Isle in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 控火师的魔典
text.objectives: 杀掉6个暮光使者，并从石深渊索瑞森神殿控火师罗格雷恩的身上获得罗格雷恩的魔典。
text.description: 黑铁大军和他们盟友暮光之锤的势力在黑石山日趋壮大。控火师罗格雷恩是一位知名的大法师，他在暮光之锤的部队中扮演着重要的领导角色。如果我们能拿到他的魔典，说不定我就能研究出反制的法术，以及其他办法来削弱他们的元素魔法。$B$B你必须到黑石深渊下面的索瑞森神殿去，缴获那本魔典。不要给罗格雷恩和他的暮光爪牙留情。
text.progress: Have you managed to capture the pyromancer's grimoire?
text.completion: I've already seen a dozen spells I never knew existed. This will be most helpful, $n.
text.completed: Return to Maginor Dumas at the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind's Mage Quarter.

english.title: The Pyromancer's Grimoire
english.objectives: Kill 6 Twilight Emissaries and recover Loregrain's Grimoire from Pyromancer Loregrain at the Shrine of Thaurissan in Blackrock Depths.
english.description: The power of the Dark Iron forces and their Twilight's Hammer allies is growing within Blackrock Mountain. Pyromancer Loregrain, a magus of renown, plays an important role in leading the Twilight's Hammer forces there. If we could get our hands on his grimoire, I might be able to devise counterspells and other ways of dampening their elemental magics.$B$BYou must descend into Blackrock Depths, locate the Shrine of Thaurissan, and capture the grimoire. Show Loregrain and his Twilight minions no mercy.
english.progress: Have you managed to capture the pyromancer's grimoire?
english.completion: I've already seen a dozen spells I never knew existed. This will be most helpful, $n.
english.completed: Return to Maginor Dumas at the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind's Mage Quarter.

text.title: 绑缚之石
text.objectives: 从黑石深渊找到6块元素束缚之石。你可以在暗炉城、住宅区、索瑞森神殿、东区兵营，以及西区兵营这些地方找到它们。
text.description: 可靠消息，军情七处已经在关注黑石深渊暮光之锤和黑铁矮人勾搭的事情了。我们可以据此行动，向联盟证明我们的价值，并同时为我们自己捞点好处。$b$b报告指出暮光之锤的追随者们在暗炉城、住宅区、索瑞森神殿、东区兵营，以及西区兵营这些地方放置了一系列的元素束缚之石。找到并缴获那些石头！
text.progress: Have you managed to find those binding stones?
text.completion: The binding stones you brought back are exceedingly powerful. It will likely take me years to learn all their secrets, but I'm certain they'll prove most useful. Thank you, $n.
text.completed: Return to Demisette Cloyce beneath the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind's Mage Quarter.

english.title: Stones of Binding
english.objectives: Recover 6 Elemental Binding Stones from Blackrock Depths. You can find the stones in Shadowforge City, the Domicile, the Shrine of Thaurissan, the East Garrison, and the West Garrison.
english.description: I have it on good authority that SI:7 is concerned about collaboration between Twilight's Hammer and the Dark Iron dwarves in Blackrock Depths. We can act on this information, prove our value to the Alliance, and gain something for ourselves at the same time.$B$BThe report mentions that the Twilight's Hammer followers have placed a number of elemental binding stones throughout Shadowforge City, the Domicile, the Shrine of Thaurissan, the West Garrison and the East Garrison. Find and capture those stones!
english.progress: Have you managed to find those binding stones?
english.completion: The binding stones you brought back are exceedingly powerful. It will likely take me years to learn all their secrets, but I'm certain they'll prove most useful. Thank you, $n.
english.completed: Return to Demisette Cloyce beneath the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind's Mage Quarter.

text.title: 部落的英雄！
text.objectives: 偷走联盟进攻计划，成为部落的英雄。
text.description: 接下来，我们要找到进攻计划并对付那两名头目！一旦获胜，高阶督军就会赐予我们奖励！这位兽人可是个了不起的人物，他曾参与银松森林的战斗，现在负责镇守位于希尔斯布莱德中心的塔伦米尔。我们将成为部落的英雄，$n！$B$B前进！让我们一起击败联盟的头目吧！
text.progress: <High Warlord Cromush looks somber.>
text.completion: He will be honored as a hero of the Horde, just as he always hoped. What you and Orkus did will save hundreds of lives and ensure that our foothold in Hillsbrad is not lost.
text.completed: Give the Alliance Battle Plans to High Warlord Cromush at Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: Heroes of the Horde!
english.objectives: Steal the Alliance Battle Plans and Become Heroes of the Horde.
english.description: Now to find their battle plans and take out their leaders! Should we succeed there is an orc high warlord who served in the war in Silverpine that is now stationed at Tarren Mill - located in the heart of Hillsbrad. He will grant both of us commendations for this! We will be heroes of the Horde, $n!$B$BOnward! Together we will defeat the Alliance filth!
english.progress: <High Warlord Cromush looks somber.>
english.completion: He will be honored as a hero of the Horde, just as he always hoped. What you and Orkus did will save hundreds of lives and ensure that our foothold in Hillsbrad is not lost.
english.completed: Give the Alliance Battle Plans to High Warlord Cromush at Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 炎魔之王的奴隶们
text.objectives: 用自由图腾在黑石深渊解放6名火焰卫士、火焰驱逐者或炽热火焰卫士的精华。
text.description: 暮光之锤邪教和黑铁矮人正在黑石深渊里集结兵力。被炎魔之王拉格纳罗斯所束缚的，为其效命的大量火元素在他们后面压阵。$B$B如果我们能把这些元素从束缚中解放出来，就不但能削弱敌人，还能尽我们的本职。带上这根图腾，对那些被制约住的元素使用。它将把它们的灵魂从约束中解放出来，恢复其自然的天性。
text.completion: You have truly served both the Alliance and your calling as a $c.
text.completed: Return to Farseer Umbra in the Dwarven District of Stormwind.

english.title: Slaves of the Firelord
english.objectives: Use the Totem of Freedom to free the essences of 6 Fireguards, Fireguard Destroyers, or Blazing Fireguards in Blackrock Depths.
english.description: Within the halls of Blackrock Depths, the Twilight's Hammer cult and the Dark Iron dwarves are gathering their forces. Backing up their legions are hordes of fire elementals bound to the service of the firelord, Ragnaros.$B$BIf we can free those elementals from their bonds, we can both weaken our enemies and honor the elements. Take this totem with you and use it on subdued fireguards. It will free their spirits from their bondage and restore them to their natural state.
english.completion: You have truly served both the Alliance and your calling as a $c.
english.completed: Return to Farseer Umbra in the Dwarven District of Stormwind.

text.title: 司克诺兹可真快
text.objectives: 在月亮密室中杀死10个司克诺兹精锐士兵。
text.description: 我差不多准备好了，$n。$b$b你的卷轴包含了足够的信息，可以用来推断出它们的加密规则。现在我只需翻译这些密码就成了。$b$b我要你去侦察一下月亮方尖碑下面的房间。那里很可能有一些躲过了爆炸的司克诺兹的部队。$B$B你去解决他们，我翻译好之后就去找你会合。
text.completion: Alright, $n. I think everything is in order. Let's do this!
text.completed: Speak to Harrison Jones in the Chamber of the Moon.

english.title: Schnottz So Fast
english.objectives: Kill 10 Schnottz Elite Troopers in the Chamber of the Moon.
english.description: I'm nearly ready, $n.$b$bYour scrolls contained enough information to discern their encryption method. Now all that's left is for me to translate the codes.$b$bI need you to scout out the chamber beneath the Obelisk of the Moon. There are likely to be a few of Schnottz's troops down there that escaped your blast.$b$bYou take care of them and I'll meet you there when I'm finished.
english.completion: Alright, $n. I think everything is in order. Let's do this!
english.completed: Speak to Harrison Jones in the Chamber of the Moon.

objectiveDetails.description: 杀死司克诺兹精锐士兵

text.title: 错误数据
text.objectives: 在月亮密室中与哈里森·琼斯一起行动。
text.description: 这间大厅里应该有两个泰坦通讯装置。$b$b如果我的翻译没错的话，其中一个是致命的陷阱，而另一个可以接收密码，启动方尖碑。$b$b希望我没搞错。$b$b等你准备好了就告诉我。
text.completion: Okay, $n. I think I can do this manually, but I'll need your help.
text.completed: Speak to Harrison Jones in the Chamber of the Moon.

english.title: Bad Datas
english.objectives: Accompany Harrison Jones in the Chamber of the Moon.
english.description: There should be two titan communication devices in this chamber.$b$bIf my translations are correct, one is a death trap and the other will accept the codes and activate the obelisk.$b$bLet's hope I get this right.$b$bLet me know when you're ready.
english.completion: Okay, $n. I think I can do this manually, but I'll need your help.
english.completed: Speak to Harrison Jones in the Chamber of the Moon.

text.title: 我亲自来做
text.objectives: 击败泰坦守护者。
text.description: 嗯，这些看起来都很熟悉。$b$b感谢你为我收集到的情报，我相信我可以激活这台装置。只需要一点时间就好了。$b$b等我开始之后，估计那个泰坦的造物会启动并阻止我。$B$B这时候就该你上场啦。$B$B不需要我来提醒你要怎么办吧？把那个守护者干掉就行！
text.completion: That should do it. Stand back!
text.completed: Speak to Harrison Jones in the Chamber of the Moon.

english.title: I'll Do It By Hand
english.objectives: Defeat the Titanic Guardian.
english.description: Yes, this all looks familiar enough.$b$bThanks to all the information you gathered for me, I'm sure that I can activate the mechanism. I'll just need some time free from distraction.$b$bAs soon as I get started, you can count on that titan construct to try and stop me.$b$bThat's where you come in.$b$bI don't need to remind you of what's riding on this. Take down that guardian!
english.completion: That should do it. Stand back!
english.completed: Speak to Harrison Jones in the Chamber of the Moon.

text.title: 黑暗的武器
text.objectives: 从黑石深渊的铁怒矮人身上缴获5把元素灌能武器，然后在暗炉城的黑铁砧上将它们敲断。
text.description: 长年来，黑石深渊就是我们敌人的老家，但现在军情七处报告说黑铁矮人和暮光之锤加大了合作力度。在邪教的帮助下，黑铁矮人将元素的力量灌注在他们的武器里，然后用这些可怕的新兵器武装铁怒军团。$B$B我要你进入黑石深渊，从铁怒矮人身上把那些武器缴下来，然后在暗炉城心脏地带的黑铁砧上将它们打断。
text.completion: Thanks to your efforts, those weapons will never shed Alliance blood. Excellent work, $n.
text.completed: Return to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker at the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind's Cathedral District.

english.title: Weapons of Darkness
english.objectives: Capture 5 Elemental-Imbued Weapons from Anvilrage dwarves in Blackrock Depths, then break them over the Black Anvil in Shadowforge City.
english.description: Blackrock Depths has long been home to our enemies, but now SI:7 sends word that the Dark Irons and Twilight's Hammer are increasing their collaboration. Using the knowledge of the cult, the Dark Iron dwarves are imbuing their weapons with elemental powers. They've outfitted the Anvilrage legion with these fearsome new weapons.$B$BI want you to go into Blackrock Depths and gather the weapons from the Anvilrage dwarves there and break them over the Black Anvil in the heart of Shadowforge City.
english.completion: Thanks to your efforts, those weapons will never shed Alliance blood. Excellent work, $n.
english.completed: Return to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker at the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind's Cathedral District.

starters.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

text.title: 黑铁大军
text.objectives: 用速效毒药污染黑石深渊西区军营或东区军营的6份谷物军粮。
text.description: 黑石山的情况变得有意思起来，$n。我们的情报显示黑铁矮人和暮光之锤紧密地勾搭在了一起，在准备一次全面的进攻。$B$B我已经把报告的内容告诉给暴风城的关键领导人了，现在我要你帮忙处理这一紧急的黑铁威胁。$B$B黑铁大军的口粮大部分都存放在黑石深渊的东区和西区兵营。带上这份毒药，给他们的粮草下毒。
text.completion: With any luck, the poison will take out a fair number of their frontline troops before they know what's happening. That should stall them for the near future. SI:7 is most pleased with your work.
text.completed: Return to Lord Tony Romano at SI:7, south of Stormwind's Old Town.

english.title: The Dark Iron Army
english.objectives: Use the Fast-Acting Poison to contaminate 6 Grain Rations in the West Garrison or East Garrison of Blackrock Depths.
english.description: Things are getting interesting in Blackrock Mountain, $n. Our sources report that the Dark Iron dwarves have formed closer ties with Twilight's Hammer and both are preparing for a major offensive.$B$BI've made the contents of the report known to key leaders in Stormwind and I want you to help deal with this emerging Dark Iron threat.$B$BThe rations for most of the Dark Iron army are kept in the East and West Garrison of Blackrock Depths. Take this poison and apply it to their grain reserves.
english.completion: With any luck, the poison will take out a fair number of their frontline troops before they know what's happening. That should stall them for the near future. SI:7 is most pleased with your work.
english.completed: Return to Lord Tony Romano at SI:7, south of Stormwind's Old Town.

text.title: 未婚女子
text.objectives: 跟暮光高地库斯海文的范妮谈一谈。
text.description: 焰须？娶我的妹妹！？我敢说这世界一定是疯了，$n！$B$B不过，也许库德兰是对的。一场美满的婚姻可以抚平所有人的心灵……说不定还能让焰须冷静冷静。能在这里齐心协力对抗食人魔真是不错。$B$B那么好吧！都听范妮的。我有预感，她是不会愿意被束缚住的。$B$B飞回库斯海文，看看她是否愿意。我来把食人魔的脏活收拾完。
text.completion: You, Kurdran, Firebeard, and now my brother - everyone's got wedding fever! Fine, fine, I'll marry Keegan Firebeard. But only 'cuz he's strong and handsome, with a jaw that can cut gravel and an arse like an anvil. Not for any political reasons. We're going to need your help, though. We got a whole lotta wedding to put together, and not a lot of time to do it.

english.title: The Bachelorette
english.objectives: Talk to Fanny at Kirthaven in Twilight Highlands.
english.description: Firebeard? Marry my sister!? I swear the world's gone mad, $n!$B$BStill, maybe Kurdran is right. A nice normal wedding would ease everyone's mind... and maybe cool off Firebeard a little. It was great to actually work together here against the ogres.$B$BRight then! It's all up to Fanny. Something tells me she won't want to be tied down.$B$BFly back to Kirthaven and see if she's game. I'll finish up the nasty business with the ogres here.
english.completion: You, Kurdran, Firebeard, and now my brother - everyone's got wedding fever! Fine, fine, I'll marry Keegan Firebeard. But only 'cuz he's strong and handsome, with a jaw that can cut gravel and an arse like an anvil. Not for any political reasons. We're going to need your help, though. We got a whole lotta wedding to put together, and not a lot of time to do it.

text.title: 大胆
text.objectives: 收集12根完好的猫头鹰羽毛。
text.description: 根据传统，蛮锤的新娘要穿一身白，象征纯洁。此外，她们还要戴一顶黑色羽毛做成的头冠——来表现她们的大胆放肆。$B$B猫头鹰羽毛最能表现这一点，而范妮又再合适不过。高地有种土生的棕色猫头鹰。它们就盘旋在悬崖边的树上，把它们的羽毛拿来。$B$B很可能，你得先把它们给宰了才行。
text.progress: Have you Fanny's feathers?
text.completion: Ah, you work fast. Bold feathers for a bold woman. Well done!
text.completed: Take the feathers to Lachlan MacGraff at Kirthaven in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Something Bold
english.objectives: Collect 12 Pristine Owl Feathers.
english.description: By tradition, Wildhammer brides wear white to show their purity. In addition, they wear a crown of black feathers - to show their CHUTZPAH.$B$BOwl feathers make the boldest statement, and Fanny deserves nothing less. Tawny owls are native to the Highlands. Look for them circling near trees that grow along the cliffs, and take their feathers.$B$BYou'll probably want to kill 'em, first.
english.progress: Have you Fanny's feathers?
english.completion: Ah, you work fast. Bold feathers for a bold woman. Well done!
english.completed: Take the feathers to Lachlan MacGraff at Kirthaven in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 好酒
text.objectives: 跟库斯海文东边路上的哈缪汉德谈一谈，护送补给车队回镇子里。
text.description: 庆祝蛮锤的婚礼却没有酒，那就形同侮辱。库德兰亲自要了几桶少有的雷霆啤酒运到滩头堡的海岸上，但车队没能通过小径。$B$B沿着路朝东，绕过落雷山的南侧，就能发现车队。去找一个叫做哈缪汉德的家伙，帮他把酒运过小径！
text.completion: Ahh, Russell the Bard is always raving about Thundermar Lager. I guess it doesn't have the kick of a good Wildhammer brew, but he goes on and on about the "body" or "flavor." I guess we'll find out, eh?
text.completed: Talk to Lachlan MacGraff at Kirthaven in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Something Brewed
english.objectives: Speak with Hammelhand on the road East of Kirthaven, and escort a supply caravan back to town.
english.description: It would be an insult to celebrate a Wildhammer wedding without drink. Kurdran himself called for a few kegs of rare Thunderbrew Lager to be sent ashore from Highbank, but the caravan can't get through the pass.$B$BFollow the road east of here, around the south side of Thunderstrike Mountain, and catch up with the caravan. Look for a fellow named Hammelhand, and help him get the booze through the pass!
english.completion: Ahh, Russell the Bard is always raving about Thundermar Lager. I guess it doesn't have the kick of a good Wildhammer brew, but he goes on and on about the "body" or "flavor." I guess we'll find out, eh?
english.completed: Talk to Lachlan MacGraff at Kirthaven in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 取货
text.objectives: 获得一匹精致的深色布料。
text.description: 每个人都想穿得漂漂亮亮的，可高地没那么多华丽衣裳。$B$B我听说海上的地精混账们用最好的丝线修补飞艇的气层。真浪费！$B$B找一艘在龙喉港和卡拉兹工坊来回的飞艇，从甲板下面的仓储里弄点丝绸来。
text.progress: How did the air raid go?
text.completion: Oh, aye! Kilts for the gents, gowns for the bridesmaids. Just don't tell the ladies they're wearing clothes fit for a blimp.
text.completed: Bring the cloth to Lachlan MacGraff at Kirthaven in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Something Stolen
english.objectives: Collect a bolt of Fine Dark Cloth.
english.description: Everyone's going to want to dress their best for this, and finery is in short supply in the Highlands.$B$BI understand that those goblin wretches off the coast use the finest silk for repairing their zeppelin air envelopes. A waste!$B$BFind a zeppelin flying back and forth between Dragonmaw Port and the Krazzworks, and liberate some silk from the cargo hold in the lower decks.
english.progress: How did the air raid go?
english.completion: Oh, aye! Kilts for the gents, gowns for the bridesmaids. Just don't tell the ladies they're wearing clothes fit for a blimp.
english.completed: Bring the cloth to Lachlan MacGraff at Kirthaven in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 烹煮
text.objectives: 收集8块新鲜的鹿肉和5根座狼肋骨。
text.description: 最后，我们需要举办一场宴会。不准上什么“零食”！群众要的是肉，大量的肉。$B$B高地的公母鹿身上可以弄到鹿肉。高地座狼味道也不错——弄点肋排来。我们要给你开开眼，朋友，让你见识见识东部王国前所未有的宴会。
text.progress: What's the food situation, $n?
text.completion: Lookat that! You're practically bent double under the weight of all that meat. I'd better get my people cooking.
text.completed: Take the food back to Lachlan MacGraff at Kirthaven in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Something Stewed
english.objectives: Gather 8 slabs of Fresh Venison and 5 Worg Ribs.
english.description: Finally, we're going to need a feast. And none of that "finger food" stuff! This crowd wants meat, and lots of it.$B$BGather up venison from Highland elk and does. Highland worg are good eatin' too - bring back some ribs. We'll show you a feast like you've never had in all the Eastern Kingdoms, friend.
english.progress: What's the food situation, $n?
english.completion: Lookat that! You're practically bent double under the weight of all that meat. I'd better get my people cooking.
english.completed: Take the food back to Lachlan MacGraff at Kirthaven in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 作词作曲
text.objectives: 跟罗素·布鲁尔谈一谈，帮他把歌写出来。
text.description: 我一生写过不少传世之作，$n，可即将来临的婚事得有一首特别的曲子。还得要快。$B$B我是该写一首情歌呢？还是快乐的小乐曲？还是下流的劝酒歌？$B$B我需要有人帮我想词，你愿意的话可以试试。$B$B跟我谈谈，咱们一起写一首出来！
text.completion: Well, it's catchy, that's for sure. But is it a classic?
text.completed: Talk to Russell Brower at Kirthaven in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Words and Music By...
english.objectives: Talk to Russell Brower and help him write a song.
english.description: I've written many an epic tune in my lifetime, $n, but this upcoming wedding deserves a very special ballad. And fast!$B$BShould I write a love song? A lighthearted ditty? A bawdy drinking song?$B$BI could use some help with the lyrics, if you fancy a go at it.$B$BTalk to me and we'll write a song together!
english.completion: Well, it's catchy, that's for sure. But is it a classic?
english.completed: Talk to Russell Brower at Kirthaven in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 破门得分
text.objectives: 钻进锈水海盗队伐木机，将足球炸弹踢过对方的烟囱球门，赢得比赛。
text.description: 全都看你的了，孩子。你摧毁了热砂港大鲨鱼队，现在剩下来要做的就是破门。$B$B<教练靠过来在你耳边低语道。>$B$B现在，你我之间私下说说，我想只是进球也太容易了。我要你不止是破门……我要你把它踢得更远，直穿过球门后面的两根烟囱！$B$B我已经把足球炸弹调整过了，可以给你提供所需要的额外动力。$B$B现在上场去给我争光吧！
text.completion: Uh... you did it, kid. You REALLY did it! We won the game and.... DID YOU SEE THAT DRAGON?!!!
text.completed: Return to Coach Crosscheck at Kajaro Field on Kezan.

english.title: Fourth and Goal
english.objectives: Get in the Bilgewater Buccaneer and score the winning goal by kicking the Footbomb through the smokestacks behind the opposing goal.
english.description: It's all up to you, kid. You demolished the Steamwheedle Sharks, so now all that's left to do is to kick the winning goal.$B$B<The coach leans in close and whispers in your ear.>$B$BNow, just between you and me, I think we should do this one right. I don't want you to just kick a goal... I want you to kick it so far it sails between the two smokestacks behind the goal!$B$BI've modified the footbomb to give you the extra power that you'll need.$B$BNow get out there and make me proud!
english.completion: Uh... you did it, kid. You REALLY did it! We won the game and.... DID YOU SEE THAT DRAGON?!!!
english.completed: Return to Coach Crosscheck at Kajaro Field on Kezan.

text.title: 七个！对！
text.objectives: 收集7只火焰蜂。
text.description: 我们必须采取行动。温奇和戈泰什打了起来，我策划了一个友好典礼，帮他们弥补彼此的关系。一切都进展顺利，直到……$b$b嗯，你知道接下来发生了什么事的。$b$b我连饮料都买了！$b$b温奇喜欢火焰蜂。他几乎每晚都要跑去捉那玩意。我想，也许他就是到那边去了。$b$b你可以在西边和北边找到火焰蜂，有岩浆的地方就有火焰蜂。给我抓七只来，快一点！$b$b说不定下一个跑掉的就是戈泰什了！
text.progress: <Oralius grasps at the air, lifts his fist, and peers hopefully between his clenched fingers.>
text.completion: You'll never guess what happened!  Winky came back!  No flameflies needed. Can a dwarf get a celebratory belly rub?  Come on now!  RUBBA MAH BELLY!
text.completed: Return to Oralius at Morgan's Vigil in Burning Steppes.

english.title: SEVEN! YUP!
english.objectives: Gather 7 Flameflies.
english.description: We have to take action.  Winky and Gor'tesh were fighting, so I planned this friendship ceremony to help the two of them make up.  Everything was going well, until...$b$bWell, you know the rest.$b$bI even bought drinks!$b$bWinky loves flameflies.  He runs off to chase them most every night.  I'm thinking maybe that's where he went.$b$bYou'll find flameflies to the west and north, wherever you find lava.  Bring me seven of them, and hurry!$b$bGor'tesh might leave next!
english.progress: <Oralius grasps at the air, lifts his fist, and peers hopefully between his clenched fingers.>
english.completion: You'll never guess what happened!  Winky came back!  No flameflies needed. Can a dwarf get a celebratory belly rub?  Come on now!  RUBBA MAH BELLY!
english.completed: Return to Oralius at Morgan's Vigil in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 燃烧的复仇
text.objectives: 杀死5名黑石驭龙者和5只火鳞小龙。
text.description: $n…是你吗？！我以为你和其他人一起死了！$b$b是的，你一直很强，就算当初在赤脊山的时候你就已经很强了。$b$b我们的战斗还未结束，$n。他们曾经攻击过我的家乡。我来到这里就是为了确保这种事情不再发生。$b$b如果你还能像那天一样的战斗，那么就加入我的行列。你可以从南方的雏龙丘陵开始，杀死他们的驭龙者和刚刚孵化的黑龙。$b$b这就像是旧日时光重现。
text.completion: Glad to have you on my side, $n.  Bravo Company reunited, right? Oh, did I mention that Troteman's here, too?
text.completed: Return to John J. Keeshan at Flamestar Post in Burning Steppes.

english.title: Burning Vengeance
english.objectives: Slay 5 Blackrock Whelpers and 5 Flamescale Broodlings.
english.description: $n... is that you?  I thought you were dead, with the rest of them!$b$bNo, you were always strong, even back then, even in Redridge.$b$bOur fight's not over, $n.  They already attacked our homeland once.  I'm here to make sure it doesn't happen again.$b$bIf you can still fight like you did back in the day, then join me.  You can start by heading south, to the Whelping Downs, and slaying their whelpers and their hatchling black dragons.$b$bIt'll be like old times.
english.completion: Glad to have you on my side, $n.  Bravo Company reunited, right? Oh, did I mention that Troteman's here, too?
english.completed: Return to John J. Keeshan at Flamestar Post in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 无辜
text.objectives: 取得一只获救的红色雏龙、一只获救的绿色雏龙、一只获救的蓝色雏龙和一只获救的青铜雏龙。
text.description: 燃烧平原上的黑石兽人在为一个黑暗的主人卖命——他用活物来进行扭曲的实验，以创造属于自己的怪兽军队。他的实验品中，有许多像他本人一样堕落的家伙，但其他人则是完全无辜的。$b$b在南边的雏龙丘陵，他们将雏龙捆在地上，准备拿它们进行这种邪恶的实验。我不能容忍这种事。破坏它们的锁链，把雏龙带回来给我……让它们获得安全。
text.progress: I hope we weren't too late.
text.completion: I will see to it that these dragons are taken care of.
text.completed: Return to Mouton Flamestar at Flamestar Post in Burning Steppes.

english.title: Done Nothing Wrong
english.objectives: Obtain a Freed Red Whelpling, a Freed Green Whelpling, a Freed Blue Whelpling, and a Freed Bronze Whelpling.
english.description: The Blackrock orcs of the steppes serve a dark master -  one who performs twisted experiments on living creatures to create his own menagerie of abominations.  Many of his test subjects are as corrupted as their master, but others are completely innocent.$b$bIn the whelping downs to the south, they chain baby dragons to the ground, preparing them for such experiments.  I will not stand for this.  Break their fetters and return the hatchlings to me... to safety.
english.progress: I hope we weren't too late.
english.completion: I will see to it that these dragons are taken care of.
english.completed: Return to Mouton Flamestar at Flamestar Post in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 燃烧的复仇
text.objectives: 杀死5名黑石驭龙者和5只火鳞小龙。
text.description: 我天生就是个黑石兽人，幼年的大部分时光都耗在那座山里了。$b$b<阿里乌克指了指北面的黑石山。>$b$b我的体内留着和他们相同的血液，但这不意味着我和他们秉承同样的观念。我正在寻求一名可靠的盟友来协助我阻止他们即将发起的进攻。$b$b你需要先证明你自己。前往南方的雏龙丘陵，杀死他们的驭龙者和刚刚孵化的黑龙。向我证明你已经做好了投入战争的准备。
text.completion: So you're in, then? Good.
text.completed: Return to Ariok at Flamestar Post in Burning Steppes.

english.title: Burning Vengeance
english.objectives: Slay 5 Blackrock Whelpers and 5 Flamescale Broodlings.
english.description: I am a Blackrock orc by birth.  I spent a large part of my youth inside that mountain.$b$b<Ariok motions towards Blackrock Mountain, to the north.>$b$bBut while I share blood with them, I do not share their outlook.  And I am seeking an ally to assist me in stopping their upcoming attack.$b$bSo prove yourself.  Travel south, to the Whelping Downs, and slay their whelpers and the hatchling black dragons.  Prove to me that you're ready for this war.
english.completion: So you're in, then? Good.
english.completed: Return to Ariok at Flamestar Post in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 囤积军备
text.objectives: 收集5根尖利的毒蝎钩刺。
text.description: 如果我们要向黑石氏族开战，就要先制定计划。我的父亲已经把计划准备好了——现在只需要执行。$b$b我需要蝎子的毒刺……你能找到的最锋利的那种。燃烧平原上到处都是蝎子，不过西边的峡谷中最多。$b$b不用操心它们是用来干什么的，你很快就知道了。
text.progress: 这麽快就回来了?
text.completion: Those scorpids are easy to underestimate.  You're lucky you didn't end up on the end of one of these barbs.  Or maybe you're just good. I'll add these to the stockpile.  We're not done yet, $r.
text.completed: Return to Ariok at Flamestar Post in Burning Steppes.

english.title: Stocking Up
english.objectives: Obtain 5 Razor-Sharp Scorpid Barbs.
english.description: If we're going to wage war against the Blackrock clan, we're going to need to plan ahead.  My father has already put the plan together - now it's time to execute.$b$bI need scorpid stingers... the sharpest ones you can find.  Scorpids are all over the steppes, but you can find most of them in the gulch to the west.$b$bDon't worry about what they're for.  You'll find out soon enough.
english.progress: Back already?
english.completion: Those scorpids are easy to underestimate.  You're lucky you didn't end up on the end of one of these barbs.  Or maybe you're just good. I'll add these to the stockpile.  We're not done yet, $r.
english.completed: Return to Ariok at Flamestar Post in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 未来的计划
text.objectives: 收集11张灰烬座狼之皮。
text.description: 根据我父亲的说法，我们需要座狼的毛皮，大量。至于是不是裂开了、烧坏了、沾血了，都无所谓，只要大量就行。$b$b实际上，如果有点残缺就最好了。$b$b你可以到西边或者东边去找座狼。
text.progress: Let's take a look at those hides.
text.completion: Believe me, $n... I'm just as anxious to get to the killing as you are.  We've got to keep to the plan.  The armageddon will come soon enough. I'll keep these hides here.
text.completed: Return to Ariok at Flamestar Post in Burning Steppes.

english.title: A Future Project
english.objectives: Obtain 11 Ember Worg Hides.
english.description: According to my father, we'll need worg hides, and lots of them.  It doesn't matter if they're torn, burned, or bloody, but we need plenty of them.$b$bActually, it's probably better if they're a little beat-up.$b$bYou'll find worgs both to the west and to the east of here.
english.progress: Let's take a look at those hides.
english.completion: Believe me, $n... I'm just as anxious to get to the killing as you are.  We've got to keep to the plan.  The armageddon will come soon enough. I'll keep these hides here.
english.completed: Return to Ariok at Flamestar Post in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 软泥猎人
text.objectives: 收集9堆黑曜斑点软泥。
text.description: 希望你不是个怕弄脏自己的人。看你的风尘仆仆的样子，这应该不是问题。$b$b在北边的熔岩边上，有一堆堆的暗色泥土。我需要这东西。$b$b如果你不问问题，只管埋头执行命令就最好了，$n。
text.progress: You'll want to watch out for those obsidian elementals.  They have a tendency to sneak up on you.
text.completion: This is exactly what we need. Don't worry, $n... the killing will come soon enough.
text.completed: Return to Ariok at Flamestar Post in Burning Steppes.

english.title: Mud Hunter
english.objectives: Obtain 9 piles of Obsidian-Flecked Mud.
english.description: Hope you're not afraid of getting dirty.  Judging by the looks of you, that won't be a problem.$b$bTo the north, at the lava's edge, you'll find piles of dark mud.  I need it.$b$bIt'd be best if you didn't ask questions, and focused your efforts on following orders, $n.
english.progress: You'll want to watch out for those obsidian elementals.  They have a tendency to sneak up on you.
english.completion: This is exactly what we need. Don't worry, $n... the killing will come soon enough.
english.completed: Return to Ariok at Flamestar Post in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 沙子、苹果酒和宝珠
text.objectives: 与风暴祭坛附近的戈瑟奇·邪眼交谈。
text.description: 我的父亲正在东边等我们。不过，在我们出发之前，还需要收集一点东西。这一次，你要从一个名叫戈瑟奇·邪眼的术士那里去拿件东西。$b$b你大概可以在西北边的风暴祭坛附近找到他。告诉他，他必须帮我们的忙。我们需要沙子、苹果酒和宝珠。$b$b他知道这是什么意思。
text.completion: Gah!  Who are you? Oh, so Ariok sent you?  Good.  Would ya mind sticking around for a while?  It's nothing big... I just need you to kill some warlocks for me.
text.completed: 去找燃烧平原风暴祭坛的戈瑟奇·邪眼。

english.title: The Sand, the Cider, and the Orb
english.objectives: Speak with Gorzeeki Wildeyes near the Altar of Storms.
english.description: My father is waiting for us to the east.  Before we head out though, we need to gather some more supplies.  This time, you'll be taking it from a warlock by the name of Gorzeeki Wildeyes.$b$bYou'll probably find him to the northwest, near the Altar of Storms.  Tell him he's going to help us out.  We need the sand, the cider, and the orb.$b$bHe'll know what it means.
english.completion: Gah!  Who are you? Oh, so Ariok sent you?  Good.  Would ya mind sticking around for a while?  It's nothing big... I just need you to kill some warlocks for me.
english.completed: Report to Gorzeeki Wildeyes at the Altar of Storms in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 好东西都在术士那里
text.objectives: 取回一把沉睡之砂、一壶魔能泻药以及一颗澄澈的玻璃球。
text.description: 阿里乌克说他需要物资？我多得是物资呀！问题是，我被术士们赶出了家园，他们还不许我回去。$b$b<戈瑟奇打量着你。>$b$b你说不定可以溜进去。前往北面，取回一把沉睡之砂、一壶魔能泻药和一颗澄澈的玻璃球。没错，他要的就是这些。$b$b噢，如果你不小心杀死了几名兽人，我是不会感到难过的。
text.progress: Let's see if you managed to get everything.
text.completion: I hope that's what Ariok was looking for.  It's not doing me much good right now, anyhow.
text.completed: Return to Gorzeeki Wildeyes at the Altar of Storms in Burning Steppes.

english.title: Warlocks Have the Neatest Stuff
english.objectives: Obtain a handful of Slumber Sand, a jug of Fel Slider Cider, and a Clear Glass Orb.
english.description: Ariok said he needs supplies?  I've got plenty of supplies!  Problem is, those warlocks have kicked me out of my home, and they're not letting me back in.$b$b<Gorzeeki sizes you up.>$b$bYou might be able to get in, though.  Head north, and grab some of my slumber sand, my fel slider cider, and a clear glass orb.  I'm pretty sure that's what he wants.$b$bOh, and if you happen to accidentally kill any of those orcs while you're up there, I wouldn't be terribly upset.
english.progress: Let's see if you managed to get everything.
english.completion: I hope that's what Ariok was looking for.  It's not doing me much good right now, anyhow.
english.completed: Return to Gorzeeki Wildeyes at the Altar of Storms in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 对付耐格什
text.objectives: 杀死暗影耐格什。
text.description: 暗影耐格什是北面那群术士的头目。黑石兽人一露面，这个蠢货就将我赶出了家园。哼，他们都是坏蛋，但是耐格什尤其讨厌。$b$b我要想回到祭坛的话，他就必须死。
text.completion: Knowing the way those orcs operate, there'll be another one to take his place soon.  I'll see if I can't sneak back into the altar before that happens. Thanks, buddy.
text.completed: Return to Gorzeeki Wildeyes at the Altar of Storms in Burning Steppes.

english.title: Shadow Boxing
english.objectives: Slay Ner'gosh the Shadow.
english.description: Ner'gosh the Shadow is the leader of those warlocks to our north.  He's the jerk that kicked me out of my home once those Blackrock orcs started showing up.  Well, they're all jerks, but he's the jerkiest.$b$bIf I'm ever going to move back in near the Altar, Ner'gosh has to go.
english.completion: Knowing the way those orcs operate, there'll be another one to take his place soon.  I'll see if I can't sneak back into the altar before that happens. Thanks, buddy.
english.completed: Return to Gorzeeki Wildeyes at the Altar of Storms in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 向阿里乌克复命
text.objectives: 将术士补给品交给燃烧平原焰星哨站的阿里乌克。
text.description: 我想我和你之间的任务已经清了。等我胆量足够了，我会赶走剩余的术士的。$b$b给，别忘记带上这些物资。
text.progress: It looks like you managed to deal with Gorzeeki.
text.completion: Good, good, good.  We can move on.  Our war takes us east, away from Blackrock Mountain... for now.
text.completed: Report to Ariok at Flamestar Post in Burning Steppes.

english.title: Return to Ariok
english.objectives: Bring the Warlock's Supplies back to Ariok at Flamestar Post in Burning Steppes.
english.description: Well I suppose I'm done with you here.  I'll go shoo those other warlocks out when I build up the courage.$b$bHere, don't forget those supplies.
english.progress: It looks like you managed to deal with Gorzeeki.
english.completion: Good, good, good.  We can move on.  Our war takes us east, away from Blackrock Mountain... for now.
english.completed: Report to Ariok at Flamestar Post in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 凿握据点，燃烧平原的中心
text.objectives: 在你前往凿握据点的途中杀死任意15名黑石大军的成员。
text.description: 我们要启程前往位于燃烧平原中心的凿握据点，与瑟银兄弟会以及我的父亲会合。$b$b你知道瑟银兄弟会吗？兄弟会的黑铁矮人们不止一次地帮助我脱离险境。现在，我们又需要他们伸出援手了。$b$b我们将穿越黑齿营地。沿途不如杀一些兽人玩玩？我的手正痒痒呢。
text.completion: You'll have to excuse me, but we're not taking visitors right now.  I'll ask you to leave Chiselgrip out the same door you came in. Oh, Ariok... is that you?
text.completed: Report to Stebben Oreknuckle at Chiselgrip in Burning Steppes.

english.title: Chiselgrip, the Heart of the Steppes
english.objectives: Kill any 15 Blackrock troops on your way to Chiselgrip.
english.description: We're headed to Chiselgrip, right in the center of these steppes.  We'll rendezvous with the Thorium Brotherhood there, as well as with my father.$b$bAre you familiar with the Brotherhood?  Those dark iron dwarves have helped me out more than once.  We may need their help again.$b$bWe'll pass through Black Tooth Hovel on our way there.  What do you say we kill a few of the Blackrock while we travel?  I'm getting a little restless here in this camp.
english.completion: You'll have to excuse me, but we're not taking visitors right now.  I'll ask you to leave Chiselgrip out the same door you came in. Oh, Ariok... is that you?
english.completed: Report to Stebben Oreknuckle at Chiselgrip in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 困境中的针芒
text.objectives: 跟燃烧平原凿握据点的萨拉隆·巨钉谈一谈。
text.description: 你好，$c。我是银色北伐军战士伊崔格……之前是酋长的荣誉卫士。再之前，我是一名黑石兽人。$b$b我的儿子已经跟你讲过这项计划了吧。他还没有？那更好。$b$b接下来的部分就需要耐心和细致了……我可不擅长，所以要你亲自来。$b$b跟镇上的裁缝萨拉隆·巨钉谈一谈。我已经将收集到的兽皮和泥土交给他了。他要为你测量一下身围。$b$b没错，$n：你需要一件伪装。
text.completion: You need a disguise?  Well, you came to the right place, honey. Let me take a look... mm-hmm.  I know exactly what we'll do.
text.completed: 跟燃烧平原凿握据点的萨拉隆·巨钉谈一谈。

english.title: A Needle in a Hellhole
english.objectives: Speak with Thelaron Direneedle at Chiselgrip in Burning Steppes.
english.description: Lok'tar, $c.  My name is Eitrigg, of the Argent Crusade... formerly of the Warchief's Honor Guard.  Before that, of the Blackrock orcs.$b$bI trust my son has briefed you on our plan.  He hasn't?  That is probably for the better.$b$bThe next part of the plan is going to require a bit of subtlety.  Speak with Thelaron Direneedle, the tailor here in town.  I've already given him the hides and mud that you've collected.  He's going to need to size you.$b$bThat's right, $r: you're going undercover.
english.completion: You need a disguise?  Well, you came to the right place, honey. Let me take a look... mm-hmm.  I know exactly what we'll do.
english.completed: Speak with Thelaron Direneedle at Chiselgrip in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 完美的伪装
text.objectives: 从裁缝桌上拿取适当数量的材料，交给凿握据点的萨拉隆·巨钉。
text.description: 根据你的体重、体格和体型，我们要把你假扮成一个兽人。他们的军队里大部分都是兽人，所以你很容易混进去。$b$b你对裁缝有了解吗？如果没有的话，就把这个当成你的第一课吧。我的工作台就在那边，上面有所有必要的材料。$b$b去拿一些你觉得有用的东西，把它们拿来交给我。萨拉隆会帮你料理一切。
text.completion: That's it?  That's your disguise?  I'm feeling less confident about our chances. But still confident.
text.completed: Report to Eitrigg at Chiselgrip in Burning Steppes.

english.title: A Perfect Costume
english.objectives: Bring the appropriate amount of supplies from the Tailoring Table to Thelaron Direneedle at Chiselgrip.
english.description: Judging by your weight, build, and size, we're going to dress you as an orc.  Their army is made mostly of orcs, so you'll fit right in.$b$bDo you know much about tailoring?  If not, then consider this your first lesson.  My crafting table over there has all the necessary supplies on it.$b$bGo ahead and grab whatever you think is necessary, then bring it here.  Thelaron will fix you right up.
english.completion: That's it?  That's your disguise?  I'm feeling less confident about our chances. But still confident.
english.completed: Report to Eitrigg at Chiselgrip in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 完美的伪装
text.objectives: 从裁缝桌上拿取适当数量的材料，交给凿握据点的萨拉隆·巨钉。
text.description: 根据你的体重、体格和体型，我们要把你假扮成一个食人魔。火腹食人魔一直在为黑石兽人卖力，所以你很容易混进去。$b$b你对裁缝有了解吗？如果没有的话，就把这个当成你的第一课吧。我的工作台就在那边，上面有所有必要的材料。$b$b去拿一些你觉得有用的东西，把它们拿来交给我。萨拉隆会帮你料理一切。
text.completion: That's it?  That's your disguise?  I'm feeling less confident about our chances. But still confident.
text.completed: Report to Eitrigg at Chiselgrip in Burning Steppes.

english.title: A Perfect Costume
english.objectives: Bring the appropriate amount of supplies from the Tailoring Table to Thelaron Direneedle at Chiselgrip.
english.description: Judging by your weight, build, and size, we're going to dress you as an ogre.  The firegut ogres have always worked for the Blackrocks, so you'll fit right in.$b$bDo you know much about tailoring?  If not, then consider this your first lesson.  My crafting table over there has all the necessary supplies on it.$b$bGo ahead and grab whatever you think is necessary, then bring it here.  Thelaron will fix you right up.
english.completion: That's it?  That's your disguise?  I'm feeling less confident about our chances. But still confident.
english.completed: Report to Eitrigg at Chiselgrip in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 完美的伪装
text.objectives: 从裁缝桌上拿取适当数量的材料，交给凿握据点的萨拉隆·巨钉。
text.description: 根据你的体重、体格和体型，我们要把你假扮成一个地精。黑石兽人一直拿地精雇佣兵来填补兵力空缺，所以你很容易混进去。$b$b你对裁缝有了解吗？如果没有的话，就把这个当成你的第一课吧。我的工作台就在那边，上面有所有必要的材料。$b$b去拿一些你觉得有用的东西，把它们拿来交给我。萨拉隆会帮你料理一切。
text.completion: That's it?  That's your disguise?  I'm feeling less confident about our chances. But still confident.
text.completed: Report to Eitrigg at Chiselgrip in Burning Steppes.

english.title: A Perfect Costume
english.objectives: Bring the appropriate amount of supplies from the Tailoring Table to Thelaron Direneedle at Chiselgrip.
english.description: Judging by your weight, build, and size, we're going to dress you as a goblin.  The Blackrocks have been known to hire goblin mercenaries to fill their ranks, so you'll fit right in.$b$bDo you know much about tailoring?  If not, then consider this your first lesson.  My crafting table over there has all the necessary supplies on it.$b$bGo ahead and grab whatever you think is necessary, then bring it here.  Thelaron will fix you right up.
english.completion: That's it?  That's your disguise?  I'm feeling less confident about our chances. But still confident.
english.completed: Report to Eitrigg at Chiselgrip in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 完美的伪装
text.objectives: 从裁缝桌上拿取适当数量的材料，交给凿握据点的萨拉隆·巨钉。
text.description: 根据你的体重、体格和体型，我们要把你假扮成一个巨魔。燃棘巨魔一直跟黑石兽人共事，所以你很容易混进去。$b$b你对裁缝有了解吗？如果没有的话，就把这个当成你的第一课吧。我的工作台就在那边，上面有所有必要的材料。$b$b去拿一些你觉得有用的东西，把它们拿来交给我。萨拉隆会帮你料理一切。
text.completion: That's it?  That's your disguise?  I'm feeling less confident about our chances. But still confident.
text.completed: Report to Eitrigg at Chiselgrip in Burning Steppes.

english.title: A Perfect Costume
english.objectives: Bring the appropriate amount of supplies from the Tailoring Table to Thelaron Direneedle at Chiselgrip.
english.description: Judging by your weight, build, and size, we're going to dress you as a troll.  The Smolderthorn trolls have always worked with the Blackrock orcs, so you'll fit right in.$b$bDo you know much about tailoring?  If not, then consider this your first lesson.  My crafting table over there has all the necessary supplies on it.$b$bGo ahead and grab whatever you think is necessary, then bring it here.  Thelaron will fix you right up.
english.completion: That's it?  That's your disguise?  I'm feeling less confident about our chances. But still confident.
english.completed: Report to Eitrigg at Chiselgrip in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 前往黑齿营地
text.objectives: 跟燃烧平原凿黑齿营地的军需官卡奥辛谈一谈。
text.description: 伪装潜入的秘诀就是摆出大摇大摆的模样。你要表现得泰然自若，就没有人会怀疑你。$b$b进入黑齿营地后，直接跟一个叫军需官卡奥辛的兽人取得联络。他不知道你是间谍，所以尽量保持冷静。照他的要求去做。$b$b<伊崔格递给你一件小巧的机械装置。>$b$b把它塞进耳朵里。我会给你最新的指示。$b$b祝你好运，士兵。
text.completion: Where have you been, grunt?  You're late!  Give me one reason why I shouldn't kill you on the spot!
text.completed: 跟燃烧平原黑齿营地的军需官卡奥辛谈一谈。

english.title: Into the Black Tooth Hovel
english.objectives: Speak with Quartermaster Kaoshin at the Black Tooth Hovel in Burning Steppes.
english.description: Undercover work is all about swagger.  Just act like you're supposed to be there, and you'll be fine.$b$bYour contact inside Black Tooth Hovel will be an orc by the name of Quartermaster Kaoshin.  He does NOT know you're a spy, so try and stay cool.  Do whatever he asks of you.$b$b<Eitrigg presses a small mechanical object into your palm.>$b$bPlace this device in your ear.  I will be in touch to give you any special instructions.$b$bGood luck out there, soldier.
english.completion: Where have you been, grunt?  You're late!  Give me one reason why I shouldn't kill you on the spot!
english.completed: Speak with Quartermaster Kaoshin at the Black Tooth Hovel in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 苦力
text.objectives: 用力擦拭7双黑石战靴。
text.description: 呸！今天我正好缺人手，你太幸运了。不干的话，我这一整周都会让你背黑锅。$b$b官员和高阶士兵需要擦鞋服务。他们的靴子就放在营帐前。$b$b我要能从鞋面上看见我的倒影，步兵！赶紧干活去！
text.completion: Hmph.  Good work, grunt.
text.completed: Return to Quartermaster Kaoshin at Black Tooth Hovel in Burning Steppes.

english.title: Grunt Work
english.objectives: Vigorously polish 7 pairs of Blackrock Boots.
english.description: Bah!  You're lucky I'm short-handed today.  Otherwise I'd make you my personal whipping $g boy: girl; for the week.$b$bThe officers and high-ranking soldiers need their boots polished.  They've left them out in front of their huts.$b$bI want to see my reflection in those boots, grunt!  Get to work!
english.completion: Hmph.  Good work, grunt.
english.completed: Return to Quartermaster Kaoshin at Black Tooth Hovel in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 战略偷袭
text.objectives: 对灰烬之柱顶端的巫毒师提曼，座狼兽栏处的座狼驭手欧萨娜以及巡逻到熔岩池附近的格尔洛普使用尖利的毒蝎钩刺。
text.description: <耳畔传来嗡嗡声。>$b$b$n？是我，伊崔格。$b$b我们刚刚收到有关下一项任务的情报。你需要解决三名目标人物。第一，巫毒师提曼，你可以在灰烬之柱顶端找到他。第二，座狼驭手欧萨娜，他就在中央区域的座狼兽栏处。第三，南面熔岩池附近的格尔洛普。$b$b在你的背包里找到毒蝎钩刺。找准时机下手吧。
text.completion: Not only did you pull off the executions, you managed to make them all look like accidents. You were the right $r for this undercover work.  Good job, soldier.
text.giverWindow: 该使用你收集的毒蝎钩刺了。

english.title: Strategic Cuts
english.objectives: Use the Razor-Sharp Scorpid Barb on Voodooist Timan atop the Pillar of Ash, Worgmistress Othana in the worg pens, and Gorlop when he is near the lava pools.
english.description: <You hear a buzzing in your ear.>$b$b$n?  It's Eitrigg.$b$bWe've just received the final bit of information for your next mission.  There are three marks that we'd like you to take down.  The first is Voodooist Timan, whom you'll find atop the Pillar of Ash.  Worgmistress Othana is in the central worg pens.  Finally, Gorlop is near the lava pools to the south.$b$bYou will find the scorpid barbs you harvested packed along with your belongings.  Use the barbs on the marks when the time is right.
english.completion: Not only did you pull off the executions, you managed to make them all look like accidents. You were the right $r for this undercover work.  Good job, soldier.
english.giverWindow: Time to use those scorpid barbs you collected.

text.title: 科多兽召唤者号角
text.objectives: 使用召唤者号角召唤7匹黑石作战科多兽返回营地。如果哪只科多兽怀有敌意，就迫使它屈服。
text.description: 好吧，我有一项合法并且重要的任务要交代你。我们要唤回南面草场上的科多兽。索基佐格将军很快就要带领军队前往赤脊山。要是没有科多兽载我，我会掉队的。$b$b靠近科多兽并吹响这支号角，它就会主动返回营地了。$b$b你得仔细点。科多兽的脾气有时候会不太好，揍它们一顿就会听话了。

english.title: The Kodocaller's Horn
english.objectives: Use the Horn of the Callers to call 7 Blackrock War Kodos back to camp.  If a kodo turns hostile, fight it until it submits.
english.description: Alright, I've got some actual, legitimate, important work for you.  We've got to call the kodos in from the grazing lands to the south.  General Thorg'izog says we'll be moving out into Redridge soon, and I won't be caught with my kodos down.$b$bUse this horn near a kodo.  It will return to the camp when it hears the call.$b$bYou'll want to watch out.  Sometimes the kodos get a little feisty, so you need to knock them around a bit before they listen to you.

objectiveDetails.description: 将黑石作战科多兽召唤回营地

text.title: 物归己用
text.objectives: 将召唤者号角还给燃烧平原凿握据点的伊崔格。
text.description: $n，是我，伊崔格。我要你保管好那支号角。我相信应该能想出个办法把它融入到我们的计划当中。$b$b我非常关心卡奥辛所说的进攻赤脊山到底是怎么回事。虽然新一轮的进攻迫在眉睫，但是我们很多天的时间表都已经排满了。$b$b将号角带回来给我。我在凿握据点等你，到时候详谈。对了，保管好你的伪装。间谍任务还没有完呢。
text.progress: Welcome back, soldier.
text.completion: True, an attack on Redridge is an attack against the Alliance... but it is also an attack against innocents. I won't stand for that.  Not as a Crusader.  Not as an orc. It's time we taught the Blackrock clan - my old clan - that their raiding days are over.
text.completed: Report to Eitrigg at Chiselgrip in Burning Steppes.
text.giverWindow: 那样的号角不止会对科多兽有用……

english.title: Taking the Horn For Ourselves
english.objectives: Bring the Horn of the Callers back to Eitrigg at Chiselgrip in Burning Steppes.
english.description: $n, it's Eitrigg.  I want you to hold onto that horn.  I'm sure we can improvise and find a way to work it into the plan.$b$bI'm more than a little concerned about what Kaoshin said about attacking Redridge.  We knew an attack was imminent, but not this soon!$b$bReturn to me, with the horn.  We will talk again here, in Chiselgrip.  And try not to ruin that disguise.  You're not done with your undercover work yet.
english.progress: Welcome back, soldier.
english.completion: True, an attack on Redridge is an attack against the Alliance... but it is also an attack against innocents. I won't stand for that.  Not as a Crusader.  Not as an orc. It's time we taught the Blackrock clan - my old clan - that their raiding days are over.
english.completed: Report to Eitrigg at Chiselgrip in Burning Steppes.
english.giverWindow: A horn like that will work on more than just kodos...

text.title: 索基佐格将军
text.objectives: 跟索基佐格将军谈一谈。
text.description: 原来卡奥辛远比我预料中的要有用的多嘛，不过他对我们已经没有什么利用价值了。是时候跟索基佐格将军谈谈了。我觉得你已经准备好了。$b$b他是统领燃烧平原地面部队的“三巨头”之一。索基佐格的据点就是西北边的黑石要塞。穿上伪装跟他谈谈。看看你能不能赢得他的信任。如果有进一步的指示，托德曼会联系你的。
text.completion: More outsiders?  What do you want?
text.completed: 向燃烧平原黑石要塞的索基佐格将军报到。

english.title: General Thorg'izog
english.objectives: Speak with General Thorg'izog.
english.description: Kaoshin turned out to be more helpful than I expected, but we're done with him.  It's time you spoke with the General.  I think you're ready.$b$bGeneral Thorg'izog is one of the "Big Three" that run the Blackrock forces here in Burning Steppes.  He leads from the Blackrock Stronghold to the northwest.  Put on your disguise and go speak with him.  See if you can earn his trust.  I will be in touch, should I need anything further.
english.completion: More outsiders?  What do you want?
english.completed: Report to General Thorg'izog at Blackrock Stronghold in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 熔岩试炼
text.objectives: 跟维莱特·斯普里通克谈一谈，让他释放熔岩之王克洛博。然后击败熔岩之王克洛博。
text.description: 我想我会最大限度地利用眼前的机会。这帮地精佣兵给我的要塞送来了这只巨大的火元素，以此“感谢”我雇佣他们。我在燃烧平原要这种东西做什么？还嫌这里的火不够多啊。$b$b如果你想找活干，就证明自己的实力吧。跟那个地精谈谈，向他的火元素发起挑战。如果你赢了，你就能赢得我的尊重和认可。
text.completion: I had a feeling you'd be the one returning to me.  I like your style, soldier.
text.completed: Return to General Thorg'izog at Blackrock Stronghold in Burning Steppes.

english.title: Trial by Magma
english.objectives: Speak with Wyrtle Spreelthonket and ask him to release Magma Lord Kolob.  Then defeat Magma Lord Kolob in battle.
english.description: I suppose I'll make the most of this situation.  These goblin mercenaries brought this enormous fire elemental to my stronghold as a "thank you" for hiring them.  What am I going to do with an elemental here in the steppes?  That's like bringing sand to the beach.$b$bIf you're looking for work, then prove yourself.  Talk to this goblin here, and challenge his elemental to a fight.  The victor earns my respect, and my time.
english.completion: I had a feeling you'd be the one returning to me.  I like your style, soldier.
english.completed: Return to General Thorg'izog at Blackrock Stronghold in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 我就是法律，我就是鞭子
text.objectives: 对荣耀之地的20名军人使用黑石训诫棒。如果某位军人识破了你的伪装，你必须在他揭发你之前杀死他。
text.description: 我一直在找像你这样优秀而强壮的士兵。我需要有人维持军队的秩序。$b$b兽人、食人魔和巨魔大军正在要塞外操练，准备进攻赤脊山。我的中士们负责监督他们，但是我希望你能参与协助。$b$b带上这根棍棒，用它教训那些不听话的士兵。我才不关心他们有没有犯错或是队伍没站整齐呢，我就是要让他们挨几下打。我要他们集中精神，训练有素并且绝对服从命令。$b$b去吧。
text.completion: I have a feeling we'll be hearing about you and your exploits for a long time, soldier.  I look forward to fighting by your side in Redridge. You are dismissed.
text.completed: Return to General Thorg'izog at Blackrock Stronghold in Burning Steppes.

english.title: I Am the Law and I Am the Lash
english.objectives: Use the Blackrock Cudgel of Discipline on 20 troops in the Fields of Honor.  If one of the troops discovers your disguise, cudgel him to death before he can unmask you.
english.description: I've been looking for a good, strong soldier like you.  I need someone to keep my troops in line.$b$bOutside the stronghold, you will find orcs, ogres, and trolls preparing for the assault on Redridge.  My sergeants keep them in line, but I'd like you to assist them.$b$bTake this cudgel and discipline a few of my soldiers.  I don't care if they're misbehaving or standing perfectly in line, I want them beaten.  I want them focused, battle-hardened, and obedient.$b$bNow go.
english.completion: I have a feeling we'll be hearing about you and your exploits for a long time, soldier.  I look forward to fighting by your side in Redridge. You are dismissed.
english.completed: Return to General Thorg'izog at Blackrock Stronghold in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 滥用权力
text.objectives: 使用黑石训诫棒杀死5名黑石中士。速战速决，在你暴露身份之前杀死他们。
text.description: $n？是我，伊崔格。$b$b看来你已经赢得了索基佐格的信任，他连维持军队秩序的这样的重任都交给了你。我们真是幸运得很。$b$b杀掉他手下的中士吧。他们骑着座狼，在荣耀之地的黑石要塞外围巡逻。用那根棍棒猛敲他们，多敲几下，敲死为止。动作要快，一旦他们发现你不是黑石兽人，他们就会揭穿你的真面目。速战速决，下手要狠，$n。$b$b完毕。
text.completion: Without those sergeants, Thorg'izog will be hard-pressed getting his troops ready for battle. Already the dominoes are beginning to fall, $n.
text.giverWindow: 该是对付那些军士的时候了。

english.title: Abuse of Power
english.objectives: Kill 5 Blackrock Sergeants using the Blackrock Cudgel of Discipline.  Defeat them quickly, before they have a chance to unmask you.
english.description: $n?  Eitrigg here.$b$bIt sounds like you have earned Thorg'izog's trust, and he's assigned you to discipline duty.  This is fortunate.$b$bWe need you to take out his sergeants.  You'll find them on wolfback, outside of the Blackrock Stronghold in the Fields of Honor.  Use that cudgel on them, several times, until they die.  You'll have to act fast, because if they realize you're not one of them, they can unmask you.  Strike quickly and ferociously, $n.
english.completion: Without those sergeants, Thorg'izog will be hard-pressed getting his troops ready for battle. Already the dominoes are beginning to fall, $n.
english.giverWindow: Time to turn the tables on these sergeants.
english.turninWindow: It is done.  Nice form, by the way.

text.title: 见好就收
text.objectives: 向凿握据点的伊崔格复命。
text.description: 我们没有针对索基佐格或是黑石地面部队的战略措施了。我们必须继续执行计划的下一阶段。$b$b你处理完要塞的事务就返回凿握据点吧。
text.completion: Are you alright? Good.  You were strong out there, $n.  Strong, and wise. Now pack up your things.  We're moving out of here.
text.completed: 向燃烧平原凿握据点的伊崔格报到。
text.giverWindow: 返回凿握据点。我们很快就会继续前进。

english.title: Enough Damage For One Day
english.objectives: Return to Eitrigg at Chiselgrip.
english.description: We do not have any further strategic need for Thorg'izog or the Blackrock ground troops.  We must continue to the next phase of the plan.$b$bWhen you are finished at the stronghold, return to my son and me, here in Chiselgrip.
english.completion: Are you alright? Good.  You were strong out there, $n.  Strong, and wise. Now pack up your things.  We're moving out of here.
english.completed: Report to Eitrigg at Chiselgrip in Burning Steppes.
english.giverWindow: Return to Chiselgrip.  We move on soon.

text.title: 烈焰峰
text.objectives: 向燃烧平原烈焰峰的基布雷尔报到。
text.description: 在你的大力帮助下，我们在凿握据点的工作结束了。我们将转移到东北方的烈焰峰去。$b$b穿越索瑞森废墟，烈焰峰就在悬崖区域。我们可以去那里设立营地，执行计划的最后一个阶段。$b$b当然，Ariok和我都会随你同行的。
text.completion: Oh.  Visitors?

english.title: Flame Crest
english.objectives: Report to Kibler at Flame Crest in Burning Steppes.
english.description: Our work here in Chiselgrip is done, mostly thanks to you.  We'll now be moving on to the northeast, to Flame Crest.$b$bFlame Crest is in the cliffs, past the Ruins of Thaurissan.  It should serve as a sufficient base of operations for the final stages of our plan.$b$bOf course, my son Ariok will be joining you on the road.  As will I.
english.completion: Oh.  Visitors?

text.title: 漆黑的灰烬
text.objectives: 收集9堆黑曜石灰烬。
text.description: 在清除黑石大军的余孽之前，我有一项收集任务要交给你。既然要做，就要做好，也就是说我们必须做好充分的准备。$b$b我需要灰烬，$n。不是普通的灰烬……而是黑曜石元素的灰烬，它们就在东南边的平原上游荡。这种灰烬的颜色黝黑，我们需要它来制作下一件伪装。$b$b别担心，你已经有一件伪装啦。新的一件是给其他人……呃，其他生物……穿的。
text.progress: The ashes of the obsidian elementals are particularly dark - exactly what we need for our purposes.
text.completion: Yes, these will do.  I will get this packed up for you.
text.completed: 返回燃烧平原的烈焰峰，向伊崔格复命。

english.title: Blackened Ashes
english.objectives: Obtain 9 piles of Obsidian Ash.
english.description: I need you to do some more gathering before we can go take out the remainder of the Blackrock army.  If we're going to do this, we're going to do it right, and that means being prepared.$b$bI need ash, $n.  Not just any ash... ash from the greater obsidian elementals that roam the plains to the southeast.  The stuff is deep, deep black, which is what we need for our next disguise.$b$bDon't worry, you've already got a disguise.  This one is for someone... well, someTHING... else.
english.progress: The ashes of the obsidian elementals are particularly dark - exactly what we need for our purposes.
english.completion: Yes, these will do.  I will get this packed up for you.
english.completed: Return to Eitrigg at Flame Crest in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 潜在的恶魔
text.objectives: 收集18个死亡的烈焰小鬼。
text.description: 南边不远处的熔岩层是烈焰小鬼的家园，这种火焰恶魔生活在燃烧平原有段日子了。说到清除黑石大军，如果小心行事的话，我们或许可以利用这些烈焰小鬼潜入敌人后方并制造混乱。$b$b将它们的尸体带回来给我。要复活这些恶魔非常简单，然后它们就能为我们所用了。
text.progress: The flamekin are weak, but they travel in packs.  Be cautious.
text.completion: To the untrained eye, these will look exactly like imps. We just need to get them to that untrained eye.  I'll work on preparing them for delivery.
text.completed: 返回燃烧平原的烈焰峰，向伊崔格复命。

english.title: Latent Demons of the Land
english.objectives: Obtain 18 Fallen Flamekin.
english.description: The lava beds nearby - to the south - play host to flamekin, a brand of fire demon that has long roamed the steppes.  Situations are such in the Blackrock army that, if we are careful, we may be able to sneak some of these flamekin behind enemy lines to cause some havoc.$b$bBring me the bodies of several flamekin.  As demons, they are easily resurrected, and then we can use them for our own purposes.
english.progress: The flamekin are weak, but they travel in packs.  Be cautious.
english.completion: To the untrained eye, these will look exactly like imps. We just need to get them to that untrained eye.  I'll work on preparing them for delivery.
english.completed: Return to Eitrigg at Flame Crest in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 美味的狼肉
text.objectives: 对巨型灰烬座狼的尸体使用座狼锯肉刀，收集40块座狼肉排。
text.description: 我们需要新鲜的肉，也就是说你得出去猎狼。燃烧平原这一侧的座狼就是你的狩猎目标。$b$b<伊崔格将一柄巨刃递给你。>$b$b杀死巨型灰烬座狼，然后用座狼锯肉刀割下最肥美的肉块。燃烧平原上到处都是座狼，最近的一支族群统领着东南方的土地。
text.progress: 运气如何？
text.completion: This meat looks good... but I think it needs a little "seasoning".  I'll make sure that gets taken care of. Thank you, $n.
text.completed: 返回燃烧平原的烈焰峰，向伊崔格复命。

english.title: A Heap of Delicious Worg
english.objectives: Use the Worgsaw on the bodies of slain Giant Ember Worgs to obtain 40 Worg Cutlets.
english.description: We're going to need fresh meat, which means you're going to be hunting worg.  The worg on this side of the steppes should be your target.$b$b<Eitrigg produces a large blade, which he hands to you.>$b$bHunt the giant ember worgs.  Once you've killed them, use this saw to remove the choicest bits of meat from their bodies.  You will find these worgs all over the steppes, but the closest pack rules the land just to our southeast.
english.progress: Any luck out there?
english.completion: This meat looks good... but I think it needs a little "seasoning".  I'll make sure that gets taken care of. Thank you, $n.
english.completed: Return to Eitrigg at Flame Crest in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 血之途
text.objectives: 杀死25只黑色龙人或是黑色龙族。
text.description: 我的腿又有点闲不住了。你愿意跑一趟吗，$n？$b$b我们打算围着巨槌石绕一圈。在我们采取行动之前，我希望能调查一下黑石大军的情况，说不定还能顺手杀上一些呢。
text.completion: That was exactly what I needed.
text.completed: Speak with Ariok.

english.title: Blood Tour
english.objectives: Kill 25 Black Dragonspawn or Black Wyrmkin.
english.description: My legs are getting a little restless again.  You interested in taking a little tour, $n?$b$bWe're going to take a trip around Dreadmaul Rock.  I'd like to investigate some of the Blackrock army before we make our move, and I figure we might as well kill some of them while we're on the way.
english.completion: That was exactly what I needed.
english.completed: Speak with Ariok.

text.title: 黑龙前锋
text.objectives: 杀死米诺尤斯、幼龙驯养人阿库米、灼烧者特洛玛斯和塔格纳尔·血喉。
text.description: 黑石兽人可不是单干的。你也瞧见了，他们拉拢了火腹食人魔和燃棘巨魔。更为不幸的是，这帮家伙还与黑龙结成了同盟。$b$b兽人和龙族已经派出兵力，驻守在各处的集结点，集结点以挑上龙骨的长矛为标识。我们得找到这些集结点，在战争开始前除掉驻守在那里的前锋兵力。$b$b准备好了吗？
text.completion: Your kill count is adding up, $n.  We're chipping away at them. And we are going to win.
text.completed: Speak with Ariok.

english.title: Draconic Vanguard
english.objectives: Slay Minyoth, Whelptamer Akumi, Terromath the Seared, and Tugnar Goremaw.
english.description: The Blackrock orcs don't come alone.  You've already seen that they've got the Firegut ogres and Smolderthorn trolls on their side.  Unfortunately for us, they're also teamed up with the black dragonflight.$b$bThe orcs and the dragons have already sent some of their champions to stand guard at rally points, which are marked by a dragon skull on a pike.  You and I are going to find these rally points and take out this vanguard before the battle starts.$b$bReady?
english.completion: Your kill count is adding up, $n.  We're chipping away at them. And we are going to win.
english.completed: Speak with Ariok.

text.title: 与龙的交易
text.objectives: 将获救的雏龙交给燃烧平原滑石的阿克莱德。
text.description: 在我们绕着巨槌石侦察的过程中，还有一事要做。$b$b还记得你在雏龙丘陵救出的幼龙吗？我一直负责照顾它们，现在得将它们送到更值得托付的人手中。这个人就在巨槌石东北方的滑石。$B$B他叫阿克莱德，或许他会在这场迫在眉睫的战争中，成为获胜的关键。
text.progress: You've arrived, $n.
text.completion: Yes, the whelplings.  I will take care of them. As for the agreement I made with your father earlier, tell him that I will hold up my end of the bargain.  You will have your dragon for the battle against the orcs. We share your grudge against the Blackrock clan.
text.completed: Speak with Acride at Slither Rock in Burning Steppes.

english.title: A Deal With a Dragon
english.objectives: Deliver the Rescued Whelplings to Acride at Slither Rock in Burning Steppes.
english.description: While we are circling around Dreadmaul Rock, there's one more stop that we need to make.$b$bYou remember the hatchlings that you freed from the Whelping Downs?  I've been watching over them, and now we're going to deliver them to someone who will take care of them better than we can.  He's staying in Slither Rock, to the northeast of Dreadmaul Rock.$b$bHis name is Acride, and he might be the key to victory in the upcoming battle.
english.progress: You've arrived, $n.
english.completion: Yes, the whelplings.  I will take care of them. As for the agreement I made with your father earlier, tell him that I will hold up my end of the bargain.  You will have your dragon for the battle against the orcs. We share your grudge against the Blackrock clan.
english.completed: Speak with Acride at Slither Rock in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 设局
text.objectives: 返回燃烧平原的烈焰峰，向伊崔格复命。
text.description: <你听见一阵嗡嗡声。>$b$b$n。看来你和阿里乌克顺利完成了任务。我的事儿也都办妥当了。$b$b返回烈焰峰吧。我有些包裹要交给那三位巨头：索基佐格、尼纳拉克和克希鲁恩。你已经见过索基佐格将军了。这次你将有机会见到另外两位。$b$b也就是说，在我们杀死他们之前。
text.completion: Good, you're back. I hope you've still got that disguise.  You're going back undercover, $n.
text.giverWindow: 返回烈焰峰，我有些货物需要你运送。

english.title: Placing the Pawns
english.objectives: Return to Eitrigg at Flame Crest in Burning Steppes.
english.description: <You hear a buzzing in your ear.>$b$b$n.  It sounds like you and Ariok have finished with your tasks.  I've also finished mine.$b$bReturn to Flame Crest.  I've prepared a few packages to deliver to the Big Three: Thorg'izog, Neeralak, and Xi'lun.  You've already met General Thorg'izog.  This will be your chance to meet the other two.$b$bThat is, before you kill them.
english.completion: Good, you're back. I hope you've still got that disguise.  You're going back undercover, $n.
english.giverWindow: Return to Flame Crest.  I have a few packages for you to deliver.

choices.name: Breastplate of the Undercover Thorium Brother

text.title: 送给索基佐格的货物
text.objectives: 使用黑石伪装，将沾满泻药的肉排交给燃烧平原火腹熔炉的索基佐格将军。如果你需要一件新的黑石伪装，就跟伊崔格谈一谈。
text.description: 索基佐格将军跟其他食人魔一起待在火腹熔炉，他就在巨槌石西部边缘的洞穴里。我要你将这件货物交到他和食人魔手中。$b$b包裹里是你找来的新鲜狼肉，浸泡在我们从风暴祭坛取回的魔能泻药中。$b$b如果我是你的话，就绝不会碰这玩意儿。$b$b将它交给索基佐格将军。他一定会让食人魔饱餐一顿的；幸运的话，他自己也会来上一口。
text.progress: What've you got there, soldier?
text.completion: Well would you look at that!  My favorite soldier comes through in the clutch! I'll make sure to get this distributed among the ogres. I'll see you in Redridge, soldier.  For the glory of the Blackrock!
text.completed: Speak with General Thorg'izog within Firegut Furnace in Burning Steppes.

english.title: A Delivery for Thorg'izog
english.objectives: Using your Blackrock Disguise, bring the Slider Cider-Marinated Cutlets to General Thorg'izog at Firegut Furnace in Burning Steppes.  Speak with Eitrigg if you need a new Blackrock Disguise.
english.description: General Thorg'izog is staying among the ogres in the Firegut Furnace, a cave on the western edge of Dreadmaul Rock.  I'd like you to deliver this to him and the ogres.$b$bInside this package, you will find the worg cutlets you obtained, marinated in the fel slider cider that we took from the Altar of Storms.$b$bI would avoid eating it if I were you.$b$bBring it to General Thorg'izog.  He will make sure that his troops are fed and, with any luck, he will eat some himself.
english.progress: What've you got there, soldier?
english.completion: Well would you look at that!  My favorite soldier comes through in the clutch! I'll make sure to get this distributed among the ogres. I'll see you in Redridge, soldier.  For the glory of the Blackrock!
english.completed: Speak with General Thorg'izog within Firegut Furnace in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 送给尼纳拉克的货物
text.objectives: 使用黑石伪装，潜入颅骨密径，说服龙领主尼纳拉克收下一箱陷入昏睡的烈焰小鬼。如果你需要一件新的黑石伪装，就跟伊崔格谈一谈。
text.description: 黑石氏族的术士通常在颅骨密径练习魔法，那是一处位于巨槌石东部边缘的洞穴。他们的首领克希鲁恩有别的事情要忙，因此那里暂时由三巨头之一的龙领主尼纳拉克看守。尼纳拉克精通的是如何跟黑龙打交道，他对通灵术就一窍不通了。$b$b我对你抓来的烈焰小鬼使用了沉睡之砂。说服尼纳拉克它们只是术士的小鬼而已。等这帮家伙醒来时，就有好戏看啦。
text.progress: 什麽?
text.completion: What are these?  Oh, are these imps? I'm pretty sure that imps don't just fall asleep in boxes! I'll take your word for it, though.  I don't understand any of this warlock crap.  Leave them in the corner.
text.completed: Speak with Dragon-Lord Neeralak at the Skull Warren in Burning Steppes.

english.title: A Delivery for Neeralak
english.objectives: Using your Blackrock Disguise, sneak into the Skull Warren and convince Dragon-Lord Neeralak to take your Crate of Sleeping Flamekin.  Speak with Eitrigg if you need a new Blackrock Disguise.
english.description: The warlocks of the Blackrock Clan often practice their magic in the Skull Warren, a cave on the eastern side of Dreadmaul Rock.  Their leader, Xi'lun, is busy elsewhere, so the cave is currently being held by another of the Big Three: Dragon-Lord Neeralak.  And Neeralak's expertise is in dragons, not in necromancy.$b$bI've used the slumber sand on those flamekin you captured.  Try to convince Neeralak that they're warlock imps, and not flamekin.  When they wake up, they won't be happy.
english.progress: What?
english.completion: What are these?  Oh, are these imps? I'm pretty sure that imps don't just fall asleep in boxes! I'll take your word for it, though.  I don't understand any of this warlock crap.  Leave them in the corner.
english.completed: Speak with Dragon-Lord Neeralak at the Skull Warren in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 送给克希鲁恩的货物
text.objectives: 使用黑石伪装，将澄澈的玻璃球交给燃烧平原巨槌石的高阶术士克希鲁恩。如果你需要一件新的黑石伪装，就跟伊崔格谈一谈。
text.description: 情报指出，三巨头的最后一名成员高阶术士克希鲁恩在巨槌石顶端的洞穴中秘密策划着他的伟大计划。$b$b他在等一件东西：统御宝珠，想利用它执行强大的仪式。我要你给他的是：$b$b<托德曼递给你一颗玻璃球。>$b$b这颗玻璃球是你从风暴祭坛取回的。它没有任何能量。把这玩意儿交给克希鲁恩，然后祈祷他不会识破吧。
text.progress: I don't have time for games, fool.  Get out of my sight.
text.completion: Pff!  You're late!  Do you know how long I've been waiting for Ner'gosh to deliver this orb? There's something strange about this orb... it's too... Never mind, it must be my nerves talking.  Thank you for the delivery.  For blood and honor!
text.completed: Report to High Warlock Xi'lun at Dreadmaul Rock in Burning Steppes.

english.title: A Delivery for Xi'lun
english.objectives: While using the Blackrock Disguise, deliver the Clear Glass Orb to High Warlock Xi'lun atop Dreadmaul Rock in Burning Steppes.  Speak with Eitrigg if you need a new Blackrock Disguise.
english.description: Intel tells us that High Warlock Xi'lun - the final member of the Big Three - is within the cave atop Dreadmaul Peak, preparing for his big moment.$b$bHe is waiting for a delivery: an Orb of Domination, with which he can perform a powerful summoning ritual.  I want you to give him this:$b$b<Eitrigg hands you a glass orb.>$b$bThis is the clear glass orb that you freed from the Altar of Storms.  It is powerless.  Give it to Xi'lun, and cross your fingers that he doesn't notice.
english.progress: I don't have time for games, fool.  Get out of my sight.
english.completion: Pff!  You're late!  Do you know how long I've been waiting for Ner'gosh to deliver this orb? There's something strange about this orb... it's too... Never mind, it must be my nerves talking.  Thank you for the delivery.  For blood and honor!
english.completed: Report to High Warlock Xi'lun at Dreadmaul Rock in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 准备行动
text.objectives: 向燃烧平原烈焰峰的伊崔格报到。
text.description: $n，进来。你懂我的意思吗？$B$B战争就要开始了。我希望你送出了所有的包裹。$B$B现在，我需要你待在烈焰峰。
text.giverWindow: 赶快回到烈焰峰！战斗随时都会打响！

english.title: Locked and Loaded
english.objectives: Report to Eitrigg at Flame Crest in Burning Steppes.
english.description: $n, come in.  Can you read me?$b$bThe battle is about to start.  I hope you've delivered all of those packages.$b$bI need you here in Flame Crest, NOW.
english.giverWindow: Hurry back to Flame Crest!  It is nearly time for the battle!

text.title: 巨槌石之战
text.objectives: 击败200名黑石入侵者。如果你弄丢了载具，就使用召唤者号角再次召唤它。
text.description: 是啦，$n。悲伤的日子……但是黑石兽人也得到了惨痛的教训。我们的计划成功了。$B$B跟我来吧。我们要跟阿克莱德谈谈，他回馈恩情的时候到了。然后我们要在黑石大军展开赤脊山的入侵计划之前将其扼杀。
text.completion: Our job is almost done, $n.  It's time to deliver the deathblow.
text.completed: 返回燃烧平原的烈焰峰，向伊崔格复命。

english.title: Assault on Dreadmaul Rock
english.objectives: Slay 200 Blackrock Invaders.  If you should lose your vehicle, use the Horn of the Callers to summon it again.
english.description: This is it, $n.  A sad day... but a day in which the Blackrock orcs will learn a powerful lesson.  Today, our plan comes to fruition.$b$bCome with me.  We're going to go talk to Acride and call in that favor that he owes us.  Then we'll stop this invasion of Redridge before it even starts.
english.completion: Our job is almost done, $n.  It's time to deliver the deathblow.
english.completed: Return to Eitrigg at Flame Crest in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 混战中的荣耀
text.objectives: 杀死索基佐格将军、龙领主尼纳拉克和高阶术士克希鲁恩。
text.description: 你和我的儿子得返回巨槌石。攻势结束之后尚有三名兽人存活，不除掉他们我们就休得安宁。$b$b没错，我说的就是三巨头。$b$b索基佐格将军逃回了火腹熔炉，龙领主尼纳拉克躲藏在巨槌石顶端的洞穴中，克希鲁恩则在颅骨密径背后继续和他的术士走狗们谋划着什么。$b$b立下战功吧，$n。杀死这些堕落的黑石兽人。
text.completion: Welcome home, boys.
text.completed: 返回燃烧平原的烈焰峰，向伊崔格复命。

english.title: Glory Amidst Chaos
english.objectives: Kill General Thorg'izog, Dragon-Lord Neeralak, and High Warlock Xi'lun.
english.description: You and my son are going back to that mountain.  There's three orcs who survived the attack, and we won't rest until they're dead.$b$bThat's right, I'm talking about the Big Three.$b$bGeneral Thorg'izog crawled back into the Firegut Furnace, and Dragon-Lord Neeralak is cowering in the cave on the mountain's peak.  Xi'lun is in the back of the Skull Warren, plotting with his fellow warlocks.$b$bLeave your mark, $n.  Topple these corrupt Blackrock orcs once and for all.
english.completion: Welcome home, boys.
english.completed: Return to Eitrigg at Flame Crest in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 战利品
text.objectives: 查验燃烧平原烈焰峰的一箱剩余补给品。
text.description: 虽然黑石兽人仍然盘踞在他们的塔楼里，但是我相信短期内他们再也不敢轻易进犯赤脊山了。这一切都是你和阿里乌克的功劳。$b$b我们在燃烧平原收获了不少物资——我们搜集到的这些术士的玩意儿都能派上用场，还有我们用来隐藏龙族的黑曜石灰烬。$b$b但是还剩下了一些东西。在你离开燃烧平原之前，请随意挑选吧。
text.completion: You peer inside, and find...

english.title: The Spoils of War
english.objectives: Inspect the Box of Left Over Supplies at Flame Crest in Burning Steppes.
english.description: While the Blackrock orcs still swarm in their spire, I doubt their plans will take them anywhere near the innocent people of Redridge anytime soon.  You and Ariok saw to that.$b$bI'd say we were fairly resourceful here in Burning Steppes - those warlock supplies we collected certainly came in handy, as did the obsidian ash that we used to conceal our dragon.$b$bThere were, however, some collected items left over.  Please, take your pick before you move on, beyond the steppes.
english.completion: You peer inside, and find...

text.title: 危险的联盟
text.objectives: 在黑石深渊杀死6名火焰驱逐者，并从西区兵营的怒炉将军身上缴获将军的进攻计划书。
text.description: 碎手氏族相信黑铁矮人和暮光之锤正在携手。证据表明他们正在黑石山里准备发动一次联合进攻。我们不能让这样一支军队从黑石山开拔。$B$B你要到黑石深渊去，从西区兵营的怒炉将军身上弄到暮光之锤的战斗计划书。至于支援他的那些元素，不要犹豫，直接干掉。
text.progress: We cannot afford to allow the Dark Iron dwarves to ally with Twilight's Hammer.
text.completion: The warchief will be most interested in seeing these plans. You are a most loyal member of the Horde.
text.completed: Return to Gress Ragefist in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.

english.title: A Dangerous Alliance
english.objectives: Kill 6 Fireguard Destroyers and recover the General's Attack Plans from General Angerforge at the West Garrison in Blackrock Depths.
english.description: The Shattered Hand believes that the Dark Iron dwarves and Twilight's Hammer are working together. There's evidence that they are preparing a joint attack from within Blackrock Mountain. We can't allow such a force to depart Blackrock Mountain.$B$BYou must go into Blackrock Depths and capture the Twilight's Hammer attack plans from General Angerforge in the West Garrison. Eliminate the elementals Twilight's Hammer has provided to support his forces.
english.progress: We cannot afford to allow the Dark Iron dwarves to ally with Twilight's Hammer.
english.completion: The warchief will be most interested in seeing these plans. You are a most loyal member of the Horde.
english.completed: Return to Gress Ragefist in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.

text.title: 控火师的魔典
text.objectives: 杀掉6个暮光使者，并从石深渊索瑞森神殿控火师罗格雷恩的身上获得罗格雷恩的魔典。
text.description: 黑铁大军和他们盟友暮光之锤的势力在黑石山日趋壮大。在暮光之锤的团体里，控火师罗格雷恩是一位不但强大，而且很有影响力的大法师。如果我们能拿到他的魔典，我就能研究出法术反制暮光之锤的魔法和诅咒。$B$B你必须到黑石深渊下面的索瑞森神殿去，缴获那本魔典。不要给罗格雷恩和他的暮光爪牙留情。
text.progress: Have you managed to capture the pyromancer's grimoire?
text.completion: There's a wealth of arcane knowledge in this book! We will learn much about our enemies and the arcane arts.
text.completed: Return to Ureda in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow.

english.title: The Pyromancer's Grimoire
english.objectives: Kill 6 Twilight Emissaries and recover Loregrain's Grimoire from Pyromancer Loregrain at the Shrine of Thaurissan in Blackrock Depths.
english.description: The power of the Dark Iron forces and their Twilight's Hammer allies is growing within Blackrock Mountain. Pyromancer Loregrain is a powerful and influential magus in the Twilight's Hammer delegation. If we could get our hands on his grimoire, I could develop counters for Twilight's Hammer spells and curses.$B$BYou must descend into Blackrock Depths, locate the Shrine of Thaurissan, and capture the grimoire. Show Loregrain and his Twilight minions no mercy.
english.progress: Have you managed to capture the pyromancer's grimoire?
english.completion: There's a wealth of arcane knowledge in this book! We will learn much about our enemies and the arcane arts.
english.completed: Return to Ureda in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow.

text.title: 绑缚之石
text.objectives: 从黑石深渊找到6块元素束缚之石。你可以在暗炉城、住宅区、索瑞森神殿、东区兵营，以及西区兵营这些地方找到它们。
text.description: 碎手氏族已经发现黑石深渊暮光之锤和黑铁矮人的联系日益紧密。这是一个机会，$n，可以让我们打击敌人，壮大自己。$B$B暮光之锤的追随者们在暗炉城、住宅区、索瑞森神殿、东区兵营，以及西区兵营这些地方放置了一系列的元素束缚之石。找到并缴获那些石头！
text.progress: Have you managed to find those binding stones?
text.completion: The binding stones you brought back are exceedingly powerful. Not only have we dealt a blow to the Horde's enemies, but you have also discovered a fascinating source of power.
text.completed: Return to Zevrost in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow.

english.title: Stones of Binding
english.objectives: Recover 6 Elemental Binding Stones from Blackrock Depths. You can find the stones in Shadowforge City, the Domicile, the Shrine of Thaurissan, the East Garrison, and the West Garrison.
english.description: The Shattered Hand has discovered increased collaboration between Twilight's Hammer and the Dark Iron dwarves in Blackrock Depths. We have an opportunity to strike at our enemies and empower ourselves, $n.$B$BTwilight's Hammer followers have placed a number of elemental binding stones throughout Shadowforge City, the Domicile, the Shrine of Thaurissan, the West Garrison and the East Garrison. Find and capture those stones!
english.progress: Have you managed to find those binding stones?
english.completion: The binding stones you brought back are exceedingly powerful. Not only have we dealt a blow to the Horde's enemies, but you have also discovered a fascinating source of power.
english.completed: Return to Zevrost in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow.

items.name: Horns of the Left Hand Path

text.title: 冬泉熊怪的威胁
text.objectives: 在冰火温泉附近杀死任意15个冬泉熊怪。
text.description: 我是来冬泉谷调查冰火温泉的。我注意到这里的泉水似乎有些……古怪。我暂时还没有找出问题的根源，老实说，我最近遇到一些麻烦，都是那些冬泉熊怪在作祟。$B$B它们跟我一样被吸引到了泉水附近。这些熊怪对水源的保护意识极强，不让我接近北边那两处较大的温泉。$B$B我想继续进行研究，你能帮帮我吗？
text.completion: 非常感谢你，$N!现在我可以继续研究了。$B$B你在冬泉熊怪的营地里发现什麽有趣的东西没有?$B$B
text.completed: Return to Donova Snowden at the Frostfire Hot Springs in Winterspring.

english.title: Threat of the Winterfall
english.objectives: Slay 15 Winterfall furbolg of any kind near the Frostfire Hot Springs.
english.description: I came to Winterspring to investigate the Frostfire Hot Springs. I've noticed that the water seems to have... strange qualities. I haven't yet been able to discover the source, and to tell you the truth, I've had some difficulty lately, due to the Winterfall furbolg.$B$BThey seem to be drawn to the springs, just as I am. They have become extremely protective of the water, and won't let me come near the two larger springs to the north of here.$B$BI'd like to continue my studies, so won't you help me?
english.completion: Thanks so much, $n! Now I can get back to work here.$B$BDid you find anything of interest at the Winterfall camp?
