english.completed: Return to Donova Snowden at the Frostfire Hot Springs in Winterspring.

text.title: 傀儡统帅的造物
text.objectives: 从黑石深渊制造厂获得5个元素模组，并且拿回元素傀儡蓝图。
text.description: 碎手氏族从黑石深渊带来了一些令人不安的情报。看来暮光之锤在和黑铁工程师阿格曼奇合作制造由元素驱动的战争傀儡。这些傀儡可以让敌人占据极大的优势。$b$b你的任务就是阻止这一切的发生。在黑石深渊找到制造厂，缴获他用来制造傀儡的蓝图，把他用来启动它们的元素模组拿走。
text.progress: We cannot afford to allow those golems to be used against us.
text.completion: Can you imagine what would happen if they got these models working and into the field? You've done a great service for the Horde, $n.
text.completed: Return to Ormak Grimshot in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.

english.title: The Golem Lord's Creations
english.objectives: Obtain 5 Elemental Modules from the golems in the Manufactory of Blackrock Depths and recover the Elemental Golem Blueprints.
english.description: The Shattered Hand has discovered some disturbing information in Blackrock Depths. It appears Twilight's Hammer is working with the Dark Iron engineer, Argelmach, to create war golems powered by elementals. These golems could be a great advantage for our enemies.$B$BIt is your duty to prevent that from happening. Find the Manufactory in Blackrock Depths, capture the blueprints he's using to make those golems, and recover the elemental modules he's using to power them.
english.progress: We cannot afford to allow those golems to be used against us.
english.completion: Can you imagine what would happen if they got these models working and into the field? You've done a great service for the Horde, $n.
english.completed: Return to Ormak Grimshot in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.

text.title: 冬泉火酒
text.objectives: 将空的火酒瓶交给冬泉谷的多诺瓦·雪山。
text.description: 你从冬泉熊怪那儿拣来的这只小瓶子是空的，但是里面有一些奇怪的绿色液体，它甚至发出了微微的光芒。$B$B这会是什么重要的东西吗？$B$B多诺瓦·雪山可能会告诉你更多的信息，她在冬泉谷的温泉附近有个营地。

english.title: Winterfall Firewater
english.objectives: Bring the Empty Firewater Flask to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.
english.description: This vial that you picked up from the Winterfall furbolg is empty, but you can detect a few drops of a strange green liquid inside; it almost glows.$B$BIs it something important?$B$BDonova Snowden would probably be able to tell you more, since she has been camped by the hot springs in Winterspring for some time now.

text.title: 黑铁大军
text.objectives: 用速效毒药污染黑石深渊西区军营或东区军营的6份谷物军粮。
text.description: 你也知道，作为碎手的一员，我们的任务就是监视部落的敌人。我们发现黑铁矮人和他们的新盟友暮光之锤正在准备展开攻势。$B$B我要把你派去帮忙，在黑铁大军出征之前把问题处理掉。带上这份毒药到黑石深渊去，给他们士兵的军粮下毒。$B$B黑铁大军的口粮大部分都存在黑石深渊的东区和西区兵营。
text.completion: The poison should decimate their ranks if they're slow in discovering the tainted rations. Even if it does not kill most of the troops, we will have delayed them significantly. Well done.
text.completed: Return to Gordul in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow.

english.title: The Dark Iron Army
english.objectives: Use the Fast-Acting Poison to contaminate 6 Grain Rations in the West Garrison or East Garrison of Blackrock Depths.
english.description: As a member of the Shattered Hand, you know that it is our job to watch the Horde's enemies. We have discovered that the Dark Iron dwarves and their new allies, Twilight's Hammer, are preparing to attack.$B$BI'm sending you to help deal with this threat before the Dark Iron army marches. Take this poison and apply it to the soldiers' rations of grain in Blackrock Depths.$B$BThe rations for most of the Dark Iron army are kept in the East and West Garrison of Blackrock Depths.
english.completion: The poison should decimate their ranks if they're slow in discovering the tainted rations. Even if it does not kill most of the troops, we will have delayed them significantly. Well done.
english.completed: Return to Gordul in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow.

text.title: 堕入腐蚀
text.objectives: 在寒水村营地北部找到寒水村大锅。
text.description: 冬泉熊怪的攻击性必然有其源头。我一定要尽全力把它查个水落石出！$B$B我看到北边营地里的熊怪在用一口大锅酿制些什么东西。他们好像在严加保护它……如果他们正在酿制的东西就是这一切的源头，那么我必须亲自检验一下才行。$B$B去看看那口锅是不是还在那里，给我把里面的东西带一些回来！
text.completion: 锅中翻腾着一种令人作呕的腐烂物质……$B$B

english.title: Falling to Corruption
english.objectives: Find the Winterfall Cauldron at the northern Winterfall camp.
english.description: The aggression of the Winterfall furbolg has to have its source somewhere. I'd like to get to the bottom of it if I can!$B$BI've seen the furbolg in the camps to the north brewing something in a cauldron. They seemed very protective of it... if whatever they're cooking up is what's causing this, I must examine it myself.$B$BFind that cauldron if it's still there, and bring me back what's inside!
english.completion: Inside the cauldron bubbles a rotting, repulsive-smelling substance...

text.title: 炎魔之王的奴隶们
text.objectives: 用自由图腾在黑石深渊解放6名火焰卫士、火焰驱逐者或炽热火焰卫士的精华。
text.description: 暮光之锤邪教和黑铁矮人正在黑石深渊里集结兵力。被炎魔之王拉格纳罗斯所束缚的，为其效命的大量火元素在他们后面压阵。$B$B如果我们能把这些元素从束缚中解放出来，就不但能削弱敌人，还能尽我们的本职。带上这根图腾，对那些被制约住的元素使用。它将把它们的灵魂从约束中解放出来，恢复其自然的天性。
text.completion: Your actions honor the ancestors and the Horde, $n.
text.completed: Return to Kardris Dreamseeker in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom.

english.title: Slaves of the Firelord
english.objectives: Use the Totem of Freedom to free the essences of 6 Fireguards, Fireguard Destroyers, or Blazing Fireguards in Blackrock Depths.
english.description: Within the halls of Blackrock Depths, the Twilight's Hammer cult and the Dark Iron dwarves are gathering their forces. Backing up their legions are hordes of fire elementals bound to the service of the firelord, Ragnaros.$B$BIf we can free those elementals from their bonds, we can both weaken our enemies and honor the elements. Take this totem with you and use it on subdued fireguards. It will free their spirits from their bondage and restore them to their natural state.
english.completion: Your actions honor the ancestors and the Horde, $n.
english.completed: Return to Kardris Dreamseeker in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom.

text.title: 黑暗的武器
text.objectives: 从黑石深渊的铁怒矮人身上缴获5把元素灌能武器，然后在暗炉城的黑铁砧上将它们敲断。
text.description: 长年来，黑石深渊就是我们敌人的老家，但现在碎手氏族发现黑铁矮人和暮光之锤加大了合作力度。在邪教的帮助下，黑铁矮人将元素的力量灌注在他们的武器里，然后用这些可怕的新兵器武装铁怒军团。$B$B我要你进入黑石深渊，从铁怒矮人身上把那些武器缴下来，然后在暗炉城心脏地带的黑铁砧上将它们打断。
text.completion: Without those weapons, the Dark Irons will never be a match for the Horde. You have served your brothers and sisters well this day, $n.
text.completed: Return to Sunwalker Atohmo in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom.

english.title: Weapons of Darkness
english.objectives: Capture 5 Elemental-Imbued Weapons from Anvilrage dwarves in Blackrock Depths, then break them over the Black Anvil in Shadowforge City.
english.description: Blackrock Depths has long been home to our enemies, but now the Shattered Hand has discovered that the Dark Irons and Twilight's Hammer are increasing their collaboration. Using the cult's knowledge, the Dark Iron dwarves are imbuing their weapons with elemental powers. They've outfitted the Anvilrage legion with these fearsome new weapons.$B$BI want you to go into Blackrock Depths and gather the weapons from the Anvilrage dwarves there and break them over the Black Anvil in the heart of Shadowforge City.
english.completion: Without those weapons, the Dark Irons will never be a match for the Horde. You have served your brothers and sisters well this day, $n.
english.completed: Return to Sunwalker Atohmo in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom.

text.title: 神秘的粘液
text.objectives: 将你的发现报告给多诺瓦·雪山。
text.description: 锅里沸腾的绿色物质非常腐烂粘稠。无论它是什么，都绝对不是好东西。$B$B你最好赶快向多诺瓦汇报你的发现，顺便从锅里采集一点液体样本给她。
text.progress: 我希望你有些发现，$N。寒水熊变得越来越咄咄逼人了!
text.completion: Disturbing news indeed. This stuff's much more like what you'd see in Felwood than in Winterspring...

english.title: Mystery Goo
english.objectives: Report back to Donova Snowden with your findings.
english.description: The greenish substance inside the cauldron is putrid and viscous.  No matter what it is, it doesn't seem to be good.$B$BIt would be best to report back to Donova with your findings, along with a sample of the liquid in the cauldron.
english.progress: I hope you found something, $n. The Winterfall are becoming increasingly aggressive!
english.completion: Disturbing news indeed. This stuff's much more like what you'd see in Felwood than in Winterspring...

text.title: 剧毒之水
text.objectives: 为冬泉谷的多诺瓦·雪山收集3份剧毒水滴。
text.description: 我研究了你取回来的样本，虽然我还无法确定，但是我相信其中包含着有毒的成分。判断这一点的唯一方法是收集其它类似的物质进行比较。$B$B我想死木熊怪也许会从费伍德森林的其它堕落生物那儿收集这些东西，尤其是生活在铁木森林中的那种被称作剧毒之水的元素生物。$B$B为我收集一些样本以进行比较，但是要小心——那里是个非常危险的地方！
text.completed: Return to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

english.title: [DEPRECATED]Toxic Horrors
english.objectives: Collect 3 Toxic Horror Droplets for Donova Snowden in Winterspring.
english.description: I've studied the sample you returned with, and while I can't say for sure, I believe it contains traces of toxic elements. However, the only way to know for sure is to gather some as a comparison.$B$BI believe that the Deadwood furbolg may be gathering these elements from other corrupted creatures in Felwood; in particular, the elementals living in the Irontree Woods, called toxic horrors.$B$BCollect a few samples for me to compare, but be careful -- it's very dangerous there!
english.completed: Return to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

text.title: 冬泉信使
text.objectives: 找到并击败冬泉信使，夺取他们的冬泉箱子。
text.description: 真有趣，$n……$B$B当这种有毒物质与温泉里的水混合的时候，它的毒性就消失了，对饮用者来说，它只会产生暂时的影响。这必定是冬泉熊怪如此热衷于守护温泉的原因——它们需要这些泉水来净化火酒。$B$B我们必须阻止它们——截断冬泉熊怪与死木熊怪之间的联系。有一队冬泉熊怪的信使往返于它们的村子和费伍德森林之间。找到它们，把它们的货物劫下来。
text.progress: 让我们来看没有火水的冬泉熊怪变成什麽样子吧!
text.completion: <多诺瓦检查木箱内的物品>$B$B我在想，熊怪是不是在喝下了这种东西之後就会变得更具攻击性。它们看起来真的比以前更巨大……$B$B
text.completed: Return to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

english.title: Winterfall Runners
english.objectives: Find and defeat the Winterfall Runner and take the Winterfall Crate from him.
english.description: Very interesting, $n...$B$BWhen this toxic substance is mixed with the water from the hot springs, it loses its toxicity, only retaining the ability to temporarily affect those that ingest it. This must be why the Winterfall protect the hot springs so fervently -- they need them to purify their firewater.$B$BWe need to stop this -- cut off contact between the Winterfall and the Deadwood. A group of runners walks the distance between their village and Felwood. Find and defeat them, and steal their shipment.
english.progress: We'll see what happens when the Winterfall don't get their firewater!
english.completion: <Donova examines the contents of the crate.>$B$BI wonder if consuming this substance makes the furbolg more aggressive. They do seem much larger...
english.completed: Return to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

text.title: 冬泉酋长
text.objectives: 杀死冬泉酋长。
text.description: 冬泉熊怪通常来说不是攻击性的部族，他们行为的改变使我觉得，他们肯定是受到了本部族酋长的指示才这么做的。我们大约没办法消除他们造成的破坏，但是如果能干掉他们的领袖，也许他们的情况不会变得更糟。$B$B再回到东边去，走过你发现大锅的地方。冬泉酋长就在此地，木喉岗哨的最东边。
text.completion: 非常感谢你，$N。我希望能不受干扰地继续进行我的研究。请收下这个作为报酬。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

english.title: High Chief Winterfall
english.objectives: Slay High Chief Winterfall.
english.description: The Winterfall furbolg are not a normally aggressive tribe, and this change in their behavior leads me to think that they must be under orders from their chief. We most likely can't undo the damage that has already been done, but if their leader is slain, they may not get any worse.$B$BHead east again, past where you found that cauldron. High Chief Winterfall is here, at the easternmost part of Timbermaw Post.
english.completion: Thank you so much, $n. I hope to get back to my studies without worry that I will be ambushed. Please accept this as a reward.
english.completed: Return to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

text.title: 最后一片
text.objectives: 把潦草的日志交给冬泉谷的多诺瓦·雪山。
text.description: 你在冬泉酋长身上找到的日志看起来内容丰富，但是看完几页之后，你发现自己完全看不懂这本书。上面的符号粗糙而又拙劣——你不禁怀疑是否真的有人能读懂它们。$B$B不过，多诺瓦也许能告诉你这本书上写了些什么……
text.progress: 嗯，这是什麽，$N?
text.completion: 我在想这些东西代表了什麽……我什麽都看不出来……$B$B

english.title: The Final Piece
english.objectives: Bring the Crudely-written Log to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.
english.description: The log you found on the high chief looks extensive, but after looking through a couple of the pages, you find that you cannot read the text. The markings are so crude and poorly-formed that you are not sure if anyone would be able to read them.$B$BBut perhaps Donova will be able to tell you what it says...
english.progress: Now, what's this, $n?
english.completion: I wonder what all of this means... I can't make anything out...

text.title: 熊怪酋长的话
text.objectives: 将潦草的日志交给费伍德森林南部的科雷克·望天。
text.description: 冬泉熊怪对我而言已不是个威胁了，但是如果你仍然想要查出是什么驱使熊怪制造并饮用这种奇怪的火酒，那么你应该去寻求科雷克·望天的帮助。$B$B他是个德鲁伊，曾帮助翡翠议会净化费伍德，现在到这里来研究附近的废墟了。$B$B你可以到东边的凯斯利尔湖去找他，最近他都在那边打发时间。
text.progress: What is it you carry, $c?
text.completion: 嗯，如果你让我好好研究一下这个，我可能会帮你翻译出来。$B$B<科雷克翻动着书页。>$B$B等我看完它之後，我会通知你的。$B$B谢谢你把它交给我，$N。说实话，我对冬泉熊怪知之甚少。$B$B

english.title: Words of the High Chief
english.objectives: Take the Crudely-written Log to Kelek Skykeeper at Lake Kel'theril.
english.description: The Winterfall are no longer a threat to me, but if you still want to find out what was driving the furbolg to create and consume this strange firewater, I think you should seek out Kelek Skykeeper.$B$BHe's a druid that once worked to help cleanse Felwood with the Emerald Circle, and has since come here to study the nearby ruins.$B$BYou might be able to find him to the east at Lake Kel'theril, where he spends his time recently.
english.progress: What is it you carry, $c?
english.completion: Yes, if you let me examine this for a while, I might be able to translate it for you.$B$B<Kelek flips through the pages.>$B$BWhen I am able to look over this fully, I will send word to you.$B$BThank you for sharing this with me, $n. Very little is known about the Winterfall furbolg.

text.title: 黑暗的武器
text.objectives: 从黑石深渊的铁怒矮人身上缴获5把元素灌能武器，然后在暗炉城的黑铁砧上将它们敲断。
text.description: 长年来，黑石深渊就是我们敌人的老家，但现在碎手氏族发现黑铁矮人和暮光之锤加大了合作力度。在邪教的帮助下，黑铁矮人将元素的力量灌注在他们的武器里，然后用这些可怕的新兵器武装铁怒军团。$B$B我要你进入黑石深渊，从铁怒矮人身上把那些武器缴下来，然后在暗炉城心脏地带的黑铁砧上将它们打断。
text.completion: Your actions honor your brethren and the Horde, $n.
text.completed: Return to Master Pyreanor in Orgrimmar's Grommash Hold.

english.title: Weapons of Darkness
english.objectives: Capture 5 Elemental-Imbued Weapons from Anvilrage dwarves in Blackrock Depths, then break them over the Black Anvil in Shadowforge City.
english.description: Blackrock Depths has long been home to our enemies, but now the Shattered Hand has discovered that the Dark Irons and Twilight's Hammer are increasing their collaboration. Using the cult's knowledge, the Dark Iron dwarves are imbuing their weapons with elemental powers. They've outfitted the Anvilrage legion with these fearsome new weapons.$B$BI want you to go into Blackrock Depths and gather the weapons from the Anvilrage dwarves there and break them over the Black Anvil in the heart of Shadowforge City.
english.completion: Your actions honor your brethren and the Horde, $n.
english.completed: Return to Master Pyreanor in Orgrimmar's Grommash Hold.

text.title: 暮光的诡计
text.objectives: 用发光的火炬点燃黑石深渊住宅区的8本暮光教义。
text.description: 暮光之锤在黑石深渊里的影响日益扩大。他们已经同黑铁矮人结盟，打算说服他们打出山外。$B$B我们必须摧毁暮光之锤的煽动工具。把他们对黑铁矮人的影响降到最小。$B$B我要你到黑石深渊的住宅区去，用这把火炬点燃暮光之锤发放到那里的书籍。
text.completion: This will not dissuade Twilight's Hammer, but perhaps it will increase the suspicion between them and the Dark Irons.
text.completed: Return to Dark Cleric Cecille at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.

english.title: Twilight Scheming
english.objectives: Use the Glowing Torch to destroy 8 copies of The Twilight Creed in the Domicile of Blackrock Depths.
english.description: The influence of Twilight's Hammer grows within Blackrock Depths. They have allied with the Dark Iron dwarves and seek to convince them to strike outside the mountain.$B$BWe must destroy the instruments of the Twilight's Hammer agitation. Their influence over the Dark Irons must be minimized.$B$BI want you to go into Domicile portion of Blackrock Depths and use this torch to burn the books that the Twilight's Hammer is distributing there.
english.completion: This will not dissuade Twilight's Hammer, but perhaps it will increase the suspicion between them and the Dark Irons.
english.completed: Return to Dark Cleric Cecille at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 暮光的诡计
text.objectives: 用发光的火炬点燃黑石深渊住宅区的8本暮光教义。
text.description: 在黑石深渊，暮光之锤开始说服黑铁矮人巩固他们的盟约，为了山外面的战役准备兵力。$B$B我们不能让暮光之锤操纵黑铁矮人，组织起一支联军来！我们必须摧毁邪教的说服工具。$B$B我要你到黑石深渊的住宅区去，用这把火炬点燃暮光之锤发放到那里的书籍。
text.completion: We can only hope your efforts will keep the two forces apart long enough for us to exploit their weakness.
text.completed: Return to Tyelis at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.

english.title: Twilight Scheming
english.objectives: Use the Glowing Torch to destroy 8 copies of The Twilight Creed in the Domicile of Blackrock Depths.
english.description: In Blackrock Depths, Twilight's Hammer has started to persuade the Dark Irons to strengthen their alliance and prepare their armies for a campaign outside the mountain.$B$BWe must not allow this manipulation to create a combined Dark Iron-Twilight's Hammer force! We must destroy the tools of the cult's persuasion.$B$BI want you to go into Domicile portion of Blackrock Depths and use this torch to burn the books that the Twilight's Hammer is distributing there.
english.completion: We can only hope your efforts will keep the two forces apart long enough for us to exploit their weakness.
english.completed: Return to Tyelis at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 暮光的诡计
text.objectives: 用发光的火炬点燃黑石深渊住宅区的8本暮光教义。
text.description: 在黑石深渊，暮光之锤开始说服黑铁矮人巩固他们的盟约，为了山外面的战役准备兵力。$B$B在邪教徒把黑铁矮人及其领导层的嗜血情绪煽动起来之前，我们必须采取行动。也许最好的办法，就是毁掉邪教徒分发给矮人的材料。$B$B我要你到黑石深渊的住宅区去，用这把火炬点燃暮光之锤发放到那里的书籍。
text.completion: We can only hope that the confusion and distrust you have created enables us to keep our enemies divided.
text.completed: Return to Seer Liwatha in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom.

english.title: Twilight Scheming
english.objectives: Use the Glowing Torch to destroy 8 copies of The Twilight Creed in the Domicile of Blackrock Depths.
english.description: In Blackrock Depths, Twilight's Hammer has started to persuade the Dark Irons to strengthen their alliance and wage a campaign of conquest.$B$BWe have to act before the cultists can whip up the bloodlust in the Dark Irons and their leadership. Perhaps the best way to deal with this is to destroy the material the cultists are distributing to the dwarves.$B$BI want you to go into Domicile portion of Blackrock Depths and use this torch to burn the books that the Twilight's Hammer is distributing there.
english.completion: We can only hope that the confusion and distrust you have created enables us to keep our enemies divided.
english.completed: Return to Seer Liwatha in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom.

text.title: 暮光的诡计
text.objectives: 用发光的火炬点燃黑石深渊住宅区的8本暮光教义。
text.description: 我们的敌人们在黑石深渊的大厅里阴谋对付我们。暮光之锤的邪教徒们，正忙着向黑铁矮人传道，分发书籍，煽动他们发动战争。有了黑铁大军撑腰，暮光之锤就变成了一股可怕的势力。我们必须阻止这一煽动行为！$B$B我要你到黑石深渊的住宅区去，用这把火炬点燃那些暮光之锤的书籍！
text.completion: I shoulda asked you to mind control the cultists and truly tear our enemies apart. But what you did will work, $n.
text.completed: Return to Shadow-Walker Zuru in Orgrimmar's Valley of the Spirits.

english.title: Twilight Scheming
english.objectives: Use the Glowing Torch to destroy 8 copies of The Twilight Creed in the Domicile of Blackrock Depths.
english.description: Our enemies be plottin' against us in the halls of Blackrock Depths. The Twilight's Hammer cultists, they be busy preaching and handin' out books to the Dark Irons, tellin' them that it's time for war. Wit' a Dark Iron army at their backs, the Twilight's Hammer be a formidable force. We must put an end to the agitation!$B$BI be wantin' you to go into Domicile of Blackrock Depths and use this torch to burn those Twilight's Hammer books!
english.completion: I shoulda asked you to mind control the cultists and truly tear our enemies apart. But what you did will work, $n.
english.completed: Return to Shadow-Walker Zuru in Orgrimmar's Valley of the Spirits.

text.title: 暮光的诡计
text.objectives: 用发光的火炬点燃黑石深渊住宅区的8本暮光教义。
text.description: 他们的主子把世界破坏成这样还嫌不够，不！暮光之锤在竭尽所能联合我们的敌人对付我们，尤其是在黑石深渊。他们组织了一队使节，下去大肆宣传，目的是发动一场联合战役。$B$B我总听人说媒介就是讯息。那么，就该把那讯息给摧毁掉！$B$B我要你到黑石深渊的住宅区去，用这把火炬点燃那些暮光之锤的书籍！
text.completion: That's the way you do it when you don't have an army. And now, Twilight's Hammer won't, either.
text.completed: Return to Brother Silverhallow in Orgrimmar's Goblin Slums.

english.title: Twilight Scheming
english.objectives: Use the Glowing Torch to destroy 8 copies of The Twilight Creed in the Domicile of Blackrock Depths.
english.description: It wasn't enough for their master to break the world, no! Twilight's Hammer is doing its best to unite our enemies against us, particularly in Blackrock Depths. They've got a whole team of emissaries down there spreading propaganda aimed at starting a joint campaign.$B$BI've always head that the medium's the message. Well, it's time to destroy the message!$B$BI be want you to go into the Domicile of Blackrock Depths and use this torch to burn those Twilight's Hammer books!
english.completion: That's the way you do it when you don't have an army. And now, Twilight's Hammer won't, either.
english.completed: Return to Brother Silverhallow in Orgrimmar's Goblin Slums.

text.title: 凯斯利尔废墟
text.objectives: 跟冬泉谷凯斯利尔湖的卡多雷之魂谈一谈。
text.description: 上层精灵从凯斯利尔湖偷走了辛玛洛水晶。作为强大的圣物，这颗水晶蕴含着狂野难测的奥术魔法能量……只有能者才可以驾驭它，为世人带来厄运。$B$B这里的灵魂被辛玛洛禁锢，世代徘徊在凯斯利尔湖。$B$B如果你想了解辛玛洛的命运，就去湖中心找卡多雷之魂吧……
text.completion: Pity me, stranger, and all the Highborne, for it was here our folly began... our folly that cursed our children, and our children's children, to this day.

english.title: The Ruins of Kel'Theril
english.objectives: Speak with the Kaldorei Spirit at Lake Kel'theril in Winterspring.
english.description: At this lake, the Crystal of Zin-Malor was stolen by the Highborne. The crystal was a powerful artifact that bent arcane magic in wild and unpredictable ways... but it could only be held by the worthy, and brought doom upon all others.$B$BThe spirits that wander here span generations, each shackled here by Zin-Malor. Some will speak and tell their fates.$B$BShould you wish to learn the fate of Zin-Malor, seek the spirit at the center of the lake...
english.completion: Pity me, stranger, and all the Highborne, for it was here our folly began... our folly that cursed our children, and our children's children, to this day.

text.title: 黑暗的副手
text.objectives: 击败毒蝎领主纳穆卡哈雷和高阶祭司塞卡赫莫特。
text.description: 尼斐塞特那些不朽的守护巨神像把拉穆卡恒的部队打得溃不成军。$B$B打败他们的唯一办法就是杀掉尼斐塞特的黑暗法老。$B$B不过，在我们行动之前，得先把他的副手除掉。$B$B到敌后去击败毒蝎领主纳穆卡哈雷和高阶祭司塞卡赫莫特。只有那时，我们才能面对黑暗法老本人。
text.completion: You are a valuable ally, $n.  We are one step closer to defeating the enemy.
text.completed: Return to King Phaoris at the Neferset City Outskirts in Uldum.

english.title: Lieutenants of Darkness
english.objectives: Slay Scorpion-Lord Namkhare and High Priest Sekhemet.
english.description: The armies of Ramkahen are getting obliterated by Neferset's immortal guardians.$B$BThe only way to defeat them is to slay the Dark Pharaoh of Neferset.$B$BBefore we make our move, however, we're going to need to take care of his lieutenants.$B$BGo behind the battle-lines and slay Scorpion-Lord Namkhare and High Priest Sekhemet.  Only then will we be ready to confront the Dark Pharaoh himself.
english.completion: You are a valuable ally, $n.  We are one step closer to defeating the enemy.
english.completed: Return to King Phaoris at the Neferset City Outskirts in Uldum.

text.title: 凯斯利尔的怨灵
text.objectives: Use Gormir's Pick to find the four Highborne Relic Fragments.
text.description: 那些上层精灵的灵魂是非常悲惨的，他们仍在寻找那件诅咒了他们、使他们被困在凯斯利尔的古代遗物的碎片。$B$B如果你感兴趣的话，拿着我的镐到南方的湖边去，看看你能否从冰里找到它的碎片。$B$B眼下我不能告诉你任何有关这些碎片的事，但我知道谁可以……奥萝拉，她就住在东瘟疫之地北部的北地哨塔附近。
text.completed: Return to Gormir Stoneshaper at Starfall Village in Winterspring.

english.title: Troubled Spirits of Kel'Theril
english.objectives: Use Gormir's Pick to find the four Highborne Relic Fragments.
english.description: The highborne spirits are miserable creatures, that's for sure. They are still searching for pieces of the very thing that has cursed them to Kel'Theril forever -- the stolen relic.$B$BIf you are that interested, take my pick and go south to the lake, see if you can gather the pieces of it from within the ice.
english.completed: Return to Gormir Stoneshaper at Starfall Village in Winterspring.

text.title: 苏拉赫的礼物
text.objectives: 与朝圣崖的哈里森·琼斯交谈。
text.description: 琼斯跟我说你们俩要到那座山上去。$b$b嗯，那座山上密密麻麻地爬满了士兵，你们是没法过去的。$b$b我有朋友弄来了一点点敌人的装备，应该可以让你们的旅途轻松一些。$b$b到北边的山脊上去，就可以发现你们需要的东西正在等着你们。$b$b祝你们好运，小伙子们！
text.completion: Glad you could make it, $n!
text.completed: 与朝圣崖的哈里森·琼斯交谈。

english.title: Sullah's Gift
english.objectives: Speak to Harrison Jones at Pilgrim's Precipice.
english.description: Jonesy tells me you two need to make it up that mountain.$b$bWell, you're not going far with those troopers crawling all over it like ants on a carcass.$b$bSome of my friends were able to confiscate a bit of the enemy's hardware. It should make your journey a bit easier.$b$bMake your way up the ridgeline to the north, and you'll find it waiting for you.$b$bGood luck, you two!
english.completion: Glad you could make it, $n!
english.completed: Speak to Harrison Jones at Pilgrim's Precipice.

text.title: 横扫敌人
text.objectives: 获得10个尼斐塞特徽记。
text.description: 我跟你说实话吧，$n。在我们面前的是一个严峻的挑战。$B$B我要你潜入敌后的尼斐塞特城，消灭那些尼斐塞特渣滓，把他们的徽记带回来。$B$B这样就能挫败敌人的士气，让他们了解你造成的打击有多么致命。
text.progress: It is good to see you once more, $n.
text.completion: Excellent job, $n.  Our troops will hear of your deeds.
text.completed: Return to King Phaoris at the Neferset City Outskirts in Uldum.

english.title: Bleeding the Enemy
english.objectives: Obtain 10 Neferset Insignia.
english.description: I will not lie to you, $n.  We face a tremendous challenge ahead of us.$B$BAs you go behind the enemy lines into Neferset City, I want you to bring back the insignia of any Neferset scum you defeat.$B$BIt will be a boon to our armies to know that you've dealt a crushing blow to the enemy.
english.progress: It is good to see you once more, $n.
english.completion: Excellent job, $n.  Our troops will hear of your deeds.
english.completed: Return to King Phaoris at the Neferset City Outskirts in Uldum.

text.title: 雪人的毛发
text.objectives: 收集12份雪人的毛发。
text.description: 大法师整天一副无所事事的模样，想出来的计策自然很糟糕。这次我的任务是收集野兽的毛发，以此制作什么控制魔杖。我才不要出去打猎呢——尤其是雪人！$B$B如果我出个价，你愿意替我跑一趟吗？去西边的洞穴击败雪人，收集雪人的毛发，然后带回来给我就好啦。
text.progress: Bring me yeti hearts, $n.
text.completion: I... um... well... turns out he doesn't need the hearts anymore. Sorry about that! Hope it wasn't too inconvenient! A deal's a deal though, so here is your reward. You can go ahead and keep the yeti hearts. I hear they hold excellent nutritional value - if you're into eating.
text.completed: Return to Keeper Bel'varil at Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: The Heart of the Matter
english.objectives: Collect 12 Beating Yeti Hearts.
english.description: The magus has been idle for far too long and an idle magus often leads to poorly thought out schemes. This time I am charged with collecting various beast organs in order to power some type of control rod. I am far too frail to go out hunting beasts - especially yetis!$B$BPerhaps if I were to offer you a reward of some kind you would do it? All I need is for you to head west to the yeti caves and kill yetis. Rip their still beating hearts from their chests and bring them back here.
english.progress: Bring me yeti hearts, $n.
english.completion: I... um... well... turns out he doesn't need the hearts anymore. Sorry about that! Hope it wasn't too inconvenient! A deal's a deal though, so here is your reward. You can go ahead and keep the yeti hearts. I hear they hold excellent nutritional value - if you're into eating.
english.completed: Return to Keeper Bel'varil at Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 雪怪之王耶提玛斯
text.objectives: 取回耶提玛斯的扭曲之角。
text.description: 数年来，我们任由这里的山地雪人肆意横行。对雪人放任不管的政策最终导致了异常的后果！雪怪之王耶提玛斯的体型和力量发展到了新的高度，守卫们完全无法与之抗衡。我们担心它会跑来塔伦米尔觅食，那样大家都没命了。$B$B约上几名冒险家，杀死这头野兽。它就在西边的原野处游荡。$B$B将它的角带回来给我，我就给你丰厚的报酬。
text.progress: Yetimus must die!
text.completion: So it's true, you did kill the beast! The people of Hillsbrad are indebted to you, $n. You have made the land safer for our citizens.$B$BTake whatever you may desire from our coffers.
text.completed: Return Yetimus' Twisted Horn to Deathguard Samsa at Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills.
text.giverWindow: 达隆山的天灾。

english.title: Yetimus the Yeti Lord
english.objectives: Take Yetimus' Twisted Horn.
english.description: For years the mountain yeti of this region have been allowed free reign. Our complacency in dealing with the yeti menace has resulted in an aberration! Yetimus, lord of all yetis, has grown to a size and strength that our guard simply cannot handle. We fear that should his appetite lead him near Tarren Mill he would devour us all.$B$BGather a party of suitable adventurers and dispatch the beast. He roams the countryside to the west.$B$BBring me one of his horns and I will reward you handsomely.
english.progress: Yetimus must die!
english.completion: So it's true, you did kill the beast! The people of Hillsbrad are indebted to you, $n. You have made the land safer for our citizens.$B$BTake whatever you may desire from our coffers.
english.completed: Return Yetimus' Twisted Horn to Deathguard Samsa at Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills.
english.giverWindow: The scourge of Darrow Hill.

text.title: 萨赫特的计谋
text.objectives: 护送拉穆卡恒游侠队长前往高地。
text.description: 尼斐塞特城防守太严密了。但是，它所毗邻的山峦却无人把守。$B$B我跟游侠队长谈过了，他愿意带一队人去占领山顶的战略地带。$B$B只有一个条件，$n。那就是你得跟他们一起当先头部队。$B$B人数不会很多，不然敌人很快就会注意到我们的，但相信我……拉穆卡恒的游侠非常厉害。有你在，我们一定可以成功。
text.progress: Hail, $n!
text.completion: You did it, $n!  Excellent!
text.completed: Return to Salhet at the Neferset City Outskirts in Uldum.

english.title: Salhet's Gambit
english.objectives: Escort the Ramkahen Ranger Captain to higher ground.
english.description: Neferset City is too well defended.  The mountain next to it, however, is not.$B$BI've spoken to the ranger captain and he's willing to take a handful of his men and secure the strategic mountaintop.$B$BThere is one catch, $n.  He agreed, but only if you would spearhead the attack with them.$B$BIt must be a small group, else we'll draw the enemy's attention too soon, but trust me... the rangers of Ramkahen are as tough as they come.  With you by their side we'll surely succeed.
english.progress: Hail, $n!
english.completion: You did it, $n!  Excellent!
english.completed: Return to Salhet at the Neferset City Outskirts in Uldum.

text.title: 亨伯特的私人问题
text.objectives: 取回亨伯特的长剑、亨伯特的头盔和亨伯特的长裤。
text.description: 真是难为情啊。我该从何说起呢？$B$B嗯，梅里萨拉派我来西边的洞穴调查雪人的情况。天色已晚，盔甲又很重。我就脱下装备，想四下逛逛。嗯，我去散了个步。回来的时候我才发现我的装备被偷了！是雪人干的。我敢肯定。它们偷走了我的裤子、佩剑和头盔，然后逃回了洞穴。取回我的装备，我会答谢你的。
text.progress: I'm practically naked here, $n. Help me out, eh?
text.completion: Thank you, $n! I promise you that this is the last time I take this gear off.
text.completed: Return to Deathguard Humbert at Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: Humbert's Personal Problems
english.objectives: Recover Humbert's Sword, Humbert's Helm, and Humbert's Pants.
english.description: So this is pretty embarrassing. Where to begin?$B$BWell, you see, Melisara sent me to investigate the yeti menace in the nearby caves, west of here. It was getting late and my armor was weighing heavily on me. I took my gear off and decided to take a stroll. Yes, I, erm, went for a walk. Anyway, when I returned I discovered that my gear had been stolen! It was the yetis. I'm sure of it. They took my pants, sword and helm and ran off into their cave. Get them back for me and I will reward you.
english.progress: I'm practically naked here, $n. Help me out, eh?
english.completion: Thank you, $n! I promise you that this is the last time I take this gear off.
english.completed: Return to Deathguard Humbert at Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 岩层之下
text.objectives: 采集巨大的红宝石晶簇。
text.description: 在我们无法触及的碎岩之渊深处，埋藏着许多珍贵的宝石，其中包括巨大的红宝石水晶簇。它们蕴藏着可怕的能量。$B$B要获得它们并不容易，因为有人重兵把守。但是你，你既坚强又勇敢。我想这件事你可以做到。$B$B在碎岩之渊之中，通向那里的通道都被石头堵上了。如果要找到水晶簇，那些通道是唯一的去处。如果你找到了一簇，就把它带来给我。
text.progress: These crystals are of great value, particularly to Gorsik. I shall have a heavy sway over him if I come into possession of one. I wish this to be so.
text.completion: This is exactly what I was seeking. Thank you, $r.
text.completed: Return to Felsen the Enduring at Therazane's Throne in Deepholm.

english.title: Beneath the Surface
english.objectives: Recover an Enormous Ruby Crystal Cluster.
english.description: Among the other precious gemstones hidden deep out of our reach in the Crumbling Depths, there are enormous ruby crystal clusters. They are infused with terrible energy.$B$BIt will not be easy to obtain such a thing, for they are well guarded. But you, you are stubborn and brave. I think this is something you can do.$B$BWithin the Crumbling Depths, look to where the tunnels end abruptly in stone. The clusters are found in those passages when they are to be found at all. Should you find one, return to me.
english.progress: These crystals are of great value, particularly to Gorsik. I shall have a heavy sway over him if I come into possession of one. I wish this to be so.
english.completion: This is exactly what I was seeking. Thank you, $r.
english.completed: Return to Felsen the Enduring at Therazane's Throne in Deepholm.

text.title: 鹿肉三明治
text.objectives: 取回8片鹿肉。
text.description: 你吃过鹿肉三明治吗？我也没有。想必非常美味。我可不是什么美食家，我是商人。如果顾客点名要鹿肉三明治，我就得拿出货来。$B$B你或许在想，“这跟我有什么关系？”听说我，$c，我需要鹿肉！你能拿来，我就付钱！这笔交易很不错吧？$B$B快去！西边的原野上就有很多丛林鹿。
text.progress: I need stag meat!
text.completion: That's a hefty load you're carrying. It should keep my customers satisfied for the time being.$B$BHere is your pay, as promised.
text.completed: Return to Derak Nightfall at Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: Stagwiches
english.objectives: Retrieve 8 slabs of Stag Meat.
english.description: Ever had a stagwich? Me neither. Apparently they're delicious. Now I'm not one for eating, but I am a businessman. If my customers want stagwiches, who am I to argue?$B$BYou're probably asking yourself, "What does this have to do with me?" I'll tell you what, $c, I need stag meat! You get me stag meat from the hill stags of Hillsbrad and I will pay you. Sounds like a pretty good deal, doesn't it?$B$BGet going! Stags are most plentiful to the west.
english.progress: I need stag meat!
english.completion: That's a hefty load you're carrying. It should keep my customers satisfied for the time being.$B$BHere is your pay, as promised.
english.completed: Return to Derak Nightfall at Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：黑海岸！
text.objectives: 去找黑海岸洛达内尔的女祭司德塔莉亚。
text.description: 奉安度因·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，联盟所有身强力壮的公民都要向黑海岸洛达内尔的女祭司德塔莉亚报到。$B$B洛达内尔的人民需要你们的帮助，照顾奥伯丁毁灭后的幸存者，保护他们的城镇不受暮光之锤的威胁。前往达纳苏斯外的鲁瑟兰村，与角鹰兽管理员维斯派塔斯交谈，他会安排你飞往黑海岸。$B$B为了联盟的荣耀与骄傲！
text.completion: So, the king has heard our plea? Thank Elune! We can use all the help we can get.

english.title: Hero's Call: Darkshore!
english.objectives: Report to Priestess Dentaria at Lor'danel in Darkshore.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Priestess Dentaria at Lor'danel in Darkshore.$B$BThe people of Lor'danel need your aid in caring for the survivors of Auberdine's destruction and securing their town against Twilight's Hammer. Speak to Vesprystus, the hippograph master at Rut'theran Village outside of Darnassus and he'll arrange a flight to Darkshore.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!
english.completion: So, the king has heard our plea? Thank Elune! We can use all the help we can get.

text.title: 不是萤火虫，是火焰蜂
text.objectives: 收集7只火焰蜂。
text.description: 烈焰峰这里的居民似乎总是会选择离开。我猜是因为燃烧平原对他们来说还不够有趣。$b$b不过我可不算在内。我总是能找到不离开的新理由，最近的理由就是前不久刚刚出现的火焰蜂。$b$b它们在白天的时候会绕着岩浆地带飞。到了晚上，几乎就满地都是了。$b$b如果你能帮我收集一些的话，我也许会付你一些报酬。
text.progress: Well?
text.completion: Nice work!  More pets for Kibler!
text.completed: Return to Kibler at Flame Crest in Burning Steppes.

english.title: Not Fireflies, Flameflies
english.objectives: Gather 7 Flameflies.
english.description: Most of my fellow residents here at Flame Crest seem to have left at some point.  I guess the Burning Steppes weren't INTERESTING enough for them.$b$bNot me, though.  I'm always finding new reasons to not leave, and the latest happens to be the flameflies that have been appearing lately.$b$bThey appear near lava during the day.  By night, you'll find them almost anywhere.$b$bIf you wouldn't mind collecting some, I might be able to make it worth your while.
english.progress: Well?
english.completion: Nice work!  More pets for Kibler!
english.completed: Return to Kibler at Flame Crest in Burning Steppes.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：灰谷！
text.objectives: 去找灰谷西北部奥雷迪尔的居所中的哨兵塞雅拉。
text.description: 奉安度因·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，联盟所有身强力壮的公民都要向灰谷西北部奥雷迪尔的居所中的哨兵塞雅拉报到。$B$B部落在灰谷的攻势必须得到遏制！要击退入侵者并光复神圣的森林，你们的帮助是不可或缺的。从黑海岸的暮光谷向南进发，前往灰谷森林。$B$B为了联盟的荣耀与骄傲！
text.completion: Have you come to help us fight back against the forces of the Horde? Every blade and spell will be needed!

english.title: Hero's Call: Ashenvale!
english.objectives: Report to Sentinel Shyela at Ordanil's Retreat in northwestern Ashenvale.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Sentinel Shyela at Orendil's Retreat in northwestern Ashenvale.$B$BThe Horde's aggression in Ashenvale cannot be allowed to stand! Your help is needed to repel the invaders and restore the sacred forest. Head south through the Twilight Vale in Darkshore to reach the forest of Ashenvale.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!
english.completion: Have you come to help us fight back against the forces of the Horde? Every blade and spell will be needed!

text.title: 大酋长的命令：灰谷！
text.objectives: 去找北贫瘠之地和灰谷交界处的莫尔杉壁垒的卡德拉克。
text.description: 所有身强力壮的部落成员，从此刻起都要向北贫瘠之地和灰谷交界处的莫尔杉壁垒的卡德拉克报到。帮助我们驱逐森林中的暗夜精灵，这样我们就可以为自己的人民夺取丰富的资源！$B$B要抵达莫尔杉壁垒，就必须沿着北贫瘠之地十字路口北面的黄金之路前进。$B$B命运在召唤！
text.completion: So you're the reinforcements? I suppose you'll do fine as long you can kill night elves.

english.title: Warchief's Command: Ashenvale!
english.objectives: Report to Kadrak at the Mor'shan Rampart on the border between the Northern Barrens and Ashenvale.
english.description: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Kadrak at the Mor'shan Rampart on the border between the Northern Barrens and Ashenvale. Aid in driving the night elves from the forest, so that we may claim its resources for our people!$B$BTo reach the Mor'shan Rampart, you must take the Gold Road north from Crossroads in the Northern Barrens.$B$BDestiny calls!
english.completion: So you're the reinforcements? I suppose you'll do fine as long you can kill night elves.

text.title: 大酋长的命令：北贫瘠之地！
text.objectives: 去找北贫瘠之地前沿哨所的卡加尔·战痕。
text.description: 所有身强力壮的部落成员，从此刻起都要向北贫瘠之地前沿哨所的卡加尔·战痕报到。$B$B为了击退步步紧逼的野猪人和半人马，保卫北贫瘠之地，你们的帮助不可或缺。$B$B要抵达前沿哨所，就向西方进发，跨过杜隆塔尔的怒水河流域盆地，过桥之后就是北贫瘠之地了。$B$B使命在召唤你们！
text.completion: You look competent with a weapon or a spellbook. We could use your help in driving back the quillboars in these parts.

english.title: Warchief's Command: Northern Barrens!
english.objectives: Report to Kargal Battlescar at Far Watch Post in the Northern Barrens.
english.description: All able-bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Kargal Battlescar at Far Watch Post in the Northern Barrens.$B$BYour help is needed to secure the Northern Barrens against the encroaching quilboars and centaurs.$B$BTo reach Far Watch Post, travel west across Durotar's Southfury Watershed and cross the bridge into the Northern Barrens.$B$BDestiny calls!
english.completion: You look competent with a weapon or a spellbook. We could use your help in driving back the quillboars in these parts.

text.title: 生存的机会
text.objectives: 拯救10只丘陵小鹿。
text.description: 圣光保佑！我需要帮助！$B$B在前往希尔斯布莱德的路上，我发现了好几群可爱的小鹿。就在我抚摸其中一只时，突然窜出一头饥饿的山地豹，迅速叼走了它。我逃回塔伦米尔，发誓要帮助丘陵小鹿摆脱被捕食的困境。我苦思冥想，终于想到了一个法子！$B$B带上这根魔杖进入西边的原野，用它强化小鹿。如此一来，它们就能保护自己了！
text.completion: WHAT!? No, don't tell me that, $n! It can't be true! My... I... I would never...$B$BI won't give up, $c. Just you wait and see. I will save those fawns!
text.completed: Return to Advisor Duskingdawn at Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: A Fighting Chance
english.objectives: Save 10 Hill Fawns.
english.description: Blessed be the Light! I need your help!$B$BOn my way into Hillsbrad I noticed several families of adorable little deer. As I went out to pet one of the little fawns a ravenous mountain cat leapt out and killed it. I fled to Tarren Mill and swore to solve the plight of the hill fawn. Now, after many days of tinkering, I have created the hill fawn's salvation!$B$BTake my wand into the fields to the west and use it to empower the wee hill fawns. Once empowered they will be able to fend for themselves!
english.completion: WHAT!? No, don't tell me that, $n! It can't be true! My... I... I would never...$B$BI won't give up, $c. Just you wait and see. I will save those fawns!
english.completed: Return to Advisor Duskingdawn at Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 大酋长的命令：艾萨拉！
text.objectives: 去找艾萨拉的奥格瑞玛后门的劳工队长格拉比特。
text.description: 所有身强力壮的部落成员，从此刻起都要向艾萨拉的奥格瑞玛后门的阿格图·血拳报到。$B$B为了部落的荣耀，帮助他们击退入侵的联盟部队，占领艾萨拉！$B$B从奥格瑞玛北门离开，即可到达位于艾萨拉的奥格瑞玛后门。$B$B命运在召唤你们！
text.completion: We could sure use some help out here.

english.title: Warchief's Command: Azshara!
english.objectives: Report to Labor Captain Grabbit at the Orgrimmar Rear Gate in Azshara.
english.description: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Ag'tor Bloodfist at the Orgrimmar Rear Gate in Azshara.$B$BAid in driving back the encroaching Alliance forces and assist in securing Aszhara for the glory of the Horde!$B$BDepart Orgrimmar through its northern gate to reach the Orgrimmar Rear Gate in Azshara.$B$BDestiny calls!
english.completion: We could sure use some help out here.

text.title: 天降弹雨
text.objectives: 使用被征用的火炮杀死100个司克诺兹步兵。
text.description: 苏拉赫没有开玩笑。那座山丘上站满了士兵！$b$b跳上来，帮我标示敌方目标。$b$b要保证命中率，$n！我们一定要想办法过去。
text.completion: Good work, $n. Now let's see if we can make our way up there before they're able to recover.
text.completed: Speak to Harrison Jones in Pilgrim's Precipice.

english.title: Fire From the Sky
english.objectives: Kill 100 Schnottz Troopers while mounted on the Confiscated Artillery.
english.description: Sullah wasn't kidding. That hill is crawling with troopers!$b$bJump on and paint our targets for me.$b$bMake every shot count, $n! We need to be able to get up there.
english.completion: Good work, $n. Now let's see if we can make our way up there before they're able to recover.
english.completed: Speak to Harrison Jones in Pilgrim's Precipice.

text.title: 纳奥姆的秘密
text.objectives: 获得8块阿图希特的记录碎片。
text.description: 关于纳奥姆流传着一个古老的故事。据说一个名叫阿图希特的强大先知通过这座神殿，用太阳的力量把财宝保护起来，免遭敌人的侵犯。$B$B很多人认为这个故事只是一个传说，但那种力量……显然将会对我们十分有用。$B$B邪恶的尼斐塞特人洗劫了阿图希特陵墓。他们把神器抢夺一空，将记载着他回忆的石板砸得粉碎。$B$B到东边的先贤陵墓去，把你所发现的碎片都找来。
text.progress: Did you find them, $n?  Were they salvageable?
text.completion: Excellent.  Let's see if we can find anything of importance.
text.completed: Return to Salhet at Nahom in Uldum.

english.title: The Secret of Nahom
english.objectives: Obtain 8 Atulhet's Record Fragments.
english.description: There is an old story about Nahom.  It speaks of how a powerful prophet named Atulhet held off troves of enemies by channeling the power of the sun through this very temple.$B$BMost believe the tale to be just a legend, but that power... would certainly be useful to us now.$B$BThe vile Neferset have ransacked Atulhet's tomb.  They've taken any artifacts of power and shattered the tablets that encode his memories.$B$BGo to the Tombs of the Precursors to the east and retrieve any fragments that you find.
english.progress: Did you find them, $n?  Were they salvageable?
english.completion: Excellent.  Let's see if we can find anything of importance.
english.completed: Return to Salhet at Nahom in Uldum.

text.title: 惩处入侵者
text.objectives: 杀死先贤陵墓里的任意10名尼斐塞特入侵者。
text.description: 我们乃是纳奥姆的牧师，先贤陵墓的守护者。$B$B自从尼斐塞特人投向了他们的新主子后，他们就变成了彻头彻尾的异端。$B$B他们洗劫了我们祖先的神圣陵墓，寻找强大的神器，摧毁了价值连城的圣物。$B$B到东边的陵墓去，惩罚那些入侵的盗墓贼，在尼斐塞特人进攻纳奥姆之前阻止他们同自己人会合。
text.completion: Perhaps you are as powerful as I've heard afterall. You have our gratitude.
text.completed: Return to Sun Prophet Tumet at Nahom in Uldum.

english.title: Punish the Trespassers
english.objectives: Slay any 10 Neferset intruders at the Tombs of the Precursors.
english.description: We, priests of Nahom, are guardians of the Tombs of the Precursors.$B$BEver since the Neferset turned to their new masters, they've turned to great heresies.$B$BThey rob the sacred tombs of our forefathers, seeking powerful artifacts and destroying invaluable relics in the process.$B$BGo to the tombs, east of here and punish the tomb-robbers for their transgressions, lest they join their brethren when the Neferset attack on Nahom begins.
english.completion: Perhaps you are as powerful as I've heard afterall. You have our gratitude.
english.completed: Return to Sun Prophet Tumet at Nahom in Uldum.

text.title: 柯塞特密码石板
text.objectives: 获得柯塞特密码石板。
text.description: <萨赫特和周围的牧师对石板颇是研究了一阵。>$B$B就在这里，$n。阿图希特在他的神殿里造了一件强大的武器，获得它的唯一办法就是输入正确的密码。$B$B据说它就藏在柯塞特小径。我们只希望尼斐塞特的劫掠者还没有找到它。那里正是劫掠领主哈瓦特的地盘，而他又是他们中最残忍的一个。$B$B尽管没有支援，但这是我们保卫纳奥姆的唯一希望。
text.progress: Did you retrieve the codex, $n?
text.completion: It is true then?  It does exist!
text.completed: Return to Salhet at Nahom in Uldum.

english.title: The Cypher of Keset
english.objectives: Obtain the Cypher of Keset.
english.description: <Salhet spends some time going over the tablets with the priests around him.>$B$BIt's all right here, $n.  Atulhet built a potent weapon into this temple and the only way to access it is with the correct cypher.$B$BIt is reportedly hidden in the Keset Pass.  We must hope the Neferset looters haven't gotten to it yet.  That's where Raider Lord Havat is operating and he's the most ruthless of the lot.$B$BBut without reinforcements, this might be our only hope for defending Nahom.
english.progress: Did you retrieve the codex, $n?
english.completion: It is true then?  It does exist!
english.completed: Return to Salhet at Nahom in Uldum.

text.title: 纳奥姆保卫战
text.objectives: 在一名拉穆卡恒中士谈一谈，赢得纳奥姆保卫战。
text.description: 敌人来了……数量还不少。$B$B我们没有进一步的支援。但愿我们能阻止尼斐塞特人的前进。$B$B如果纳奥姆失陷了，拉穆卡恒就会是下一个。$B$B准备好之后，就出去和我的一名中士谈谈。我会尽一切所能帮你指挥我们手头的兵力的。
text.completion: We did it, $n!  We held Nahom.
text.completed: 去找奥丹姆纳奥姆的萨赫特。

english.title: The Defense of Nahom
english.objectives: Speak to a Ramkahen Sergeant and succeed in the Defense of Nahom.
english.description: The enemy is coming... and in great numbers.$B$BWe will get no further reinforcements.  Let us hope we can stop the Neferset advance.$B$BIf Nahom falls, Ramkahen will follow.$B$BGo outside and speak to one of my sergeants when you're ready.  I will help you command the forces we have to the best of my ability.
english.completion: We did it, $n!  We held Nahom.
english.completed: Return to Salhet at Nahom in Uldum.

text.title: 强盗头子
text.objectives: 击败督军埃赫森。
text.description: 根据我们的法律，发动这些进攻的人必将遭到惩处。$B$B强盗团伙的头目是一个叫做督军埃赫森的人。$B$B你可以在沙漠的西端找到他。让他的罪行得到应有的惩罚。
text.completion: I thank you, $n.  These savages must be punished for what they've done here.
text.completed: Return to Sun Priest Asaris at the Seal of the Sun King in Uldum.
text.giverWindow: 让他受到应得的裁决。

english.title: The Bandit Warlord
english.objectives: Slay Warlord Ihsenn.
english.description: Our law demands that those behind this attack face proper retribution.$B$BThe band of bandits' ringleader is a man known as Warlord Ihsenn.$B$BYou will find him in the far west of the desert.  Make sure his transgressions do not go unpunished.
english.completion: I thank you, $n.  These savages must be punished for what they've done here.
english.completed: Return to Sun Priest Asaris at the Seal of the Sun King in Uldum.
english.giverWindow: Give him the justice he rightfully deserves.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：千针石林！
text.objectives: 去找菲拉斯与千针石林边境处的新萨兰纳尔的凯雷希亚·猎月。
text.description: 奉安度因·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，联盟所有身强力壮的公民都要向菲拉斯与千针石林边境处的新萨兰纳尔的凯雷希亚·猎月报到。$B$B哨兵部队需要你们的帮助，以击退控制该地区的恐怖图腾掠夺者。要抵达新萨兰纳尔，只需前往菲拉斯东部与千针石林接壤的地方即可。$B$B为了联盟的荣耀与骄傲！
text.completion: You've arrived just in time, $c. We need your help to hold off the Grimtotem.

english.title: Hero's Call: Thousand Needles!
english.objectives: Report to Caryssia Moonhunter at New Thalanaar on the border between Feralas and Thousand Needles.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Caryssia Moonhunter at New Thalanaar at the border between Feralas and Thousand Needles.$B$BThe sentinels need your help to turn back the marauding Grimtotem raiders who dominate the area. To reach New Thalaanar, travel to eastern Feralas, near the border with Thousand Needles.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!
english.completion: You've arrived just in time, $c. We need your help to hold off the Grimtotem.

text.title: 大酋长的命令：千针石林！
text.objectives: 前往尘泥沼泽南部的泥链镇，向奈瑟报告。你也可以让奥格瑞玛的多拉斯送你过去。
text.description: 所有身强力壮的部落成员，从此刻起都要向泥链镇的奈瑟报到。加入部落的军队，与控制该地区的叛变氏族恐怖图腾作战。$B$B奈瑟将会为你们提供开往前线的运输工具。她在尘泥沼泽南部泥链镇的旅店中一边大吃大喝，一边等着你们。$B$B命运在召唤！
text.completion: The Horde forces in Thousand Needles desperately need your help.

english.title: Warchief's Command: Thousand Needles!
english.objectives: Report to Nyse at Mudsprocket in southern Dustwallow Marsh.
english.description: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Nyse at Mudsprocket. Join the Horde forces fighting against the renegade Grimtotems who dominate the area.$B$BNyse will provide you with transportation to the front lines. She will be waiting for you at Mudsprocket's inn, tucked away in southern Dustwallow Marsh.$B$BDestiny calls!
english.completion: The Horde forces in Thousand Needles desperately need your help.

text.title: 安多哈尔战争
text.objectives: 跟戈斯鲁姆交谈，飞往西瘟疫之地的安多哈尔。然后去找安多哈尔的萨萨里安。
text.description: 我刚收到消息，$g小子:姑娘;。听上去不大妙。$b$b安多哈尔城正处于被遗忘者、联盟，还有天灾军团的三方混战之中。乌瑞恩国王孤注一掷，派了一名死亡骑士为他带兵冲锋陷阵，但我敢肯定他肯定不介意多些帮忙的人手。$b$b我不愿意放你走，但他们指名要你，$n。$b$b跟外面的戈斯鲁姆谈谈。他会把你送上前往安多哈尔的头班狮鹫。
text.completion: It's about time you arrived, $c.
text.completed: 去西瘟疫之地，找安多哈尔的萨萨里安。

english.title: The Battle for Andorhal
english.objectives: Speak with Guthrum Thunderfist to fly to Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.  Then report to Thassarian within Andorhal.
english.description: I just got word, $g lad: lass;.  It doesn't sound good.$b$bThe city of Andorhal is in the middle of a three-way war between the Forsaken, the Alliance, and the Scourge.  King Wrynn has rolled the dice and sent a death knight to lead the charge for his cause, but I'm sure he can use all the help he can get.$b$bI hate to see you go, but they've asked for you by name, $n.  Speak with Guthrum Thunderfist outside.  He'll put you on the first gryphon out to Andorhal.
english.completion: It's about time you arrived, $c.
english.completed: Report to Thassarian within Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

starters.name: 狮鹫管理员塔隆艾克斯

text.title: 雷矛行军
text.objectives: 观察雷矛行军。
text.description: 这些作战计划非常有趣，$n。在过去的一个多月里，雷矛矮人不断地将他们的军队从奥特兰克山谷转移到希尔斯布莱德丘陵的“四指峰”。他们悄悄地搭建起了军营，我军对此却浑然不觉。要不是我们截获这些计划，恐怕他们一周内就会发起攻击，将我们杀得片甲不留。$B$B但是现在，我们还是有机会扭转战局的。$B$B首先，我们必须……
text.completion: The time to act is now. The Stormpike must be crushed!
text.completed: 去找希尔斯布莱德塔伦米尔的高阶督军克鲁姆什。

english.title: March of the Stormpike
english.objectives: See the March of the Stormpike.
english.description: These plans you recovered weave an interesting tale, $n. The Stormpike have been moving their armies from Alterac Valley into the "four fingers" of Hillsbrad for over a month. Somehow they have managed to secretly get their installations set up without our forces knowing. Had we not received these plans they would have marched on us in a week's time, annihilating everything in their path.$B$BWith these plans, though, we can turn the tables.$B$BThis is what we must do...
english.completion: The time to act is now. The Stormpike must be crushed!
english.end: See the March of the Stormpike.
english.completed: Speak to High Warlord Cromush at Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：塔纳利斯！
text.objectives: 去找塔纳利斯加基森的凯尔希·钢烁。
text.description: 奉安度因·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，联盟所有身强力壮的公民都要向加基森的凯尔希·钢烁报到。$B$B联盟需要你们的帮助，以赢得当地财阀的让步，并获得该地区的珍贵资源。从千针石林的闪光深渊向南进发，即可抵达加基森。$B$B为了联盟的荣耀与骄傲！
text.completion: We have to persuade the goblins of Gadgetzan to side with us, $c.

english.title: Hero's Call: Tanaris!
english.objectives: Report to Kelsey Steelspark at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Kelsey Steelspark in Gadgetzan.$B$BThe Alliance needs your help to win concessions from the local baron and access to the area's priceless resources. You can reach Gadgetzan by traveling south from the Shimmering Deep in Thousand Needles.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!
english.completion: We have to persuade the goblins of Gadgetzan to side with us, $c.

text.title: 安多哈尔战争
text.objectives: 跟凯伦·库恩交谈，飞往西瘟疫之地的安多哈尔。然后去找安多哈尔的库尔迪拉·织亡者。
text.description: 我刚收到一封奇怪的信函。非常奇怪……$b$b安多哈尔城正处于被遗忘者、联盟，还有天灾军团的三方混战之中。听上去希尔瓦娜斯行动了，让事情更有意思的是，她派了死亡骑士库尔迪拉·织亡者来全权负责。$b$b他们指名要你去，$n。跟蝙蝠管理员凯伦·库恩谈谈。他会把你送上前往安多哈尔的头班蝙蝠。
text.completion: It's about time you arrived, $c.
text.completed: 去找西瘟疫之地安多哈尔的库尔迪拉·织亡者。

english.title: The Battle for Andorhal
english.objectives: Speak with Kellen Kuhn to fly to Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.  Then report to Koltira Deathweaver within Andorhal.
english.description: I just received the most curious missive.  Curious indeed...$b$bThe city of Andorhal is in the middle of a three-way war between the Forsaken, the Alliance, and the Scourge.  It sounds like Sylvanas has made her move, and to make matters interesting, she's put Koltira Deathweaver, the death knight, in command.$b$bThey've asked for you by name, $n.  Speak with Kellen Kuhn, the bat handler.  He'll put you on the first bat out to Andorhal.
english.completion: It's about time you arrived, $c.
english.completed: Report to Koltira Deathweaver within Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 大酋长的命令：塔纳利斯！
text.objectives: 前往塔纳利斯的加基森，向梅格斯·碎纸机报到。你也可以让奥格瑞玛的多拉斯送你过去。
text.description: 所有身强力壮的部落成员，从此刻起都要向加基森的梅格斯·碎纸机报到。帮助部落和锈水财阀，抢在联盟之前在塔纳利斯壮大势力！$B$B从千针石林东南部的菲兹尔和普兹克的赛艇平台一直向南进发就可以抵达加基森。你也可以从奥格瑞玛的多拉斯那里飞过去。$B$B命运在召唤！
text.completion: I could use your help, $c. That blasted gnome is trying to persuade the Steemwheedle Cartel to favor her side!

english.title: Warchief's Command: Tanaris!
english.objectives: Report to Megs Dreadshredder at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.
english.description: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Megs Dreadshredder in Gadgetzan. Help the Horde and the Bilgewater Cartel establish a presence in Tanaris before the Alliance does!$B$BYou can reach Gadgetzan in Tanaris by traveling south to the shore from Fizzle and Pozzik's Speedbarge in southeastern Thousand Needles.$B$BDestiny calls!
english.completion: I could use your help, $c. That blasted gnome is trying to persuade the Steemwheedle Cartel to favor her side!

text.title: 大酋长的命令：菲拉斯！
text.objectives: 去找菲拉斯阿塔亚营地的克努·符文图腾。
text.description: 所有身强力壮的部落成员，从此刻起都要向菲拉斯阿塔亚营地的克努·符文图腾报到。帮助部落抵抗联盟和恐怖图腾，占领那片茂密的森林。$B$B从凄凉之地南面进入菲拉斯，即可抵达阿塔亚营地。$B$B命运在召唤！
text.completion: There is much wrong in Feralas. I am glad to have your help.

english.title: Warchief's Command: Feralas!
english.objectives: Report to Konu Runetotem at Camp Ataya in Feralas.
english.description: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Konu Runetotem at Camp Ataya in Feralas. Help the Horde secure the great forest against the Alliance and the Grimtotems.$B$BYou can reach Camp Ataya by traveling south from Desolace and into Feralas.$B$BDestiny calls!
english.completion: There is much wrong in Feralas. I am glad to have your help.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：菲拉斯！
text.objectives: 去找菲拉斯梦游者栖地的特拉隆·风程。
text.description: 奉安度因·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，联盟所有身强力壮的公民都要向菲拉斯的梦游者栖地的特拉隆·风程报到。$B$B联盟需要你们的帮助，以战胜我们的敌人——部落和恐怖图腾。从凄凉之地南部可以进入菲拉斯，抵达梦游者栖地。$B$B为了联盟的荣耀与骄傲！
text.completion: Elune has favored us with your arrival, $c. There is much to do.

english.title: Hero's Call: Feralas!
english.objectives: Report to Telaron Windflight at Dreamer's Rest in Feralas.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Telaron Windflight at Dreamer's Rest in Feralas.$B$BThe Alliance needs your help to overcome our enemies, the Horde and the Grimtotems. You can reach Dreamer's Rest by traveling south from Desolace into Feralas.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!
english.completion: Elune has favored us with your arrival, $c. There is much to do.

text.title: 帮助瑟银兄弟会
text.objectives: 跟灼热峡谷瑟银前哨的杰克·岩腿谈一谈。
text.description: 黑铁矮人或许诡计多端、爱生是非……但他们不全都是敌人。我跟瑟银兄弟会的矮人谈过几次，没人比他们更加乐于助人了。$b$b不久前，我的一个老相识杰克·岩腿来到镇子里，问我是不是能跟他一起参加远征什么的。听起来挺重要。$b$b我有点忙，不过也许你不介意替我去？朝西走，沿着路前往灼热峡谷。从荒芜之地离开不远就能找到他。
text.completion: Well whadda we have here?  You here to help?

english.title: To the Aid of the Thorium Brotherhood
english.objectives: Speak with Jack Rockleg at Thorium Advance in Searing Gorge.
english.description: Dark Iron dwarves may be scheming and mischievous... but they're not all enemies.  I've spoken several times with the dwarves of the Thorium Brotherhood, and they've never been anything but helpful.$b$bAn acquaintance of mine, Jack Rockleg, came to town not long ago, asking if I could join him on an expedition of some sort.  It sounded important.$b$bI'm a little busy, but maybe you wouldn't mind going?  Just travel west, on the road to Searing Gorge.  You'll see him soon after leaving the Badlands.
english.completion: Well whadda we have here?  You here to help?

text.title: 上层精灵的荣耀
text.objectives: 杀死8名痛苦的上层精灵或是受难的上层精灵。
text.description: 一万年前……$B$B上层精灵曾居住在这里，繁衍生息。我们是暗夜精灵中地位较高的族群。我们享受着魔法和财富带来的便捷，也渐渐陷入了放纵、欢愉以及……贪婪的生活。$B$B徘徊此地的灵魂心中满是悔恨。痛苦将他们禁锢在这里。如果你想要了解更多关于凯斯利尔和辛玛洛的故事，就去解除他们的痛苦吧。
text.completion: The Crystal of Zin-Malor was stolen from a far-off temple without remorse. Its ability to control the arcane was too tempting, and when it was toyed with, its shattering cursed us all. Kel'theril suffered until the Sundering destroyed it for good.$B$BThe curse of Zin-Malor binds all who seek its power here. I was the first to fall to its temptation. Thousands of years later, our long lost descendants would be next...
text.completed: Return to the Kaldorei Spirit at Lake Kel'theril in Winterspring.

english.title: Pride of the Highborne
english.objectives: Slay 8 Anguished or Suffering Highborne.
english.description: Ten thousand years ago...$B$BThe Highborne lived here in prosperity. We considered ourselves above the common ranks of the other night elves. With our every need met by magic and wealth, we led lives of indulgence and amusement. And greed...$B$BThe spirits you see here are overwhelmed with remorse and regret. Their anguish chains them here. If you wish to learn more of Kel'theril and Zin'malor, free them from their agony.
english.completion: The Crystal of Zin-Malor was stolen from a far-off temple without remorse. Its ability to control the arcane was too tempting, and when it was toyed with, its shattering cursed us all. Kel'theril suffered until the Sundering destroyed it for good.$B$BThe curse of Zin-Malor binds all who seek its power here. I was the first to fall to its temptation. Thousands of years later, our long lost descendants would be next...
english.completed: Return to the Kaldorei Spirit at Lake Kel'theril in Winterspring.

text.title: 莫顿·焰星
text.objectives: 去找燃烧平原焰星哨站的莫顿·焰星。
text.description: 这几天我好不容易有空离开灼热峡谷。过去几个月我一直打算去拜访一位住在燃烧平原的朋友，但总是没有机会。$b$b他的名字叫做莫顿·焰星。尽管他不是兄弟会的一员，但他依然是一名绝对值得信任的朋友。$b$b你能不能代我问候问候他？你要往南穿过黑石山脚。一直往南……就能找到他。$b$b谢谢你。
text.completion: Oh, Oilfist sent you?  Hah! Did he ever tell you how he got the name Oilfist?  You'll have to ask him about that one sometime.

english.title: Mouton Flamestar
english.objectives: Report to Mouton Flamestar at Flamestar Post in Burning Steppes.
english.description: I get precious little time away from Searing Gorge these days.  I've been meaning to visit a friend in Burning Steppes for the last several months, but haven't had the chance.$b$bHis name is Mouton Flamestar.  While he's not a member of the Brotherhood, he's a trusted friend, and definitely trustworthy.$b$bWill you send him my regards?  You'll have to travel south, through the base of Blackrock Mountain.  Just keep heading south... you'll find him.$b$bThank you.
english.completion: Oh, Oilfist sent you?  Hah! Did he ever tell you how he got the name Oilfist?  You'll have to ask him about that one sometime.

text.title: 莫顿·焰星
text.objectives: 去找燃烧平原焰星哨站的莫顿·焰星。
text.description: 这几天我好不容易有空离开灼热峡谷。过去几个月我一直打算去拜访一位住在燃烧平原的朋友，但总是没有机会。$b$b他的名字叫做莫顿·焰星。尽管他不是兄弟会的一员，但他依然是一名绝对值得信任的朋友。$b$b你能不能代我问候问候他？你要往南穿过黑石山脚。一直往南……就能找到他。$b$b谢谢你。
text.completion: Oh, Oilfist sent you?  Hah! Did he ever tell you how he got the name Oilfist?  You'll have to ask him about that one sometime.

english.title: Mouton Flamestar
english.objectives: Report to Mouton Flamestar at Flamestar Post in Burning Steppes.
english.description: I get precious little time away from Searing Gorge these days.  I've been meaning to visit a friend in Burning Steppes for the last several months, but haven't had the chance.$b$bHis name is Mouton Flamestar.  While he's not a member of the Brotherhood, he's a trusted friend, and definitely trustworthy.$b$bWill you send him my regards?  You'll have to travel south, through the base of Blackrock Mountain.  Just keep heading south... you'll find him.$b$bThank you.
english.completion: Oh, Oilfist sent you?  Hah! Did he ever tell you how he got the name Oilfist?  You'll have to ask him about that one sometime.

text.title: 数世纪的苦难
text.objectives: 跟凯斯利尔湖中心的卡多雷之魂谈一谈。
text.description: 谣传辛玛洛水晶是在这里被发现的，因此我勉强答应了与暗夜精灵以及联盟合作。$B$B这颗水晶是一件古老而强大的生物，它的毁灭诅咒了这片大地，它的重生却并未带来多大的慰藉。$B$B我已无法面对徘徊在此地的灵魂。尽情地嘲笑我吧，如果你真的这么想，不妨亲自试试。或许湖中央温和的灵魂会开口跟你谈谈……

english.title: Centuries of Suffering
english.objectives: Speak with the Kaldorei Spirit at the center of Lake Kel'theril.
english.description: I only agreed to even consider cooperating with night elves and the alliance on rumors that the Crystal of Zin-Malor was found here.$B$BThe crystal is a powerful and ancient artifact, whose destruction cursed this land, and whose reassembly has caused little relief.$B$BBut I cannot face the hauntings that dwell here. Mock me if you must, but if you do, try your own hand. Perhaps the placid spirits that sit at the center of the lake will speak with you...

text.title: 风嚎橡树
text.objectives: 跟达纳苏斯中风嚎橡树的吉恩·格雷迈恩谈一谈。
text.description: 这里就是……我们的新家。我不能肯定我会不会真正有家的感觉。$B$B但是对于暗夜精灵的慷慨，我们也不能知恩不谢。他们可不是那种轻易就会接纳别人的种族。我们能得到他们的欢迎，这说明了真正的信任与宽容。$B$B格温和格雷迈恩就在市区的风嚎橡树那里。你应该去拜访一下。穿过北边大树下的传送门，然后到城市北部的风嚎橡树去。
text.completion: This oak was grown through the aid of the druids from a seed taken back on Gilneas. It stands for all that we've endured, and all that we've accomplished. May it serve to remind us that our curse is also our blessing.

english.title: The Howling Oak
english.objectives: Speak to Genn Greymane at the Howling Oak in Darnassus.
english.description: So this is it... our new home. I'm not sure if I'll ever feel like I truly have a home again.$B$BWe mustn't be unappreciative of what the night elves have offered us though. Their race is not one to throw out idle welcomes to just anyone. It is a true testament to faith and generosity that they've taken us in.$B$BGwen and Greymane are in the city proper, at the Howling Oak. You should stop by. Take the portal beneath the tree north of us, then seek out the Howling Oak in the northern portion of the city.
english.completion: This oak was grown through the aid of the druids from a seed taken back on Gilneas. It stands for all that we've endured, and all that we've accomplished. May it serve to remind us that our curse is also our blessing.

text.title: 高等精灵的遗赠
text.objectives: 从大法师玛伊留斯的灵魂那里获取辛玛洛的记忆。
text.description: 一百年前……$B$B我和一小队高等精灵从我们的故乡奎尔萨拉斯来到这里。我们想要探寻凯斯利尔的古老传说……希望了解那颗水晶是如何被摧毁的。$B$B我们在雪地里发现了水晶的碎片。随行的大法师很快就发现了它们蕴含的力量。等我们意识到问题的严重性时，已经太晚了。$B$B他的灵魂至今仍在东南方游荡，残留着对那些珍贵碎片的记忆……
text.progress: Maenius was a powerful mage and an honorable elf.  His spirit did not deserve such an ignoble fate.
text.completion: We were shocked before we died. Shocked that one among our noble and austere kind could descend into vicious obsession so quickly. We died as naive fools, the victims of our own blithe assumptions.$B$BThe living would know that these events would play out yet again... both here, and among the entire elven race with the fall of Quel'thalas.
text.completed: Return to the Quel'dorei Spirit at the center of Lake Kel'theril in Winterspring.
text.giverWindow: 我们中某个人的痴迷招致了辛玛洛的诅咒。

english.title: Legacy of the High Elves
english.objectives: Obtain the Memory of Zin-Malor from the spirit of Archmage Maenius.
english.description: One hundred years ago...$B$BI and a small group of other High Elves traveled here from our homeland, Quel'thalas. We sought the ancient mysteries of Kel'thoril... to find why it was destroyed.$B$BWe found fragments in the ice, shards of the crystal. The Archmage we accompanied did not take long to fall under their sway. In our foolishness, we noticed too late.$B$BHis spirit wanders in the southeast, among those he drove to madness, still clutching the memory of the precious shard...
english.progress: Maenius was a powerful mage and an honorable elf.  His spirit did not deserve such an ignoble fate.
english.completion: We were shocked before we died. Shocked that one among our noble and austere kind could descend into vicious obsession so quickly. We died as naive fools, the victims of our own blithe assumptions.$B$BThe living would know that these events would play out yet again... both here, and among the entire elven race with the fall of Quel'thalas.
english.completed: Return to the Quel'dorei Spirit at the center of Lake Kel'theril in Winterspring.
english.giverWindow: The obsession of one of our own brought the curse of Zin-Malor upon us all.

text.title: 血精灵之痛
text.objectives: 在凯斯利尔湖杀死7名苦痛灵魂或苦痛幽魂。
text.description: 一年前……$B$B辛玛洛水晶的传说在银月城散播开来，我带领了一堆优秀的战士和学者来到这里。我们随身带有大量的法力水晶，避免被辛玛洛水晶的碎片所诱惑。$B$B但是，它不利用贪念也能轻易地摧毁我们。我们一接触到水晶碎片，它就将所有人变成了失心的野兽，只有我幸免于难。$B$B失心者的灵魂依然在这里徘徊，想要将更多的生命禁锢在凯斯利尔湖。你愿意宽恕他们的罪孽……还是逃往安全的地方静静等死呢？
text.completion: The living farstrider who sent you here could not bear to see our fate. He ran... a wise decision.$B$BIf one now holds the Crystal of Zin-Malor again, it will spell the doom of all around them. It should never have been reassembled.
text.completed: Return to the Sin'dorei Spirit at the center of Lake Kel'theril in Winterspring.

english.title: Pain of the Blood Elves
english.objectives: Slay 7 Wretched Spirits or Wretched Spectres at Lake Kel'theril.
english.description: One year ago...$B$BThe legend of the Crystal of Zin-Malor reached Silvermoon, and I led a group of the finest warriors and scholars available to this land. We brought ample mana crystals, so none of us would be tempted to taste the crystal itself.$B$BThe crystal did not need our hunger to ruin us. Once in our possession, it warped all but me into wretched beasts.$B$BThe wretched souls still wander, seeking more lives to chain to this lake. Will you give them mercy... or flee to die on safer ground someday?
english.completion: The living farstrider who sent you here could not bear to see our fate. He ran... a wise decision.$B$BIf one now holds the Crystal of Zin-Malor again, it will spell the doom of all around them. It should never have been reassembled.
english.completed: Return to the Sin'dorei Spirit at the center of Lake Kel'theril in Winterspring.

text.title: 尼斐塞特城失守
text.objectives: 击败奥丹姆尼斐塞特城的黑暗法老塔卡恒。
text.description: 我们做好进攻的准备了，$n。$B$B只要我们打倒黑暗法老塔卡恒，不朽巨神像就会倒下，我们的部队就能开进尼斐塞特城。$B$B把他找出来，无畏地跟他战斗。我保证你不会单枪匹马地作战。
text.completion: It is done.  We have defeated the Neferset inside their own city. I wish I could say that there is peace for my people at last, but I only foresee more bloodshed.
text.completed: Return to King Phaoris at Ramkahen in Uldum.
text.giverWindow: 杀死黑暗法老，尼斐塞特就会随之陷落。

english.title: The Fall of Neferset City
english.objectives: Slay Dark Pharaoh Tekahn at Neferset City in Uldum.
english.description: We are ready to strike now, $n.$B$BIf we take down Dark Pharaoh Tekahn, the immortal colossi will fall and our armies will be able to march into Neferset City.$B$BSeek him out and engage him without fear.  I will make sure you're not alone when it's time to bring him down.
english.completion: It is done.  We have defeated the Neferset inside their own city. I wish I could say that there is peace for my people at last, but I only foresee more bloodshed.
english.completed: Return to King Phaoris at Ramkahen in Uldum.
english.giverWindow: Slay the Dark Pharaoh, and Neferset falls with him.

text.title: 跟萨尔法谈谈
text.objectives: 穿过木喉要塞进入冬泉谷。跟萨尔法谈一谈，那人就守在木喉要塞入口外。
text.description: 腐化的威胁不仅仅来自南边的死木熊怪，还有东边以及冬泉谷的冬泉熊怪。如果你愿意进一步帮助我们，就去跟要塞另一头冬泉谷入口那儿的萨尔法谈一谈。沿着左边的路走就是了。
text.completion: 你好，$C─我是木喉在冬泉谷这里的发言人也是部族的防卫者。$B$B我们在这寒冷土地的冬泉兄弟们都受到和费伍德森林的熊怪一样的腐败侵略。如果你是来提供木喉熊怪支援的话，我们很乐意接受。$B$B

english.title: Speak to Salfa
english.objectives: Travel through Timbermaw Hold and exit into Winterspring.  Speak with Salfa, who stands guard outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.
english.description: The threat of corruption comes not only from the Deadwood furbolgs to the south, but also from the east and the Winterfall furbolgs of Winterspring.  If you wish to further aid us, speak with Salfa on the other side of the Hold, by the Winterspring entrance.  Follow the path to the left to reach it.
english.completion: Greetings, $c - I stand guard here as both a speaker for the Timbermaw here in Winterspring and as a defender of the tribe. Our Winterfall brethren here in this frigid land have fallen under the same corruptive sway as the furbolg of Felwood.  If you've come here offering the Timbermaw furbolgs aid, then we are ready to accept such an offer.

text.title: 冬泉熊怪的活动
text.objectives: 从冬泉熊怪身上收集10条灵魂珠串。
text.description: 木喉部族倾向于防守，$n。虽然我们允许那些值得信赖的朋友安全地通过，但我们还是尽可能地避开其他熊怪部族。$B$B最近冬泉部族与我们的敌对情绪有所增长。他们似乎处于极度愤怒的状态，完全陷入了对一切他们无法理解的事物的恐慌和仇视。$B$B冬泉熊怪携带着灵魂珠串，不过那些东西看样子显然是没能阻止他们陷入堕落。给我带来10条珠串，以此证明你已经削减了他们的数量。
text.progress: 我们很感激你为木喉部族所做的一切，$N。
text.completion: 感谢你所做的一切。请收下这枚感谢的硬币。$B$B请继续帮助我们，$N。我们的盟友很少，若你不再帮助我们，威胁我们部族的危险会增强到我们无法抵抗的地步。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Salfa in Winterspring.

english.title: Winterfall Activity
english.objectives: Collect 10 Spirit Beads from Winterfall furbolg.
english.description: The Timbermaw tend to stay to themselves, $n.  While we do allow safe passage to those we trust, we try to avoid other furbolg tribes if at all possible.$B$BThe Winterfall tribe has become increasingly hostile towards us.  They seem to be in a state of rage, completely engulfed by their own fear and hatred of anything they do not understand.$B$BThe Winterfall carry spirit beads, which have clearly failed to protect them against corruption. Bring me 10 of these beads to show you have thinned their ranks.
english.progress: We very much appreciate what you have done for the Timbermaw, $n.  Your continued efforts will surely earn my tribe's trust and respect.
english.completion: Thank you for what you have done, as saddening as it is.  Accept this as a token of thanks.$B$BI would ask of you to please continue helping us, $n.  We have very few allies on which to call upon, and without your aid, the threats against my tribe would surely be too much for us to handle alone.
english.completed: Return to Salfa in Winterspring.

text.title: 更多给萨尔法的珠串
text.completion: 你再一次的向我们证明了你的信誉!我会让我的族人都知道你的行为。$B$B记得把你找到的冬泉谷珠子带来给我。只要你把一套珠子给我，我就会继续为你向部族说些好话。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Salfa in Felwood.

english.title: More Beads for Salfa
english.completion: Once again, you prove your honor to us!  I will make sure that your deeds are known amongst my kind. Remember to bring any of the Winterfall's beads you find to me.  For each set you continue to bring to me, I will speak on your behalf to the tribe.
english.completed: Return to Salfa in Felwood.

text.title: 给多诺瓦的货物
text.objectives: 将萨尔法的篮子交给冬泉谷的多诺瓦·雪山。
text.description: 多诺瓦·雪山是一位善良的矮人，她经常拜访附近的温泉。她说是在研究它们的魔法属性。$B$B她人很不错，跟我们部族的关系也很好。随着冬泉熊怪变得越来越有攻击性，她也开始研究他们堕落的原因。$B$B我的岗位在这里，没法走开，不过我给她做了一篮吃的。请帮我把这篮东西交给她，并转告她，我们期待着她的再次拜访。
text.progress: Welcome to the hot springs. What've you got there?
text.completion: Oh, how nice of those dear furbolg. I feel so bad for them, cooped up in that hold, afraid of the world. But can you blame them? These Winterfall furbolg are turning just as vicious as any in Felwood. I'd like to put a stop to it... if only for the sake of my own research, let alone the dear Timbermaw.

english.title: Delivery for Donova
english.objectives: Delivery Salfa's Basket to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.
english.description: Donova Snowden is a kind dwarf who frequents the nearby hot springs. She claims to be studying their magical properties.$B$BShe is a kind person and has good relations with our tribe. As the Winterfall have become more and more aggressive, she has begun researching the cause of their corruption.$B$BI must keep my post here, but I have made a basket of refreshments for her. Please take it to her for me and tell her we await her next visit.
english.progress: Welcome to the hot springs. What've you got there?
english.completion: Oh, how nice of those dear furbolg. I feel so bad for them, cooped up in that hold, afraid of the world. But can you blame them? These Winterfall furbolg are turning just as vicious as any in Felwood. I'd like to put a stop to it... if only for the sake of my own research, let alone the dear Timbermaw.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：安戈洛环形山！
text.objectives: 去找安戈洛环形山马绍尔哨站的威利德·马绍尔。
text.description: 奉安度因·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，联盟所有身强力壮的公民都要向马绍尔哨站的威利德·马绍尔报到。$B$B联盟需要你们支持马绍尔远征队，帮助他们揭开安戈洛环形山的远古野兽、独特植物和高能水晶的秘密。从塔纳利斯西部沿路走，即可进入环形山，前往马绍尔哨站。$B$B为了联盟的荣耀与骄傲！
text.completion: My team of explorers, researchers, and scientists is the finest in Azeroth, but we need all the help we can get to discover the truth about the crater's history and its denizens.

english.title: Hero's Call: Un'Goro Crater!
english.objectives: Report to Williden Marshal at Marshal's Stand in Un'Goro Crater.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Williden Marshal at Marshal's Stand.$B$BThe Alliance needs you to provide support to the Marshal Expeditions as they uncover the secrets of Un'Goro Crater's ancient beasts, unique flora, and powerful crystals. You can reach the crater by departing western Tanaris and following the road all the way to Marshal's Stand.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!
english.completion: My team of explorers, researchers, and scientists is the finest in Azeroth, but we need all the help we can get to discover the truth about the crater's history and its denizens.

text.title: 大酋长的命令：安戈洛环形山！
text.objectives: 前往安戈洛环形山的马绍尔哨站，向威利德·马绍尔报到。你也可以让奥格瑞玛的多拉斯送你过去。
text.description: 所有身强力壮的部落成员，从此刻起都要向马绍尔哨站的威利德·马绍尔报到。你们将帮助马绍尔远征队的人员揭开安戈洛环形山的秘密。该地区的独特野兽和水晶也许可以为部落所用。$B$B沿着塔纳利斯西部的路一直朝下走，就可以进入安戈洛环形山，抵达马绍尔哨站。你也可以从奥格瑞玛的多拉斯那里飞过去。$B$B命运在召唤！
text.completion: Welcome, $c. My scientists and explorers will be glad to have your help.

english.title: Warchief's Command: Un'Goro Crater!
english.objectives: Report to Williden Marshal at Marshal's Stand in Un'Goro Crater.
english.description: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report Williden Marshal at Marshal's Stand. You are to provide aid to the Marshal Expeditions' personnel as they uncover the secrets of Un'Goro Crater. The Horde may be able to find a use for the unique beasts and crystals populating the crater.$B$BYou can reach Un'Goro Crater by taking the road from western Tanaris down into the crater and toward Marshal's Stand.$B$BDestiny calls!
english.completion: Welcome, $c. My scientists and explorers will be glad to have your help.

text.title: 大酋长的命令：希利苏斯！
text.objectives: 前往希利苏斯的塞纳里奥要塞，向唤风者梅恩·长角报到。你也可以让奥格瑞玛的多拉斯送你过去。
text.description: 所有身强力壮的部落成员必须即刻向塞纳里奥要塞的唤风者梅恩·长角报到。你们要帮助我们的盟友击退暮光之锤。绝不能让古加尔的走狗控制希利苏斯！$B$B沿着安戈洛环形山西北方的路出去，即可前往希利苏斯。你也可以从奥格瑞玛的多拉斯那里飞过去。$B$B命运在召唤！
text.completion: Welcome to Cenarion Hold.

english.title: Warchief's Command: Silithus!
english.objectives: Report to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
english.description: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold. You are to aid our Cenarion allies in their battle to turn back Twilight's Hammer. Cho'Gall's minions must not be allowed to dominate Sililthus!$B$BYou can reach Silithus by taking the northwestern road out of Un'Goro Crater.$B$BDestiny calls!
english.completion: Welcome to Cenarion Hold.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：希利苏斯！
text.objectives: 去找希利苏斯塞纳里奥要塞的唤风者梅恩·长角。
text.description: 奉安度因·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，联盟所有身强力壮的公民都要向塞纳里奥要塞的唤风者梅恩·长角报到。$B$B我们的塞纳里奥议会盟友需要你们的帮助，以击退暮光之锤的攻击。沿着安戈洛环形山西北方的路出去，即可前往希利苏斯。$B$B为了联盟的荣耀与骄傲！
text.completion: Welcome to Cenarion Hold.

english.title: Hero's Call: Silithus!
english.objectives: Report to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold.$B$BOur Cenarion Circle allies require your assistance to fight back against the Twilight's Hammer onslaught. You can reach Silithus by taking the northwestern road out of the Un'Goro Crater.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!
english.completion: Welcome to Cenarion Hold.

text.title: 虚空的书卷
text.objectives: 将黑暗预示文书交给洛达内尔的游侠戈琳达·纳希恩。
text.description: 这些卷轴语焉不详，仿佛只是一个更大的谜题的一小部分，但如果你没弄错的话，它们似乎揭示了成为一个恶魔猎手所需要经历的步骤。$B$B大部分暗夜精灵对成为恶魔猎手所必须的黑暗誓约和仪式表示不理解，他们很可能不愿意让人看到这些卷轴。$B$B游侠戈琳达·纳希恩知道该拿它们怎么办。
text.progress: 有什麽我能帮忙的吗，$C?
text.completion: Where did you find these?! You haven't shown them to anyone else, have you? I apologize. You took me off guard. Telarius was a very powerful Demon Hunter, but he was slain during a confrontation with the warden, Maeiv, many years ago. You are fortunate that his ghost was only a shade of his former power. I wonder how many have found their way to him in those ruins. I will see to it that these scrolls make their way to the high priestess immediately. Thank you, $n.

english.title: Writings of the Void
english.objectives: Bring the Writings of the Dark Herald to Ranger Glynda Nal'Shea at Lor'danel.
english.description: The scrolls are vague and appear to be a piece of a much larger puzzle, but if you are not mistaken, they seem to reveal some of the steps on the path to becoming a demon hunter.$B$BThe dark oaths and rituals necessary for becoming a demon hunter are frowned on by most of the night elves, so this is likely something they would be very interested in keeping quiet.$B$BRanger Glynda Nal'Shea wil know what to do with these scrolls.
english.progress: How can I help you, $c?
english.completion: Where did you find these?! You haven't shown them to anyone else, have you? I apologize. You took me off guard. Telarius was a very powerful Demon Hunter, but he was slain during a confrontation with the warden, Maeiv, many years ago. You are fortunate that his ghost was only a shade of his former power. I wonder how many have found their way to him in those ruins. I will see to it that these scrolls make their way to the high priestess immediately. Thank you, $n.

text.title: 滚烫的征兆
text.objectives: 从滚烫的泉涌元素或沸腾的泉泡身上收集7份可疑的绿色泥团。
text.description: 这口大锅中似乎盛着某种浓缩的物质。如果冬泉熊怪把它直接倒进泉水中稀释，污染物会逐渐聚集起来……然后稀释的效果就会越来越差。$B$B东北边的泉水中充斥着沸腾的元素生物。我原本以为这是由大灾变造成的，但是从外表看，也可能是对这种物质的反应。$B$B你能去查看一下它们是否有堕落的迹象吗？去杀掉一些元素生物，如果它们留下了绿色的异物，就把它带来给我。
