text.progress: What did you find?
text.completion: That's quite a bit of it... the Winterfall are slipping further and further. And now we'll have to worry about the other wildlife as well, in time.
text.completed: Return to Donova Snowden at Frostfire Hot Springs in Winterspring.

english.title: Scalding Signs
english.objectives: Collect 7 pieces of Suspicious Green Sludge from Scalding Springsurges or Boiling Springbubbles.
english.description: The cauldron looked like it contained concentrated material. If the Winterfall are diluting this stuff directly in the springs, contamination could build up over time... and then the dilution would be less and less effective.$B$BThe spring to the northeast has boiled over with elementals. I thought it was because of the Cataclysm, but their appearance could be a reaction to this.$B$BCould you check them for corruption? Hunt a few and bring me any bits of green foreign material they leave behind.
english.progress: What did you find?
english.completion: That's quite a bit of it... the Winterfall are slipping further and further. And now we'll have to worry about the other wildlife as well, in time.
english.completed: Return to Donova Snowden at Frostfire Hot Springs in Winterspring.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：凄凉之地！
text.objectives: 去凄凉之地的塔迪萨兰找军官金妮。
text.description: 奉安度因·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，所有身强力壮的联盟公民必须前往凄凉之地，向军官金妮报到。她就位于塔迪萨兰的路边。$B$B尼耶尔前哨站的英勇战士们遭到了恶魔和部落军队的围困，需要你们的帮助。要前往凄凉之地，从石爪山的焦炭谷沿路向南进发即可。$B$B为了联盟的荣耀！
text.completion: I can get you to Nijel's Point quickly! We need all the reinforcements we can get.

english.title: Hero's Call: Desolace!
english.objectives: Report to Officer Jankie at Tethris Aran in Desolace.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Officer Jankie on the road into Desolace at Tethris Aran.$B$BThe brave soldiers of Nijel's Point are beset by demons and the armies of the Horde, and they need your help. To reach Desolace, travel south on the road from the Charred Vale in the Stonetalon Mountains.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!
english.completion: I can get you to Nijel's Point quickly! We need all the reinforcements we can get.

text.title: 大酋长的命令：石爪山！
text.objectives: 去找灰谷银风避难所的血卫士阿尔多·石雨。
text.description: 所有身强力壮的部落成员，从此刻起都要向灰谷银风避难所的血卫士阿尔多·石雨报到。石爪山的部落军队需要你们的帮助，以击退联盟入侵者并保护我们的人民。血卫士会指引你去石爪山边境。$B$B要前往银风避难所，就到灰谷的中心地带去，找到我们部署在湖边的部队。$B$B命运在召唤！
text.completion: So you're to deploy to Stonetalon? Good, we'll need your abilities to defeat the Alliance there.

english.title: Warchief's Command: Stonetalon Mountains!
english.objectives: Report to Blood Guard Aldo Rockrain at Silverwind Refuge in Ashenvale.
english.description: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Blood Guard Aldo Rockrain at Silverwind Refuge in Ashenvale. The Horde forces in Stonetalon need your help to drive back the Alliance invaders and protect our people. The blood guard will direct you to the border of Stonetalon.$B$BTo reach Silverwind Refuge, travel into the heart of Ashenvale and join our forces by the lake.$B$BDestiny calls!
english.completion: So you're to deploy to Stonetalon? Good, we'll need your abilities to defeat the Alliance there.

text.title: 高阶议会的决定
text.objectives: 跟奥丹姆拉穆卡恒的法奥瑞斯国王谈一谈。
text.description: 高阶议会已经做好了对尼斐塞特部落开战的准备。
text.completion: Very well, it looks like it's time.  Stay and watch if you so please.

english.title: The High Council's Decision
english.objectives: Speak to King Phaoris at Ramkahen in Uldum.
english.description: The High Council is ready to decide on the war with the Neferset tribe.
english.completion: Very well, it looks like it's time.  Stay and watch if you so please.

text.title: 上层精灵的子嗣
text.objectives: 跟奎多雷之魂谈一谈。
text.description: 我死后不久，贪婪很快令整个族群遭至被流放的命运。他们本可以跨越大陆，成为高等精灵奎尔多雷。他们本可以在奎尔萨拉斯沐浴着太阳井的光辉，遗忘对力量的渴望与贪念。$B$B但是他们被命运之手带回了这里，历史的悲剧注定重演。聆听他们的故事吧……
text.completion: We were proud and noble. Our faith in the light protected us, and with the Sunwell, we wanted for nothing.$B$BBecause of that blindness, we came here to repeat the tragedy of history, as our entire race would in time.

english.title: Descendants of the Highborne
english.objectives: Speak with the Quel'dorei Spirit.
english.description: Not long after my death, the greed of my people would lead to their exile. A continent away, they would become Quel'dorei, the High Elves. In Quel'thalas they would bathe in the power of their Sunwell, and forget their legacy of desire and greed.$B$BThese distant descendants returned here, drawn by the hand of fate, doomed to repeat history. Hear their tale now, as I have...
english.completion: We were proud and noble. Our faith in the light protected us, and with the Sunwell, we wanted for nothing.$B$BBecause of that blindness, we came here to repeat the tragedy of history, as our entire race would in time.

text.title: 高等精灵的子嗣
text.objectives: 跟辛多雷之魂谈一谈。
text.description: 在我死后数年，高等精灵一族犯下更为严重的错误。他们依赖于太阳井的能量和荣耀，从来没有想过氏族将如何面临失去它的命运。$B$B之后，太阳井未能抵御亡灵大军的冲击，精灵的子嗣由此陷入迷失和无助……而他们接下来选择的道路则永远地改变了整个氏族。$B$B仍然在寻求救赎的辛多雷，也将回到这里……
text.completion: We were not naive, as our forefathers were. We were suspicious and cunning and ready for betrayal at every turn.$B$BYet our pride and greed drove us to ruin once more. How many more will be lost to Kel'theril?

english.title: Descendants of the High Elves
english.objectives: Speak with the Sin'dorei Spirit.
english.description: Long after my death, my people would suffer an even greater mistake. The High Elves relied on the Sunwell and its glory. Never imagining a world without it, we would never make preparations to deal with such a fate.$B$BLater, when the Sunwell fell to the forces of the undead, what was left of my descendants would be lost and helpless... and the path they would take in response would change them forever.$B$BThe Sin'dorei, still striving for redemption, would return here as well...
english.completion: We were not naive, as our forefathers were. We were suspicious and cunning and ready for betrayal at every turn.$B$BYet our pride and greed drove us to ruin once more. How many more will be lost to Kel'theril?

text.title: 辛玛洛的诅咒
text.objectives: 向冬泉谷凯斯利尔湖的科雷克·望天复命。
text.description: 你所见的已经够多了。辛玛洛水晶带来的只有毁灭。$B$B如果你还不想加入我们的行列，就离开这里吧。
text.completion: The shade! Yes, I saw it too!

english.title: The Curse of Zin-Malor
english.objectives: Return to Kelek Skykeeper at Lake Kel'theril in Winterspring.
english.description: You have seen enough. Know that the Crystal of Zin-Malor brings only ruin to all around it.$B$BLeave this place, if you do not wish to join us.
english.completion: The shade! Yes, I saw it too!

text.title: 逐影
text.objectives: 追踪并杀死灵语者之影，获取其主人的信息。
text.description: 它提到了主人？辛玛洛水晶的主人？$B$B这是个重要的消息。你必须采取行动，$c！我看见南边有阴影掠过。沿着道路去废墟上层，你或许需要攀上结冰的瀑布！$B$B千万别放松警惕……这位主人可能在等你。
text.progress: Did you find the shade? Was anything left to indicate its origin?
text.completion: Let me see... faintly written, among the engraved incantations, is the name of its master!$B$B"Umbranse..."
text.completed: 向冬泉谷凯斯利尔湖的科雷克·望天复命。
text.giverWindow: 我们必须找到是谁在控制这只怪兽！

english.title: In Pursuit of Shades
english.objectives: Pursue and slay the Shade of the Spiritspeaker and obtain any evidence of its master.
english.description: You say it spoke of a master? Of one who holds Zin-Malor?$B$BThis is grave news. You must act, $c! I saw the shade fly off to the south. Take the path to the upper ruins, and you may be able to climb the frozen waterfall after it!$B$BAnd do not let your guard down... it may be waiting for you.
english.progress: Did you find the shade? Was anything left to indicate its origin?
english.completion: Let me see... faintly written, among the engraved incantations, is the name of its master!$B$B"Umbranse..."
english.completed: Return to Kelek Skykeeper at Lake Kel'theril in Winterspring.
english.giverWindow: We must discover who commands this monstrosity!

text.title: 女王之泣
text.objectives: 使用女妖之镜抓获10名军情七处特工。
text.description: 你想成为我们的救星吗？很好，我将与你实现灵体链接。在这种状态下，我可以通过你的眼睛看见事物并随时与你交流。$B$B根据你找到的作战计划，雷矛矮人得到了来自北面索菲亚高地的军情七处的帮助。军情七处是纯人类组织——我们可以利用这一点。$B$B带上这面镜子去北方。$B$B与军情七处的成员交手，在他们濒死之际使用女妖之镜。
text.completion: The humans will serve us in life and in death. I will be in contact with you shortly.
text.completed: Speak to Melisara at Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills.
text.turninWindow: 要做的事情还有很多。别沾沾自喜了。

english.title: Cry of the Banshee
english.objectives: Use the Banshee Mirror to capture 10 SI:7 Agents.
english.description: So you are to be our savior? Very well then, I will bond myself with you. Through this bond I will be able to see through your eyes and communicate with you in the field.$B$BAccording to the plans you brought to us, the Stormpike have enlisted the aid of SI:7 at Sofera's Naze, to the north. SI:7 are comprised solely of humans - humans that we are able to use to our benefit.$B$BTake my mirror and travel north. Engage in combat with the SI:7 and bring them near death. Once they are injured, use the mirror.
english.completion: The humans will serve us in life and in death. I will be in contact with you shortly.
english.completed: Speak to Melisara at Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills.
english.turninWindow: There is much more work to be done. Do not grow complacent.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：石爪山！
text.objectives: 去找灰谷和石爪山交界处的星尘塔的女猎手嘉琳。
text.description: 奉安度因·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，联盟所有身强力壮的公民都要向灰谷星尘塔的女猎手嘉琳报到。$B$B部落的军队准备开进石爪山，我们必须阻止他们！前往灰谷森林的南部，与石爪山的边界附近，就是星尘塔。$B$B为了联盟的荣耀与骄傲！
text.completion: The Horde has bored a giant pass into the mountains, and we have few enough sentinels to spare. We have to find a way to stop them!

english.title: Hero's Call: Stonetalon Mountains!
english.objectives: Report to Huntress Jalin at Stardust Spire at the border between Ashenvale and the Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Huntress Jalin at Stardust Spire in Ashenvale.$B$BThe Horde's forces are poised to push into Stonetalon and they must be opposed! You can reach Stardust Spire by traveling to the southern part of Ashenvale Forest, near the border with Stonetalon.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!
english.completion: The Horde has bored a giant pass into the mountains, and we have few enough sentinels to spare. We have to find a way to stop them!

text.title: 魂精魔法
text.objectives: 获得霜毛之心。
text.description: 多年来，玛艾里都在用野生动物的灵魂制作护符。玛艾里把魂精从动物体内抽出来，然后做成护符，给孩子们和冒险者们。$b$b在东边有一座高山，许多碎齿熊生活在那一带。在山顶上有一头名叫霜毛的熊，是那片树林中最年长的熊。$B$B玛艾里需要那头熊才能施法。你去把那头熊的巨大心脏拿来。
text.progress: You got de bear? Let's see de bear.
text.completion: Dis is nice, big heart! If you be interested, Mau'ari tell ya how I be gettin' de E'ko....
text.completed: Return to Witch Doctor Mau'ari in western Winterspring.

english.title: Doin' De E'ko Magic
english.objectives: Obtain Rimepelt's Heart.
english.description: Mau'ari been makin' charms from da spirits of de wilds here for years now. Mau'ari just PLUCK de E'ko right outta de animals, and make charms for de kids, and de adventurers.$b$bOvah to de east, dere be a tall hill surrounded by de shardtooth bears. Up on de hill be Rimepelt, de oldest bear in de woods.$B$BMau'ari need dat bear for her magic. You bring me de bear's big ol' heart.
english.progress: You got de bear? Let's see de bear.
english.completion: Dis is nice, big heart! If you be interested, Mau'ari tell ya how I be gettin' de E'ko....
english.completed: Return to Witch Doctor Mau'ari in western Winterspring.

text.title: 玛艾里的容器
text.objectives: Watch Witch Doctor Mau'ari pull the E'ko from Rimepelt's body.
text.description: It be hard to describe de E'ko, but all creatures in dese lands have it... beasts, furbolg, even de frost giants. You got to open your mind and know where to look...$B$BWatch me now, an' I show you how to pull out de E'ko.

english.title: Cache of Mau'ari
english.objectives: Watch Witch Doctor Mau'ari pull the E'ko from Rimepelt's body.
english.description: It be hard to describe de E'ko, but all creatures in dese lands have it... beasts, furbolg, even de frost giants. You got to open your mind and know where to look...$B$BWatch me now, an' I show you how to pull out de E'ko.

text.title: 大酋长的命令：费伍德！
text.objectives: 去找费伍德翡翠圣地的泰尼尔·飘叶。
text.description: 所有身强力壮的部落成员，从此刻起都要向费伍德翡翠圣地的泰尼尔·飘叶报到。塞纳里奥议会需要你们的帮助，将费伍德从恶魔和其它堕落的生物手中拯救出来！$B$B从灰谷沿路向北进发，直到抵达翡翠圣地。$B$B命运在召唤！
text.completion: Welcome. My brothers and I are dedicated to the redemption and rejuvenation of this once-sacred forest.

english.title: Warchief's Command: Felwood!
english.objectives: Report to Tenell Leafrunner at the Emerald Sanctuary in Felwood.
english.description: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Tenell Leafrunner at the Emerald Sanctuary in Felwood. The Cenarion Circle requires your help to wrest Felwood from the control of demons and other corrupt creatures!$B$BTo reach the Emerald Sanctuary, travel north from Ashenvale and follow the road until you reach the sanctuary.$B$BDestiny calls!
english.completion: Welcome. My brothers and I are dedicated to the redemption and rejuvenation of this once-sacred forest.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：费伍德！
text.objectives: 去找费伍德翡翠圣地的泰尼尔·飘叶。
text.description: 奉安度因·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，联盟所有身强力壮的公民都要向翡翠圣地的泰尼尔·飘叶报到。$B$B此道命令要求你们从影响费伍德森林的恶魔手中拯救该地区。从灰谷向北进发，沿路进入费伍德森林，直到抵达翡翠圣地。$B$B为了联盟的荣耀与骄傲！
text.completion: There is much work to do here. The forest is on the mend, but without our help, it will take generations to restore this once-sacred wood.

english.title: Hero's Call: Felwood!
english.objectives: Report to Tenell Leafrunner at the Emerald Sanctuary in Felwood.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Tenell Leafrunner at the Emerald Sanctuary.$B$BHis order requires your help to redeem Felwood from the demonic influences that rule the forest. Head north from Ashenvale and follow the road into Felwood until you reach the Emerald Sanctuary.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!
english.completion: There is much work to do here. The forest is on the mend, but without our help, it will take generations to restore this once-sacred wood.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：冬泉谷！
text.objectives: 去找冬泉谷冰火温泉的多诺瓦·雪山。
text.description: 奉安度因·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，联盟所有身强力壮的公民都要向冰火温泉的多诺瓦·雪山报到。$B$B她需要你们的帮助以化解冬泉熊怪的威胁。要前往冬泉谷，就必须从费伍德北部向东走，穿越木喉要塞。$B$B为了联盟的光辉与荣耀！
text.completion: Thank goodness you're here. I've discovered the secret of the fierce Winterfall furbolg.

english.title: Hero's Call: Winterspring!
english.objectives: Report to Donova Snowden at Frostfire Hot Springs in Winterspring.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Donova Snowden at Frostfire Hotsprings.$B$BShe requires your help to overcome the threat of the Winterfall furbolg. To reach Winterspring, you must travel east from northern Felwood and traverse Timbermaw Hold.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!
english.completion: Thank goodness you're here. I've discovered the secret of the fierce Winterfall furbolg.

text.title: 大酋长的命令：冬泉谷！
text.objectives: 去找冬泉谷冰火温泉的多诺瓦·雪山。
text.description: 所有身强力壮的部落成员，从此刻起都要向冰火温泉的多诺瓦·雪山报到。她关于冬泉熊怪的发现也许是我们彻底解决这一威胁的关键。$B$B要前往冬泉谷，就必须从费伍德北部向东走，穿越木喉要塞。$B$B命运在召唤！
text.completion: Perhaps you can help me make sense of my discoveries about the source of the Winterfall Furbolgs' strength.

english.title: Warchief's Command: Winterspring!
english.objectives: Report to Donova Snowden at Frostfire Hot Springs in Winterspring.
english.description: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Donova Snowden at Frostfire Hot Springs. Her discoveries about the Winterfall furbolg may be the key to dealing with this threat once and for all.$B$BTo reach the Frostfire Hot Springs in Winterspring, you must travel east from northern Felwood and traverse Timbermaw Hold.$B$BDestiny calls!
english.completion: Perhaps you can help me make sense of my discoveries about the source of the Winterfall Furbolgs' strength.

text.title: 寒水魂精
text.objectives: Collect 5 Winterfall E'ko from any Winterfall furbolg in Winterspring.
text.description: In Winterspring, you will fight misguided creatures known as de Winterfall furbolg. These bear-people be so angry an' ferocious, dey live in a constant frenzy.$B$BBring me de E'ko of de Winterfall, an' I give you a frenzy so intense, ya legs will let you run like de wind!
text.completed: Summon Witch Doctor Mau'ari using the Tiny Totem of Mau'ari.

english.title: Winterfall E'ko
english.objectives: Collect 5 Winterfall E'ko from any Winterfall furbolg in Winterspring.
english.description: In Winterspring, you will fight misguided creatures known as de Winterfall furbolg. These bear-people be so angry an' ferocious, dey live in a constant frenzy.$B$BBring me de E'ko of de Winterfall, an' I give you a frenzy so intense, ya legs will let you run like de wind!
english.completed: Summon Witch Doctor Mau'ari using the Tiny Totem of Mau'ari.

text.title: 寒水魂精
text.objectives: Collect 3 Winterfall E'ko from any Winterfall furbolg in Winterspring.
text.description: In Winterspring, you will fight misguided creatures known as da Winterfall furbolg. Dese bear-people be so angry an' ferocious, dey live in a constant frenzy.$B$BBring me de E'ko of de Winterfall, an' I give you a frenzy so intense, ya legs will let you run like de wind!
text.completed: Summon With Doctor Mau'ari using the Tiny Totem of Mau'ari.

english.title: Winterfall E'ko
english.objectives: Collect 3 Winterfall E'ko from any Winterfall furbolg in Winterspring.
english.description: In Winterspring, you will fight misguided creatures known as da Winterfall furbolg. Dese bear-people be so angry an' ferocious, dey live in a constant frenzy.$B$BBring me de E'ko of de Winterfall, an' I give you a frenzy so intense, ya legs will let you run like de wind!
english.completed: Summon With Doctor Mau'ari using the Tiny Totem of Mau'ari.

text.title: 大酋长的命令：凄凉之地！
text.objectives: 去找凄凉之地塔迪萨兰的弗瑞恩。
text.description: 所有身强力壮的部落成员，从此刻起都要向凄凉之地塔迪萨兰的弗瑞恩报到。凄凉之地一带勇敢的部落士兵需要你们的帮助，以击退联盟的军队和远古的恶魔。$B$B要抵达塔迪萨兰，只需从石爪山的焦炭谷向南进发。$B$B命运在召唤！
text.completion: You... arrived just in... time...

english.title: Warchief's Command: Desolace!
english.objectives: Report to Furien at Tethris Aran in Desolace.
english.description: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Furien at Tethris Aran in Desolace. The brave Horde warriors of Desolace need your help to beat back the armies of the Alliance and ancient demons.$B$BTo reach Tethris Aran, travel south from the Charred Vale in the Stonetalon Mountains.$B$BDestiny calls!
english.completion: You... arrived just in... time...

text.title: 大酋长的命令：南贫瘠之地！
text.objectives: 在南贫瘠之地的高地之路向探路者鲁娜报告。你也可以让奥格瑞玛的多拉斯送你过去。
text.description: 所有身强力壮的部落成员，从此刻起都要向南贫瘠之地高地之路的探路者鲁娜报到。鉴于联盟近期在贫瘠之地取得的胜利，我们的敌人有可能切断我们的补给线，让我们的战士陷入兵粮寸断的绝境。我们必须采取行动！$B$B要前往高地之路，就从石爪山向东进发。你也可以从奥格瑞玛的多拉斯那里飞过去。$B$B命运在召唤！
text.completion: You've no doubt seen what the Alliance has done to the Barrens, $c. If we don't act, there may not be a Horde presence here much longer.

english.title: Warchief's Command: Southern Barrens!
english.objectives: Report to Nura Pathfinder at the High Road in the Southern Barrens.
english.description: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Nura Pathfinder at the High Road in the Southern Barrens. With the recent Alliance victories in the Barrens, our enemies are threatening to cut our supply lines and leave our warriors stranded. We must act!$B$BTo reach the High Road, travel east from Stonetalon Mountains.$B$BDestiny calls!
english.completion: You've no doubt seen what the Alliance has done to the Barrens, $c. If we don't act, there may not be a Horde presence here much longer.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：南贫瘠之地！
text.objectives: 去找南贫瘠之地西北部石爪小径的指挥官瓦波尔。
text.description: 奉安度因·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，联盟所有身强力壮的公民都要向南贫瘠之地石爪小径的指挥官瓦波尔报到。$B$B我们勇敢的士兵在贫瘠之地取得了巨大的收获，但也付出了沉重的代价！为了巩固我们获得的成果，你们的帮助是不可或缺的。从石爪山的巨木谷向东南方向进发，即可抵达南贫瘠之地。$B$B为了联盟的荣耀与骄傲！
text.completion: We face heavy Horde counterattacks daily, $c. We need every pair of hands we can get to keep them at bay.

english.title: Hero's Call: Southern Barrens!
english.objectives: Report to Commander Walpole at Stonetalon Pass in northwestern Southern Barrens.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Commander Walpole at Stonetalon Pass in the Southern Barrens.$B$BOur brave soldiers have made tremendous gains in the Barrens, but they have paid a heavy price! Your efforts are needed to consolidate our gains. You can reach the Southern Barrens from the Stonetalon Mountains by traveling southeast through Greatwood Vale.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!
english.completion: We face heavy Horde counterattacks daily, $c. We need every pair of hands we can get to keep them at bay.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：南贫瘠之地！
text.objectives: 去找南贫瘠之地北方城堡码头上的码头管理员刘易斯。
text.description: 奉安度因·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，联盟所有身强力壮的公民都要向北方城堡的码头管理员刘易斯报到。$B$B我们勇敢的士兵在贫瘠之地取得了巨大的收获，但也付出了沉重的代价！为了巩固我们获得的成果，你们的帮助是不可或缺的。从藏宝海湾乘船前往棘齿城，然后沿着海岸线朝南进发，即可抵达北方城堡的码头。$B$B为了联盟的荣耀与骄傲！
text.completion: We're facing heavy resistance from the Horde, $c. Any reinforcements are welcome.

english.title: Hero's Call: Southern Barrens!
english.objectives: Report to Dockmaster Lewis at the docks outside Northwatch Hold in the Southern Barrens.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Dockmaster Lewis near Northwatch Hold.$B$BOur brave soldiers have made tremendous gains in the Barrens, but they have paid a heavy price! Your efforts are needed to consolidate our gains. You can reach the docks outside Northwatch Hold by taking a boat from Booty Bay to Ratchet and traveling south along the coast.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!
english.completion: We're facing heavy resistance from the Horde, $c. Any reinforcements are welcome.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：尘泥沼泽！
text.objectives: 去找尘泥沼泽塞拉摩岛的加莉亚·哈斯汀。
text.description: 奉安度因·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，联盟所有身强力壮的公民都要向塞拉摩岛的加莉亚·哈斯汀报到。$B$B你们必须帮助军情七处的加莉亚·哈斯汀找出威胁塞拉摩的因素，无论是潜伏在城内的，还是游荡在城外的。从米奈希尔港乘船或从南贫瘠之地步行穿越尘泥沼泽，都可以抵达塞拉摩岛。$B$B为了联盟的荣耀与骄傲！
text.completion: Deserters from the city guards are spreading discontent in the ranks. We have to get to the bottom of this before it undermines our defenses.

english.title: Hero's Call: Dustwallow Marsh!
english.objectives: Report to Calia Hastings at Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Calia Hastings at Theramore Isle.$B$BYou must aid SI:7's Calia Hastings in uncovering the threats to Theramore, both within the city and beyond its walls. You can reach Theramore Isle by taking the boat from Menethil or traveling across the marsh from the Southern Barrens.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!
english.completion: Deserters from the city guards are spreading discontent in the ranks. We have to get to the bottom of this before it undermines our defenses.

text.title: 奥克莉拉与诅咒之地
text.objectives: 去找诅咒之地巨槌要塞的奥克莉拉。
text.description: 我还有最后一件委托要派你去做，$n。是关于南边的诅咒之地巨槌要塞。$b$b战争主母奥克莉拉正在和守望堡的联盟军队开战，她需要一个强悍的$c帮忙。我马上就想到了你。$b$b往南前往诅咒之地，然后朝西走。祝你好运，$n。
text.completion: Well, well, well... look what the Ruag dragged in!

english.title: Okrilla and the Blasted Lands
english.objectives: Report to Okrilla at Dreadmaul Hold in the Blasted Lands.
english.description: I have one final dispatch to deliver to you, $n.  It comes from Dreadmaul Hold, to the south, in the Blasted Lands.$b$bWarmatron Okrilla is waging battle against the Alliance forces of Nethergarde Keep, and she needs the assistance of a stout $c.  You immediately sprung to mind.$b$bTravel south into the Blasted Lands, then head west.  Good luck, $n.
english.completion: Well, well, well... look what the Ruag dragged in!

text.title: 大酋长的命令：尘泥沼泽！
text.objectives: 去尘泥沼泽的蕨墙村向克罗格报告。你也可以让奥格瑞玛的多拉斯送你过去。
text.description: 所有身强力壮的部落成员，从此刻起都要向蕨墙村的克罗格报到。沼泽被形形色色的敌人占据，那里的联盟势力强大到了危险的地步。$B$B从南贫瘠之地东部的路进入尘泥沼泽，就可以抵达蕨墙村。你也可以从奥格瑞玛的多拉斯那里飞过去。$B$B命运在召唤！
text.completion: If we can get things straightened out here, we have a chance to strike at the Alliance while most of their forces are busy in the Barrens.

english.title: Warchief's Command: Dustwallow Marsh!
english.objectives: Report to Krog at Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh.
english.description: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Krog at Brackenwall Village. The marsh is overrun with enemies of many kinds and the Alliance forces there are dangerously strong.$B$BYou can travel to Dustwallow Marsh by following the path from the eastern part of the Southern Barrens toward Brackenwall Village.$B$BDestiny calls!
english.completion: If we can get things straightened out here, we have a chance to strike at the Alliance while most of their forces are busy in the Barrens.

text.title: Expel the Envoys
text.description: <Not yet implemented.>

english.title: Expel the Envoys
english.description: <Not yet implemented.>

text.title: 消灭先头部队
text.objectives: 将地精袖珍核弹放置在索菲亚高地、考兰之匕、山头营地和加文高地。
text.description: 我们必须铲除雷矛矮人的先头部队，才能阻止这场入侵行动。$B$B<克鲁姆什递给你一个小包裹。>$B$B包裹里装着四枚强效地精炸弹。潜入四座山峰——索菲亚高地、考兰之匕、山头营地和加文高地，并放置地精袖珍核弹。$B$B完成我和梅里萨拉交给你的任务后，再回来向我复命。
text.completion: Once Melisara is through with you we will detonate the explosives!
text.completed: Return to High Warlord Cromush at Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: Breaking the Hand
english.objectives: Plant a Goblin Pocket-Nuke at Sofera's Naze, Corrahn's Dagger, the Headland and Gavin's Naze.
english.description: We must break the fingers of the Stormpike if we are to stop their incursion.$B$B<Cromush hands you a small package.>$B$BWithin this package are four high-yield goblin explosives. You are to infiltrate each of the four fingers - Sofera's Naze, Corrahn's Dagger, the Headland and Gavin's Naze - and plant a goblin pocket-nuke at each.$B$BOnce you have done that - as well as all that Melisara asks of you - return to me.
english.completion: Once Melisara is through with you we will detonate the explosives!
english.completed: Return to High Warlord Cromush at Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills.

在考兰之匕放置袖珍核弹
在山头营地放置袖珍核弹
