text.title: 大酋长的命令：奥丹姆！
text.objectives: 与塔纳利斯西部灌木谷的埃达尔拉交谈。
text.description: 所有身强力壮的部落成员，从此刻起都要向塔纳利斯灌木谷的埃达尔拉报到。$B$B古代的记载告诉我们，奥丹姆蕴藏着无数未知的财富和宝藏。勇往直前，以部落之名夺取这些宝藏吧！$B$B你可以前往塔纳利斯，在西南部的灌木谷找到埃达尔拉的车队。$B$B命运在召唤！
text.completion: You could be one of the very first mortals to set foot in Uldum in millenia. Just think of the treasures that await us!

english.title: Warchief's Command: Uldum!
english.objectives: Speak with Adarrah in Thistleshrub Valley in western Tanaris.
english.description: All able-bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Adarrah at the Thistleshrub Valley in Tanaris.$B$BAncient texts tell us that Uldum is home to untold riches and treasures beyond compare. Go forth and claim these in the name of the Horde!$B$BYou can reach Adarrah's caravan by traveling to the southwestern part of Tanaris and looking for her in Thistleshrub Valley.$B$BDestiny calls!
english.completion: You could be one of the very first mortals to set foot in Uldum in millenia. Just think of the treasures that await us!

text.title: 英雄的召唤：奥丹姆！
text.objectives: 与塔纳利斯灌木谷的埃达尔拉交谈。
text.description: 奉安度因·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，联盟所有身强力壮的公民都要向塔纳利斯灌木谷的埃达尔拉报到。$B$B成为第一批进入壮观的奥丹姆探险的勇士，为了联盟的荣耀，夺取那里的宝藏！$B$B你可以前往塔纳利斯，在西部边界找到埃达尔拉的车队。$B$B为了联盟的荣耀与骄傲！
text.completion: There are wonders just waiting to be discovered beyond this valley. And they will be ours!

english.title: Hero's Call: Uldum!
english.objectives: Speak with Adarrah at Thistleshrub Valley in Tanaris.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Adarrah at Thistleshrub Valley in Tanaris.$B$BBe one of the first to enter glorious Uldum and claim its treasures in honor of the Alliance!$B$BYou can reach Adarrah's caravan by traveling to the western reaches of Tanaris.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!
english.completion: There are wonders just waiting to be discovered beyond this valley. And they will be ours!

text.title: 英雄的召唤：秘血岛！
text.objectives: 去找秘血岛凯希尔路口的雷象管理者沃克汉。
text.description: 奉安度因·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，联盟所有身强力壮的公民都要向凯希尔路口的雷象管理者沃克汉报到。$B$B秘血岛的人民需要你们的帮助，以对付狡诈的血精灵和在岛上肆意横行的生物。走过秘蓝岛北方的桥，就是秘血岛的凯希尔路口。$B$B为了联盟的荣耀与骄傲！
text.completion: So you're here to help? Well, there's plenty to do...

english.title: Hero's Call: Bloodmyst Isle!
english.objectives: Report to Vorkhan the Elekk Herder at Kessel's Crossing on Bloodmyst Isle.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Vorkhan the Elekk Herder at Kessel's Crossing.$B$BThe people of Bloodmyst need your help to deal with treacherous blood elves and dangerous creatures loose on the island. You can reach Kessel's Crossing on Bloodmyst Isle by taking the bridge north from Azuremyst Isle.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!
english.completion: So you're here to help? Well, there's plenty to do...

text.title: 大酋长的命令：幽魂之地！
text.objectives: 向幽魂之地塔奎林的奥术师范迪瑞尔报到。
text.description: 所有身强力壮的部落成员，从此刻起都要向幽魂之地塔奎林的奥术师范迪瑞尔报到。$B$B帮助我们来击退无穷无尽的天灾军团入侵者，并帮助被遗忘者对付我们共同的敌人。$B$B要前往塔奎林，就从晴风村广场沿着道路向南进入幽魂之地就可以到达那里。$B$B命运在召唤！
text.completion: Your arrival here is fortuitous, $c. We cannot fight the Scourge without help.

english.title: Warchief's Command: Ghostlands!
english.objectives: Report to Arcanist Vandril at Tranquilien in the Ghostlands.
english.description: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Arcanist Vandril at Tranquilien in the Ghostlands.$B$BYour help is needed to turn back the numberless Scourge invaders and secure the help of the Forsaken in fighting our common enemy.$B$BTo reach Tranquilien, follow the road south from Fairbreeze Square and into the Ghostlands.$B$BDestiny calls!
english.completion: Your arrival here is fortuitous, $c. We cannot fight the Scourge without help.

text.title: 坚守纳奥姆
text.objectives: 加入奥丹姆纳奥姆的军团。
text.description: 只要我们向西攻打尼斐塞特城，敌人就会从东边进攻我们的薄弱之处。$B$B纳奥姆将是第一个失陷的，如果它被敌人占领了，那么拉穆卡恒就会是下一个。$B$B一支小分队已经来到了这里。$B$B他们会跟你简要介绍一下情况。我要你保证他们守住纳奥姆，直到我能派更多的部队过来为止。
text.completion: $n!  It's you!  My regiment was ambushed on our way here. Our captain was slain, leaving me in command... until you got here, that is... sir!

english.title: Nahom Must Hold
english.objectives: Report to the regiment at Nahom in Uldum.
english.description: As soon as we make our move west in order to attack Neferset City, the enemy will strike us from the east, where we'll be weak.$B$BNahom will be the first to fall, and if it does, Ramkahen will soon follow.$B$BA small detachment is there already.$B$BGet a briefing from them.  I want you to make sure that they hold Nahom until I can send more troops there.
english.completion: $n!  It's you!  My regiment was ambushed on our way here. Our captain was slain, leaving me in command... until you got here, that is... sir!

text.title: 英雄的召唤：西部荒野！
text.objectives: 去找西部荒野贾森农场的霍拉提奥·莱茵中尉。
text.description: 奉安度因·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，所有身强力壮的联盟公民都要向贾森农场的霍拉提奥·莱茵中尉报到。$B$B由于西部荒野的乞丐和流民泛滥，导致犯罪活动激增。为了恢复正常的生活秩序，联盟需要你的帮助。从艾尔文森林一直向西，就能到达西部荒野的贾森农场。$B$B为了联盟的荣耀与骄傲！
text.completion: Murder, rookie. That's what you're looking at on the ground in front of us.

english.title: Hero's Call: Westfall!
english.objectives: Report to Lieutenant Horatio Laine at the Jansen Stead in Westfall.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Lieutenant Horatio Lane at the Jansen Stead.$B$BWestfall has been overrun by beggars and transients, leading to a massive increase in criminal activity. Your help is needed to restore order to the populace. You can reach the Jansen Stead in Westfall by traveling west from Elwynn Forest.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!
english.completion: Murder, rookie. That's what you're looking at on the ground in front of us.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：赤脊山！
text.objectives: 去找赤脊山瞭望塔的卫兵队长帕克。
text.description: 奉安度因·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，联盟所有身强力壮的公民都要向赤脊山瞭望塔的卫兵队长帕克报到。$B$B帕克队长的部队正在被肆虐的豺狼人和兽人攻击。湖畔镇的人民正处于危机当中，急需你们协助保护他们的安全。从艾尔文森林的东部边境前往赤脊山的三角路口，即可抵达瞭望塔。$B$B为了联盟的荣耀与骄傲！
text.completion: Heard Westfall was in some deep doody. Well, we got our own set of problems here. See them gnolls out there? Looks like they're actin' up again. I don't like it. Don't like it one bit.

english.title: Hero's Call: Redridge Mountains!
english.objectives: Report to Watch Captain Parker at Tower Watch in Redridge Mountains.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report Watch Captain Parker at Tower Watch in the Redridge Mountains.$B$BCaptain Parker's forces have come under attack from marauding gnolls and orcs. The people of Lakewood are in peril and your aid is needed to safeguard them. Travel east from the border of Elwynn Forest and into the Three Corners area of Redridge to reach Tower Watch.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!
english.completion: Heard Westfall was in some deep doody. Well, we got our own set of problems here. See them gnolls out there? Looks like they're actin' up again. I don't like it. Don't like it one bit.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：暮色森林！
text.objectives: 去找暮色森林夜色镇的指挥官阿尔泰娅·埃伯洛克。
text.description: 奉安度因·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，联盟所有身强力壮的公民都要向夜色镇的指挥官阿尔泰娅·埃伯洛克报到。$B$B指挥官手下的守夜人被肆虐的狼群和野蛮的狼人搅得疲于奔命。没有你们的帮助，他们无法继续坚持下去。沿着艾尔文森林与赤脊山交界处的路，即可抵达暮色森林的夜色镇。$B$B为了联盟的荣耀与骄傲！
text.completion: You are the help that we requested? I suppose you will have to do.

english.title: Hero's Call: Duskwood!
english.objectives: Report to Commander Althea Ebonlocke at Darkshire in Duskwood.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Commander Althea Ebonlocke in Darkshire.$B$BThe commander's watchmen are stretched thin defending against marauding wolves and bands of wild worgen. They cannot hold out for long without your help. You can reach Darkshire in Duskwood by following the road south at the border between Elwynn Forest and the Redridge Mountains.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!
english.completion: You are the help that we requested? I suppose you will have to do.

enders.name: 指挥官阿尔泰娅·埃伯洛克

text.title: 英雄的召唤：湿地！
text.objectives: 去找丹奥加兹的巡山人拉伦。
text.description: 奉安度因·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，联盟所有身强力壮的公民都要向丹奥加兹的巡山人拉伦报到。$B$B随着大灾变的毁灭性爆发，湿地已被野兽、兽人掠夺者和野蛮的豺狼人搅得天翻地覆！要抵达湿地，你们必须从洛克莫丹往北进发，穿过矮人要塞丹奥加兹。$B$B为了联盟的荣耀与骄傲！
text.completion: We haven't gotten much in the way of reinforcements lately. We can use every pair of hands we can get.

english.title: Hero's Call: Wetlands!
english.objectives: Report to Mountaineer Rharen at Dun Algaz.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Mountaineer Rharen at Dun Algaz.$B$BIn the wake of the cataclysm's destruction, Wetlands has become overrun with wild beasts, orcish raiders, and savage gnolls! To reach the Wetlands, you must travel north from Loch Modan through the dwarven hold of Dun Algaz.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!
english.completion: We haven't gotten much in the way of reinforcements lately. We can use every pair of hands we can get.

text.title: 总攻
text.objectives: 击败寒心上尉和12名雷矛士兵。
text.description: <梅里萨拉的影像出现在你面前。>$B$B雷矛矮人的先头部队驻扎在索菲亚高地以西的考兰之匕。去那里击败你撞见的所有矮人。让他们尝尝恐惧的滋味，给他们上最好的一课吧。$B$B不要手软，$n。寒心上尉，他必须被击败。$B$B我会再联络你的。
text.completion: They will see the bloodshed and they will hesitate. Hesitation will make them think twice about ever attacking us again.
text.completed: Speak to Melisara at Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills.
text.giverWindow: 雷矛矮人会得到教训的。

english.title: Decimation
english.objectives: Kill Captain Iceheart and 12 Stormpike Soldiers.
english.description: <Melisara's image appears before you.>$B$BThe Stormpike forward camp sits atop Corrahn's Dagger, west of Sofera's Naze. You must enter the camp and slaughter every dwarf that you see. They must be taught what it means to fear and there is no finer lesson than absolute decimation.$B$BNo survivors, $n. Even their captain - especially their captain - must die.$B$BI will be in contact.
english.completion: They will see the bloodshed and they will hesitate. Hesitation will make them think twice about ever attacking us again.
english.completed: Speak to Melisara at Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills.
english.giverWindow: The Stormpike will learn what it means to fear.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：洛克莫丹！
text.objectives: 去找洛克莫丹南门哨岗的驾驶员塞克·锤足。
text.description: 奉安度因·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，联盟所有身强力壮的公民都要向南门哨岗的驾驶员塞克·锤足报到。$B$B巨石水坝的破坏和石腭怪、狗头人的再度活跃使巡山人应接不暇。他们急需援助！从丹莫罗东部的南门小径向东进发，即可抵达南门哨岗。$B$B为了联盟的荣耀与骄傲！
text.completion: Have our leaders finally heard my pleas? We're down to just a handful of pilots and mountaineers to defend Loch Modan.

english.title: Hero's Call: Loch Modan!
english.objectives: Report to Pilot Hammerfoot at South Gate Outpost in Loch Modan.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Pilot Hammerfoot at South Gate Outpost.$B$BThe destruction of the Stonewrought Dam and the resurgence of the kobolds and troggs has the mountaineers stretched thin. Reinforcements are desperately needed! Travel east through South Gate Pass from eastern Dun Morogh to reach South Gate Outpost.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!
english.completion: Have our leaders finally heard my pleas? We're down to just a handful of pilots and mountaineers to defend Loch Modan.

text.title: 大酋长的命令：银松森林！
text.objectives: 去找银松森林被遗忘者统帅部的大执行官摩尔图斯。
text.description: 所有身强力壮的部落成员，从此刻起都要向银松森林被遗忘者统帅部的大执行官摩尔图斯报到。$B$B现在，为了剿灭侵入该地的敌人，并征服吉尔尼斯的港口，向你们寻求帮助的需要比以往任何时候都更为紧迫！$B$B要前往被遗忘者统帅部，就必须从提瑞斯法林地南部进发，进入银松森林。然后沿着路朝南走，即可抵达被遗忘者统帅部。$B$B命运在召唤！
text.completion: Most excellent! A new recruit has arrived. There is much to do... much to do I say.

english.title: Warchief's Command: Silverpine Forest!
english.objectives: Report to Grand Executor Mortuus at Forsaken High Command in Silverpine Forest.
english.description: All able-bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Grand Executor Mortuus at Forsaken High Command in Silverpine Forest.$B$BNow, more than ever, your help is needed in routing the enemy infestation of the region and conquering the port of Gilneas!$B$BTo reach Forsaken High Command you must travel south through Tirisfal Glades and enter Silverpine Forest. From there, follow the road south until you reach Forsaken High Command.$B$B Destiny calls!
english.completion: Most excellent! A new recruit has arrived. There is much to do... much to do I say.

text.title: 沼桨弹头
text.objectives: 与燃烧平原东南角的莎朗·缓爆交谈，骑着沼桨弹头前往悲伤沼泽。然后与沼桨镇的贸易巨头银罐交谈。
text.description: 我听过一个故事，讲的是有一条通往悲伤沼泽的道路。这个神秘的故事讲的是一条蜿蜒曲折的山间小路，横跨了整座赤脊山，直接把你送到沼桨镇！$b$b如果你没事做了，我想你可能就要离开这里了。我们都会很伤心的。当你离开的时候，去跟燃烧平原东南角的莎朗·缓爆谈谈。她会送你一程的。$b$b<奥拉留斯歪过头，仿佛是在听什么。>$b$b温奇？温奇！不！
text.completion: Time is money, $c... and I've got plenty of each. What can I do for you?
text.completed: 去找悲伤沼泽沼桨镇的贸易巨头银罐。

english.title: The Bogpaddle Bullet
english.objectives: Speak with Sharon Boomgetter in the southeastern corner of Burning Steppes to ride the Bogpaddle Bullet to the Swamp of Sorrows.  Then speak with Trade Baron Silversnap in Bogpaddle.
english.description: I've heard stories about a road to the Swamp of Sorrows.  Mysterious tales of a meandering mountain pathway that completely bypasses Redridge and poops you right out into Bogpaddle!$b$bIf you run out of things to do, I suppose you'll have to leave.  And we'll all be sad.  When you do leave, talk to Sharon Boomgetter in the southeastern corner of the Steppes.  She'll give you a ride.$b$b<Oralius tilts his head, as if listening to something.>$b$bWinky?  WINKY!  NO!
english.completion: Time is money, $c... and I've got plenty of each. What can I do for you?
english.completed: Report to Trade Baron Silversnap at Bogpaddle in the Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 沼桨弹头
text.objectives: 与燃烧平原东南角的莎朗·缓爆交谈，骑着沼桨弹头前往悲伤沼泽。然后与沼桨镇的贸易巨头银罐交谈。
text.description: 你真是个厉害的$r，难道不是吗？看看你……已经成长这么多了。我们才刚见面不久啊！$b$b我知道事情会怎样发展的……很快，你就会做完烈焰峰这边的事情，然后你会保证自己会经常回来看看，但是你再也不会回来。$b$b基布雷尔对此已经习惯了。$b$b当你离开的时候，就去跟燃烧平原东南角的莎朗·缓爆谈谈吧。她会用弹头送你一程的。$b$b什么？哦，只是火箭而已。非常安全的。
text.completion: Time is money, $c... and I've got plenty of each. What can I do for you?
text.completed: 去找悲伤沼泽沼桨镇的贸易巨头银罐。

english.title: The Bogpaddle Bullet
english.objectives: Speak with Sharon Boomgetter in the southeastern corner of Burning Steppes to ride the Bogpaddle Bullet to the Swamp of Sorrows.  Then speak with Trade Baron Silversnap in Bogpaddle.
english.description: You're quite the $r, aren't you?  Look at you... you're all grown up already.  And we only just met!$b$bI know how it'll go... soon you'll run out of things to do here at Flame Crest.  You'll promise to come back.  But you never will.$b$bKibler's seen it all before.$b$bWhen you do leave, talk to Sharon Boomgetter in the southeastern corner of the Steppes.  She'll give you a ride on the bullet.$b$bWhat?  Oh, it's just a rocket.  Perfectly safe.
english.completion: Time is money, $c... and I've got plenty of each. What can I do for you?
english.completed: Report to Trade Baron Silversnap at Bogpaddle in the Swamp of Sorrows.

text.title: 大酋长的命令：希尔斯布莱德丘陵！
text.objectives: 去找希尔斯布莱德丘陵南点大门的高级执行官达萨利亚。
text.description: 所有身强力壮的部落成员，从此刻起都要向希尔斯布莱德丘陵南点大门的高级执行官达萨利亚报到。被遗忘者的战争机器正在全力开动，为部落夺取洛丹伦！$B$B要前往南点大门，就沿着南边的路穿越银松森林，然后走东边的岔路进入希尔斯布莱德丘陵。$B$B前进吧，$g兄弟:姐妹;！命运在召唤！
text.completion: I was wondering when reinforcements would show up. Suit up, $n. It's time to dispense some justice!

english.title: Warchief's Command: Hillsbrad Foothills!
english.objectives: Report to High Executor Darthalia at Southpoint Gate in Hillsbrad Foothills.
english.description: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to High Executor Darthalia at Southpoint Gate in Hillsbrad Foothills. The Forsaken war machine marches ever onward, securing Lordaeron for the Horde!$B$BTo reach Southpoint Gate you must follow the road south through Silverpine Forest and take the east fork leading into Hillsbrad Foothills.$B$BOnward, $g brother:sister;! Destiny calls!
english.completion: I was wondering when reinforcements would show up. Suit up, $n. It's time to dispense some justice!

text.title: 大酋长的命令：阿拉希高地！
text.objectives: 去找阿拉希高地加林之陨的黑暗游侠阿莉娜。
text.description: 所有身强力壮的部落成员，从此刻起都要向加林之陨的黑暗游侠阿莉娜报到。黑暗女王的部队需要你们的帮助，以拓展部落的势力范围，并击退联盟入侵者。$B$B要前往阿拉希高地，就向希尔斯布莱德丘陵东部进发，穿过索拉丁之墙后沿着路继续走。$B$B命运在召唤！
text.completion: At last, the Warchief's reinforcements have arrived. The Dark Lady has plans for you, as she does for us.

english.title: Warchief's Command: Arathi Highlands!
english.objectives: Report to Dark Ranger Alina at Galen's Fall in Arathi Highlands.
english.description: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Dark Ranger Alina at Galen's Fall. The Dark Lady's forces need your help to expand the dominions of the Horde and drive back the Alliance interlopers.$B$BTo reach the Arathi Highlands, travel east from Hillsbrad Foothills and follow the road past Thoradin's Wall.$B$BDestiny calls!
english.completion: At last, the Warchief's reinforcements have arrived. The Dark Lady has plans for you, as she does for us.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：阿拉希高地！
text.objectives: 去找阿拉希高地避难谷地的尼艾丝队长。
text.description: 奉安度因·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，所有身强力壮的联盟公民都要向避难谷地的尼艾丝队长报到。$B$B激流堡古老的荣耀必须恢复！食人魔和歹徒已经玷污城中的街道太久了。从湿地向北方进发，穿过萨多尔大桥，进入阿拉希高地。沿着路抵达避难谷地，向队长报到。$B$B为了联盟的荣耀与骄傲！
text.completion: Would that you were a company, but we'll have to make do with with what we have.

english.title: Hero's Call: Arathi Highlands!
english.objectives: Report to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe in Arathi Highlands.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe.$B$BAncient Stromgarde's honor must be redeemed! Too long have ogres and criminals sullied its streets. Travel north from the Wetlands and cross the Than'dol Span to reach Arathi. Follow the road to Refuge Pointe and present yourself to the captain.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!
english.completion: Would that you were a company, but we'll have to make do with with what we have.

text.title: 大酋长的命令：辛特兰！
text.objectives: 去找辛特兰恶齿村的断齿长者。
text.description: 所有身强力壮的部落成员，从此刻起都要向恶齿村的断齿长者报到。$B$B眼下，蛮锤矮人已正式投靠联盟，因此他们就是我们的敌人。必须击败他们！$B$B要前往恶齿村，就从希尔斯布莱德丘陵东部穿越山地，进入辛特兰，然后一直走到东部的海岸边。$B$B命运在召唤！
text.completion: Have you come to help us against the Wildhammers? The Warchief knows that what happens here will be important to the Horde's future.

english.title: Warchief's Command: The Hinterlands!
english.objectives: Report to Elder Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands.
english.description: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Elder Torntusk at Revantusk Village.$B$BNow that the Wildhammer dwarves have officially thrown in their lot with the Alliance, they have made themselves our enemies. They must be defeated!$B$BTo reach Revanktusk Village, cross into the Hinterlands from the mountain pass in eastern Hillsbrad Foothills and make your way to the eastern coast.$B$BDestiny calls!
english.completion: Have you come to help us against the Wildhammers? The Warchief knows that what happens here will be important to the Horde's future.

text.title: 大酋长的命令：西瘟疫之地！
text.objectives: 去找西瘟疫之地安多哈尔的库尔迪拉·织亡者。
text.description: 所有身强力壮的部落成员，从此刻起都要向安多哈尔的库尔迪拉·织亡者报到。$B$B联盟部队正在进犯安多哈尔的废墟，妄图将其占为己有。我们必须在他们站稳脚跟之前，向他们发起反击！$B$B穿过提瑞斯法林地东部边境的亡灵壁垒，沿着路向东南进发，到安多哈尔与我们的部队会合。$B$B命运在召唤！
text.completion: Is this all the warchief can spare? Don't worry, you'll be put to good use.

english.title: Warchief's Command: Western Plaguelands!
english.objectives: Report to Koltira Deathweaver at Andorhal in the Western Plaguelands.
english.description: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Koltira Deathweaver at Andorhal.$B$BThe Alliance forces are advancing into the ruined city of Andorhal, seeking to claim it for themselves. We must counter their them before they can gain a foothold there!$B$BCross the Bulwark at the eastern end of Tirisfal Glades and follow the roads southest to Andorhal and meet up with our forces there.$B$BDestiny calls!
english.completion: Is this all the warchief can spare? Don't worry, you'll be put to good use.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：西瘟疫之地！
text.objectives: 去找西瘟疫之地安多哈尔的萨萨里安。
text.description: 奉安度因·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，联盟所有身强力壮的公民都要向安多哈尔的萨萨里安报到。$B$B我们在安多哈尔取得了初步的胜利，但被遗忘者准备立即发动反击。为了击退天灾军团和部落，夺回失陷的安多哈尔，你们的帮助是不可或缺的。$B$B从希尔斯布莱德丘陵向北进发，沿着寒风营地外的路继续向北，即可抵达安多哈尔。$B$B为了联盟的荣耀与骄傲！
text.completion: There is much to be done here. Both of our enemies are relentless and would slaughter us without mercy the moment we sheathe our blades.

english.title: Hero's Call: Western Plaguelands!
english.objectives: Report to Thassarian at Andorhal in the Western Plaguelands.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Thassarian at Andorhal.$B$BOn the heels of our early victories in Andorhal, the Forsaken have decided to launch a counterattack. Your help is needed to beat back the Scourge and Horde and reclaim lost Andorhal.$B$BTo reach Andorhal, travel north through the Hillsbrad Foothills and follow the road beyond Chillwind Camp.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!
english.completion: There is much to be done here. Both of our enemies are relentless and would slaughter us without mercy the moment we sheathe our blades.

text.title: 大酋长的命令：东瘟疫之地！
text.objectives: 去找东瘟疫之地索多里尔河东岸的菲奥拉。
text.description: 所有身强力壮的部落成员，从此刻起都要向索多里尔河东岸的菲奥拉报到。$B$B银色北伐军加强了部署在瘟疫之地的兵力，他们需要你们的帮助，以巩固胜利果实。$B$B前往西瘟疫之地的东岸，跨过索多里尔河，在另一边的河岸上寻找菲奥拉。$B$B命运在召唤！
text.completion: Perhaps you can help, $c.

english.title: Warchief's Command: Eastern Plaguelands!
english.objectives: Report to Fiona on the east bank of the Thondroril River in the Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Fiona on the east bank of the Thondroril River.$B$BThe Argent Crusade has reinforced its presence in the Plaguelands and it needs your help to consolidate its victories.$B$BCross the Thondroril River at the eastern border of the Western Plaguelands and look for Fiona on the far bank.$B$BDestiny calls!
english.completion: Perhaps you can help, $c.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：东瘟疫之地！
text.objectives: 去找东瘟疫之地索多里尔河东岸的菲奥拉。
text.description: 奉安度因·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，联盟所有身强力壮的公民都要向索多里尔河东岸的菲奥拉报到。$B$B银色北伐军需要你们的帮助，以从天灾军团手中夺回东瘟疫之地。$B$B要前往东瘟疫之地，只需从西瘟疫之地跨过索多里尔河，在东岸寻找菲奥拉即可。$B$B为了联盟的荣耀与骄傲！
text.completion: Perhaps you can help, $c.

english.title: Hero's Call: Eastern Plaguelands!
english.objectives: Report to Fiona on the eastern bank of the Thondroril River in the Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Fiona on the east bank of the Thondroril River.$B$BThe Argent Crusade needs your help to win back the Eastern Plaguelands from the grasp of the Scourge.$B$BTo reach the Eastern Plaguelands, cross the Thondroril River from the Western Plaguelands and look for Fiona on the eastern bank.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!
english.completion: Perhaps you can help, $c.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：荒芜之地！
text.objectives: 去找东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的格克·喷箭。
text.description: 奉安度因·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，联盟所有身强力壮的公民都要向东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的格克·喷箭报到。$B$B你们要协助调查死亡之翼造成的破坏，以及部落军队在荒芜之地的部署。$B$B作为你们提供帮助的交换条件，格克同意提供前往荒芜之地的运输火箭。到东瘟疫之地的圣光之愿礼拜堂去找他。$B$B为了联盟的荣耀与骄傲！
text.completion: You must be here to help Fuselight! Let's get you to the Badlands right away.

english.title: Hero's Call: Badlands!
english.objectives: Report to Gek Nozzlerocket at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Gek Nozzlerocket at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.$B$BYour help is needed to survey the damage done by Deathwing, and the disposition of Horde forces in the Badlands.$B$BGek has agreed to provide transportation to the Badlands via rocket, in exchange for your help. Look for him at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!
english.completion: You must be here to help Fuselight! Let's get you to the Badlands right away.

text.title: 大酋长的命令：荒芜之地！
text.objectives: 去找东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的格克·喷箭。
text.description: 所有身强力壮的部落成员，从此刻起都要向东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的格克·喷箭报到。$B$B联盟急切地妄图在荒芜之地建立根据地。你们的职责就是阻止他们，并了解死亡之翼对该地造成的破坏情况。$B$B格克已经同意将火箭作为前往荒芜之地的交通工具。到圣光之愿礼拜堂去找他。$B$B命运在召唤！
text.completion: Sure, I can get you to the Badlands, but when you get there, I want you to agree to help my comrades.

english.title: Warchief's Command: Badlands!
english.objectives: Report to Gek Nozzlerocket at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Gek Nozzlerocket at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.$B$BThe Alliance is desperate to gain a foothold in the Badlands. Your duty will be to keep them at bay and learn about the destruction wrought by Deathwing.$B$BGek has agreed to provide transportation to the Badlands by rocket. Meet with him at Light's Hope Chapel.$B$BDestiny calls!
english.completion: Sure, I can get you to the Badlands, but when you get there, I want you to agree to help my comrades.

text.title: 大酋长的命令：灼热峡谷！
text.objectives: 去找灼热峡谷瑟银前哨的杰克·岩腿。
text.description: 所有身强力壮的部落成员，从此刻起都要向瑟银前哨的杰克·岩腿报到。$B$B碎手氏族的报告称，灼热峡谷的黑铁矮人可能正在筹划某个阴谋。你们的职责是尽可能多的了解他们的计划，并阻止它。$B$B沿着荒芜之地西边的路，即可进入灼热峡谷。$B$B命运在召唤！
text.completion: We, too, are suspicious of the Dark Irons' recent activities.

english.title: Warchief's Command: Searing Gorge!
english.objectives: Report to Jack Rockleg at Thorium Advance in the Searing Gorge.
english.description: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Jack Rockleg at Thorium Advance.$B$BThe Shattered Hand reports that the Dark Iron dwarves of the Searing Gorge seem to be preparing for something. Your duty is to learn all you can about their scheming and put a halt to it.$B$BYou can reach the Searing Gorge by following the road west from the Badlands.$B$BDestiny calls!
english.completion: We, too, are suspicious of the Dark Irons' recent activities.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：灼热峡谷！
text.objectives: 去找灼热峡谷瑟银前哨的杰克·岩腿。
text.description: 奉安度因·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，联盟所有身强力壮的公民都要向瑟银前哨的杰克·岩腿报到。$B$B军情七处的报告称，灼热峡谷的黑铁矮人可能正在筹划一场进攻。你们的职责是尽可能多的了解他们的计划，并阻止它。$B$B沿着荒芜之地西边的路，即可进入灼热峡谷。$B$B为了联盟的光辉与荣耀！
text.completion: We, too, are suspicious of the Dark Irons.

english.title: Hero's Call: Searing Gorge!
english.objectives: Report to Jack Rockleg at Thorium Advance in the Searing Gorge.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Jack Rockleg at Thorium Advance.$B$BSI:7 reports that the Dark Iron dwarves of the Searing Gorge seem to be preparing to attack. Your duty is to learn all you can about their scheming and put a halt to it.$B$BYou can reach the Searing Gorge by following the road west from the Badlands.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!
english.completion: We, too, are suspicious of the Dark Irons.

text.title: 卡拉兹工坊
text.objectives: 把专利申请书交给暮光高地卡拉兹工坊的卡拉兹船长。
text.description: 新伐木机的设计是一流的，$n。一流的！下一步要保护我的知识产权。要登记专利，注册商标，强制禁令。哦，还有贿赂！$B$B给，把这份专利申请书交给卡拉兹工坊的卡拉兹船长。他从飞艇失事中幸存了下来，因此多半急于寻求新的商机。$B$B卡拉兹工坊就在正北方，位于一座绝对安全的山峰上。去吧，孩子。快快快！
text.progress: I know you! You were on the Zeppelin with me on the way in.
text.completion: What's this? The "$n-o-matic:" a shredder with an integrated missile platform? Bah! Already patented by Labor Captain Grabbit in Azshara. Worthless! What I really need is a machine that knocks dwarves from the sky.
text.completed: 把专利申请书交给暮光高地卡拉兹工坊的卡拉兹船长。

english.title: Krazzworks
english.objectives: Take the Patent Application to Captain Krazz at the Krazzworks in Twilight Highlands.
english.description: This new shredder design is tops, $n. Tops! Next step is to protect my intellectual property. There are patents to file, traders to mark, ceases to desist. Oh, and the bribes!$B$BHere, take this patent application to Captain Krazz at the Krazzworks. He survived the destruction of his zeppelin, so he's probably hungry for new business opportunities.$B$BThe Krazzworks is due north of here, atop a perfectly safe mountain peak. Go ahead, kid. Chop chop!
english.progress: I know you! You were on the Zeppelin with me on the way in.
english.completion: What's this? The "$n-o-matic:" a shredder with an integrated missile platform? Bah! Already patented by Labor Captain Grabbit in Azshara. Worthless! What I really need is a machine that knocks dwarves from the sky.
english.completed: Take the Patent Application to Captain Krazz at the Krazzworks in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 豆腐渣工程
text.objectives: 用爆破胶带封住10个故障阀门。
text.description: 瞧这儿，老大，要不是对面的这个白痴，卡拉兹工坊本来好好的一点事都没有。$B$B算大家倒霉，“闪花眼”罗斯曼决定把地方造在山顶上！说真的，谁会那么干？$B$B于是，由于故障阀门，我们这儿到处都是泄漏。你能不能用这个爆破胶带帮我把它们都封上？
text.completion: There you go. Now hows about we use this blast tape on Rothman's mouth?
text.completed: Return to Brett the Bomber at the Krazzworks in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Quality Construction
english.objectives: Use the Blast Tape to seal 10 Faulty Valves.
english.description: Look here, chief, if it weren't for this bumbly idiot across from me, the Krazzworks would be holding up just fine.$B$BUnfortunately for everyone involved, "Fancypants" Rothman here decided to deploy the place on top of a mountain! I mean really, who does that?$B$BSo, we got leaks all over the place due to faulty valves. Think you could take this blast tape and seal 'em up for me?
english.completion: There you go. Now hows about we use this blast tape on Rothman's mouth?
english.completed: Return to Brett the Bomber at the Krazzworks in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 池塘小马大营救
text.objectives: 用池塘小马营救10名落水的卡拉兹工坊劳工。
text.description: 对面的这个白痴会把我们所有人都害死的！$B$B“捣蛋机”布雷特把卡拉兹工坊建错了地方，现在它极度不稳定。由此导致的爆炸正把我们的工人从平台上掀到下面的水里。$B$B你介不介意飞下去用池塘小马把他们给救上来，$n？
text.completion: Thanks, $n! Now if we could just get the Krazzworks stable so that our people would stop being thrown off of the platforms.
text.completed: Return to Flashbang Rothman at the Krazzworks in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Pool Pony Rescue
english.objectives: Use the Pool Ponies to rescue 10 Krazzworks Laborers that have fallen into the water.
english.description: This jerk across from me is getting all of our people killed!$B$BBrett "the Bummer" unpacked the Krazzworks in the wrong place and now it's highly unstable. The explosions from the instability are throwing our laborers off of the platforms and into the water below.$B$BYou don't mind flying down there and rescuing them with some pool ponies, $n?
english.completion: Thanks, $n! Now if we could just get the Krazzworks stable so that our people would stop being thrown off of the platforms.
english.completed: Return to Flashbang Rothman at the Krazzworks in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 霜狼的帮助
text.objectives: 跟希尔斯布莱德丘陵奥特兰克山脉的沃加·死爪谈一谈。
text.description: 我会研究雷矛作战计划，并做好战斗的准备。我要你前往奥特兰克山谷，寻求霜狼氏族的帮助：也就是前任酋长萨尔的氏族。他们会帮助我们对付雷矛矮人的！我们将携手作战，击退入侵者并将他们永远地逐出洛丹伦！$B$B出发吧，$n。奥特兰克山谷就在塔伦米尔的东北方。去找沃加·死爪，告诉他部落需要霜狼氏族的帮助！$B$B胜利！
text.completion: You come from Tarren Mill? You reek of death...

english.title: Aid of the Frostwolf
english.objectives: Speak to Voggah Deathgrip at Alterac Mountains in Hillsbrad Foothills.
english.description: I will study the Stormpike battle plans and prepare for an assault. I need you to go to Alterac Valley and enlist the aid of the Frostwolf Clan: the very clan of our former warchief, Thrall. They will help us battle the Stormpike dwarves! Together, we will crush the invaders and see them driven out of Lordaeron for good!$B$BGo now, $n. Alterac Valley is northeast of Tarren Mill. Find Voggah Deathgrip and tell him that the Horde requires the aid of the Frostwolf!$B$BLOK'TAR!
english.completion: You come from Tarren Mill? You reek of death...

text.title: 蛮锤进犯
text.objectives: 消灭10名蛮锤劫掠者。
text.description: 这两个白痴在争论到底是谁把这儿弄得一团糟的时候，卡拉兹工坊遭到了全面进攻！$B$B到处都是那些可恶的蛮锤矮人。出去把那些浑身酒臭的害虫给清理掉。
text.completion: You got the chops for killing dwarves, that's for sure, $n. This is a good thing. Next up, more dwarf slayage!
text.completed: Return to Captain Krazz at the Krazzworks in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Wildhammer Infestation
english.objectives: Slay 10 Wildhammer Raiders.
english.description: While these two idiots argue about who royally messed up here, we've got a full-scale invasion of the Krazzworks taking place!$B$BThose no-good Wildhammer are all over the place. Get out there and clear the Krazzworks of those smelly ale-guzzling pests.
english.completion: You got the chops for killing dwarves, that's for sure, $n. This is a good thing. Next up, more dwarf slayage!
english.completed: Return to Captain Krazz at the Krazzworks in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 除了厨房里的洗脸盆什么都有
text.objectives: 消灭15名蛮锤雷爪狮鹫。
text.description: 那些蛮锤雷爪狮鹫你得想想办法。他们要把我们干掉啦！$B$B问题是，我们没弹药了，所以我们得动动脑筋。我们把什么东西都塞到卡拉兹加农炮里去了：池塘小马、卡亚可乐罐、饭盒、燃料桶、轮胎……你就想吧。$B$B基本上，除了厨房里的洗脸盆什么都有。$B$B喜欢打靶吗？
text.completion: That's the spirit! Must be pretty humiliating being shot down by junk.
text.completed: Return to Captain Krazz at the Krazzworks in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Everything But the Kitchen Sink
english.objectives: Slay 15 Wildhammer Stormtalons.
english.description: You gotta do something about them Wildhammer Stormtalons. They're tearing us up!$B$BProblem is, we're out of ammo, so we had to improvise. We loaded up my Krazz Cannons with all kinds of stuff: pool ponies, Kaja'Cola cans, food containers, fuelcells, tires... you get the picture.$B$BBasically, everything but the kitchen sink.$B$BThink you're in the mood for some target practice?
english.completion: That's the spirit! Must be pretty humiliating being shot down by junk.
english.completed: Return to Captain Krazz at the Krazzworks in the Twilight Highlands.

objectiveDetails.description: 跳上一门卡拉兹加农炮

text.title: 报复
text.objectives: 跟滩头堡上空裂天号的补丁谈一谈。
text.description: 我碰巧知道联盟的人渣得到了某样东西，某样属于我们的东西。我已经授权对滩头堡发动全面进攻。$B$B搭乘裂天号加入战斗，你到了以后补丁会告诉你细节。
text.completion: Good to have you, $n. Ready to sew some chaos?

english.title: Reprisal
english.objectives: Speak to Patch aboard the Skyshredder circling Highbank.
english.description: I happen to know some Alliance scum that have somethin' coming to them. And they have something that belongs to us. I've authorized an all out assault on Highbank.$B$BBoard the Skyshredder and join the assault. Patch will fill you in on the details as you arrive.
english.completion: Good to have you, $n. Ready to sew some chaos?

text.title: 打下来
text.objectives: 用裂天炮台解决80名滩头堡神射手、12名滩头堡炮手，以及4门滩头堡加农炮。
text.description: 你看起来像是一个能打的$g小伙子:姑娘;。找台炮塔，把他们城墙上的防御都打掉。$B$B动作要快，好不好？不然我们就要变成一个大火球啦。
text.completion: Marvels of modernized goblin destructivity, eh? I love these babies.
text.completed: Speak to Patch aboard the Skyshredder circling Highbank in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Off The Wall
english.objectives: Kill 80 Highbank Marksman, 12 Highbank Cannoneers, and 4 Highbank Cannons with a Skyshredder Turret.
english.description: You look like a $gman:girl; who likes some action. Get on one of those turrets and lay waste to their defenses on the wall.$B$BBe quick about it, will you? Before we go up in a big ball of fire preferably.
english.completion: Marvels of modernized goblin destructivity, eh? I love these babies.
english.completed: Speak to Patch aboard the Skyshredder circling Highbank in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 饯别礼
text.objectives: 在船上、要塞入口处，以及北部的一座高塔上设置炸弹。
text.description: 我肯定补丁心里自有计划，不过说到进攻，把炸弹忘记可不应该。$B$B去船上、要塞的入口，还有其中一座北部高塔上设置炸药。这就应该够他们喝一壶的了。$B$B我们也要到地面去。你完事之后到东部高塔来找我们吧。
text.completion: Hahah! Wonderful show. That should be a proper welcome to the highlands.
text.completed: Find Ticker near the eastern tower of Highbank in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Parting Packages
english.objectives: Set bombs on the boat, in the keep entrance, and in one of the northern towers.
english.description: I'm sure Patch has some grand scheme in mind, but this wouldn't be an assault if we didn't leave some explosive presents behind.$B$BGet down there and plant some of these explosives on the boat, in the keep entrance, and in one of those northern towers. That should be enough to leave them reeling.$B$BWe're heading down to the ground as well. Meet us at the eastern tower when you're through.
english.completion: Hahah! Wonderful show. That should be a proper welcome to the highlands.
english.completed: Find Ticker near the eastern tower of Highbank in the Twilight Highlands.

objectiveDetails.description: 在滩头堡船只上设置炸弹
在滩头堡要塞上设置炸弹
在滩头堡高塔上设置炸弹

text.title: 至关重要
text.objectives: 夺回感应主动式负载平衡器。
text.description: 加尔鲁什的飞艇掉下来的时候，你在艾萨拉帮我们找到的感应主动式负载平衡器也在上面。联盟把它放在要塞里的某个地方，而卡拉兹想把它拿回来。$B$B东西很有可能在要塞的地下室，不妨从那儿找起。拿到之后，就到东部高塔附近来找我们。
text.progress: Krazz is waitin'. Keep it moving.
text.completion: Brilliant! Krazz will love you something mighty for bringing this one home. Good on you.
text.completed: Find Patch near the eastern Highbank tower in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Of Utmost Importance
english.objectives: Recover the Induction Samophlange.
english.description: When Garrosh's zeppelin went down, so did the induction samophlange that you recovered for us in Azshara. The Alliance have it somewhere in that keep, and Krazz wants it back.$B$BThe basement of the keep would be my best guess, so start there. When you get your hands on it, bring it back to me near the eastern tower.
english.progress: Krazz is waitin'. Keep it moving.
english.completion: Brilliant! Krazz will love you something mighty for bringing this one home. Good on you.
english.completed: Find Patch near the eastern Highbank tower in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 滩头堡，伤心堡
text.objectives: 杀死10名滩头堡防御者。
text.description: 下去给那些联盟渣滓好看。不管是谁都行。我只想要他们抱头鼠窜，这样你才能瞄准真正的目标。$B$B完事后到东部高塔附近来找我们。
text.completion: And that's how it's done. Scattered to the wind. Not quite the fighting force they boast themselves to be, eh?
text.completed: Find Patch near the eastern Highbank tower in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Highbank, Crybank
english.objectives: Kill 10 Highbank defenders.
english.description: Get down there and make a mess of those Alliance rabble. Any of'm will do. I just want'm scattered while you're in there after the real target.$B$BFind us near the eastern tower when you're done.
english.completion: And that's how it's done. Scattered to the wind. Not quite the fighting force they boast themselves to be, eh?
english.completed: Find Patch near the eastern Highbank tower in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 卡拉兹又回来啦！
text.objectives: 跟蝾螈谈一谈，飞回卡拉兹工坊，然后将感应主动式负载平衡器交给卡拉兹船长。
text.description: 就是这样。我们都收拾好了。咱们出发。$B$B蝾螈搞到了一些旋翼机，就拴在塔顶。去找她，飞回卡拉兹工坊。我们将在那里大干一场。
text.progress: Tell me you came through? You always come through. Show me my beauty!
text.completion: Now that's what I wanted to see! I'll have this fleet back up in no time with this beauty. You know just how I like it, $n. I know just how you like it too - take this.

english.title: Krazz Works!
english.objectives: Speak to Newt to secure a ride back to Krazzworks, then give the Induction Samophlange to Captain Krazz.
english.description: That's it. We're all wrapped up. Let's ship out.$B$BNewt's got some gyrocopters tethered at the top of the tower. Go meet up with her for a quick trip back to Krazzworks. We'll mop up here.
english.progress: Tell me you came through? You always come through. Show me my beauty!
english.completion: Now that's what I wanted to see! I'll have this fleet back up in no time with this beauty. You know just how I like it, $n. I know just how you like it too - take this.

text.title: 欢迎来到滩头堡！
text.objectives: 在滩头堡消灭10名部落进犯者。
text.description: 欢迎来到滩头堡，士兵。你来得正是时候。$B$B部落大军刚刚从空中发动了一场攻势。做好准备，参加战斗。把他们都干掉！
text.completion: That's more like it. We should be able to mop this up from here.
text.completed: Return to Lieutenant Fawkes at Highbank in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Welcome to Highbank!
english.objectives: Kill 10 Horde attackers within Highbank.
english.description: Welcome to the highlands, soldier. You're here just in time.$B$BHorde troops just launched an assault from the air. Step up and do something about it. Clear them out!
english.completion: That's more like it. We should be able to mop this up from here.
english.completed: Return to Lieutenant Fawkes at Highbank in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 两头难
text.objectives: 收集满满10袋炮用火药。
text.description: 哈！我们得马上行动，$n。看来滩头堡遇到了所谓的飞艇问题：那艘飞船把城墙都快打烂了。$B$B听着，我有一个堪称天才的馊主意。我需要一点炮用火药。$B$B尽你所能在滩头堡帮我找些，然后到交易区去找我。
text.progress: I need more powder! Get me more powder! More more more!
text.completion: Aye, that'll do 'er. Ohhh, fresh. Heady. Redridge fine grain with a hint of Westfall sulphur and a mild aftertaste. Highbank gets the good stuff.
text.completed: Find Fargo Flintlocke in western Highbank in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Burnin' at Both Ends
english.objectives: Collect 10 bags full of Cannon Powder.
english.description: Har! We get to jump right inta the action, $n. Looks like Highbank has whatcha call a zeppelin problem: that airship is poundin' the crap outta the walls.$B$BListen, I've got me an idear so stupid it's genius. I just need some cannon powder.$B$BCollect as much as you can find around Highbank an' meet me by the trade area!
english.progress: I need more powder! Get me more powder! More more more!
english.completion: Aye, that'll do 'er. Ohhh, fresh. Heady. Redridge fine grain with a hint of Westfall sulphur and a mild aftertaste. Highbank gets the good stuff.
english.completed: Find Fargo Flintlocke in western Highbank in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 瞄准高空
text.objectives: 等法戈·弗林特洛克把你送上飞艇，然后将他的炸药安放在底舱。
text.description: 瞧这儿，$n。我找到了一把滩头堡最大的枪！我们要尝试一下这个技术玩意，它是我爸爸的爸爸的爸爸传给我爸爸的爸爸，然后传给我的爸爸，然后传给了我。在那之后不久他就被炸上了天。$B$B这东西的名字叫做“$c炮”。$B$B你找一个$r$c，把$g他:她;装到一门巨炮里，然后放轻松。通常都管用。$B$B拿好这些炸药，然后在我身边等着。一旦那艘飞船过来，我就把你打到甲板上去。将炸药安在她的肚子底下，然后呢，哦，我不知道，你就即兴发挥吧。
text.progress: Ain't no problem a bomb can't solve.
text.completion: Oh, $n. $n! That ... were beautiful.
text.completed: Return to Fargo Flintlocke within Highbank in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Aiming High
english.objectives: Wait for Fargo Flintlocke to get you onto the zeppelin and then set his explosives in its lower chamber.
english.description: Lookie here, $n. I found the biggest gun in Highbank! We're gonna try a technique handed down ta me by my pappy, from his pappy, from his pappy, shortly before he got blowed up.$B$BIt's called the "$c-shot."$B$BYou take a $r $c, and load $ghim:her; inta a gigantic cannon, and then ya - oh relax. This usually works.$B$BTake these explosives, then wait here next ta me. As soon as that blimpy comes around I'll blast you onto tha deck. Plant the explosives in 'er belly and, oh I dunno, make it up as you go.
english.progress: Ain't no problem a bomb can't solve.
english.completion: Oh, $n. $n! That ... were beautiful.
english.completed: Return to Fargo Flintlocke within Highbank in the Twilight Highlands.

objectiveDetails.description: 等着从弗林特洛克的火炮里被发射出去

text.title: 库德兰在等待
text.objectives: 跟暮光高地滩头堡要塞里的库德兰·蛮锤谈一谈。
text.description: 看来进攻停止了，$n，真可惜，因为我们没机会使用$c火箭了。$B$B不管怎么说，库德兰·蛮锤在要塞的上面，我确定他会给你一个英雄般的欢迎。这是你应得的！去跟他谈谈。$B$B我要前去侦察一下海滩。
text.completion: The King himself sent you? Good to hear that Stormwind is secure. I was expecting more in the way of troops, but word is that the Alliance fleet was ambushed by the Horde on the way here. They gave as good as they got, but the fleet is in shambles. If we're to make any forward progress here in the Highlands, we're going to need the help of heroes like you.

english.title: Kurdran's Waitin'
english.objectives: Speak to Kurdran Wildhammer inside of the Highbank Keep in Twilight Highlands.
english.description: It looks like the attack stopped, $n. Which is a shame, 'cuz we never got to use the $c-rocket.$B$BAnyways, Kurdran Wildhammer is up in the top of the keep an' I'm sure he'll be wantin' to gives ya a hero's welcome. Yeh earned it! Go talk to 'im!$B$BI'll move on ahead and scout out the beach.
english.completion: The King himself sent you? Good to hear that Stormwind is secure. I was expecting more in the way of troops, but word is that the Alliance fleet was ambushed by the Horde on the way here. They gave as good as they got, but the fleet is in shambles. If we're to make any forward progress here in the Highlands, we're going to need the help of heroes like you.

text.title: 忠诚问题
text.objectives: 跟德雷克塔尔谈一谈。
text.description: 我没权过问这种事宜。你得跟我们的首领德雷克塔尔谈谈。我已经将你造访的消息通报到霜狼要塞了。德雷克塔尔将亲自跟你交谈。
text.completion: THEY HAVE FORSAKEN US? THEY HAVE FORSAKEN THE HORDE? This cannot be! I... I... I WILL BE FINE. We will do this without their aid. To hell with the Frostwolf!
text.completed: 去找希尔斯布莱德塔伦米尔的高阶督军克鲁姆什。

english.title: Matters of Loyalty
english.objectives: Speak to Drek'Thar.
english.description: I have no authority over such matters. You must speak to our leader, Drek'Thar. I have already sent word of your arrival to Frostwolf Keep. Drek'Thar will be out to speak with you personally.
english.completion: THEY HAVE FORSAKEN US? THEY HAVE FORSAKEN THE HORDE? This cannot be! I... I... I WILL BE FINE. We will do this without their aid. To hell with the Frostwolf!
english.completed: Return to High Warlord Cromush at Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 做好准备
text.objectives: 收集6根断绳。
text.description: 每个脑子正常的冒险者都知道，如果没有足够长的绳子，就不要进入进入洞穴、地牢、寝陵或古墓的地方……对吧？$b$b嗯，我的绳子就在你刚刚炸掉的那辆装满炸药的车上。$b$b你不如去周围找找看有没有绳子。
text.progress: How goes the search?
text.completion: Something tells me I'm going to need this.
text.completed: Speak with Harrison Jones in the Chamber of the Stars.

english.title: Be Prepared
english.objectives: Collect 6 Rope Pieces.
english.description: Every adventurer worth their salt knows never to step foot in a cave, dungeon, crypt or tomb without an ample supply of rope... right?$b$bWell, mine was in that wagon full of explosives that you set off.$b$bHow about searching around here and seeing if you can't find some.
english.progress: How goes the search?
english.completion: Something tells me I'm going to need this.
english.completed: Speak with Harrison Jones in the Chamber of the Stars.

text.title: 深入敌后
text.objectives: 杀死教官鲁夫斯、教官玛格纳斯和渣胡队长。
text.description: 接下来，我要你去西边的山头营地，潜入雷矛矮人的训练场。那里有数以百计的新兵，但是我手下的女妖会将你伪装成我们抓获的人类俘虏的模样，让你顺利地深入敌后。$B$B进入山头营地，找到雷矛训导师并迫使他们与你战斗！杀掉他们。训导师一死，雷矛矮人就没法再训练新兵了！
text.completion: Perfectly handled. You could easily be a Deathstalker. And what could they have even done to you? You acted in self defense! Now to deal with the final finger.
text.completed: Speak to Melisara at Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills.
text.giverWindow: 离间他们。

english.title: Infiltration
english.objectives: Kill Instructor Rufus, Drill Sergeant Magnus and Captain Crudbeard.
english.description: For your next mission I want you to travel west to the Headland and infiltrate the Stormpike training grounds. Though there are hundreds of Stormpike trainees there, one of my banshees will disguise you to look like one of the humans captured earlier, allowing you to walk freely among the enemy.$B$BEnter the Headland and find the Stormpike instructors. Once found, coerce them into attacking you! When they attack, kill them. With their instructors dead, they will be unable to train more soldiers!
english.completion: Perfectly handled. You could easily be a Deathstalker. And what could they have even done to you? You acted in self defense! Now to deal with the final finger.
english.completed: Speak to Melisara at Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills.
english.giverWindow: Turn them against each other.

text.title: 圈套与计谋
text.objectives: 使用水桶削弱30名雷矛新兵。
text.description: 只要我还在你身边，敌人就会认为你是他们的一员。但是人类幻象非常脆弱，不容许任何闪失。一旦你转移到本体意识，就会引起矮人的怀疑，很可能遭到攻击！$B$B所以，我想了个法子。带上这桶掺了药剂的水，让疲惫的雷矛新兵饮下解渴。这种药剂将极大地削弱他们的战斗力。
text.completion: They won't die immediately, but they WILL die! When they finally piece together who was responsible for the deaths of their soldiers, you will be long gone - a phantom of death!
text.completed: Speak to Lilith in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: Deception and Trickery
english.objectives: Use the Barrel of Water to Poison 30 Stormpike Trainees.
english.description: As long as I am by your side the enemy will think of you as one of their own. Your newfound humanity, however, will not allow you to be reckless. If you draw attention to yourself the dwarves will grow suspicious and likely attack!$B$BWith that said, I have a plan. Take this barrel of poisoned water and use it to sate the thirst of the tired Stormpike trainees. Once they drink from it they will become deathly ill, eventually succumbing to the poison.
english.completion: They won't die immediately, but they WILL die! When they finally piece together who was responsible for the deaths of their soldiers, you will be long gone - a phantom of death!
english.completed: Speak to Lilith in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 控制权
text.objectives: 杀死10名雷矛工程师。
text.description: <梅里萨拉的思绪侵入了你的脑海。>$B$B最后，我们要攻击加文高地的工程技师，就在山头营地以西。前往最后一处驻军山峰，除掉制造战争器械的矮人和侏儒工程师。记得要放下克鲁姆什的袖珍核弹。
text.completion: With the Stormpike forces maimed, the time has come for detonation!
text.completed: Return to Melisara at Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills.
text.giverWindow: 杀戮带来胜利！

english.title: Domination
english.objectives: Kill 10 Stormpike Engineers.
english.description: <Melisara's thoughts intermingle with your thoughts.>$B$BThe last task will be an assault against the siege technicians of Gavin's Naze, located west of the Headland. Venture to the final finger and lay waste to the dwarf and gnome engineers that build and fortify the Stormpike machines of war. Be sure to plant Cromush's final pocket-nuke as well.
english.completion: With the Stormpike forces maimed, the time has come for detonation!
english.completed: Return to Melisara at Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills.
english.giverWindow: Domination leads to victory!

text.title: The Keys to the Hot Rod

english.title: The Keys to the Hot Rod

text.title: 改装跑车的钥匙
text.completion:
You lost your Keys to the Hot Rod somewhere?

No problem, boss. I always like to keep a spare set handy just in case.

english.title: The Keys to the Hot Rod
english.completion:
You lost your Keys to the Hot Rod somewhere?

No problem, boss. I always like to keep a spare set handy just in case.

text.title: 灰影墓穴
text.objectives: 从丧钟镇的灰影墓穴中拿取粘稠的防腐剂和缝尸麻线。
text.description: 很高兴看到你又站起来走动了，$n。你的身体状况不错，尤其是在死了这么久的情况下！$b$b其他人就没这么幸运了。如果你不介意的话，我要你帮我拿点防腐液和缝尸线来，以便我缝合尸体。这两样东西都在灰影墓穴里，就是我身后的这座建筑物。$b$b来，达内尔跟你一起去。他知道怎么走。
text.progress: You will find the items within the Shadow Grave.  I believe I left them on my work table.
text.completion: Exactly what I needed.  You'll be an asset to the Forsaken, $n. You know, word has it that you were quite the $c in your previous life.  Perhaps I should assign you to a more exciting task.
text.completed: Return to Undertaker Mordo at the Deathknell Graveyards in Deathknell.

english.title: The Shadow Grave
english.objectives: Obtain the Thick Embalming Fluid and the Corpse-Stitching Twine from the Shadow Grave in Deathknell.
english.description: I'm pleased to see that you're up and walking around, $n.  You've held up nicely, especially after being dead for so long!$b$bOthers weren't as lucky.  If you wouldn't mind, I need you to fetch my embalming fluid and some twine to stitch up these bodies.  You'll find both in the Shadow Grave, the building just behind me.$b$bHere, Darnell will join you.  He knows the way.
english.progress: You will find the items within the Shadow Grave.  I believe I left them on my work table.
english.completion: Exactly what I needed.  You'll be an asset to the Forsaken, $n. You know, word has it that you were quite the $c in your previous life.  Perhaps I should assign you to a more exciting task.
english.completed: Return to Undertaker Mordo at the Deathknell Graveyards in Deathknell.

text.title: 该抡起锤子了！
text.objectives: 跟迪兹·石爆谈一谈。
text.description: 数周来，我们三人一直在争论谁的武器最厉害。$B$B谁敢说我的锤子排名第二，哼哼。基尔拉姆的斧头和瑟里尔的剑怎么能跟我亲手打造的纯力量武器相比呢。$B$B我厌倦了无休止的争吵。我决定演示一番，好让他们俩心服口服。亲爱的，请你去外面找迪兹·石爆，告诉他我需要一块最大的漂石！
text.completion: Lilith wants a boulder moved inside the observatory, eh? That's my business: consolidated materials. I usually don't get individual buyers, but hey, I won't ask questions.

english.title: Hammer Time
english.objectives: Speak with Deez Rocksnitch.
english.description: The three of us have been arguing for weeks over whose weapons are superior.$B$BI won't let anyone tell me my maces are second best. Kilram's axes and Seril's swords could never match the pure strength of my craft.$B$BI'm tired of arguing. It's time to show those two I'm right with a demonstration. If you would, dear, head outside and tell Deez Rocksnitch that I need the biggest boulder he can find!
english.completion: Lilith wants a boulder moved inside the observatory, eh? That's my business: consolidated materials. I usually don't get individual buyers, but hey, I won't ask questions.

text.title: 石料短缺
text.objectives: 从霜岩滚石元素身上收集6块大块粗石。
text.description: 如果你想搞块大石头进去，你可以使用我的专利产品盒装巨石！通常我就直接卖给你啦，但现在我没材料了。$B$B镇子南边的山坡上有许多土元素。它们出产丰富的石料。如果你能取一些回来，帮我补充原料储备的话，我就免费送你一台盒装巨石！
text.progress: You got that rubble?
text.completion: Looks like a good amount! Here's your pay, as promised...
text.completed: Return to Deez Rocksnitch at Everlook in Winterspring.

english.title: Rubble Trouble
english.objectives: Collect 6 Prime Rubble Chunks from Frostshard Rumblers.
english.description: If you want to get a boulder in there, you can use my own patented Boulder-in-a-Box! Normally I'd just sell you one up front, but I'm fresh out of materials.$B$BEarth elementals have been popping up on the peak directly south of town. They're a good source of rubble. If you bring me back a good amount, I'll pay you for the restock, and I'll throw in a Boulder-in-a-Box absolutely free!
english.progress: You got that rubble?
english.completion: Looks like a good amount! Here's your pay, as promised...
english.completed: Return to Deez Rocksnitch at Everlook in Winterspring.

text.title: 污染者的仪式
text.objectives: 去深暗洞穴阻止尼斐塞特仪式。
text.description: 啊，我已经觉得它变清澈了，$n。$B$B留意尼斐塞特人总是没错的。我能够感觉到就是他们污染了河水。$B$B再到水下去一次，前往深暗洞穴。你可以发现尼斐塞特人正在举行邪恶的污染仪式。$B$B阻止他们，让河水再度得到净化。
text.completion: The waters of the river are nearly cleansed.  Our prophetic visions will soon return.
text.completed: Return to High Priest Amet at the Vir'Naal Dam in Uldum.

english.title: The Defilers' Ritual
english.objectives: Stop the Neferset Ritual at the Murkdeep Cavern.
english.description: Ah, I can already see more clearly, $n.$B$BWe are right to be wary of the evil Neferset.  I can already sense that they're behind the forces that corrupt the river.$B$BGo underwater once more and find the Murkdeep Cavern.  You will find the Neferset are performing a foul ritual of corruption.$B$BStop them so the river is cleansed once again.
english.completion: The waters of the river are nearly cleansed.  Our prophetic visions will soon return.
english.completed: Return to High Priest Amet at the Vir'Naal Dam in Uldum.

text.title: 哈里森·琼斯与奥丹姆神殿
text.objectives: 获得应许约柜。
text.description: 在经历了这么多事之后，一切似乎都要水落石出了！$b$b我们离箱子只有一步之遥……我已经研究过打开它的密码……司克诺兹以为我们已经死了。$b$b你知道吗，我们终于要成功了！
text.completion: Lucky fer you, this ol' dwarf's still got a few tricks up his sleeve! Heehee! ...shoulda seen tha look on yer faces!
text.completed: Speak with Brann Bronzebeard at the Temple of Uldum.

english.title: Harrison Jones and the Temple of Uldum
english.objectives: Recover the Coffer of Promise.
english.description: After all we've been through, it looks like everything's actually coming together!$b$bWe're just steps away from the coffer... I've researched the codes to reveal it... Schnottz thinks we're dead....$b$bYou know, we might just pull this off after all!
english.completion: Lucky fer you, this ol' dwarf's still got a few tricks up his sleeve! Heehee! ...shoulda seen tha look on yer faces!
english.completed: Speak with Brann Bronzebeard at the Temple of Uldum.

text.title: 另一边见！
text.objectives: 与奥丹姆造物主高地顶端的哈里森·琼斯交谈。
text.description: 好了，$n。我们有了一点喘息之机，但时间已经不多了。$b$b跟着我！
text.completion: So far, so good...

english.title: See You on the Other Side!
english.objectives: Speak to Harrison Jones at the top of Maker's Ascent in Uldum.
english.description: Alright, $n. We've bought ourselves a little breathing room, but there's no time to lose.$b$bFollow me!
english.completion: So far, so good...

text.title: 狂暴熊怪
text.objectives: 杀死狂暴者格罗尔纳。
text.description: 冬泉酋长之死对于冬泉熊怪的狂暴毫无抑制作用。在他消失之后，部族中最强大的战士登上了掌握恐怖力量的至高位置。$B$B狂暴者格罗尔纳潜伏在寒水村顶部的洞穴中，吞下了剂量多得足以杀死十个普通熊怪的火酒。$B$B他变成了一只浮肿而可怕的怪兽！我们的战士无法对抗他……你有没有击败他的能力呢，$c？
text.completion: Your actions prove yourself a mighty warrior to me and all the Timbermaw! Let us hope the Winterfall will be defeated for good now...
text.completed: Return to Burndl near Winterfall Village in Winterspring.
text.giverWindow: 狂饮了堕落的冬泉火酒之后，他的力量压倒所有熊怪。

english.title: Bearzerker
english.objectives: Slay Grolnar the Berserk.
english.description: High Chieftain Winterfall's absence has done little to quell the rage of the Winterfall. In his absence, their greatest warrior has rose to a position of terrible power.$B$BGrolnar the Berserk lurks in the cave at the top of Winterfall Village, gorged on enough corrupt firewater to kill ten lesser furbolgs.$B$BHe has become a bloated and horrible beast! Our warriors have been unable to face him... do you have the strength to defeat him, $c?
english.completion: Your actions prove yourself a mighty warrior to me and all the Timbermaw! Let us hope the Winterfall will be defeated for good now...
english.completed: Return to Burndl near Winterfall Village in Winterspring.
english.giverWindow: Gorged on corrupted firewater, he towers over all furbolg.

text.title: 大地之怒
text.objectives: 使用塔尼尔的过载图腾，使4根冬泉大地图腾过载。
text.description: 虽然冬泉熊怪已堕落而且疯狂，但他们仍然能够运用萨满的力量。看到元素之力被用来伤害我的部族和其他无辜者，这令我非常不安。$B$B我们要用他们的图腾来对付他们！带上我的图腾，进入寒水村。在冬泉熊怪的图腾远处召唤它的力量，大地之怒就会在他们的图腾周围爆发！$B$B不用我多说吧……保持安全距离！
text.completion: May the Winterfall never threaten the Timbermaw again. Thank you, $n.
text.completed: Return to Tanrir near Winterfall Village in Winterspring.

english.title: Turning the Earth
english.objectives: Use Tanrir's Overcharged Totem to overload 4 Winterfall Earth Totems.
english.description: Despite their corruption and madness, the Winterfall barely cling to their shamanic powers. It disturbs me to see the power of the elements used by them to harm my tribe and other innocents.$B$BWe will turn their totems against them! Take my own totem with you into Winterfall Village. Use its powers on the Winterfall's totems from afar, and the fury of the earth will be unleashed on all nearby!$B$BNeedless to say... keep a safe distance!
english.completion: May the Winterfall never threaten the Timbermaw again. Thank you, $n.
english.completed: Return to Tanrir near Winterfall Village in Winterspring.

text.title: 雷矛的末日
text.objectives: 见证雷矛的末日。
text.description: 让我们先为英勇牺牲的兄弟奥尔库斯默哀吧。没有他，我们是不可能挫败雷矛矮人的。向你致敬，我的兄弟！$B$B<克鲁姆什单膝跪地。>$B$B$n，我深知你为这项计划付出的努力！因此，我让你来引爆四枚地精袖珍核弹。$B$B准备好了吗？为了部落！
text.completion: With the fingers destroyed and the hand shattered, the Stormpike will have no choice but to scurry back to their cave in Alterac Valley. Warchief Hellscream will hear about your bravery, $n. And rest assured that he will know of the Frostwolf clan's treason!
text.completed: 去找希尔斯布莱德塔伦米尔的高阶督军克鲁姆什。

english.title: Stormpike Apocalypse
english.objectives: Witness the Stormpike Apocalypse.
english.description: Before we continue, let us have a moment of silence for our fallen brother, Orkus, for without him, we would have been destroyed by the Stormpike onslaught. This is for you, brother!$B$B<Cromush takes a knee.>$B$BNow, $n, do not think that I forgot your part in all of this! That is why you get the honors of detonating the goblin pocket-nukes.$B$BAre you ready? FOR THE HORDE!
english.completion: With the fingers destroyed and the hand shattered, the Stormpike will have no choice but to scurry back to their cave in Alterac Valley. Warchief Hellscream will hear about your bravery, $n. And rest assured that he will know of the Frostwolf clan's treason!
english.completed: Speak to High Warlord Cromush at Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 花朵的力量
text.objectives: 抵御一大波僵尸攻击。
text.description: 你知道如何使用喷酸草了，但你知不知道，如果你使用向日葵的话，就可以更快地种下植物了呢？我们要种下一些向日葵，然后再种一些喷酸草，击退看守者斯蒂沃特的疯狂怪物。$B$B开始动手吧！
text.completion: I think that was just the start of it, bud! MORE INCOMING!
text.completed: Speak to Brazie the Botanist at Brazie's Farmstead in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: Flower Power
english.objectives: Survive a Massive Wave of Zombies.
english.description: You know how to use the spitters, but did you know that if you use a sunflower you can grow things faster? We'll grow some sunflowers and then we'll plant some spitters to push back Warden Stillwater's crazed monstrosities.$B$BLet's go!
english.completion: I think that was just the start of it, bud! MORE INCOMING!
english.completed: Speak to Brazie the Botanist at Brazie's Farmstead in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 巨石到货
text.objectives: 将盒装巨石交给永望镇的轻盈的莉莉丝。
text.description: 喏，我说话算数！盒装巨石。$B$B这是莉莉丝要的，对吧？她是我唯一的顾客！
text.progress: Oh, it's you again. Where's that boulder?
text.completion: Ah, you actually brought the boulder! I'm a bit surprised.$B$BStand back and witness the pinnacle of craftsmanship.

english.title: Boulder Delivery
english.objectives: Deliver the Boulder-in-a-Box to Lilith the Lithe in Everlook.
english.description: Here you go, as promised! One Boulder-in-a-Box.$B$BLilith was asking for this, wasn't she? She's my only customer!
english.progress: Oh, it's you again. Where's that boulder?
english.completion: Ah, you actually brought the boulder! I'm a bit surprised.$B$BStand back and witness the pinnacle of craftsmanship.

text.title: 大酋长的命令：阿拉希高地！
text.objectives: 去找阿拉希高地加林之陨的黑暗游侠阿莉娜。
text.description: 所有身强力壮的部落成员，从此刻起都要向加林之陨的黑暗游侠阿莉娜报到。黑暗女王的部队需要你们的帮助，以拓展部落的势力范围，并击退联盟入侵者。$B$B要前往阿拉希高地，就向希尔斯布莱德丘陵东部进发，穿过索拉丁之墙后沿着路继续走。$B$B命运在召唤！
text.completion: At last, the Warchief's reinforcements have arrived. The Dark Lady has plans for you, as she does for us.

english.title: Warchief's Command: Arathi Highlands!
english.objectives: Report to Dark Ranger Alina at Galen's Fall in Arathi Highlands.
english.description: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Dark Ranger Alina at Galen's Fall. The Dark Lady's forces need your help to expand the dominions of the Horde and drive back the Alliance interlopers.$B$BTo reach the Arathi Highlands, travel east from Hillsbrad Foothills and follow the road past Thoradin's Wall.$B$BDestiny calls!
english.completion: At last, the Warchief's reinforcements have arrived. The Dark Lady has plans for you, as she does for us.

text.title: 东点哨塔
text.objectives: 跟希尔斯布莱德丘陵东点哨塔的尼尔斯·毕若特谈一谈。
text.description: 东南方的前哨站遇到了麻烦。我并不清楚具体的状况……还是直接看信上怎么说吧：$B$B“兽人愈发暴躁了。赶紧派帮手来，不然我就狠狠地抽他们。”$B$B就这么两句话。信是哲人尼尔斯·毕若特写的。我完全看不懂啊。要不你去东点哨塔跑一趟，看看到底出了什么事？这写得不清不楚的，真是头痛！$B$B往南走，沿着东边的道路就可以抵达哨塔。
text.completion: That imbecile finally sent help, did he? These two orcs are a lost cause. They are stricken with something that I have termed "Durnholde Syndrome." They were both locked up for so long that they grew an affinity for their captors. Now they sit upon my couch with their big, iron balls and cry.$B$BHopefully you will prove to be more useful.

english.title: Eastpoint Tower
english.objectives: Speak to Nils Beerot at Eastpoint Tower in Hillsbrad Foothills.
english.description: Our outpost in the southeast is having some problems. I don't have any details other than... well, let me just read from the latest letter:$B$B"The orcs have grown petulant. Send help or I will have them beaten with reeds."$B$BThat's it. It was sent from our chief psylosopher, Nils Beerot. Yea, I have no idea what that means either. Could you please head to Eastpoint Tower and find out what he needs? I can't take any more of these cryptic letters!$B$BJust head south and then follow the road east.
english.completion: That imbecile finally sent help, did he? These two orcs are a lost cause. They are stricken with something that I have termed "Durnholde Syndrome." They were both locked up for so long that they grew an affinity for their captors. Now they sit upon my couch with their big, iron balls and cry.$B$BHopefully you will prove to be more useful.
